english: Foreword
zh_tw: 前言

english: In Waterdeep, a gold coin is called a dragon, and someone has hidden half a million dragons in the City of Splendors. Tyler Jacobson illustrates the villains hunting for the treasure. May the gods protect any adventurer who stands in their way!
zh_tw: 在深水城，金幣被稱為龍幣，有人將五十萬龍幣藏在了輝煌之城。泰勒·雅各布森為尋找寶藏的惡棍們繪製了插圖。願神明保佑任何擋在他們路上的冒險者！

english: A simple question began rattling around in my head over two years ago as I was bidding farewell to Barovia, dragging myself out of the depths of Maelstrom, and planning a yearlong expedition to Chult. Where do we go next? After mulling over several options, we decided it would be refreshing to return to civilization. Waterdeep: Dragon Heist is a treasure hunt with an urban backdrop. We've visited Waterdeep before, but not like this. Clever heroes will respect the city's rules. Those who get on the city's bad side are in for a rough time, as the City of Splendors is home to some of the most powerful figures in the Forgotten Realms.
zh_tw: 兩年前，當我告別巴洛維亞，從漩渦深淵中掙扎出來，計劃前往楚爾特進行為期一年的探險時，一個簡單的問題開始在我腦海中迴響。我們接下來去哪裡？經過反覆思考，我們決定回到文明社會將是令人耳目一新的。《深水城：龍金劫》是一場以都市為背景的尋寶遊戲。我們以前去過深水城，但不是像這次這樣。聰明的英雄會尊重這座城市的規則。那些得罪了這座城市的人將會有一段艱難的時光，因為輝煌之城是被遺忘的國度中最強大人物的家園。

english: Charlie Sanders, a lifelong D&D player, brought his experience writing for television to the project by helping flesh out the story bible months before work on the adventure was scheduled to begin. Matthew Mercer, whom you might know from the livestreamed show {@i Critical Role}, lent us his boundless imagination and helped flesh out the villains and their motives. A D&D adventure is only as good as its villains, and Waterdeep: Dragon Heist has multiple baddies to choose from.
zh_tw: 查理·桑德斯，一位終身《龍與地下城》玩家，早在冒險工作預定開始前幾個月，就利用他在電視寫作方面的經驗，幫助充實了故事手冊。馬修·默瑟，你可能從直播節目{@i Critical Role}中認識他，我們藉助了他無盡的想象力，幫助充實了反派及其動機。一部《龍與地下城》冒險的質量取決於其反派，而《深水城：龍金劫》有多個反派可供選擇。

english: Before I pull back the curtain and lead you into the heart of Waterdeep, I wish to thank Ed Greenwood for making the City of Splendors what it is: the kind of magical place you wish in your heart was real.
zh_tw: 在我拉開帷幕，帶領你進入深水城的心臟之前，我想感謝艾德·格林伍德，是他讓輝煌之城成為它現在的樣子：一個你內心深處希望它真實存在的神奇之地。

english: Introduction
zh_tw: 簡介

english: Welcome to Waterdeep, the Crown of the North, where a wondrous tale of urban adventure is about to unfold. Our story begins with the gathering of adventurers at the Yawning Portal Inn and Tavern. {@creature Volothamp "Volo" Geddarm|ToA|Volothamp Geddarm}, the famous explorer and raconteur, has a quest for them-one that entangles the characters in a bitter conflict between two nefarious organizations. If the adventurers complete his quest, Volo rewards them handsomely. Yet a much greater prize lies hidden somewhere in the City of Splendors, waiting to be claimed. Waterdeep: Dragon Heist is a Dungeons & Dragons adventure designed for characters starting at 1st level. By the end of the story, the characters will be at least 5th level. If you're planning to run through the adventure as a player, stop reading now!
zh_tw: 歡迎來到北地之冠——深水城，這裡將展開一段奇妙的都市冒險。我們的故事從冒險者們聚集在"呵欠之門"酒館和旅店開始。著名的探險家兼故事大王{@creature Volothamp "Volo" Geddarm|ToA|瓦羅贊普·格達姆}為他們準備了一項任務——這項任務將使角色們陷入兩個邪惡組織之間的激烈衝突。如果冒險者們完成了他的任務，瓦羅將慷慨地獎勵他們。然而，還有一個更大的獎賞隱藏在這座輝煌之城的某個角落，等待著被髮掘。深水城：龍金劫是一款為起始等級為1級角色設計的《龍與地下城》冒險。在故事結束時，角色們將至少達到5級。如果你打算以玩家身份參與這次冒險，請立即停止閱讀！

english: If you're looking for higher-level adventure content set in Waterdeep, a companion product titled {@i Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage} explores the vast dungeon under Waterdeep known as Undermountain and is designed for characters of levels all the way up to 20th.
zh_tw: 如果你在尋找更高等級的在深水城設定的冒險內容，一個名為{@i 深水城: 瘋法師的地城}的配套產品探索了深水城下被稱為地脈迷城的廣闊地牢，並設計為適合角色等級一直提升到第20級的冒險。

english: Story Overview
zh_tw: 故事梗概

english: Waterdeep: Dragon Heist is a treasure hunt set against an urban backdrop. The adventure's plot can be summarized as follows:
zh_tw: 《深水城：龍金劫》是一場在都市背景下進行的尋寶遊戲。這個冒險的情節可以概括如下：

english: Half a million gold coins are hidden somewhere in Waterdeep. Many individuals know about the cache and are looking for it. Adventurers can join the hunt and prevent the cache from falling into evil hands.
zh_tw: 五十萬金幣被藏在深水城的某個地方。許多人知道這個藏寶地點，並且正在尋找它。冒險者可以加入這場搜尋，並阻止寶藏落入邪惡之手。

english: The city is threatened by escalating tension between two power groups that is on the verge of flaring into violence. The Zhentarim, a shadowy network of mercenaries, and {@creature Xanathar|WDH}, the beholder crime lord of Waterdeep, are at odds, and when they clash, the characters are pulled into the conflict.
zh_tw: 城市正受到兩個權力集團之間不斷升級的緊張局勢威脅，這種緊張局勢即將爆發成暴力衝突。散塔林會，一個由僱傭兵組成的神秘網路，以及{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}，深水城的眼魔犯罪領主，兩者之間存在分歧，當他們發生衝突時，角色們被捲入了這場紛爭。

english: Cache of Dragons
zh_tw: 龍金劫

english: In Waterdeep, a gold coin is called a dragon. Before he was ousted from his position as the Open Lord of Waterdeep, Dagult Neverember embezzled half a million dragons and hid them in a secret vault. As a security precaution, he arranged for all knowledge of the vault's location and defenses to be magically erased from his mind and the minds of his subordinates. The wizard who performed the procedure trapped this knowledge within an artifact called the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}. The wizard disappeared shortly thereafter, and Dagult hid the stone in the Palace of Waterdeep.
zh_tw: 在深水城，金幣被稱為龍幣。在他被趕下深水城公開領主的位置之前，達格魯特·無燼侵吞了五十萬龍幣，並把它們藏在了一個秘密金庫中。作為安全措施，他安排將金庫的位置和防禦措施的所有知識從他和他的下屬的記憶中魔法抹除。執行這個程式的法師將這些知識困在了一個叫做{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}的神器中。法師不久後消失了，達格魯特將這塊石頭藏在了深水宮裡。

english: Dagult was off rebuilding the city of Neverwinter when the other Lords of Waterdeep voted him out of office. He immediately made plans to retrieve the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} and smuggle his cache of dragons out of Waterdeep. His spies plucked the stone from the palace but were killed while trying to leave the city. The stone was stolen and passed from one hand to another like a common jewel until it wound up in the clutches of {@creature Xanathar|WDH}.
zh_tw: 當其他深水城的領主投票罷免達格魯特的職位時，他正在重建無冬城。他立即計劃取回{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}並將他的龍類寶藏走私出深水城。他的間諜從宮殿中盜走了寶石，但在試圖離開城市時被殺。這塊寶石像普通珠寶一樣被偷來偷去，直到落入{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的手中。

english: The {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} is actually an aboleth transformed by magic. In this inanimate state, the aboleth can read the mind of any creature that attunes to the stone, as well as modify that creature's memory. A creature attuned to the stone can also extract information from the aboleth, including lore about Neverember's vault.
zh_tw: {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}實際上是一個被魔法轉化的底棲魔魚。在這種無生命的狀態下，底棲魔魚可以讀取任何與石頭調諧的生物的思想，並修改該生物的記憶。與石頭調諧的生物也可以從底棲魔魚那裡提取資訊，包括關於無燼寶庫的知識。

english: Built long ago by dwarves, the vault is warded against all forms of magical detection and intrusion. Its current protector is an adult gold dragon named {@creature Aurinax|WDH}, who is also the current wielder and guardian of the {@item dragonstaff of Ahghairon|WDH}, which has the power to prevent other dragons from entering the city. In exchange for the staff, {@creature Aurinax|WDH} promised to guard the gold until such time as Neverember or his appointed vassals removed it.
zh_tw: 很久以前由矮人建造的金庫，被施加了防止所有形式的魔法偵測和入侵的保護。它現在的守護者是一條成年金龍，名為{@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯}，它同時也是{@item dragonstaff of Ahghairon|WDH|阿蓋爾倫的龍杖}的當前持有者和守護者，這根法杖擁有阻止其他龍進入城市的力量。作為交換法杖的條件，{@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯}承諾將守護這些金子，直到無燼或他指定的封臣將其移走。

english: Using the Poster Map
zh_tw: 使用海報地圖

english: The {@adventure map in the back of this book|WDH|14} has the city of Waterdeep on both sides. One side can be shown to players. The other side is for the DM and includes tags marking important locations in the adventure.
zh_tw: 本書末尾的{@adventure 本書末尾的地圖|WDH|14}兩面都印有深水城。其中一面可向玩家展示。另一面供地下城主使用，上面標記了冒險中重要位置的標籤。

english: War in the Streets
zh_tw: 街頭戰爭

english: Beneath the city streets lurks a criminal underworld, its leader a beholder called {@creature Xanathar|WDH}. Hoping to gain a political foothold in Waterdeep, agents of the Zhentarim (also known as the Black Network) recently tried to ally their organization with the Xanathar Guild. The architect of this attempt was a clone of the wizard {@creature Manshoon|WDH}, a founder of the Black Network long thought dead.
zh_tw: 在城市街道之下潛伏著一個罪犯的陰暗世界，其領導者是一個名為{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的眼魔。希望在深水城中獲得政治基礎的散塔林會（也被稱為黑網）的代理人最近試圖將其組織與姍娜薩公會結盟。這次嘗試的策劃者是巫師{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的一個克隆體，他是黑網的創始人，長期以來被認為已經死亡。

english: While the two sides were negotiating in {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s lair, the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} suddenly disappeared from where {@creature Xanathar|WDH} had hidden it. The paranoid beholder accused the Black Network of stealing it and slew the Zhentarim envoys who were present. When the Zhents retaliated by attacking Xanathar Guild outposts, {@creature Xanathar|WDH} took their actions as confirmation of the Black Network's vile intentions. Now the bad blood between the Zhentarim and {@creature Xanathar|WDH} has begun to spill into the streets, threatening peace throughout the city.
zh_tw: 當雙方在{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的巢穴中進行談判時，{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}突然從{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}藏匿它的地方消失了。這個多疑的眼魔指責黑網偷走了它，並殺死了在場的散塔林會使者。當散塔林會透過襲擊姍娜薩公會的據點進行報復時，{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}將他們的行為視為黑網邪惡意圖的確認。如今，散塔林會與{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}之間的仇恨已經開始蔓延到街頭，威脅著整個城市的和平。

english: Who actually stole the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}? The answer: a rock gnome named Dalakhar. After Lord Neverember used magic to discern the gemstone's location, he sent forth a succession of spies to infiltrate {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s lair and obtain it. Dalakhar succeeded where many others before him had failed, but his success turns out to be short-lived.
zh_tw: 到底是誰偷走了{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}？答案是：一個名叫達拉卡爾的岩石侏儒。在無燼領主使用魔法確定了寶石的位置後，他派出一系列的間諜潛入{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的巢穴並取得它。達拉卡爾在他之前的許多人失敗的地方成功了，但他的成功最終證明是短暫的。

english: Volo's Quest
zh_tw: 瓦羅的任務

english: The Yawning Portal serves as the default starting point for this story. One of the first people the adventurers meet there is Volothamp Geddarm. He has just returned from a tour promoting his latest book, {@book Volo's Guide to Monsters|vgm}, and he has a quest for the characters.
zh_tw: 呵欠之門是本次故事的預設起始地點。冒險者們在那裡最先遇到的人之一是瓦羅贊普·格達姆。他剛剛完成了推廣新書{@book 瓦羅怪物指南|vgm}的巡迴宣傳活動，並有一個任務要交給玩家們。

english: One of Volo's friends, a handsome simpleton named {@creature Floon Blagmaar|WDH}, has disappeared, seemingly kidnapped. The search for Floon leads to the revelation that he was caught up in a case of mistaken identity, and the characters are actually looking for two victims. The intended target was Lord Neverember's estranged son, {@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh}. Agents of the Zhentarim waylaid him because they want to know everything that Renaer knows about the cache of dragons. (Unfortunately for them, Renaer is ignorant of the cache and its whereabouts). If the characters rescue him, Renaer proves to be a worthy ally to adventurers hoping to make a name for themselves in Waterdeep.
zh_tw: 瓦羅的一個朋友，一個名叫{@creature Floon Blagmaar|WDH|福盧恩·布拉格瑪}的英俊傻瓜失蹤了，似乎被綁架了。尋找福盧恩的行動揭示了他被捲入了身份錯誤的情況下，實際上角色們正在尋找兩名受害者。真正的目標是洛斯諾布勳爵疏遠的兒子{@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh|瑞納爾·無燼}。散塔林會的特工攔截了他，因為他們想知道瑞納爾所掌握的關於龍金劫的一切。（對他們來說不幸的是，瑞納爾對寶藏及其所在位置一無所知）。如果角色們救了他，瑞納爾將證明自己是那些希望在深水城揚名立萬的冒險者們值得信賴的盟友。

english: As a reward for rescuing Floon, Volo gives adventurers the deed to a building in the North Ward that looks out onto a wide cul-de-sac hemmed in by old residences and shops. The property used to be a tavern with a residence on the upper floors. The tavern has been closed for years, and the residence is haunted by a poltergeist that the characters can lay to rest.
zh_tw: 作為救援福盧恩的獎勵，瓦羅給冒險者們提供了位於北區的一棟建築的產權，這棟建築俯瞰著一個被舊住宅和商店包圍的寬闊死衚衕。該物業過去曾是一家酒館，上面幾層是住宅。酒館已經關閉多年，而住宅被一個作祟幽靈鬧鬼，角色們可以讓它安息。

english: Ahghairon's Dragonward
zh_tw: 阿蓋爾倫的龍之結界

english: Waterdeep is blanketed by an undispellable magical effect called {@i Ahghairon's dragonward}. The effect originates from somewhere under Ahghairon's Tower in the Castle Ward and is permanent. Dragons and all other creatures of the dragon type are physically unable to enter the city (or its sewers) as long as the dragonward persists. The effect doesn't extend to the harbor or into Undermountain.
zh_tw: 深水城被一種不可解除的魔法效應所覆蓋，稱為{@i 阿蓋爾倫的龍之結界}。這種效應源自城堡區阿蓋爾倫塔下的某處，並且是永久性的。只要龍之結界存在，龍類以及所有其他龍類生物都無法物理上進入城市（或其下水道）。這種效應並不會延伸到港口或地脈迷城。

english: A creature of the dragon type that is touched by the {@item dragonstaff of Ahghairon|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix A|WDH|11}) can ignore {@i Ahghairon's dragonward} and move through the city freely. The effect lasts until the creature is touched again by the staff, or until the passage of a period of time specified by one who is attuned to the staff.
zh_tw: 被{@item dragonstaff of Ahghairon|WDH|阿蓋爾倫的龍杖}（見{@adventure 附錄A|WDH|11}）觸碰的龍類生物可以無視{@i 阿蓋爾倫的龍之結界}，並在城市中自由移動。該效果持續到生物再次被龍杖觸碰，或與龍杖調諧者指定的時間結束為止。

english: The {@i dragonstaff} is currently in the possession of an adult gold dragon named {@creature Aurinax|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), who guards a hidden vault under the city.
zh_tw: {@i 龍杖}目前由一隻名為{@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯}的成年金龍持有（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），他守護著城市地下的一個隱秘金庫。

english: Fireball!
zh_tw: 火球術！

english: As time goes on, the characters attract the attention of local factions hoping to recruit them while they settle into the city. Eventually, these relatively peaceful times are shattered when a fireball detonates near their new residence. The characters are swept up in the aftermath of this horrific event and can try to get to the bottom of it. Who cast the {@spell fireball} spell and why? Who was the intended target? They can investigate the incident on behalf of a guild or a faction, or they can become involved for reasons of their own.
zh_tw: 隨著時間的推移，角色們吸引了當地派系的注意，這些派系希望在他們定居城市時招募他們。最終，這些相對和平的時光被一顆火球在他們新居附近爆炸所打破。角色們被捲入了這一可怕事件的餘波中，並可以嘗試查明真相。是誰施放了{@spell fireball||火球術}法術？為什麼？目標是誰？他們可以代表某個公會或派系調查這一事件，或者出於自己的原因參與其中。

english: One casualty of the fireball is in fact its intended target: Lord Neverember's spy, Dalakhar. Whoever killed the gnome now has the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, the key to finding the lost cache of dragons. One way or another, depending on the alliances-and the enemies-they have made in the city, the characters become embroiled in the chase for the stone and the hoard it protects.
zh_tw: 火球的一名受害者實際上是其預定目標：無燼領主的間諜，達拉卡爾。無論是誰殺死了這個侏儒，現在都擁有了{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，這是找到龍類遺失寶藏的關鍵。無論如何，根據他們在城市中建立的聯盟——以及他們所樹的敵，角色們捲入了對這塊石頭及其所保護的財寶的追逐之中。

english: Choose Your Villain
zh_tw: 選擇你的反派

english: When you run this adventure, you choose its main villain at the outset. Your choice determines the season of the year in which the story takes place, as well as the antagonists in several of the encounters in chapter 4. The villain you choose opposes the player characters, while the villains you don't choose become part of the backdrop and could help the characters or hinder them.
zh_tw: 當你進行這個冒險時，你需要在開始時選擇主要的反派角色。你的選擇決定了故事發生的一年中的季節，以及第4章中一些遭遇的對手。你選擇的反派角色會與玩家角色作對，而你沒有選擇的反派角色則成為背景的一部分，他們可能會幫助角色或阻礙他們。

english: As another unusual feature of this adventure, the villains aren't meant to be killed, nor are they out to kill the player characters. The villains are after a treasure hoard, and the adventurers' ultimate goal is to keep the treasure out of their clutches.
zh_tw: 作為這次冒險的一個不尋常特點，反派角色並不是為了被殺死，他們也不打算殺死玩家角色。反派角色在追尋一批寶藏，而冒險者的最終目標是阻止寶藏落入他們的手中。

english: You can swap out one villain for another at any time. For example, if you decide halfway through the adventure that because of how the story has progressed {@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH} would make a better antagonist than {@creature Xanathar|WDH}, you can make that change on the fly and run subsequent encounters accordingly.
zh_tw: 你可以隨時將一個反派替換為另一個。例如，如果你在冒險中途決定，由於故事的發展，{@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH|賈拉索·班瑞}會比{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}更適合作為反派，你可以立即進行這種調整，並相應地安排後續的遭遇戰。

english: Each villain is fully described in appendix B and summarized below.
zh_tw: 每個反派角色在附錄B中有詳細描述，並在下文進行了總結。

english: Xanathar
zh_tw: 姍娜薩

english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH} is a paranoid, megalomaniacal beholder crime lord whose goal is to wipe out anyone it perceives as a Zhentarim operative or sympathizer, retrieve the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, and secure the cache of dragons. Its base is a dungeon under Skullport, a subterranean settlement beneath Waterdeep. This lair is described in chapter 5.
zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩} 是一個多疑、狂妄自大的眼魔犯罪領主，其目標是消滅所有它認為是散塔林會行動人員或同情者的人，奪回{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，並確保龍幣寶藏。它的基地是位於骷髏港下的地牢，骷髏港是深水城下面的一個地下定居點。這個巢穴在第5章中有描述。

english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH} has a healthy fear of {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH} and is inclined to spare those in her employ, to avoid provoking a conflict with Waterdeep's Open Lord. Adventurers who incur the wrath of the beholder can use its fear of Laeral to escape certain death.
zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}對{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}有著深深的忌憚，往往會放過她的下屬，以避免與深水城公開領主發生衝突。招致眼魔之怒的冒險者可以利用它對萊拉的恐懼來逃過一劫。

english: If you choose {@creature Xanathar|WDH} as the villain, the adventure takes place in the spring.
zh_tw: 如果你選擇{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}作為反派，冒險將在春天展開。

english: The Cassalanters
zh_tw: 卡薩蘭特家族

english: Victoro and {@creature Ammalia Cassalanter|WDH} are Waterdavian nobles and secret devil worshipers. The Cassalanters plan to use the cache of dragons to buy back the souls of their children, which they traded to Asmodeus for power. Their estate, Cassalanter Villa, has a temple of Asmodeus hidden underneath it, as described in chapter 6.
zh_tw: 維克托羅和{@creature Ammalia Cassalanter|WDH|阿瑪利亞·卡薩蘭特}是深水城的貴族，也是秘密崇拜魔鬼的人。卡薩蘭特家族計劃使用龍幣寶藏來贖回他們孩子的魂魄，他們曾將孩子們的魂魄交易給阿斯蒙蒂斯以換取力量。他們的莊園，卡薩蘭特別墅，下面隱藏著一個阿斯蒙蒂斯的神廟，如第6章所述。

english: The Cassalanters try to misdirect and discredit the characters rather than murder them. Victoro and Ammalia rely on their noble status to protect them, and the last thing they want is the City Watch on their doorstep.
zh_tw: 卡薩蘭特家族試圖誤導和詆譭角色們，而不是殺害他們。維克托羅和阿瑪利亞依靠他們的貴族地位來保護自己，他們最不想看到的就是城市守衛出現在他們的家門口。

english: If you choose the Cassalanters as the villains, the adventure takes place in the summer.
zh_tw: 如果你選擇卡薩蘭特家族作為反派，冒險故事發生在夏天。

english: Jarlaxle Baenre
zh_tw: 賈拉索·班瑞

english: {@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH} is a drow swashbuckler and the secret lord of Luskan, the City of Sails. Jarlaxle plans to use the cache of dragons to buy his way into the Lords' Alliance, a confederation of cities and towns that band together against common threats. Jarlaxle also wants the {@item dragonstaff of Ahghairon|WDH} for leverage in his negotiations. In the magical guise of a human sea captain named Zardoz Zord, Jarlaxle runs a traveling carnival called the Sea Maidens Faire and lairs aboard a ship in Waterdeep's harbor that has a submarine (the {@i Scarlet Marpenoth}) underneath it, as described in chapter 7.
zh_tw: {@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH|賈拉索·班瑞} 是一個黑暗精靈冒險家，也是帆之城路斯坎的秘密領主。賈拉索計劃使用龍幣寶藏來購買進入領主聯盟的方式，領主聯盟是一個城市和小鎮的聯盟，他們聯合起來對抗共同的威脅。賈拉索還想要{@item dragonstaff of Ahghairon|WDH|阿蓋爾倫的龍杖}作為他在談判中的籌碼。以一個名叫扎多茲·佐德的人類船長的魔法偽裝下，賈拉索經營著一個名為海之少女嘉年華的旅行嘉年華，並在深水城港口的一艘船上設有巢穴，這艘船下面有一艘潛水艇（{@i 緋紅瑪佩諾斯}），如第7章所述。

english: Jarlaxle delights in thwarting his enemies, enjoys the complications that arise when adventurers try to meddle in his affairs, and loves to see the looks on their faces when he finally gets the better of them. He doesn't suffer fools who threaten him, however. If forced into a violent confrontation, he swiftly and brutally kills someone to make an example of them and then walks off.
zh_tw: 賈拉索喜歡挫敗他的敵人，喜歡冒險者試圖幹預他的事務時出現的複雜情況，並且喜歡看當他最終佔上風時他們臉上的表情。然而，他不會容忍威脅他的傻瓜。如果被迫進行暴力對抗，他會迅速而殘酷地殺掉某人以示警告，然後走開。

english: If you choose Jarlaxle as the villain, the adventure takes place in the autumn.
zh_tw: 如果您選擇賈拉索作為反派，冒險發生在秋天。

english: Manshoon
zh_tw: 曼松

english: A clone of the wizard {@creature Manshoon|WDH}, one of the founders of the Zhentarim, is hiding in Waterdeep. He wants to rule the city, by claiming the cache of dragons and by using that wealth to bribe the Masked Lords into making him the new Open Lord. He also wants to regain control of the Black Network. {@creature Manshoon|WDH} lurks in Kolat Towers, a pair of wizards' towers in the Trades Ward. This residence is described in chapter 8.
zh_tw: 法師{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的克隆體，是散塔林會的創始人之一，正隱藏在深水城。他想要透過聲稱擁有龍幣寶藏，並利用這筆財富賄賂蒙面領主們，使他成為新的公開領主，從而統治這座城市。他還想要重新控制黑網。{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}潛伏在克拉特雙塔，這是位於商業區的一對法師塔。這個住所在第8章中有描述。

english: {@creature Manshoon|WDH} creates copies of himself using the {@spell simulacrum} spell and takes great pains to conceal his identity, since his success hinges on not attracting the attention of others who would seek to thwart him before his plans come to fruition. {@creature Manshoon|WDH} avoids unnecessary confrontations with adventurers; only those who enter his extradimensional sanctum are likely to incur his wrath.
zh_tw: {@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松} 使用 {@spell simulacrum||擬像術} 法術創造自己的複製品，並極力隱藏自己的身份，因為他的成功依賴於不引起那些可能在他計劃完成前試圖阻止他的人的注意。{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松} 儘量避免與冒險者發生不必要的衝突；只有那些進入他的異次元聖所的人才可能激怒他。

english: If you choose {@creature Manshoon|WDH} as the villain, the adventure takes place in the winter.
zh_tw: 如果您選擇{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}作為反派，冒險發生在冬天。

english: Seasons
zh_tw: 季節

english: The adventure unfolds in a particular season depending on the villain you choose at the outset. If you switch to a new villain midway through the adventure, don't change the season to match unless the characters take enough downtime for seasons to change naturally.
zh_tw: 冒險故事根據你在開始時選擇的反派角色在特定的季節展開。如果你在冒險中途切換到一個新的反派角色，除非角色們有足夠的休息時間讓季節自然更替，否則不要改變季節以匹配。

english: Spring
zh_tw: 春

english: In Waterdeep, early spring tends to be cold and damp. Misty rain falls for days on end. It's common for fog to settle at night and last through the day. As the weather improves, the city attracts more visitors, and the streets become increasingly crowded as summer approaches.
zh_tw: 在深水城，初春通常寒冷潮溼。霧雨連綿數日。夜晚常有霧氣降臨，並且持續到白天。隨著天氣的改善，城市吸引了更多的訪客，隨著夏天的臨近，街道變得越來越擁擠。

english: Summer
zh_tw: 夏

english: Summers in Waterdeep are quite comfortable, and it's a great time for citizens and visitors to congregate outside. The markets are busier than at any other time of year. Sometimes, though, warm air pushes up from the south and settles in the valleys north and east of the city. This air gets trapped, creating a hot spell that might last days or weeks. Activity in the city slows to a crawl, since Waterdavians are unaccustomed to such heat.
zh_tw: 深水城的夏天相當宜人，是市民和遊客聚集在戶外的好時機。市場比一年中任何其他時間都要繁忙。然而，有時從南方吹來的暖空氣會上升到城市北部和東部的山谷中並停滯。這股空氣被困住，形成了可能持續數天或數週的熱浪。由於深水城居民不習慣這樣的高溫，城市的活動會減緩到爬行速度。

english: Autumn
zh_tw: 秋

english: Throughout autumn, wagonloads of food arrive in Waterdeep from outlying farms. Without this bounty, city folk would starve during the winter. Cold, howling sea winds remind Waterdavians that winter is near.
zh_tw: 整個秋天，滿載食物的馬車從周邊農場抵達深水城。沒有這些豐收，城市居民在冬天會捱餓。寒冷、呼嘯的海風提醒深水城居民冬天即將來臨。

english: Winter
zh_tw: 冬

english: Waterdavian winters are harsh. As snow piles up around the city and ice fills the harbor, trade grinds to a halt and the city seals its gates. Citizens willing to brave the cold still gather in local taverns and festhalls, but few venture outside the city walls.
zh_tw: 深水城的冬天非常嚴酷。當雪堆積在城市周圍，冰填滿港口，貿易就會陷入停滯，城市封閉其城門。願意忍受寒冷的市民仍然聚集在本地酒館和節日大廳，但很少有人冒險走出城牆。

english: Faerûnian Calendar
zh_tw: 費倫歷

english: The Faerûnian calendar has twelve months that roughly correspond to the months of the Gregorian calendar. Each month has thirty days divided into three ten-day weeks (each week is called a tenday). Scattered throughout the year are five holidays that aren't considered part of any month. Once every four years, the holiday of Shieldmeet is added to the calendar as a leap day immediately following Midsummer night. Collectively, these days create a cycle similar to what we have on Earth: three 365-day years followed by a leap year.
zh_tw: 費倫日曆有十二個月，大致對應於公曆的月份。每個月有三十天，分為三個十天的周（每個周稱為一個旬）。全年散佈著五個節日，這些節日不被認為是任何一個月的一部分。每四年，盾會節這個節日會被新增到日曆中，作為仲夏夜之後的閏日。總的來說，這些日子創造了一個類似於我們在地球上的週期：三個365天的年份，隨後是一個閏年。

english: Months
zh_tw: 月曆

english: The Faerûnian months are Hammer, Alturiak, Ches, Tarsakh, Mirtul, Kythorn, Flamerule, Eleasis, Eleint, Marpenoth, Uktar, and Nightal.
zh_tw: 費倫的月份依次是：錘子（錘月），阿爾圖里亞克（阿爾圖里亞克月），切斯（切斯月），塔薩克（塔薩克月），米爾圖（米爾圖月），凱索恩（基索恩月），弗萊姆魯爾（弗萊姆魯爾），伊萊西斯（伊萊西斯月），伊萊恩特（伊萊恩特月），瑪佩諾斯（瑪佩諾斯月），烏克塔爾（烏克塔爾月），和奈塔爾（奈塔爾月）。

english: Annual Holidays
zh_tw: 年度節日

english: The annual holidays are Midwinter (between Hammer and Alturiak), Greengrass (between Tarsakh and Mirtul), Midsummer (between Flamerule and Eleasis), Highharvestide (between Eleint and Marpenoth), and the Feast of the Moon (between Uktar and Nightal).
zh_tw: 年度節日包括：冬至（位於錘月和阿爾圖里亞克月之間），綠草節（位於塔薩克月和米爾圖月之間），仲夏（位於弗萊姆魯爾和伊萊西斯月之間），豐收節（位於伊萊恩特月和瑪佩諾斯月之間），以及月之盛宴（位於烏克塔爾月和奈塔爾月之間）。

zh_tw: 太陽照耀著深水城的海港

english: Adventure Structure
zh_tw: 冒險故事結構

english: Waterdeep: Dragon Heist consists of an introductory adventure designed to familiarize player characters with the city of Waterdeep and provide them with a base of operations (chapters 1 and 2), followed by a citywide treasure hunt (chapters 3 and 4) and descriptions of the villains' lairs (chapters 5 through 8).
zh_tw: 《深水城：龍金劫》由一個介紹性的冒險組成，旨在讓玩家角色熟悉深水城這座城市，併為他們提供一個行動基地（第1章和第2章），隨後是全城範圍的尋寶活動（第3章和第4章），以及對反派巢穴的描述（第5章至第8章）。

english: In chapter 1, the characters arrive at the Yawning Portal, where Volo gives them a quest. It's a straightforward rescue mission with a twist involving a case of mistaken identity. If the adventurers complete the quest, Volo rewards them with a valuable piece of property.
zh_tw: 在第1章中，角色們抵達了呵欠之門，那裡瓦羅給他們一個任務。這是一個直接的救援任務，其中有一個涉及身份誤認的轉折。如果冒險者們完成了任務，瓦羅會用一塊有價值的地產來獎勵他們。

english: In chapter 2, the characters explore their new home in Trollskull Alley and attract the attention of factions interested in recruiting them for special missions.
zh_tw: 在第2章中，角色們探索他們在巨魔顱骨巷的新家，並吸引了一些派系的注意，這些派系希望招募他們執行特殊任務。

english: Chapter 3 begins days or weeks later, allowing characters time to adjust to city life and pursue their own interests. An explosion tears through Trollskull Alley, prompting an investigation that hurls the characters into conflict with some secondary villains, culminating in a bloody confrontation at a noble estate.
zh_tw: 第3章在幾天或幾周後開始，允許角色們有時間適應城市生活並追求自己的興趣。一場爆炸穿過巨魔顱骨巷，引發了一項調查，將角色們捲入與一些次要反派的衝突，最終在一座貴族莊園發生了血腥的對抗。

english: In chapter 4, the characters race to find the gold. The encounters in this chapter and the order in which they occur change depending on the villain you've chosen. The chapter concludes with the discovery of Lord Neverember's treasure vault and a showdown with its gold dragon guardian. The characters' ultimate goal is to prevent the gold from falling into the hands of the bad guys. If all goes well, some of the gold will find its way into the characters' pockets. Characters will have a hard time claiming it all for themselves, however.
zh_tw: 在第4章中，角色們競相尋找黃金。這一章中的遭遇以及它們的發生順序會根據您選擇的反派而改變。本章以發現無燼領主的寶藏庫和與它的金龍守衛的對決結束。角色們的最終目標是防止黃金落入壞人之手。如果一切順利，一些黃金將進入角色們的口袋。然而，角色們很難全部據為己有。

english: Chapters 5 through 8 describe the lairs of the story's villains and can be used at any time, in any order, or not at all. The characters might have reason to visit one or more of these lairs in the course of the adventure. Thwarting the villains doesn't require the characters to invade their lairs or defeat them in combat, so it's possible to complete the adventure without these chapters coming into play.
zh_tw: 第5章到第8章描述了故事中反派的巢穴，可以在任何時間、以任何順序使用，或者根本不用。角色們在冒險過程中可能有必要訪問一個或多個這樣的巢穴。阻止反派並不要求角色們侵入他們的巢穴或在戰鬥中擊敗他們，所以有可能在不涉及這些章節的情況下完成冒險。

english: Be prepared to make adjustments on the fly if the characters find themselves in a villain's lair prior to completing chapter 4, as the challenges within each lair are difficult for characters of lower than 5th level to overcome. You can gently steer characters in a different direction, drop hints that urge them to use extreme caution, or make deadly encounters easier. It also bears remembering that the villains are meant to be thwarted, not killed, and they are rarely spoiling for a fight. Adventurers who get in over their heads can be knocked {@condition unconscious} rather than killed. Such characters might awaken in an alley, a sewer tunnel, or a prison cell, with or without their gear. Conversely, they might awaken safe and sound with all their gear in a private residence, being cared for by friendly NPCs who took them in.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在完成第四章之前意外進入了反派的巢穴，請隨時準備好進行調整，因為這些巢穴內的挑戰對於低於5級的角色來說過於困難。你可以巧妙地引導角色們前往其他方向，給予他們需要極度小心的提示，或者簡化致命的遭遇。此外，記住反派們是被設計來被挫敗的，而不是被殺死，他們通常並不急著引發戰鬥。角色們如果陷入困境，可以選擇被擊{@condition unconscious||昏迷}而非死亡。這些角色可能會在一條小巷、下水道隧道或監獄牢房中醒來，他們的裝備可能還在，也可能丟失。相反地，他們也可能會在一處私人住所中安全無恙地醒來，所有的裝備都在，並且被友好的NPC照料著。

english: Life in Waterdeep
zh_tw: 深水城的生活

english: City-based adventures can be challenging to run, especially if your player characters are inclined to wander. Keeping the characters in Waterdeep, where the action is, requires that they feel at home. To that end, here are some points to keep in mind:
zh_tw: 以城市為背景的冒險活動可能很難進行，特別是如果您的玩家角色傾向於閒逛。要讓角色們留在深水城，即行動發生的地方，需要讓他們感到賓至如歸。為此，這裡有一些要點需要記住：

english: Almost anything can be bought or sold in Waterdeep. There's no need for adventurers to shop elsewhere.
zh_tw: 在深水城幾乎可以買到或出售任何東西。冒險者們沒有必要去其他地方購物。

english: Waterdavians generally hold adventurers in high regard, given that many of the city's most esteemed citizens are former adventurers and that the city has been saved countless times by adventurers over the years.
zh_tw: 深水城的居民通常對冒險者非常尊敬，因為許多城市中最受尊敬的市民都是前冒險者，而且多年來城市多次被冒險者拯救。

english: Adventurers who are invested in the city are less likely to want to leave it. As your players flesh out their characters' backgrounds, encourage them to establish roots in Waterdeep. The adventure further invests the characters by awarding them property in the city and giving them opportunities to join local factions and guilds.
zh_tw: 對城市有投入的冒險者們不太可能想要離開它。當您的玩家們完善他們角色的背景時，鼓勵他們在深水城建立根基。這次冒險透過在城市中獎勵他們地產，並給予他們加入當地派系和公會的機會，進一步增加了角色們的投入。

english: Breaking the Law
zh_tw: 違反法律

english: Waterdeep is a city of firm laws and swift justice. Adventurers hell-bent on slaughter and plunder won't fare well in the City of Splendors. The punishments for assault, arson, theft, and murder are severe, regardless of the reason for the crime.
zh_tw: 深水城是一個法律嚴明、司法迅速的城市。那些決心屠殺和掠奪的冒險者在壯麗之城不會過得好。無論是出於何種原因，對攻擊、縱火、盜竊和謀殺的懲罰都是嚴厲的。

english: If the characters express interest in knowing more about crimes and punishments in Waterdeep, give them the Code Legal handout in appendix C.
zh_tw: 如果角色們表示對瞭解深水城的犯罪和懲罰感興趣，可以給他們附錄C中的《法律法典》手冊。

english: Characters who overtly engage in criminal behavior are quickly cornered and arrested by members of the City Watch. Those charged with committing a crime are brought before a magister to be judged. Advocates might intercede on behalf of the characters if they have allied themselves with influential NPCs and factions. For example, characters who become agents of the Lords' Alliance are more likely to be excused for crimes if {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH}, the Open Lord of Waterdeep, has cause to let them off the hook.
zh_tw: 公開從事犯罪行為的角色很快就會被城市守衛的成員圍捕並逮捕。被指控犯罪的人將被帶到地方法官面前接受審判。如果角色與有影響力的NPC和派系結盟，辯護人可能會代表他們進行幹預。例如，成為領主聯盟代理人的角色，如果深水城的公開領主{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}有理由讓他們脫鉤，更有可能被免除罪責。

english: Given how strictly laws are enforced in Waterdeep, it's possible that the adventure could end with one or more of the characters being exiled, sentenced to several years of hard labor, imprisoned, or put to death. If that's how their adventure ends, so be it. Hopefully, your next group will fare better.
zh_tw: 鑑於深水城的法律執行得非常嚴格，冒險活動有可能以一個或多個角色被流放、被判處多年苦役、監禁或被處死而告終。如果他們的冒險以這種方式結束，那就順其自然。希望你們的下一個團隊會有更好運氣。

english: Arresting Characters
zh_tw: 逮捕角色

english: When the authorities show up to arrest one or more player characters for breaking the law, you can handle the arrest in one of two ways.
zh_tw: 噹噹局出現要逮捕一個或多個違反法律的玩家角色時，您可以用兩種方式之一來處理這次逮捕。

english: The first approach is to roleplay the encounter with the arresting officers of the City Watch. The benefit of this approach is that characters can choose to go quietly or resist. The drawback is that the encounter might devolve into a fight-or-flight situation, leading to one or more characters becoming fugitives. If the party includes one or more characters who aren't lawful, such an outcome is likely. To mitigate this drawback, you might allow fugitive characters to forge alliances with NPCs who can help clear their names.
zh_tw: 第一種方法是透過角色扮演與城市守衛的逮捕官員相遇。這種方法的好處是角色可以選擇平靜地去或抵抗。缺點是這次遭遇可能會演變成戰鬥或逃跑的情況，導致一個或多個角色成為逃犯。如果團隊中包括一個或多個不守法的角色，這樣的結果很可能發生。為了減輕這個缺點，你可以允許逃犯角色與能夠幫助澄清他們名譽的NPC建立聯盟。

english: If the threat of arrest becomes tedious, you can switch to the second approach, which is to merely inform the players that one or more characters have been arrested. You can describe the arrest, the subsequent detention, and the events leading up to the trial. The drawback to this approach is that player characters have no control over the situation. (This sense of helplessness has the virtue of being realistic, if not fun.) To mitigate this drawback, you might allow characters to make ability checks to influence the outcome; for example, a successful Charisma (Persuasion) check might enable a character to bribe an official or sow enough doubt in the mind of a magistrate to have the case thrown out.
zh_tw: 如果逮捕的威脅變得單調乏味，您可以轉而採用第二種方法，那就是僅僅通知玩家一個或多個角色已被逮捕。您可以描述逮捕過程、隨後的拘留以及導致審判的事件。這種方法的缺點是玩家角色對局勢沒有控制權。（這種無助感具有現實性的優點，儘管可能並不有趣。）為了減輕這種缺點，您可能允許角色進行屬性檢定以影響結果；例如，成功的魅力 (說服) 檢定可能使角色能夠賄賂官員，或者在法官心中種下足夠的懷疑，從而使案件被駁回。

english: Naming NPCs
zh_tw: 命名NPC

english: Important NPCs in the adventure are given names, but many of the secondary NPCs aren't named. {@book Xanathar's Guide to Everything|xge} contains an appendix of {@5etools tables you can use to randomly generate names|names.html} for human and non-human NPCs if you have trouble coming up with names on your own.
zh_tw: 冒險中的重要NPC被賦予了名字，但許多次要NPC沒有名字。如果您在自己想出名字時遇到困難，{@book 珊娜薩的萬事指南|xge}包含了一個附錄，其中包含{@5etools 用來隨機生成名字的表格|names.html}。

english: Character Creation
zh_tw: 建立角色

english: If your players are creating 1st-level characters for this adventure, consider setting aside the first game session for character creation. That way, the players can flesh out their adventuring party together and come up with reasons why their characters are friends.
zh_tw: 如果您的玩家正在為這次冒險建立1級角色，請考慮將第一次遊戲會議留出來進行角色建立。這樣，玩家們可以一起完善他們的冒險團隊，並想出他們的角色為何成為朋友的理由。

english: Bringing the Party Together
zh_tw: 隊伍匯合

english: The Yawning Portal is a popular adventurers' hangout. Unless you have a better idea, assume that the characters are familiar with the establishment and have met there before. If any of the characters are new to the city, they can be drawn to the Yawning Portal by its reputation or summoned there by Volo.
zh_tw: "呵欠之門"是冒險者們常去的聚集地。除非你有更好的主意，否則假定角色們對這個地方很熟悉，並且之前已經在那裡見過面。如果任何角色是新來城市的，他們可能會因其名聲而被吸引到"呵欠之門"，或者被瓦羅召喚到那裡。

english: To make the Yawning Portal feel like a familiar, welcoming place, give the players a copy of the Yawning Portal Familiar Faces handout in appendix C and allow each player to select one NPC as a friendly acquaintance. Additional information about these NPCs can be found at the end of this introduction.
zh_tw: 為了讓呵欠之門感覺像一個熟悉且親切的地方，請給玩家一份附錄C中的呵欠之門熟悉面孔傳單，並允許每個玩家選擇一個NPC作為友好的熟人。關於這些NPC的額外資訊可以在本介紹的末尾找到。

english: Buying Equipment at 1st Level
zh_tw: 在1級時購買裝備

english: All the equipment in chapter 5 of the {@book Player's Handbook|phb} is available for purchase in Waterdeep at normal prices.
zh_tw: {@book 玩家手冊|phb}第5章中的所有裝備都可以在深水城以正常價格購買。

english: Character Backgrounds
zh_tw: 角色背景

english: Players looking for background options beyond those described in the {@book Player's Handbook|phb} can find several appropriate ones in the {@book Sword Coast Adventurer's Guide|scag}: {@background City Watch|scag}, {@background cloistered scholar|scag}, {@background courtier|scag}, {@background faction agent|scag}, {@background far traveler|scag}, {@background inheritor|scag}, {@background mercenary veteran|scag}, {@background urban bounty hunter|scag}, and {@background Waterdhavian noble|scag|Waterdavian noble}. If you have access to this book, consider making its background options available to your players' characters.
zh_tw: 尋找{@book 玩家手冊|phb}中描述之外背景選項的玩家可以在{@book 劍灣冒險者指南|scag}中找到幾個合適的選項：{@background City Watch|scag|城市守衛}（城市守衛）、{@background cloistered scholar|scag|與世隔絕的學者}（隱居學者）、{@background courtier|scag|朝臣}（宮廷貴族）、{@background faction agent|scag|組織代理人}（派系代理人）、{@background far traveler|scag|遠行者}（遠行者）、{@background inheritor|scag|繼承人}（繼承人）、{@background mercenary veteran|scag|老傭兵}（僱傭兵老兵）、{@background urban bounty hunter|scag|城市獵人}（城市賞金獵人）和{@background Waterdhavian noble|scag|水深貴族}（深水城貴族）。如果您有這本書，考慮將其中背景選項提供給您的玩家角色。

english: Waterdavian Noble Families
zh_tw: 深水城貴族家族

english: Waterdeep contains well over a hundred noble families. The following noble houses are fine choices for any character with the noble background from the {@book Player's Handbook|phb} or the Waterdavian noble background from the {@book Sword Coast Adventurer's Guide|scag}.
zh_tw: 深水城擁有超過一百個貴族家族。以下貴族家族是任何具有來自{@book 玩家手冊|phb}的貴族背景或來自{@book 劍灣冒險者指南|scag}的深水城貴族背景的角色的絕佳選擇。

english: House Amcathra
zh_tw: 安卡斯拉家族

english: The Amcathras are a Tethyrian family that specializes in horse breeding and training, cattle ranching, wine-making, and weaponsmithing. The family motto is "We trample our troubles." The family has a large villa in the North Ward, on the east side of the High Road between Hassantyr's Street and Tarnath Street.
zh_tw: 安卡斯拉家族是一個泰瑟爾人家族，專門從事馬匹繁殖和訓練、牧場經營、釀酒和武器製造。家族的座右銘是"我們踐踏我們的煩惱"。該家族在北區有一座大別墅，位於高路的東側，介於哈桑提爾街和塔納斯街之間。

english: House Margaster
zh_tw: 瑪加斯特家族

english: The Margasters are an Illuskan family whose business interests lie in land-based shipping and bulk goods trading. The house also has a quiet history of wizardry. The family motto is "Nothing is beyond our grasp." The Margaster family estate is situated between Stabbed Sailor Alley and Shattercrock Alley in the North Ward.
zh_tw: 瑪加斯特家族是一個伊路斯坎人家族，其商業利益在於陸基運輸和大宗商品貿易。該家族還有一段安靜的巫術歷史。家族的座右銘是"沒有什麼是我們無法掌握的"。瑪加斯特家族的莊園位於北區，介於刺傷水手巷和碎石巷之間。

english: House Phylund
zh_tw: 菲倫德家族

english: The Phylunds are a Tashlutar family that captures and sells monsters. Monsters that can't be trained as pets or guard beasts are sold to arenas or harvested for their meat, bones, and skins. The Phylunds sponsor adventuring parties and monster-hunting expeditions, and their motto is "What you fear, we master." House Phylund has an estate on Copper Street, west of the High Road between Julthoon Street and Trader's Way in the North Ward.
zh_tw: 菲倫德家族是一個塔什盧塔爾家族，他們捕捉並出售怪物。那些不能被訓練成寵物或守衛獸的怪物會被賣給競技場或被屠宰以獲取它們的肉、骨頭和皮。菲倫德家族贊助冒險團隊和怪物狩獵遠徵，他們的座右銘是"你們所恐懼的，我們掌控"。菲倫德家族在北區擁有一處房產，位於高路和朱爾蘇恩街以及商人之路之間的銅街上。

english: House Rosznar
zh_tw: 羅茲納爾家族

english: Once banished from Waterdeep for smuggling, slavery, and other crimes, this Tethyrian house has returned and is trying to overcome its dark past and disgraceful reputation by focusing on legitimate business ventures such as wine-making and gem trading. The family motto is "We fly high and stoop swift." Rosznar Villa is situated on Thunderstaff Way between Copper Street and Shield Street in the Sea Ward, west of the High Road.
zh_tw: 這個泰瑟爾人家族曾因走私、奴隸貿易和其他罪行被深水城驅逐，現已迴歸並試圖透過專注於合法的商業活動，如釀酒和寶石交易，來克服其黑暗的過去和不光彩的名聲。家族的座右銘是"我們高飛猛撲"。羅茲納爾別墅位於海區的雷杖路上，介於銅街和盾街之間，高路的西側。

english: Lady Esvele Rosznar (see "The {@creature Black Viper|WDH}" in appendix B) is a member of this house, though she keeps her masked identity and thieving escapades a secret.
zh_tw: 艾絲薇爾·羅茲納爾女士（見附錄B中的"{@creature Black Viper|WDH|黑毒蛇}"）是這個家族的成員，儘管她將自己的蒙面身份和偷竊行為保持秘密。

english: Guild Membership
zh_tw: 公會成員身份

english: Any characters with the guild artisan background are assumed to have free membership in one Waterdeep guild of their choice. Arcane spellcasters living in the city are required by law to register with the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors, so that they can be called on to defend the city with their magic in times of need.
zh_tw: 任何具有公會工匠背景的角色都假定可以免費加入他們選擇的一個深水城公會。居住在城市中的奧術施法者依法必須在警戒法師與護衛教團註冊，這樣在需要時他們可以被召喚用他們的魔法來保衛城市。

english: Waterdeep's most prominent guilds appear on the Guilds of Waterdeep list. By law, there are no active thieves' guilds in Waterdeep, and the Xanathar Guild isn't an actual guild but a faction (see "Factions in Waterdeep,").
zh_tw: 深水城最傑出的公會出現在深水城公會列表上。依法，深水城沒有活躍的盜賊公會，而姍娜薩公會不是一個真正的公會，而是一個派系（見"深水城中的派系"）。

english: To join a guild, one must possess a background, a proficiency, or a status that the guild values. For example, a character with the sailor background is welcome to join the Master Mariners' Guild. One can practice a profession and not be a guild member, but such autonomy carries a cost. The guilds do everything they can to entice new members to join and pay for membership, and they go out of their way to hinder independent business owners, up to and including driving them out of business. A baker who refuses to join the Bakers' Guild might find her flour supply cut off, while a wizard who refuses to join the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors might be denied access to sages, libraries, and other useful resources.
zh_tw: 要加入一個公會，一個人必須擁有公會重視的背景、專長或地位。例如，具有水手背景的角色很受歡迎加入主人航海家公會。一個人可以從事一個職業而不一定是公會成員，但這種自主性是有代價的。公會盡一切努力吸引新成員加入並支付會費，並且他們會不遺餘力地阻礙獨立企業主，包括甚至將他們趕出生意。一個拒絕加入麵包師公會的麵包師可能會發現她的麵粉供應被切斷，而一個拒絕加入警戒法師與護衛教團的法師可能會被拒絕進入智者、圖書館和其他有用資源的訪問。

english: Guilds charge members monthly or yearly dues that vary. For simplicity, you can have a guild charge 1 gp per month or 10 gp for a year's dues paid in advance. A guild can expel a member for any number of reasons, not the least of which is failing to pay dues.
zh_tw: 公會向成員收取每月或每年的不同會費。為了簡化，你可以讓一個公會收取每月1金幣或提前支付10金幣的年費。公會可以因各種原因開除成員，其中最不重要的原因是未能支付會費。

english: A character with the faction agent background (described in the {@book Sword Coast Adventurer's Guide|scag}) must choose a faction to belong to (see "Factions in Waterdeep" below). Characters without this background can join factions once they reach the end of chapter 1 of this adventure.
zh_tw: 具有派系代理人背景的角色（參見{@book 劍灣冒險者指南|scag}）必須選擇一個派系加入（見下文的"深水城派系"）。沒有此背景的角色可以在完成本冒險第一章後加入派系。

english: Tracking Renown
zh_tw: 追蹤聲望

english: This adventure includes side quests available only to characters who join the factions described in this adventure. You can use the optional renown rules in chapter 1 of the Dungeon Master's Guide to track a character's rank and ascent within a given faction. The Dungeon Master's Guide gives names for various ranks within the Harpers, the Emerald Enclave, the Lords' Alliance, the Order of the Gauntlet, and the Zhentarim. Rank names for members of Bregan D'aerthe, Force Grey, and the Xanathar Guild are given below, with the renown needed to attain each rank.
zh_tw: 這次冒險包括只有加入本冒險中描述的派系的角色才能使用支線任務。您可以使用《地下城主指南》第一章中的可選聲望規則來追蹤角色在給定派系中的等級和提升。《地下城主指南》為豎琴手聯盟、翠綠閒庭、領主聯盟、鐵手套教團和散塔林會的各個等級提供了名稱。布雷甘·達耶、灰色力量和姍娜薩公會成員的等級名稱如下，以及達到每個等級所需的聲望值。

english: If you decide to track experience points, you can slow the rate of advancement by banking XP until you're ready for the party to level up. Conversely, you can hasten level advancement by awarding ad hoc XP for completing goals, roleplaying well, and surviving or avoiding deadly traps. Any such award should be no more than what the characters would earn for defeating a monster with a challenge rating equal to their level. For example, a fair ad hoc award for a party of 2nd-level adventurers would be 450 XP, which is what the characters would earn for defeating a challenge rating 2 monster.
zh_tw: 如果您決定追蹤經驗點，您可以透過累積經驗值直到您準備好讓隊伍升級來減緩升級速度。相反，您可以透過為完成目標、角色扮演出色以及生存或避免致命陷阱而臨時獎勵經驗點來加快等級提升。任何此類獎勵都不應超過角色擊敗與他們等級相等挑戰等級的怪物所能獲得的經驗值。例如，對於一組2級冒險者來說，一個公平的臨時獎勵是450經驗點，這是角色擊敗挑戰等級2的怪物所能獲得的經驗值。

english: If you dispense with XP tracking and allow characters to gain levels as the adventure progresses, use the Suggested Character Levels table as your guide.
zh_tw: 如果您放棄追蹤經驗點，並允許角色隨著冒險的進展而升級，那麼請使用"建議角色等級"表作為您的指南。

english: Factions in Waterdeep
zh_tw: 深水城的派系

english: Various factions have roots in Waterdeep, and any character with the faction agent background (described in the Sword Coast Adventurer's Guide) can choose to belong to one of the factions described below, provided the character meets the faction's prerequisites.
zh_tw: 不同的派系在深水城有根基，任何具有派系代理人背景的角色（在《劍海岸冒險者指南》中描述）都可以選擇加入下面描述的派系之一，前提是角色滿足派系的先決條件。

english: If you're using the optional renown rules described in chapter 1 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|dmg}, allow a player whose character has the faction agent background to roll a {@dice d4} to determine that character's renown at the start of the adventure. See the "Tracking Renown" sidebar for more information.
zh_tw: 如果你使用的是{@book 城主指南|dmg}第1章中描述的可選聲望規則，允許擁有派系代理人背景的玩家擲一個{@dice d4}，以在冒險開始時確定該角色的聲望。更多資訊請參閱"追蹤聲望"側邊欄。

english: Characters of other backgrounds will have opportunities to join a faction later in the adventure. Any such character must meet a faction's prerequisites to be eligible to join it, and the character's starting renown is 0.
zh_tw: 其他背景的角色在冒險後期將有機會加入派系。任何這樣的角色必須滿足派系的先決條件才有資格加入，並且角色的起始聲望為0。

english: Characters who have renown greater than 0 in a faction can gain its support in times of need by reaching out to an influential NPC member of that faction. As a character's renown improves, so does the quality of the support. A faction might also help non-members who further its interests. The descriptions of the factions that follow include suggestions for how support from a faction can manifest.
zh_tw: 在派系中聲望大於0的角色可以在需要時透過聯絡該派系中有影響力的NPC成員來獲得其支援。隨著角色聲望的提高，所獲得的支援質量也會提高。派系也可能幫助那些推動其利益的非成員。下面對派系的描述包括了派系支援可能表現的方式的建議。

english: You decide the extent to which a faction will assist the adventurers, based on each faction's perception of how important or valuable the adventurers are. For example, if the characters earn {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH}'s trust and her support of them becomes public knowledge, members of Bregan D'aerthe might aid the characters so that {@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH} can curry favor with the Open Lord of Waterdeep.
zh_tw: 你根據每個派系對冒險者重要性或價值的看法來決定派系將在多大程度上協助冒險者。例如，如果角色們贏得了{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}的信任，並且她對他們的支援成為眾所周知的事實，布雷甘·達耶的成員可能會幫助角色們，以便{@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH|賈拉索·班瑞}能夠贏得深水城公開領主的青睞。

english: Bregan D'aerthe
zh_tw: 布雷甘·達耶

english: Bregan D'aerthe
zh_tw: 布雷甘·達耶

english: A character must be a drow, preferably a male, to join this faction.
zh_tw: 要加入這個派系，角色必須是卓爾精靈，最好是男性。

english: Bregan D'aerthe is a company of mercenaries originally made up of the much-derided and dishonorable castaways of destroyed drow houses. The group's leader, {@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH}, is always looking for new members to fill the ranks, and loyalty is what matters to him most.
zh_tw: 布雷甘·達耶是由被摧毀的卓爾家族中被嘲笑和不光彩的流亡者組成的僱傭兵公司。這個組織的領袖{@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH|賈拉索·班瑞}總是在尋找新成員來填補隊伍，對他來說，忠誠是最重要的。

english: Almost all Bregan D'aerthe members are male because female drow rarely condescend to take orders from a male. A female drow can earn a place in the faction by decrying the drow matriarchy and convincing Jarlaxle that she would be an asset to the brotherhood. Jarlaxle employs non-drow operatives as well, none of whom know they're working for him; such individuals aren't considered members of the faction.
zh_tw: 幾乎所有布雷甘·達耶的成員都是男性，因為女性黑暗精靈很少屈尊接受男性的命令。一個女性黑暗精靈可以透過譴責黑暗精靈的母權制，並說服賈拉索利她將成為兄弟會的資產，從而在派系中獲得一席之地。賈拉索利也僱傭非黑暗精靈的特工，但這些人都不知道他們是在為他工作；這樣的人不被視為派系的成員。

english: Bregan D'aerthe is using one of Jarlaxle's legitimate business enterprises-the Sea Maidens Faire-as a front in Waterdeep. The Sea Maidens Faire consists of three carnival ships (the {@i Eyecatcher}, the {@i Heartbreaker}, and the {@i Hellraiser}) crewed by disguised drow and a host of non-drow performers (musicians, acrobats, actors, and the like). The ships' cargo consists mostly of wagons and floats that can be hastily assembled and paraded through the city. The drow use these parades to draw attention away from their illicit activities.
zh_tw: 布雷甘·達耶正在利用賈拉索的一個合法商業企業——海之少女嘉年華——作為在深水城的掩護。海之少女嘉年華由三艘狂歡船組成（分別是{@i 奪目號}、{@i 碎心號}和{@i 煽亂號}），船員由偽裝的地底卓爾和一大批非卓爾表演者（如音樂家、雜技演員、演員等）組成。船隻的貨物主要包括可以迅速組裝並在城市中游行的馬車和花車。卓爾利用這些遊行來轉移人們對他們非法活動的注意力。

english: In the magical guise of a flamboyant Illuskan captain named Zardoz Zord, Jarlaxle oversees things from the {@i Eyecatcher}, his flagship, and the {@i Scarlet Marpenoth}, a submarine mounted underneath it. He relies on three {@creature Drow Gunslinger|wdh|drow gunslingers}—{@creature Fel'rekt Lafeen|WDH}, {@creature Krebbyg Masq'il'yr|WDH}, and {@creature Soluun Xibrindas|wdh}—to do most of his dirty work in the city. For more information on Jarlaxle and his lieutenants, see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}.
zh_tw: 以一位名叫扎多茲·佐德的浮誇伊路斯坎人船長的魔法偽裝，賈拉索從 {@i 奪目號}，他的旗艦，以及其下方的潛水艇 {@i 緋紅瑪佩諾斯} 上監督一切。他依靠三名 {@creature Drow Gunslinger|wdh|卓爾火槍手}——{@creature Fel'rekt Lafeen|WDH|菲爾萊科特·拉菲恩}、{@creature Krebbyg Masq'il'yr|WDH|克雷比格·馬斯奇爾} 和 {@creature Soluun Xibrindas|wdh|索倫·希布林達斯}——在城中完成大部分骯髒的工作。有關賈拉索及其副手的更多資訊，請參見 {@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}。

english: Bregan D'aerthe is skilled at infiltrating criminal organizations. {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s drow advisor, {@creature Nar'l Xibrindas|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), is actually a Bregan D'aerthe spy. Bregan D'aerthe support comes in these ways:
zh_tw: 布雷甘·達耶擅長滲透犯罪組織。{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的卓爾顧問，{@creature Nar'l Xibrindas|wdh|納爾·澤布林達斯}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），實際上是布雷甘·達耶的間諜。布雷甘·達耶的支援以以下方式提供：

english: The adventurers receive small, unmarked black pouches of coins from an anonymous source.
zh_tw: 冒險者從匿名來源收到裝有硬幣的小而無標記的黑色袋子。

english: The adventurers receive an invitation to dine with Zardoz Zord aboard his flagship, during which Jarlaxle takes their measure and offers assistance if they impress him.
zh_tw: 冒險者收到了扎多茲·佐德的邀請，邀請他們在他的旗艦上與他共進晚餐，在晚餐期間，賈拉索勒對他們進行了評估，並在他們給他留下深刻印象時提供幫助。

english: Bregan D'aerthe members buy off or quietly dispose of individuals who threaten the adventurers (usually without asking).
zh_tw: 布雷甘·達耶的成員會買通或悄無聲息地處理掉威脅冒險者的個人（通常不經詢問）。

english: Emerald Enclave
zh_tw: 翠綠閒庭

english: A character must demonstrate an interest in protecting nature or the natural order to join the Emerald Enclave. Druids and rangers are especially welcome.
zh_tw: 一個角色必須表現出對保護自然或自然秩序的興趣才能加入翠綠閒庭。德魯伊和遊俠尤其受歡迎。

english: Waterdeep harbors a few members of the faction, which seeks to foster harmony between nature and civilization. Members living in Waterdeep help guard the city against unnatural threats, including aberrations and undead. They also watch over the City of the Dead (Waterdeep's public cemetery) and the city's parks.
zh_tw: 深水城港藏有一些派系成員，他們致力於促進自然與文明之間的和諧。居住在深水城的成員幫助保護城市免受非自然威脅，包括異怪和不死生物。他們還守護著亡者之城（深水城的公共墓地）和城市的公園。

english: Members of the Emerald Enclave can be found in Phaulkonmere, a noble villa in the Southern Ward, and at the Snobeedle Orchard and Meadery in Undercliff. The walls of Phaulkonmere enclose fabulous gardens, and the buildings are covered with moss and ivy. The place is owned by descendants of two wealthy families-the Tarms (longtime Waterdavians) and the Phaulkons (who are of Cormyrean descent). They spend most of the year traveling abroad and entrust the estate to a half-elf groundskeeper named {@creature Melannor Fellbranch|wdh}. He is joined by Jeryth Phaulkon, a noblewoman turned demigod who serves Mielikki, divine lady of the forest.
zh_tw: 翠綠閒庭的成員可以在波康莊園找到，這是位於南區的一座貴族別墅，也可以在崖下區的斯諾貝德爾果園和釀酒廠找到。波康莊園的牆壁環繞著美麗的花園，建築物上覆蓋著苔蘚和常春藤。這個地方由兩個富裕家族的後代擁有——塔姆家族（長期的深水城居民）和波康家族（科米爾血統）。他們大部分時間都在國外旅行，並將莊園委託給一位名叫{@creature Melannor Fellbranch|wdh|梅蘭諾·費爾布蘭奇}的半精靈園丁。他由傑瑞斯·波康加入，她是一位貴族女性轉變成的半神，為森林女神梅麗凱服務。

english: The Snobeedle Orchard and Meadery is run by the Snobeedle family of halflings, among them an old druid named Blossom Snobeedle. Blossom's youngest son, Dasher, disappeared in Waterdeep about six months ago. He was infected with lycanthropy and is now a member of a wererat gang called the Shard Shunners.
zh_tw: 斯諾貝德爾果園和蜜酒廠由半身人斯諾貝德爾家族經營，其中有一位名叫布洛瑟姆·斯諾貝德爾的老德魯伊。布洛瑟姆的小兒子，達舍爾，大約六個月前在深水城失蹤了。他被感染了鼠人病，現在是一個名為避碎幫的鼠狼幫派的成員。

english: Emerald Enclave support comes in these ways:
zh_tw: 翠綠閒庭的支援以以下方式提供：

english: Enclave members share information they've gathered from magical conversations with animals in the city.
zh_tw: 聯盟成員分享他們從城市中與動物進行的魔法對話中收集到的資訊。

english: {@creature Melannor Fellbranch|wdh} (see "Emerald Enclave") provides free food and care for the adventurers' animals at Phaulkonmere.
zh_tw: {@creature Melannor Fellbranch|wdh|梅蘭諾·費爾布蘭奇}（見"翠綠閒庭"）在波康莊園為冒險者的動物提供免費食物和照料。

english: One adventurer receives a supernatural charm (see "Supernatural Gifts" in chapter 7 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|dmg}) bestowed by Jeryth Phaulkon (see "Emerald Enclave").
zh_tw: 一位冒險者獲得了由傑瑞斯·波康（參見"翠綠閒庭"）賜予的超自然護咒（參見{@book 城主指南|dmg}第7章中的"超自然恩賜"）。

english: Force Grey
zh_tw: 灰色力量

english: To join Force Grey, one must first become a member of the Gray Hands. An individual who has served in the City Watch or the City Guard is eligible to join, as are characters who are willing to swear oaths to defend Waterdeep, its citizens, and its laws with their lives. Adventurers who show promise might be invited to join the Gray Hands, a faction overseen by the Blackstaff, {@creature Vajra Safahr|WDH}. Members of the Gray Hands complete assignments dictated by Vajra.
zh_tw: 要加入灰色力量，首先必須成為灰手成員。曾在城市守衛隊或城市守衛中服役的個人有資格加入，願意發誓用生命保衛深水城、其市民和法律的角色也有資格。有前途的冒險者可能會被邀請加入由黑杖，{@creature Vajra Safahr|WDH|瓦婕拉·莎法爾}監督的灰手派系。灰手成員完成由瓦婕拉指派的任務。

english: Force Grey is an elite cadre of specialized adventurers, drawn from the ranks of the Gray Hands, whose fighting prowess is matched only by their loyalty to the city. Force Grey attracts the best of the best. Characters don't begin their adventuring careers as members of Force Grey, but they can work up to that status.
zh_tw: 灰色力量是一群來自灰手組織的精英冒險家團隊，他們的戰鬥技巧與對城市的忠誠度相匹配。灰色力量吸引著最優秀的人才。角色們在冒險生涯的開始並不是灰色力量的成員，但他們可以透過努力達到那個地位。

english: Whenever Waterdeep has a problem that can't be handled by diplomats or the city's other armed forces, the Open Lord has the option to mobilize Force Grey. Such action is usually taken as a last resort, since some past members of the group have exhibited a tendency to indulge in wanton violence, causing as much damage as they ostensibly prevent.
zh_tw: 每當深水城遇到外交官或城市其他武裝力量無法解決的問題時，公開領主可以選擇動員灰色力量。這樣的行動通常是作為最後的手段，因為該組織的一些過去的成員表現出傾向於無節制的暴力，他們造成的破壞與他們表面上阻止的破壞一樣多。

english: Although the Open Lord sets mission goals and parameters whenever the unit is activated, the Force Grey team needed to complete any given assignment is made up of individuals handpicked by the Blackstaff.
zh_tw: 儘管公開領主在每次啟用單位時都會設定任務目標和引數，但需要完成任何特定任務的灰色力量團隊由黑杖親自挑選的個人組成。

english: If members of Force Grey (and, in some cases, the Gray Hands) are arrested for a crime, the Open Lord or the Blackstaff will usually intervene on their behalf and facilitate their release.
zh_tw: 如果灰色力量（在某些情況下，灰手組織）的成員因犯罪被捕，公開領主或黑杖法師通常會代表他們進行幹預，並協助他們獲釋。

english: Force Grey support comes in these ways:
zh_tw: 灰色力量的支援以以下方式提供：

english: Adventurers who are arrested are released under the loose supervision of {@creature Vajra Safahr|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}).
zh_tw: 被逮捕的冒險者在{@creature Vajra Safahr|wdh|瓦婕拉·莎法爾}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）的寬鬆監督下被釋放。

english: The adventurers receive a helpful uncommon or rare magic item that they're allowed to use for a time (until it mysteriously disappears).
zh_tw: 冒險者們收到了一個有用的稀有或罕見魔法物品，他們被允許使用一段時間（直到它神秘地消失）。

english: {@creature Meloon Wardragon|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) or some other respected member of Force Grey helps the adventurers out of a tough situation.
zh_tw: {@creature Meloon Wardragon|wdh|麥倫·戰龍}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）或灰色力量的其他受尊敬的成員幫助冒險者們擺脫困境。

english: Harpers
zh_tw: 豎琴手聯盟

english: Any smart, non-evil character can join the Harpers of Waterdeep. Bards and wizards are especially welcome.
zh_tw: 任何聰明且非邪惡的角色都可以加入深水城的豎琴手聯盟。吟遊詩人和法師尤其受歡迎。

english: Harpers are altruists who work behind the scenes to keep power out of the hands of evil tyrants. In the current situation, it doesn't take long for them to suspect that the Zhentarim is wholly or partially responsible for the escalation of violence in Waterdeep. Harper spies might use the adventurers as instruments to get at the truth. Various nobles and guildmasters in the city are Harper sympathizers.
zh_tw: 豎琴手聯盟是幕後工作的利他主義者，他們致力於防止邪惡暴君掌握權力。在當前情況下，他們很快就懷疑到散塔林會完全或部分對深水城暴力事件的升級負有責任。豎琴手聯盟間諜可能會利用冒險者作為工具來揭露真相。城市中各種貴族和行會首領是豎琴手聯盟的同情者。

english: The Harpers have several secret gathering places in Waterdeep, among them Ulbrinter Villa, an estate located on Delzorin Street between Vhezoar Street and Brondar's Way, in the North Ward (just south of Trollskull Alley). The elf lady of the house, {@creature Remallia Haventree|WDH} ("Remi" to her friends), the widow of Lord Arthagast Ulbrinter, is a high-ranking member of the faction. Other key members include {@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh}, the estranged son of Lord Dagult Neverember, and {@creature Mirt|WDH}, an advisor to Open Lord {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH}. See {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12} for more information on these NPCs.
zh_tw: 豎琴手聯盟在深水城有幾個秘密聚集地，其中包括烏爾布林特別墅，這是一座位於北區德爾佐林街，介於維佐爾街和布隆達爾路之間，就在巨魔顱骨巷南邊的莊園。家中的精靈女士，{@creature Remallia Haventree|WDH|蕾米莉亞·港樹}（朋友們稱她為"蕾米"），是阿薩加斯特·烏爾布林特領主的寡婦，是派系中的高階成員。其他關鍵成員包括{@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh|瑞納爾·無燼}，達格魯特·無燼領主的疏遠兒子，以及{@creature Mirt|WDH|米爾特}，公開領主{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}的顧問。有關這些NPC的更多資訊，請參見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}。

english: Harpers prefer to conduct their business in bustling inns and taverns such as the Yawning Portal, or in quiet locations such as the City of the Dead.
zh_tw: 豎琴手聯盟更喜歡在繁忙的客棧和酒館，如呵欠之門，或者在如亡者之城這樣的安靜地點進行他們的事務。

english: Harper support comes in these ways:
zh_tw: 豎琴手聯盟的支援以以下方式提供：

english: The Harpers make common and uncommon potions and scrolls available to the adventurers at a reduced or deferred cost depending on the circumstances.
zh_tw: 豎琴手聯盟根據情況，向冒險者提供普通和不常見的藥水和卷軸，價格可以降低或延期支付。

english: {@creature Remallia Haventree|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) feeds useful bits of information to the adventurers and might also offer them temporary shelter.
zh_tw: {@creature Remallia Haventree|wdh|蕾米莉亞·港樹}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）向冒險者提供有用的資訊片段，並且也可能為他們提供臨時住所。

english: If the adventurers are accosted and overwhelmed, one or more Harpers come to their rescue. A Harper rescue team usually consists of a {@creature bard|vgm} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) or a {@creature mage}, plus {@dice 1d4 + 3} {@creature spy||spies} or {@creature veteran||veterans}.
zh_tw: 如果冒險者們遭到圍攻並被壓倒，一個或更多的豎琴手聯盟成員會來援救他們。豎琴手聯盟救援隊通常由一個{@creature bard|vgm|吟遊詩人}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）或一個{@creature mage||魔法師}，加上{@dice 1d4 + 3}個{@creature spy||間諜們}或{@creature veteran||老兵}組成。

english: Lords' Alliance
zh_tw: 領主聯盟

english: To become a member of the Lords' Alliance faction in Waterdeep, a character must be a Waterdavian citizen. Those with criminal records can also join, provided they demonstrate their allegiance to the city.
zh_tw: 要成為深水城領主聯盟派系的成員，一個角色必須是深水城的公民。那些有犯罪記錄的人也可以加入，只要他們表現出對城市的忠誠。

english: The Lords' Alliance is a confederation of cities and towns up and down the Sword Coast and throughout the North, including (among others) Baldur's Gate, Mirabar, Mithral Hall, Neverwinter, and Silverymoon. Members of the alliance must come to one another's aid in times of need, and the organization uses field operatives (diplomats, spies, and assassins) to safeguard its interests.
zh_tw: 領主聯盟是劍海岸和整個北方的一系列城市和小鎮的聯盟，包括（但不限於）博德之門、米拉巴、秘銀廳、無冬城和銀月城。聯盟成員在需要時必須互相幫助，該組織使用外勤人員（外交官、間諜和刺客）來保護其利益。

english: Waterdeep is one of the most influential and invested members of the Lords' Alliance. Waterdeep's Open Lord, {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH}, uses spies to keep tabs on adventurers in the city, rewarding those who place Waterdeep's interests above their own. Laeral employs adventurers as agents of the Lords' Alliance, among them {@creature Jalester Silvermane|WDH}. See {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12} for more information on these NPCs.
zh_tw: 深水城是領主聯盟中最有影響力和投入的成員之一。深水城的公開領主，{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}，使用間諜來監視城市中的冒險者，獎勵那些將深水城的利益置於自身之上的人。萊拉僱傭冒險者作為領主聯盟的代理人，其中包括{@creature Jalester Silvermane|WDH|加萊斯特·銀鬃}。有關這些NPC的更多資訊，請參見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}。

english: Laeral spends most of her time in the Palace of Waterdeep. Within walking distance of the palace are well-maintained government residences set aside for the use of representatives of other Lords' Alliance cities and towns.
zh_tw: 萊拉大部分時間都在深水宮度過。宮殿步行距離內，有維護良好的政府住宅，這些住宅是為其他領主聯盟城市和小鎮的代表預留使用的。

english: Lords' Alliance support comes in these ways:
zh_tw: 領主聯盟的支援以以下方式提供：

english: City Watch officials are notified that the characters are on "official business" for the Lords' Alliance and instructed to provide support whenever they can.
zh_tw: 城市守衛官員被告知這些角色正在為領主聯盟執行"官方事務"，並被指示在可能的情況下提供支援。

english: {@creature Mirt|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), a Masked Lord who serves as {@creature Laeral Silverhand|wdh}'s advisor, invites the adventurers to dinner at his dilapidated mansion as a pretense for sharing rumors and imparting pearls of wisdom.
zh_tw: {@creature Mirt|wdh|米爾特}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），一位戴面具的領主，擔任{@creature Laeral Silverhand|wdh|萊拉·銀手}的顧問，以晚宴為藉口邀請冒險者到他破舊的宅邸，分享謠言並傳授感知的珍珠。

english: The characters are granted a brief audience with {@creature Laeral Silverhand|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}).
zh_tw: 角色們獲得了與{@creature Laeral Silverhand|wdh|萊拉·銀手}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）簡短會面的許可。

english: Order of the Gauntlet
zh_tw: 鐵手套教團

english: Any non-evil character can join the Order of the Gauntlet in Waterdeep. Clerics, monks, and paladins are especially welcome, particularly if they worship Helm, Torm, or Tyr.
zh_tw: 任何非邪惡角色都可以加入深水城的鐵手套教團。牧師、和尚和聖武士特別受歡迎，尤其是那些崇拜海爾姆、託姆或提爾的。

english: The order's mission is to seek out and destroy evil before it gains a foothold. The surge of violence in Waterdeep spurs members of the order to find adventurers who can help return peace to the city.
zh_tw: 該組織的使命是在邪惡站穩腳跟之前尋找並摧毀它。深水城的暴力浪潮促使該組織的成員尋找能夠幫助恢復城市和平的冒險者。

english: An individual can be a member of the faction and also a member of the clergy or a knight pledged to a specific god or temple. Members of the order act alone or in small groups. Some are Waterdavian natives; others hail from distant settlements and have come to the city on temple business.
zh_tw: 個人可以是派系的成員，同時也可以是神職人員或向特定神或寺廟宣誓的騎士。該秩序的成員單獨行動或以小組形式行動。有些是水深城本地人；其他人來自遙遠的地方，因寺廟事務來到這座城市。

english: Order of the Gauntlet support comes in these ways:
zh_tw: 鐵手套教團的支援方式包括：

english: If the adventurers require healing or other magic, a member of the order can facilitate meetings with local priests who worship non-evil deities.
zh_tw: 如果冒險者需要治療或其他魔法，騎士團的成員可以幫助安排與崇拜非邪惡神祇的當地牧師會面。

english: If the adventurers get in trouble with the law, a member of the order puts in a good word for them and tends to their affairs while they're incarcerated.
zh_tw: 如果冒險者遇到法律問題，該組織的一名成員會為他們說好話，並在他們被監禁時照顧他們的事務。

english: {@creature Hlam|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) might show up and help the characters in an impending battle.
zh_tw: {@creature Hlam|wdh|胡拉姆}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）可能會出現並幫助角色們在即將到來的戰鬥中。

english: Xanathar Guild
zh_tw: 姍娜薩公會

english: Anyone can join the Xanathar Guild, which, despite its name, doesn't have official guild status in Waterdeep. Before membership is granted, however, an applicant must pass a test that always involves the perpetration of a serious crime. Possibilities include murdering a guild member who has failed {@creature Xanathar|WDH} in some fashion, kidnapping a Waterdavian citizen, collecting a ransom, robbing a hire-coach, or looting a warehouse.
zh_tw: 任何人都可以加入姍娜薩公會，儘管它的名字如此，但在深水城並沒有官方公會地位。然而，在授予會員資格之前，申請人必須透過一項測試，測試總是涉及犯下一項嚴重罪行。可能性包括謀殺一個以某種方式讓{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}失望的公會成員，綁架一個深水城公民，收取贖金，搶劫一輛僱傭馬車，或洗劫一個倉庫。

english: Among low-ranking guild members, rampant speculation goes on about the true nature of {@creature Xanathar|WDH}. Few have any inkling that their boss is a beholder, and fewer still have seen or spoken to the eye tyrant.
zh_tw: 在低階行會成員中，關於{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的真實性質，人們議論紛紛。很少有人知道他們的老闆是一個眼魔，更少有人見過或與這個眼魔暴君說過話。

english: Given that the faction is fundamentally evil, advancement is based on one's wiles or one's ability to dispose of rivals. Competition within the organization is fierce and often deadly. Evil characters can thrive in this environment, but the risks are seldom worth the reward.
zh_tw: 鑑於該派系本質上是邪惡的，晉升基於個人的狡詐或除掉對手的能力。組織內部的競爭非常激烈，通常還帶有致命性。邪惡角色可以在這種環境中茁壯成長，但風險很少值得回報。

english: Xanathar Guild support comes in these ways:
zh_tw: 姍娜薩公會的支援方式包括：

english: Any member given an assignment might receive a monstrous bodyguard or assistant (such as a {@creature bugbear}, a {@creature kenku}, or a {@creature wererat}), who has secret instructions to kill the guild member if they fail to complete the assignment as ordered.
zh_tw: 任何被分配任務的成員可能會收到一個怪物保鏢或助手（例如一個{@creature bugbear||熊地精}，一個{@creature kenku||天狗}，或一個{@creature wererat||鼠人}），他們有秘密指令，如果成員未能按命令完成任務，就殺死該公會成員。

english: The guild grants access to secret tunnels and safe houses (hidden cellars) underneath Waterdeep.
zh_tw: 行會允許進入深水城下面的秘道和安全屋（隱藏的地下室）。

english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH} might send a {@creature gazer|vgm} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) to help (and spy on) an up-and-coming guild member.
zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩} 可能會派遣一個 {@creature gazer|vgm|凝視者眼魔}（見 {@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）來幫助（並監視）一個嶄露頭角的公會成員。

english: Zhentarim
zh_tw: 散塔林會

english: The Black Network has an open recruitment policy. Anyone can join. Tenacity and loyalty are highly valued (but not essential) traits in new members.
zh_tw: 黑網有一個開放的招募政策。任何人都可以加入。堅韌和忠誠是新成員中非常重視（但不是必需的）特質。

english: The Zhentarim is a shadow organization that trades mercenaries and goods (including weapons) for profit. It has long sought to gain political influence in Waterdeep, but the strength of the city's Masked Lords, nobility, and professional guilds makes that difficult.
zh_tw: 散塔林會是一個以利潤為目的交易僱傭兵和商品（包括武器）的神秘組織。它長期以來一直在尋求在深水城獲得政治影響力，但是該城市蒙面領主、貴族和專業公會的力量使得這很困難。

english: The Zhentarim in Waterdeep is a fractured organization. Those who support {@creature Manshoon|WDH} want to destroy {@creature Xanathar|WDH} and seize political and economic control of the city. Those who oppose {@creature Manshoon|WDH} want to expose and destroy him before they are themselves apprehended or driven out of the city by the local authorities.
zh_tw: 深水城的散塔林會是一個分裂的組織。支援 {@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松} 的人想要摧毀 {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩} 並奪取城市的政權和經濟控制權。反對 {@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松} 的人想要在他們自己被當地當局逮捕或趕出城市之前揭露並摧毀他。

english: Adventurers can't join {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s cause, but they can join and receive aid from the Zhents who are opposed to him. The leaders of this branch of the Black Network are retired adventurers who have become business entrepreneurs. Their adventuring party was called the Doom Raiders because their specialty was plundering lich lairs (which are called "dooms"). They are desperately trying to gain a legitimate economic foothold in Waterdeep, which requires making alliances with local guilds and nobles. {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s war against the Xanathar Guild has thrown their plans into upheaval.
zh_tw: 冒險者不能加入{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的事業，但他們可以加入並從反對他的散塔林會那裡獲得幫助。這個黑網分支的領導者是已經成為商業企業家的退休冒險者。他們的冒險團隊被稱為末日劫掠者，因為他們的專長是掠奪巫妖巢穴（被稱為"厄運"）。他們正拼命地在深水城獲得合法的經濟立足點，這需要與當地行會和貴族建立聯盟。{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}對姍娜薩公會的戰爭使他們的計劃陷入混亂。

english: The Doom Raiders (described in appendix B) consider themselves the true Zhentarim of Waterdeep. The group's leaders are {@creature Davil Starsong|WDH} (Master of Opportunities and Negotiations), {@creature Istrid Horn|WDH} (Master of Trade and Coin), {@creature Skeemo Weirdbottle|WDH} (Master of Magic), {@creature Tashlyn Yafeera|WDH} (Master of Arms and Mercenaries), and {@creature Ziraj the Hunter|WDH} (Master of Assassination).
zh_tw: 末日劫掠者（在附錄B中描述）自認為是深水城真正的散塔林會。該組織的領導者包括{@creature Davil Starsong|WDH|達維爾·星歌}（機會與談判大師），{@creature Istrid Horn|WDH|伊思崔德·霍恩}（貿易與硬幣大師），{@creature Skeemo Weirdbottle|WDH|斯齊莫·奇瓶}（魔法大師），{@creature Tashlyn Yafeera|WDH|塔什琳·雅菲拉}（武器與僱傭兵大師），以及{@creature Ziraj the Hunter|WDH|獵人茲拉吉}（暗殺大師）。

english: Zhentarim support comes in these ways:
zh_tw: 散塔林會的支援方式包括：

english: Davil can arrange meetings with influential nobles and members of city guilds.
zh_tw: 達維爾可以安排與有影響力的貴族和城市公會成員的會面。

english: Adventurers can procure discounted potions and poisons from Skeemo's shop, Weirdbottle's Concoctions, which is located in the Trades Ward.
zh_tw: 冒險者可以從斯齊莫的商店，位於商業區的奇瓶藥劑店，以折扣價購買藥水和毒藥。

english: Tashlyn offers affordable mercenaries, either {@creature thug||thugs} costing 2 sp per day each or {@creature veteran||veterans} costing 2 gp per day each.
zh_tw: 塔什琳提供價格合理的僱傭兵，其中{@creature thug||暴徒}每人每天2銀幣，或者{@creature veteran||老兵}每人每天2金幣。

english: Istrid offers loans of up to 2,500 gp with an interest rate of 10 percent per tenday.
zh_tw: 伊思崔德提供高達 2,500 gp 的貸款，每十天的利率為 10%。

english: Adventurers can hire {@creature Ziraj the Hunter|wdh|Ziraj} to assassinate someone, in return for some undisclosed favor to be called in later.
zh_tw: 冒險者可以僱傭 {@creature Ziraj the Hunter|wdh|茲拉吉} 暗殺某人，作為回報，將來需要履行一些未公開的人情。

english: The Yawning Portal
zh_tw: 呵欠之門

english: The Yawning Portal is a famous inn and tavern located in the Castle Ward of Waterdeep. Adventurers can meet all sorts of colorful characters here.
zh_tw: 呵欠之門是位於城堡區的一家著名客棧和酒館。冒險者們可以在這裡遇見各種豐富多彩的人物。

english: The place is a stone building with a slate roof and several chimneys. Most of the ground floor is taken up by the tavern's common room, which contains a 40-foot-diameter open well (actually the outer shell of a sunken stone tower) that descends 140 feet to the first level of Undermountain, the sprawling dungeon under Waterdeep. A rope-and-pulley mechanism is used to lower adventurers into the well and hoist them out. More information about this entrance to Undermountain can be found in {@i Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage}.
zh_tw: 這個地方是一座石砌建築，屋頂由石板鋪設，並帶有多個煙囪。一樓大部分區域被酒館的公共休息室佔據，其中包含一個直徑為40尺的敞口井（實際上是一座沉沒石塔的外殼），這口井向下延伸140尺，通向地脈迷城的第一層，這是位於深水城下方的廣闊地下城。一個繩索和滑輪裝置用於將冒險者降入井中並將他們拉上來。關於這個地脈迷城入口的更多資訊可以在{@i 深水城: 瘋法師的地城}中找到。

english: The upper floors of the Yawning Portal contain comfortable, nicely appointed rooms for guests.
zh_tw: 呵欠之門的上層包含為客人準備的舒適、裝飾精美的房間。

english: {@creature Durnan|WDH}, the proprietor, charges standard prices for food, drink, and lodging (see chapter 5 of the {@book Player's Handbook|phb} for costs).
zh_tw: {@creature Durnan|WDH|杜爾南}，這位店主，對食物、飲料和住宿收取標準價格（見《{@book 玩家手冊|phb}》第5章瞭解費用）。

english: The Yawning Portal attracts adventurers from every corner of the Forgotten Realms and the D&D multiverse. Not sure who a numbered character is? See the answer key, below.
zh_tw: 呵欠之門吸引來自被遺忘的國度和 D&D 多元宇宙的每個角落的冒險者。不確定編號角色是誰？請檢視下方的答案鍵。

english: Familiar Faces
zh_tw: 熟悉的面孔

english: Give the Yawning Portal Familiar Faces handout in appendix C to the players, and allow each of them to select one NPC as a friendly acquaintance-someone the player's character knows and trusts. More than one player can select the same NPC. The information below should be withheld from the players until their characters learn it.
zh_tw: 給玩家附錄C中的《呵欠之門熟悉的面孔》傳單，並允許每位玩家選擇一個NPC作為友好的熟人——即玩家角色所認識和信任的人。多個玩家可以選擇同一個NPC。以下資訊應保留，直到他們的角色瞭解到為止。

english: Durnan
zh_tw: 杜爾南

english: {@i N male Illuskan human innkeeper}
zh_tw: {@i N 男伊路斯坎人人類旅店老闆}

english: The proprietor of the Yawning Portal is a retired adventurer and a man of few words. {@creature Durnan|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) bluntly warns adventurers of lower than 5th level that entering Undermountain "isn't a good idea." He keeps a magic greatsword hidden behind the bar just in case something monstrous crawls up out of the entry well.
zh_tw: 呵欠之門的老闆是一位退休的冒險者，也是一個話不多的人。{@creature Durnan|WDH|杜爾南}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）直截了當地警告那些等級低於5級的冒險者，進入地脈迷城"不是個好主意"。他在吧檯後面藏了一把魔法巨劍，以防有怪物從入口井爬出來。

english: "Bonnie"
zh_tw: "邦妮"

english: {@i N doppelganger disguised as Tethyrian human barmaid}
zh_tw: {@i 一個偽裝成泰瑟爾人人類女招待的變形怪}

english: This doppelganger posing as a friendly barmaid is the leader of a gang of five doppelgangers that arrived in Waterdeep over a year ago. To help the gang make ends meet, she works for {@creature Durnan|WDH} as a barmaid. Mattrim Mereg (see below) knows her secret.
zh_tw: 這個偽裝成友好酒吧女招待的變形怪是一群五個變形怪的頭目，這群變形怪一年多前來到深水城。為了幫助團夥維持生計，她為 {@creature Durnan|WDH|杜爾南} 工作，擔任酒吧女招待。馬特里姆·梅雷格（見下文）知道她的秘密。

english: Mattrim "Threestrings" Mereg
zh_tw: 馬特里姆"三絃" 梅雷格

english: {@i LG male Illuskan human bard}
zh_tw: {@i LG 男性伊路斯坎人人類吟遊詩人}

english: This socially awkward bard (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) performs at the Yawning Portal and is a better musician than he pretends to be. He's called "Threestrings" because he plays a lute that has only three strings remaining. His secret is that he's a Harper spy, and he's far more eloquent and composed than he lets on. He lives at the inn, where he spends his afternoons and evenings spying on Zhentarim agents and gathering information on other potential troublemakers. He recently befriended {@creature Bonnie|WDH} and wants to help her doppelganger gang settle into the city.
zh_tw: 這位社交上有些笨拙的吟遊詩人（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）在呵欠之門表演，並且他比他假裝的要擅長音樂。他被稱為"三絃"，因為他演奏的琵琶只剩下三根弦。他的秘密是他是一個豎琴手聯盟間諜，他遠比他表現出來的要更雄辯和沉著。他住在客棧裡，在那裡他花費下午和晚上的時間監視散塔林會代理人並收集其他潛在麻煩製造者的資訊。他最近與{@creature Bonnie|WDH|邦妮}成為了朋友，並希望幫助她的變形怪幫派在城市中安頓下來。

english: Jalester Silvermane
zh_tw: 加萊斯特·銀鬃

english: {@i LG male Chondathan human fighter}
zh_tw: {@i LG 男性喬達坦人人類戰士}

english: {@creature Jalester Silvermane|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) is an agent of the Lords' Alliance who reports directly to {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH}. The Open Lord of Waterdeep has asked him to spy on adventurers who might, through their actions, aid or imperil the city and its citizens. Since the Yawning Portal attracts adventurers of all sorts, Jalester spends a lot of time here, usually seated by himself in a quiet corner. {@creature Durnan|WDH} knows that Jalester works for Laeral and leaves the young man alone.
zh_tw: {@creature Jalester Silvermane|WDH|加萊斯特·銀鬃}（見 {@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）是諸領主聯盟的代理人，直接向 {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手} 報告。深水城的公開領主要求他監視那些透過他們的行為可能幫助或危及城市及其市民的冒險者。由於呵欠之門吸引了各種冒險者，加萊斯特在這裡度過了很多時間，通常獨自坐在安靜的角落。{@creature Durnan|WDH|杜爾南} 知道加萊斯特為萊拉工作，所以不打擾這個年輕人。

english: Jalester is often distracted by thoughts of Faerrel Dunblade, his boyfriend, who was killed in a street fight last year. When not engaged in alliance business, Jalester is lonely and looking for love.
zh_tw: 加萊斯特經常被對費瑞爾·鄧布萊德的思念分散注意力，他男朋友去年在一場街頭鬥毆中被殺。當不忙於聯盟事務時，加萊斯特感到孤獨並尋找愛情。

english: Meloon Wardragon
zh_tw: 麥倫·戰龍

english: {@i NE male Chondathan human adventurer under the control of an intellect devourer}
zh_tw: {@i NE 男性瓊達斯人人類冒險家，受噬腦怪控制}

english: {@creature Meloon Wardragon|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) comes across as a cheery, optimistic, warm-hearted man eager to fight alongside those he considers his friends. The Yawning Portal staff and many of the regular guests know that Meloon is a skilled fighter with ties to Force Grey.
zh_tw: {@creature Meloon Wardragon|WDH|麥倫·戰龍}（見 {@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）給人的印象是一個快樂、樂觀、熱心腸的人，渴望與他視為朋友的人並肩作戰。呵欠之門的員工和許多常客都知道麥倫是一位與灰色力量有聯絡的熟練戰士。

english: An intellect devourer in league with {@creature Xanathar|WDH} ate Meloon's brain several months ago. Now under the monster's control, Meloon actively discourages adventurers from exploring Undermountain and urges them to focus on conflicts in the city instead. He also hunts down and kills Zhentarim operatives for his secret beholder master. He has his eye on {@creature Davil Starsong|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) but won't kill the elf in plain view of witnesses.
zh_tw: 幾個月前，與{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}有勾結的噬腦怪吃掉了麥倫的大腦。現在在怪物的控制下，麥倫積極勸阻冒險者探索地脈迷城，並敦促他們專注於城市中的衝突。他還追捕並殺死散塔林會的特工，為他的秘密眼魔主人服務。他盯上了{@creature Davil Starsong|WDH|達維爾·星歌}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），但不會在目擊者眾目睽睽之下殺死這個精靈。

english: Obaya Uday
zh_tw: 歐芭雅·烏黛

english: {@i NG female Chultan human priest of Waukeen}
zh_tw: {@i NG 女楚爾坦人類瓦金女神的女祭司}

english: Obaya, a priest, has traveled from Chult to sponsor expeditions into Undermountain, with the goal of bringing its magical treasures back to her employer, the merchant prince Wakanga O'tamu of Port Nyanzaru. She discourages low-level adventurers from exploring Undermountain but is happy to help them with her magic until they gain enough experience to be useful to her.
zh_tw: 歐芭雅，一位牧師，從楚爾特旅行到此，贊助進入地脈迷城的探險，目標是將其魔法寶藏帶回給她的僱主，南扎路港的商人王子瓦康嘎歐塔姆。她勸阻低等級的冒險者探索地脈迷城，但樂於用她的魔法幫助他們，直到他們獲得足夠的經驗對她有用為止。

english: If you plan to run {@i Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage} after this adventure, Obaya can take on a more prominent role as an advisor and a source of quests.
zh_tw: 如果你計劃在這次冒險之後進行 {@i 深水城: 瘋法師的地城}，歐芭雅可以擔任更重要的角色，作為顧問和任務來源。

english: Yagra Stonefist
zh_tw: 雅格拉·石拳

english: {@i N female half-orc thug-for-hire}
zh_tw: {@i N 女性半獸人僱傭打手}

english: Yagra is a Black Network mercenary who gets paid to protect a Zhent negotiator named {@creature Davil Starsong|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12} for more information on him). Yagra finds the job boring and likes to pass the time by challenging adventurers to arm wrestle. (Resolve such contests using contested Strength checks.) If the characters express their opposition to the Xanathar Guild, Yagra might urge them to speak to Davil about joining forces with the Zhentarim to destroy the beholder crime lord.
zh_tw: 雅格拉是黑網僱傭兵，受僱保護一位名叫{@creature Davil Starsong|WDH|達維爾·星歌}的散塔林會成員談判代表（有關他的更多資訊，請參見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）。雅格拉覺得這份工作很無聊，喜歡透過挑戰冒險者進行扳手腕來打發時間。（使用競爭的力量檢查來解決這類比賽。）如果角色們表達了他們對姍娜薩公會的反對，雅格拉可能會敦促他們與達維爾談談，加入散塔林會的力量，以摧毀穴居人犯罪領主。

english: Yagra is a half-orc thug. When reduced to 0 hit points, she drops to 1 hit point instead (but can't do this again until she finishes a long rest). She has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. She speaks Common and Orc.
zh_tw: 雅格拉是一個半獸人暴徒。當她的生命值降至0點時，她的生命值會改為1點（但在完成長休之前不能再這樣做）。她擁有60尺範圍內的黑暗視覺。她會說通用語和獸人語。

english: Chapter 1: A Friend in Need
zh_tw: 第1章：需要幫助的朋友

english: A bar brawl in the Yawning Portal proves that nowhere is safe from the gang war between the Zhentarim and the Xanathar Guild. In this atmosphere of danger, the characters are offered a quest by Volothamp Geddarm. Volo promises a reward if they can rescue his missing friend, {@creature Floon Blagmaar|WDH}, who he fears has been caught up in the conflict. Volo's quest is a straightforward introduction to the streets of Waterdeep, providing the characters with an excuse to explore the city.
zh_tw: 在呵欠之門發生的一場酒吧鬥毆證明瞭散塔林會和姍娜薩公會之間的幫派戰爭無處不在，沒有地方是安全的。在這種危險的氛圍中，瓦羅贊普·格達姆向角色們提供了一個任務。瓦羅承諾如果他們能夠救出他失蹤的朋友，{@creature Floon Blagmaar|WDH|福盧恩·布拉格瑪}，他將給予獎勵，他擔心福盧恩已經捲入了這場衝突。瓦羅的任務是向深水城街道的直接介紹，為角色們提供了探索城市的藉口。

english: In their hunt for Volo's friend, the characters might make allies and enemies who can resurface throughout the adventure. Following the completion of Volo's quest, the characters gain a home base with an address in Trollskull Alley, in Waterdeep's North Ward. From their new base, the characters can plot their own course, whether it involves interacting with Waterdeep's people, joining one of the city's many factions, or simply poking around for danger.
zh_tw: 在尋找瓦羅的朋友的過程中，角色們可能會結交盟友和敵人，這些人可能會在整個冒險中重新出現。完成瓦羅的任務後，角色們在深水城北區的巨魔顱骨巷獲得了一個帶有地址的基地。從他們的新基地出發，角色們可以規劃自己的路線，無論是與深水城的人民互動，加入城市眾多派系之一，還是簡單地尋找危險。

english: Where to Start
zh_tw: 從哪裡開始

english: This adventure assumes that the characters have already formed a party and are presently in the Yawning Portal, perhaps knocking back a pint of Shadowdark ale and wolfing down a plate of quipper and chips. Alternatively, you can begin this adventure as the characters first enter the raucous tavern, or by having them all meet for the first time as Volo hands them their initial quest.
zh_tw: 這次冒險假定角色們已經組成了一個隊伍，並且目前正在呵欠之門中，也許正在喝著一杯暗影黑暗啤酒，狼吞虎嚥地吃著一盤食人魚和薯條。或者，你可以從角色們第一次進入喧鬧的酒館開始這次冒險，或者讓他們在瓦羅交給他們最初的任務時第一次見面。

english: Tavern Brawl
zh_tw: 酒館鬥毆

english: As the characters are relaxing in the taproom of the Yawning Portal, a fistfight breaks out. Read the following to set the scene:
zh_tw: 當角色們在呵欠之門的酒吧放鬆時，一場鬥毆爆發了。請閱讀以下內容以設定場景：
