english: You sit around a sturdy wooden table lit by a brightly burning candle and littered with plates cleared of food and half-drained tankards. The sounds of gamblers yelling and drunken adventurers singing bawdy songs nearly drown out the off-key strumming of a young bard three tables over.
zh_tw: 你坐在一張堅固的木桌旁，桌上點著明亮燃燒的蠟燭，散落著已經清空食物的盤子和半空的酒杯。賭徒的叫喊聲和醉酒冒險者唱著粗俗歌曲的聲音幾乎淹沒了三張桌子外一個年輕吟遊詩人走調的彈奏聲。

english: Then all the noise is eclipsed by a shout: "Ya pig! Like killin' me mates, does ya?" Then a seven-foot-tall half-orc is hit by a wild, swinging punch from a male human whose shaved head is covered with eye-shaped tattoos. Four other humans stand behind him, ready to jump into the fray. The half-orc cracks her knuckles, roars, and leaps at the tattooed figure-but before you can see if blood is drawn, a crowd of spectators clusters around the brawl. What do you do?
zh_tw: 然後所有的噪音都被一聲大喊所掩蓋："你這頭豬！是不是想殺了我的同伴？"然後一個七尺高的半獸人被一個剃光頭、頭上佈滿眼睛形狀紋身的男性的一記狂野揮拳擊中。他身後站著四個人類，準備加入混戰。半獸人咔咔作響地捏響指關節，咆哮著，向紋身的人撲去——但在你能看到是否流血之前，一群圍觀者聚集在鬥毆周圍。你該怎麼辦？

english: The human combatants are five members of the Xanathar Guild (CE human {@creature bandit||bandits}). The one with the eye-shaped tattoos on his bald pate is their leader, Krentz. Their foe, Yagra Strongfist, is a half-orc employed by the Zhentarim (see the Yawning Portal Friendly Faces handout in appendix C). Yagra fights for her pride.
zh_tw: 參與鬥毆的人類是姍娜薩公會的五名成員（守序邪惡，人類{@creature bandit||匪徒}）。光頭上刺有眼睛圖案的克倫茲是他們的首領。他們的對手雅格拉·石拳是一名受僱於散塔林會的半獸人（見附錄C的「呵欠之門的友善面孔」）。雅格拉正在捍衛自己的榮譽。

english: Getting Involved
zh_tw: 參與其中

english: If the characters choose to join the fray, have everyone roll initiative. But the fight is almost over by the time they push through the rowdy spectators. Krentz has only 3 hit points remaining and is trying to escape from underneath Yagra, but the four other Xanathar Guild members are poised to tackle her.
zh_tw: 如果角色選擇加入混戰，請每個人進行先攻骰。但當他們擠過喧鬧的觀眾時，戰鬥幾乎已經結束了。克倫茲只剩下3點生命值，試圖從雅格拉身下逃脫，但另外四名姍娜薩公會成員準備抓住她。

english: Pulling Yagra away from Krentz requires a successful Strength check contested by Yagra's Strength check. Yagra thanks the characters if they help her, but is disappointed that they interfered in the fight.
zh_tw: 將雅格拉從克倫茲身邊拉開需要一次成功的力量檢查，與雅格拉的力量檢查相競爭。如果角色們幫助了她，雅格拉會感謝他們，但會對他們干涉戰鬥感到失望。

english: Remember how the characters deal with Krentz in this scene. If he survives, the characters might meet him again in one of the Xanathar Guild's sewer hideouts (see {@area Q5|07f}, page 28).
zh_tw: 記住角色在這場戲中如何處理克倫茲。如果他倖存下來，角色們可能會在姍娜薩公會的下水道藏身之處再次遇見他（見 {@area Q5|07f}，第28頁）。

english: Hanging Back
zh_tw: 保持距離

english: If the characters don't interfere in the brawl, Yagra knocks Krentz out cold but is then beaten {@condition unconscious} by his companions. {@creature Durnan|WDH}, the proprietor of the Yawning Portal, points toward the door. "Out!" he snarls, and the Xanathar Guild members flee carrying Krentz's {@condition unconscious} form.
zh_tw: 如果角色們沒有介入這場鬥毆，雅格拉會將克倫茲打得不省人事，隨後卻被他的同伴們打至{@condition unconscious||昏迷}。呵欠之門的老闆{@creature Durnan|WDH|杜爾南}指向門口，怒吼：「出去！」姍娜薩公會的成員便扛著{@condition unconscious||昏迷}的克倫茲逃了出去。

english: Troll and Friends
zh_tw: 巨魔和朋友們

english: In the third round of the brawl, trouble arises from out of the gaping well in the middle of the Yawning Portal's taproom:
zh_tw: 在呵欠之門酒吧的第三輪混戰中，麻煩從酒吧中間敞開的井中出現了：

english: Shouts of alarm suddenly ring out as a hulking creature climbs up out of the shaft in the middle of the taproom-a monster with warty green skin, a tangled nest of wiry black hair, a long, carrot-shaped nose, and bloodshot eyes. As it bares its yellow teeth and howls, you can see that a half-dozen bat-like creatures are attached to its body, with three more circling above it like flies. Everyone in the tavern reacts in fear except for the barkeep, {@creature Durnan|WDH}, who shouts, "Troll!"
zh_tw: 突然間，隨著一個巨大的生物從酒吧中央的豎井爬出來，驚叫聲響起——這是一個怪物，有著疣狀的綠色皮膚、一團亂蓬蓬的黑色頭髮、一個長而胡蘿蔔形狀的鼻子和充血的眼睛。當它露出黃色的牙齒並嚎叫時，你可以看到有六個蝙蝠樣的生物附著在它的身體上，還有三個像蒼蠅一樣在它上方盤旋。酒吧裡的每個人都感到恐懼，除了酒吧老闆 {@creature Durnan|WDH|杜爾南}，他大喊：'巨魔！'

english: The {@creature troll}, which currently has 44 hit points, has crawled up from the first level of Undermountain to feed on tasty humanoid flesh, bringing nine {@creature stirge||stirges} with it. Once in the taproom, the troll rises to its full height of 9 feet and rolls initiative. The stirges also roll initiative, but only the three flying above the troll pose a threat. The remaining stirges are bloated, having drained copious amounts of the troll's blood, and fly back down the shaft to digest their meal. As the troll regenerates, the effects of its blood loss become less apparent.
zh_tw: 這個{@creature troll||巨魔}，目前有44點生命值，從地脈迷城的第一層爬上來，以美味的類人生物的肉為食，它帶來了九隻{@creature stirge||蚊蝠}。一旦進入酒吧，巨魔站起身來，高達9尺，並進行先攻。蚊蝠們也進行先攻，但只有飛在巨魔上方的三隻構成威脅。其餘的蚊蝠們因為吸取了巨魔大量的血液而膨脹，它們飛回井道去消化它們的食物。隨著巨魔的再生，它失血的影響變得不那麼明顯。

english: Most tavern patrons and staffers flee or take cover at the sight of the troll. The stirges attack the nearest characters as {@creature Durnan|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) draws his greatsword, springs over the bar, and confronts the monster himself. As he attacks, he calls on the characters to focus on slaying the stirges and then douse the troll with lamp oil and set it on fire when it falls. Yagra joins the fight if she's conscious. To any characters who help defeat the troll, {@creature Durnan|WDH} says matter-of-factly, "You fought well."
zh_tw: 大多數酒館的顧客和員工在看到巨魔時都會逃跑或尋找掩護。螞蟥攻擊最近的角色，而{@creature Durnan|WDH|杜爾南}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）拔出他的雙手劍，跳過吧檯，親自面對怪物。當他攻擊時，他呼籲角色們集中精力殺死螞蟥，然後在巨魔倒下時用燈油澆它並點燃它。如果雅格拉還清醒，她會加入戰鬥。對於任何幫助擊敗巨魔的角色，{@creature Durnan|WDH|杜爾南}實事求是地說："你們打得很好。"

english: If any of the characters are reduced to 0 hit points during the fight, employees of the Yawning Portal step forward to stabilize them.
zh_tw: 如果在戰鬥中有任何角色的生命值降至0，呵欠之門的員工會上前穩定他們的狀態。

english: Meeting Volo
zh_tw: 遇見瓦羅

english: Once the {@creature troll} and the {@creature stirge||stirges} are dealt with, Volo pushes against the tide of patrons staying clear of the monster to greet the characters, lavishing praise on them for their bravery (whether justified or not): "You be adventurers, am I right? I could use your help. Let's find a table to talk, shall we?"
zh_tw: 一旦{@creature troll||巨魔}和{@creature stirge||蚊蝠}被處理掉，瓦羅就會逆著避開怪物的顧客潮流，向角色們打招呼，對他們的勇氣大加讚揚（無論是否合理）："你們是冒險者，對吧？我可能需要你們的幫助。我們找張桌子談談，好嗎？"

english: Volothamp Geddarm is known to most Waterdavians as a braggart and a notorious embellisher of facts. For all his faults, though, Volo is a soft-hearted sort who cares for nothing as much as his friends. At present, he is grievously concerned for the well-being of one of them. He begins his request with an air of charm and mystery, but it quickly devolves into tearful sincerity.
zh_tw: 瓦羅贊普·格達姆在大多數水深城人中以自吹自擂和臭名昭著的事實誇張者而聞名。儘管他有所有這些缺點，瓦羅卻是一個心地善良的人，他最關心的莫過於他的朋友。目前，他對其中一位朋友的福祉深感憂慮。他以魅力和神秘的氣氛開始他的請求，但很快就變成了淚流滿面的真誠。

english: The figure who approached you strokes his mustache, adjusts his floppy hat, and tightens his scarf. "Volothamp Geddarm, chronicler, wizard, and celebrity, at your service. I trust you've noted the violence in our fair city these past tendays. I haven't seen so much blood since my last visit to Baldur's Gate! But now I fear I have misplaced a friend amid this odious malevolence.
zh_tw: 接近你們的人物撫摸著他的鬍子，調整他的軟帽，拉緊他的圍巾。"瓦羅贊普·格達姆，編年史家，法師，名人，為您服務。我相信你們已經注意到了我們美麗城市在過去幾天裡的暴力事件。自從我上次訪問博德之門以來，我還沒有見過這麼多血跡！但現在我擔心我在這可憎的惡行中迷失了一個朋友。

english: "My friend's name is {@creature Floon Blagmaar|WDH}. He's got more beauty than brains, and I worry he took a bad way home a couple nights ago and was kidnapped-or worse. If you agree to track him down with all due haste, I can offer you ten dragons apiece now, and I can give you each ten times that when you find Floon. May I prevail upon you in my hour of need?"
zh_tw: "我的朋友名叫 {@creature Floon Blagmaar|WDH|福盧恩·布拉格瑪}。他美過智，我擔心幾天前晚上他選錯了回家的路，被綁架了——或者更糟。如果你們同意儘快追蹤他，我現在可以給你們每人十條龍（金幣），當你們找到福盧恩時，我還可以給每人十倍於此的報酬。在我需要幫助的時候，你們能幫我嗎？"

english: Volo gives each character a small pouch containing 10 gp simply for accepting his quest. Characters who want to discover his intentions must make a {@dc 10} Wisdom (Insight) check. On a success, a character discerns that Volo is honest but might be stretching the truth about how much he can pay. (Currently low on cash, Volo is awaiting royalty payments from {@book Volo's Guide to Monsters|vgm}. To make more coin, he began work on a new book, {@i Volo's Guide to Spirits and Specters}. As it happens, his knowledge of spirits mostly concerns the alcoholic variety, and the writing has not been going well.) If pressed, Volo urges the characters to trust him, and promises he'll have the rest of the reward, 100 gp per character, ready to deliver once Floon is returned to him alive.
zh_tw: 瓦羅為每位接受了任務的角色提供一個小袋子，裡面裝有10金幣。想要了解他意圖的角色必須進行一次{@dc 10}的感知（洞悉）檢定。成功的角色會察覺到瓦羅是誠實的，但可能誇大了他能支付的金額。（目前現金緊缺的瓦羅正在等待他《瓦羅的怪物指南》（{@book 瓦羅怪物指南|vgm}）的版稅收入。為了賺更多的錢，他開始著手寫一本新書，{@i 瓦羅的鬼魂與幽靈指南}。事實上，他對"精神"的瞭解大多與酒精有關，寫作進展並不順利。）如果被逼問，瓦羅會敦促角色們相信他，並承諾一旦福盧恩活著歸還給他，他將準備好發放剩餘的獎勵，每位角色100金幣。

english: Volo describes Floon as a handsome human male in his early thirties with wavy red-blond hair. He was dressed in princely garb when Volo last saw him. Two nights ago, before Floon disappeared, he and Volo were drinking and merrymaking at the Skewered Dragon, a dark, bawdy tavern in the Dock Ward. Volo recommends that the characters start their search there.
zh_tw: 瓦羅描述福盧恩為一個三十多歲、英俊的紅髮男子，擁有波浪般的紅金色頭髮。瓦羅上次見到他時，他穿著王子般的華服。在福盧恩消失前兩晚，他和瓦羅在碼頭區的"穿刺之龍"——一家昏暗、粗俗的酒館——喝酒作樂。瓦羅建議角色們從那裡開始他們的搜尋。

english: What Happened That Night?
zh_tw: 那晚發生了什麼？

english: Volo is embarrassed to admit he might have gotten his friend Floon in trouble, and he resists providing all the details of what happened the night Floon disappeared.
zh_tw: 瓦羅感到尷尬，承認他可能讓他的朋友福盧恩陷入了麻煩，他拒絕提供福盧恩消失那晚發生的事情的所有細節。

english: Beset by writer's block, Volo met {@creature Floon Blagmaar|WDH} for drinks at the Skewered Dragon two nights ago. They drank and gambled for a few hours, and then Volo left. That's the last he saw of Floon.
zh_tw: 由於寫作障礙，瓦羅兩天前在穿刺之龍與 {@creature Floon Blagmaar|WDH|福盧恩·布拉格瑪} 見面喝酒。他們喝了幾個小時的酒，還賭博，然後瓦羅離開了。那是他最後一次見到福盧恩。

english: Unbeknownst to Volo, not long after he departed, a drunken Floon met another acquaintance, Lord {@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh}, at the tavern. The two left together, with Renaer offering to walk Floon home. Five Zhentarim thugs working for {@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) jumped both Floon and Renaer. They took them to a warehouse in the Dock Ward, so they could question Renaer-the son of Lord Dagult Neverember-about the whereabouts of the Stone of Golorr and his father's hidden cache of dragons. Before the interrogation could begin, members of the Xanathar Guild ambushed and killed the Zhent guards in the warehouse. The new arrivals mistook Floon for Renaer, knocked Floon {@condition unconscious}, and dragged him away while Renaer hid and escaped their notice.
zh_tw: 瓦羅並不知道，他離開後不久，醉醺醺的福盧恩在酒館遇到了另一位熟人——{@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh|瑞納爾·無燼}領主。兩人一同離開，瑞納爾主動提出送福盧恩回家。五名替{@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh|厄斯圖爾·弗洛克辛}（見{@adventure 附錄B|WDH|12}）效力的散塔林會暴徒伏擊了他們，將兩人帶到碼頭區的一座倉庫，打算審問達格魯特·無燼領主之子瑞納爾，查出格洛爾之石的下落，以及他父親藏匿龍幣寶藏的地點。審訊尚未開始，姍娜薩公會的成員便伏擊並殺死了倉庫中的散塔林會守衛。後來的襲擊者將福盧恩誤認為瑞納爾，把他打至{@condition unconscious||昏迷}後拖走；瑞納爾則躲了起來，沒有被他們發現。

english: Floon was taken to a Xanathar Guild hideout in the sewers. A small gang of kenku was left behind at the Zhentarim warehouse to kill any other Zhents who might show up at the warehouse. The presence of the kenku has prevented Renaer from trying to leave the warehouse.
zh_tw: 福盧恩被帶到了一個位於下水道中的姍娜薩公會藏身之處。一小群天狗留在了散塔林會的倉庫裡，目的是殺死任何可能出現在倉庫的其他散塔林會成員。天狗的存在阻止了瑞納爾試圖離開倉庫。

english: Finding Floon
zh_tw: 尋找福盧恩

english: Volo last saw Floon outside the Skewered Dragon, a dubious (and Zhentarim-owned) tavern between Net Street and Fillet Lane in the Dock Ward. The following encounters kick off the characters' investigation.
zh_tw: 瓦羅最後一次見到福盧恩是在穿刺之龍外面，這是一個位於碼頭區的漁網街和魚片巷之間的可疑（並且是散塔林會擁有的）酒館。接下來的遭遇啟動了角色們的調查。

english: En route to the tavern, "Blood in the Streets" is a chance for characters to see the City Watch in action. If the characters decide to look around, "Searching the Dock Ward" gives them a feel for their surroundings, and they might discover a strange place, "Old Xoblob Shop," that warrants further exploration. Once they arrive at their destination, "The Skewered Dragon" is an opportunity for the characters to get information from the patrons, which leads them to "Candle Lane," where their quest continues.
zh_tw: 在前往酒館的路上，"血染街頭"是一個讓角色們看到城市守衛行動的機會。如果角色們決定四處看看，"搜尋碼頭區"讓他們對周圍環境有所感受，他們可能會發現一個奇怪的地方，"老索布洛布商店"，值得進一步探索。一旦他們到達目的地，"穿刺之龍"是一個讓角色們從顧客那裡獲取資訊的機會，這將引導他們前往"蠟燭巷"，他們的任務在那裡繼續。

english: Blood in the Streets
zh_tw: 街頭的血跡

english: As the characters travel through the Dock Ward, they come upon the aftermath of a bloody clash between the Xanathar Guild and the Zhentarim:
zh_tw: 當角色們穿越碼頭區時，他們遇到了姍娜薩公會和散塔林會之間血腥衝突的後果：

english: As you turn a corner, you find yourselves on a street that has been cordoned off by the City Watch. Lying on the cobblestones are a half-dozen corpses, seemingly the victims of some terrible skirmish. Watch officers have disarmed and arrested three blood-drenched humans and are in the midst of questioning witnesses. One of the officers sees you. "Get on," she says. "Nothing to see here."
zh_tw: 當你轉過一個街角，發現自己來到了一條被城市守衛封鎖的街道。躺在鵝卵石上的是半打屍體，顯然是某種可怕小規模戰鬥的受害者。守衛官員已經解除了三個血跡斑斑的人的武裝並將其逮捕，目前正在詢問目擊者。其中一位官員看到了你。"走吧，"她說。"這裡沒什麼好看的。"

english: The skirmish that occurred here has nothing to do with Floon's disappearance but represents an escalation in the conflict between the Zhentarim and the Xanathar Guild. A dozen {@creature guard||guards} of the City Watch have arrested three {@creature bandit||bandits} and are questioning witnesses while waiting for wagons to take away the criminals and the corpses. The survivors of the skirmish have been stripped of their weapons and forced to kneel with their hands on their heads. All three, loyal Zhentarim agents (employed by {@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh}; see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), are likely to be accused of murder. They coldly catch the eye of anyone who passes by, but the City Watch won't let the characters anywhere near the prisoners.
zh_tw: 這裡發生的小規模戰鬥與福盧恩的失蹤無關，但代表了散塔林會和姍娜薩公會之間衝突的升級。城市守衛的一打{@creature guard||警衛}逮捕了三名{@creature bandit||匪徒}，並在等待馬車來運送罪犯和屍體的同時詢問目擊者。小規模戰鬥的生還者被剝奪了武器，被迫跪下，手放在頭上。所有三人，都是忠誠的散塔林會特工（由{@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh|厄斯圖爾·弗洛克辛}僱傭；見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），很可能會被控以謀殺罪。他們冷漠地注視著每一個經過的人，但城市守衛不會讓角色們靠近囚犯。

english: Searching the Dock Ward
zh_tw: 搜尋碼頭區

english: The Dock Ward is unsafe. You can set the mood by reading the following to the players:
zh_tw: 碼頭區不安全。你可以透過向玩家閱讀以下內容來營造氛圍：

english: Tall, densely packed tenements leave most of the neighborhood in shadow at ground level. Most of the streetlamps have had their glass smashed and their candles stolen, and the smells of salt air and excrement linger as you pass by rows of run-down buildings.
zh_tw: 高大、密集的公寓樓使得大部分社群在地面層都處於陰影中。大多數路燈的玻璃都被砸碎，蠟燭也被偷走了，當你經過一排排破舊的建築物時，鹽空氣和糞便的氣味依然瀰漫。

english: On the corner of Zastrow Street and Fillet Lane is a shop with a peculiar window display:
zh_tw: 在扎斯特羅街和魚片巷的拐角處有一家商店，櫥窗展示非常奇特：

english: One nearby shop stands out from the others. It has a deep purple facade, and in its window hangs a stuffed beholder. Above the door hangs a sign whose elaborate letters spell out "Old Xoblob Shop."
zh_tw: 附近的一家商店與其他店鋪截然不同。它有一個深紫色的立面，在窗戶裡掛著一個填充的眼魔。門上方掛著一個招牌，上面用繁複的字母拼出"老索布洛布商店"。

english: If the characters check out the shop, continue with "Old Xoblob Shop." If they don't, they find the tavern without further incident; see "The Skewered Dragon" below.
zh_tw: 如果角色們去檢視商店，請繼續閱讀'老索布洛布商店'。如果他們沒有，他們會在沒有進一步事件的情況下找到酒館；見下面的'穿刺之龍'。

english: Old Xoblob Shop
zh_tw: 老索布洛布商店

english: When the characters enter, they quickly get a sense of the strangeness of the place:
zh_tw: 當角色們進入時，他們很快感受到了這個地方的奇異之處：

english: A cloud of lavender-scented purple smoke trails out of the shop's door as you peer inside. Every wall is painted purple, and every dusty knickknack on the shelves is dyed a deep violet. The hairless old gnome sitting cross-legged on the counter wears plum-colored robes. His cheeks are decorated with nine purple face-painted eyes.
zh_tw: 當你窺視店內時，一陣薰衣草香氣的紫色煙霧從店門飄出。每面牆都被漆成紫色，架子上每件落滿灰塵的小飾品都被染成深紫羅蘭色。那位盤腿坐在櫃檯上的無毛老侏儒穿著梅子色的長袍，臉頰上畫著九隻紫色的眼睛圖案。

english: The gnome lowers a pipe and exhales a cloud of lavender smoke before raising a hand. "Hail and well met! Come browse the shelves of the most curious curiosity shop in the world!"
zh_tw: 侏儒放下菸鬥，撥出一團薰衣草色的煙霧，然後舉起手。"歡迎光臨！來瀏覽世界上最奇特的古董店的貨架吧！"

english: The shop is named after the stuffed beholder in the window-a fixture that is actually a magical sensor, through which {@creature Xanathar|WDH} can peer whenever it wishes.
zh_tw: 這家商店是以櫥窗裡的填充眼魔命名的——這個裝置實際上是一個魔法感測器，{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}可以隨時透過它窺視。

english: The shopkeeper is a wizened {@creature deep gnome (svirfneblin)||deep gnome} who spies for the Xanathar Guild. A few years ago, he survived the detonation of a gas spore in Undermountain and inherited some stray beholder memories. Driven by a compulsion to carve out his own domain, the gnome settled in Waterdeep, bought the Old Xoblob Shop from its previous owner, and tried renaming it after himself, yet everyone kept calling it the Old Xoblob Shop. He therefore restored the old name and changed his name to Xoblob. "No relation to the eye tyrant hanging in the window!" he says.
zh_tw: 店主是一個老練的{@creature deep gnome (svirfneblin)||地底侏儒}，為姍娜薩公會做間諜。幾年前，他在地脈迷城的一次氣孢爆炸中倖存下來，並繼承了一些零散的眼魔記憶。出於建立自己領地的衝動，這個侏儒在深水城定居，從前任店主那裡買下了老索布洛布商店，並試圖以自己的名字重新命名它，但每個人都繼續叫它老索布洛布商店。因此，他恢復了舊名字，並將名字改為索布洛布。"和櫥窗裡掛著的眼魔暴君沒有關係！"他說。

english: Trinkets
zh_tw: 飾品

english: The gnome sells an assortment of trinkets. As the characters search the shelves, roll on the {@item Trinket|phb|Trinkets} table in chapter 5 of the {@book Player's Handbook|phb} to determine what catches their eye. Xoblob sells any trinket for {@dice 1d6} gp.
zh_tw: 侏儒出售各種小玩意兒。當角色們在貨架上搜尋時，請參考{@book 玩家手冊|phb}第五章中的{@item Trinket|phb|飾品}表進行擲骰，以確定吸引他們目光的物品。索布洛布以{@dice 1d6}金幣的價格出售任何小飾品。

english: Floon's Fate
zh_tw: 福盧恩的命運

english: The gnome doesn't know Floon by name, but he recognizes his description. He is reluctant to share information, but offering him a new purple item or succeeding on a {@dc 13} Charisma (Intimidation or Persuasion) check loosens his tongue. He says that Floon and a well-dressed fellow of similar appearance and bearing ({@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh}, though the gnome doesn't know his name and didn't recognize him) were jumped outside the shop by rough-looking men in black leather armor. Xoblob thinks there were five attackers, but none of them looked familiar. One of them had a black tattoo of a winged snake on his neck.
zh_tw: 這個侏儒不知道福盧恩的名字，但他認出了他的描述。他不願分享資訊，但給他一個新的紫色物品或在{@dc 13}魅力（威嚇或說服）檢定中成功可以讓他開口。他說福盧恩和一個穿著考究、外表和舉止相似的人（{@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh|瑞納爾·無燼}，儘管侏儒不知道他的名字，也沒有認出他）在店外被穿著黑色皮甲的粗魯男子襲擊了。索布洛布認為有五名襲擊者，但他們都不熟悉。其中一個人的脖子上有一個帶翅膀的蛇的黑色紋身。

english: The Skewered Dragon
zh_tw: 穿刺之龍

english: The Skewered Dragon faces an alley that runs between Net Street and Fillet Lane in the Dock Ward, not far from the Old Xoblob Shop. When the characters approach it, read:
zh_tw: 穿刺之龍面向一個位於碼頭區的漁網街和魚片巷之間的巷子，離老索布洛布商店不遠。當角色們接近它時，閱讀：

english: The Skewered Dragon looks like a ruin. Both of its front-facing windows are smashed, and a ship's anchor is lodged in the roof. Through the windows, you can see a group of haggard patrons drinking from huge tankards.
zh_tw: 穿刺之龍看起來像是一座廢墟。它的兩個面向前方的窗戶都被砸碎了，一個船錨卡在屋頂上。透過窗戶，你可以看到一群疲憊的顧客在喝著巨大的酒杯。

english: Floon has not been at the Skewered Dragon since the night of his disappearance, and the dive's dockworker patrons are loath to talk to strangers. A bribe or a successful {@dc 13} Charisma (Intimidation or Persuasion) check gets them to open up.
zh_tw: 福盧恩自從失蹤的那個晚上之後就沒有再來過"穿刺之龍"，這家破舊酒吧的碼頭工人顧客們不願意與陌生人交談。一賄賂或一次成功的 {@dc 13} 魅力（威嚇或說服）檢定可以讓他們開口。

english: Floon's Fate
zh_tw: 福盧恩的命運

english: Several of the regulars remember seeing Volo and Floon drinking together a couple of nights ago. After Volo left, Floon stuck around long enough to meet with another friend: {@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh}, the son of Waterdeep's previous Open Lord, Dagult Neverember. "Chip off the old block, that one!" sneers one patron. "Just another spoiled, rich noble who likes to rub our noses in it!" says another.
zh_tw: 一些常客記得幾天前看到瓦羅和福盧恩一起喝酒。瓦羅離開後，福盧恩留下來足夠長的時間會見另一個朋友：{@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh|瑞納爾·無燼}，深水城前公開領主達格魯特·無燼的兒子。"真是一個模子刻出來的！"一個顧客嘲笑道。"又一個被寵壞的富貴族，喜歡在我們面前炫耀！"另一個人說。

english: The two drank and played a few rounds of Three-Dragon Ante before leaving around midnight. Five men followed them out, and no one in the tavern knows what happened after that. The men who left shortly after Floon and Renaer haven't returned to the tavern since, but they're known to frequent a warehouse on Candle Lane. "Look for the snake symbol on the door," says one of the tavern regulars.
zh_tw: 他們兩個喝酒並玩了幾輪三龍牌局，然後在午夜前後離開。五個人跟著他們出去，酒館裡沒有人知道之後發生了什麼。在福盧恩和瑞納爾離開後不久離開的那些人還沒有回到酒館，但他們被知道經常光顧蠟燭巷上的一個倉庫。"在門上尋找蛇的標記，"一個酒館常客說。

english: Candle Lane
zh_tw: 蠟燭巷

english: The buildings on either side of Candle Lane are so tall and so tightly packed together that light touches the street only at highsun.
zh_tw: 蠟燭巷兩旁的建築物如此高大、如此緊密地擠在一起，以至於陽光只有在正午時分才能照到街道上。

english: Gloom envelops a narrow alley as dark as a dungeon-and as odorous as one, too. Nearly all the streetlamps have been smashed. The only light that pierces the darkness is a faint flickering from down the lane, like a distant candle.
zh_tw: 黑暗籠罩著一條狹窄的巷子，它像地牢一樣黑暗——而且氣味也像。幾乎所有的路燈都被砸碎了。唯一穿透黑暗的光線是遠處小巷傳來的微弱閃爍，就像遠處的蠟燭。

english: The flickering comes from the one streetlamp still intact on Candle Lane, kept alight by a {@spell continual flame} spell. A warehouse is directly across the street from the lamp, which illuminates a black winged snake (the symbol of the Zhentarim) painted above the door's handle. Characters who have ties to the Zhentarim recognize the symbol, while others can recall its significance with a successful {@dc 10} Intelligence check.
zh_tw: 閃爍的燈光來自於蠟燭巷上唯一完好無損的路燈，被一個{@spell continual flame||不滅明焰}法術保持點亮。路燈的正對面是一個倉庫，燈光照亮的門把手上方畫著一條黑色的翼蛇（散塔林會的象徵）。與散塔林會有關聯的角色會認出這個符號，而其他角色可以透過一個成功的{@dc 10}智力檢定回想起其意義。

english: Zhentarim Hideout
zh_tw: 散塔林會藏身之地

english: The hideout on Castle Lane (see map 1.1) is a ramshackle two-story warehouse. The Black Network has other sanctuaries in run-down buildings like this one throughout Waterdeep (meaning that the floor plan of this locale can be reused for other Zhent hideouts).
zh_tw: 城堡巷的藏身之處（見地圖1.1）是一個破舊的兩層倉庫。黑網在深水城像這樣的破敗建築中還有其他避難所（這意味著這個地方的平面圖可以重複用於其他散塔林會藏身點）。

english: Zhent Warehouse
zh_tw: 散塔林會成員倉庫

english: Zhent Warehouse, Lower (Player Version)
zh_tw: 散塔林會倉庫，下層（玩家版）

english: The warehouse stands at the back of an outer yard behind a high fence. The gate on the fence isn't locked. The building's three points of entry-a front door, a large warehouse loading door, and a painted-over window-are locked. The front door has a sliding peephole that can be opened from the inside. Either of the doors or the window can be unlocked by a character who makes a successful {@dc 12} Dexterity check using thieves' tools, or can be forced open with a successful {@dc 10} Strength (Athletics) check.
zh_tw: 倉庫位於一個高牆後面的外院後方。圍牆上的門沒有上鎖。建築物的三個入口——一扇前門、一扇大型倉庫裝卸門和一扇被油漆覆蓋的窗戶——都被鎖上了。前門上有一個可以從內部開啟的滑動窺視孔。任何一扇門或窗戶都可以透過使用盜賊工具成功進行{@dc 12}敏捷檢定來解鎖，或者透過成功進行{@dc 10}力量（運動）檢定來強行開啟。

english: Knocking at the doors or the window alerts a group of {@creature kenku} inside that someone is coming. The kenku scramble to hide behind toppled furniture, making a ruckus that any character who has a passive Wisdom (Perception) score of 16 or higher can hear. These kenku are all that remain of the Xanathar Guild force that murdered almost everyone in the warehouse after the five Zhentarim thugs captured {@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh} and {@creature Floon Blagmaar|WDH} and brought them here. Floon was taken away, but Renaer succeeded in staying alive by hiding. Now, the young noble is trying to figure out how to slip past the kenku, who are lazily searching the warehouse for loot while waiting to see if any more Zhents show up.
zh_tw: 敲門或窗戶會提醒裡面一群{@creature kenku||天狗}有人來了。這些天狗趕緊躲在翻倒的傢俱後面，發出的喧鬧聲任何被動感知（感知）得分為16或更高的角色都能聽到。這些天狗是姍娜薩公會力量的殘餘，他們在五個散塔林會暴徒捕獲{@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh|瑞納爾·無燼}和{@creature Floon Blagmaar|WDH|福盧恩·布拉格瑪}並將他們帶到這裡之後，幾乎殺害了倉庫裡的所有人。福盧恩被帶走了，但瑞納爾設法透過隱藏而存活下來。現在，這位年輕的貴族正在試圖找出如何溜過這些天狗，它們正在懶洋洋地在倉庫裡搜尋戰利品，同時等待看是否有更多的散塔林會成員出現。

english: Z1. Main Room
zh_tw: Z1. 主房間

english: The Black Network's main business is recruiting, training, and equipping sellswords. Crates packed with weapons, rations, boots, black uniforms, and other gear fill the warehouse.
zh_tw: 黑網的主要業務是招募、訓練和裝備僱傭兵。裝滿武器、口糧、靴子、黑色制服和其他裝備的板條箱填滿了倉庫。

english: When the characters try to enter, determine if the four {@creature kenku} inside are aware of their presence before reading the boxed text.
zh_tw: 當角色們試圖進入時，在閱讀方框文字之前，確定裡面的四個 {@creature kenku||天狗} 是否意識到了他們的存在。

english: A character with thieves' tools can pick the lock on a door or the window with a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity check. Characters who enter quietly can try to catch the kenku by surprise. If the characters knock before entering or announce their arrival in some other way, the kenku hide as described above.
zh_tw: 一名擁有盜賊工具的角色可以透過成功的 {@dc 10} 敏捷檢定撬開門鎖或窗戶。悄悄進入的角色可以嘗試讓肯庫措手不及。如果角色在進入前敲門或以其他方式宣佈他們的到來，肯庫會像上面描述的那樣躲藏起來。

english: Tables and chairs have been carelessly tossed across the floor. The corpses of a dozen men lie along the walls, their rapiers and daggers lying nearby. On the north side of the area, stairs rise to an open level above.
zh_tw: 桌子和椅子被隨意地扔在地板上。一打人的屍體躺在牆邊，他們的刺劍和匕首散落在附近。在區域的北側，樓梯通向上方一個開放的樓層。

english: If the kenku aren't hidden, add:
zh_tw: 如果天狗沒有隱藏，新增：

english: Four short, avian creatures with long beaks and black feathers look over in surprise from where they stand in the middle of the warehouse. Each wears a hooded cloak and wields a shortsword.
zh_tw: 四隻短小的禽類生物，有著長喙和黑色羽毛，從倉庫中央的位置驚訝地看過來。每個都穿著帶兜帽的斗篷，手持短劍。

english: The corpses belong to five human Zhentarim sellswords (the same ones who kidnapped Floon and Renaer) and seven human Xanathar Guild thugs, all of them clad in leather armor. Each Zhent has a black tattoo of a winged snake on his neck or forearm, and one of the Xanathar Guild members has a black tattoo on the palm of his right hand that looks like a circle with ten spokes radiating out from its circumference (the symbol of {@creature Xanathar|WDH}).
zh_tw: 屍體屬於五名人類散塔林會僱傭兵（也就是綁架福盧恩和瑞納爾的人）和七名人類姍娜薩公會暴徒，他們全都穿著皮甲。每個散塔林會成員的脖子或前臂上都有一個黑色有翼蛇的紋身，其中一名姍娜薩公會成員的右手掌上有一個黑色的紋身，看起來像一個圓圈，圓週上有十個輻射狀的輪輻（姍娜薩{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的標誌）。

english: The kenku fight until two of them are {@condition incapacitated} or killed, whereupon the survivors try to flee. A successful {@dc 10} Charisma (Intimidation) check forces captured kenku to divulge what they know.
zh_tw: 肯庫會戰鬥直到其中兩個被{@condition incapacitated||無力}或被殺死，倖存的肯庫會試圖逃跑。一次成功的{@dc 10}魅力（威嚇）檢定可以迫使被俘的肯庫透露他們知道的資訊。

english: What the Kenku Know
zh_tw: 天狗所知道的

english: When kenku speak, they mimic sounds and voices they have heard before. Under interrogation, they repeat the following phrases:
zh_tw: 當天狗（天狗）說話時，它們模仿它們以前聽過的聲音和嗓音。在審問下，它們重複以下短語：

english: In a deep voice with an orcish accent: "{@creature Xanathar|WDH} sends its regards."
zh_tw: 用帶有獸人口音的低沉聲音說："{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩} 向你致意。"

english: In a thin, nasally voice: "Tie up the pretty boy in the back room!" and "Follow the yellow signs in the sewers." (This remark refers to tunnels in the sewers that are marked with {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s symbol where they lead to the Xanathar Guild hideout.)
zh_tw: 用尖細的鼻音說道："把那個漂亮男孩綁在後屋裡！"和"跟著下水道里的黃色標誌走。"（這句話指的是下水道中標記有{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}符號的隧道，它們通向姍娜薩公會藏身處。）

english: In a scratchy voice: "No time to loot the place. Just get him to the boss."
zh_tw: 用沙啞的聲音說："沒時間搜刮這個地方。只需把他帶到老闆那裡。"

english: Z2. Storage Closet
zh_tw: Z2. 儲藏室

english: The door to this back room hangs loosely on broken hinges. The cramped chamber beyond smells strongly of sour fish and vinegar. It is filled with discarded ropes, canvas tarpaulins, and splintered wood from smashed barrels. {@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) is hiding here, having slipped free of his rope bonds. The characters can hear his ragged breathing coming from under a tarpaulin at the north end of the room.
zh_tw: 這個後室的門鬆鬆地掛在斷裂的鉸鏈上。狹窄的房間散發出濃重的酸魚和醋味。房間裡堆滿了廢棄的繩索、帆布防水布和從破碎的木桶上裂開的木片。{@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh|瑞納爾·無燼}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）就藏在這裡，他已經從繩索的束縛中溜了出來。角色們可以聽到他在房間北端的防水布下傳來的急促呼吸聲。

english: Roleplaying Renaer
zh_tw: 扮演瑞納爾

english: Renaer is unarmed. Marred by grime and the lingering stench of rancid pickled herring, he speaks with grace and articulation, as befits his noble upbringing. His trust is easily gained but impossible to restore once broken.
zh_tw: 瑞納爾沒有攜帶武器。他身上沾滿汙垢，還殘留著變質的醃鯡魚的刺鼻氣味，但他說話時仍然優雅而清晰，這與他貴族的教養相符。他的信任很容易獲得，但一旦破裂就無法恢復。

english: On the night of the abduction, Renaer was concerned that Floon was too intoxicated to find his way home by himself and offered to escort him. The two were jumped by five thugs as they left Fillet Lane and headed north on Zastrow Street.
zh_tw: 在綁架的那個晚上，瑞納爾擔心福盧恩喝得太多，無法自己找到回家的路，於是提出護送他。當他們離開魚片巷向北走扎斯特羅街時，被五個暴徒襲擊了。

english: Renaer feels guilty that Floon was taken, since he believes (correctly) that they mistook Floon for him. If the characters ask Renaer to join their search for Floon, he agrees to do so, arming himself with a dagger and a rapier scavenged from the dead Zhents in the warehouse.
zh_tw: 瑞納爾對於福盧恩被抓感到內疚，因為他相信（正確地）他們誤將福盧恩當成了他。如果角色們請求瑞納爾加入他們尋找福盧恩的行動，他同意這樣做，並從倉庫中死去的散塔林會成員那裡搜尋到一把匕首和一把刺劍來武裝自己。

english: If a character asks Renaer why the Zhents kidnapped him, he gives the following truthful reply:
zh_tw: 如果一個角色問瑞納爾為什麼散塔林會成員綁架了他，他給出了以下真實的回答：

english: "The Zhentarim thinks that my father embezzled a large amount of gold while he was Open Lord, and that he hid the dragons somewhere in the city. They think they can find it by using an artifact called the Stone of Golorr, which was in the hands of the Xanathar Guild until recently. Apparently, someone stole it. The Zhents thought I knew something about all of this, but I don't. My father and I haven't spoken in years."
zh_tw: "散塔林會認為我父親在擔任公開領主期間挪用了一大筆黃金，並且他把龍藏在了城市的某個地方。他們認為他們可以透過使用一個叫做格洛爾之石的神器來找到它，這個神器直到最近還在姍娜薩公會的手中。顯然，有人偷走了它。散塔林會成員認為我知道這一切的一些事情，但我並不知道。我和我父親已經多年沒有交談了。"

english: Z3. Secret Room
zh_tw: Z3. 密室

english: This room is hidden behind a secret door that can be found with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check. When the secret door is opened, the characters can hear the faint sound of a bell ringing in the offices above them ({@area Z5|06e}).
zh_tw: 這個房間隱藏在一扇秘密門後，可以透過成功的 {@dc 15} 感知（感知）檢定發現。當秘密門被開啟時，角色們可以聽到上方辦公室裡微弱的鐘聲 ({@area Z5|06e})。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The Zhents have stashed two wooden crates here. The first, stolen from the docks, contains four wood-framed paintings wrapped in leather. The paintings depict the cities of Luskan, Neverwinter, Silverymoon, and Baldur's Gate and are worth 75 gp each.
zh_tw: 散塔林會在這裡藏了兩個木製板條箱。第一個是從碼頭偷來的，裡面裝有四幅用皮革包裹的木框畫。這些畫描繪了路斯坎、無冬城、銀月城和博德之門的城市，每幅價值75金幣。

english: The second crate, stolen from a caravan on the High Road, contains fifteen 10-pound silver trade bars, all black from corrosion but still worth 50 gp each.
zh_tw: 第二個箱子是從高路上的商隊那裡偷來的，裡面裝有十五根重10磅的銀條，雖然因腐蝕而變黑，但每根仍然價值50金幣。

english: Z4. Balcony
zh_tw: Z4. 陽臺

english: The open second level is stacked with crates where it overlooks the main warehouse. Characters who search through the crates find all sorts of junk, including moth-eaten bolts of cloth, bottles of spoiled olive oil, and hundreds of pairs of wooden-soled sandals that were all the rage last summer but are now out of fashion. None of this junk is valuable.
zh_tw: 開闊的二樓堆滿了板條箱，俯瞰著主倉庫。搜查箱子的角色會發現各種垃圾，包括被蟲蛀的布匹、變質的橄欖油瓶，以及數百雙木底涼鞋——這些去年夏天風靡一時，如今卻已過時。這些垃圾都沒有價值。

english: Z5. Offices
zh_tw: Z5. 辦公室

english: The upper floor contains a suite of offices that get little use by the Zhents. The rooms have desks, chairs, and bare shelves covered with dust and draped in cobwebs. Harmless rats skitter about.
zh_tw: 上層包含一套散塔林會成員很少使用的辦公室。房間裡有桌子、椅子和佈滿灰塵、掛滿蛛網的空架子。無害的老鼠在四處奔跑。

english: Mounted above each office door is a steel alarm bell. The bells are connected by wires to the secret door in {@area Z3|06b}, and they ring loudly when that door is opened.
zh_tw: 每個辦公室門上方都安裝著一個鋼製報警鈴。這些鈴鐺透過電線與在{@area Z3|06b}的秘密門相連，當那扇門被開啟時，它們會大聲響起。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: A character who searches the offices finds an unused {@item paper bird|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix A|WDH|11}).
zh_tw: 一個搜尋辦公室的角色發現了一個未使用的 {@item paper bird|WDH|紙鳶}（見 {@adventure 附錄A|WDH|11}）。

english: The Watch Arrives
zh_tw: 守衛到來

english: Shortly after the characters find Renaer, a captain of the City Watch named Hyustus Staget (LG male Illuskan human {@creature veteran}) leads a dozen {@creature veteran||veterans} to the warehouse. Having received a report of suspicious activity, they barge in and try to prevent anyone from leaving. Kenku that are still alive and present are taken into custody, and it doesn't take long for the City Watch to conclude that the dead men are members of the Zhentarim and the Xanathar Guild, since violent encounters between the two factions are becoming ever more frequent. While his constables search the warehouse, Captain Staget questions the characters.
zh_tw: 角色們找到瑞納爾不久後，一位名叫海斯特斯·斯塔吉特（休斯圖斯·斯塔吉特，守序善良男性伊路斯坎人人類{@creature veteran||老兵}）的城市守衛長帶領一打{@creature veteran||老兵}來到倉庫。接到可疑活動的報告後，他們衝進來並試圖阻止任何人離開。仍然活著並且在現場的天狗被拘留，城市守衛很快得出結論，死者是散塔林會和姍娜薩公會的成員，因為兩個派系之間暴力衝突正變得越來越頻繁。在他的警官搜查倉庫的同時，斯塔吉特隊長詢問角色們。

english: Captain Staget is an uptight man who helps keep the peace in the Dock Ward. Every shopkeeper, guild member, innkeeper, and tavern keeper in the Dock Ward knows him, and most respect him regardless of their opinions of the City Watch in general. Staget doesn't believe in rumors or gossip, he doesn't drink, and he doesn't let anger get the better of him. His job is to curb the violence in the Dock Ward, but he has been dragging his heels. After all, he reasons, if the Xanathar Guild and the Zhentarim want to destroy each other, why not let them?
zh_tw: 斯塔吉特隊長是一個拘謹的人，他幫助維護碼頭區的和平。碼頭區的每個店主、公會成員、旅店老闆和酒館老闆都認識他，儘管他們對城市守衛的總體看法各不相同，但大多數人都尊重他。斯塔吉特不相信謠言或八卦，他不喝酒，也不讓憤怒控制自己。他的工作是遏制碼頭區的暴力行為，但他一直在拖延。畢竟，他推理說，如果姍娜薩公會和散塔林會想要互相摧毀，為什麼不讓他們這樣做呢？

english: Staget once had the warehouse under surveillance, but elected to pull the detail to bolster patrols throughout the Dock Ward-a decision he now regrets. That surveillance was part of an attempt to catch a known Zhent instigator named {@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh}, a "big fish" rumored to be responsible for much of the recent strife. Staget doesn't share this information with strangers.
zh_tw: 斯塔吉特曾經監視過這個倉庫，但後來決定撤回細節以加強碼頭區全區的巡邏——一個他現在後悔的決定。那次監視是試圖捕獲一個已知的散塔林會成員煽動者，名叫{@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh|厄斯圖爾·弗洛克辛}的"大魚"，據傳他要對最近許多衝突負責。斯塔吉特不會與陌生人分享這些資訊。

english: Staget and Renaer recognize each other, though they aren't well acquainted. The involvement of a Neverember noble prompts the captain to be on his best behavior. He is prepared to overlook any crimes committed by the characters as long as Renaer is with them, but he gives them a folded sheet of parchment with the Code Legal written on it and encourages them to read it. (Give the players a copy of the Code Legal handout in appendix C, if you haven't done so already.)
zh_tw: 斯塔吉特和瑞納爾彼此認識，儘管他們並不熟絡。一位無燼貴族的牽涉促使隊長表現得最為得體。只要瑞納爾和角色們在一起，他就準備忽視角色們所犯的任何罪行，但他給了他們一張折起來的羊皮紙，上面寫著《法律法典》，並鼓勵他們閱讀。（如果還沒有這樣做，請給玩家們附錄C中的《法律法典》傳單的副本。）

english: If the characters ask for the Watch's help in locating Floon, Staget makes it clear that he won't send a force into the sewers in search of someone who might well be a Zhent or Xanathar Guild spy. If they appear intent on involving themselves further in the conflict between the Zhentarim and the Xanathar Guild, Staget imparts some free advice before letting them go:
zh_tw: 如果角色們請求守衛幫助尋找福盧恩，斯塔吉特明確表示他不會派遣一支隊伍進入下水道尋找一個很可能是散塔林會成員或姍娜薩公會間諜的人。如果他們似乎決心進一步捲入散塔林會和姍娜薩公會之間的衝突，斯塔吉特在讓他們離開之前會提供一些免費的建議：

english: "Best not to meddle in criminal matters. Leave this dirty business to the City Watch."
zh_tw: "最好不要插手犯罪事務。把這種骯髒的生意留給城市守衛。"

english: "Not all City Watch officers are as nice as me."
zh_tw: "並非所有的城市守衛官員都像我這樣好說話。"

english: "Keep the blood off the streets, okay?" (This is a common saying among City Watch officials, who care more about what happens in the city above than what happens in the sewers below.)
zh_tw: "別讓血跡弄髒街道，好嗎？"（這是城市守衛官員中常見的說法，他們更關心城市上方發生的事情，而不是下水道下面發生的事情。）

english: Characters who stir up trouble in the Dock Ward are likely to run into Captain Staget again. Though he is secretly pleased to have adventurers doing some of his work for him, he can't let them overshadow his own efforts to keep the peace without risking a reprimand from his superiors.
zh_tw: 在碼頭區惹麻煩的角色很可能會再次遇到斯塔吉特隊長。儘管他暗自高興有冒險者為他分擔一些工作，但他不能讓他們蓋過自己維護和平的努力，否則就有從上級那裡受到斥責的風險。

english: Tracking Floon
zh_tw: 追蹤福盧恩

english: At this point, the characters likely know that Floon was kidnapped by Xanathar Guild members who mistook him for {@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh}, and that he was taken to a hideout in the sewers. If the characters didn't learn from the kenku where Floon was taken, asking questions of the locals can reveal that many people saw him being dragged off. A successful {@dc 15} Intelligence (Investigation) check or 5 gp in bribes allows the characters to trace the kidnappers' path through back alleys to a circular metal cover inset in the pavement. The cover is easily lifted, revealing a ladder down into the sewers.
zh_tw: 此時，角色們很可能已經知道福盧恩被誤認為是 {@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh|瑞納爾·無燼} 而被姍娜薩公會成員綁架，並被帶到了下水道的一個藏身處。如果角色們沒有從肯庫那裡得知福盧恩被帶往何處，向當地人詢問可能會發現許多人看到他被拖走。一次成功的 {@dc 15} 智力（調查）檢定或 5 金幣的賄賂可以讓角色們追蹤綁架者的路徑，透過後巷來到一個嵌入路面的圓形金屬蓋。蓋子很容易被抬起，露出一段通往下水道的梯子。

english: Navigating the Sewers
zh_tw: 導航下水道

english: The sewers have no natural light. Characters without darkvision need light sources to see.
zh_tw: 下水道沒有自然光。沒有黑暗視覺的角色需要光源才能看見。

english: A putrid stream flows along this sewer tunnel, which leads in two directions. In one direction, you see a tiny symbol drawn on the wall in yellow chalk: a palm-sized circle with ten equidistant spokes radiating out from its circumference.
zh_tw: 一股惡臭的水流沿著這條下水道隧道流動，它通向兩個方向。在一個方向上，你看到牆上用黃色粉筆畫著一個小小的符號：一個手掌大小的圓，圓週上有十個等距的輻條向外輻射。

english: The hideout of the Xanathar Guild operatives who snatched up Floon is deep in the city's labyrinthine sewers. At every location where characters must make a decision about which direction to go, a symbol scrawled in yellow chalk-a stylized representation of {@creature Xanathar|WDH}-is marked next to the tunnel that leads in the right direction. The symbols are erased by members of the Xanathar Guild or the Dungsweepers' Guild every few days, but these markings have yet to be removed.
zh_tw: 綁架福盧恩的姍娜薩公會行動人員的藏身之處位於城市錯綜複雜的下水道深處。在角色們必須做出選擇走哪個方向的每個地點，用黃色粉筆潦草地畫著一個符號——一個{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的風格化表示——標記在正確的方向旁邊的隧道上。這些符號每幾天就會被姍娜薩公會或清潔工公會的成員擦除，但這些標記還沒有被移除。

english: Gazer Guard
zh_tw: 凝視者眼魔守衛

english: Before arriving at the Xanathar Guild hideout, the characters have an encounter in the sewers:
zh_tw: 在到達姍娜薩公會的藏身之處之前，角色們在下水道中遇到了：

english: After an hour of following signs through the tunnels, you come to a three-way intersection where a ladder leads up into a stone shaft capped by a circular metal cover. One of the familiar chalk symbols is marked on a wall nearby, and floating near the symbol is a spherical, grapefruit-sized creature with a bulging central eye and four stumpy eyestalks. It bares its teeth at you.
zh_tw: 在隧道中跟隨標誌一個小時後，你來到了一個三岔路口，那裡有一個梯子通向一個頂部被圓形金屬蓋子封閉的石質通道。附近牆上標有一個熟悉的粉筆符號，符號附近浮動著一個球形的、葡萄柚大小的生物，它有一個凸起的中央眼睛和四條短粗的眼柄。它向你露出了牙齒。

english: A hostile {@creature gazer|VGM} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) that is in league with {@creature Grum'shar|wdh}, the local Xanathar Guild boss, guards this intersection. Once the characters defeat it, they can press on, following the corridor where the chalk symbol is located; they reach the hideout after following the correct tunnel for 5 minutes.
zh_tw: 一隻敵對的 {@creature gazer|VGM|凝視者眼魔}（見 {@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），與當地姍娜薩公會的老闆 {@creature Grum'shar|wdh|格魯姆沙} 有勾結，守衛著這個交叉路口。一旦角色們擊敗它，他們可以繼續前進，沿著標記有粉筆符號的走廊走；在沿著正確的隧道走 5 分鐘後，他們到達了藏身之處。

english: Ladder
zh_tw: 梯子

english: Characters who climb the ladder and push open the metal cover find themselves in the cellar of the Spouting Fish, a tavern in the Dock Ward.
zh_tw: 角色們爬上梯子並推開金屬蓋子，發現自己位於碼頭區的酒館——噴魚的地窖中。

english: Xanathar Guild Hideout
zh_tw: 姍娜薩公會藏身地

english: The Xanathar Guild has hideouts throughout Waterdeep's sewers. The floor plan of this locale (see map 1.2) can be reused for other hideouts.
zh_tw: 姍娜薩公會在深水城的下水道中設有多個藏身之處。這個地方的平面圖（見地圖1.2）可以用於其他藏身之處。

english: Xanathar Guild Hideout
zh_tw: 姍娜薩公會藏身地

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: The boss of this hideout is a half-orc named {@creature Grum'shar|wdh}. When the characters arrive, {@creature Grum'shar|WDH} is interrogating {@creature Floon Blagmaar|WDH} in {@area Q7|081}. His display of torture techniques is a ploy to impress his other guest: a mind flayer named {@creature Nihiloor|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}).
zh_tw: 這個藏身之處的頭目是一個名叫{@creature Grum'shar|wdh|格魯姆沙}的半獸人。當角色們到達時，{@creature Grum'shar|WDH|格魯姆沙}正在{@area Q7|081}審問{@creature Floon Blagmaar|WDH|福盧恩·布拉格瑪}。他展示折磨技巧的目的是為了給他的另一位客人留下深刻印象：一個名叫{@creature Nihiloor|WDH|尼希盧爾}的奪心魔（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）。

english: All the doors in the hideout are unlocked. {@creature Grum'shar|WDH} assumes that only those who have guild business will be able to find their way here.
zh_tw: 藏身之處的所有門都是未上鎖的。{@creature Grum'shar|WDH|格魯姆沙} 假設只有那些有公會事務的人才能找得到這裡。

english: Q1. Central Hub
zh_tw: Q1. 中央樞紐

english: The characters approach this area from the east, slogging through 1-foot-deep water and sewage.
zh_tw: 角色們從東邊接近這個區域，艱難地穿過深達1尺的水和汙水。

english: The main sewer tunnel expands into a circular hub with a pair of arrow slits carved into its outer walls, directly across from each other. Two passages continue on to the north and south. A stone door is set into the back wall of a stone ledge to the west.
zh_tw: 主要的下水道隧道擴充套件成一個圓形的樞紐，在其外牆上刻有一對箭縫，它們直接相對。向北和向南各有兩條通道繼續延伸。一扇石門嵌在西側的石架的後牆上。

english: If the characters talk loudly or otherwise make a lot of noise here, the goblin sentries in areas Q2a and Q2b awaken and shoot arrows at them through the arrow slits. The slits provide the goblins with {@quickref Cover||3||three-quarters cover}.
zh_tw: 如果角色在這裡大聲說話或以其他方式發出很大聲響，區域 Q2a 和 Q2b 的地精哨兵會醒來，並透過箭縫向他們射擊。箭縫為地精提供了{@quickref Cover||3||掩護}。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: A secret door in the wall of the tunnel that leads south can be found with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check.
zh_tw: 在隧道南牆的一扇暗門可以透過成功的 {@dc 15} 感知（感知）檢定被發現。

english: Q2. Watch Posts
zh_tw: Q2. 觀察哨

english: Two {@creature goblin||goblins} are stationed here, one in Q2a and one in Q2b. Allies of the Xanathar Guild, they came here from Undermountain. The goblins rely on darkvision to see and are supposed to be watching {@area Q1|078}, but both have dozed off. Characters who succeed on a {@dc 9} Dexterity (Stealth) check can sneak past the sleeping goblins without waking them.
zh_tw: 這裡有兩隻 {@creature goblin||地精}，分別位於 Q2a 和 Q2b。它們是姍娜薩公會的盟友，從地脈迷城來到這裡。地精依賴黑暗視覺觀察周圍，並本應監視 {@area Q1|078}，但它倆都睡著了。成功透過一次 {@dc 9} 敏捷（隱匿）檢定的角色可以從這些睡著的地精身邊悄悄溜過而不驚動它們。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Each goblin carries {@dice 1d6} cp in a small pouch.
zh_tw: 每個地精在一個小袋子裡攜帶{@dice 1d6}銅幣。

english: Q3. Messy Room
zh_tw: Q3. 凌亂的房間

english: Rusty weapons and threadbare clothing litter the floor of this area, which serves as a coat room and armory. It contains nothing of value.
zh_tw: 這個區域的地板上散落著生鏽的武器和破舊的衣物，這裡充當著衣帽間和軍械庫的角色。這裡沒有任何有價值的東西。

english: Q4. Empty Sleeping Area
zh_tw: Q4. 空置的睡眠區

english: This room contains six tattered, straw-stuffed mattresses and nothing of value. If the occupant or occupants of {@area Q5|07f} have not been dealt with already, the characters hear the sounds of activity in that room through the thin wooden door that separates these two chambers.
zh_tw: 這個房間有六張破爛的、填充著稻草的床墊，沒有價值。如果 {@area Q5|07f} 的居住者還沒有被處理，角色們可以透過這兩個房間之間的薄木門聽到那個房間裡的活動聲。

english: Q5. Sleeping Area
zh_tw: Q5. 睡眠區

english: This room contains six tattered, straw-stuffed mattresses and a hostile member of the Xanathar Guild, a {@creature duergar} named Zemk. If Krentz (CE human {@creature bandit}) escaped from the Yawning Portal after the tavern brawl that kicked off the adventure, he's here as well.
zh_tw: 這個房間有六張破爛的、填充著稻草的床墊，還有一位姍娜薩公會的敵對成員，一個名為澤姆克的 {@creature duergar||灰矮人}。如果克倫茲（CE 人類 {@creature bandit||匪徒}）在冒險開始的酒館鬥毆後從呵欠之門逃脫了，他也在這裡。

english: When the characters arrive, Zemk is using pieces of furniture to barricade the door to {@area Q6|080}. If Krentz is here, he's trying to explain that Zemk's approach won't work, and is telling him to plug the gap at the bottom of the door with blankets. Neither of them notices intruders right away unless the interlopers make a lot of noise.
zh_tw: 當角色們到達時，澤姆克正在用傢俱堵住通往{@area Q6|080}的門。如果克倫茲在這裡，他正試圖解釋澤姆克的方法行不通，並告訴他用毯子堵住門底部的縫隙。除非闖入者製造很多噪音，否則他們都不會立即注意到入侵者。

english: Once combat starts, Zemk fights to the death. How Krentz reacts to the adventurers depends on how they treated him earlier. If they helped him, he gives them a chance to leave in peace, but he fights alongside Zemk if they refuse to withdraw. If the duergar is killed, Krentz flees if he can or surrenders if he must.
zh_tw: 一旦戰鬥開始，澤姆克會戰鬥到死。克倫茲對冒險者的反應取決於他們之前如何對待他。如果他們幫助過他，他會給他們一個和平離開的機會，但如果他們拒絕撤退，他會和澤姆克並肩作戰。如果灰矮人被殺，克倫茲會儘可能逃跑，或者在必要時投降。

english: Neither Zemk nor Krentz carries any treasure. Both report to {@creature Grum'shar|wdh} (see {@area Q7|081}).
zh_tw: 澤姆克和克倫茲都沒有攜帶任何財寶。他們兩個都向 {@creature Grum'shar|wdh|格魯姆沙}（見 {@area Q7|081}）彙報。

english: Q6. Lavatory
zh_tw: Q6. 廁所

english: This room has a hole in the floor that opens into a cesspit. A {@creature gray ooze} has emerged from the pit and killed two goblins that were sent into the room to dispose of it. The goblins' bones float amid the ooze's gooey form, and their pitted weapons lie on the floor nearby. None of the gear is salvageable.
zh_tw: 這個房間的地板上有一個洞，通向一個糞坑。一個{@creature gray ooze||灰泥怪}從坑中出現並殺死了兩個被派進房間處理它的地精。地精的骨頭在軟泥怪的黏稠形態中漂浮，他們坑坑窪窪的武器散落在附近的地板上。所有的裝備都無法回收利用。

english: Q7. Boss Fight
zh_tw: Q7. 老大戰鬥

english: Threadbare curtains hang on the east wall of a long hall, in the middle of which a muscular half-orc in dingy robes stands with his foot on the chest of a male human with wavy red-blond hair. Fire burns around the orc's clenched fist, and his victim cries and squirms helplessly beneath him.
zh_tw: 破舊的窗簾掛在長廊東牆上，一個肌肉發達的半獸人穿著髒兮兮的長袍，一隻腳站在一個有著波浪狀紅金色頭髮的男性人類胸膛上。火焰在獸人的緊握的拳頭周圍燃燒，他的受害者在他身下無助地哭泣和扭動。

english: Seated on a raised platform to the south is a nightmarish figure wearing black robes. It has large white eyes and rubbery purple skin, with four tentacles encircling its inhuman mouth. It cradles and gently caresses what looks like a disembodied brain with feet.
zh_tw: 坐在南方的高臺上的是一個噩夢般的人物，穿著黑色長袍。它有著巨大的白色眼睛和橡膠般的紫色皮膚，四隻觸手環繞著它非人類的嘴巴。它懷抱著並輕輕撫摸著看起來像是一個有腳的離體大腦。

english: The tentacled creature is {@creature Nihiloor|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), a {@creature mind flayer} that is caressing an {@creature intellect devourer}. Upon seeing the adventurers, {@creature Nihiloor|WDH} rises from the stone chair, sets its pet down, and glides across the room, intending to leave through the double door in the west wall. The mind flayer expects {@creature Grum'shar|wdh} and the intellect devourer to cover its escape.
zh_tw: 這個有觸手的生物是{@creature Nihiloor|WDH|尼希盧爾}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），一個正在撫摸一個{@creature intellect devourer||噬腦怪}的{@creature mind flayer||奪心魔}。當看到冒險者時，{@creature Nihiloor|WDH|尼希盧爾}從石椅上站起來，放下它的寵物，並滑行穿過房間，打算透過西牆上的雙扇門離開。這個奪心魔期望{@creature Grum'shar|wdh|格魯姆沙}和智力吞噬者掩護其逃跑。

english: {@creature Nihiloor|WDH} carries a 3-inch-diameter stone orb carved to resemble an eyeball, similar to what one might see at the end of a beholder's eyestalk. This stone eye is the key to activating the magic portal in {@area Q11|089}. The mind flayer uses it to return to {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s lair (described in chapter 5). It uses {@spell dominate monster} to control someone who gets in its way and turns any such individuals against their allies.
zh_tw: {@creature Nihiloor|WDH|尼希盧爾} 攜帶著一個直徑3吋的石頭球體，雕刻成類似眼魔眼柄末端可能看到的眼球形狀。這個石頭眼睛是啟用 {@area Q11|089} 中魔法傳送門的關鍵。奪心魔使用它返回到 {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩} 的巢穴（在第5章中描述）。它使用 {@spell dominate monster||支配怪物} 來控制擋路的人，並將這些人轉為對抗他們的盟友。

english: The half-orc is {@creature Grum'shar|WDH}, a low-end Xanathar Guild boss. As soon as his minions retrieved who they thought was {@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh}, the half-orc begged {@creature Nihiloor|WDH} let him witness the interrogation of the captive, not realizing until after he did so that he had mistaken the prisoner's identity. {@creature Grum'shar|WDH} attacks the characters in the hope of salvaging his reputation. He is an {@creature apprentice wizard|VGM} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), with these changes:
zh_tw: 這個半獸人是{@creature Grum'shar|WDH|格魯姆沙}，姍娜薩公會的一個低階老闆。當他的手下把他們認為是{@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh|瑞納爾·無燼}的人帶回來時，這個半獸人請求{@creature Nihiloor|WDH|尼希盧爾}讓他見證對俘虜的審訊，直到事後他才意識到他認錯了囚犯的身份。{@creature Grum'shar|WDH|格魯姆沙}為了挽回自己的名聲而攻擊角色們。他是一個{@creature apprentice wizard|VGM|學徒法師}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），有以下變化：

english: {@creature Grum'shar|WDH} is chaotic evil.
zh_tw: {@creature Grum'shar|WDH|格魯姆沙} 是混亂邪惡。

english: He has these racial traits: When reduced to 0 hit points, he drops to 1 hit point instead (but can't do this again until he finishes a long rest). He has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. He speaks Common and Orc.
zh_tw: 他擁有以下種族特性：當生命值降至0點時，他的生命值反而降至1點（但在完成一次長休之前不能再這樣做）。他具有60尺範圍內的黑暗視覺。他說通用語和獸人語。

english: Roleplaying Floon
zh_tw: 扮演福盧恩

english: As a result of {@creature Grum'shar|wdh}'s torture, {@creature Floon Blagmaar|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) has 1 hit point left. If he is healed by the characters, he is eternally grateful and shows his affection by hugging them. He stays close to them, trusting in their ability to protect him. If Renaer is with the party, he can shoulder the burden of protecting Floon.
zh_tw: 由於{@creature Grum'shar|wdh|格魯姆沙}的折磨，{@creature Floon Blagmaar|WDH|福盧恩·布拉格瑪}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）只剩下1點生命值。如果他被角色們治癒，他會永遠感激，並以擁抱他們的方式來表達他的感激之情。他緊貼在他們身邊，相信他們有能力保護他。如果瑞納爾與隊伍在一起，他可以承擔起保護福盧恩的責任。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: In a satchel, {@creature Grum'shar|wdh} carries his spellbook, which contains the following spells: {@spell burning hands}, {@spell disguise self}, {@spell false life}, {@spell shield}, {@spell unseen servant}, and {@spell witch bolt}.
zh_tw: 在一個小包裡，{@creature Grum'shar|wdh|格魯姆沙}攜帶著他的咒語書，其中包含以下咒語：{@spell burning hands||燃燒之手}、{@spell disguise self||易容術}、{@spell false life||虛假生命}、{@spell shield||護盾術}、{@spell unseen servant||隱形僕役}和{@spell witch bolt||巫術箭}。

english: Tucked behind the stone chair is a small, unlocked wooden chest containing two {@item potion of healing||potions of healing}, 16 gp, 82 sp, and 250 cp.
zh_tw: 在石椅後面藏著一個小巧的未上鎖木箱，內含兩瓶{@item potion of healing||治療藥水}，16金幣，82銀幣，以及250銅幣。

english: Q8. Getaway Passage
zh_tw: Q8. 逃跑通道

english: This room looks empty, but a thorough search accompanied by a successful {@dc 10} Wisdom (Perception) check reveals a rough-hewn tunnel hidden beneath a loose flagstone. The low tunnel leads north to {@area Q9|086}.
zh_tw: 這個房間看起來是空的，但經過徹底的搜查，並結合一次成功的 {@dc 10} 感知（感知）檢定，可以發現一塊鬆動的石板下隱藏著一個粗鑿的隧道。這個低矮的隧道向北通向了 {@area Q9|086}。

english: Q9. Private Cellar
zh_tw: Q9. 私人酒窖

english: An innocent halfling family, the Peabodys, brews beer in this cellar, which lies beneath their home on Fishgut Alley in the Dock Ward. Their cellar contains brewing supplies and lots of worthless clutter.
zh_tw: 一個無辜的半身人家庭，皮博迪一家，在碼頭區的魚腸巷他們家的下面這個酒窖裡釀造啤酒。他們的酒窖裡有釀造用品和許多無價值的雜物。

english: The halflings haven't noticed the secret tunnel that leads to the Xanathar Guild hideout; it's concealed beneath a large flagstone that requires a Strength score of 10 or higher to be lifted.
zh_tw: 半身人們還沒有注意到通往姍娜薩公會藏身之處的秘密隧道；它隱藏在一塊需要10點或更高力量值才能舉起的大石板下。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: If the characters ascend out of the cellar and enter the Peabodys' small house, the halflings are initially alarmed but can be easily calmed. Upon learning of the secret trapdoor, they vow to seal it up again but allow the characters to make use of it if the need arises.
zh_tw: 如果角色們從酒窖出來並進入皮博迪家的小房子，這些半身人一開始會感到驚慌，但可以很容易地平靜下來。得知秘密活板門的事情後，他們發誓要再次封住它，但如果有必要，他們允許角色們使用它。

english: Q10. Sleeping Quarters
zh_tw: Q10. 睡眠區

english: Straw pallets lie on the floor, and rusty manacles are bolted to the walls.
zh_tw: 地板上鋪著稻草墊，牆上固定著生鏽的鐐銬。

english: Q11. Back Door
zh_tw: Q11. 後門

english: This hideout contains a secret route to {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s lair.
zh_tw: 這個藏身之處包含一條通往{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的巢穴的秘密路線。

english: In the middle of this otherwise empty room is a stone pillar carved with a small symbol: a perfect circle with ten equidistant spokes radiating outward from its circumference. In the middle of this circle is a smaller circular indentation that bears a passing resemblance to a lidless eye.
zh_tw: 在這個本應空無一物的房間中央，有一根石柱，上面雕刻著一個小符號：一個完美的圓圈，有十個等距的輻條從其周長向外輻射。在這個圓圈的中間是一個較小的圓形凹陷，它與無蓋眼睛有幾分相似。

english: If the stone eye in {@creature Nihiloor|WDH}'s possession is pressed into the circular indentation, an opaque black doorway magically opens in the south wall. The opening is 8 feet tall and 4 feet wide. Any creature that passes through it appears in {@area X22|2a5} of {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s lair (see chapter 5). The door is a one-way portal, and it closes again 1 minute after the stone eye is removed from the pillar.
zh_tw: 如果將{@creature Nihiloor|WDH|尼希盧爾}擁有的石眼按入圓形凹槽，南牆上就會神奇地開啟一扇不透明的黑色門。這個開口高8尺，寬4尺。任何透過它的生物都會出現{@area X22|2a5}在{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的巢穴中（見第5章）。這扇門是單向傳送門，石眼從柱子上移開1分鐘後門會再次關閉。

english: Not-So-Secret Door
zh_tw: 不是那麼秘密的門

english: The secret door is plainly visible to anyone who approaches it from the east.
zh_tw: 這扇秘密門對於從東邊接近的任何人都是清晰可見的。

english: Q12. Hostel Cellar
zh_tw: Q12. 旅店地窖

english: A narrow passage leads to the cellar of a halfling-owned hostel on Spices Street in the Dock Ward. Medium characters must squeeze to reach this area from the tunnel. The hostel is used as a base by the Shard Shunners, a gang of halfling wererats. They are aware of the Xanathar Guild hideout, and the two gangs are tenuous allies.
zh_tw: 一條狹窄的通道通向位於碼頭區香料街上一個半身人擁有的旅店的地窖。中等體型的角色必須擠過去才能從隧道到達這個區域。這家旅店被"避碎幫"（避碎幫）用作基地，這是一群半身人狼人組成的幫派。他們知道姍娜薩公會的藏身之處，這兩個幫派是不穩定的盟友。

english: Roscoe Underbough, a {@creature Shard Shunner|WDH} in hybrid form, guards the cellar. He hides in the northwest storeroom, ready to jump out and scare away anyone who heads for the stairs. Not eager to commit murder, Roscoe allows retreating characters to flee back to the sewers. He is a {@creature wererat}, with these changes:
zh_tw: 羅斯科·枝下，一個處於混合形態的{@creature Shard Shunner|WDH|避碎幫}，守衛著地窖。他藏在西北儲藏室裡，隨時準備跳出來嚇跑任何朝樓梯走去的人。羅斯科並不想犯下謀殺，他允許撤退的角色逃回下水道。他是一隻{@creature wererat||鼠人}，有以下變化：

english: Roscoe is Small and has 27 ({@dice 6d6 + 6}) hit points.
zh_tw: 羅斯科體型小，有 27 ({@dice 6d6 + 6}) 點生命值。

english: He has these racial traits: He can move through the space of a Medium or larger creature. He has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition frightened}. He speaks Common and Halfling, and he knows thieves' cant.
zh_tw: 他具有以下種族特徵：他可以透過一箇中等大小或更大的生物的空間移動。他在對抗{@condition frightened||恐懼}的豁免檢定中具有優勢。他會說通用語和半身人語，並且他知道盜賊的暗號。

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: If the characters defeat Roscoe or slip past him, they can make their way up into the hostel, which caters to a mostly halfling clientele. With none of the other Shard Shunners currently present, the characters are greeted warmly by staff and patrons, who point them in the direction of the nearest bathhouse.
zh_tw: 如果角色們擊敗了羅斯科或者悄悄地溜過他，他們可以進入旅店，這家旅店主要服務於半身人客戶。由於目前沒有其他避碎幫在場，角色們會受到員工和顧客的熱情歡迎，他們會指引角色們前往最近的澡堂。

english: Completing Volo's Quest
zh_tw: 完成瓦羅的請求

english: Returning to the Yawning Portal with {@creature Floon Blagmaar|WDH} in tow marks the end of this introductory quest. All that remains is for the characters to collect their reward.
zh_tw: 帶著{@creature Floon Blagmaar|WDH|福盧恩·布拉格瑪}返回呵欠之門標誌著這個入門任務的結束。剩下的就是讓角色們領取他們的獎勵。

english: Rewards
zh_tw: 獎勵

english: Volo is drinking alone in the Yawning Portal while anxiously awaiting news of Floon's fate. He springs up and runs to embrace the characters and his friend as soon as he sees them.
zh_tw: 瓦羅獨自在呵欠之門裡喝酒，焦急地等待福盧恩命運的訊息。他一看到角色們和他的朋友，就立刻跳起來跑過去擁抱他們。

english: A Good Deed
zh_tw: 一件好事

english: If the characters reunite Volo with Floon, Volo gives them a rather sheepish look as he explains their reward:
zh_tw: 如果角色們讓瓦羅與福盧恩團聚，瓦羅給了他們一個相當尷尬的表情，同時他解釋他們的獎勵：

english: "I confess that I have but few coins to spare. But never let it be said that Volo reneges on a promise. Allow me to present something much more valuable." He holds out a scroll tube. "The deed to a remarkable property here in Waterdeep! We'll need a magistrate to witness the transfer of ownership. I'll arrange a meeting with one after you've inspected the estate and deemed it satisfactory."
zh_tw: "我承認，我手頭的硬幣不多。但永遠不要說瓦羅違背了諾言。請允許我提供一些更有價值的東西。" 他遞出一個卷軸筒。"這是一份在深水城的非凡地產的契約！我們需要一位法官來見證所有權的轉移。在你檢查了房產並認為滿意之後，我會安排與法官的會面。"

english: The tube contains a deed to Trollskull Manor, a historic building in the North Ward that the characters can claim as a home base. The deed has been notarized and appears legitimate (because it is). Volo recently bought the property because it is rumored to be haunted, and he was hoping that investigating it might yield a chapter for his next book, {@i Volo's Guide to Spirits and Specters}.
zh_tw: 這根管子裡裝著一份地契，是北區一棟歷史建築——巨魔顱骨莊園的所有權證書，角色們可以將其作為據點。這份地契經過了公證，看起來合法有效（因為它確實如此）。瓦羅最近買下了這處房產，因為據說這裡鬧鬼，他希望調查此事能為他的下一本書《{@i 瓦羅的鬼魂與幽靈指南}》提供一個章節的素材。

english: If the characters accept their reward, Volo sets up a meeting with a tiefling magistrate named Kylynne Silmerhelve. The brief session takes place at a courthouse in the Castle Ward at highsun. Magistrate Silmerhelve witnesses the transfer of the deed, rendering the new ownership official, with the impatience of one who has more important matters to attend to. She also collects an estate transfer tax of 25 gp, which is normally paid by the new owners. If the characters can't afford this fee or don't want to pay it and they have befriended {@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh}, he makes sure that Volo has a pouch of coins to cover the expense.
zh_tw: 如果角色們接受了他們的獎勵，瓦羅安排了一個名為凱琳希爾默赫爾夫的提夫林法官的會面。簡短的會議在城堡區的一個法院舉行，時間是正午。希爾默赫爾夫法官見證了契約的轉移，使得新的所有權正式生效，她表現出對更重要事務的關注。她還會收取25金幣的房產轉讓稅，這通常由新業主支付。如果角色們負擔不起這筆費用或者不想支付，並且他們已經和{@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh|瑞納爾·無燼}成為朋友，他會確保瓦羅有一個裝滿硬幣的小袋來支付這筆費用。

english: Fine Friends
zh_tw: 好朋友

english: Volo, Floon, and Renaer all express their gratitude through camaraderie. If the characters need to call upon their new friends for an occasional favor, any of them are happy to oblige. Floon has little to offer the characters, but friendship with Volo and Renaer has its perks.
zh_tw: 瓦羅、福盧恩和瑞納爾都透過友情表達了他們的感激之情。如果角色們需要偶爾請他們的新朋友幫忙，他們中的任何一個都樂意效勞。福盧恩對角色們的幫助有限，但與瓦羅和瑞納爾的友誼有其好處。

english: Volo knows the best places to eat and find merriment. He can also give characters a tour of Waterdeep. If the characters accept his offer, share the information in chapter 9, "Volo's Waterdeep Enchiridion," with the players.
zh_tw: 瓦羅知道最好的吃飯和尋找歡樂的地方。他還可以給角色們提供一次深水城之旅。如果角色們接受了他的提議，請與玩家分享第9章《瓦羅的深水城手冊》中的資訊。

english: Although Renaer is estranged from his rich and powerful father, he still has friends in high places, including Harpers who can come to the characters' rescue if they need it. If the characters are looking for an audience with influential persons in Waterdeep, Renaer can set up meetings with {@creature Mirt|WDH}, {@creature Remallia Haventree|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12} for both), or just about any other Waterdavian noble, if he thinks the characters will comport themselves well.
zh_tw: 儘管瑞納爾與他富有且有權勢的父親關係疏遠，但他仍然在高層有朋友，包括可以為角色提供幫助的豎琴手聯盟。如果角色們希望與深水城的有影響力的人物見面，瑞納爾可以安排與{@creature Mirt|WDH|米爾特}、{@creature Remallia Haventree|WDH|蕾米莉亞·港樹}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}中關於兩者的資訊）或幾乎任何其他沃特德維安貴族的會面，只要他認為角色們會表現得體。

english: Level Advancement
zh_tw: 等級提升

english: If you're using milestone level advancement instead of tracking experience points, the characters advance from 1st to 2nd level when they return to Volo after having explored the Xanathar Guild hideout.
zh_tw: 如果您使用里程碑式等級提升而不是跟蹤經驗點，當角色們在探索了姍娜薩公會藏身之處後返回瓦羅那裡時，他們將從1級提升到2級。

english: Chapter 2: Trollskull Alley
zh_tw: 第2章：巨魔顱骨巷

english: Trollskull Alley
zh_tw: 巨魔顱骨巷

english: Trollskull Alley is filled with people who can shape the characters' day-to-day lives in Waterdeep. The characters will likely return to Trollskull Alley many times during the adventure and get to know their neighbors as time passes.
zh_tw: 巨魔顱骨巷充滿了能夠影響角色們在深水城日常生活中的人。在冒險過程中，角色們很可能會多次回到巨魔顱骨巷，並隨著時間的推移逐漸瞭解他們的鄰居。

english: The locations described below are keyed to the map of Trollskull Alley. Buildings not specifically identified on the map are row-houses that serve as private residences for upper-middle class Waterdavians who can afford housekeepers, groundskeepers, and nannies.
zh_tw: 下面描述的地點在巨魔顱骨巷的地圖上有標註。地圖上沒有特別標識的建築是排屋，它們作為私人住宅，供能夠負擔得起管家、園丁和保姆的上層中產階級沃特迪普居民使用。

english: Areas in the Alley
zh_tw: 巷內區域

english: Trollskull Alley
zh_tw: 巨魔顱骨巷

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: T1. Trollskull Manor
zh_tw: T1. 巨魔顱骨莊園

english: See {@adventure appendix C|WDH|13|Trollskull Manor} for a handout showing the floor plan of this building. Give a copy of this handout to your players as their characters begin to explore Trollskull Manor.
zh_tw: 參考《{@adventure 附錄C|WDH|13|Trollskull Manor}》的傳單，展示這座建築的平面圖。當玩家的角色開始探索巨魔顱骨莊園時，將這份傳單的副本交給你的玩家。

english: Four stories tall and boasting balconies, a turret, and five chimneys, the abandoned building is one of the grandest in Trollskull Alley. Characters can refurnish, rebuild, rename, and otherwise personalize their new stronghold to their hearts' content.
zh_tw: 這座廢棄的建築高四層，擁有陽臺、塔樓和五個煙囪，是巨魔顱骨巷中最宏偉的建築之一。角色們可以重新裝修、重建、重新命名，並以其他方式根據他們的喜好個性化他們的新要塞。

english: Tavern Rooms
zh_tw: 客棧房間

english: When the characters first arrive, the tavern's taproom is filled with broken furniture, tarnished silverware, casks of wine that have turned to vinegar, and worthless detritus. The tavern's other rooms are all empty, except for cobwebs, dust, and harmless rats.
zh_tw: 當角色們第一次到達時，客棧的酒吧間裡滿是破損的傢俱、褪色的銀器、已經變成醋的酒桶，以及無價值的雜物。客棧的其他房間都是空的，除了蜘蛛網、灰塵和無害的老鼠。

english: Spirit on Tap
zh_tw: 酒館鬧鬼

english: The former tavern is haunted by the poltergeist ({@creature specter}) of the tavern's previous barkeeper, a half-elf named Lif. Maintaining the tavern was his life's work, and he couldn't abandon the place in death.
zh_tw: 這家前客棧被前酒吧老闆的作祟幽靈（{@creature specter||惡靈}）所困擾，這位酒吧老闆是一個名叫利夫的半精靈。維護這家客棧是他一生的工作，即使死後他也無法放棄這個地方。

english: The poltergeist understands Common and Elvish, but it can't speak. It invisibly causes mischief at the expense of the new owners by smashing plates, breaking beer barrels, and so forth. If the characters don't take the hint, it writes not-so-subtle warnings (such as "Closing time!" and "Last call!") on dusty floors and grimy windows. To truly claim the tavern as their own, the characters must either appease the poltergeist or destroy it.
zh_tw: 這個作祟幽靈能理解通用語和精靈語，但它不能說話。它無形中以新主人為代價製造麻煩，比如打碎盤子、破壞啤酒桶等。如果角色們沒有領會到暗示，它會在佈滿灰塵的地板和油膩的窗戶上寫下不太微妙的警告（比如"打烊時間！"和"最後一杯！"）。為了真正將客棧據為己有，角色們必須要麼安撫這個作祟幽靈，要麼摧毀它。

english: Appeasing Lif
zh_tw: 安撫利夫

english: If the characters work to repair and renovate the tavern with the goal of opening it to the public again, the poltergeist begins to accept them as the new owners and gradually becomes quite accommodating: pulling out a chair when a character wants to sit down, pouring a beer and delivering it to a character, taking coats when folks come in from the rain, and so forth. Once the business is up and running, Lif can also perform other helpful functions, such as locking doors, sweeping floors, and so forth.
zh_tw: 如果角色們致力於修復和翻新客棧，目標是再次向公眾開放，作祟幽靈開始接受他們作為新的所有者，並逐漸變得非常樂於助人：當角色想要坐下時拉出一把椅子，倒一杯啤酒並遞給角色，當人們從雨中進來時接過外套，等等。一旦生意開始運營，利夫還可以執行其他有用的功能，比如鎖門、掃地等。

english: Destroying Lif
zh_tw: 摧毀利夫

english: Lif's poltergeist is destroyed if its hit points are reduced to 0. If attacked, it flees to the uppermost level of the turret when reduced to half its hit points. From there it fights to the bitter end.
zh_tw: 如果利夫的作祟幽靈的生命值降至0，它就會被摧毀。如果遭到攻擊，當它的生命值降至一半時，它會逃到塔樓的最高層。從那裡它將戰鬥到底。

english: T2. The Bent Nail
zh_tw: T2. 彎釘

english: A small wooden sign above this shop's main door is bare except for a large, bent nail sticking out of it. The front room contains displays of ornate wooden furniture, as well as a selection of bows and crossbows. The wall behind the counter is lined with rows of finely carved wooden canes, {@item quarterstaff|PHB|quarterstaffs}, and {@item shield|PHB|shields}.
zh_tw: 這家商店的正門上方掛著一塊小木牌，除了一根大彎釘伸出來外，別無他物。前廳展示著華麗的木製傢俱，還有一系列弓和弩。櫃檯後面的牆上排列著一排精美的木製手杖、{@item quarterstaff|PHB|長棍}和{@item shield|PHB|盾牌}。

english: {@creature Talisolvanar "Tally" Fellbranch|wdh}, the owner and chief artisan of the Bent Nail, is a male half-elf carpenter and woodcarver. He is a {@creature commoner}, with these changes:
zh_tw: {@creature Talisolvanar "Tally" Fellbranch|wdh|塔利索瓦納 "塔莉" 費爾布蘭奇}，彎釘的主人和首席工匠，是一位男性半精靈木匠和木雕師。他是一個{@creature commoner||平民}，有以下變化：

english: Tally is chaotic good.
zh_tw: 塔利是混亂善良。

english: He has these racial traits: He has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put him to sleep. He has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. He speaks Common and Elvish.
zh_tw: 他具有以下種族特徵：他在對抗{@condition charmed||魅惑}的豁免檢定中有優勢，魔法不能讓他入睡。他具有60尺範圍內的黑暗視覺。他會說通用語和精靈語。

english: Services
zh_tw: 服務

english: Tally sells wooden weapons and shields at normal cost. He also crafts and sells furniture and wood sculptures.
zh_tw: 塔利以正常價格出售木製武器和盾牌。他還製作並出售傢俱和木雕。

english: T3. Steam and Steel
zh_tw: T3. 蒸汽與鋼鐵

english: During daylight hours, smoke and steam billow from the many windows around this indoor forge where metal weapons, armor, and tools are made. The forge is owned and operated by a married couple: a fire genasi named {@creature Embric|wdh} and a water genasi named {@creature Avi|wdh}. Both are members of the Most Careful Order of Skilled Smiths and Metalforgers. As an armorer, {@creature Avi|WDH} also belongs to the Splendid Order of Armorers, Locksmiths, and Finesmiths.
zh_tw: 在白天，這家室內鍛造廠的許多窗戶中冒出煙霧和蒸汽，這裡製造金屬武器、盔甲和工具。鍛造廠由一對夫婦擁有和經營：一個名叫{@creature Embric|wdh|恩布里克}的火元素裔和一個名叫{@creature Avi|wdh|阿維}的水元素裔。他們都是謹慎技能鐵匠和金屬鍛造師最謹慎秩序的成員。作為盔甲製造者，{@creature Avi|WDH|阿維}還屬於華麗盔甲製造者、鎖匠和精細金屬工藝師秩序。

english: {@creature Embric|WDH} tends the forge and is an expert weaponsmith. He claims descent from the efreet of Calimshan and is prone to extreme mood swings. He has the statistics of a {@creature bandit captain}, with these changes:
zh_tw: {@creature Embric|WDH|恩布里克} 負責鍛造工作，是一位專業的武器製造師。他自稱是來自卡利姆沙的伊夫裡特的後裔，並且情緒波動極端。他的具體數值與{@creature bandit captain||匪幫隊長}相同，但有以下變化：

english: {@creature Embric|WDH} is neutral good.
zh_tw: {@creature Embric|WDH|恩布里克} 是中立善良。

english: He has these racial traits: He can cast {@spell produce flame} at will. (Constitution is his spellcasting ability, and he has a {@hit 4} bonus to hit with spell attacks.) He has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet and resistance to fire damage. He speaks Common and Primordial.
zh_tw: 他擁有以下種族特質：他可以隨意施放{@spell produce flame||燃火術}。（體質是他的施法屬性，且他在法術攻擊上擁有{@hit 4}的命中加值。）他擁有60尺範圍的黑暗視覺和火焰傷害抗性。他會說通用語和原初語。

english: {@creature Avi|WDH} worships Eldath, god of peace, and uses his magic to quench hot steel. He is an expert armorsmith. {@creature Avi|WDH} is laid back and speaks plainly. He has the statistics of a {@creature priest}, with these changes:
zh_tw: {@creature Avi|WDH|阿維} 崇拜和平之神埃達絲，並使用他的魔法來淬鍊熾熱的鋼鐵。他是一位專業的盔甲製造師。{@creature Avi|WDH|阿維} 性格隨和，說話直白。他的具體數值與{@creature priest||祭司}相同，但有以下變化：

english: {@creature Avi|WDH} is neutral good.
zh_tw: {@creature Avi|WDH|阿維} 是中立善良。

english: He has these racial traits: At will, he can control the flow and shape of water in a 5-foot cube, or cause the water to freeze for up to 1 hour. He has a swimming speed of 30 feet, and he can breathe air and water. He has resistance to acid damage. He speaks Common and Primordial.
zh_tw: 他具有以下種族特徵：他可以隨意控制5尺立方體內水流的方向和形狀，或者使水凍結長達1小時。他有30尺的游泳速度，並且可以呼吸空氣和水。他對強酸傷害有抗性。他會說通用語和原始語。

english: Services
zh_tw: 服務

english: The genasi couple sells all metal weapons, armor, and shields listed in chapter 5 of the {@book Player's Handbook|phb} at normal cost.
zh_tw: 這對元素裔夫妻以正常價格出售列在{@book 玩家手冊|phb}第5章中的所有金屬武器、護甲和盾牌。

english: T4. Corellon's Crown
zh_tw: T4. 科瑞隆之冠

english: {@creature Fala Lefaliir|wdh}, an herbalist and a member of the Guild of Apothecaries and Physicians, operates out of this stately, three-story town house, the third floor of which has been converted into a greenhouse. Its translucent glass walls allow anyone on the street to see the rainbow of flowers blossoming within.
zh_tw: {@creature Fala Lefaliir|wdh|法拉·勒法利爾}，一位草藥師，藥劑師和醫師公會的成員，在這個莊嚴的三層城市住宅中經營，其三樓已經改造成了一個溫室。其半透明的玻璃牆讓街上的任何人都可以看到裡面盛開的花朵的彩虹。

english: {@creature Fala Lefaliir|WDH} is an outgoing wood elf with long, braided hair. Like the elven god Corellon Larethian, Fala is neither male nor female. If referred to as "he" or "she," Fala gently requests to be addressed by name or as "they." Fala is friends with a member of the Zhentarim named Ziraj, who saved Fala's life. He visits Fala from time to time, and Fala has set aside a room for him on the second floor.
zh_tw: {@creature Fala Lefaliir|WDH|法拉·勒法利爾} 是一位外向的木精靈，有著長長的辮子頭髮。和精靈神科瑞隆·拉瑞斯安一樣，法拉既不是男性也不是女性。如果被稱為"他"或"她"，法拉會溫柔地請求用名字或"他們"來稱呼。法拉與一個名叫茲拉吉的散塔林會成員是朋友，茲拉吉曾經救過法拉的命。他不時地拜訪法拉，法拉在二樓為他預留了一個房間。

english: {@creature Fala Lefaliir|wdh|Fala} is a {@creature druid}, with these changes:
zh_tw: {@creature Fala Lefaliir|wdh|法拉} 是一位{@creature druid||德魯伊}，有以下變化：

english: Fala is chaotic good.
zh_tw: 法拉是混亂善良。

english: Fala has these racial traits: Fala has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put Fala to sleep. Fala has a walking speed of 35 feet and darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. Fala speaks Common, Druidic, and Elvish.
zh_tw: 法拉具有以下種族特徵：法拉在對抗{@condition charmed||魅惑}的豁免檢定中有優勢，魔法不能讓法拉入睡。法拉的步行速度為35尺，並且具有60尺範圍內的黑暗視覺。法拉會說通用語、德魯伊語和精靈語。

english: Services
zh_tw: 服務

english: In addition to nonmagical herbal remedies, Fala sells potions of the types listed in the Fala's Potions table. Fala keeps {@dice 1d6} vials of each potion in locked cabinets behind the shop counter.
zh_tw: 除了非魔法草藥療法，法拉還出售法拉藥水錶中列出的藥水型別。法拉在商店櫃檯後面的鎖櫃裡，每種藥水都存放了{@dice 1d6}瓶。

english: T5. Tiger's Eye
zh_tw: T5. 虎眼石

english: This private detective's business is unremarkable on the outside, its only distinguishing mark an orange-and-black sign featuring a cat's eyes. Inside is a regal apartment dimly lit by flickering oil lamps. The door is locked, and visitors must knock or ring the bell before being let in.
zh_tw: 這傢俬人偵探的辦公室外表毫不起眼，唯一的標誌是一個橙黑色招牌，上面畫著貓的眼睛。裡面是一個由閃爍的油燈昏暗照明的豪華公寓。門是鎖著的，訪客必須敲門或按門鈴才能被允許進入。

english: They are met by {@creature Vincent Trench|WDH}, a human detective and the owner of the Tiger's Eye. He speaks concisely, dresses in a sharp suit, and smokes a slim pipe. Vincent is in fact a {@creature rakshasa} named Valantajar that always casts {@spell disguise self} on itself before seeing visitors. The rakshasa has lived in Waterdeep for years, switching identities as often as needed to keep its true nature hidden. It has grown accustomed to living among mortals and, much to its own astonishment, is rather fond of Waterdeep and its citizens.
zh_tw: 他們被{@creature Vincent Trench|WDH|文森特·特倫奇}接待，他是一位人類偵探，也是虎眼石的主人。他說話簡潔，穿著一套筆挺的西裝，抽著一根細長的菸鬥。實際上，文森特是一個名叫瓦蘭塔賈爾的{@creature rakshasa||羅剎}，總是在見訪客之前對自己施放{@spell disguise self||易容術}。這個羅剎在深水城生活了多年，根據需要頻繁更換身份，以隱藏其真實本性。它已經習慣了與凡人共處，並且，令它自己驚訝的是，它相當喜歡深水城及其市民。

english: Services
zh_tw: 服務

english: Trench can discover any secret in Waterdeep, for a fee. Use your judgment when pricing its services; 50 gp is sufficient for most investigations, but if the characters want to learn secrets relating to the major antagonists of this adventure, the rakshasa might require a service in payment, such as slaying enemies that are hunting it, posting advertisements for its business in their tavern, or keeping tabs on someone Vincent has been hired to spy on.
zh_tw: 特倫奇可以發現深水城的任何秘密，只需付費。在定價其服務時請使用您的判斷力；50金幣對於大多數調查來說已經足夠，但如果角色們想要了解與本次冒險的主要反派相關的機密，這個羅剎可能需要以服務作為支付，例如殺死正在追捕它的敵人，在他們的客棧為其業務張貼廣告，或者監視文森特被僱傭來監視的人。

english: T6. Book Wyrm's Treasure
zh_tw: T6. 書蟲的寶藏

english: The front of this bookstore is adorned with a charming sign of a gold dragon curled around a treasure hoard of books and scrolls. Inside, the shop is decorated with beautiful hardwood, and the earthy scent of old books permeates the air. The library fills two floors of this three-story building, and it somehow seems to contain more shelves than the building should be able to hold.
zh_tw: 這家書店的正面裝飾著一個迷人的招牌，上面畫著一條金色的龍圍繞著一堆寶藏——書籍和卷軸。書店內部裝飾著美麗的硬木，舊書的泥土氣息瀰漫在空氣中。這家圖書館佔據了這座三層建築的兩層，而且它似乎包含了比建築本身能夠容納的更多的書架。

english: The shop is managed by a short dragonborn of gold dragon ancestry named {@creature Rishaal the Page-Turner|wdh|Rishaal} the Page-Turner, who lives on the third floor. Rishaal, a member of the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors, is a {@creature mage}, with these changes:
zh_tw: 這間書店由一名個子矮小、擁有金龍血統的龍裔{@creature Rishaal the Page-Turner|wdh|瑞莎爾}經營，他住在三樓。瑞莎爾是警戒法師與護衛教團的成員。他使用{@creature mage||魔法師}的資料，並有以下調整：

english: Rishaal is neutral.
zh_tw: 瑞莎爾是中立的。

english: He has these racial traits: He can use his action to exhale a 15-foot cone of fire (but can't do this again until he finishes a short or long rest); each creature in the cone must make a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw, taking {@dice 2d6} fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. He has resistance to fire damage. He speaks Common, Draconic, Dwarvish, and Elvish.
zh_tw: 他擁有以下種族特性：他可以使用他的動作撥出一股15尺的火焰錐形（但在完成一次短休或長休之前無法再次使用）；錐形範圍內的每個生物必須進行一次{@dc 10}敏捷豁免檢定，若豁免失敗則受到{@dice 2d6}火焰傷害，若豁免成功則只受到一半傷害。他對火焰傷害具有抗性。他會說通用語、龍語、矮人語和精靈語。

english: Services
zh_tw: 服務

english: The shop contains books of all sorts. In addition, {@creature Rishaal the Page-Turner|wdh|Rishaal} has a small collection of spellbooks and allows wizards to copy spells from them at the cost listed in the Spells for Sale table. He can scribe any of these spells as a spell scroll but charges twice the listed cost for this service.
zh_tw: 這家商店包含各種書籍。此外，{@creature Rishaal the Page-Turner|wdh|瑞莎爾}擁有一小批咒語書，並允許法師們以"出售咒語表"中列出的價格從這些書中抄寫咒語。他可以為這些咒語抄寫任何卷軸，但這項服務的費用是列出價格的兩倍。

english: T7. Sewer Access
zh_tw: T7. 汙水管道入口

english: At the east end of Trollskull Alley is a removable metal grate that covers an opening. Below the grate, a ladder descends 20 feet into the Waterdeep sewer system.
zh_tw: 在巨魔顱骨巷的東端，有一個可移動的金屬柵欄覆蓋著一個開口。柵欄下面，一個梯子下降20尺進入深水城的下水道系統。

english: Joining Factions
zh_tw: 加入派系

english: Word begins to spread throughout Waterdeep that a group of adventurers helped Volothamp Geddarm and rescued {@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh}. Within days, faction representatives begin to approach the characters and try to recruit them. This book's introduction describes the various factions and what they look for in recruits. The characters need not all join the same faction, and some might not want to join a faction at all.
zh_tw: 深水城開始流傳著一群冒險家幫助了瓦羅贊普·格達姆並救出了{@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh|瑞納爾·無燼}的訊息。幾天之內，各個派系的代表開始接觸這些角色並試圖招募他們。本書的引言描述了各個派系以及他們在招募成員時尋找的特質。角色們不必都加入同一個派系，有些人可能根本不想加入任何派系。

english: A character who belongs to a faction is given a mission upon gaining a level, from 2nd through 5th level. Completing the mission increases that member's renown in the faction. Other characters who aren't faction members can assist in the mission's completion. A character who belongs to a faction other than the Lords' Alliance can turn down a mission without consequence.
zh_tw: 一個屬於派系的角色在從2級到5級每升一級時，都會獲得一個任務。完成任務會增加該成員在派系中的聲望。不屬於該派系的其他角色也可以協助完成任務。屬於除了領主聯盟之外的其他派系的角色可以拒絕任務而不會產生後果。

english: Each faction has a representative who serves as its primary contact. This NPC delivers mission briefings and dispenses the tangible rewards for completing a mission. An increase in renown quickly follows. The missions and the manner in which they can be completed are described in the tables throughout this section. You can use missions from these tables or replace any of them with ones of your own creation.
zh_tw: 每個派系都有一個代表，作為其主要聯絡人。這個NPC提供任務簡報，並分發完成任務的有形獎勵。聲望的提升會迅速跟進。任務以及完成它們的方式在本節的表格中有所描述。您可以使用這些表格中的任務，或者用您自己建立的任務替換其中的任何一個。

english: If a mission ends in failure, the characters can try again after 24 hours, unless the failure has created circumstances where doing so is impossible.
zh_tw: 如果任務失敗，角色們可以在24小時後再次嘗試，除非失敗造成了無法再次嘗試的情況。

english: Bregan D'aerthe
zh_tw: 布雷甘·達耶

english: If one or more characters are drow, {@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH} has his lieutenants, three {@creature drow gunslinger|WDH|drow gunslingers}, shadow these potential new recruits while keeping a safe distance. {@creature Fel'rekt Lafeen|WDH} and {@creature Krebbyg Masq'il'yr|WDH} watch the characters at night, and {@creature Soluun Xibrindas|wdh} watches them during the day (doing his best to stay out of the sunlight). See {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12} for details on these lieutenants.
zh_tw: 如果有一個或多個角色是卓爾，{@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH|賈拉索·班瑞}會派他的三名副官——{@creature drow gunslinger|WDH|卓爾火槍手}跟蹤這些潛在的新成員，同時保持安全距離。{@creature Fel'rekt Lafeen|WDH|菲爾萊科特·拉菲恩}和{@creature Krebbyg Masq'il'yr|WDH|克雷比格·馬斯奇爾}在夜間監視這些角色，而{@creature Soluun Xibrindas|wdh|索倫·希布林達斯}則在白天監視他們（並儘量避免暴露在陽光下）。有關這些副官的詳細資訊，請參閱{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}。

english: Characters who have a passive Wisdom (Perception) score of 18 or higher see fleeting glimpses of the drow spies over a period of several days and can, with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Insight) check, ascertain that these spies are paying particular attention to the activities of the drow party members.
zh_tw: 被動感知（感知）值為18或更高的角色在幾天內會瞥見卓爾間諜，並且可以透過成功的{@dc 15} 感知（洞悉）檢定，確認這些間諜特別關注卓爾一員的行動。

english: Jarlaxle Baenre
zh_tw: 賈拉索·班瑞

english: If the party reports the drow to the City Watch, Jarlaxle ends the surveillance and breaks off all contact with the characters for the time being.
zh_tw: 如果隊伍向城市守衛報告了黑暗精靈，賈拉索利將結束監視，並暫時切斷與角色們的所有聯絡。

english: On the other hand, if the characters try to confront the drow spies, they avoid contact but leave behind a black eye patch as a calling card. The next day, {@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) shows up at the party's headquarters, using his {@item hat of disguise} to appear as a haberdasher named J.B. Nevercott. In this guise, he asks to speak privately with drow characters who he thinks might make suitable Bregan D'aerthe recruits. Only drow are given serious consideration, but Jarlaxle doesn't care if they're male or female. As a test, he offers them their first mission.
zh_tw: 另一方面，如果角色們試圖面對黑暗精靈間諜，他們會避免接觸，但會留下一個黑色眼罩作為名片。第二天，{@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH|賈拉索·班瑞}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）出現在聚會的總部，使用他的{@item hat of disguise||易容帽}變成一個名叫J.B. 奈弗科特的服裝商。在這個偽裝下，他請求私下與他認為可能成為適合布雷甘·達耶招募的黑暗精靈角色交談。只有黑暗精靈會被認真考慮，但賈拉索不在乎他們是男性還是女性。作為測試，他為他們提供第一個任務。

english: Jarlaxle is a consummate actor who never lets down his guard. Even if the characters discern his true identity, he never admits to being anything other than what he pretends to be.
zh_tw: 賈拉索利是一個高超的演員，他從不放鬆警惕。即使角色們識破了他的真實身份，他也從不承認自己是除了他假裝的身份之外的任何人。
