english: 2nd
zh_tw: 2nd

english: "I'd like you to steal a silk handkerchief from a Waterdavian noble and give it to a tiefling girl who lives in a crate at the corner of Net Street and Dock Street, by the wharf."
zh_tw: "我想讓你們從一個深水城貴族那裡偷一條絲質手帕，然後把它交給一個住在漁網街和碼頭街拐角處貨箱裡的提夫林女孩。"

english: Finding a noble isn't hard, but snatching one's handkerchief without being detected requires a successful {@dc 12} Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check. One can also convince a noble to surrender it with a successful {@dc 12} Charisma (Deception, Intimidation, or Persuasion) check. The tiefling girl in the crate thanks the characters for the hanky. {@i Reward:} Each Bregan D'aerthe character gains 1 renown.
zh_tw: 找到一位貴族並不難，但要在不被察覺的情況下奪走他的手帕，需要進行一次成功的 {@dc 12} 敏捷（巧手）檢定。也可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 12} 魅力（欺瞞、威嚇或說服）檢定，說服貴族交出手帕。箱子裡的提夫林女孩為手帕向角色們道謝。{@i 獎勵：} 每個布雷甘·達耶成員角色獲得 1 點聲望。

english: 3rd
zh_tw: 3rd

english: "This mission is so easy, a gang of street urchins could pull it off. I want you to deliver an exposé to Gaxly Rudderbust, the publisher of a local broadsheet called {@i The Waterdeep Wazoo}, without his knowing who wrote it or where it came from. You'll find his office at the corner of Immar Street and Stallion Street, in the North Ward. Leave the story on his desk."
zh_tw: "這個任務太簡單了，就連一幫街頭小混混都能完成。我要你把一篇揭露文章交給蓋克斯利·魯德巴斯特，他是當地一份名為{@i 深水城瓦祖}的報紙的出版商，但不能讓他知道是誰寫的或者它來自哪裡。你會在北區的伊瑪街和種馬街的拐角處找到他的辦公室。把文章放在他的桌子上。"

english: Jarlaxle has written an exposé on devil worship among unnamed Waterdavian noble families. The story mentions orgies and secret deals happening behind closed doors. (Jarlaxle never passes up a chance to rattle the nobility and sow political unrest.) A character can break into Gaxly's office while it's closed, either during lunch hour or after hours. Getting in and out without being seen requires two successful {@dc 15} Dexterity (Stealth) checks, and getting past a locked door requires a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity check using thieves' tools (or a {@spell knock} spell or similar magic). {@i Reward}: Each Bregan D'aerthe character gains 1 renown.
zh_tw: 賈拉索撰寫了一篇揭露未具名的深水城貴族家族中魔鬼崇拜的報道。故事中提到了一些關起門來進行的狂歡和秘密交易。（賈拉索從不錯過任何動搖貴族和政治動盪的機會。）一個角色可以在蓋克斯利的辦公室關閉時闖入，要麼在午餐時間，要麼在營業時間後。進出而不被發現需要進行兩次成功的 {@dc 15} 敏捷（隱匿）檢定，透過一扇鎖上的門需要使用盜賊工具進行一次成功的 {@dc 10} 敏捷檢定（或者使用 {@spell knock||敲擊術} 咒語或類似魔法）。{@i 獎勵}：每個布雷甘·達耶成員獲得 1 點聲望。

english: 4th
zh_tw: 4th

english: "We've captured a member of the Xanathar Guild, and I'd like you to guard him for three nights until I or another member of Bregan D'aerthe reclaims him. You'll find him trapped in your basement."
zh_tw: "我們已經捕獲了一名姍娜薩公會的成員，我希望你為他守衛三個晚上，直到我或其他布雷甘·達耶成員來認領他。你會發現他被困在你的地下室裡。"

english: Characters who search the basement of their Trollskull Alley tavern (see below) find {@creature Ott Steeltoes|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) bound by {@item iron bands of Bilarro}. How he got there is anyone's guess; even he doesn't know. On the first night, {@creature Xanathar|WDH} sends a gang of six {@creature bugbear||bugbears} to attack the tavern and rescue Ott. If the characters have moved Ott elsewhere, the bugbears attack the tavern anyway. On the second night, four members of the Dungsweepers' Guild ({@creature commoner||commoners}) with {@creature intellect devourer||intellect devourers} in their skulls visit the tavern. They order drinks and scope out the tavern, attacking if they find Ott or leaving if they don't. On the third night, a {@creature beholder zombie} attacks. After the third attack, Ott disappears as mysteriously as he arrived, along with the {@item iron bands of Bilarro}. {@i Reward}: Each Bregan D'aerthe character gains 2 renown.
zh_tw: 在巨魔顱骨巷酒館的地下室中搜尋的角色們（見下文）會發現被{@item iron bands of Bilarro||比拉羅的鐵索}束縛的{@creature Ott Steeltoes|wdh|奧特·鋼趾}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）。他是怎麼到那裡的，誰也說不準；甚至連他自己也不知道。在第一個晚上，{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}派出了六名{@creature bugbear||熊地精}組成的團夥襲擊酒館並試圖解救奧特。如果角色們已經把奧特轉移到了其他地方，熊地精們仍然會攻擊酒館。在第二個晚上，四名來自糞掃行者公會的成員（{@creature commoner||平民}），他們的頭顱中寄居著{@creature intellect devourer||噬腦怪}，會造訪酒館。他們點了飲料並偵察酒館的情況，如果發現了奧特，他們會發動攻擊；如果沒有發現，他們會離開。在第三個晚上，一隻{@creature beholder zombie||眼魔喪屍}會發動攻擊。在第三次襲擊之後，奧特就像他神秘到來一樣神秘失蹤，{@item iron bands of Bilarro||比拉羅的鐵索}也隨之消失。{@i 獎勵}：每個布雷甘·達耶成員獲得 2 點聲望。

english: 5th
zh_tw: 5th

english: "We have a spy deep within {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s organization, but I fear he has been compromised. It breaks my heart to do this, but I'm sending you to eliminate him. Make it quick and painless, and for Lolth's sake, be discreet."
zh_tw: "我們在{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的組織內部有一名間諜，但我擔心他已經被暴露了。讓我心痛的是，我派你們去消除他。請迅速且無痛苦地完成，看在羅絲的份上，要保持謹慎。"

english: Jarlaxle identifies the traitor as a drow mage named {@creature Nar'l Xibrindas|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) and furnishes the characters with a route to {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s lair through underground passageways. ({@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s lair is described in chapter 5. Characters who follow Jarlaxle's route arrive at {@area X1|271}.) {@i Reward}: Each Bregan D'aerthe character gains 2 renown. Each party member who contributes to the mission receives a trophy bearing a gold statuette of Jarlaxle (worth 250 gp).
zh_tw: 賈拉索確認叛徒是一名叫做{@creature Nar'l Xibrindas|wdh|納爾·澤布林達斯}的卓爾法師（參見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），併為角色們提供了一條經過地下通道通往{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}巢穴的路線。（{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的巢穴在第五章中有描述。遵循賈拉索路線的角色將抵達{@area X1|271}。）{@i 獎勵}：每個布雷甘·達耶成員獲得2點聲望。每個為任務做出貢獻的隊員將獲得一個帶有賈拉索金色小雕像的戰利品（價值250金幣）。

zh_tw: 巨魔顱骨巷，地下室

english: Emerald Enclave
zh_tw: 翠綠閒庭

english: The Emerald Enclave takes an interest in characters who seek to preserve the balance within Waterdeep (particularly clerics of nature, druids, and rangers). Any such character is visited by a white cat that speaks the following message in a melodious male voice:
zh_tw: 翠綠閒庭對那些尋求維護深水城平衡的角色（特別是自然的牧師、德魯伊和遊俠）感興趣。任何這樣的角色都會被一隻白貓拜訪，它以悅耳的男性聲音傳達以下資訊：

english: "Interested in joining the Emerald Enclave? Come meet us at Phaulkonmere in the Southern Ward."
zh_tw: "對加入翠綠閒庭感興趣嗎？來南區的波康莊園見我們。"

english: The cat is an ordinary animal upon which an {@spell animal messenger} spell was cast. It dashes away after delivering its invitation.
zh_tw: 這隻貓是一隻普通的動物，它被施加了{@spell animal messenger||動物信使}法術。它在傳遞完邀請後迅速離開。

english: Melannor Fellbranch
zh_tw: 梅蘭諾·費爾布蘭奇

english: The characters' main contact in the Emerald Enclave is {@creature Melannor Fellbranch|wdh}, the friendly but humorless groundskeeper of Phaulkonmere, a compound located one block south of Kolat Towers (see chapter 8). Phaulkonmere is owned by the Tarm and Phaulkon noble families. Melannor delivers missions by way of {@spell animal messenger} spells and is partial to using cats and pigeons as couriers. He quickly assigns new members their first mission.
zh_tw: 角色們在翠綠閒庭的主要聯絡人是{@creature Melannor Fellbranch|wdh|梅蘭諾·費爾布蘭奇}，他是位於克拉特雙塔（見第8章）南邊一個街區的波康莊園的友好但缺乏幽默感的園丁。波康莊園由塔姆和波康貴族家族擁有。梅蘭諾透過{@spell animal messenger||動物信使}法術傳遞任務，並且喜歡使用貓和鴿子作為信使。他很快為新成員分配了第一個任務。

english: {@creature Melannor Fellbranch|wdh|Melannor} is a half-elf {@creature druid}, with these changes:
zh_tw: {@creature Melannor Fellbranch|wdh|梅蘭諾} 是一位半精靈{@creature druid||德魯伊}，有以下變化：

english: Melannor is chaotic good.
zh_tw: 梅蘭諾是混亂善良。

english: He has these racial traits: He has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put him to sleep. He has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. He speaks Common and Elvish.
zh_tw: 他具有以下種族特徵：他在對抗{@condition charmed||魅惑}的豁免檢定中有優勢，魔法不能讓他入睡。他具有60尺範圍內的黑暗視覺。他會說通用語和精靈語。

english: Jeryth Phaulkon
zh_tw: 傑瑞斯·波康

english: When the characters arrive at Phaulkonmere for the first time, {@creature Melannor Fellbranch|wdh|Melannor} introduces them to the lady of the estate: a noblewoman-turned-demigod and Chosen of Mielikki named Jeryth Phaulkon. Jeryth, the only member of her family who currently resides at Phaulkonmere, manifests as a disembodied female voice that can be heard by anyone in the villa gardens. She offers membership in the enclave and bestows on each new member a {@reward charm of restoration} (see "Supernatural Gifts" in chapter 7 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|dmg}). Jeryth also offers Phaulkonmere as a safe haven for enclave members and their friends.
zh_tw: 當角色們第一次到達波康莊園時，{@creature Melannor Fellbranch|wdh|梅蘭諾}將他們介紹給了莊園的女主人：一位從貴族轉變為半神、並被梅麗凱選中的傑瑞斯·波康。傑瑞斯是家族中目前唯一居住在波康莊園的成員，她以無實體的女性聲音顯現，別墅花園中的任何人都能聽到她的聲音。她提供了加入這個陣營的機會，並賦予每位新成員一個{@reward charm of restoration||復原護咒}（參看{@book 城主指南|dmg}第7章的"超自然贈禮"）。傑瑞斯還提供波康莊園作為陣營成員及其朋友的安全避難所。

english: In her disembodied state, Jeryth can't be harmed. If the need arises, Jeryth can cast any spell on the {@filter druid|spells|class=druid} spell list. She uses her spells in defense of her estate and its beautiful gardens. A member of the Emerald Enclave can petition Jeryth to cast a spell, which she is happy to do if that character's renown in the enclave equals or exceeds the spell's level.
zh_tw: 在她的非實體狀態下，傑瑞斯無法受到傷害。如果需要，傑瑞斯可以施展{@filter 德魯伊|spells|class=druid}法術列表中的任何法術。她使用這些法術來保護她的莊園及其美麗的花園。翠綠閒庭的一名成員可以向傑瑞斯請求施展一個法術，如果該角色在結界中的聲望等於或超過法術的等級，她很樂意這樣做。

english: 2nd
zh_tw: 2nd

english: "Outlying farms are being terrorized by a scarecrow come to life. It has slaughtered livestock, chased horses, and spooked farmers. No people have been killed as yet, so the City Guard is dragging its heels. Something must be done!"
zh_tw: "郊外的農場正遭受一個活過來的稻草人的恐嚇。它已經屠殺了牲畜，追逐馬匹，嚇壞了農民。到目前為止還沒有人被殺，所以城防軍隊還在拖延。必須採取行動！"

english: Not one but three {@creature scarecrow||scarecrows} are terrorizing Undercliff. One wears a sackcloth hood, another has a rotting pumpkin head, and the third is covered with a threadbare blanket. Characters who camp in a field for the better part of a day or night have a {@chance 10|10 percent chance} of encountering one of the scarecrows. The attacks continue until all three scarecrows are destroyed. {@i Reward}: Each Emerald Enclave character gains 1 renown for ending the threat.
zh_tw: 不是一隻而是三隻{@creature scarecrow||稻草人}正在恐嚇崖下區。一隻戴著麻袋頭罩，另一隻有著腐爛的南瓜頭，第三隻則覆蓋著一張破舊的毯子。在田野裡露營超過大半天或夜晚的角色有{@chance 10|10% 的機會}遇到其中一隻稻草人。襲擊將持續到所有三隻稻草人被摧毀。{@i 獎勵}：每個翠綠閒庭的角色因結束威脅而獲得1點聲望。

english: 3rd
zh_tw: 3rd

english: "Sir Ambrose Everdawn, a grizzled old champion of Kelemvor, has offered to help the City Guard catch a necromancer who's stealing bones from the City of the Dead and animating them as skeletons. Sir Ambrose could use your help, if you're not too busy."
zh_tw: "安布羅斯·永曉爵士，一位經驗豐富的凱蘭沃老冠軍，提出幫助城防軍捉拿一個從亡者之城偷骨頭並將其製成骷髏的死靈師。如果你不太忙的話，安布羅斯爵士可以利用你的幫助。"

english: Convincing Ambrose Everdawn (LG male human Tethyrian {@creature knight}) that the party intends to help requires a successful {@dc 13} Charisma (Persuasion) check. If the check succeeds, Sir Ambrose asks the party to patrol the southern half of the cemetery for ten consecutive nights while he patrols the north half. The characters have a cumulative {@chance 10|10 percent chance} each night of encountering six {@creature skeleton||skeletons}, but there's no sign of the necromancer who animated them. Once the skeletons are destroyed, no further encounters occur. After a tenday, Sir Ambrose releases the characters from service. {@i Reward}: Each Emerald Enclave character gains 1 renown. Each party member who patrolled the cemetery for all ten nights receives 100 gp.
zh_tw: 說服安布羅斯·永晨（守序善良男性人類泰瑟爾人 {@creature knight||騎士}）相信隊伍確實打算提供幫助，需要透過一次成功的 {@dc 13} 魅力（說服）檢定。如果檢定成功，安布羅斯爵士會要求隊伍連續十個晚上巡邏墓地的南半部分，而他則負責北半部分。角色們每晚有累積的 {@chance 10|10% 的機會} 遇到六具 {@creature skeleton||骷髏}，但沒有發現驅使它們的死靈師的蹤跡。一旦骷髏被消滅，便不會再遇到更多敵人。十天後，安布羅斯爵士會解除角色的任務。 {@i 獎勵}：每個翠綠閒庭的角色獲得 1 聲望。每晚都巡邏墓地的每個隊伍成員將獲得 100 金幣。

english: 4th
zh_tw: 4th

english: "Doppelgangers threaten the balance of power in Waterdeep. Rumor has it a group of them are hiding in the Yawning Portal. Root them out and rid the city of them if you can."
zh_tw: "變形怪威脅著深水城的權力平衡。有傳言說一群變形怪藏在呵欠之門裡。如果你能的話，把它們挖出來，把城市從它們手中清除。"

english: The characters need to confront "{@creature Bonnie|WDH}" the {@creature doppelganger} and, with a successful {@dc 15} Charisma (Intimidation or Persuasion) check, convince her to leave Waterdeep and take her gang with her. {@i Reward}: Each Emerald Enclave character gains 2 renown.
zh_tw: 角色們需要面對 {@creature Bonnie|WDH|邦妮} 這個 {@creature doppelganger||變形怪}，並透過一次成功的 {@dc 15} 魅力（威嚇或說服）檢定，說服她離開深水城並帶走她的幫派。{@i 獎勵}：每個翠綠閒庭角色的聲望增加2。

english: 5th
zh_tw: 5th

english: "The Xanathar Guild is releasing monsters to distract the City Watch and the City Guard while its members stir up trouble elsewhere. The authorities are having trouble catching and killing a flying horror known as a grell. This aberration was latest seen snatching up an old woman in the Dock Ward. Unless we intervene, she won't be the last."
zh_tw: "姍娜薩公會正在釋放怪物以分散城市守衛和城市守衛隊的注意力，而其成員在其他地方製造麻煩。當局在捕捉和殺死一種名為觸鬚怪的飛行恐怖生物方面遇到了麻煩。這種異怪最後一次被看到是在碼頭區抓走了一位老婦人。除非我們介入，否則她不會是最後一個。"

english: Locating the grell requires a successful {@dc 18} Intelligence (Investigation) check followed by a successful {@dc 18} Wisdom (Survival) check. Each check, whether successful or not, represents 1 hour of gathering information or tracking spoor. In fact, there are two {@creature grell||grells}. One grell tries to flee if the other is killed. {@i Reward}: Each Emerald Enclave character gains 2 renown. Jeryth bestows a charm of heroism (see "Supernatural Gifts" in chapter 7 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|dmg}) on each party member who helped slay the grells.
zh_tw: 定位格雷爾需要成功的 {@dc 18} 智力（調查）檢定，隨後是成功的 {@dc 18} 感知（求生）檢定。無論是否成功，每次檢定都代表了1小時的資訊收集或追蹤蹤跡。實際上，有兩隻 {@creature grell||觸鬚怪}。如果其中一隻格雷爾被殺死，另一隻會試圖逃跑。{@i 獎勵}：每個翠綠閒庭的角色獲得2點聲望。傑瑞斯會將英勇護咒（見《{@book 城主指南|dmg}》第7章的"超自然禮物"）賜予每個參與擊殺格雷爾的隊伍成員。

english: Force Grey (Gray Hands)
zh_tw: 灰色力量 (灰手)

english: The Blackstaff, {@creature Vajra Safahr|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), is friends with {@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh}, and word of his rescue quickly reaches her ears. She uses a {@spell sending} spell to deliver the following short message to one of the characters:
zh_tw: 黑杖，{@creature Vajra Safahr|WDH|瓦婕拉·莎法爾}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），是{@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh|瑞納爾·無燼}的朋友，他獲救的訊息很快就傳到了她的耳朵。她使用了一個{@spell sending||短訊術}法術，向其中一名角色傳遞了以下簡短的資訊：

english: "I am {@creature Vajra Safahr|WDH}, the Blackstaff. Come to Blackstaff Tower in the Castle Ward at once. Bring your friends."
zh_tw: "我是{@creature Vajra Safahr|WDH|瓦婕拉·莎法爾}，黑杖。立刻來城堡區的黑杖塔。帶上你的朋友們。"

english: Despite her insistent tone, Vajra doesn't take offense if the character refuses her invitation. A day later, she casts another {@spell sending} spell and reaches out to a different party member. If she is refused a second time, she doesn't contact the party again until the characters gain a level.
zh_tw: 儘管瓦婕拉的語氣很堅持，但如果角色拒絕了她的邀請，她不會生氣。一天後，她再次施放另一個{@spell sending||短訊術}法術，並聯系隊伍中的另一個成員。如果第二次還被拒絕，她將不會再聯絡這個隊伍，直到角色們升級。

english: Vajra Safahr
zh_tw: 瓦婕拉·莎法爾

english: Blackstaff Tower is a fortress and a wizard training academy all in one. From here, {@creature Vajra Safahr|WDH} watches over the city and asserts herself as Blackstaff. {@spell Sending} spells are her preferred way of communicating with her operatives.
zh_tw: 黑杖塔既是一座堡壘，也是一座法師培訓學校。在這裡，{@creature Vajra Safahr|WDH|瓦婕拉·莎法爾}守望著這座城市，並以黑杖的身份自居。{@spell Sending||短訊術}法術是她與她的特工溝通的首選方式。

english: Vajra offers the characters membership in the Gray Hands, a private security force under her command. She doles out missions designed to tax the characters' resources and test their loyalty to Waterdeep. Characters who complete these missions won't gain enough renown to join Force Grey yet, but they will gain something valuable: the Blackstaff's patronage. Vajra continues to take an interest in their adventuring careers, helping out when she can.
zh_tw: 瓦婕拉為角色們提供了加入灰手的會員資格，灰手是她指揮下的私人保安力量。她分發的任務旨在考驗角色們的資源並測試他們對深水城的忠誠。完成這些任務的角色們將不會獲得足夠的聲望加入灰色力量，但他們將獲得一些有價值的東西：黑杖的贊助。瓦婕拉繼續對他們的冒險事業感興趣，並在可能的情況下提供幫助。

english: Party Level
zh_tw: 隊伍等級

english: Mission Brief
zh_tw: 任務簡報

english: Mission Requirements and Reward
zh_tw: 任務要求和獎勵

english: 2nd
zh_tw: 2nd

english: "Seek out {@creature Hlam|WDH}, a monk who lives in a cave on the side of Mount Waterdeep. Ask him what he's heard about threats to the city, but try not to annoy him or overstay your welcome."
zh_tw: "尋找{@creature Hlam|WDH|胡拉姆}，一位居住在深水城山山洞中的僧侶。詢問他關於城市威脅的所聞，但儘量不要惹惱他或逗留太久。"

english: Those who climb the mountainside to reach the cave must succeed on a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw or arrive with {@dice 1d4} levels of {@condition exhaustion}. Trying to get {@creature Hlam|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) to share information requires a {@dc 12} Charisma (Persuasion) check. If the check succeeds, he tells the characters, "Evil's twin hides its face for now. Expect that to change before winter's end." (This is an oblique reference to {@creature Manshoon|WDH}.) The characters can descend the mountain safely. {@i Reward}: Each Gray Hand character gains 1 renown.
zh_tw: 那些攀登山坡到達洞穴的人必須成功進行一次 {@dc 12} 體質豁免檢定，否則將在抵達時帶有 {@dice 1d4} 層 {@condition exhaustion||力竭}。嘗試讓 {@creature Hlam|WDH|胡拉姆}（參見 {@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）分享資訊需要進行一次 {@dc 12} 魅力（說服）檢定。如果檢定成功，他會告訴角色們："邪惡的雙胞胎暫時隱藏了它的面目。預計在冬末之前情況會有所變化。"（這是對 {@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松} 的隱晦提及。）角色們可以安全地下山。{@i 獎勵}：每個灰手角色獲得1點聲望。

english: 3rd
zh_tw: 3rd

english: "A young bronze dragon has taken up residence in Deepwater Harbor. It startled a few sailors recently but hasn't hurt anyone. Confront the dragon and learn its intentions."
zh_tw: "一隻年輕的青銅龍在深水港定居了。它最近嚇壞了幾個水手，但並沒有傷害任何人。面對這條龍，瞭解它的意圖。"

english: Vajra gives each character a {@item potion of water breathing} to complete this mission. They find a {@creature young bronze dragon}, Zelifarn, swimming around a barnacle-covered shipwreck at the bottom of the deep harbor. The friendly dragon tries to coax as much treasure as it can from the characters. Those who converse with Zelifarn can make a {@dc 13} Wisdom (Insight) check. A successful check reveals that the dragon poses no danger to Waterdeep. If no one succeeds on the check, the dragon's true intentions can't be gleaned. {@i Reward}: Each Gray Hand character gains 1 renown.
zh_tw: 瓦婕拉給每個角色一瓶{@item potion of water breathing||水下呼吸藥水}來完成這項任務。他們在深港底部發現一條{@creature young bronze dragon||青年青銅龍}——澤利法恩，在覆蓋著藤壺的沉船周圍遊動。這隻友好的龍試圖從角色們身上哄騙儘可能多的財寶。與澤利法恩交談的人可以嘗試進行一次{@dc 13}感知（洞悉）檢定。如果檢定成功，角色會發現這條龍對深水城沒有威脅。如果沒有人透過檢定，龍的真正意圖就無法被察覺。{@i 獎勵}: 每個灰手成員獲得1點聲望。

english: 4th
zh_tw: 4th

english: "A member of Force Grey has been acting strangely of late. His name is {@creature Meloon Wardragon|WDH}, and his happy-go-lucky demeanor has soured. He's been hanging around the Yawning Portal more than usual. Observe him for a tenday, then report back to me."
zh_tw: "最近，灰色力量的一名成員表現得有些奇怪。他的名字是{@creature Meloon Wardragon|WDH|麥倫·戰龍}，他那無憂無慮的性格已經變得陰沉。他比平時更多地在呵欠之門周圍徘徊。觀察他十天，然後向我彙報。"

english: Characters can befriend {@creature Meloon Wardragon|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) or watch him from afar. Each day at dawn, Meloon engages in a telepathic contest of wills with his magic axe, {@item Azuredge|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix A|WDH|11}), before leaving his room at the Yawning Portal. The axe wants a new wielder, but Meloon refuses to part with it. Characters who observe Meloon during this exchange can ascertain what's going on with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Insight) check. {@i Reward}: Each Gray Hand character gains 2 renown. If the characters rid Meloon of the {@creature intellect devourer} in his skull, Vajra gives the party a {@item wand of secrets}.
zh_tw: 角色們可以與 {@creature Meloon Wardragon|WDH|麥倫·戰龍}（見 {@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）建立友誼，或是遠遠地觀察他。每天黎明時分，梅倫都會在他位於"呵欠之門"的房間裡與他的魔法斧頭 {@item Azuredge|WDH|蔚藍之鋒}（見 {@adventure 附錄A|WDH|11}）進行一場心靈意志的較量，然後才會離開房間。斧頭想要尋找一個新的持有者，但梅倫拒絕放棄它。角色們如果在這場較量中觀察梅倫，可以透過一個成功 {@dc 15} 的感知（洞悉）檢定來瞭解發生了什麼事情。{@i 獎勵}：每個"灰手"角色的角色將獲得 2 點聲望。如果角色們能夠清除梅倫頭顱中的 {@creature intellect devourer||噬腦怪}，瓦婕拉將給予隊伍一支 {@item wand of secrets||探秘魔杖}。

english: 5th
zh_tw: 5th

english: "{@creature Xanathar|WDH} is using intellect devourers to take control of Waterdavians in key positions throughout the city. We must deal with this problem at once. Infiltrate {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s lair and destroy whatever is responsible for creating these creatures."
zh_tw: "{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩} 正在使用噬腦怪控制城市中關鍵位置的深水城居民。我們必須立即解決這個問題。潛入{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的巢穴並摧毀負責創造這些生物的任何東西。"

english: The characters must slay {@creature Nihiloor|WDH} the {@creature mind flayer} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}). They can stake out a Xanathar Guild hideout (see chapter 1) and wait for {@creature Nihiloor|WDH} to show up there, or confront the mind flayer in {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s lair (see chapter 5). {@i Reward}: Each Gray Hand character gains 2 renown. Every character who participated in the raid receives a {@item potion of resistance}. In addition, Vajra covers the cost of any {@spell raise dead} spells needed to bring back dead characters.
zh_tw: 角色們必須剿滅{@creature mind flayer||奪心魔}{@creature Nihiloor|WDH|尼希盧爾}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）。他們可以蹲守一個姍娜薩公會藏身地（見第一章）並等待{@creature Nihiloor|WDH|尼希盧爾}在那裡出現，或在{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的巢穴（見第五章）中對抗奪心魔。{@i 獎勵}：每位灰手角色獲得2點聲望。每位參與突襲的角色獲得一瓶{@item potion of resistance||抗性藥水}。此外，瓦婕拉會支付任何用於復活死亡角色所需的{@spell raise dead||死者復活}法術的花費。

english: Harpers
zh_tw: 豎琴手聯盟

english: The Harpers approach good-aligned characters who show promise as spies. One such character receives the following message, written on a {@item paper bird|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix A|WDH|11}):
zh_tw: "豎琴手聯盟組織接觸那些表現出作為間諜潛力的善良陣營的角色。其中一位角色收到了以下資訊，寫在一隻{@item paper bird|WDH|紙鳶}上（見{@adventure 附錄A|WDH|11}）："

english: "Renaer tells us you are a good bet. He bought you tickets to the opera tonight at the Lightsinger Theater in the Sea Ward. If you are interested, meet {@creature Mirt|WDH} at intermission. Private Box C. Formal attire is required for admittance."
zh_tw: "瑞納爾告訴我們你是個不錯的選擇。他在海區的光歌劇院為你買了今晚的歌劇票。如果你感興趣，請在中場休息時與{@creature Mirt|WDH|米爾特}會面。私人包廂C。入場需要正式著裝。"

english: Enclosed are tickets for the entire party to {@i The Fall of Tiamat}, an opera sung in Giant describing the evil dragon queen's defeat at the Well of Dragons.
zh_tw: 隨信附上整個團隊觀看{@i 提亞馬特的隕落}的門票，這是一部以巨人語演唱的歌劇，描述了惡龍女王在龍井的敗北。

english: Mirt
zh_tw: 米爾特

english: If any of the characters join the Harpers, {@creature Mirt|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) becomes their main Harper contact throughout the adventure.
zh_tw: 如果任何角色加入豎琴手聯盟組織，{@creature Mirt|WDH|米爾特}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）將成為他們在整個冒險過程中的主要豎琴手聯盟聯絡人。

english: Lightsinger Theater is a high-end establishment located in the Castle Ward. If the characters meet {@creature Mirt|WDH} in his private box during the opera's intermission, he describes the Harpers and offers membership to eligible characters. Characters who accept receive a silver pin of a harp within a crescent moon, along with their first mission (see the Harpers Missions table). {@creature Mirt|WDH} also tells them that if they ever need to speak with him directly, they are welcome to visit his manor in the Sea Ward. If the characters do visit {@creature Mirt|WDH}'s manor, there's a {@chance 90|90 percent chance} that {@creature Mirt|WDH} isn't home and no one answers the door.
zh_tw: 光歌劇院是一家位於城堡區的高階場所。如果角色們在歌劇中場休息時在私人包廂與{@creature Mirt|WDH|米爾特}會面，他會描述豎琴手聯盟組織並邀請符合條件的角色加入。接受邀請的角色將收到一枚帶有新月內豎琴圖案的銀質徽章，以及他們的第一個任務（見豎琴手聯盟任務表）。{@creature Mirt|WDH|米爾特}還告訴他們，如果他們需要直接與他交談，歡迎他們訪問他在海區的莊園。如果角色們確實去訪問{@creature Mirt|WDH|米爾特}的莊園，有{@chance 90|90%的機率}會發現{@creature Mirt|WDH|米爾特}不在家，且無人應門。

english: Party Level
zh_tw: 隊伍等級

english: Mission Brief
zh_tw: 任務簡報

english: Mission Requirements and Reward
zh_tw: 任務要求和獎勵

english: 2nd
zh_tw: 2nd

english: "One of the drays working in the city is pulled by a talking mare named {@creature Maxeene|wdh}. Locate her, find out if she's learned the identity of any Zhent operatives, and if so, determine their whereabouts."
zh_tw: "城市中工作的一輛馬車由一匹會說話的母馬駕駛，名叫{@creature Maxeene|wdh|瑪克辛}。找到她，找出她是否已經瞭解到任何散提爾堡特工的身份，如果是的話，確定他們的位置。"

english: Characters can find {@creature Maxeene|WDH}, a {@creature draft horse} with an Intelligence score of 10, with a successful {@dc 13} Intelligence (Investigation) check. {@creature Maxeene|WDH} speaks Common, and characters must try to convince her that they're Harpers by making a {@dc 13} Charisma (Persuasion) check. If the check succeeds, the horse recalls giving a ride to a sun elf and his half-orc bodyguard two days ago; she picked them up at an intersection (she doesn't recall which one) and dropped them off at the Yawning Portal. They talked about hiring spies to root out Xanathar Guild hideouts in the city. {@creature Maxeene|WDH}'s descriptions of the passengers match the appearances of {@creature Davil Starsong|WDH} and {@creature Yagra Stonefist|wdh}. {@i Reward}: Each Harper character gains 1 renown.
zh_tw: 角色們若成功透過{@dc 13}智力（調查）檢定，就能找到{@creature Maxeene|WDH|瑪克辛}。牠是一匹智力值為10的{@creature draft horse||馱用馬}。{@creature Maxeene|WDH|瑪克辛}會說通用語；角色們必須進行{@dc 13}魅力（說服）檢定，讓牠相信他們是豎琴手聯盟成員。若檢定成功，牠回憶起兩天前曾載過一名日精靈與他的半獸人保鏢：牠在一處十字路口接到他們，但不記得是哪一處，並在呵欠之門讓他們下車。他們談到僱用間諜，找出城內姍娜薩公會的藏身處。{@creature Maxeene|WDH|瑪克辛}對乘客的描述符合{@creature Davil Starsong|WDH|達維爾·星歌}與{@creature Yagra Stonefist|wdh|雅格拉·石拳}的外貌。{@i 獎勵}：每名豎琴手聯盟角色獲得1點聲望。

english: 3rd
zh_tw: 3rd

english: "Uza Solizeph is an old woman who sells books out of a narrow three-story building on Sorn Street in the Trades Ward. She claims to have trapped a monster in her shop and fears for the welfare of her books and her cat. The City Watch isn't likely to lend a hand, given Uza's propensity for tall tales, but the Harpers owe her a favor. You'll find her sobbing at Felzoun's Folly, a tavern on the corner of Sorn Street and Salabar Street. Make haste!"
zh_tw: "烏扎·索利澤夫是一位老婦人，她在商業區索恩街上一座狹窄的三層建築裡賣書。她聲稱在她的書店裡困住了一個怪物，擔心她的書和她的貓的安全。鑑於烏扎喜歡講誇張的故事，城市守衛不太可能提供幫助，但豎琴手聯盟組織欠她一個人情。你會在費爾佐恩的荒唐事找到她哭泣，那是索恩街和薩拉巴爾街拐角處的一家酒館。快點行動！"

english: Uza (LG female human Mulan {@creature commoner}) describes the threat as a "monstrous orb of many eyes" that chased her cat, Fillipa, into the shop. The monster is, in fact, a {@creature gazer|VGM} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}). If the characters met a gazer in chapter 1, they know what they're up against. Uza lends them the keys to the front and back doors of her shop. Characters find the interior in shambles and hear a cat meowing on the third floor. The sounds are coming from the gazer, which is hunting Fillipa. The cat has so far eluded the nasty little predator. {@i Reward}: Each Harper character gains 1 renown if the gazer is defeated. Uza also gives the party a used spellbook containing four {@filter 1st-level|spells|class=wizard|level=1} and three {@filter 2nd-level|spells|class=wizard|level=2} wizard spells.
zh_tw: 烏扎（LG女性人類穆蘭人 {@creature commoner||平民}）描述威脅為一個"多眼的怪物球體"，它追趕她的貓菲莉帕進入書店。實際上，這個怪物是一隻{@creature gazer|VGM|凝視者眼魔}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）。如果角色們在第一章遇到了凝視者眼魔，他們就會知道他們面臨的是什麼。烏扎借給他們書店前後門的鑰匙。角色們發現內部一片狼藉，並聽到三樓有貓在喵喵叫。聲音來自正在追捕菲莉帕的凝視者眼魔。到目前為止，這隻貓已經成功躲避了這個討厭的小捕食者。{@i 獎勵}：如果擊敗了凝視者眼魔，每個豎琴手聯盟角色獲得1點聲望。烏扎還送給隊伍一本用過的魔法書，其中包含四個{@filter 11級或以上|spells|class=wizard|level=1}和三個{@filter 2級|spells|class=wizard|level=2}的法師法術。

english: 4th
zh_tw: 4th

english: "One of our members, Mattrim Mereg, has allied himself with a gang of doppelgangers and believes the Harpers should recruit them. We need an unbiased opinion. Track down and speak with each of the doppelgangers, and gauge their trustworthiness."
zh_tw: "我們的一名成員，馬特里姆·梅雷格，已經與一群變形怪結盟，並認為豎琴手聯盟組織應該招募他們。我們需要一個公正的意見。追蹤並與每個變形怪交談，評估他們的可信度。"

english: The characters must speak with five {@creature doppelganger||doppelgangers}, starting with their leader, "{@creature Bonnie|WDH}," who works at the Yawning Portal. She needs a few days to round up the other doppelgangers, who agree to meet at the tavern in human guises. Characters must interview each doppelganger and succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom (Insight) check to ascertain its trustworthiness. Only "{@creature Bonnie|WDH}" is trustworthy. {@i Reward}: Each Harper character gains 2 renown. Every contributing party member receives 50 gp.
zh_tw: 角色們必須與五個{@creature doppelganger||變形怪}交談，從他們的領袖"{@creature Bonnie|WDH|邦妮}"開始，她在呵欠之門工作。她需要幾天時間來召集其他化身怪，他們同意以人類的外表在酒館碰面。角色們必須分別採訪每個化身怪，並透過一個{@dc 16}的感知（洞悉）檢定來確定其可信度。只有"{@creature Bonnie|WDH|邦妮}"是可信的。{@i 獎勵}：每個豎琴手聯盟的角色獲得2點聲望。每個參與的隊員獲得50金幣。

english: 5th
zh_tw: 5th

english: "Lady {@creature Remallia Haventree|WDH} is hosting a party at House Ulbrinter, her villa on Delzorin Street, located between Vhezoar Street and Brondar's Way in the North Ward. We have reason to suspect that drow spies have infiltrated the guest list. Attend the party and root out the disguised drow. Dress sharply."
zh_tw: 「{@creature Remallia Haventree|WDH|蕾米莉亞·港樹}女士正在她的烏爾布林特別墅舉辦派對。別墅位於北區德爾佐林街，介於維佐爾街與布隆達爾路之間。我們有理由懷疑卓爾間諜已混入賓客之中。去參加派對，找出偽裝的卓爾。記得穿得體面些。」

english: {@creature Remallia Haventree|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) knows of the mission, but it's not revealed to the characters that she's a Harper. There's one drow spy in attendance: {@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}). He uses his {@item hat of disguise} to appear as a young actor from Luskan named Erystian Demarne. A successful {@dc 24} Wisdom (Insight) check is needed to out Jarlaxle. Impressed by the perceptive adventurers, he thanks Lady Haventree for an entertaining evening and dashes off, but not without first tipping his hat to the character or characters who exposed him. {@i Reward}: Each Harper character gains 2 renown. Every party member who attended the party receives 200 gp.
zh_tw: {@creature Remallia Haventree|WDH|蕾米莉亞·港樹}（參見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）知道這個任務，但角色們並不知道她是豎琴手聯盟的一員。在場的一名卓爾間諜是{@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH|賈拉索·班瑞}（參見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）。他使用{@item hat of disguise||易容帽}變身為一名來自路斯坎的年輕演員，名為埃里斯蒂安·德馬涅。需要成功的{@dc 24} 感知（洞悉）檢定才能揭穿賈拉索。他對這些敏銳的冒險者印象頗深，感謝哈文特里夫人提供了一個愉快的夜晚並迅速離開，但在離開前他會向揭穿他的角色或角色們脫帽致意。{@i 獎勵}：每個豎琴手聯盟角色獲得2點聲望。每位參加派對的隊伍成員將獲得200金幣。

english: Lords' Alliance
zh_tw: 領主聯盟

english: Characters who place the security of the city and the realm ahead of their own interests are invited to join this faction. Potential recruits must be residents of Waterdeep.
zh_tw: 將城市和王國的安全置於個人利益之上的角色被邀請加入這個派系。潛在的新成員必須是深水城的居民。

english: Jalester Silvermane
zh_tw: 加萊斯特·銀鬃

english: The characters' primary contact is {@creature Jalester Silvermane|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), a field agent who reports to Open Lord {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH}. Jalester spends much of his time in the Yawning Portal and other taverns that adventurers are known to frequent.
zh_tw: 角色們的主要聯絡人是{@creature Jalester Silvermane|WDH|加萊斯特·銀鬃}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），他是一名向公開領主{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}彙報的現場特工。加萊斯特大部分時間都在呵欠之門和其他冒險者常去的酒館裡。

english: Jalester offers membership in the Lords' Alliance to those who qualify. Members are expected to complete whatever missions are assigned to them in a timely, professional manner. Refusing to accept or complete a mission can result in suspension or dismissal. An alliance member who is suspended receives no alliance missions until the suspension ends, while dismissal from the alliance means a loss of membership and the loss of all renown in the faction.
zh_tw: 加萊斯特為符合條件的人提供加入領主聯盟的會員資格。成員們被期望以及時、專業的方式完成分配給他們的任何任務。拒絕接受或完成任務可能導致暫停或解僱。被暫停的聯盟成員在暫停期結束之前不會收到任何聯盟任務，而從聯盟中被解僱則意味著失去會員資格以及在派系中的所有聲望。

english: Party Level
zh_tw: 隊伍等級

english: Mission Brief
zh_tw: 任務簡報

english: Mission Requirements and Reward
zh_tw: 任務要求和獎勵

english: 2nd
zh_tw: 2nd

english: "A gang war is causing unrest throughout the city. We have offered protection to members of the Dungsweepers' Guild, and you have been assigned to protect a group of them. Meet them at the Muleskull Tavern, on Ship Street in the Dock Ward, at six bells and guard them while they work. Do this every day for a tenday."
zh_tw: "一場幫派戰爭正在整個城市引起不安。我們已經向清潔工公會的成員提供保護，你被指派去保護他們中的一群人。在碼頭區的船街上的騾骨酒館與他們見面，在六點鐘的鐘聲敲響時開始，並在他們工作時保護他們。連續十天每天都這樣做。"

english: Each morning, the characters meet with a team of four dungsweepers ({@creature commoner||commoners}) and head to the Trades Ward, where the sweepers spend the day cleaning up waste in the streets. It's boring work. On the ninth day, around highsun, a {@creature carrion crawler} emerges from a nearby alley, pursued by two City Watch {@creature guard||guards}. The characters can help slay the carrion crawler, which came up from the sewers. {@i Reward}: Each Lords' Alliance character gains 1 renown.
zh_tw: 每天早晨，角色們與一隊四名糞便清掃工（{@creature commoner||平民}）會面，然後前往商業區，清掃工們在這裡花一整天時間清理街道上的垃圾。這是件無聊的工作。在第九天，大約正午時分，一隻{@creature carrion crawler||食腐蟲}從附近的小巷中竄出，被兩名城市守衛（{@creature guard||警衛}）追趕。角色們可以幫助殺死這隻從下水道里爬出來的食腐獸。{@i 獎勵}：每位領主聯盟的角色獲得1點聲望。

english: 3rd
zh_tw: 3rd

english: "Harko Swornhold, an evil adventurer who was exiled three years ago for attempting to bribe a city magistrate, has returned to Waterdeep illegally. We think the Xanathar Guild is using him to incite violence. He was last seen recruiting kenku in the Dock Ward. Find him and quietly put him to the sword."
zh_tw: "哈爾科·斯溫霍爾德，一個三年前因試圖賄賂城市法官而被流放的邪惡冒險家，非法返回了深水城。我們認為姍娜薩公會正在利用他煽動暴力。他最後一次被看到是在碼頭區招募天狗。找到他，然後悄悄地將他處決。"

english: Whichever character leads the search must succeed on three {@dc 14} Intelligence (Investigation) checks before gaining three failures, with each check representing 8 hours of investigation. Other characters can assist, granting advantage on the checks. Harko ({@creature bandit captain}) has two {@creature kenku} companions that fight by his side. {@i Reward}: Each Lords' Alliance character gains 1 renown.
zh_tw: 負責搜尋的角色必須成功透過三次 {@dc 14} 智力（調查）檢定，且在獲得三次失敗前完成，每次檢定代表8小時的調查。其他角色可以協助，為檢定提供優勢。哈科（{@creature bandit captain||匪幫隊長}）有兩名 {@creature kenku||天狗}同伴與他並肩作戰。{@i 獎勵}：每位領主聯盟的角色獲得1點聲望。

english: 4th
zh_tw: 4th

english: "The Zhents are courting a Red Wizard of Thay named Esloon Bezant, trying to add his gang of thugs to their ranks. All we know about him is that he fled his homeland a few years back and is too smart to get caught doing anything illegal. He and his gang of bullies prowl the Dock Ward. Scuttle the deal, and do it fast!"
zh_tw: "散塔林會正在拉攏一個名叫埃斯盧恩·貝贊特的賽爾紅袍法師，試圖將他的暴徒團夥納入他們的行列。我們所知道的關於他的資訊是，他幾年前逃離了自己的家鄉，並且非常聰明，沒有被抓到做任何違法的事情。他和他的惡霸團夥在碼頭區遊蕩。破壞這筆交易，並且要快！"

english: The characters can create a rift between the Zhentarim and Esloon's gang by sowing rumors of betrayal. They must spend 25 gp in bribes and succeed on a {@dc 16} Charisma (Deception or Persuasion) check. Conversely, they can confront Esloon Bezant (LE male Thayan human {@creature mage}) and his gang of five {@creature thug||thugs} and either defeat them or bribe them with at least 500 gp. {@i Reward}: Each Lords' Alliance character gains 2 renown. The characters can also deprive Esloon of his spellbook, which contains all the spells he has prepared.
zh_tw: 角色們可以透過散播背叛的謠言在散塔林會和埃斯盧恩的幫派之間製造裂痕。他們必須花費25金幣進行賄賂，併成功透過一個{@dc 16}魅力（欺瞞或說服）檢定。相反地，他們也可以直接面對埃斯盧恩·貝贊特（守序邪惡男性賽爾人類{@creature mage||魔法師}）和他的五名{@creature thug||暴徒}手下，要麼擊敗他們，要麼用至少500金幣賄賂他們。{@i 獎勵}：每個領主聯盟的角色獲得2點聲望。角色們還可以剝奪埃斯盧恩的法術書，其中包含他所準備的所有法術。

english: 5th
zh_tw: 5th

english: "The City Watch is overwhelmed by the recent surge in violence and needs our help. We have reports of an assassin prowling the rooftops, picking off targets with arrows and alarming citizens. My sources say he goes to ground somewhere near Trollskull Alley. Find him, alert the City Watch to his whereabouts, and aid in his arrest if you can. Don't kill him, since doing that could escalate the violence further."
zh_tw: "城市守衛因最近暴力事件激增而應接不暇，需要我們的幫助。我們收到報告稱有一名刺客在屋頂上徘徊，用箭射殺目標，引起市民恐慌。我的線人說他藏身於巨魔顱骨巷附近的某個地方。找到他，向城市守衛通報他的位置，並儘可能幫助逮捕他。不要殺死他，因為那樣做可能會進一步加劇暴力。"

english: Whichever character leads the hunt must succeed on three {@dc 18} Intelligence (Investigation) checks before gaining three failures, with each check representing 8 hours of investigation. Other characters can assist, granting advantage on the checks. If the search succeeds, characters corner the assassin, {@creature Ziraj the Hunter|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), in the greenhouse of Corellon's Crown in Trollskull Alley ({@area T4|09f}). Ziraj surrenders to the City Watch without a fight, believing that his fellow Zhents will find a way to free him. {@i Reward}: Each Lords' Alliance character gains 2 renown. Every character who aids in Ziraj's capture receives 50 gp.
zh_tw: 無論由哪位角色領導此次追捕，都必須成功透過三次 {@dc 18} 智力（調查）檢定，且在獲得三次失敗前完成，每次檢定代表8小時的調查。其他角色可以進行協助，為檢定提供優勢。如果搜尋成功，角色們將在巨魔顱骨巷（{@area T4|09f}）的科瑞隆之冠溫室內圍堵刺客 {@creature Ziraj the Hunter|WDH|獵人茲拉吉}（參見 {@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）。茲拉吉會毫不反抗地向城市守衛投降，他相信他的同僚散塔林會成員會設法將他解救出來。{@i 獎勵}：每個領主聯盟的角色獲得2點聲望。所有協助抓捕茲拉吉的角色將獲得50金幣。

english: Order of the Gauntlet
zh_tw: 鐵手套教團

english: The Order of the Gauntlet looks for members who seek to fight evil in all its forms. Adventurers who worship Helm, Torm, or Tyr are especially sought after.
zh_tw: "鐵手套教團尋找那些尋求以各種形式對抗邪惡的成員。信仰赫爾姆、託姆或提爾的冒險家特別受歡迎。"

english: Savra Belabranta
zh_tw: 薩芙拉·貝拉布蘭塔

english: If the party includes one or more likely recruits, Savra Belabranta (NG female Tethyrian human {@creature knight}) visits the characters' residence and invites them to the Halls of Justice, the temple of Tyr (located west of the Market in the Castle Ward), where they can be sworn into the order. The swearing-in ceremony involves the recitation of an oath to find and destroy evil in all its forms. The oath is spoken while every candidate wears a silver gauntlet (a symbol of the order). After the ceremony, Savra gives new recruits their first mission.
zh_tw: 如果隊伍中有一或多個可能的招募物件，薩芙拉·貝拉布蘭塔（NG女性泰瑟爾人人類{@creature knight||騎士}）會拜訪角色們的住處，並邀請他們前往正義大廳，即提爾神廟（位於城堡區市場以西），在那裡他們可以宣誓加入騎士團。宣誓儀式包括背誦一個誓言，誓言要找到並摧毀所有形式的邪惡。每個候選人在宣誓時都會佩戴一隻銀色護手（騎士團的象徵）。儀式結束後，薩芙拉會給新招募的人員分配他們的首個任務。

english: The Belabrantas are a Waterdavian noble family that raises griffons for the Griffon Cavalry. Savra is trying to regain her honor by serving Tyr, thus atoning for the evil acts she committed as a member of an evil elemental cult called the Howling Hatred. Savra's sins are irrelevant to this adventure, but you can learn more about her past in {@adventure Princes of the Apocalypse|PotA}. Whenever she has a mission for the characters, she communicates the missive to them herself.
zh_tw: "貝拉布蘭塔家族是沃特迪普的一個貴族家族，他們為獅鷲騎兵飼養獅鷲。薩芙拉正試圖透過服務於提爾來恢復她的榮譽，從而彌補她作為一個名為'嚎叫仇恨'的邪惡元素教派成員時所犯下的惡行。薩芙拉的罪行與這次冒險無關，但你可以在《{@adventure 毀滅親王|PotA}》中瞭解更多關於她的過去。每當她有任務給角色們時，她都會親自傳達給他們。"

english: Party Level
zh_tw: 隊伍等級

english: Mission Brief
zh_tw: 任務簡報

english: Mission Requirements and Reward
zh_tw: 任務要求和獎勵

english: 2nd
zh_tw: 2nd

english: "We hear that the Zhents are paying gangs in the Field Ward to attack suspected Xanathar Guild members. Fights are breaking out in the ward daily. Stop a fight before it happens. We need to send a message to these thugs that further altercations won't be tolerated."
zh_tw: "我們聽說散塔林會成員正在支付原野區的幫派去攻擊疑似姍娜薩公會成員。該區每天都在發生打鬥。在打鬥發生前阻止一場。我們需要向這些暴徒傳達一個資訊，即進一步的衝突將不會被容忍。"

english: The characters must visit the Field Ward and, as a fight threatens to break out, make three successful {@dc 12} Charisma (Intimidation) checks before failing three checks, or else defeat four {@creature thug||thugs} (preferably without killing them) to disperse the would-be brawlers. {@i Reward}: Each Order of the Gauntlet character gains 1 renown.
zh_tw: 角色們必須前往原野區，當一場戰鬥即將爆發時，在失敗三次前成功進行三次 {@dc 12} 魅力（威嚇）檢定，或者擊敗四名 {@creature thug||暴徒}（最好不殺死他們）以驅散潛在的鬥毆者。{@i 獎勵}：每個鐵手套教團的角色獲得1點聲望。

english: 3rd
zh_tw: 3rd

english: "A notorious thief called the {@creature Black Viper|WDH}, long thought dead, has apparently returned to Waterdeep. She has already robbed at least a dozen noble estates. No one knows her identity because she wears a mask, but it was reported in The Waterdeep Wazoo that she's a noble. Find out what else the broadsheet's publisher knows about her and report back to me."
zh_tw: "一個臭名昭著的小偷，被稱為{@creature Black Viper|WDH|黑毒蛇}，長久以來都認為她已經死了，顯然已經回到了深水城。她已經至少搶劫了十幾個貴族莊園。沒有人知道她的身份，因為她戴著面具，但《深水城瓦祖報》報道稱她是一個貴族。找出該小報的出版人還知道關於她的什麼，並向我彙報。"

english: The characters can meet with Gaxly Rudderbust (N male Illuskan human {@creature commoner}), the publisher of The Waterdeep Wazoo, and either succeed on a {@dc 12} Charisma (Intimidation or Persuasion) check or bribe him with at least 50 gp. If they do so, Gaxly shares his suspicions that the {@creature Black Viper|WDH} is the secret, evil twin sister of {@creature Ammalia Cassalanter|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), and that she wears a mask to hide a disfigurement. Interviewing the Cassalanters at their villa (see chapter 6) or conducting a day-long investigation and succeeding on a {@dc 15} Intelligence (Investigation) check reveals that no such person exists. {@i Reward}: Each Order of the Gauntlet character gains 1 renown for reporting what Gaxly said.
zh_tw: 角色們可以與《深水城瓦祖》的出版商蓋克斯利·魯德巴斯特（中立男性伊路斯坎人類{@creature commoner||平民}）會面，併成功透過一次{@dc 12}的魅力（威嚇或說服）檢定，或者用至少50 gp賄賂他。如果他們這樣做，蓋克斯利會分享他的懷疑，即{@creature Black Viper|WDH|黑毒蛇}是{@creature Ammalia Cassalanter|WDH|阿瑪利亞·卡薩蘭特}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）秘密的、邪惡的雙胞胎姐妹，並且她戴著面具是為了隱藏毀容。在卡薩蘭特家族的別墅（見第6章）採訪他們，或者進行為期一天的調查併成功透過一次{@dc 15}的智力（調查）檢定，可以揭示並不存在這樣一個人。{@i 獎勵}：每個鐵手套教團角色因報告蓋克斯利所說的話而獲得1點聲望。

english: 4th
zh_tw: 4th

english: "Guards at the Endshift Tavern, located on Endshift Street in the Field Ward, are being robbed nightly, and the innkeeper says he's seen giant rats prowling around the back alleys. Sounds dull, but it's a plea for help that we can't ignore."
zh_tw: "位於原野區收工街的收工酒館的守衛每晚都遭到搶劫，店主說他看到巨大的老鼠在後巷徘徊。聽起來很無聊，但這是我們不能忽視的求助。"

english: The inn is being harassed by the Shard Shunners, a gang of halfling wererats, because the innkeeper's guards once threatened a gang member. To end the harassment, the characters must defeat three {@creature wererat||wererats} or scare them off with a successful {@dc 17} Charisma (Intimidation) check. {@i Reward}: Each Order of the Gauntlet character gains 2 renown and receives a {@item potion of healing}.
zh_tw: 這家旅館正受到"避碎幫"的騷擾，這是一個由半身人鼠人組成的幫派，因為旅館老闆的守衛曾威脅過一名幫派成員。為了結束這種騷擾，角色們必須擊敗三隻{@creature wererat||鼠人}或透過一次成功的{@dc 17}魅力（威嚇）檢定嚇跑他們。{@i 獎勵}：每位鐵手套教團角色獲得2點聲望，並收到一瓶{@item potion of healing||治療藥水}。

english: 5th
zh_tw: 5th

english: "I just received a report that spined devils are terrorizing citizens in Twelvedog Court, in the Field Ward. Come, let us slay them together and find their evil summoner!"
zh_tw: "我剛收到一份報告，說棘魔在原野區的十二狗法院恐嚇市民。來，讓我們一起殺死它們，找出那個邪惡的召喚者！"

english: The characters must help Savra defeat five {@creature spined devil||spined devils}, which have locals pinned down in nearby buildings. Right afterward, Gysheer Omfreys (LE female Tethyrian human {@creature cult fanatic}) emerges from an alley and attacks Savra. Gysheer is an overzealous member of a devil-worshiping cult led by {@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}). Savra tries to subdue and question her, but only magical compulsion can force her to implicate Victoro. Since devil worship isn't illegal in Waterdeep, Savra has no grounds to stir up trouble with the Cassalanters, and she advises characters not to do so, either. {@i Reward}: Each Order of the Gauntlet character gains 2 renown. Every character who took part receives a {@item potion of greater healing}.
zh_tw: 角色們必須幫助薩芙拉擊敗五個{@creature spined devil||棘魔}，它們使當地居民被困在附近的建築物中。緊接著，吉希爾·奧姆弗雷斯 (LE女性泰瑟爾人人類{@creature cult fanatic||邪教狂信者})從一條小巷中出現並攻擊薩芙拉。吉希爾是由{@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH|維克托羅·卡薩蘭特}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）領導的崇拜魔鬼的邪教的過於熱心的成員。薩芙拉試圖制服並審問她，但只有魔法強制才能迫使她揭露維克托羅。由於在深水城崇拜魔鬼並不違法，薩芙拉沒有理由與卡薩蘭特家族製造麻煩，她也建議角色們不要這樣做。{@i 獎勵}：每個鐵手套教團角色獲得2點聲望。每個參與的角色都會收到一瓶{@item potion of greater healing||高等治療藥水}。

english: Zhentarim
zh_tw: 散塔林會

english: The Doom Raiders try to contact evil-aligned or morally ambiguous characters. A {@creature flying snake} with a parchment tied about its body visits one character in the dead of night. The message reads:
zh_tw: 末日劫掠者試圖聯絡邪惡傾向或道德模糊的角色。一條身上綁著羊皮紙的{@creature flying snake||飛蛇}在深夜拜訪了一個角色。資訊內容如下：

english: "Want to be part of something big? Speak to {@creature Davil Starsong|WDH} at the Yawning Portal."
zh_tw: "想成為偉大事業的一部分嗎？去呵欠之門找{@creature Davil Starsong|WDH|達維爾·星歌}談談。"

english: If the characters seek out Davil, {@creature Yagra Stonefist|wdh} (see "Familiar Faces"), greets them and leads interested parties to a table in the center of the Yawning Portal's taproom, where her boss waits with drink in hand.
zh_tw: 如果角色們尋找達維爾，{@creature Yagra Stonefist|wdh|雅格拉·石拳}（見"熟悉的面孔"），她會迎接他們並帶領感興趣的人到呵欠之門酒吧中心的一張桌子，她的老闆正手持飲料在那裡等待。

english: Davil Starsong
zh_tw: 達維爾·星歌

english: {@creature Davil Starsong|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) is the characters' primary contact in the Black Network, at least initially. Over drinks, he shares the following information:
zh_tw: {@creature Davil Starsong|WDH|達維爾·星歌}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）是角色們在黑網中的主要聯絡人，至少最初是這樣。在喝酒時，他分享了以下資訊：

english: Davil is a retired adventurer. He and his adventuring companions joined the Zhentarim a few years back. They help people in need. (More specifically, they provide loans, mercenaries, and other services.)
zh_tw: 達維爾是一位退休的冒險家。他和他的冒險夥伴幾年前加入了散塔林會。他們幫助有需要的人。（更具體地說，他們提供貸款、僱傭兵和其他服務。）

english: Another Black Network gang has recently infiltrated the city and tried to take over the Xanathar Guild. They failed, setting off a war in the streets. Davil and his colleagues want to end the violence and restore the peace.
zh_tw: 另一個黑網幫派最近潛入了這座城市，並試圖接管姍娜薩公會。他們失敗了，引發了街頭的戰爭。達維爾和他的同事們想要結束暴力並恢復和平。

english: Davil offers membership in the faction to interested characters, then assigns them their first mission (see the Zhentarim Missions table). Subsequent mission briefings are written on scrolls and delivered by flying snakes.
zh_tw: 達維爾向感興趣的角色提供加入派系的會員資格，然後指派他們第一個任務（見散塔林會任務表）。隨後的任務簡報寫在卷軸上，由飛蛇送達。

english: Tashlyn Yafeera
zh_tw: 塔什琳·雅菲拉

english: After the characters complete two missions for Davil, he is arrested by the City Watch and held in Castle Waterdeep while he waits to be questioned by the Lords of Waterdeep about the Black Network's operations in the city. The characters continue to receive missions, but they come from {@creature Tashlyn Yafeera|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}). Characters first become aware of this change when they receive their next mission briefing, since it's written in a different hand.
zh_tw: 當角色們為達維爾完成兩個任務後，他被城市守衛逮捕，並在深水堡中等待深水城領主就黑網在城市的行動進行詢問。角色們繼續接收任務，但任務來自{@creature Tashlyn Yafeera|WDH|塔什琳·雅菲拉}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）。角色們首次意識到這一變化是在他們收到下一個任務簡報時，因為它是用不同的手寫的。

english: If the characters want to speak with Tashlyn directly, Yagra can arrange a meeting in the City of the Dead or some other quiet place. By the time the characters see her, Tashlyn has learned the following information:
zh_tw: 如果角色們想直接與塔什琳交談，雅格拉可以安排在亡者之城或其它安靜的地方會面。到角色們見到她的時候，塔什琳已經瞭解到以下資訊：

english: The rumored leader of the renegade Zhent faction is {@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh}, a known Black Network assassin.
zh_tw: 傳言中叛變的散塔林會派系的領袖是{@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh|厄斯圖爾·弗洛克辛}，一個已知的黑網刺客。

english: A warrant has been issued for Urstul's arrest, but his current whereabouts are unknown. Even magical scrying has failed to reveal his location.
zh_tw: 已對厄斯圖爾發出逮捕令，但他的當前下落不明。即使是魔法窺視也未能揭示他的位置。

english: The botched kidnapping of {@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh} won't sit well with Urstul. He might try again. (Tashlyn doesn't actually believe this, but she knows that Renaer has ties to the Harpers and might share information of interest with the characters.)
zh_tw: 對{@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh|瑞納爾·無燼}的綁架失敗不會讓厄斯圖爾感到滿意。他可能會再次嘗試。（塔什琳實際上並不相信這一點，但她知道瑞納爾與豎琴手聯盟有聯絡，並且可能會與角色們分享一些有趣的資訊。）

english: Weeks after his arrest, Davil is released from custody once the Lords of Waterdeep are satisfied that neither he nor his associates are responsible for the recent violence.
zh_tw: 在他被捕數週後，一旦深水城領主確信他和他的同夥對最近的暴力事件不負責任，達維爾就被釋放了。

english: Party Level
zh_tw: 隊伍等級

english: Mission Brief
zh_tw: 任務簡報

english: Mission Requirements and Reward
zh_tw: 任務要求和獎勵

english: 2nd
zh_tw: 2nd

english: "Someone is killing elf and half-elf sailors in the Dock Ward-three dead so far, each one decapitated by a blade in the dead of night. Look into it, will you? Methinks the City Watch could use a little help."
zh_tw: "有人在碼頭區殺害精靈和半精靈水手——到目前為止已經有三人死亡，每個人都是在深夜被刀片斬首的。調查一下，好嗎？我認為城市守衛可能需要一些幫助。"

english: Characters who spend three consecutive nights loitering around the docks spot Heldar, a drunk half-elf sailor ({@creature bandit}), leaving the Muleskull Tavern (on Ship Street in the Dock Ward). Characters who follow Heldar can save him from {@creature Soluun Xibrindas|wdh}, a renegade {@creature drow gunslinger|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}). Soluun hides in the shadows, blade drawn, waiting for the half-elf to stumble by. Spotting him before he strikes requires a successful {@dc 18} Wisdom (Perception) check. Soluun flees if reduced to half his hit points or fewer. {@i Reward}: Each Zhentarim character gains 1 renown. If Heldar survives Soluun's attack, each character receives 50 gp.
zh_tw: 連續三晚在碼頭附近閒逛的角色會發現一個醉醺醺的半精靈水手赫爾德（{@creature bandit||匪徒}）離開騾骨酒館（位於碼頭區的船街）。跟隨赫爾德的角色可以從叛徒索倫·希布林達斯（{@creature Soluun Xibrindas|wdh|索倫·希布林達斯}），一個叛逃的卓爾火槍手（{@creature drow gunslinger|WDH|卓爾火槍手}）手中救下他（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）。索倫藏在陰影中，拔出刀刃，等待半精靈跌跌撞撞地經過。在他發動攻擊前發現他需要成功透過一次 {@dc 18} 的感知（感知）檢定。如果索倫的生命值降至一半或更低，他會逃跑。{@i 獎勵}：每個散塔林會角色獲得1點聲望。如果赫爾德在索倫的攻擊中倖存下來，每個角色將獲得50金幣。

english: 3rd
zh_tw: 3rd

english: "There's a shop in the Trades Ward called Weirdbottle's Concoctions. The gnome who runs it is a friend of ours named Skeemo. He's made some potions of mind reading for a client. Pick up the potions and deliver them to the God Catcher, one of the enormous statues in the Castle Ward. Give the potions to the lady in the purple cloak, and keep the tip."
zh_tw: "在商業區有一家叫做奇瓶藥劑店的商店。經營這家商店的侏儒是我們的朋友，名叫斯齊莫。他為一個客戶製作了一些讀心藥水。去取藥水，然後把它們送到城堡區的"捕神者"——那些巨大的雕像之一。把藥水交給穿紫色斗篷的女士，並收下小費。"

english: {@creature Skeemo Weirdbottle|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) has placed four potions of poison in a small silk-lined coffer. The potions look, smell, and taste like potions of mind reading. Awaiting delivery near the God Catcher is Esvele Rosznar, the {@creature Black Viper|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}). She wears a hooded purple cloak and is seated in the back of a hire-coach. She exchanges the coffer for a black velvet pouch, then orders her driver to depart. The coach delivers Esvele to her estate in the Sea Ward. {@i Reward}: Each Zhentarim character gains 1 renown. Esvele's pouch contains 15 pp, which the characters can keep.
zh_tw: {@creature Skeemo Weirdbottle|WDH|斯齊莫·奇瓶}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）在一個小的絲綢襯裡的箱子裡放了四瓶毒藥。這些藥水看起來、聞起來、嚐起來都像是讀心藥水。在捕神者附近等待交付的是艾絲薇爾·羅茲納爾，{@creature Black Viper|WDH|黑毒蛇}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）。她穿著帶兜帽的紫色斗篷，坐在一輛租來的馬車裡。她用箱子交換了一個黑色天鵝絨袋子，然後命令她的司機出發。馬車將艾絲薇爾送到她在海區的莊園。{@i 獎勵}：每個散塔林會角色獲得1點聲望。艾絲薇爾的袋子裡有15枚鉑金幣，角色們可以保留。

english: 4th
zh_tw: 4th

english: "Waterdeep's richest halfling family, the Snobeedles, is offering 500 gold pieces for information leading to the safe return of a missing family member named {@creature Shard Shunner|wdh|Dasher Snobeedle}. Those dragons sure would look good in our coffers! Investigate and see what you can learn, but don't get in any trouble. The City Watch already has it out for us."
zh_tw: "深水城最富有的半身人家族，斯諾貝德爾家族，正在提供500金幣的資訊，以確保一個名叫{@creature Shard Shunner|wdh|達舍·斯諾貝德爾}的失蹤家庭成員安全歸來。那些龍幣在我們的金庫中看起來肯定不錯！調查一下，看看你能瞭解到什麼，但不要惹上任何麻煩。城市守衛已經對我們有意見了。"

english: Any character who spends at least three days asking pertinent questions and pursuing leads in the Southern Ward or the Dock Ward can, at the end of that time, make a {@dc 18} Charisma (Persuasion or Intimidation) check. On a success, the character convinces some tight-lipped halflings to arrange a meeting with Dasher. The meeting is scheduled to occur at highsun in Waymoot the next day. Dasher shows up to hear what the characters have to say, but he has no intention of going home. He recently joined a gang of halfling wererats called the Shard Shunners (so named because they detest silver) and has since become a wererat himself. The Shard Shunners are his family now. {@i Reward}: Each Zhentarim character gains 2 renown.
zh_tw: 任何角色只要在南區或碼頭區花至少三天時間提問相關問題並追查線索，便可在該段時間結束時進行一個{@dc 18}魅力（說服或威嚇）檢定。若成功，該角色將說服一些寡言的半身人安排與達舍的會面。會面安排在隔天正午的路會廣場進行。達舍會出席聽取角色要說的話，但他無意回家。他最近加入了一個名為"避碎幫"的半身人狼鼠幫派（如此命名是因為他們憎惡銀器），並因此自己變成了狼鼠。避碎幫現在已是他的家人。{@i 獎勵}：每位散塔林會角色獲得2點聲望。

english: 5th
zh_tw: 5th

english: "{@creature Skeemo Weirdbottle|WDH} has betrayed us! The little worm has been feeding information to our enemies. He must be eliminated. Make it look like an accident."
zh_tw: "{@creature Skeemo Weirdbottle|WDH|斯齊莫·奇瓶}背叛了我們！這個小蟲子一直在向我們的敵人提供資訊。他必須被消滅。讓它看起來像是一場意外。"

english: {@creature Skeemo Weirdbottle|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) manages to stay one step ahead of the characters. As they approach his shop, they see him ride off in a dray with five other passengers and a driver (all {@creature commoner||commoners}). If Skeemo realizes he's being followed, he casts fly and takes to the air. If the effect is dispelled or the characters maintain pursuit, he casts greater invisibility on himself and uses crowds to cover his escape. If the characters fail to nab him, he takes refuge in Kolat Towers (see chapter 8). {@i Reward}: Each Zhentarim character gains 2 renown if Skeemo is eliminated without implicating the Black Network. In addition, characters who snatch Skeemo's satchel find that it holds his spellbook (containing all the spells he has prepared), a {@item potion of mind reading}, and 150 gp in a silk coin purse.
zh_tw: {@creature Skeemo Weirdbottle|WDH|斯齊莫·奇瓶}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）設法比角色們領先一步。當他們接近他的商店時，他們看到他和其他五名乘客以及一名司機（都是{@creature commoner||平民}）一起乘坐貨車離開。如果斯齊莫意識到自己被跟蹤，他會施放飛行術並飛向空中。如果效果被解除或者角色們繼續追擊，他會對自己施放高等隱形術，並利用人群來掩護他的逃跑。如果角色們未能抓住他，他會在克拉特雙塔（見第8章）中尋求庇護。{@i 獎勵}：如果斯齊莫在不牽連黑網的情況下被消滅，每個散塔林會角色獲得2點聲望。此外，抓住斯齊莫的揹包的角色會發現揹包裡有他的法術書（包含他準備的所有法術）、一瓶{@item potion of mind reading||讀心藥水}，以及一個絲綢錢袋裡的150金幣。

english: Open for Business?
zh_tw: 營業中？

english: If the characters intend to fix up and reopen the tavern in Trollskull Alley, they can expect to deal with various guilds without whose support the business is likely to fail. Repairs to the walls and the roof require the approval and oversight of the Carpenters', Roofers', and Plaisterers' Guild. The Cellarers' and Plumbers' Guild is best equipped to handle the refurbishing of the basement and plumbing. Clean bedsheets are provided by the Launderers' Guild. The streets around the establishment are kept up by the Dungsweepers' Guild and the Loyal Order of Street Laborers. Meat must come from the Guild of Butchers; ale and wine from the Vintners', Distillers', and Brewers' Guild; and bread and pastries from the Bakers' Guild. The list goes on.
zh_tw: 如果角色們打算修繕並重新開放位於巨魔顱骨巷的酒館，他們可以預期需要與各種行會打交道，沒有這些行會的支援，生意很可能會失敗。牆壁和屋頂的修復需要得到木匠、屋頂工和抹灰工行會的批准和監督。地窖和管道的翻新工作最好由地窖工和管道工行會來處理。清潔的床單由洗衣工行會提供。酒館周圍的街道由掃街工會和街頭勞動者忠誠秩序維護。肉類必須來自屠夫行會；啤酒和葡萄酒來自釀酒師、蒸餾師和釀酒工行會；麵包和糕點來自麵包師行會。名單還在繼續。

english: The "Tavern Keeping Expenses" sidebar lists the costs that the characters must pay to get their place ready for business, as well as the recurring obligations they must meet while the tavern is open for business.
zh_tw: "酒館經營開支"側邊欄列出了角色們必須支付的費用，以使他們的場所準備好營業，以及酒館營業期間他們必須滿足的持續義務。

english: Sample Guild Representatives
zh_tw: 樣本行會代表

english: Once it becomes known around the city that the tavern in Trollskull Alley is planning to reopen its doors to the public, the adventurers receive visits from guild representatives interested in the tavern's welfare. This section describes a handful of these representatives.
zh_tw: 一旦城市中眾所周知，位於巨魔顱骨巷的酒館計劃重新向公眾開放，冒險家們就會收到對酒館福祉感興趣的行會代表的訪問。這一節描述了其中一些代表。

english: Broxley Fairkettle
zh_tw: 布羅克斯利·費爾凱特

english: {@i Fellowship of Innkeepers}
zh_tw: {@i 旅館老闆協會}

english: Broxley (LG male strongheart halfling {@creature commoner}) is a laid-back, law-abiding halfling with mutton chops and bushy eyebrows. Inns and taverns are few and far between in the North Ward, so he makes frequent visits to the characters' place to see how it's doing and to offer his well-wishes. If none of the characters are members of the guild, he strongly urges them to join "to avoid further harassment." The cost of membership in the Fellowship of Innkeepers is included in the regular expenses outlined in the "Tavern Keeping Expenses" sidebar.
zh_tw: 布羅克斯利（LG 男性強壯心半身人 {@creature commoner||平民}）是一個悠閒守法的半身人，留著羊排胡和濃密的眉毛。在北區，客棧和酒館很少見，所以他經常來角色們的地方看看情況，並提供他的良好祝願。如果角色們中沒有人是行會成員，他強烈敦促他們加入"以避免進一步的騷擾"。客棧老闆聯盟的會費已包含在"酒館經營費用"側邊欄中概述的常規費用裡。

english: Broxley has long believed the tavern to be haunted and is glad to see living souls in it once more. While lamenting the burdens of being a father of nine, he is quick to point out that the characters' continued compliance with guild rules and regulations makes his rather difficult life "just a bitty bit easier."
zh_tw: 布羅克斯利一直相信這家酒館鬧鬼，很高興再次看到活生生的靈魂在裡面。雖然他哀嘆作為九個孩子的父親所承受的重擔，但他很快指出，角色們持續遵守行會的規則和規章使他相當艱難的生活"稍微容易一些"。

english: Hammond Kraddoc
zh_tw: 哈蒙德·克拉多克

english: {@i Vintners', Distillers', and Brewers' Guild}
zh_tw: {@i 釀酒師、蒸餾師和啤酒釀造師公會}

english: Hammond (N male Illuskan human {@creature commoner}) doesn't like adventurers, but he likes their coin. This effete, well-dressed man is always seen in the company of a young scribe, Jinny (NG female tiefling commoner), who wears spectacles and silently records notes and conversations in a small book as Hammond speaks.
zh_tw: 哈蒙德（N男性伊路斯坎人人類{@creature commoner||平民}）不喜歡冒險家，但他喜歡他們的金幣。這個矯揉造作、衣著考究的男人總是和一個年輕的抄寫員，金妮（NG女性提夫林平民）在一起，金妮戴著眼鏡，默默地在一本小本子上記錄著哈蒙德說話時的筆記和對話。

english: Hammond likes to stop by in the middle of the month to inform the characters of new spirits that the guild has to offer, and to give them a list of which ones to push hard. To test the extent of their willingness to cooperate, he chastises them for their current selection of beverages, even if he previously sold them those goods.
zh_tw: 哈蒙德喜歡在月中時順便來告知角色們行會新推出的烈酒，並給他們一個清單，告訴他們哪些應該大力推廣。為了測試他們合作意願的程度，他批評他們目前的飲料選擇，即使他之前賣給他們的就是那些商品。

english: Justyn Rassk
zh_tw: 賈斯汀·拉斯克

english: {@i Guild of Butchers}
zh_tw: {@i 屠夫公會}

english: Dead-eyed, slack-jawed Justyn (NE male Illuskan human {@creature thug}) grew up in the toughest neighborhood in the Field Ward and has the scars to prove it. The guild doesn't pay him enough for him to afford a residence in the North Ward, and going to that part of the city fills his heart with resentment. He darkens the characters' doorstep once a month to deliver a cartload of chopped meat for the tavern's larder. Although delivery fees are covered by the guild's monthly dues, Justyn always demands some extra coin for his service. If the characters don't give him a gratuity of at least 3 gp, he says, "Maybe next time the meat will be someone you know." He lets the threat hang in the air, then departs.
zh_tw: 眼神空洞、下巴鬆弛的賈斯汀（NE 男性伊路斯坎人人類 {@creature thug||暴徒}）在原野區最艱苦的社群長大，身上的傷疤足以證明這一切。行會給他的工資不足以讓他負擔得起北區的住所，去那個城市的部分讓他心中充滿了怨恨。他每月都會來到角色們的門前，為酒館的儲藏室送來一車切好的肉。儘管送貨費用由行會的月費支付，賈斯汀總是要求一些額外的硬幣作為他的服務費。如果角色們不給他至少3金幣的小費，他就會說："也許下次肉就會是你們認識的人。"他讓這個威脅懸在空中，然後離開。

english: Ulkoria Stonemarrow
zh_tw: 烏爾科裡亞·斯通馬羅

english: {@i Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors}
zh_tw: {@i 警戒法師與護衛教團}

english: Ulkoria (NG female shield dwarf {@creature archmage}) has defended Waterdeep with her magic more times than she can recall. She's known as "the Gargoyle" because her face is frozen in a scowl that frightens adults and children alike. No one knows where she lives, but it's believed to be underground, possibly a cellar or dungeon under one of the city's oldest estates. She uses {@spell teleport} spells to enter and leave her home, and she's never seen without her {@creature shield guardian} close by.
zh_tw: 烏爾科裡亞（NG女性盾矮人{@creature archmage||大法師}）用她的魔法保衛深水城的次數多到她自己都記不清。她被稱為"石像鬼"，因為她的臉上總是帶著一種讓成人和孩子都感到害怕的怒容。沒有人知道她住在哪裡，但人們相信她住在地下，可能是城市最古老莊園之一下面的地窖或地牢。她使用{@spell teleport||傳送術}法術進出她的家，而且總是有她的{@creature shield guardian||構裝盾衛}在她身邊。

english: A little-known fact is that Ulkoria once owned the tavern in Trollskull Alley. She sold it to a family of shield dwarves, who fell on hard times and sold it to a woman who made it into an orphanage. "Turned out to be a hag who was cooking and eating the children," Ulkoria recalls. The estate passed through several more hands in the years that followed. Ulkoria hopes the new owners make something good of it.
zh_tw: 鮮為人知的事實是，烏爾科裡亞曾經擁有過巨魔顱骨巷的酒館。她把它賣給了一個盾矮人家庭，這個家庭後來遭遇了困難，又把它賣給了一個把酒館變成了孤兒院的女人。"結果證明那是個巫婆，她煮孩子還吃他們，"烏爾科裡亞回憶道。在隨後的歲月裡，這個房產又經過了幾次轉手。烏爾科裡亞希望新的所有者能好好利用它。

english: Anytime she passes through the North Ward, Ulkoria stops by the tavern for a drink and to check out the place while her shield guardian waits outside. If she doesn't like what the characters have done with the establishment, she keeps her criticisms to herself. The characters can hire her to cast {@spell glyph of warding||glyphs of warding} on the place, for which she charges 300 gp apiece.
zh_tw: 無論何時烏爾科裡亞穿過北區，她都會在酒館停下來喝一杯，並檢查這個地方，而她的盾牌守衛則在外面等候。如果她不喜歡角色們對這個地方的打理，她會保留自己的批評。角色們可以僱傭她在這個場所施展{@spell glyph of warding||守衛刻文}，她每個收費300金幣。

english: Tavern Keeping Expenses
zh_tw: 酒館經營費用

english: This sidebar summarizes the one-time payments and continuing expenses associated with running the tavern in Trollskull Alley, as well as providing rules for determining how much coin the business makes or loses.
zh_tw: 這個側邊欄總結了與經營巨魔顱骨巷中的酒館相關的一次性支付和持續費用，同時提供了規則以確定該業務賺取或損失多少硬幣。

english: One-Time Expenses
zh_tw: 一次性費用

english: 1,000 gp to renovate the tavern over 12 days
zh_tw: 1000金幣用於在12天內翻新酒館

english: 250 gp for guild licenses and contracts (paid up front)
zh_tw: 250金幣用於行會執照和合同（預付）

english: Regular Expenses
zh_tw: 定期費用

english: 50 gp per tenday for maintenance and wages of hirelings
zh_tw: 每10天50金幣用於維護和僱傭勞工的工資

english: 10 gp per tenday for all other guild expenses
zh_tw: 每10天10金幣用於所有其他行會費用

english: Profit or Loss
zh_tw: 盈餘或虧損

english: At the end of every tenday, roll a {@dice d100 + 10} and consult the Running a Business table in chapter 6 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|dmg} to determine whether the tavern lost money or earned profit. If the characters spent coin on promoting their business during that tenday, add 1 to the roll for each 1 gp they spent. If the characters have unpaid expenses, subtract 1 from the roll for each 1 gp they owe.
zh_tw: 在每個十天的結束時，擲一次{@dice d100 + 10}並參考{@book 城主指南|dmg}第6章中的"經營業務"表格來確定酒館是虧損還是盈利。如果角色在這十天內花費金幣來推廣業務，每花費1 gp，擲骰結果加1。如果角色有未支付的費用，每欠1 gp，擲骰結果減1。

english: Running Trollskull Manor
zh_tw: 運營巨魔顱骨莊園

english: {@dice d100 + #$prompt_number:title=Enter a Modifier,default=10$#}
zh_tw: {@dice d100 + #$prompt_number:title=Enter a Modifier,default=10$#}

english: Result
zh_tw: 結果

english: You made a loss of 90 gp this tenday
zh_tw: 這個10天你虧損了90金幣

english: You made a loss of 60 gp this tenday
zh_tw: 這個10天你虧損了60金幣

english: You made a loss of 30 gp this tenday
zh_tw: 這個10天你虧損了30金幣

english: You broke even this tenday
zh_tw: 這個10天你收支平衡

english: You covered your business costs and earned a profit of {@dice 1d6 × 5} gp.
zh_tw: 你支付了業務成本並賺取了{@dice 1d6 × 5}金幣的利潤。

english: You covered your business costs and earned a profit of {@dice 2d8 × 5} gp.
zh_tw: 你支付了業務成本並賺取了{@dice 2d8 × 5}金幣的利潤。

english: You covered your business costs and earned a profit of {@dice 3d10 × 5} gp.
zh_tw: 你支付了業務成本並賺取了{@dice 3d10 × 5}金幣的利潤。

english: Business Rival: Emmek Frewn
zh_tw: 商業競爭對手：埃梅克·弗倫

english: {@creature Emmek Frewn|WDH}, a salty northerner (NE male Illuskan {@creature commoner}), recently tried to buy the tavern in Trollskull Alley but was outbid by Volothamp Geddarm. Stung by the loss, he bought a smaller, less impressive building in the same alley and turned it into a pub, which he calls Frewn's Brews. If you decide to introduce Emmek as a business rival, choose an unmarked building on map 2.1 to serve as the pub.
zh_tw: {@creature Emmek Frewn|WDH|埃梅克·弗倫}，一個粗魯的北方人（NE 男性伊路斯坎人 {@creature commoner||平民}），最近試圖購買巨魔顱骨巷的酒館，但被瓦羅贊普·格達姆出價更高而敗北。由於這次失利，他在同一條巷子裡買了一個更小、不那麼引人注目的建築，並將其改造成了一個酒吧，他稱之為弗倫釀坊。如果你決定將埃梅克介紹為商業競爭對手，選擇地圖2.1上一個未標記的建築作為酒吧。

english: Emmek's family migrated to Waterdeep after its holdings in Neverwinter were destroyed by the eruption of Mount Hotenow in 1451 DR. The family struggled to make ends meet by tanning leather in the Trades Ward. After Emmek's parents died, his sisters took over the business and bought him out. He never liked the work anyway, and he particularly hated dealing with the League of Skinners and Tanners.
zh_tw: 埃梅克的家族在1451 DR年霍特諾火山爆發摧毀了他們在無冬城的財產後遷往深水城。家族透過在商業區鞣製皮革勉強維持生計。埃梅克的父母去世後，他的姐妹們接管了生意並將他買斷了。他本來就不喜歡這項工作，尤其是討厭與剝皮工和鞣革工聯盟打交道。

english: Emmek is on shaky financial footing because he has sunk most of his wealth into this latest endeavor. He's also in trouble with two of the guilds. First, he tried to save coin by fixing the roof himself, in defiance of the Carpenters', Roofers', and Plaisterers' Guild. Then he offended a member of the Cellarers' and Plumbers' Guild by comparing the dwarf's beard to barnacles on a ship.
zh_tw: 埃梅克的財務狀況不穩定，因為他已經將大部分財富投入到了最新的事業中。他還與兩個公會產生了麻煩。首先，他試圖透過自己修理屋頂來節省金錢，這違背了木工、屋頂工和灰泥工公會的規定。然後，他透過將一個矮人的鬍鬚比作船上的藤壺，冒犯了酒窖和管道工公會的一名成員。

english: Goals
zh_tw: 目標

english: Emmek wants his pub to be the most successful tavern in the North Ward, and he wants the characters' business to fail spectacularly.
zh_tw: 埃梅克希望他的酒吧成為北區最成功的酒館，並希望角色們的生意徹底失敗。

english: Assets
zh_tw: 資產

english: Emmek is stingy when it comes to certain kinds of expenses and foolish with his coin in other ways. He tends to spend a lot on big, showy items and cut corners on the little amenities. Because he doesn't have much coin to throw around right now, his plan to ruin the characters' establishment begins with borrowing some money.
zh_tw: 埃梅克在某些型別的開支上非常吝嗇，而在其他方面則揮霍無度。他傾向於在大型顯眼的物品上花費很多，在小便利設施上則偷工減料。由於他現在沒有太多錢可以揮霍，他破壞角色們生意的計劃始於借款。

english: Plans
zh_tw: 計劃

english: Emmek secures a 150 gp loan from {@creature Istrid Horn|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}). He spends 50 gp for the services of the Shard Shunners, a gang of halfling wererats with which he has had nefarious dealings in the past. He pays the halflings to hinder the characters' efforts while he works feverishly to manage his own business.
zh_tw: 埃梅克從{@creature Istrid Horn|WDH|伊思崔德·霍恩}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）那裡獲得了150金幣的貸款。他花費50金幣僱傭了避碎幫，這是一群他過去曾有過不正當交易的半身人鼠人幫派。他付錢給這些半身人以阻礙角色們的努力，而他則瘋狂地管理自己的生意。

english: Four gang members have been assigned to work with Emmek: two males named {@creature Shard Shunner|wdh|Kelso Fiddlewick} and {@creature Shard Shunner|wdh|Dasher Snobeedle}, and two females named {@creature Shard Shunner|wdh|Danika Fiddlewick} (Kelso's younger sister) and {@creature Shard Shunner|wdh|Brynn Hilltopple}. These halflings are {@creature wererat||wererats}, with these changes:
zh_tw: 四名幫派成員被指派與埃梅克合作：兩個男性分別名為{@creature Shard Shunner|wdh|凱爾索·菲德爾維克}和{@creature Shard Shunner|wdh|達舍·斯諾貝德爾}，以及兩個女性分別名為{@creature Shard Shunner|wdh|達尼卡·菲德爾威克}（凱爾索的妹妹）和{@creature Shard Shunner|wdh|布琳·希爾託普爾}。這些半身人是{@creature wererat||鼠人}，有以下變化：

english: Each wererat is Small and has 27 ({@dice 6d6 + 6}) hit points.
zh_tw: 每隻鼠人都是小型生物，擁有 27 ({@dice 6d6 + 6}) 點生命值。

english: It has these racial traits: It can move through the space of a Medium or larger creature. It has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition frightened}. It speaks Common and Halfling, and it knows thieves' cant.
zh_tw: 它具有以下種族特性：它可以穿過中型或更大生物的空間。它在豁免檢定中對抗{@condition frightened||恐懼}時具有優勢。它會說通用語和半身人語，並且它懂得盜賊密語。

english: Emmek's strategy for ruining the competition and the consequences for putting it into action are summarized in the table below.
zh_tw: 埃梅克破壞競爭對手的策略以及實施該策略的後果在下面的表格中進行了總結。

english: Emmek's Plans
zh_tw: 埃梅克的計劃

english: Element
zh_tw: 元素

english: Description
zh_tw: 描述

english: Event
zh_tw: 事件

english: The wererats scope out the characters' tavern in halfling forms and might try to get jobs there.
zh_tw: 這些鼠人在半身人形態下偵查角色們的酒館，並可能嘗試在那裡找工作。

english: Event
zh_tw: 事件

english: The wererats plant morsels of food inside the characters' place and bore tiny holes in the outside walls to attract rats, creating an infestation.
zh_tw: 狼鼠人在角色們的住處內部放置食物碎屑，並在外牆鑽小洞以吸引老鼠，造成鼠患。

english: Action
zh_tw: 動作

english: Emmek spreads rumors that the characters' tavern is rat-infested, which is why he didn't buy it. Apply a -10 penalty on the next three rolls characters make on the Running a Business table (see "Tavern Keeping Expenses," page 41).
zh_tw: 埃梅克散佈謠言說角色們的酒館有老鼠出沒，這就是他沒有購買它的原因。在接下來的三次商業運營檢定時，對角色們在"運營酒館"表格（見"酒館經營費用"，第41頁）上的擲骰結果施加-10的懲罰。

english: Event
zh_tw: 事件

english: The Shard Shunners claim they've done enough for their coin and demand more.
zh_tw: 避碎幫聲稱他們已經做得夠多了，要求更多的金幣。

english: Action
zh_tw: 動作

english: Emmek pays the wererats another 50 gp to creep around the characters' tavern at night in hybrid and rat form, carve rat faces into the doors of neighbors, and otherwise draw attention to themselves.
zh_tw: 埃梅克再付給鼠人50金幣，讓他們在夜間以混合形態和老鼠形態在角色們的酒館周圍潛行，在鄰居的門上刻老鼠臉，並以其他方式吸引注意力。

english: Action
zh_tw: 動作

english: Emmek convinces several local residents to sign a letter he has drafted, then dispatches it to the City Watch. The letter accuses the characters of running a front for a guild of wererat thieves and urges the Watch to close their establishment.
zh_tw: 埃梅克說服了幾名當地居民簽署他起草的一封信，然後將信傳送給城市守衛。信中指控角色們為狼鼠人盜賊公會經營掩護，並敦促守衛關閉他們的據點。

english: Level Advancement
zh_tw: 等級提升

english: In this section of the adventure, the characters should advance to 3rd level by engaging in faction missions, dealing with {@creature Emmek Frewn|WDH}, or partaking in self-directed activities. This period of time represents an opportunity for the characters to make friends and gain a reputation (for good or ill) in Trollskull Alley-and in Waterdeep itself-before the events of chapter 3 embroil them in a greater plot.
zh_tw: 在這個冒險部分中，角色們應該透過參與派系任務、處理{@creature Emmek Frewn|WDH|埃梅克·弗倫}，或參與自我指導的活動來提升到3級。這段時間是角色們在巨魔顱骨巷——乃至整個深水城——結交朋友和獲得聲譽（好或壞）的機會，然後第三章的事件將他們捲入一個更大的陰謀中。

english: Chapter 3: Fireball
zh_tw: 第3章：火球

english: Residents of Trollskull Alley are shaken by a loud whoosh, rattling windows, and the screams of city folk. A {@spell fireball} spell has just detonated in the street, and the neighborhood is thrown into chaos. As members of the City Guard, the City Watch, and the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors rush to the scene, the characters are afforded a chance to assess the damage and investigate further. This incident sets into motion the main plot and puts the characters on a collision course with those who want to find and claim Lord Neverember's hidden cache of gold.
zh_tw: 巨魔顱骨巷的居民被巨響、震動的窗戶與市民的尖叫聲驚醒。街上剛剛發生了{@spell fireball||火球術}法術的爆炸，整個街坊陷入混亂。城市守衛、城防軍以及警戒法師與護衛教團的成員趕赴現場時，角色們有機會檢視損害並深入調查。這起事件啟動了主要情節，使角色們與企圖找出並奪取無燼領主所藏黃金的人發生衝突。

english: The fireball goes off early in the morning, at a time when all the characters are in Trollskull Manor. Read aloud the following text to set the scene:
zh_tw: 火球在清晨早些時候爆炸，那時所有角色都在巨魔顱骨莊園內。請大聲朗讀以下文字以設定場景：

english: Windows rattle as the roar of an explosion fills Trollskull Alley. Charred bodies and anguished screams fly through the air. A thick cloud of acrid smoke billows outward from the blast, which seems to have occurred right outside your door.
zh_tw: 隨著一聲爆炸的巨響震動了巨魔顱骨巷，窗戶嘎嘎作響。燒焦的屍體和痛苦的尖叫聲在空中飛過。從爆炸中冒出的濃密刺鼻的煙霧向外翻滾，爆炸似乎就發生在你的門外。

english: Let the players tell you what their characters are doing at this moment and how they react to the explosion. Those who want to guess the nature of the explosion can, with a successful {@dc 13} Intelligence (Arcana) check, conclude that someone just cast a {@spell fireball} spell outside.
zh_tw: 讓玩家告訴你他們的角色在此時正在做什麼，以及他們如何應對這次爆炸。那些想要猜測爆炸性質的人，可以透過一個成功的 {@dc 13} 智力（奧術）檢定，得出結論：有人剛剛在外面施放了一個 {@spell fireball||火球術} 法術。

english: What's Happening Here?
zh_tw: 這裡發生了什麼？

english: Dalakhar, a rock gnome spy working for Lord Dagult Neverember, was on his way to see the characters when the fireball went off, killing him and ten other people. The gnome is important because he was carrying the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix A|WDH|11})-the key to finding Lord Neverember's hidden cache of gold. Hounded by agents of the Zhentarim, the Xanathar Guild, and Bregan D'aerthe, Dalakhar was unable to escape from Waterdeep with the artifact, so he planned to entrust it to the characters briefly, for surely the folk who rescued Lord Neverember's son could keep it safe where he could not.
zh_tw: 達拉卡爾，一個為達格魯特·無燼勳爵工作的岩石侏儒間諜，在前往拜訪角色們的途中遭遇了火球爆炸，導致他和其他十人喪生。這個侏儒很重要，因為他攜帶著{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}（見{@adventure 附錄A|WDH|11}）——找到無燼勳爵隱藏的金幣儲藏處的關鍵。由於受到散塔林會代理、姍娜薩公會和布雷甘·達耶的追捕，達拉卡爾無法帶著這件神器逃離深水城，所以他計劃暫時將其託付給角色們，因為他相信那些曾經救出無燼勳爵兒子的人肯定能在他無法做到的地方保護好它。

english: By the time the events of this chapter have played out, the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} has changed hands a few times and the characters have learned more about the big picture-though they still have a long chase ahead of them.
zh_tw: 到了這一章的事件發展到尾聲時，{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}已經幾次易手，角色們也對大局有了更多的瞭解——儘管他們仍然面臨著漫長的追逐。

english: Zhents Caught in the Act
zh_tw: 現場被捕的散塔林會成員

english: Three members of the Black Network, including the Zhent assassin {@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), were close to nabbing Dalakhar when they were caught in the blast. Of the three, only Urstul survived. Though he was wounded, he was able to pluck the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} from Dalakhar's pocket before fleeing the scene. While other survivors were coming to their senses, Urstul stumbled through the smoke and haze and eventually made his way back to Gralhund Villa a short distance away.
zh_tw: 黑網的三名成員，包括散塔林會刺客{@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh|厄斯圖爾·弗洛克辛}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），在即將抓住達拉卡爾時被爆炸波及。三人中，只有厄斯圖爾倖存。儘管他受傷了，但他還是能夠在逃離現場之前從達拉卡爾的口袋裡取出{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}。當其他生還者開始恢復意識時，厄斯圖爾跌跌撞撞地穿過煙霧，最終回到了不遠處的格勞洪德別墅。

english: House Gralhund
zh_tw: 格勞洪德家族

english: The heads of the Gralhund noble family, {@creature Yalah Gralhund|wdh} and her husband, {@creature Orond Gralhund|wdh|Orond}, are providing coin and shelter to Urstul and his fellow Zhents in exchange for the promise of getting their fair share of the hidden cache of gold. But the Gralhunds aren't willing to put their trust entirely in the Black Network; they sent out their own agent to shadow the Zhents, eliminate Dalakhar, and obtain the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} on their behalf. Yalah gave the would-be assassin a {@item necklace of fireballs} with instructions on how and when to use it. When it seemed as though Dalakhar might give {@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh} the slip, this agent hurled one of the beads from the necklace to stop the gnome in his tracks.
zh_tw: 格勞洪德貴族家族的首領，{@creature Yalah Gralhund|wdh|雅拉·格勞洪德}和她的丈夫，{@creature Orond Gralhund|wdh|奧隆德}，正在為厄斯圖爾和他的散塔林會同夥提供金錢和庇護，作為交換，他們承諾將獲得隱藏的金幣儲藏中的公平份額。但是格勞洪德家族並不願意完全信任黑網；他們派出了自己的特工去跟蹤散塔林會成員，消除達拉卡爾，並代表他們獲得{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}。雅拉給這位本該成為刺客的人一條{@item necklace of fireballs||火球項鍊}，並指示了如何以及何時使用它。當達拉卡爾似乎可能會從{@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh|厄斯圖爾·弗洛克辛}手中溜走時，這位特工投擲了項鍊上的一顆珠子來阻止侏儒的行動。

english: The Gralhunds' assassin is a {@creature nimblewright|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) that escaped from the House of Inspired Hands, the temple of Gond in the Sea Ward, a month ago. The construct hitched a ride on House Gralhund's coach. {@creature Yalah Gralhund|WDH} befriended it, offered it shelter, and used it as a servant until she and her husband found a more sinister use for it.
zh_tw: 格勞洪德家族的刺客是一個{@creature nimblewright|wdh|秘偶}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），它一個月前從位於海區的貢德神廟——巧手之屋逃脫。這個構裝生物搭了格勞洪德家族馬車的便車。{@creature Yalah Gralhund|WDH|雅拉·格勞洪德}與它成為朋友，為它提供庇護，並將其作為僕人使用，直到她和她的丈夫為它找到了一個更加陰險的用途。

english: The incident with the fireball has strained the alliance between the Gralhunds and the Black Network. {@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh} is refusing to hand over the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} until he speaks to his secret master, {@creature Manshoon|WDH}. Meanwhile, the Gralhunds are weighing the risks of betraying and murdering Urstul in their own house. If the characters' investigation goes well, they'll blunder into this den of snakes before the chapter is done.
zh_tw: 火球事件已經使格勞洪德家族和黑網之間的聯盟關係變得緊張。{@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh|厄斯圖爾·弗洛克辛}拒絕交出{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，直到他與他的秘密主人{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}交談。與此同時，格勞洪德家族正在權衡背叛和在自己的家中謀殺厄斯圖爾的風險。如果角色們的調查進展順利，他們將在本章結束之前無意中闖入這個蛇窩。

english: Unraveling the Plot
zh_tw: 解開陰謀

english: During their investigation, the characters should learn who or what cast the {@spell fireball} (a {@creature nimblewright|wdh}), why the attack was committed (to steal the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}), and where the stone was taken (Gralhund Villa). If the investigation stalls, friendly NPCs might step forward to help in exchange for compensation. One such figure is {@creature Vincent Trench|WDH}, the private detective, who lives in Trollskull Alley (see chapter 2, {@area T5|0a1}). The characters can also consult with friendly factions such as the Harpers.
zh_tw: 在他們的調查中，角色們應該瞭解到是誰或者是什麼施放了{@spell fireball||火球術}法術（一個{@creature nimblewright|wdh|秘偶}），為什麼發起這次襲擊（為了偷取{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}），以及這塊石頭被帶到了哪裡（格勞洪德別墅）。如果調查陷入僵局，友好的NPC可能會主動提供幫助，以換取報酬。其中一位這樣的人物是{@creature Vincent Trench|WDH|文森特·特倫奇}，這位私家偵探，住在巨魔顱骨巷（見第2章，{@area T5|0a1}）。角色們也可以諮詢像豎琴手聯盟組織這樣的友好派系。

english: The Crime Scene
zh_tw: 犯罪現場

english: In the wake of the explosion, people emerge from their houses and shops to survey the devastation. The fireball didn't set any buildings ablaze, but it left eleven people dead:
zh_tw: 爆炸之後，人們從他們的房屋和商店中走出來，檢視破壞情況。火球沒有點燃任何建築物，但它造成了11人死亡：

english: One elderly female human who was out for a walk (no one recognizes her)
zh_tw: 一位出去散步的老年女性（沒有人認出她）

english: Two cloaked male humans (Zhentarim sellswords) clad in leather armor with sheathed longswords
zh_tw: 兩個披著斗篷的男性人類（散塔林會僱傭兵），穿著皮甲，腰間佩著長劍

english: Two female humans and one male half-elf dressed in plain clothes (servants of wealthy North Ward families, killed while running errands)
zh_tw: 兩名女性人類和一個男性半精靈，穿著普通衣服（北區富裕家庭的僕人，在跑腿時被殺）

english: One male gnome (Dalakhar) wearing a burned cloak and clutching a dagger
zh_tw: 一個男性侏儒（達拉卡爾），身穿燒焦的斗篷，緊握著一把匕首

english: Two female halflings who were playing a flute and a fiddle, and two male halflings who were dancing
zh_tw: 兩個正在演奏長笛和小提琴的女性半身人，以及兩個正在跳舞的男性半身人

english: The characters have only a few minutes to search the crime scene before members of the City Guard arrive. After that, they aren't allowed anywhere near the bodies, although {@condition invisible} and similarly hidden characters can search the crime scene further. A search of the bodies accompanied by a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check reveals the following:
zh_tw: 在城防軍到達之前，角色們只有幾分鐘的時間來搜查犯罪現場。之後，他們不允許靠近屍體，儘管{@condition invisible||隱形}和類似隱藏的角色可以進一步搜查犯罪現場。伴隨成功的{@dc 15} 感知 (感知) 檢定搜查屍體會發現以下內容：

english: One of the dead male humans has a black, winged snake (the symbol of the Black Network) tattooed on his right forearm.
zh_tw: 其中一個死去的男性人類右前臂上有一個黑色的、有翅膀的蛇（黑網的標誌）紋身。

english: The dead gnome has dry waste on his boots and cloak, suggesting he has spent time in the sewers recently. He also has a pouch containing five 100 gp gemstones.
zh_tw: 死去的侏儒的靴子和斗篷上沾有乾燥的廢物，這表明他最近曾在下水道中待過。他的身上還有一個袋子，裡面裝有五顆價值100金幣的寶石。

english: A character can try to snatch Dalakhar's pouch without being seen by NPC onlookers, doing so with a successful {@dc 13} Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check. On a failed check, the character still acquires the pouch, but someone observes the theft and reports it to City Watch constables once they show up (see "The Watch Arrives" below). This witness to the theft can be silenced with a bribe of 50 gp or more.
zh_tw: 一個角色可以嘗試在不被NPC旁觀者發現的情況下搶奪達拉卡爾的袋子，這需要透過一個成功的{@dc 13}敏捷（巧手）檢定。如果檢定失敗，角色仍然能獲得袋子，但有人會觀察到這一偷竊行為並在城市守衛出現時報告給他們（見下文"守衛到來"）。這名偷竊的目擊者可以透過賄賂50金幣或更多來使其保持沉默。

english: After the Blast
zh_tw: 爆炸之後

english: The characters have a few minutes to examine the crime scene before the City Guard arrives and cordons off Trollskull Alley, posting six {@creature guard||guards} at each entrance. The guards don't allow anyone in or out without permission from a superior officer. Another six {@creature guard||guards}, including a {@creature sergeant|WDH} with 18 hit points, make their way to the crime scene and watch over the dead bodies until the City Watch arrives. Lingering smoke from the fireball also attracts a {@creature Griffon Cavalry rider|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}). As its {@creature griffon} mount circles the neighborhood, the rider watches the streets and alleys for suspicious figures.
