zh_tw: 在城市守衛到達並封鎖巨魔顱骨巷，每個入口處部署六名{@creature guard||警衛}之前，角色們有幾分鐘時間檢查犯罪現場。守衛們不允許任何人進出，除非得到上級軍官的許可。另外六名{@creature guard||警衛}，包括一名有18生命值的{@creature sergeant|WDH|軍士}，前往犯罪現場，並守護屍體直到城市守衛到達。火球爆炸後殘留的煙霧還吸引了一名{@creature Griffon Cavalry rider|WDH|獅鷲騎兵騎手}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）。當它的{@creature griffon||獅鷲}坐騎在附近盤旋時，騎兵監視著街道和小巷中可疑的人物。

english: The Watch Arrives
zh_tw: 守衛到來

english: Saeth and Barnibus
zh_tw: 薩斯和巴尼布斯

english: Twenty minutes after the explosion, a City Watch {@creature sergeant|WDH} named {@creature Saeth Cromley|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) escorts a member of the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors named {@creature Barnibus Blastwind|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) to the crime scene. Barnibus quietly takes charge of the investigation at that point, while {@creature Sergeant|WDH} Cromley directs a force of twenty constables ({@creature veteran||veterans}) to knock on doors and question locals.
zh_tw: 爆炸發生20分鐘後，一名名叫{@creature sergeant|WDH|軍士}的城市守衛{@creature Saeth Cromley|wdh|薩斯·克姆利}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）護送一名來自警戒法師與護衛教團的成員，名叫{@creature Barnibus Blastwind|WDH|巴尼布斯·陣風}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）前往犯罪現場。從那時起，巴尼布斯默默地接管了調查工作，而{@creature Sergeant|WDH|軍士}克姆利指揮著一支由20名警察（{@creature veteran||老兵}）組成的隊伍，敲門詢問當地居民。

english: Before allowing the corpses to be removed and taken to local temples, Barnibus inspects the scene closely and reaches the following conclusions, which he prefers to keep to himself but might share with other members of the Watchful Order:
zh_tw: 在允許將屍體移走並送往當地神廟之前，巴尼布斯仔細檢查了現場，並得出了以下結論，他更願意保留這些資訊，但可能會與警覺秩序的其他成員分享：

english: The gnome was running from armed pursuers, of which there were three. The third person who was chasing the gnome isn't among the dead.
zh_tw: 這個侏儒正在從三個武裝追擊者那裡逃跑。追趕侏儒的第三個人不在死者之中。

english: The gnome and his pursuers were moving toward the tavern in Trollskull Alley (which Barnibus will soon come to realize is the characters' property).
zh_tw: 這個侏儒和他的追擊者正朝著巨魔顱骨巷的酒館移動（巴尼布斯很快就會意識到這是角色們的財產）。

english: Neither the gnome nor his pursuers saw the blast coming.
zh_tw: 侏儒和他的追擊者都沒有預見到爆炸的發生。

english: Given these findings, Barnibus decides to question the tavern's owners and occupants, with {@creature Sergeant|WDH} Cromley by his side as a witness and bodyguard. Specifically, Barnibus wants to find out the gnome's identity and whether he was known to anyone. The characters, having never met Dalakhar, have little information to offer unless they decide to lie.
zh_tw: 鑑於這些發現，巴尼布斯決定詢問酒館的所有者和居住者，{@creature Sergeant|WDH|軍士}克姆利作為見證人和保鏢在他身邊。具體來說，巴尼布斯想要弄清楚侏儒的身份以及是否有人認識他。角色們從未見過達拉卡爾，除非他們決定撒謊，否則他們提供的資訊很少。

english: Neither Barnibus nor {@creature Sergeant|WDH} Cromley is quick to jump to conclusions. They both prefer to have ironclad evidence and testimony from reliable witnesses before making any arrests. Even though the characters are suspects by virtue of their proximity to the crime scene, it hardly seems plausible that they would unleash destructive magic so close to their place of business in broad daylight. Consequently, Barnibus intends not to take up too much of their time.
zh_tw: 巴尼布斯和{@creature Sergeant|WDH|軍士}克姆利都不會急於下結論。他們倆都更傾向於在採取任何逮捕行動之前，擁有確鑿的證據和可靠證人的證詞。儘管由於角色們靠近犯罪現場而成為嫌疑人，但他們在光天化日之下如此接近自己的營業場所釋放破壞性魔法，似乎也不太可能。因此，巴尼布斯並不打算佔用他們太多時間。

english: Barnibus and {@creature Sergeant|WDH} Cromley refuse requests by characters to join the investigation. "That would introduce too many new variables into an already confounding equation," replies Barnibus with a frown. "Trust in the Watch," Cromley adds dismissively. Characters who seem truthful and honest can press Barnibus for further information by making a {@dc 15} Charisma (Persuasion) check. On a success, they nudge Barnibus into revealing what he has discovered, as outlined above.
zh_tw: 巴尼布斯和{@creature Sergeant|WDH|軍士}克姆利拒絕了角色們加入調查的請求。"那會給已經複雜的局勢引入太多新變數，"巴尼布斯皺著眉頭回答。"相信守衛隊，"克姆利不屑地補充道。那些看起來誠實可信的角色可以透過進行一次{@dc 15}魅力（說服）檢定來逼迫巴尼布斯透露更多資訊。成功時，他們會促使巴尼布斯揭示他已經發現的資訊，如上所述。

english: Eyewitnesses
zh_tw: 目擊者

english: Many other people witnessed the fireball without being caught in the blast. Three of them have important information to share. Any character who spends at least 1 minute talking to one of them learns what that person saw or heard. (No ability checks are required, since the eyewitnesses are eager to talk.)
zh_tw: 許多其他人目擊了火球爆炸，但沒有被爆炸波及。其中三人有重要資訊要分享。任何至少花1分鐘與他們交談的角色都會瞭解到那個人看到或聽到的事情。（不需要進行屬性檢定，因為目擊者們急於交談。）

english: Fala Lefaliir
zh_tw: 法拉·勒法利爾

english: {@creature Fala Lefaliir|wdh|Fala}, the owner of Corellon's Crown (see chapter 2, {@area T4|09f}), relates the following information:
zh_tw: {@creature Fala Lefaliir|wdh|法拉}，科瑞隆之冠（見第2章，{@area T4|09f}）的所有者，提供了以下資訊：

english: "I was watering plants in the greenhouse on the second floor of my shop when the blast blew out some of the windows. Lucky I wasn't injured! Through the smoke, I saw a cloaked man take something from the body of a dead gnome, then start limping away. He was badly burned and casting glances over his shoulder, like he was afraid someone might be following him. He was headed toward the Bent Nail."
zh_tw: "我在我店二樓的溫室裡給植物澆水時，爆炸震碎了一些窗戶。幸運的是我沒有受傷！透過煙霧，我看到一個披著斗篷的男人從一個死去的侏儒身上拿走了什麼東西，然後開始一瘸一拐地離開。他嚴重燒傷，還不時回頭看，好像擔心有人跟蹤他。他朝彎釘方向去了。"

english: Fala saw {@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh} fleeing the scene with the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} in his clutches. He circled around the Bent Nail (see chapter 2, {@area T2|09b}) on his way out of Trollskull Alley.
zh_tw: 法拉看到{@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh|厄斯圖爾·弗洛克辛}帶著{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}逃離現場。他在離開巨魔顱骨巷時繞過了彎釘（見第2章，{@area T2|09b}）。

english: Jezrynne Hornraven
zh_tw: 傑茲琳·霍恩瑞文

english: A Waterdavian born of wealth and privilege, Jezrynne was leaving the Tiger's Eye (see chapter 2, {@area T5|0a1}), having just hired {@creature Vincent Trench|WDH} to spy on her philandering husband, when she witnessed the following:
zh_tw: 一個生於富裕和特權家庭的水深人，傑茲琳剛從虎眼（見第二章，{@area T5|0a1}）出來，她剛僱傭了{@creature Vincent Trench|WDH|文森特·特倫奇}來監視她不忠的丈夫，這時她目睹了以下情況：

english: "I tell you, it was not a man. More like a puppet shaped like a man. A puppet without strings. It was on the rooftop. It hurled something into the crowd below that caused the explosion. I saw those halflings burned alive! I saw them!"
zh_tw: "我告訴你，那不是人。更像是一個人形的木偶。一個沒有線的木偶。它在屋頂上。它向下面的人群投擲了一些東西，引起了爆炸。我看見那些半身人活活燒死！我看見了！"

english: Jezrynne doesn't know what the "puppet" hurled to cause the fireball. She took her eyes off the thing during the chaos and doesn't know where it went.
zh_tw: 傑茲琳不知道是什麼"木偶"投擲了火球。在混亂中，她失去了對那個東西的注意，不知道它去了哪裡。

english: Martem Trec
zh_tw: 馬爾特姆·特雷克

english: This 12-year-old boy watched as his halfling friends perished in the flames. He didn't see much beyond that, but he found something important after the blast went off:
zh_tw: 這個12歲的男孩目睹了他的半身人朋友在火焰中喪生。他沒有看到更多，但在爆炸發生後，他找到了一些重要的東西：

english: "Right after the explosion, I ducked behind a rain barrel. Then I heard a 'plop' and found this in the barrel."
zh_tw: "爆炸剛發生後，我躲在一個雨水桶後面。然後我聽到一聲'撲通'，然後在桶裡發現了這個。"

english: Martem produces a {@item necklace of fireballs} with two beads remaining and a broken clasp. As it fled across a rooftop, the {@creature nimblewright|wdh} accidentally yanked on the necklace, which came off, fell to the roof, slid off the edge, and plopped into the rain barrel next to Martem.
zh_tw: 馬爾特姆拿出了一條只剩下兩個珠子並且釦環斷裂的{@item necklace of fireballs||火球項鍊}。當{@creature nimblewright|wdh|秘偶}在屋頂上逃跑時，它不小心拽到了這條項鍊，項鍊脫落，掉到屋頂上，滑到邊緣，最後落入了馬爾特姆旁邊的雨水桶裡。

english: He doesn't know what to make of this object but was planning to keep it. A character can snatch it from him or convince Martem to relinquish it with a successful {@dc 8} Charisma (Intimidation or Persuasion) check.
zh_tw: 他不知道該如何處理這個物品，但打算保留它。角色可以強行奪走它，或透過一次成功的 {@dc 8} 魅力（威嚇或說服）檢定說服馬爾特姆放棄它。

english: Characters who withhold the necklace, and knowledge of it, from the City Watch are guilty of a crime in Waterdeep. Hampering justice by concealing evidence can result in a fine of up to 200 gp and hard labor for up to a tenday.
zh_tw: 角色如果隱瞞項鍊及其知識，不讓城市守衛知道，在深水城是犯罪行為。妨礙司法公正透過隱藏證據可能導致高達200金幣的罰款和長達十天的強制勞動。

english: Speaking with the Victims
zh_tw: 與受害者交談

english: The dead are taken to a City Watch station in the North Ward and kept in a cellar morgue. Clerics from local temples are brought in to cast {@spell gentle repose} spells on the corpses, to preserve them while the investigation is ongoing. Any character who has a renown of 1 or higher in Force Grey (the Gray Hands), the Harpers, the Lords' Alliance, the Order of the Gauntlet, or the Zhentarim can petition their faction representative to hire a cleric to cast {@spell speak with dead} on one or more of the fatalities.
zh_tw: 死者被送往北區的城市守衛站，並存放在地下室太平間。當地寺廟的牧師被請來對屍體施放{@spell gentle repose||遺體防腐}法術，以在調查進行時儲存它們。任何在灰色力量（灰手）、豎琴手聯盟、領主聯盟、鐵手套教團或散塔林會中擁有1點或更高聲望的角色都可以請求他們派系的代表僱傭一位牧師對一個或多個死者施放{@spell speak with dead||死者交談}法術。

english: The characters can hire a cleric themselves by making a donation of at least 25 gp to the cleric's temple for each casting of the spell. They must also provide a list of questions they want answered.
zh_tw: 角色們可以透過向牧師的神廟捐贈至少25金幣來僱傭一名牧師進行法術施放。他們還必須提供一份他們想要得到答案的問題清單。

english: A {@spell speak with dead} spell can pry some or all of the following information from Dalakhar's corpse if the right questions are asked:
zh_tw: 如果提問得當，一個{@spell speak with dead||死者交談}法術可以從達拉卡爾的屍體中探知以下部分或全部資訊：

english: Dalakhar stole an artifact called the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} from the lair of a beholder known as {@creature Xanathar|WDH}, in a dungeon deep below the city.
zh_tw: 達拉卡爾從一個被稱為{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的眼魔的巢穴中偷走了一件名為{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}的神器，那個巢穴位於城市下方的深洞中。

english: Dalakhar worked for the Open Lord of Waterdeep. (Here he refers to Lord Dagult Neverember, whom he believes is the rightful Open Lord, not {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH}.)
zh_tw: 達拉卡爾為深水城的公開領主工作。（在這裡他指的是達格魯特·無燼領主，他認為是合法的公開領主，而不是{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}。）

english: The {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} is the key to finding a hoard of dragons hidden in the city.
zh_tw: {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}是找到隱藏在城市中的龍類寶藏的關鍵。

english: Dalakhar heard about a group of adventurers who rescued Lord Neverember's son from the Zhentarim and thought the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} would be safe in their hands for the time being. He was on his way to deliver it to them, planning to come back and reclaim it after he had eluded his pursuers. Then the fireball went off.
zh_tw: 達拉卡爾聽說了一群冒險家從散塔林會手中救出了無燼勳爵的兒子，並認為{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}暫時在他們手中會是安全的。他正打算把它交給他們，並計劃在擺脫追蹤者後回來取回它。然後火球爆炸了。

english: The following information can be learned by casting {@spell speak with dead} on one or both of the dead Zhentarim sellswords:
zh_tw: 透過對一名或兩名死去的散塔林會僱傭兵施放{@spell speak with dead||死者交談}法術，可以得知以下資訊：

english: Their names were Bashekk Ortallis and Wern Malkrave. They worked for {@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh} and resided at Gralhund Villa.
zh_tw: 他們的名字是巴謝克·奧塔利斯和韋恩·馬爾克雷夫。他們為{@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh|厄斯圖爾·弗洛克辛}工作，並居住在格勞洪德別墅。

english: Their job was to help catch a gnome named Dalakhar.
zh_tw: 他們的工作是幫助抓捕一個名叫達拉卡爾的侏儒。

english: Dalakhar had some kind of artifact in his possession which, according to {@creature Urstul Floxin|WDH}, would make them as rich as kings.
zh_tw: 達拉卡爾擁有某種神器，根據{@creature Urstul Floxin|WDH|厄斯圖爾·弗洛克辛}的說法，這將使他們變得像國王一樣富有。

english: Nim's Secret
zh_tw: 尼姆的秘密

english: Characters who question Jezrynne Hornraven (see "Eyewitnesses" above) can get a description of the creature that set off the fireball. It bears a striking similarity to the automatons that sometimes march in the Day of Wonders parade, as anyone who has lived in Waterdeep during the fall season knows. Because the Day of Wonders parade is sponsored by the local temple of Gond, characters might want to visit the temple and investigate a possible connection.
zh_tw: 詢問傑茲琳·霍恩瑞文（見上文的"目擊者"）的角色可以得到引發火球的生物的描述。它與奇蹟日遊行中有時會出現的自動機有著驚人的相似之處，任何在秋季生活在深水城的人都知道這一點。因為奇蹟日遊行是由當地貢德神廟贊助的，角色們可能想要去神廟調查可能的聯絡。

english: House of Inspired Hands
zh_tw: 巧手之屋

english: The House of Inspired Hands, Waterdeep's temple of Gond, sits on the corner of Seawatch Street and Shark Street in the Sea Ward. If the characters visit the temple, they see the following:
zh_tw: 巧手之屋，深水城的貢德神廟，位於海防街和鯊魚街的拐角處，在海區。如果角色們訪問神廟，他們會看到以下情景：

english: The House of Inspired Hands looks like a cross between a temple and a workshop. The symbol of Gond, a toothed cog with four spokes, is displayed prominently. You see the silhouette of a humanoid shape perching on the rooftop. It extends an arm, releasing a tiny metal sparrow into the sky. The bird does a few loops in the air, then veers right toward you.
zh_tw: 巧手之屋看起來像是神廟和車間的結合體。貢德的標誌，一個帶有四個輻條的齒輪，被醒目地展示出來。你看到一個人形輪廓棲息在屋頂上。它伸出一隻手臂，向天空釋放了一隻小型金屬麻雀。這隻鳥在空中做了幾個圈，然後向右向你飛來。

english: The creature atop the temple is Nim, a {@creature nimblewright|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}). Nim was given to the temple as a gift from a visiting Lantanese wizard and has been creating its own inventions on the sly. One of those inventions was the nimblewright that detonated the fireball in Trollskull Alley. Another less-dangerous invention, a mechanical sparrow, is on an accidental collision course with the party.
zh_tw: 神廟頂上的生物是尼姆，一個{@creature nimblewright|WDH|秘偶}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）。尼姆是一位來訪的拉塔尼巫師贈送給神廟的禮物，並且一直在偷偷地創造自己的發明。其中一個發明就是在巨魔顱骨巷引爆火球的靈巧構裝體。另一個不那麼危險的發明，一隻機械麻雀，正意外地與隊伍發生碰撞。

english: Have the characters roll initiative. Nim's mechanical bird acts on initiative count 10, has a flying speed of 60 feet, and starts 60 feet away from the characters. It has AC 15, 1 hit point, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. On its turn, it flies toward one party member at random and makes a melee weapon attack ({@hit 0} to hit) against that character. On a hit, the bird deals 2 ({@dice 1d3}) piercing damage as it slams into the character with surprising force. On a miss, it crashes. Either way, it's destroyed on impact.
zh_tw: 讓角色們擲先攻。尼姆的機械鳥在先攻值10時行動，擁有60尺的飛行速度，並起始於距離角色們60尺處。它擁有AC 15、1點生命值，且免疫毒素和心靈傷害。在它的回合中，它會隨機飛向一名隊伍成員並對其發動一次近戰武器攻擊（{@hit 0}命中）。命中時，這隻鳥會造成2（{@dice 1d3}）點穿刺傷害，因為它以驚人的力場撞擊該角色。失手時，它會墜毀。無論哪種情況，它都會在撞擊時被摧毀。

english: After the attack, Nim withdraws into the temple's attic through a secret hatch in the roof and lies low, hoping the characters don't report the incident to the temple's acolytes.
zh_tw: 襲擊之後，尼姆透過屋頂的一個秘密艙口退入神廟的閣樓，並保持低調，希望角色們不要將事件報告給神廟的侍僧。

english: Inside the Temple
zh_tw: 神廟內部

english: The temple of Gond is open and abuzz with activity during daylight hours, then closes from sunset until sunrise. At night, acolytes retire to their private quarters to work on pet projects.
zh_tw: 貢德神廟在白天開放，活動繁忙，從日落到日出關閉。晚上，侍僧們退回到他們的私人房間，忙於自己的小專案。

english: Hall of Exemplary Inventions
zh_tw: 傑出發明大廳

english: The main hall of the temple holds two dozen marble pedestals. Each one bears a prize-winning invention or a miniature model of some other extraordinary creation. Among the displays are several that stand out:
zh_tw: 神廟的主廳擺放著兩打大理石基座。每一個基座上都展示著獲獎的發明或某些其他非凡創造的微型模型。在這些展品中，有幾個特別引人注目：

english: A 4-foot-tall working model of a clock tower rings at the top of every hour. It is made of wood, iron, bronze, and glass, with brass bells and delicate hands formed from solid gold.
zh_tw: 一個4尺高的鐘樓工作模型，每小時頂部都會敲響。它由木頭、鐵、青銅和玻璃製成，配有黃銅鐘和由純金製成的精緻指標。

english: A wooden flying machine has wings that flap when it becomes airborne.
zh_tw: 一架木製飛行器，當它升空時翅膀會拍打。

english: A miniature model of a mechanical dragon turtle has a brass plate affixed to its pedestal that reads, "Big Belchy. Sank in Deepwater Harbor on the Day of Wonders in 1363 DR."
zh_tw: 一個機械龍龜的微型模型，其基座上固定著一塊銅牌，上面寫著：'大噴氣。1363年奇蹟日，在深水港沉沒。'

english: A functional "waking helmet" equipped with small, articulated metal arms and hands that gently slap the wearer if he or she falls asleep.
zh_tw: 一個功能性的"喚醒頭盔"，配備有小型、可動的金屬臂和手，如果佩戴者打瞌睡，它們會輕輕地拍打佩戴者。

english: A miniature model of a red submarine shaped like a manta ray has a brass plate affixed to its pedestal that reads, {@i "The Scarlet Marpenoth}. Lantanese submersible. Launched in 1489 DR."
zh_tw: 一個紅色潛艇的微型模型，形狀像魔鬼魚，底座上固定著一個黃銅牌，上面寫著：{@i "赤紅的馬彭諾斯"}。拉塔尼潛水艇。於1489 DR下水的。"

english: Meeting Valetta
zh_tw: 遇見瓦萊塔

english: The characters are met by {@creature Valetta|wdh}, a dragonborn {@creature priest} of bronze dragon ancestry, with these changes:
zh_tw: 角色們遇到了{@creature Valetta|wdh|瓦萊塔}，一位青銅龍血統的龍裔{@creature priest||祭司}，具有以下變化：

english: {@creature Valetta|WDH} is neutral.
zh_tw: {@creature Valetta|WDH|瓦萊塔} 是中立的。

english: She has these racial traits: She can use her action to exhale a 5-foot-wide, 30-foot line of lightning (but can't do this again until she finishes a short or long rest); each creature in the line must make a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw, taking {@dice 2d6} lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. She has resistance to lightning damage. She speaks Common and Draconic.
zh_tw: 她擁有這些種族特性：她可以使用她的動作撥出一道5尺寬、30尺長的閃電線（但在完成一次短休或長休前無法再次使用）；線上的每個生物必須進行一次{@dc 11}敏捷豁免，豁免失敗則受到{@dice 2d6}點閃電傷害，豁免成功則受到一半傷害。她對閃電傷害有抗性。她會說通用語和龍語。

english: If the characters mention the figure they saw on the roof of the temple, {@creature Valetta|wdh} identifies it as Nim, a {@creature nimblewright|wdh} that was gifted to the temple by a Lantanese wizard. If they describe the incident involving the mechanical bird, {@creature Valetta|WDH} sighs and leads them up a spiral staircase to an attic that Nim uses as a lair-only to find the attic's door fitted with a new lock. {@creature Valetta|WDH} doesn't recognize the lock or have a key to open it, but a character using thieves' tools can pick the lock with a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check. A {@spell knock} spell or similar magic also opens the door. {@creature Valetta|WDH} won't allow characters to break down the door, but she does permit them to speak to Nim through the door. A character can persuade Nim to unlock the door with a successful {@dc 17} Charisma (Persuasion) check. {@creature Valetta|wdh} grants advantage on the roll by strongly urging Nim to comply.
zh_tw: 如果角色們提到在神殿屋頂上看到的身影，{@creature Valetta|wdh|瓦萊塔} 會認出那是尼姆（尼姆），一個由拉坦酒巫師贈送神殿的{@creature nimblewright|wdh|秘偶}。如果他們描述了涉及機械鳥的事件，{@creature Valetta|WDH|瓦萊塔} 會嘆口氣，並帶領他們走上螺旋樓梯，來到尼姆用作巢穴的閣樓——卻發現閣樓的門安裝了一把新鎖。{@creature Valetta|WDH|瓦萊塔} 不認識這把鎖，也沒有鑰匙來開啟它，但一個使用盜賊工具的角色可以透過成功的{@dc 20}敏捷檢定撬開鎖。{@spell knock||敲擊術}法術或類似的魔法也可以開啟這扇門。{@creature Valetta|WDH|瓦萊塔} 不會允許角色們強行破門，但她允許他們透過門與尼姆交談。一個角色可以透過成功的{@dc 17}魅力（說服）檢定說服尼姆開啟門。{@creature Valetta|wdh|瓦萊塔} 會透過強烈敦促尼姆配合，為該檢定提供優勢。

english: Meeting Nim
zh_tw: 遇見尼姆

english: Nim understands Common but can't speak. It has developed a simple sign language that {@creature Valetta|wdh} and other members of the temple staff understand. After the incident with the bird, Nim hides amid the clutter in its lair, but it emerges if the characters find their way inside or coax it into unlocking the door. If the characters ask about the other nimblewright, Nim admits (through gesturing to {@creature Valetta|WDH}) that it built the other nimblewright to ease its loneliness. But then Nim's creation fled in confused terror a month ago, and Nim hasn't seen it since. In light of this revelation, {@creature Valetta|WDH} angrily orders acolytes to remove Nim's tools and unfinished inventions from the attic, while she forces Nim to look on.
zh_tw: 尼姆能理解通用語但不能說話。它發展了一種簡單的手語，{@creature Valetta|wdh|瓦萊塔} 和神廟其他工作人員能理解。鳥的事件之後，尼姆藏在巢穴的雜物中，但如果角色們找到進入的方法或說服它開門，它會出來。如果角色們詢問另一個秘偶的情況，尼姆透過手勢向{@creature Valetta|WDH|瓦萊塔} 承認，它建造了另一個秘偶以減輕它的孤獨感。但隨後尼姆的創造物在一個月前因困惑和恐懼而逃走，尼姆自此就再也沒有看到它。鑑於這一發現，{@creature Valetta|WDH|瓦萊塔} 憤怒地命令侍僧從閣樓中移走尼姆的工具和未完成的發明，同時她強迫尼姆觀看。

english: Nimblewright Detector
zh_tw: 秘偶探測器

english: Nimblewright Detector
zh_tw: 秘偶探測器

english: Characters who search Nim's attic or watch the area as it's being cleaned out can find a 1-foot-long copper contraption with an umbrella-like metallic protrusion at one end. A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals an aura of divination magic around it. If asked about it, Nim tells {@creature Valetta|wdh} that it built this device to find the errant {@creature nimblewright|wdh} and tried to seek it out, only to discover that Nim couldn't leave the temple grounds. Once Nim explains how the nimblewright detector works, {@creature Valetta|WDH} allows the characters to take it. To activate the nimblewright detector, a character must hold down its trigger. When the activated device comes within 500 feet of a nimblewright other than Nim, the umbrella begins to spin, whir, and click. The spinning, whirring, and clicking accelerates as the distance to the target lessens, reaching maximum velocity and volume when a nimblewright other than Nim is within 30 feet of the device.
zh_tw: 搜尋尼姆的閣樓或在清理時觀察該區域的角色可以發現一個1尺長的銅製裝置，一端有一個類似傘狀的金屬突起。{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術會揭示其周圍有預言魔法的光環。如果被問及此事，尼姆會告訴{@creature Valetta|wdh|瓦萊塔}，它建造這個裝置是為了尋找走失的{@creature nimblewright|wdh|秘偶}並試圖找到它，結果卻發現尼姆無法離開寺廟的地面。一旦尼姆解釋了秘偶探測器的工作原理，{@creature Valetta|WDH|瓦萊塔}便允許角色們帶走它。要啟動秘偶探測器，角色必須按住它的觸發器。當啟用的裝置進入距離非尼姆的秘偶500尺範圍內時，傘狀物開始旋轉、嗡嗡作響併發出咔嗒聲。隨著與目標距離的減小，旋轉、嗡嗡聲和咔嗒聲會加速，當非尼姆的秘偶在裝置30尺範圍內時達到最大速度和音量。

english: Reward
zh_tw: 獎勵

english: If the characters want to track down the wayward {@creature nimblewright|wdh} themselves, {@creature Valetta|wdh} says that the House of Inspired Hands will pay them 500 gp to destroy it. If they return with proof of its destruction, {@creature Valetta|WDH} sees that they receive the promised reward and also offers them one each of the following nonmagical inventions:
zh_tw: 如果角色們想要自己追蹤那個走失的{@creature nimblewright|wdh|秘偶}，{@creature Valetta|wdh|瓦萊塔}表示巧手之屋會支付他們500金幣來摧毀它。如果他們帶著摧毀的證據回來，{@creature Valetta|WDH|瓦萊塔}會確保他們收到承諾的獎勵，並且還提供給他們每人以下非魔法發明中的一個：

english: Adjustable Stilts
zh_tw: 可調節高蹺

english: The stilts take 1 minute to put on or remove. They increase the height of any humanoid wearing them by 2 to 5 feet. Each stilt weighs 8 pounds and is 1 foot long when fully collapsed.
zh_tw: 高蹺穿脫需要1分鐘。它們可以使任何穿著它們的類人生物的身高增加2到5尺。每個高蹺重8磅，完全摺疊時長1尺。

english: Backpack Parachute
zh_tw: 降落傘包

english: A humanoid wearing this piece of gear can deploy the parachute as a reaction while falling, or as an action otherwise. The parachute requires at least a 10-foot cube of unoccupied space in which to deploy, and it doesn't open fast enough to slow a fall of less than 60 feet. If it has sufficient time and space to deploy properly, the parachute allows its wearer to land without taking falling damage. Once it has been used, the parachute takes 10 minutes to repack.
zh_tw: 穿戴這件裝備的人形生物可以在墜落時作為反應動作部署降落傘，或者在其他時候作為動作部署。降落傘需要至少一個10尺的立方體空間來部署，並且它開啟的速度不足以減緩少於60尺的墜落。如果它有足夠的時間和空間正確部署，降落傘可以讓它穿戴者安全著陸，不承受墜落傷害。一旦使用過，降落傘需要10分鐘重新打包。

english: Barking Box
zh_tw: 吠叫箱

english: This metal cube, 6 inches on a side, has a crank on top. Using an action to wind the crank activates the box for 8 hours. While activated, the box barks whenever it detects vibrations within 15 feet of it, as long as the box and the source of the vibrations are in contact with the same ground or substance. A switch on one side of the box sets the device to emit either a small dog's bark or a large dog's bark.
zh_tw: 這個金屬立方體，每邊6吋，頂部有一個曲柄。使用動作來上發條可以啟用箱子8小時。在啟用狀態下，只要箱子和振動源接觸相同的地面或物質，它就會在檢測到15尺內的振動時吠叫。箱子一側的開關可以設定裝置發出小狗的吠叫或大狗的吠叫。

english: Matchless Pipe
zh_tw: 無雙菸斗

english: A switch made of flint is built into the bowl of this fine wooden smoking pipe. With a few flicks of the switch, the pipe lights itself.
zh_tw: 這個精美的木製菸斗的菸鬥部分內建了一個由打火石製成的打火裝置。透過幾次輕敲這個裝置，菸鬥就能自行點燃。

english: Finding Nim's Creation
zh_tw: 尋找尼姆的創造物

english: Equipped with the {@i nimblewright detector}, the characters can search for Nim's escaped creation. A ward-by-ward search is the best approach, but let the players tell you how their characters conduct the search. Depending on where they go, the search could take days.
zh_tw: 配備有{@i 秘偶探測器}，角色們可以搜尋尼姆逃跑的創造物。逐區搜尋是最好的方法，但讓玩家告訴你他們的角色如何進行搜尋。根據他們去的地方，搜尋可能需要幾天時間。

english: A character mounted on a griffon can complete a city-wide search in a couple of hours. To secure the use of a griffon, a character must either be a member of the Order of the Gauntlet on good terms with Savra Belabranta or a member of the Lords' Alliance on good terms with {@creature Jalester Silvermane|WDH}. As it happens, a young {@creature griffon} named Bonesnapper is being trained to serve as a mount in the Griffon Cavalry. If Savra or Jalester is inclined to help the party, the characters can arrange to meet the griffon and its trainer outside the River Gate the following morning shortly after dawn. (The griffon and its trainer normally reside in Peaktop Aerie atop Mount Waterdeep, but most civilians aren't welcome there.) To gain Bonesnapper's trust, a character must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom (Animal Handling) check. The griffon won't allow any character who fails the check to ride it.
zh_tw: 一個騎乘獅鷲的角色可以在幾個小時內完成全城範圍的搜尋。要確保使用獅鷲，角色必須是與薩芙拉·貝拉布蘭塔關係良好的鐵手套教團成員，或者是與{@creature Jalester Silvermane|WDH|加萊斯特·銀鬃}關係良好的領主聯盟成員。碰巧，一隻名叫碎骨者的年輕{@creature griffon||獅鷲}正在接受訓練，以作為獅鷲騎兵的坐騎。如果薩芙拉或賈萊斯特傾向於幫助隊伍，角色們可以在第二天黎明後不久在河門外安排與獅鷲及其訓練師見面。（獅鷲及其訓練師通常居住在深水山山頂的峰頂鷹巢，但大多數平民不被允許進入那裡。）要贏得碎骨者的信任，角色必須成功透過一個{@dc 16}感知（動物馴養）檢定。獅鷲不會允許任何檢定失敗的角色騎乘它。

english: Nim's errant {@creature nimblewright|wdh} is in Gralhund Villa on Saerdoun Street, in the North Ward. It isn't, however, the only nimblewright to be found outside the House of Inspired Hands. If the characters decide to search the Dock Ward, the nimblewright detector starts to whir when it comes within range of a couple of the ships in port.
zh_tw: 尼姆的走失{@creature nimblewright|wdh|秘偶}在北區塞爾敦街上的格勞洪德別墅裡。然而，它並不是唯一一個在巧手之屋外被發現的秘偶。如果角色們決定搜尋碼頭區，當秘偶探測器進入港口一些船隻的範圍時，它開始嗡嗡作響。

english: Dock Ward Distraction
zh_tw: 碼頭區幹擾

english: Zardoz Zord, owner of the Sea Maidens Faire, has brought his three ships to Waterdeep. Two of these galleons, the {@i Heartbreaker} and the {@i Hellraiser}, are docked. Zord's flagship, the {@i Eyecatcher}, is anchored in Deepwater Harbor. Each of the three ships (described in chapter 7) has at least one nimblewright aboard.
zh_tw: 扎多茲·佐德，海之少女嘉年華的所有者，已經將他的三艘船帶到了深水城。其中兩艘大帆船，{@i 碎心號}和{@i 煽亂號}，已經停靠在碼頭。佐德的旗艦，{@i 奪目號}，則停泊在深水港。這三艘船（在第7章中有描述）每艘都至少有一名秘偶船員。

english: The docks are bustling and chaotic during the day, except in winter. At night, darkness provides sufficient cover for characters to approach the docked vessels unseen. If one or more characters are caught aboard a ship, the crew tries to corner them until the ship's captain can have words with them. The nimblewrights, they say, are "attractions and nothing more." If the characters ask to speak to the owner of the fleet, a {@spell sending} spell is used to contact Zord, who invites the characters to dine with him aboard the {@i Eyecatcher}.
zh_tw: 碼頭白天繁忙而混亂，冬天除外。夜晚，黑暗為角色提供了足夠的掩護，使他們能夠接近停泊的船隻而不被發現。如果一個或多個角色在船上被抓，船員會試圖將他們逼入絕境，直到船長能與他們對話。據說，那些靈活的自動偶只是"吸引人的擺設罷了"。如果角色要求與船隊的主人交談，會使用{@spell sending||短訊術}法術聯絡佐德，他邀請角色們與他一起在{@i 奪目號}上共進晚餐。

english: Dining with Zardoz Zord
zh_tw: 與扎多茲·佐德共進晚餐

english: Characters who accept Zord's offer are shuttled by dinghy to his flagship, welcomed aboard by drow crew members magically disguised as attractive humans (see chapter 7 for more information), and led to the captain's dining cabin ({@area J10|371}):
zh_tw: 接受佐德邀請的角色們會透過小艇被送到他的旗艦上，由被魔法偽裝成迷人人類的卓爾船員（見第七章以獲取更多資訊）歡迎上船，並被帶到船長的餐廳艙（{@area J10|371}）：

english: The dining cabin is bedecked with golden filigree, the purple curtains festooned with silken tassels, the wood paneling scented with perfume. A magnificent feast laid out on golden platters sprawls atop a mahogany table of exquisite craftsmanship. Even the doilies are something to behold. Standing behind it all with wine glass in hand is a well-built, scantily clad man, his scarlet apparel designed to accentuate his trim figure and bountiful chest hair. A flashy rapier hangs from his stylish belt.
zh_tw: 餐廳艙裝飾著金色的金銀絲細工，紫色的窗簾上掛著絲質流蘇，木製鑲板散發著香水的味道。一場盛大的宴會擺放在精美的桃花心木桌上，上面鋪滿了金色的託盤。即使是桌布也是值得一看的藝術品。站在這一切後面，手持酒杯的是一個身材健美、衣著暴露的男子，他的猩紅色服裝設計用來突出他勻稱的身材和濃密的胸毛。一把花哨的刺劍掛在他時髦的腰帶上。

english: "Welcome aboard the Eyecatcher," he says, flashing his pearly white teeth. "Zardoz Zord, at your service."
zh_tw: "歡迎登上奪目號，"他露出潔白的牙齒說道。"扎多茲·佐德，為您效勞。"

english: {@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH}
zh_tw: {@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH|賈拉索·班瑞}

english: This dashing figure is none other than {@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) magically disguised as Zardoz Zord.
zh_tw: 這個風度翩翩的人物正是{@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH|賈拉索·班瑞}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），他被魔法偽裝成了扎多茲·佐德。

english: The characters have piqued Jarlaxle's curiosity. He doesn't know much about them (yet) and wants to determine whether they pose a threat (they don't). To win them over, he shares the following information over dinner and wine:
zh_tw: 角色們激起了賈拉索的好奇心。他目前對他們瞭解不多，並且想要判斷他們是否構成威脅（他們不構成威脅）。為了贏得他們的好感，他在晚餐和品酒時分享了以下資訊：

english: The Sea Maidens Faire, owned and operated by Zord, is a seafaring carnival based in Luskan that travels along the Sword Coast. It provides good, wholesome entertainment in the form of fantastic street parades.
zh_tw: 海之少女嘉年華由佐德擁有並運營，是一個以路斯坎為基地，沿著劍海岸旅行的海上嘉年華。它以精彩的街頭遊行形式提供良好、健康的娛樂。

english: The {@i Heartbreaker} and the {@i Hellraiser} are used to transport entertainers, {@item wagon|PHB|wagons}, and parade floats. The {@i Eyecatcher} is Zord's command ship and private yacht. All three ships are built for comfort and speed.
zh_tw: {@i 碎心號}和{@i 煽亂號}用於運輸藝人、{@item wagon|PHB|四輪貨車}和遊行花車。{@i 奪目號}是佐德的指揮艦和私人遊艇。這三艘船都兼具舒適性與速度。

english: Zord visits the distant island of Lantan about once a year. During his last visit, he purchased four nimblewrights from a Lantanese wizard. He keeps two aboard his flagship, and one aboard each of the other two vessels.
zh_tw: 佐德大約每年訪問一次遙遠的蘭檀。在他上次訪問期間，他從一個蘭檀法師那裡購買了四個秘偶。他在自己的旗艦上保留了兩個，在其他兩艘船上各保留了一個。

english: When they're not marching in a parade, Zord's nimblewrights remain aboard his ships. "They're perfectly harmless," he attests, whereupon a {@creature nimblewright|wdh} holding a decanter enters the dining cabin and quietly refills everyone's wine glasses.
zh_tw: 當他們不參加遊行時，佐德的秘偶們會留在他的船上。"他們完全無害，"他證實道，隨即一個手持酒瓶的{@creature nimblewright|wdh|秘偶}進入餐廳艙，靜靜地為每個人重新斟滿酒杯。

english: If the characters mention the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, Zord shrugs his shoulders in a manner that suggests he doesn't know what they're talking about. He also feigns disinterest in Waterdeep politics, saying, "Every city has problems, I suppose. My job as an entertainer is to make people forget about politics for a while." Characters who are suspicious of Zord can make a {@dc 24} Wisdom (Insight) check. Any character who succeeds on the check senses that there's much more to him than meets the eye.
zh_tw: 如果角色們提到 {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，佐德會聳聳肩，表示他不知道他們在說什麼。他還假裝對深水城的政治不感興趣，說道："我想每個城市都有自己的問題。作為一名藝人，我的工作是讓人們暫時忘記政治。" 對佐德有疑心的角色可以進行一次 {@dc 24} 感知（洞悉）檢定。任何成功透過檢定的角色都會察覺到，他絕非表面看起來那麼簡單。

english: Jarlaxle owns a {@item hat of disguise} but doesn't need it to hide his true form while he's aboard any of his ships. His disguise (and the disguises of his drow subordinates) can be dispelled only by destroying the ship's figurehead (see chapter 7). If the characters somehow discern his true form, Jarlaxle gives the party a slow nod of his head, dryly says "Bravo!" and lets them make the next move.
zh_tw: 賈拉索擁有一頂{@item hat of disguise||易容帽}，但在他登上他的任何一艘船時，他不需要它來隱藏他的真實形態。他的偽裝（以及他的卓爾下屬的偽裝）只能透過摧毀船的船首像（見第七章）來解除。如果角色們以某種方式識破他的真實形態，賈拉索會向隊伍慢慢地點頭，乾巴巴地說"精彩！"，然後讓他們採取下一步行動。

english: When dinner is concluded, Zord bids the characters farewell and sees that they are escorted safely back to the docks.
zh_tw: 晚餐結束後，佐德向角色們道別，並確保他們被安全護送回碼頭。

english: Drow Characters
zh_tw: 卓爾角色

english: If the adventuring party includes one or more drow characters, Captain Zord pays close attention to what they do and say, but doesn't treat them any differently from the other party members.
zh_tw: 如果冒險團隊中包括一個或多個黑暗精靈角色，佐德船長會密切關注他們的言行，但不會與對待其他團隊成員有所不同。

english: What Renaer Knows
zh_tw: 瑞納爾知道的事

english: At some point during their investigation, the characters might want to speak to {@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh} about the fireball, given his own recent brush with the Zhentarim. Conversely, he could decide to pay them a visit at their tavern. If he's told that a gnome and two Zhents were killed in the blast, Renaer drops a bombshell:
zh_tw: 在他們的調查過程中，角色們可能想要就火球事件與{@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh|瑞納爾·無燼}交談，考慮到他最近與散塔林會的衝突。相反，他也可能決定去他們所在的酒館拜訪他們。如果他被告知一個侏儒和兩個散塔林會成員在爆炸中被殺，瑞納爾就會丟擲一個重磅訊息：

english: "When the Lords of Waterdeep ousted my father, I thought his long, dark shadow was finally gone for good. The truth is, I want nothing to do with him. But his spies hound me. One of them, a gnome named Dalakhar, had been watching me for months. Then, about two tendays ago, the spy was suddenly nowhere to be seen. My father didn't trust many people, but he trusted that gnome."
zh_tw: "當深水城的領主們驅逐了我的父親，我以為他那漫長而黑暗的陰影終於永遠消失了。事實是，我不想和他有任何瓜葛。但他的間諜一直糾纏著我。其中一個，一個名叫達拉卡爾的侏儒，已經監視我好幾個月了。然後，大約二十天前，那個間諜突然消失了。我父親沒有信任多少人，但他信任那個侏儒。"

english: "I spoke to a few of Dalakhar's friends. Apparently, he was on a special mission to retrieve the Stone of Golorr and was afraid that the Zhentarim and the Xanathar Guild were close to catching him. When he heard about my kidnapping, he wanted more information about the adventurers who had rescued me. I think Dalakhar was planning to pay you to deliver the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} to my father in Neverwinter."
zh_tw: "我與達拉卡爾的幾個朋友談過。顯然，他正在進行一個特殊任務來取回格洛爾之石，並且擔心散塔林會和姍娜薩公會快要抓到他了。當他聽說我被綁架時，他想要更多關於救出我的冒險者的資訊。我認為達拉卡爾計劃付錢給你們，讓你們把{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}交給我在無冬城的父親。"

english: Any attempt to follow up with Dalakhar's friends proves futile, since they have gone into hiding in the wake of the gnome's sudden demise.
zh_tw: 任何試圖跟進達拉卡爾朋友的努力都證明是徒勞的，因為在這位侏儒突然死亡之後，他們已經躲藏起來了。

english: If the characters tell Renaer that {@creature Fala Lefaliir|wdh} saw a man fleeing Trollskull Alley (see "Eyewitnesses"), Renaer reaches out to his friends in the Harpers. A day later, he returns with the following information:
zh_tw: 如果角色們告訴瑞納爾{@creature Fala Lefaliir|wdh|法拉·勒法利爾}看到一個男子逃離巨魔顱骨巷（見"目擊者"），瑞納爾會向他在豎琴手聯盟的朋友求助。一天後，他帶著以下資訊回來：

english: The man Fala saw matches the description of {@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh}, a suspected member of the Black Network.
zh_tw: 法拉看到的男子與{@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh|厄斯圖爾·弗洛克辛}的描述相符，他是被懷疑為黑網成員的個體。

english: Another North Ward resident claims he saw Urstul enter Gralhund Villa, in the North Ward, shortly after the fireball incident. The resident reported him to the City Watch because Urstul looked suspicious.
zh_tw: 另一位北區的居民聲稱他在火球事件發生後不久看到厄斯圖爾進入了北區的格勞洪德別墅。該居民因為厄斯圖爾看起來可疑而向城市守衛報告了他。

english: Two City Watch constables spoke to Lord Gralhund. He assured them that no one had broken into the estate and that everything was fine. The constables had no grounds to get a search warrant, so they didn't pursue the matter.
zh_tw: 兩位城市守衛的警官與格勞洪德勳爵進行了交談。他向他們保證沒有人闖入莊園，一切都很好。警官們沒有理由獲得搜查令，因此他們沒有繼續追究這件事。

english: Gralhund Villa
zh_tw: 格勞洪德別墅

english: After fleeing Trollskull Alley with the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} in his clutches, the Zhent assassin {@creature Urstul Floxin|WDH} returned to Gralhund Villa to confront {@creature Yalah Gralhund|wdh} about sending the {@creature nimblewright|wdh} to meddle in his mission. Lady Gralhund decides she no longer likes Urstul and, taking advantage of his injuries, wrests the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} from him at sword-point and orders her guards to lock him up until she decides what to do with him.
zh_tw: 在帶著{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}逃離巨魔顱骨巷後，散塔林會刺客{@creature Urstul Floxin|WDH|厄斯圖爾·弗洛克辛}返回格勞洪德別墅，質問{@creature Yalah Gralhund|wdh|雅拉·格勞洪德}為何派{@creature nimblewright|wdh|秘偶}干涉他的任務。格勞洪德女士決定不再容忍厄斯圖爾，並趁其受傷之際用劍逼他交出{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，命令衛兵將其關押直至她決定如何處置。

english: Your choice of main villain determines Lady Gralhund's motivation, which is a secret held by her and {@creature Hrabbaz|WDH}, her loyal half-orc bodyguard:
zh_tw: 您選擇的主要反派決定了格勞洪德夫人的動機，這是她和她忠誠的半獸人保鏢{@creature Hrabbaz|WDH|哈巴茲}所保守的秘密：

english: If {@creature Xanathar|WDH} is the main villain, {@creature Yalah Gralhund|WDH} has secretly cut a deal with the beholder crime lord, offering to return the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} to it if the beholder helps her create a vacancy on the council of Masked Lords.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}是主要反派，{@creature Yalah Gralhund|WDH|雅拉·格勞洪德}暗中與眼魔犯罪領主達成協議，承諾如果眼魔幫助她在蒙面領主議會中製造空缺，她將把{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}歸還給它。

english: If the Cassalanters are the main villains, Yalah is a fawning member of their Asmodeus-worshiping cult and intends to deliver the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} to them as a demonstration of her fealty and friendship.
zh_tw: 如果卡薩蘭特家族是主要反派，雅拉是他們崇拜阿斯蒙蒂斯的邪教的媚俗成員，並打算將{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}交給他們，作為她忠誠和友誼的證明。

english: If Jarlaxle is the main villain, he and Yalah are secret lovers. He has promised to facilitate her rise in power after he uses Lord Neverember's lost hoard to buy Luskan's way into the Lords' Alliance.
zh_tw: 如果賈拉索是主要反派，他和雅拉是秘密戀人。他承諾在利用無燼勳爵失去的寶藏購買路斯坎進入領主聯盟的途徑後，幫助她在權力上崛起。

english: If {@creature Manshoon|WDH} is the main villain, he promised not to destroy Yalah's family if she allowed her villa to be used as a staging area for his secret plots. Believing that {@creature Urstul Floxin|WDH} is after the gold for himself, Yalah plans to cut Urstul out of the deal and deliver the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} to {@creature Manshoon|WDH} herself.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}是主要反派，他承諾如果雅拉允許將她的別墅用作他秘密計劃的集結地，他就不會摧毀雅拉的家庭。相信{@creature Urstul Floxin|WDH|厄斯圖爾·弗洛克辛}是為了自己的黃金，雅拉計劃將厄斯圖爾排除在交易之外，親自將{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}交給{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}。

english: Having gravely misjudged and underestimated Lady Gralhund once, Urstul isn't about to do so again. Rallying despite his injuries, he manages to kill the two inattentive Gralhund guards who were watching over him and alert the other Zhents on the estate, who begin dispatching the other guards and servants. Urstul's goal is to capture Lord or Lady Gralhund, force the surrender of the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, and deliver it to his master {@creature Manshoon|WDH} in Kolat Towers (described in chapter 8).
zh_tw: 厄斯圖爾曾經嚴重誤判並低估了格勞洪德夫人，他不會再犯同樣的錯誤。儘管受傷，他還是設法殺死了兩個疏忽的格勞洪德守衛，並提醒莊園裡的其他散塔林會成員，他們開始處理其他的守衛和僕人。厄斯圖爾的目標是俘虜格勞洪德勳爵或夫人，迫使他們交出{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，並將其交給他在克拉特雙塔（見第八章描述）的主人{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}。

english: Urstul's plans-unbeknownst to him-are dashed when Lady Gralhund orders her {@creature nimblewright|wdh} to take the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} elsewhere. Amid the chaos, the nimblewright flees the estate.
zh_tw: 厄斯圖爾的計劃在他不知情的情況下落空了，當格勞洪德女士命令她的{@creature nimblewright|wdh|秘偶}將{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}帶到別處。在混亂中，秘偶逃離了莊園。

english: Should They or Shouldn't They?
zh_tw: 他們應該嗎？還是不應該？

english: The characters must proceed carefully, since they have no evidence that directly implicates the Gralhunds in the attack in Trollskull Alley. Their two basic choices are to share what they know with the City Watch or to visit Gralhund Villa themselves.
zh_tw: 角色們必須謹慎行事，因為他們沒有直接牽涉格勞洪德家族在巨魔顱骨巷襲擊中的證據。他們兩個基本的選擇是與城市守衛分享他們所知道的，或者親自去格勞洪德別墅。

english: Let the Watch Handle It
zh_tw: 讓守衛來處理

english: The characters can go to any City Watch station in the North Ward and report what they have learned to the constables there. Shortly thereafter, the characters receive a visit from {@creature Barnibus Blastwind|WDH} and {@creature Saeth Cromley|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), who have no reason to suspect the characters are lying. Their own investigation corroborates much of what the characters said. Barnibus concludes the meeting by saying, rather brusquely, "Thank you for the information." Cromley adds, "Rest assured, we'll have this case resolved in no time."
zh_tw: 角色們可以去北區的任何城市守衛站，向那裡的警察報告他們所瞭解到的情況。不久之後，角色們收到了{@creature Barnibus Blastwind|WDH|巴尼布斯·陣風}和{@creature Saeth Cromley|wdh|薩斯·克姆利}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）的訪問，他們沒有理由懷疑角色們在說謊。他們自己的調查證實了角色們所說的大部分內容。巴尼布斯以相當粗魯的方式結束了會議，說：'感謝你們提供的資訊。'克姆利補充說：'放心，我們很快就會解決這個案子。'

english: A magistrate provides the City Watch with a warrant to search Gralhund Villa. Sometime afterward, Cromley visits the characters by himself and, as a courtesy, tells them what happened:
zh_tw: 一位地方官給城市守衛提供了搜查格勞洪德別墅的許可。之後不久，克姆利獨自拜訪了角色們，並出於禮貌，告訴了他們發生了什麼：

english: Officers arrived to find Lord Gralhund {@condition unconscious}, Lady Gralhund in shock, and their half-orc bodyguard bloodied but unbowed.
zh_tw: 官員們到達現場，發現格勞洪德勳爵處於{@condition unconscious||昏迷}狀態，格勞洪德女士處於震驚之中，而他們的半獸人保鏢雖然渾身是血但仍然不屈不撓。

english: Apparently, the Gralhunds had been held hostage for more than a tenday by agents of the Black Network. Most of the Zhents were killed during a bloody revolt led by Lord Gralhund himself.
zh_tw: 顯然，格勞洪德一家被黑網的代理人扣為人質已經超過十天。在格勞洪德勳爵本人領導的一場血腥反抗中，大多數散塔林會成員被殺。

english: The Zhent leader, {@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh}, was among those who got away. He's still at large. The Watch plans to step up its search for him.
zh_tw: 散塔林會成員領袖，{@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh|厄斯圖爾·弗洛克辛}，是逃脫的人之一。他仍然在逃。守衛計劃加強對他的搜捕。

english: Of the nimblewright, there was no sign. According to the Gralhunds, the construct was delivered to Gralhund Villa weeks earlier. The family took it in, not realizing it was a Zhentarim spy. Lady Gralhund reported that it stole her {@item necklace of fireballs}.
zh_tw: 至於秘偶，沒有發現任何跡象。據格勞洪德家族所說，這個構裝生物幾周前就被送到了格勞洪德別墅。家族收留了它，並沒有意識到它是一個散塔林會間諜。格勞洪德夫人報告說，它偷走了她的{@item necklace of fireballs||火球項鍊}。

english: Cromley's summary of events is based on information given to the City Watch by the Gralhunds and is riddled with falsehoods. The hostage situation, Lord Gralhund's heroism, and the theft of Lady Gralhund's {@item necklace of fireballs} never happened. The nimblewright's affiliation with the Zhentarim is also a lie. The Gralhunds' account further doesn't explain why the {@creature nimblewright|wdh} would use the {@item necklace of fireballs} to inflict harm on the Zhents if it was working with them. If characters raise that question, Cromley thinks for a moment and then ventures the guess that the nimblewright underestimated the necklace's explosive power.
zh_tw: 克姆利對事件的總結是基於格勞洪德家族提供給城市守衛的資訊，並且充滿了謊言。人質情況、格勞洪德勳爵的英雄行為以及格勞洪德女士的{@item necklace of fireballs||火球項鍊}被盜事件從未發生過。秘偶與散塔林會的關係也是一個謊言。格勞洪德家族的敘述也沒有解釋為什麼{@creature nimblewright|wdh|秘偶}會使用{@item necklace of fireballs||火球項鍊}對散塔林會成員造成傷害，如果它與他們合作的話。如果角色提出這個問題，克姆利思考了一會兒，然後猜測秘偶低估了項鍊的爆炸力。

english: Investigate the Villa
zh_tw: 調查別墅

english: The characters can insert themselves into Gralhund Villa and accost its residents with impunity if they're careful to pin the violence on the Zhents or if they're able to enter and leave unseen before the City Watch shows up to arrest everyone.
zh_tw: 如果角色們小心地將暴力行為歸咎於散塔林會成員，或者在城市守衛出現逮捕所有人之前能夠不被發現地進入和離開，他們就可以無罪地闖入格勞洪德別墅並質問其居民。

english: Sneaking in or out of the villa without being seen or heard by neighbors and passersby requires each character to succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity (Stealth) check. A character who has proficiency in the Stealth skill can take disadvantage on the check to grant advantage on another party member's check (essentially compensating for a less stealthy companion).
zh_tw: 在未被鄰居和路人發現或聽到的情況下潛入或逃離別墅，每個角色都需要成功透過一次 {@dc 15} 敏捷（隱匿）檢定。擁有潛行技能熟練項的角色可以選擇在檢定中承受劣勢，以讓另一名隊友的檢定獲得優勢（本質上是為了彌補一位不太擅長隱匿的同伴）。

english: If the characters side with the Gralhunds in the conflict, Lady Gralhund is inclined to overlook their trespass. Her demeanor sours, however, if they start asking too many questions. She vigorously denies accusations that her family is involved with the Black Network and claims the Zhents were holding her family hostage (a false claim also parroted by her husband, her bodyguard, her children, and her staff). If the characters assault any member of the household or brandish weapons in an attempt to intimidate, the Gralhunds inform the City Watch of the party's crimes.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在衝突中站在格勞洪德家族一邊，格勞洪德女士傾向於對他們的非法入侵視而不見。然而，如果他們開始提出太多問題，她的態度就會變得冷淡。她堅決否認她的家族與黑網有關，並聲稱散塔林會成員家族扣押了她的人質（這是一個也被她的丈夫、保鏢、孩子和工作人員重複的虛假宣告）。如果角色們襲擊任何家庭成員或揮舞武器試圖恐嚇，格勞洪德家族將向城市守衛報告該隊伍的罪行。

english: During the characters' invasion of Gralhund Villa, the {@creature nimblewright|wdh} flees the estate with the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} (see chapter 4 for more information on its destination). If the characters are using Nim's nimblewright detector to track the nimblewright, the device lets them know that the nimblewright has fled the scene, but not the direction it went.
zh_tw: 在角色們入侵格勞洪德別墅期間，{@creature nimblewright|wdh|秘偶}攜帶著{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}逃離了莊園（有關其目的地的更多資訊，請參閱第四章）。如果角色們正在使用尼姆的秘偶探測器來追蹤秘偶，該裝置會讓他們知道秘偶已經逃離了現場，但並未顯示它逃走的方向。

english: Overview
zh_tw: 概述

english: Gralhund Villa sits in the middle of an upper-class residential neighborhood in the North Ward. Here are some general facts to keep in mind:
zh_tw: 格勞洪德別墅位於北區一個上層階級住宅區的中心。以下是一些需要記住的一般事實：

english: The streets around the villa have pedestrians and coaches traveling along them at all hours, though traffic is heavier during the day.
zh_tw: 別墅周圍的街道上，無論何時都有行人和馬車在行駛，儘管白天的交通更為繁忙。

english: The estate is enclosed by 12-foot-high stone walls that require a successful {@dc 15} Strength (Athletics) check to negotiate without the aid of climbing gear or magic.
zh_tw: 莊園被12尺高的石牆包圍，在沒有攀爬裝備或魔法的幫助下，需要透過一次成功的 {@dc 15} 力量（運動）檢定才能翻越。

english: Neighbors and bystanders alert the City Watch if they hear loud, disturbing noises (such as a {@spell thunderwave} spell) coming from the estate or if they see anything suspicious. The Watch sends a {@creature mage} and six {@creature veteran||veterans} (one {@creature sergeant|WDH} and five constables) to investigate, and it takes {@dice 1d6 + 4} minutes for this force to arrive.
zh_tw: 鄰居和旁觀者如果聽到從莊園傳來的響亮且令人不安的噪音（例如 {@spell thunderwave||雷鳴波} 法術）或者看到任何可疑情況，會通知城市守衛。警衛會派出一名 {@creature mage||魔法師} 和六名 {@creature veteran||老兵}（一名 {@creature sergeant|WDH|軍士} 和五名警員）進行調查，這股力量到達需要 {@dice 1d6 + 4} 分鐘。

english: All ceilings in the mansion are 20 feet high.
zh_tw: 這座宅邸內所有的天花板高度為20尺。

english: Encounters in the Villa
zh_tw: 別墅中的遭遇

english: The following encounter locations, keyed to map 3.1, describe the Gralhund estate as it stands when the characters first arrive. The Zhents have taken over the downstairs level of the mansion; the Gralhunds are fighting to hold the upstairs.
zh_tw: 以下遭遇地點，對應地圖3.1，描述了當角色們首次到達時格勞洪德莊園的情況。散塔林會成員已經佔領了宅邸的樓下層；格勞洪德家族正在努力保衛樓上。

english: Gralhund Villa
zh_tw: 格勞洪德別墅

english: Gralhund Villa, Ground Floor (Player Version)
zh_tw: 格勞洪德別墅，一樓（玩家版本）

english: G1. Locked Gates
zh_tw: G1. 鎖住的大門

english: Through a set of ornate iron gates, the characters can see a yard with several large trees, as well as two footpaths that lead to a two-story brick mansion and eastward toward a detached coach house.
zh_tw: 穿過一套華麗的鐵門，角色們可以看到一個院子，院子裡有幾棵大樹，還有兩條小徑，一條通往一座兩層的磚砌別墅，另一條向東通往一個獨立的馬車房。

english: An {@spell arcane lock} spell is cast on the gates. Forcing them open requires a successful {@dc 25} Strength (Athletics) check, while picking the lock requires a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check using thieves' tools. The spell doesn't bar members of the Gralhund family, their staff, their guards, or Lady Gralhund's {@creature nimblewright|wdh} from opening the gates.
zh_tw: 大門上施加了一道 {@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖} 法術。強行開啟它們需要透過一次 {@dc 25} 力量（運動）檢定，而撬鎖則需要使用盜賊工具並透過一次 {@dc 20} 敏捷檢定。該法術不會阻止格勞洪德家族的成員、他們的員工、他們的守衛或格勞洪德夫人的 {@creature nimblewright|wdh|秘偶} 開啟大門。

english: G2. Yard
zh_tw: G2. 院子

english: The estate is well tended. In spring and summer, large trees provide shade. The trees begin shedding leaves in the fall. By winter, their branches are stripped bare.
zh_tw: 這個莊園維護得很好。在春季和夏季，大樹提供了陰涼。樹木在秋天開始落葉。到了冬天，它們的樹枝變得光禿禿的。

english: Balcony
zh_tw: 陽臺

english: Through the trees, the characters can see a large balcony ({@area G17|116}) enclosed by an iron railing above the mansion's main entrance. The balcony is 20 feet above ground level, and scaling the mansion's brick walls to reach it without the aid of climbing gear or magic requires a successful {@dc 15} Strength (Athletics) check.
zh_tw: 穿過樹林，角色們可以看到大別墅正門上方的一個大型陽臺（{@area G17|116}），被鐵欄杆圍住。陽臺距離地面20尺，在沒有攀爬裝備或魔法幫助的情況下，要攀爬別墅的磚牆到達這裡，需要透過一個成功的{@dc 15}力量（運動）檢定。

english: Evil Groundskeeper
zh_tw: 邪惡的園丁

english: The yard is looked after by a menacing groundskeeper named Hurv Taldred (LE male Illuskan {@creature cult fanatic}) and his two quiet {@creature mastiff||mastiffs}. The Gralhunds paid a necromancer to perform a ritual on Hurv and his mastiffs. After sundown, the physical forms of these figures melt away, and they become three {@creature shadow||shadows} until dawn. Characters who succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity (Stealth) check can cross the yard without being detected. Otherwise, Hurv and his hounds detect the characters and attack, day or night.
zh_tw: 這個院子由一個名叫赫夫·塔爾德里德（LE男性伊路斯坎人 {@creature cult fanatic||邪教狂信者}）的威脅性看管人照看，還有他的兩隻安靜 {@creature mastiff||獒犬}。格勞洪德家族僱用了一名死靈師對赫夫和他的獒犬進行了一個儀式。日落後，這些生物的實體形態會消失，變成三個 {@creature shadow||幽影}，直到黎明。成功透過 {@dc 13}敏捷（隱匿）檢定的人物可以穿越院子而不被察覺。否則，無論白天還是夜晚，赫夫和他的獵犬都會察覺到人物並發動攻擊。

english: G3. Coach House
zh_tw: G3. 馬車房

english: This stone building contains a beautifully maintained coach and clean stables that house four {@creature draft horse||draft horses} and Lady Gralhund's jet-black {@creature riding horse}, named Maladar. A sliding wooden door bars access to the street and has a padlock on the outside that holds it shut. Picking the lock requires a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check using thieves' tools.
zh_tw: 這座石制建築內有一輛保養精美的馬車和乾淨的馬廄，馬廄中養著四匹{@creature draft horse||馱用馬}以及格勞洪德夫人的純黑色{@creature riding horse||乘用馬}，名為馬拉達。一扇滑動木門將街道隔開，門外有一把掛鎖將門鎖住。使用盜賊工具進行一次成功的{@dc 20}敏捷檢定即可撬開鎖具。

english: The larger room north of the stables contains tack and harness for each horse, as well as bales of hay and yard tools. The smaller room in the northwest corner has two cots: one for the groundskeeper, Hurv (see {@area G2|0f6}), who sleeps during the day, and one for a stableboy named Ike ({@creature commoner}), who sleeps here at night. Ike is away (either picking up food for the horses or out drinking with friends) if the characters arrive during the day.
zh_tw: 馬廄北邊的大房間存放著每匹馬的馬具和挽具，還有成捆的乾草和園藝工具。西北角的小房間有兩張簡易床：一張是給白天睡覺的園丁赫爾夫（見{@area G2|0f6}）的，另一張是給名叫艾克（{@creature commoner||平民}）的馬伕的，他晚上在這裡睡覺。如果角色們在白天到達，艾克不在這裡（可能去為馬匹取食物或與朋友外出喝酒）。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Lady Gralhund's horse is outfitted with {@item horseshoes of speed} and two saddlebags, each of which holds four 5-pound gold trade bars worth 250 gp each.
zh_tw: 格勞洪德女士的馬裝備了{@item horseshoes of speed||加速馬蹄鐵}（加速馬蹄鐵），並且有兩個馬鞍袋，每個袋子裡裝有四塊重5磅、價值250金幣的金條。

english: G4. Guard Barracks
zh_tw: G4. 警衛營房

english: This one-story stone building attached to the mansion serves as quarters for twenty house guards. The main room contains ten bunk beds. Each comes with a pair of footlockers containing folded clothes and worthless personal effects.
zh_tw: 這座與大廈相連的單層石制建築是二十名家丁的宿舍。主房間有十張上下鋪。每張床都配有一個腳鎖箱，裡面裝有摺疊衣服和無價值的個人物品。

english: The room in the northwest corner contains wooden mannequins and racks designed to hold armor and weapons. Since there are no guards present, the mannequins and racks are bare.
zh_tw: 位於西北角的房間內有木質模特和架子，這些架子設計用來放置盔甲和武器。由於沒有警衛在場，模特和架子都是空的。

english: G5. Kitchen
zh_tw: G5. 廚房

english: An unlocked wooden door leads from the yard to the mansion's kitchen, which is stocked with cookware and utensils. A large fireplace is used for cooking meals.
zh_tw: 一扇未上鎖的木門從院子通向宅邸的廚房，廚房裡存放著烹飪用具和餐具。一個大型壁爐用於烹飪餐食。

english: G6. Pantry
zh_tw: G6. 食品儲藏室

english: This pantry is lined with shelves containing dry foodstuffs, spices, folded tablecloths, and jars of preserves. Casks of fresh water, ale, and wine are also stored here.
zh_tw: 這個食品儲藏室的架子上擺滿了幹食品、香料、摺疊的桌布和果醬罐。這裡還存放著新鮮水、麥芽酒和葡萄酒的木桶。

english: Barred Door
zh_tw: 橫閂門

english: A back door leads out to the street. This sturdy wooden door is barred shut on the inside. Forcing it open from the outside requires a successful {@dc 20} Strength (Athletics) check and makes a lot of noise.
zh_tw: 一扇後門通向街道。這扇堅固的木門從內部被閂上了。從外部強行開啟需要成功進行一次 {@dc 20} 力量（運動）檢定，並且會發出很大的噪音。

english: Corpses
zh_tw: 屍體

english: The Zhents have killed two servants, an older male human (the head butler) and a younger male halfling (a cook), and left their bodies on the floor.
zh_tw: 散塔林會成員殺害了兩名僕人，一個年長的男性人類（首席管家）和一個年輕的男性半身人（廚師），並將他們的屍體留在了地板上。

english: G7. Laundry Room
zh_tw: G7. 洗衣房

english: This room is where servants wash clothing. It contains scrub buckets, wash basins, {@item soap|PHB}, mops, and chamber pots.
zh_tw: 這個房間是僕人們洗衣服的地方。裡面有擦洗桶、洗滌盆、{@item soap|PHB|肥皂}、拖把和便壺。

english: Corpses
zh_tw: 屍體

english: The Zhents have killed a servant, a middle-aged female human (the head maid), and left her body on the stairs leading up to the servants' quarters ({@area G19|119}). The maid has a ring of keys on her belt that opens all the locked doors in the mansion as well as the cabinets in {@area G8|102}.
zh_tw: 散塔林會成員殺害了一名僕人，一位中年女性人類（首席女僕），並將她的屍體留在通往僕人宿舍（{@area G19|119}）的樓梯上。女僕的腰帶上有一個鑰匙圈，可以開啟大廈內所有鎖著的門以及{@area G8|102}中的櫥櫃。

english: G8. Great Hall
zh_tw: G8. 大廳

english: Characters who enter this hall for the first time notice the following:
zh_tw: 首次進入這個大廳的角色會注意到以下情況：

english: The floor is strewn with bodies. Two {@creature thug||thugs} holding bloody maces stand over them.
zh_tw: 地板上散落著屍體。兩個手持血跡斑斑的連枷的{@creature thug||暴徒}站在他們上方。

english: The sound of fighting can be heard coming from the top of a wide staircase in the northwest corner (see {@area G13|10d}).
zh_tw: 從西北角的一座寬闊樓梯頂部傳來打鬥聲（見{@area G13|10d}）。

english: Two iron chandeliers hang from the dark mahogany ceiling above a long dining table carved from red larchwood. Chairs surround the table, with a particularly tall and elaborate chair at each end.
zh_tw: 兩個鐵製吊燈懸掛在由紅冷杉木製成的長餐桌上方的深紅色桃花心木天花板上。椅子圍繞著桌子，兩端各有一把特別高大且精緻的椅子。

english: Lining the wood-paneled walls are tapestries and locked wooden cabinets that contain fine dishes, silverware, and candlesticks.
zh_tw: 木鑲板牆壁上掛著掛毯和鎖著的木櫃，裡面存放著精美的餐具、銀器和燭臺。

english: A fireplace with a black marble mantelpiece has a framed family portrait mounted above it. (The portrait depicts Lord and Lady Gralhund, their three young children, and a family dog that died three years ago.)
zh_tw: 壁爐上方有一個黑色大理石壁爐架，上面掛著一幅裝裱的家庭肖像畫。（這幅肖像畫描繪了格勞洪德勳爵和夫人，他們的三個年幼的孩子，以及三年前去世的家庭狗。）

english: Corpses
zh_tw: 屍體

english: Lying about the room are the bodies of eight guards wearing bloody and tattered House Gralhund livery over their chain shirts, as well as two dead Zhents in black leather armor. All are humans.
zh_tw: 大廳裡躺著八名身穿血跡斑斑、破爛不堪的格勞洪德家族制服，覆蓋在鎖子甲上的守衛屍體，以及兩名身穿黑色皮甲的死去的散塔林會成員。他們都是人類。

english: Thugs
zh_tw: 暴徒

english: The two figures with maces are Zhents clad in black leather armor. Their orders are to hold the room. They attack strangers, including members of the City Watch, on sight. They carry no treasure.
zh_tw: 手持連枷的兩個身影是穿著黑色皮甲的散塔林會成員。他們的任務是守住這個房間。他們一見到陌生人，包括城市守衛的成員，就會攻擊。他們身上沒有攜帶任何財寶。

english: G9. Parlor
zh_tw: G9. 客廳

english: {@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh} was confined here when he returned to the villa, but shortly thereafter he killed his guards and escaped. The room is furnished for comfort and contains dainty chairs, a chaise longue, a wine cabinet, and framed paintings of various long-dead members of the Gralhund family.
zh_tw: {@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh|厄斯圖爾·弗洛克辛}回到別墅後被關押在這裡，但不久之後他殺死了守衛並逃脫了。這個房間佈置得很舒適，裡面有精緻的椅子、一張躺椅、一個酒櫃，以及格勞洪德家族已故成員的各種裝裱畫作。

english: Corpses
zh_tw: 屍體

english: The bodies of the two guards lie atop blood-soaked rugs. The guards wear chain shirts and the livery of House Gralhund.
zh_tw: 兩名衛兵的屍體躺在浸滿鮮血的地毯上。衛兵們身穿鍊甲衫和格勞洪德家族的制服。

english: G10. Den and Trophy Room
zh_tw: G10. 休息室和戰利品室

english: Lord Gralhund's den has the heads of various beasts mounted on the walls and gleaming suits of armor standing at attention in the corners. Bearskin rugs and overstuffed chairs fill the room.
zh_tw: 格勞洪德勳爵的書房牆上掛著各種野獸的頭顱，角落裡擺放著閃亮的盔甲，彷彿在行禮。熊皮地毯和填充過多的椅子填滿了整個房間。

english: Lord Gralhund recently took up falconry as a hobby. In the middle of the room, resting on a table, is a cage containing a hooded {@creature falcon|WDH} (use {@creature hawk} statistics).
zh_tw: 格勞洪德勳爵最近把養鷹作為一項愛好。在房間中央的桌子上，放著一個籠子，裡面關著一隻戴頭罩的{@creature hawk||隼}（使用{@creature falcon|WDH|獵鷹}的具體數值）。

english: G11. Orond's Study
zh_tw: G11. 奧隆德的書房

english: The door to this room is locked. The lock can be picked by a character who makes a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check using thieves' tools. The room has these features:
zh_tw: 這個房間的門上了鎖。角色可以使用盜賊工具並透過{@dc 15}的敏捷檢定來解鎖。房間具有以下特徵：

english: A 10-foot-square canvas wrestling mat is sprawled on the floor in the middle of the room.
zh_tw: 房間中央的地面上鋪著一個10尺見方的帆布摔跤墊。

english: Velvet armchairs, small statues of naked men on pedestals, and tall mahogany bookshelves are arranged neatly around the room.
zh_tw: 天鵝絨扶手椅、底座上裸體男子的小雕像，以及高高的桃花心木書架整齊地擺放在房間周圍。

english: A mahogany desk in one corner doesn't look like it sees much use.
zh_tw: 一個角落中的桃花心木辦公桌看起來並不常使用。

english: Books
zh_tw: 書籍

english: Most of the books are fake boxes made of painted cardboard. A few have bawdy drawings and salacious poems hidden inside them.
zh_tw: 大多數書籍是紙板製成的假書盒，上面塗有油漆。少數書籍內藏有猥褻的圖畫和淫穢的詩歌。

english: G12. Family Library
zh_tw: G12. 家庭圖書館

english: The wood-paneled library includes these features:
zh_tw: 這個木鑲板的圖書室包括以下特點：

english: Tall bookshelves are packed with tomes. Sliding wooden ladders mounted on rails allow easy access to higher shelves.
zh_tw: 高大的書架上擺滿了書籍。滑動的木製梯子安裝在軌道上，方便取閱上層的書架。

english: In one corner stands an iron lectern with a closed, locked, leather-bound tome resting on it.
zh_tw: 在一個角落裡，有一個鐵製的講臺，上面放著一個閉合的、上鎖的、皮革裝幀的大書。

english: Two padded chairs face a large fireplace. One has a wolf skin draped over it.
zh_tw: 兩張墊子椅子面對著一個大型壁爐。其中一個上面搭著一張狼皮。

english: Books
zh_tw: 書籍

english: Many of the books were handed down to Lady Gralhund by her parents, and they are well kept. They include historical texts, play scripts, novels, and poetry collections.
zh_tw: 這些書籍中的許多是格勞洪德女士的父母傳給她的，它們儲存得很好。包括歷史文獻、劇本、小說和詩集。

english: Locked Tome
zh_tw: 上鎖的寶典

english: Although it looks like it might be a spellbook, the tome on the lectern is a chronicle of the Gralhund family's accomplishments, embellished or recast to paint the family in the most favorable light. A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals an aura of abjuration magic emanating from the tome.
zh_tw: 儘管看起來可能是一本魔法書，但講臺上的大書實際上是記錄格勞洪德家族成就的編年史，經過修飾或重鑄，以最有利的方式描繪這個家族。一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術揭示了從大書中發出的防護魔法的氣息。

english: The tome is meant to be unlocked using a key that Lady Gralhund wears on a chain around her neck. The lock can be picked by a character who succeeds on a {@dc 15} Dexterity check using thieves' tools, or it can be opened with a {@spell knock} spell or similar magic. Opening the book by any means other than using the proper key causes three {@creature specter||specters} to appear within 10 feet of the book and attack its opener. The magic that binds the specters has weakened over time; they can exist on the Material Plane for only 1 minute, after which time they are banished to the Ethereal Plane (unless destroyed first). The specters manifest as ghostly tieflings with elongated fingers.
zh_tw: 這本典籍需要使用格勞洪德女士掛在脖子上的鑰匙來解鎖。角色可以使用盜賊工具成功透過{@dc 15}的敏捷檢定來開鎖，或者使用{@spell knock||敲擊術}法術或類似的魔法來開啟它。任何不使用正確鑰匙開啟書籍的方式都會導致三隻{@creature specter||惡靈}出現在書籍10尺範圍內，並攻擊開啟它的人。束縛這些幽靈的魔法已經隨著時間的推移而減弱；它們只能在物質位面存在1分鐘，之後它們會被放逐到以太位面（除非在此之前被消滅）。這些幽靈顯現為手指細長的幽靈形態的提夫林。

english: The Gralhund family crest appears on the book's title page. The rest of the book is written in Common and describes births, deaths, and other family events between 1239 DR, the Year of the Bloodied Sword, and 1422 DR, the Year of Advancing Shadows. Of particular note is the little-known fact that the Gralhunds forged pacts with devils in years past, giving rise to a strain of tieflings. All such members of the house were sent to live on a Gralhund estate in Yartar, a city far to the north (or so the book claims in its epilogue), and there are passing references to some Waterdavian family members having been born with tails.
zh_tw: 格勞洪德家族的徽章出現在書的標題頁上。書中其餘部分用通用語寫成，描述了從1239 DR年，流血之劍年，到1422 DR年，陰影前進年之間的出生、死亡和其他家族事件。特別值得注意的是，書中鮮為人知的事實是格勞洪德家族在過去與魔鬼締結了契約，由此產生了一種提夫林血統。所有這樣的家族成員都被送往遠在北方的亞塔的格勞洪德莊園生活（或者書的尾聲中是這樣聲稱的），並且書中還順便提到了一些水源家族成員出生時帶有尾巴。

english: {@creature Urstul Floxin|WDH}
zh_tw: {@creature Urstul Floxin|WDH|厄斯圖爾·弗洛克辛}

english: G13. Upstairs Foyer
zh_tw: G13. 二樓門廳

english: A lot is happening in this elegant foyer:
zh_tw: 這個優雅的門廳裡發生了許多事情：

english: A battle rages between several Zhents and house guards, and the floor is strewn with dead bodies.
zh_tw: 散塔林會成員和家丁之間的戰鬥激烈進行，地板上散落著屍體。

english: Doors to the master bedroom ({@area G16|113}) stand open. (If Lady Gralhund is in the master bedroom, she shouts, "The City Watch is on the way!")
zh_tw: 主臥室的門（{@area G16|113}）敞開著。（如果格勞洪德夫人在主臥室，她會喊：'城市守衛正在路上！'）

english: The door to area G15a is ajar. Beyond it, characters can hear someone putting a boot to another door.
zh_tw: 通往G15a區域的門是半開的。在門的另一邊，角色們可以聽到有人正在踢另一扇門。

english: Corpses
zh_tw: 屍體

english: Lying on the floor are the corpses and weapons of six guards wearing House Gralhund livery over chain shirts and two Zhents in black leather armor.
zh_tw: 地板上躺著六名身穿格勞洪德家族制服、鎖子甲的守衛的屍體和武器，以及兩名身穿黑色皮甲的散塔林會成員。

english: Fight in Progress
zh_tw: 正在進行的戰鬥

english: Four {@creature veteran||veterans} of House Gralhund (each with 30 hit points remaining) are fighting off an attacking force of Zhents consisting of three {@creature thug||thugs} (each with 20 hit points remaining). The Zhents are trying to get to {@area G16|113}, but the guards are blocking them.
zh_tw: 格勞洪德家族的四名{@creature veteran||老兵}（每名剩餘30生命值）正在抵禦散塔林會成員的攻擊，攻擊方由三名{@creature thug||暴徒}組成（每名剩餘20生命值）。散塔林會成員試圖到達{@area G16|113}，但守衛們正在阻擋他們。

english: If the characters do nothing to affect the outcome of this fight, assume that it ends with three House Gralhund veterans still alive and all the Zhents dead.
zh_tw: 如果角色們沒有采取任何行動來影響這場戰鬥的結果，假設戰鬥以三名格勞洪德家族的老兵存活和所有散塔林會成員死亡結束。

english: G14. Ballroom
zh_tw: G14. 舞廳

english: The door to this room is locked. A character using thieves' tools can pick the lock with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check. The ballroom is unoccupied and contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間的門是鎖著的。使用盜賊工具的角色可以透過一個成功的 {@dc 15} 敏捷檢定來開鎖。舞廳是空的，並包含以下特徵：

english: Gilded mirrors, tasseled tapestries, and stained-glass lamps festoon the walls. Mounted above a fireplace is a stag's head made of blown glass.
zh_tw: 鍍金的鏡子、飾有流蘇的掛毯和彩色玻璃燈具裝飾著牆壁。壁爐上方掛著一隻由吹制玻璃製成的鹿頭。

english: The veined marble floor is polished to a mirror-like sheen.
zh_tw: 大理石地板上的紋理清晰可見，拋光得像鏡子一樣光亮。

english: Tacky crystal chandeliers dangle from the ceiling, which has a mural depicting an orgy painted on it.
zh_tw: 俗氣的水晶吊燈懸掛在天花板上，天花板上畫著一幅描繪狂歡的壁畫。

english: G15. Guest Suite
zh_tw: G15. 客房套房

english: Until recently, this suite was set aside for the use of {@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh}. Lord Gralhund has barricaded himself in area G15b, using heavy furniture to block the door. Forcing it open requires a successful {@dc 18} Strength (Athletics) check.
zh_tw: 直到最近，這套房間是為{@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh|厄斯圖爾·弗洛克辛}保留的。格勞洪德領主已將自己封鎖在G15b區域，用沉重的傢俱堵住了門。強行開啟需要進行一次成功的{@dc 18}力量（運動）檢定。

english: The characters encounter {@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) in area G15a. Urstul is wounded with 50 hit points remaining and has no poison coating his weapons, reducing his challenge rating to 3 (700 XP). He's trying to kick open the door to area G15b in a desperate attempt to capture Lord Gralhund and trade him for the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}. If he is accosted before reaching Lord Gralhund, Urstul tries to flee the villa and uses any other surviving Zhents to cover his escape. He knows the same information that Lord Gralhund does (see "{@creature Orond Gralhund|wdh}" below) but won't divulge it or the name of his master, {@creature Manshoon|WDH}, unless he's magically compelled to do so.
zh_tw: 角色們在G15a區域遇到了{@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh|厄斯圖爾·弗洛克辛}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）。厄斯圖爾受傷了，剩餘50生命值，並且他的武器上沒有塗毒，這降低了他的挑戰等級到3（700 XP）。他正試圖踢開G15b區域的門，拼命地想要抓住格勞洪德勳爵，用他來交換{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}。如果他在到達格勞洪德勳爵之前被攔截，厄斯圖爾會試圖逃離別墅，並利用其他倖存的散塔林會成員來掩護他的逃跑。他知道與格勞洪德勳爵相同的資訊（見下面的"{@creature Orond Gralhund|wdh|奧隆德·格勞洪德}"），除非他被魔法強迫，否則他不會透露這些資訊或他的主人{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的名字。

english: Area G15a is a bathroom. A curtain to the east has been drawn back, revealing a claw-footed bathtub.
zh_tw: 區域G15a是一個浴室。東側的簾子已經被拉到一邊，露出了一個爪足浴缸。

english: Area G15b is a wood-paneled bedchamber with a birdcage on a table and a permanent teleportation circle inscribed on the floor. The birdcage contains three {@creature flying snake||flying snakes} that Urstul uses to deliver messages to his spies throughout the city. The circle is used by {@creature Manshoon|WDH} to meet secretly with {@creature Urstul Floxin|WDH} and to teleport Zhents to and from Kolat Towers (see chapter 8). See the {@spell teleportation circle} spell description in the {@book Player's Handbook|phb} for more information on how the circle functions.
zh_tw: 區域G15b是一個鑲有木板的臥室，桌上有一個鳥籠，地板上刻有一個永久的傳送法陣。鳥籠裡裝有三隻{@creature flying snake||飛蛇}，厄斯圖爾用它們在城市中傳遞資訊給他的間諜。這個圈由{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}使用，以秘密會見{@creature Urstul Floxin|WDH|厄斯圖爾·弗洛克辛}，並傳送散塔林會成員往返於克拉特塔（見第8章）。有關圈的運作方式的更多資訊，請參閱{@book 玩家手冊|phb}中的{@spell teleportation circle||傳送法陣}法術描述。

english: Orond Gralhund
zh_tw: 奧隆德·格勞洪德

english: Having blocked the bedroom door with a wardrobe, a desk, and an overstuffed chair, {@creature Orond Gralhund|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) cowers behind a bed in the southwest corner of area G15b. Although he's armed with a rapier, Orond throws himself at the mercy of the first person to bust through his barricade.
zh_tw: 用衣櫃、書桌和一張塞得滿滿的椅子堵住臥室門之後，{@creature Orond Gralhund|wdh|奧隆德·格勞洪德}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）蜷縮在G15b區域西南角的床後面。儘管他手持一把刺劍，但奧隆德向第一個突破他設定的路障的人求饒。

english: Characters who have Lord Gralhund at their mercy can pry the following information from him with a successful {@dc 10} Charisma (Intimidation) check, but the check is made with disadvantage if Lord Gralhund has reason to believe his wife can see or overhear the conversation:
zh_tw: 任何能夠控制格勞洪德勳爵的角色，可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 10} 魅力（威嚇）檢定從他那裡撬出以下資訊，但如果格勞洪德勳爵有理由相信他的妻子能看見或偷聽到對話，則檢定時帶有劣勢。

english: "The {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} is some kind of ancient creature transformed into an artifact. It knows the location of a hidden vault in Waterdeep containing half a million dragons."
zh_tw: "{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石} 是某種古老的生物轉變而成的神器。它知道隱藏在深水城的一個金庫的位置，裡面藏有五十萬龍幣。"

english: "House Gralhund has been bankrolling Black Network operations in Waterdeep, including the plot to kidnap {@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh} and the plot to steal the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} from his father's gnome spy, Dalakhar."
zh_tw: "格勞洪德家族一直在資助深水城的黑網行動，包括策劃綁架{@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh|瑞納爾·無燼}以及從他父親的侏儒間諜達拉卡爾那裡竊取{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}的計劃。"

english: "My wife was frustrated with the Zhents and their inability to secure the artifact. She gave a {@item necklace of fireballs} to her mechanical servant and sent it out to help retrieve the stone. It was careless and caught the Zhents in the fireball by mistake."
zh_tw: "我妻子對散塔林會成員及其無法確保神器安全感到沮喪。她給了她的機械僕人一個{@item necklace of fireballs||火球項鍊}，並派它出去幫助取回石頭。這是疏忽的，不小心用火球術擊中了散塔林會成員。"

english: G16. Master Bedroom
zh_tw: G16. 主臥室

english: The doors to this room have been thrown open. The room contains the following occupants and features:
zh_tw: 這間房間的門已經被推開。房間裡包含以下居住者和特點：

english: {@creature Yalah Gralhund|wdh}, wearing a breastplate and armed with a rapier, stands next to her well-dressed half-orc bodyguard, {@creature Hrabbaz|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12} for their statistics).
zh_tw: {@creature Yalah Gralhund|wdh|雅拉·格勞洪德}，穿著胸甲，手持一把細劍，站在她打扮得體的半獸人保鏢{@creature Hrabbaz|WDH|哈巴茲}旁邊（他們的狀態見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）。

english: A locked wooden trunk rests at the foot of a large, canopied bed in the southwest corner.
zh_tw: 一個鎖著的木製箱子位於西南角一個大床的床腳處。

english: A claw-footed bathtub sits in the northwest alcove near a freestanding mirror and a privacy screen.
zh_tw: 一個爪足浴缸位於西北角的凹室裡，靠近一個獨立式鏡子和一個屏風。

english: Hanging above a fireplace in the southeast corner is a shield that bears the Gralhund coat of arms. Logs are stacked neatly next to the hearth.
zh_tw: 在東南角壁爐上方掛著一面盾牌，上面刻有格勞洪德家族的紋章。木柴整齊地堆放在爐邊。

english: A tall mahogany wardrobe stuffed with expensive gowns and dress clothes stands next to a pair of open glass doors leading out to a balcony.
zh_tw: 一個高大的桃花心木衣櫃裡塞滿了昂貴的禮服和正裝，它位於一對通往陽臺的開放式玻璃門旁邊。

english: Yalah Gralhund
zh_tw: 雅拉·格勞洪德

english: Lady Gralhund gave the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} and a map of where to take it to her {@creature nimblewright|wdh} servant, who has left the villa by the time the characters reach this chamber. Its escape is crucial, since it sets into motion the events in chapter 4.
zh_tw: 格勞洪德夫人將{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}和一張目的地地圖交給了她的{@creature nimblewright|wdh|秘偶}僕人，當角色們到達這個房間時，這個秘偶已經離開了別墅。它的逃跑至關重要，因為這觸發了第四章中的事件。

english: Lady Gralhund and {@creature Hrabbaz|WDH} are the only people who know where the nimblewright has gone, but they feign ignorance when questioned about it.
zh_tw: 格勞洪德夫人和 {@creature Hrabbaz|WDH|哈巴茲} 是唯一知道秘偶去了哪裡的人，但當被問及此事時，他們裝作一無所知。

english: {@creature Yalah Gralhund|wdh|Yalah} carries a ring of keys that open all locked doors in the mansion, as well as the locked wooden trunk at the foot of the bed. If her situation turns dire and {@creature Hrabbaz|WDH} is unable to protect her, Yalah unlocks the door to {@area G18|117}, rushes inside, and locks the door behind her with her next action. She makes her final stand there, with her children cowering behind her.
zh_tw: {@creature Yalah Gralhund|wdh|雅拉} 攜帶一串能開啟宅邸內所有上鎖門的鑰匙環，以及床尾上鎖的木箱。如果她的處境變得危急，而{@creature Hrabbaz|WDH|哈巴茲}無法保護她，雅拉會開啟通向{@area G18|117}的門，衝進去，並在她的下一個動作中用鑰匙鎖上門。她在那裡做最後的抵抗，她的孩子在她身後畏縮。

english: Wooden Trunk
zh_tw: 木製行李箱

english: The lock on the trunk can be picked with thieves' tools and a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check. The trunk appears to contain folded clothes and shoes. A secret compartment in the bottom can be detected by someone who examines the outside of the trunk and makes a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check. The compartment holds two holy symbols of Asmodeus and two robes, each red and gold in color.
zh_tw: 這個箱子的鎖可以用盜賊工具開啟，並且需要進行一次成功的{@dc 15}敏捷檢定。箱子裡面似乎裝著摺疊好的衣服和鞋子。箱底有一個隱秘的隔間，如果有檢查箱子外部的人並且進行了一次成功的{@dc 15}感知（感知）檢定，就可以發現這個隔間。隔間裡裝著兩個阿斯蒙蒂斯的神聖象徵和兩件紅金色的長袍。

english: Lord and Lady Gralhund are both secret members of a cult of Asmodeus worshipers popular among select nobles in Waterdeep. The cult is led by Lord {@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), though the Gralhunds won't divulge this information willingly.
zh_tw: 格勞洪德勳爵和夫人都是阿斯蒙蒂斯崇拜者的秘密成員，這個邪教在深水城的某些貴族中很受歡迎。該邪教由勳爵{@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH|維克托羅·卡薩蘭特}領導（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），儘管格勞洪德家族不會自願透露這些資訊。

english: G17. Balcony
zh_tw: G17. 陽臺

english: This large balcony is enclosed by an ornate wrought iron railing and has lounge chairs neatly arranged on it. The ground is 20 feet below, and open glass doors lead to the master bedroom ({@area G16|113}).
zh_tw: 這個寬敞的陽臺被一個精美的鑄鐵欄杆圍住，上面整齊地擺放著躺椅。地面在20尺以下，開放式的玻璃門通向主臥室（{@area G16|113}）。

english: G18. Children's Room
zh_tw: G18. 兒童房

english: The door to this room is locked. The lock can be picked with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check using thieves' tools.
zh_tw: 通往這個房間的門被鎖上了。使用盜賊工具進行一次成功的 {@dc 15} 敏捷檢定可以撬開鎖。

english: Three beds line the south wall, and an empty cradle rests against the east wall. Other furnishings include squat wardrobes, play rugs, and children's desks.
zh_tw: 三張床沿著南牆排列，一個空的搖籃靠在東牆上。其他的傢俱包括矮衣櫃、遊戲地毯和兒童書桌。

english: Children
zh_tw: 子嗣

english: Confined here for their safety are the Gralhunds' two youngest children, a 13-year-old boy named Zartan and a 10-year-old boy named Greth. Both are noncombatants. Their 18-year-old sister, Tomassin, is visiting a tiefling cousin in Yartar.
zh_tw: 格勞洪德家族的兩個最年幼的孩子，一個名叫扎坦的13歲男孩和一個名叫格雷斯的10歲男孩，被關在這裡以確保他們的安全。他們兩個都是非戰鬥人員。他們18歲的姐姐託馬辛正在亞塔訪問一個提夫林表親。

english: G19. Servants' Wing
zh_tw: G19. 僕人區

english: Three rooms in the southeast area of the upper floor are where the servants sleep at night. The head butler and head maid have rooms to themselves, but those places are currently unoccupied. The largest of the three chambers is a common room containing six bunk beds for the junior staff. A total of nine maids, cooks, and valets ({@creature commoner||commoners}) are holed up here, waiting for someone to rescue them. They are armed with improvised weapons (rolling pins, mops, brooms, and the like) that are treated as clubs.
zh_tw: 上層東南區域的三個房間是僕人們夜間睡覺的地方。首席管家和首席女僕有自己的房間，但這些地方目前無人居住。三個房間中最大的一個是公共休息室，裡面有六張上下鋪供初級員工使用。總共有九名女僕、廚師和貼身男僕（{@creature commoner||平民}）躲藏在這裡，等待有人來救援他們。他們手持臨時武器（擀麵杖、拖把、掃帚等），這些武器被視為棍棒。

english: Aftermath
zh_tw: 後續

english: After fleeing Gralhund Villa with the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, Lady Gralhund's {@creature nimblewright|wdh} hides the artifact in a secret location in Waterdeep, setting the stage for chapter 4.
zh_tw: 帶著{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}逃離格勞洪德別墅後，格勞洪德夫人的{@creature nimblewright|wdh|秘偶}將神器藏在了深水城的一個秘密地點，為第4章的情節埋下伏筆。

english: Even if the bloody conflict at Gralhund Villa goes unnoticed outside the walls of the estate, the carnage can't be hidden from the City Watch for long. There are too many murdered servants and guards for anyone to conceal what has transpired. The arrival of the City Watch foreshadows the return of {@creature Barnibus Blastwind|WDH} and {@creature Saeth Cromley|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), who arrive in due course with twenty constables ({@creature veteran||veterans}) and two {@creature griffon cavalry rider|WDH|Griffon Cavalry riders} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) astride {@creature griffon||griffons}. The griffons and their riders remain airborne, providing aerial support and reconnaissance.
zh_tw: 即使格勞洪德別墅內的血腥衝突在莊園牆外未被注意到，屠殺也不能長時間對城市守衛隱瞞。有太多被謀殺的僕人和守衛，任何人都無法隱瞞所發生的事情。城市守衛的到來預示著{@creature Barnibus Blastwind|WDH|巴尼布斯·陣風}和{@creature Saeth Cromley|wdh|薩斯·克姆利}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）的迴歸，他們不久後帶著二十名警官（{@creature veteran||老兵}）和兩名{@creature griffon cavalry rider|WDH|獅鷲騎兵騎手}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）騎著{@creature griffon||獅鷲}到達。獅鷲和它們的騎手保持在空中，提供空中支援和偵察。

english: Barnibus thoroughly investigates the Gralhund Villa crime scene and questions neighbors and bystanders. Characters who are seen leaving the scene become suspects. If the characters killed any members of the Gralhund family and left witnesses or evidence of the act, Barnibus instructs {@creature Sergeant|WDH} Cromley to arrest them for the crime of murdering a noble, which carries a death sentence if they're found guilty.
zh_tw: 巴尼布斯徹底調查了格勞洪德別墅的犯罪現場，並詢問了鄰居和旁觀者。被看到離開現場的角色會成為嫌疑人。如果角色們殺害了格勞洪德家族的任何成員，並留下了行為的證人或證據，巴尼布斯指示{@creature Sergeant|WDH|軍士} 克姆利以謀殺貴族的罪名逮捕他們，如果被判有罪，這將被判處死刑。

english: Loose Ends
zh_tw: 未了事宜

english: You can use the following optional event to address what happens to the Zhentarim in the aftermath.
zh_tw: 您可以使用以下可選事件來處理散塔林會在餘波中發生了什麼。

english: Bad Time to Be a Zhent
zh_tw: 成為散提爾堡成員的糟糕時刻

english: Within days after the events that local broadsheets dub the "Gralhund Villa Bloodbath," the City Watch cracks down on the Black Network. Even members of the Zhentarim who have no known criminal ties are rounded up and interrogated, including {@creature Davil Starsong|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}). Characters who are members of the faction are safe for the time being, as long as they keep a low profile. Otherwise, they too are rounded up and questioned over a period of several days, until the Lords of Waterdeep ascertain their level of involvement in the violence at Gralhund Villa. The broadsheets jump on the bandwagon by portraying the Black Network in the most unflattering light, thus dealing a crippling blow to the faction's already questionable reputation.
zh_tw: 在被當地報紙稱為"格勞洪德別墅大屠殺"的事件發生幾天後，城市守衛對黑網展開了打擊。即使是沒有已知犯罪聯絡的散塔林會成員也遭到圍捕和審訊，包括{@creature Davil Starsong|WDH|達維爾·星歌}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）。只要保持低調，該派系的成員暫時是安全的。否則，他們也會在幾天內被圍捕和審問，直到深水城的領主們確定他們在格勞洪德別墅的暴力事件中的參與程度。報紙也跟風，以最不光彩的方式描繪黑網，從而對派系本已可疑的聲譽造成了致命打擊。

english: Encounter with Istrid Horn
zh_tw: 與伊思崔德·霍恩的遭遇

english: This encounter occurs only if the characters were directly involved in the events that transpired at Gralhund Villa. After {@creature Davil Starsong|WDH} is taken in for questioning, {@creature Istrid Horn|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) sends a message to the characters by way of a {@creature flying snake}. The message, written in Common, reads as follows:
zh_tw: 如果角色直接參與了格勞洪德別墅發生的事件，這次遭遇才會發生。在{@creature Davil Starsong|WDH|達維爾·星歌}被帶去審問之後，{@creature Istrid Horn|WDH|伊思崔德·霍恩}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）透過一隻{@creature flying snake||飛蛇}向角色們傳送了一條訊息。這條用通用語寫成的訊息內容如下：

english: I would like to know more about what happened at Gralhund Villa. If you can spare the time, meet me at Ahghairon's Statue in the City of the Dead at highsun tomorrow. You'll be paid generously for your time and trouble.
zh_tw: 我想知道更多關於格勞洪德別墅發生的事情。如果你能抽出時間，明天正午在亡者之城的阿蓋爾倫雕像處與我見面。你將因為你的時間和麻煩得到慷慨的報酬。

english: -{@creature Istrid Horn|WDH}
zh_tw: -{@creature Istrid Horn|WDH|伊思崔德·霍恩}

english: If the characters attend the meeting, use the following boxed text to help set the scene, embellishing it to reflect the season:
zh_tw: 如果角色們參加會面，請使用以下框起來的文字來幫助設定場景，並根據季節進行修飾：

english: Ahghairon's Statue is a well-known landmark in the city's parkland cemetery: a tall, marble sculpture of a bearded, robed wizard standing atop concentric steps and facing west toward the skyline of Waterdeep, his hands outstretched and a broad smile on his face. At the foot of the statue stands a female dwarf clad in plate armor.
zh_tw: 阿蓋爾倫的雕像是城市公園墓地中一個著名的地標：一座高大的大理石雕塑，描繪的是一位長著鬍鬚、穿著長袍的法師站在同心臺階上，面朝西方，朝向深水城的天際線，雙手伸展，面頻寬慰的微笑。在雕像的底部站著一位穿著板甲的女矮人。

english: If the weather is fair, characters can see pedestrians, picnickers, and frolicking children throughout the cemetery grounds. It's clear that Istrid chose a safe, public place for the meeting. Characters who succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom (Insight) check can tell that she came alone.
zh_tw: 如果天氣晴朗，角色們可以看到墓園中散步的行人、野餐的人以及嬉戲的孩子們。很明顯，伊思崔德選擇了一個安全的公共場所進行會面。成功透過{@dc 15}感知（洞悉）檢定的角色可以判斷出她是獨自前來。

english: Istrid fears being arrested by the City Watch. Although she wasn't involved in the matters concerning Gralhund Villa, she is worried that the Watch will uncover her illegal currency-lending operation in the course of its investigations. She offers the characters 10 pp just for meeting with her and promises another 40 pp if the characters agree to help her lie low for a tenday-half to be paid once a deal is struck and half at the end of her stay. If they decline her offer and the party includes one or more Zhentarim members, she threatens that if she's arrested and charged with a crime, she will reveal their affiliation and bring them down with her.
zh_tw: 伊思崔德擔心被城市守衛逮捕。儘管她沒有參與與格勞洪德別墅有關的事務，但她擔心在調查過程中，守衛會發現她非法放貸的生意。她向角色們提供10pp，僅僅是為了與她見面，並承諾如果角色們同意幫助她低調十天，她會再支付40pp——一半在達成協議時支付，另一半在她逗留結束時支付。如果他們拒絕她的提議，並且隊伍中有一或多名散塔林會成員，她威脅說如果她被逮捕並被控告犯罪，她將揭露他們的隸屬關係，並讓他們與她一同倒臺。

english: Hiding Istrid
zh_tw: 隱藏的伊思崔德

english: If the characters decide to let Istrid hide out at their tavern, she uses a disguise kit to make herself up to be a male dwarf named Jorn. If asked to do so, she's willing to perform chores around the place once she settles in. Ultimately, no one comes looking for her, but the longer she stays hidden, the more testy and demanding she becomes.
zh_tw: 如果角色們決定讓伊思崔德在他們的酒館裡躲藏，她會使用偽裝工具將自己化妝成一個名叫約恩的男性矮人。如果被要求這麼做，她願意在安頓下來後在酒館裡幫忙做一些雜務。最終，沒有人來找她，但她躲藏的時間越長，她變得越容易生氣和要求越多。

english: If the characters tolerate her bad behavior, Istrid leaves at the end of the tenday as promised and pays characters the remainder of what she owes. Characters who are members of the Zhentarim gain an added benefit for harboring Istrid in her time of need: their renown in the faction increases by 2.
zh_tw: 如果角色們容忍伊思崔德的不良行為，她將在十天結束時如約離開，並支付角色們她所欠的餘額。那些在伊思崔德需要幫助時收留她的散塔林會成員角色將獲得額外的好處：他們在派系中的聲望增加了2。

english: If, on the other hand, the characters throw her out or rat her out to the City Watch, Istrid becomes their mortal enemy and tries to undermine them at every turn.
zh_tw: 另一方面，如果角色們把她趕出去或向城市守衛告發她，伊思崔德就會成為他們的死敵，並試圖在每一個機會中破壞他們。

english: Harming Istrid
zh_tw: 傷害伊思崔德
