english: As a precaution against being double-crossed, Istrid shared her plan concerning the characters with at least one other member of the Doom Raiders (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}). If the characters betray or harm Istrid, her former adventuring companions use every resource at their disposal to ruin the characters. The laws of Waterdeep discourage them from attacking the characters openly, but they can damage the party's business by scaring off their clientele, and characters might find themselves the targets of worse if they dare to leave the confines of the city.
zh_tw: 作為防止被出賣的預防措施，伊思崔德至少與末日劫掠者的另一名成員（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）分享了她關於角色們的計劃。如果角色們背叛或傷害了伊思崔德，她以前的冒險夥伴會利用他們所能利用的一切資源來毀掉角色們。深水城的法律阻止他們公開攻擊角色們，但他們可以透過嚇跑客戶來破壞團隊的生意，如果角色們敢於離開城市的界限，他們可能會發現自己成為了更嚴重的目標。

english: Level Advancement
zh_tw: 等級提升

english: If you're leveling up characters using story milestones instead of tracking experience points, the characters advance from 3rd to 4th level if they conducted their own investigation into the fireball incident and affected the outcome of events in Gralhund Villa. Otherwise, they are still 3rd level at the start of chapter 4.
zh_tw: 如果您是透過故事裡程碑而不是追蹤經驗值來提升角色等級，如果角色們自行調查火球事件並影響了格勞洪德別墅事件的結果，他們將從3級提升到4級。否則，在第4章開始時，他們仍然是3級。

english: Chapter 4: Dragon Season
zh_tw: 第4章：龍之季節

english: Gold makes people do strange things, and Lord Neverember's hidden cache of dragons is up for grabs. The {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} knows where the treasure vault is located and how to get inside, and much of this chapter focuses on the characters' hunt for the artifact. The challenges before them depend on the villain (or villains) that you selected to oppose them. Whatever the season, a villain's goals are simple: obtain the stone, find the Vault of Dragons, and claim the treasure within.
zh_tw: 金錢使人做出奇怪的事情，而無燼領主隱藏的龍幣寶藏正待爭奪。{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}知道寶藏庫的位置以及如何進入，這一章的大部分內容集中在角色尋找這個神器的過程上。他們面臨的挑戰取決於你選擇的反派（或反派們）。無論季節如何，反派的目標都很簡單：獲得石頭，找到龍之寶庫，並奪取其中的寶藏。

english: Setting the Stage
zh_tw: 設定舞臺

english: In chapter 3, Lady Gralhund's {@creature nimblewright|wdh} took the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} and fled with it. The nimblewright delivers the artifact to a location and leaves it there for the main villain or villains to retrieve:
zh_tw: 在第3章中，格勞洪德女士的{@creature nimblewright|wdh|秘偶}帶著{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}逃跑了。秘偶將這件神器送到一個地點，並將其留在那裡供主要反派或反派們取回：

english: If {@creature Xanathar|WDH} is the villain, the stone is delivered to a mage named {@creature Grinda Garloth|WDH}. She owns an {@item apparatus of Kwalish} and lives in Mistshore, a seedy neighborhood built on a dock in the Dock Ward.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}是反派，那麼這塊石頭會被送到一個名叫{@creature Grinda Garloth|WDH|格林達·加洛斯}的法師那裡。她擁有一個{@item apparatus of Kwalish||誇力許裝置}，並居住在霧岸，這是一個位於碼頭區的碼頭上建造的、不光彩的社群。

english: If the Cassalanters are the villains, the stone is left in their family crypt in Waterdeep's cemetery, the City of the Dead. A halfling necromancer gets to it before the Cassalanters or the characters do.
zh_tw: 如果卡薩蘭特家族是反派，那麼這塊石頭被留在了深水城墓地，即亡者之城的他們家族的墓穴中。一個半身人死靈師在卡薩蘭特家族或角色們之前得到了它。

english: If Jarlaxle is the villain, the stone is delivered to Fenerus Stormcastle, a lamplighter in the Trades Ward. Fenerus has a criminal history and is currently in trouble with the law.
zh_tw: 如果賈拉索是反派，那麼石頭被送到了費內魯斯·風暴堡那裡，他在商業區是一名點燈人。費內魯斯有犯罪記錄，目前正與法律有麻煩。

english: If {@creature Manshoon|WDH} is the villain, the stone is brought to {@creature Thrakkus|wdh}, a dragonborn butcher in the Field Ward who chops up bodies for the Zhentarim.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}是反派，那麼這塊石頭會被帶到{@creature Thrakkus|wdh|薩卡斯}那裡，他是一個位於原野區(原野區)的龍裔屠夫，為散塔林會分解屍體。

english: Finding the Nimblewright
zh_tw: 尋找秘偶

english: If the characters can't pick up the trail after the {@creature nimblewright|wdh} escapes with the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, they might turn to the City Watch, the City Guard, or a friendly faction for help, which comes forth in {@dice 1d4} days. If it occurs to none of the characters, an NPC suggests that the party visit the House of Inspired Hands to see whether the priests of Gond know a way to find it (see "Nim's Secret"). Thereafter, armed with Nim's nimblewright detector, the characters can sweep the city. But by the time they find the nimblewright, it has already delivered the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} to its intended destination.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在{@creature nimblewright|wdh|秘偶}帶著{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}逃跑後無法追蹤到線索，他們可能會轉向城防軍、城市守衛或友好派系尋求幫助，這將在{@dice 1d4}天內得到回應。如果角色們沒有想到這一點，一個NPC建議隊伍去拜訪巧手之屋，看看貢德的祭司是否知道找到它的方法（見"尼姆的秘密"）。之後，裝備了尼姆的秘偶探測器，角色們可以搜查整個城市。但當他們找到靈巧生物時，它已經將{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}送到了預定的目的地。

english: Caught at Last!
zh_tw: 終於被抓住了！

english: When it is finally found, the {@creature nimblewright|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) is wearing a stolen cloak and hiding under a pile of uncollected garbage in an alley. Exactly where and when the characters stumble upon it is up to you. With nowhere to go and no other purpose, it fights until destroyed. Regardless of where and when this event takes place, six members of the City Watch ({@creature veteran||veterans}) arrive as the fight ends. Drawn by the commotion, the Watch couldn't care less about the nimblewright and believes any plausible story the characters tell them. (As a construct, it had no rights to speak of.) The officers are near the end of their shift and eager to move on; they urge the characters to go home and cause no further mischief.
zh_tw: 當最終找到時，{@creature nimblewright|WDH|秘偶}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）穿著一件偷來的斗篷，躲在一條小巷裡一堆未被清理的垃圾下面。角色們在何時何地偶然發現它，由你來決定。無處可逃且沒有其他目的，它會一直戰鬥直到被摧毀。無論這一事件發生在何時何地，六名城市守衛({@creature veteran||老兵})會在戰鬥結束時到達。由於騷動而被吸引過來，守衛對秘偶毫不在意，並且會相信角色們告訴他們的任何合理的故事。（作為一個構裝生物，它沒有說話的權利。）這些官員們快要結束他們的輪班，急於繼續前進；他們敦促角色們回家，不要再製造麻煩。

english: Lady Gralhund's Map
zh_tw: 格勞洪德女士的地圖

english: Lady Gralhund gave her {@creature nimblewright|wdh} a map showing where to take the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, but she forgot to tell it to destroy the map once the stone was delivered. Characters who search the nimblewright's remains find the folded-up map, which depicts one of Waterdeep's wards. Written on the map is an X with a name next to it. This map points the characters to where they need to be, setting off a sequence of encounters (see "Encounter Chains" below). The main villain determines which ward the map depicts and what name is written on it:
zh_tw: 格勞洪德女士給了她的{@creature nimblewright|wdh|秘偶}一張地圖，上面標明瞭要把{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}送到哪裡，但她忘了告訴它一旦石頭送達就要銷燬地圖。搜尋秘偶的遺骸的角色們發現了這張摺疊起來的地圖，地圖上描繪了深水城的一個區域。地圖上寫有一個X和一個名字。這張地圖指引角色們他們需要去的地方，觸發了一系列的遭遇（見下面的"遭遇鏈"）。主要反派決定地圖描繪了哪個區域以及上面寫了什麼名字：

english: If {@creature Xanathar|WDH} is the villain, "{@creature Grinda Garloth|WDH}" is written by the X on a map of the Dock Ward. (The X marks the dock neighborhood of Mistshore, where Grinda lives.)
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}是反派，那麼在碼頭區的地圖上，'X'的位置會寫上'{@creature Grinda Garloth|WDH|格林達·加洛斯}'。（'X'標記著霧岸的碼頭社群，格林達就住在那裡。）

english: If the Cassalanters are the villains, the name "Cassalanter" is written by the X on a map of the City of the Dead. (The X marks the location of the Cassalanter mausoleum.)
zh_tw: 如果卡薩蘭特家族是反派，那麼在亡者之城的地圖上，'X'的位置會寫上'卡薩蘭特'。（'X'標記著卡薩蘭特家族陵墓的位置。）

english: If Jarlaxle is the villain, "Fenerus Stormcastle" is written by the X on a map of the Trades Ward. (Residents of the Trades Ward know Fenerus. He's a lamplighter with an alley dwelling. The X marks the alley.)
zh_tw: 如果賈拉索是反派，地圖上的商業區標記了一個X，並寫有"費內魯斯·風暴堡"。（商業區的居民知道費內魯斯。他是一個點燈人，住在一個巷子裡。X標記的就是那個巷子。）

english: If {@creature Manshoon|WDH} is the villain, "{@creature Thrakkus|WDH}" is written by the X on a map of the Field Ward. (The X marks the location of {@creature Thrakkus|wdh}'s butcher shop and residence.)
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}是反派，地圖上的原野區標記了一個X，並寫有"{@creature Thrakkus|WDH|薩卡斯}"。（X標記的是{@creature Thrakkus|wdh|薩卡斯}的肉店和住所的位置。）

english: Dock Ward
zh_tw: 碼頭區

english: City of the Dead Map
zh_tw: 亡者之城地圖

english: Trades Ward Map
zh_tw: 商業區地圖

english: Field Ward Map
zh_tw: 原野區地圖

english: Obtaining the Stone of Golorr
zh_tw: 獲取格洛爾之石

english: The {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} possesses an intelligent, alien intellect and has enough prescience to realize that the characters are destined to find it. The stone doesn't want to be found too easily, though.
zh_tw: {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}擁有一個智慧的、異域的智力，並且具有足夠的預知能力，意識到角色們註定會找到它。不過，這塊石頭並不想被太容易地找到。

english: If the characters obtain the stone earlier than expected, it proves uncooperative and tries to separate itself from the party as quickly as possible, refusing to share any knowledge with characters in the meantime. The stone tries to take control of anyone who attunes to it, triggering a conflict (see "Sentient Magic Items" in chapter 7 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|dmg}). If the stone fails to take control, it can't try again against that character until the next dawn. If the stone succeeds in taking control of its owner, it orders that character to deliver it to whichever location sets into motion the sequence of encounters discussed in this chapter (see "Encounter Chains"). Once the stone divests itself of its current owner, it tries to erase all knowledge of itself from that character's mind (see the item's description in appendix A). Any player whose character is forced to forget about the stone carries the burden of roleplaying that memory loss. You can award inspiration to that character as a way to acknowledge the player's good roleplaying.
zh_tw: 如果角色們比預期更早地獲得了這塊石頭，它會變得不合作，並儘可能快地試圖從隊伍中分離出來，同時拒絕與角色分享任何知識。石頭試圖控制任何與其共鳴的人，引發衝突（見{@book 城主指南|dmg}第7章中的"有感知的魔法物品"）。如果石頭未能控制住，直到下一個黎明之前，它不能再對那個角色嘗試控制。如果石頭成功控制了它的擁有者，它會命令那個角色將它送到啟動本章討論的一系列遭遇的地點（見"遭遇鏈"）。一旦石頭擺脫了當前的擁有者，它就試圖從那個角色的記憶中抹去所有關於自己的知識（見附錄A中物品的描述）。任何被迫忘記石頭的角色都承擔著扮演記憶喪失的負擔。你可以給予那個角色靈感，作為對玩家出色角色扮演的認可。

english: As chapter 4 unfolds, you decide when it's time for the characters to have a chance of securing the Stone of Golorr. Try to keep it out of their hands for as long as possible to maximize the suspense.
zh_tw: 隨著第4章的展開，你決定什麼時候讓角色們有機會獲得格洛爾之石。儘量讓他們儘可能晚地得到它，以最大化懸念。

english: Once the characters have earned the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, it no longer tries to take control of them. A character can attune to it and learn the following information:
zh_tw: 一旦角色們獲得了{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，它就不再試圖控制他們。一個角色可以與它共鳴，並瞭解到以下資訊：

english: The location of the Vault of Dragons (see "Vault of Dragons")
zh_tw: 龍之寶庫的位置（見"龍之寶庫"）

english: The three keys required to unlock the vault's doors (see "Vault Keys")
zh_tw: 解鎖金庫門所需的三把鑰匙（見"金庫鑰匙"）

english: The name of the vault's gold dragon guardian, and the powers of the staff in its possession (see the description of the {@item dragonstaff of Ahghairon|WDH} in appendix A)
zh_tw: 金庫的金龍守護者的名字，以及它手中法杖的力量（見附錄A中{@item dragonstaff of Ahghairon|WDH|阿蓋爾倫的龍杖}的描述）

english: Encounter Chains
zh_tw: 遭遇鏈

english: Eight encounters comprise the characters' hunt for the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} and the Vault of Dragons. They form a chain, and their order is determined by your choice of villain and season. The diagram on the facing page illustrates the order of encounters in each chain. If {@creature Xanathar|WDH} is the villain, for example, the chain begins with encounter 2, "Mistshore," and ends with encounter 6, "Theater."
zh_tw: 八個遭遇構成了角色們尋找{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}和龍之寶庫的旅程。它們形成了一個鏈條，其順序由你選擇的反派和季節決定。對面頁上的圖表展示了每個鏈條中遭遇的順序。例如，如果{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}是反派，那麼鏈條從遭遇2開始，"霧岸"，並以遭遇6結束，"劇院"。

english: Don't feel bound by an encounter chain. Let the characters' decisions and actions drive the story. You can change the order in which encounters happen, remove encounters you don't need, or create new encounters. You can also modify encounters to suit your tastes.
zh_tw: 不要被遭遇鏈所束縛。讓角色的決定和行動推動故事發展。你可以改變遭遇發生的順序，移除不需要的遭遇，或者創造新的遭遇。你也可以根據你的喜好修改遭遇。

english: If the characters stray, they might find themselves at a loss for what to do next. You have a couple of easy ways to guide them back on track:
zh_tw: 如果角色們偏離了主線，他們可能會發現自己不知道接下來該做什麼。你有幾個簡單的方式來引導他們回到正軌：

english: A friendly faction that has information about the whereabouts of the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} whereabouts can bring that knowledge to the characters.
zh_tw: 一個友好的派系如果掌握了有關{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}下落的資訊，可以將這些知識帶給角色們。

english: A treacherous underling of the villain reveals the location of the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} for a price.
zh_tw: 反派的一個不忠的下屬為了一定的價格揭示了{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}的位置。

english: If a Villain Gets the Stone
zh_tw: 如果反派得到了石頭

english: If a main villain acquires the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, it takes that villain {@dice 2d6} days to find the Vault of Dragons and its keys. During this time, the characters have a chance to steal the stone from the villain's lair. If the characters don't steal the stone in time, the villain sends forces into the vault to defeat {@creature Aurinax|WDH} and recover the gold, which takes another {@dice 2d6} days. Once the gold is recovered, the villain moves forward with a master plan as detailed in the introduction. If the characters are still alive, they could oppose the villain by stealing the gold from the villain's lair.
zh_tw: 如果主要反派獲得了{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，他需要{@dice 2d6}天的時間來找到龍之寶庫及其鑰匙。在這段時間裡，角色們有機會從反派的巢穴中偷走石頭。如果角色們沒有及時偷走石頭，反派會派遣部隊進入金庫擊敗{@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯}並回收黃金，這又需要另外{@dice 2d6}天的時間。一旦黃金被回收，反派就會按照引言中詳細描述的計劃行事。如果角色們仍然活著，他們可以透過從反派的巢穴中偷走黃金來反對反派。

english: Spring: Xanathar
zh_tw: 春季：姍娜薩

english: Summer: The Cassalanters
zh_tw: 夏季：卡薩蘭特家族

english: Autumn: Jarlaxle Baenre
zh_tw: 秋季：賈拉索·班瑞

english: Winter: Manshoon
zh_tw: 冬季：曼松

english: Spring Encounter Chain
zh_tw: 春季遭遇鏈

english: Ah, springtime-when beholder eyestalks are in bloom. The Stone of Golorr was originally snatched from {@creature Xanathar|WDH}, and the eye tyrant wants it back. It sends monsters and minions to do its dirty work.
zh_tw: 啊，春天——當眼魔的眼睛梗盛開的時候。格洛爾之石最初是從{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}那裡奪走的，這位眼睛暴君想要它回來。它派遣怪物和小兵來做它的髒活。

english: Summary
zh_tw: 概述

english: The stone is delivered to {@creature Grinda Garloth|WDH}, a mage who has worked for {@creature Xanathar|WDH} in the past. When she refuses to give up the stone, members of the Xanathar Guild try to take it by force (encounter 2, "Mistshore"). After the characters defeat these attackers, they learn that Grinda told her rat familiar to hide the stone in her family's crypt in the City of the Dead. From this point on, the characters are followed by a gazer (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), through whose eyes {@creature Xanathar|WDH} can see. If this gazer is killed, {@creature Xanathar|WDH} doesn't send another one to replace it.
zh_tw: 這塊石頭被送到了過去曾為{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}工作的法師{@creature Grinda Garloth|WDH|格林達·加洛斯}手中。當她拒絕交出石頭時，姍娜薩公會的成員試圖用武力奪取（遭遇2，'霧岸'）。在角色們擊敗這些攻擊者後，他們得知格林達告訴她的老鼠使魔將石頭藏在亡者之城的家族墓穴中。從這一點開始，角色們被一個凝視者眼魔跟蹤（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），透過它的眼睛{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}可以看到。如果這個凝視者眼魔被殺死，{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}不會派出另一個來替代它。

english: {@creature Losser Mirklav|wdh}, a halfling necromancer, raids the Garloth mausoleum and takes the stone shortly before the characters arrive (encounter 4, "Mausoleum"). As they emerge from the mausoleum, members of the Xanathar Guild attack them, believing they have the stone. A clue left behind in the mausoleum leads the characters to an old windmill in the Southern Ward and a pair of grave robbers (encounter 10, "Converted Windmill"). Fearing arrest, the grave robbers point them to a cellar complex under the Trades Ward (encounter 9, "Cellar Complex"). When the characters arrive, they find Losser surrounded by foes and kenku working for the Xanathar Guild making off with the stone. A chase through the streets on or before Trolltide (encounter 3, "Street Chase") ends when the kenku, fearing capture, duck into an old tower (encounter 7, "Old Tower"). If they are caught and confronted, the kenku hand over the stone.
zh_tw: {@creature Losser Mirklav|wdh|洛瑟·米爾克拉夫}，一個半身人死靈師，在角色們到達（遭遇4，"陵墓"）前不久襲擊了加洛斯陵墓並帶走了石頭。當他們從陵墓中出來時，姍娜薩公會的成員攻擊了他們，因為他們認為他們擁有那塊石頭。在陵墓中留下的線索引導角色們前往南區的一箇舊風車和一對盜墓者（遭遇10，"改造風車"）。盜墓者擔心被捕，指引他們前往商業區下的一個地窖建築群（遭遇9，"地窖建築群"）。當角色們到達時，他們發現洛瑟被敵人包圍，姍娜薩公會工作的肯庫正帶著石頭逃走。在巨魔節之前或期間的街頭追逐（遭遇3，"街頭追逐"）結束時，天狗害怕被捕，躲進了一座舊塔（遭遇7，"舊塔"）。如果他們被抓住並面對，肯庫會交出石頭。

english: The Xanathar Guild makes one last attempt to regain the stone (encounter 1, "Alley"). Any character who becomes attuned to the stone learns that the Vault of Dragons lies beneath a theater in the Castle Ward (encounter 6, "Theater").
zh_tw: 姍娜薩公會最後嘗試一次來重新奪回石頭（遭遇1，'小巷'）。任何與石頭產生共鳴的角色都會得知龍之寶庫位於城堡區一個劇院下方（遭遇6，'劇院'）。

english: Weather Effects
zh_tw: 天氣影響

english: Until the encounter chain is complete, the following weather effects are in play.
zh_tw: 在遭遇鏈完成之前，以下天氣效果正在發揮作用。

english: Heavy Rain
zh_tw: 大雨

english: Heavy rain falls from noon until midnight. Creatures in the rain have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight. The rain also extinguishes open flames. Visibility is reduced to 60 feet.
zh_tw: 從中午到午夜下著大雨。在雨中的生物在依賴聽覺或視覺的感知（洞察）檢定時具有劣勢。雨水還會撲滅明火。能見度降低至60尺。

english: Thick Fog
zh_tw: 濃霧

english: From midnight until noon, the city is engulfed in thick fog. Creatures in the fog have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight. Visibility is reduced to 30 feet.
zh_tw: 從午夜到中午，城市被濃霧籠罩。在霧中的生物在依賴視力的感知（感知）檢定上具有劣勢。能見度降低到30尺。

english: Summer Encounter Chain
zh_tw: 夏季遭遇鏈

english: As Waterdavians contend with sweltering heat, the Cassalanters send disciples of their Asmodeus-worshiping cult to seize the Stone of Golorr while deftly avoiding entanglements with local authorities.
zh_tw: 當深水城市民在酷熱中掙扎時，卡薩蘭特家族派遣他們崇拜阿斯蒙蒂斯的邪教信徒去奪取格洛爾之石，同時巧妙地避免與當地當局發生糾葛。

english: Summary
zh_tw: 概述

english: The characters arrive at the Cassalanter mausoleum to find several dead cultists inside (encounter 4, "Mausoleum"). A left-for-dead survivor reveals that these cultists were betrayed by two of their own. The characters head to an old windmill in the Southern Ward where the cult fanatics practice their diabolical faith (encounter 10, "Converted Windmill"). Spined devils swoop in, snatch the stone, and flee, setting up a rooftop chase (encounter 5, "Rooftop Chase").
zh_tw: 當角色們到達卡薩蘭特家族的陵墓時，發現裡面有幾個死去的邪教徒（遭遇4，'陵墓'）。一個被留下等死的生還者透露，這些邪教徒被他們自己人中的兩個背叛了。角色們前往南區的一箇舊風車，那裡是邪教狂信者實踐他們魔鬼信仰的地方（遭遇10，'改造風車'）。棘魔突然降臨，搶走了石頭，並逃跑，引發了一場屋頂追逐（遭遇5，'屋頂追逐'）。

english: The spined devils deliver the stone to a hire-coach parked in an alley (encounter 1, "Alley"). Inside the coach is {@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH}'s valet, {@creature Willifort Crowelle|WDH}, a doppelganger in tiefling form. As the hire-coach flees, a street chase ensues (encounter 3, "Street Chase"). When a crowd cuts off his escape route, Willifort leaps out of the hire-coach and tries to lose himself in the crowd. In the confusion, street urchins snatch the stone. The characters catch up to the children in their cellar hideout (encounter 9, "Cellar Complex").
zh_tw: 棘魔將石頭交給了一輛停在小巷裡的出租馬車（遭遇1，'小巷'）。馬車內是{@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH|維克托羅·卡薩蘭特}的貼身男僕{@creature Willifort Crowelle|WDH|威利福特·克羅威爾}，一個以提夫林形態出現的變形怪。當出租馬車逃跑時，一場街頭追逐隨之發生（遭遇3，'街頭追逐'）。當人群切斷了他的逃跑路線時，威利福特跳出馬車，試圖混入人群中。在混亂中，街頭頑童搶走了石頭。角色們在他們的地下室藏身之處追上了這些孩子（遭遇9，'地下室綜合區'）。

english: With the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} in their possession, the characters emerge from the cellar complex only to find themselves surrounded by members of the City Watch. They are arrested for one or more crimes and taken to a courthouse in the Dock Ward to face sentencing by a magister (encounter 8, "Courthouse"). Meanwhile, the doppelganger tries to get the stone back.
zh_tw: 擁有{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}的角色們從小黑屋綜合區出來時，發現自己被城市守衛的成員包圍了。他們因一項或多項罪行被捕，並被帶到碼頭區的法院，由地方法官宣判（遭遇8，'法院'）。與此同時，變形怪試圖奪回石頭。

english: Any character who becomes attuned to the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} learns that the Vault of Dragons is hidden under an old tower in the Sea Ward (encounter 7, "Old Tower"). When they arrive at the tower, they encounter its new owner, who is discussing renovations with various local guild members.
zh_tw: 任何與{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}共鳴的角色都會得知龍之寶庫隱藏在海區的一座舊塔下（遭遇7，'舊塔'）。當他們到達塔樓時，他們遇到了新主人，他正在與各個地方行會成員討論翻新事宜。

english: Weather Effects
zh_tw: 天氣影響

english: Until the encounter chain is complete, the following weather effect is in play.
zh_tw: 在遭遇鏈完成之前，以下天氣效果正在發揮作用。

english: Heat Wave
zh_tw: 熱浪

english: During the day, a character without access to drinkable water must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw at the end of each encounter in the chain or gain one level of {@condition exhaustion}. The saving throw is made with disadvantage if the character is wearing medium or heavy armor. Characters who have resistance or immunity to fire automatically succeed on the saving throw.
zh_tw: 在白天，沒有可飲用水的角色必須在每次遭遇鏈結束時成功透過一個 {@dc 10} 的體質豁免檢定，否則獲得一級 {@condition exhaustion||力竭}。如果角色穿著中等或重型護甲，則豁免檢定具有劣勢。對火焰有抗性或免疫的角色自動透過該豁免檢定。

english: Autumn Encounter Chain
zh_tw: 秋季遭遇鏈

english: Deception and misdirection are Jarlaxle's forte, and he likes to trick his rivals into working for him. He steers the characters toward the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} and lets them think they're always one step ahead. Drow player characters who are members of Bregan D'aerthe might find their loyalty to the party put to the test.
zh_tw: 欺騙和誤導是賈拉索的專長，他喜歡誘使對手為他工作。他引導角色們走向{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，並讓他們認為他們總是領先一步。作為布雷甘·達耶成員的卓爾玩家角色可能會發現他們對隊伍的忠誠度受到考驗。

english: Summary
zh_tw: 概述

english: The characters visit the residence of Fenerus Stormcastle, a lamplighter and retired brigand who funnels information to Bregan D'aerthe. They arrive to find the place ransacked (encounter 1, "Alley"). The duergar who looted the residence work for the Xanathar Guild, and Bregan D'aerthe spies have tracked them to a cellar complex in the Southern Ward. In the guise of {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH}, Jarlaxle steers the characters in that direction (encounter 9, "Cellar Complex"). A search of the cellar complex yields a fake stone, but not the real {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}. With no other leads, the characters can follow up with "Laeral" at a theater in the Dock Ward (encounter 6, "Theater"). Jarlaxle makes the characters an offer they can't refuse, setting his agents on them if they dare to do so.
zh_tw: 角色們拜訪了費內魯斯·風暴堡的住所，他是一位點燈人和退休的強盜，向布雷甘·達耶提供情報。他們到達時發現這個地方被洗劫了（遭遇1，'小巷'）。洗劫住所的灰矮人是姍娜薩公會的成員，而布雷甘·達耶的間諜已經追蹤他們到了南區的一個地下室綜合區。賈拉索偽裝成{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}，引導角色們朝那個方向前進（遭遇9，'地下室綜合區'）。在地下室綜合區的搜尋中，他們發現了一個假石頭，但不是真正的{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}。沒有其他線索，角色們可以與'萊拉'在碼頭區的劇院跟進（遭遇6，'劇院'）。賈拉索給角色們提出了一個他們無法拒絕的提議，如果他們敢於這樣做，他會派他的代理人對付他們。

english: Once he realizes the Xanathar Guild doesn't have the stone, Jarlaxle asks the characters to interrogate Fenerus to find out where he hid it. Jarlaxle has learned that Fenerus is awaiting trial at a courthouse in the Castle Ward (encounter 8, "Courthouse"). Fenerus wants immunity for all of his past crimes. The characters are in no position to grant his wish, but they might threaten him, persuade him, or use magic to charm him. If he is compelled to reveal the stone's location, Fenerus points the characters to an old tower in the Dock Ward (encounter 7, "Old Tower").
zh_tw: 一旦賈拉索意識到姍娜薩公會沒有那塊石頭，他就要求角色們審問費內魯斯以找出他藏在哪裡。賈拉索得知費內魯斯正在城堡區的一個法院（遭遇8，"法院"）等待審判。費內魯斯希望他過去所有的罪行都能得到豁免。角色們無法實現他的願望，但他們可以威脅他、說服他或使用魔法來迷惑他。如果他被迫透露石頭的位置，費內魯斯會指引角色們去碼頭區的一座舊塔（遭遇7，"舊塔"）。

english: Jarlaxle's lieutenants reach the stone first and flee across the rooftops in the Dock Ward to escape the characters (encounter 5, "Rooftop Chase"). They go to ground in Mistshore (encounter 2, "Mistshore"). Once the characters wrest the stone away from these drow, they can use it to guide them to the home of a famous painter in the Sea Ward (encounter 10, "Converted Windmill"), beneath which is a tunnel that leads to the Vault of Dragons.
zh_tw: 賈拉索的副官們首先到達石頭所在地，並在碼頭區的屋頂上逃離角色們（遭遇5，'屋頂追逐'）。他們躲藏在霧岸（遭遇2，'霧岸'）。一旦角色們從這些卓爾精靈手中奪回石頭，他們就可以用它來引導他們前往海區一位著名畫家的家（遭遇10，'改造風車'），那裡有一條通往龍之寶庫的隧道。

english: Weather Effects
zh_tw: 天氣影響

english: Until the encounter chain is complete, the following weather effect is in play.
zh_tw: 在遭遇鏈完成之前，以下天氣效果正在發揮作用。

english: Autumn Wind
zh_tw: 秋風

english: Wind whistling through the streets imposes disadvantage on ranged weapon attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing. The wind also extinguishes open fires smaller than a torch flame.
zh_tw: 街上呼嘯的風對遠端武器攻擊骰和依賴聽力的感知（洞察）檢定造成了劣勢。風還會撲滅小於火炬火焰的開放火焰。

english: Winter Encounter Chain
zh_tw: 冬季遭遇鏈

english: Now is the winter of Waterdeep's discontent. The Zhents who serve {@creature Manshoon|WDH} believe their master to be all-powerful, which has made them reckless. Against a frigid backdrop, they're willing to thumb their noses at local authorities and risk death in pursuit of the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}.
zh_tw: 現在正是深水城不滿的冬季。為{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}服務的散塔林會成員認為他們的主人是無所不能的，這使他們變得魯莽。在寒冷的背景下，他們願意對當地當局不屑一顧，並在追求{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}的過程中冒險死亡。

english: Summary
zh_tw: 概述

english: The stone is delivered to {@creature Thrakkus|wdh}, a dragonborn butcher in the Field Ward (encounter 10, "Converted Windmill"). {@creature Thrakkus|WDH} hides the stone in one of his meat deliveries. The characters follow the delivery cart to an alley in the Trades Ward where Zhents meet in secret (encounter 1, "Alley"). Before the characters can lay hands on the stone, a Zhent named Vevette Blackwater grabs it and flees, initiating a chase across icy rooftops (encounter 5, "Rooftop Chase"). She hands off the stone to Agorn Fuoco, a bard who is attending a play in a nearby theater (encounter 6, "Theater"), before leading her pursuers on a merry chase through the snow-covered streets (encounter 3, "Street Chase"). The characters learn that the stone has been taken by hire-coach to Mistshore. The characters can catch up to Agorn there (encounter 2, "Mistshore").
zh_tw: 這塊石頭被送到了{@creature Thrakkus|wdh|薩卡斯}那裡，他是原野區（遭遇10，'改造風車'）的一個龍裔屠夫。{@creature Thrakkus|WDH|薩卡斯}把石頭藏在了他的一次肉類送貨中。角色們跟隨送貨車來到商業區的一條小巷，那裡有散塔林會成員秘密會面（遭遇1，'小巷'）。在角色們能夠接觸到石頭之前，一個名叫薇薇特·黑水的散塔林會成員抓住它逃跑了，引發了一場在結冰屋頂上的追逐（遭遇5，'屋頂追逐'）。她把石頭交給了阿戈恩·弗奧科，一個正在附近劇院看戲的吟遊詩人（遭遇6，'劇院'），然後帶領她的追蹤者在覆蓋著雪的街道上進行了一場愉快的追逐（遭遇3，'街頭追逐'）。角色們得知石頭已經被租用馬車帶到了霧岸。角色們可以在那裡追上阿戈恩（遭遇2，'霧岸'）。

english: If he is captured and questioned, Agorn reveals that he made one stop on his way to Mistshore. He dropped off a lady friend, a priest of Bane allied with the Zhentarim, and left the stone with her and her acolytes for safekeeping. The characters can find them in an old tower in the Castle Ward (encounter 7, "Old Tower"). Before they leave that place, the characters are confronted by {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s simulacrum, which arrives by way of teleportation circle to collect the stone. Once the simulacrum is defeated, the characters can use the stone to learn that the entrance to the Vault of Dragons is hidden below a mausoleum in the City of the Dead (encounter 4, "Mausoleum").
zh_tw: 如果阿戈恩被捕並受到審問，他會透露在前往霧岸的路上他停了一次。他送下了一位女士朋友，一位與散塔林會結盟的班恩的女祭司，並把石頭留給了她和她的門徒保管。角色們可以在城堡區的一座舊塔中找到他們（遭遇7，'舊塔'）。在他們離開那個地方之前，角色們被{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的擬像所挑戰，它透過傳送法陣到達這裡來收集石頭。一旦擬像被擊敗，角色們可以使用石頭得知龍之寶庫的入口隱藏在亡者之城的一個陵墓下（遭遇4，'陵墓'）。

english: Weather Effects
zh_tw: 天氣影響

english: Until the encounter chain is complete, the following weather effects are in play.
zh_tw: 在遭遇鏈完成之前，以下天氣效果正在發揮作用。

english: Blizzard
zh_tw: 暴風雪

english: Shrieking wind and falling snow impose disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight. The wind also extinguishes open fires smaller than a torch flame. Visibility is reduced to 60 feet. Snow on the ground creates {@quickref difficult terrain||3} in areas that are not heavily trod.
zh_tw: 尖嘯的風聲和飄落的雪花會使依賴聽覺或視覺的感知（感知）檢定處於劣勢。風也會熄滅比火把火焰小的明火。能見度降低至60尺。地面上的積雪在未被大量踩踏的區域會形成{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。

english: Extreme Cold
zh_tw: 極度寒冷

english: A character exposed to the cold must succeed on a {@dc 10} Constitution saving throw at the end of each encounter in the chain or gain one level of {@condition exhaustion}. Characters who have resistance or immunity to cold automatically succeed on the saving throw, as do those wearing cold weather gear (thick coats, gloves, hats, and the like).
zh_tw: 暴露在寒冷中的角色必須在每次遭遇結束時進行一次{@dc 10}的體質豁免檢定，若失敗則獲得一層{@condition exhaustion||力竭}。對寒冷具有抗性或免疫力的角色自動透過該豁免檢定，穿著寒冷天氣裝備（如厚外套、手套、帽子等）的角色亦是如此。

english: Modifying Encounters
zh_tw: 修改遭遇

english: You can adjust the difficulty of a combat encounter by adding or subtracting monsters. If you need to increase the difficulty of an encounter that has already begun, have enemy reinforcements arrive during the battle. If you find an encounter too deadly, reduce the antagonists' hit points, have NPCs arrive to help the characters, or have the bad guys cut their losses and flee.
zh_tw: 你可以透過增加或減少怪物來調整戰鬥遭遇的難度。如果你需要增加已經開始的遭遇的難度，可以讓敵方增援在戰鬥中到達。如果你發現某個遭遇過於致命，可以減少反派的生命值，讓NPC來幫助角色們，或者讓壞人減少損失並逃跑。

english: Encounter 1: Alley
zh_tw: 遭遇1：小巷

english: Use map 4.1 for this encounter. The buildings that border the alley are 30 feet (three stories) high unless you decide otherwise. Since this encounter occurs outdoors, be mindful of any weather effects in play.
zh_tw: 請使用地圖4.1進行這次遭遇。除非你有其他決定，否則與小巷相鄰的建築物高度為30尺（三層樓）。由於這次遭遇發生在戶外，請留意任何正在發揮作用的天氣效果。

english: Alley
zh_tw: 小巷

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: Areas of the Alley
zh_tw: 小巷區域

english: The following locations are keyed to map 4.1.
zh_tw: 以下地點對應地圖4.1。

english: L1. Alley Residence
zh_tw: L1. 小巷住宅

english: This old, one-story, windowless stone house with a slate roof is tucked in the middle of the alley, surrounded by taller buildings. Its doors are made of sturdy wood, and the outer door can be barred shut from within. Breaking down the barred door requires a successful {@dc 18} Strength (Athletics) check.
zh_tw: 這座古老的單層無窗石屋，帶有板岩屋頂，隱藏在巷子中間，周圍是更高的建築。它的門由堅固的木材製成，外門可以從內部閂上。要強行開啟被閂上的門，需要透過一個 {@dc 18} 力量（運動）檢定。

english: The interior is divided into two rooms, a kitchen with a fireplace and a plainly furnished bedroom.
zh_tw: 室內被劃分為兩個房間，一個帶有壁爐的廚房和一個簡樸裝飾的臥室。

english: L2. Store
zh_tw: L2. 商店

english: This stone building is a store of one kind or another. If an encounter doesn't specify the goods sold here, roll a {@dice d20} and consult the Store Goods table to determine what the store sells.
zh_tw: 這座石頭建築是一家商店。如果遭遇沒有指定這裡出售的商品，請擲一個{@dice d20}並參考商店商品表來確定這家店賣什麼。

english: Store Goods
zh_tw: 商店貨物

english: Result
zh_tw: 結果

english: Art
zh_tw: 藝術品

english: Books
zh_tw: 書籍

english: Candles
zh_tw: 蠟燭

english: Cartwheels
zh_tw: 車輪

english: Costumes
zh_tw: 戲服

english: Dolls
zh_tw: 玩偶

english: Fresh meat
zh_tw: 新鮮的肉

english: Furniture
zh_tw: 傢俱

english: Games
zh_tw: 遊戲

english: Glass
zh_tw: 玻璃

english: Hats
zh_tw: 帽子

english: Hunting traps
zh_tw: 捕獵陷阱

english: Locks and keys
zh_tw: 鎖和鑰匙

english: Musical instruments
zh_tw: 樂器

english: Pets
zh_tw: 寵物

english: Pots
zh_tw: 鍋

english: Rations
zh_tw: 口糧

english: Rugs
zh_tw: 地毯

english: Umbrellas
zh_tw: 傘

english: Wine
zh_tw: 紅酒

english: A small room serves as a cloakroom, where visitors can hang their heavier overgarments. Past the cloakroom is the store proper, with wares on display. The room to the north is a storeroom or a workshop. The store owner ({@creature commoner}) has keys to all doors.
zh_tw: 一個小房間用作衣帽間，訪客可以在這裡掛上他們較重的外衣。衣帽間過去是商店的主體部分，商品陳列其中。北邊的房間是儲藏室或工作間。店主（{@creature commoner||平民}）擁有所有門的鑰匙。

english: Alley: Spring
zh_tw: 小巷：春天

english: When this encounter begins, either the characters have the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} in their clutches, in which case they're jumped as they move through an alley near the tower-or it was taken from them by {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s gazer spies, in which case they catch up with the gazers in the alley before the creatures can descend into the sewers.
zh_tw: 當這次遭遇開始時，要麼角色們手中握有{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，這樣的話他們在穿過塔附近的小巷時會被伏擊——或者它被{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的凝視者眼魔間諜奪走了，在這種情況下他們會在小巷中追上凝視者眼魔，在這些生物能夠下到下水道之前。

english: Bear Traps
zh_tw: 熊陷阱

english: Choose five squares on the map. These squares contain deep puddles of muddy water. Hidden within each puddle is a spring-loaded bear trap. A creature that has a passive Perception score of 13 or higher spots a trap before accidentally stepping in it.
zh_tw: 在地圖上選擇五個方格。這些方格包含著泥濘水坑。每個水坑裡隱藏著一個彈簧式的熊陷阱。具有13或更高被動感知分數的生物在不小心踩進去之前能發現陷阱。

english: Any creature that steps into a trap's square must make a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 3 ({@dice 1d6}) slashing damage as the trap snaps shut around its ankle, and the creature is {@condition restrained} until the trap is removed. As an action, a creature can try to pry open the trap, doing so with a successful {@dc 12} Strength (Athletics) check.
zh_tw: 任何生物若踏入陷阱所在的方格，必須進行一次 {@dc 10} 的敏捷豁免。若豁免失敗，該生物會受到 3（{@dice 1d6}）點揮砍傷害，因為陷阱迅速夾住其腳踝，並且該生物會處於 {@condition restrained||束縛} 狀態，直至陷阱被移除。作為一個動作，生物可以嘗試撬開陷阱，需進行一次成功的 {@dc 12} 力量（運動）檢定。

english: Ambushers
zh_tw: 伏擊者

english: The characters enter the alley followed by eight {@creature kobold||kobolds} disguised as children wearing troll masks. A {@creature bugbear} named Morga and an {@creature intellect devourer} hide in a doorway halfway down the alley and can be spotted with a successful {@dc 16} Wisdom (Perception) check.
zh_tw: 角色們進入巷子，後面跟著八名偽裝成戴著巨魔面具的孩子的 {@creature kobold||狗頭人}。一名叫做莫爾加 {@creature bugbear||熊地精} 的巨熊人和一隻 {@creature intellect devourer||噬腦怪} 心靈吞噬者藏在巷子中段的一個門道里，成功透過 {@dc 16} 感知（感知）檢定可以發現它們。

english: When the characters reach Morga's hiding spot, the bugbear and the kobolds attack. The intellect devourer stays hidden and tries to take control of a character. Given the chance, Morga tries to shove a character into the nearest trap. If these creatures obtain the stone, they bring it to {@creature Xanathar|WDH} in its lair (see chapter 5).
zh_tw: 當角色們到達莫爾加的藏身之處時，地精和狗頭人發起了攻擊。噬腦怪保持隱藏並試圖控制一個角色。如果有機會，莫爾加試圖將一個角色推入最近的陷阱。如果這些生物獲得了石頭，它們會將它帶到{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的巢穴中（見第5章）。

english: Next Encounter
zh_tw: 下一場遭遇

english: If a character becomes attuned to the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, it reveals the location of the Vault of Dragons, below a theater in the Castle Ward called the Pink Flumph, and the three keys that are needed to enter it. When the characters are ready to visit the location, proceed with encounter 6, "Theater."
zh_tw: 如果一個角色與{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}共鳴，它將揭示龍之寶庫的位置，位於城堡區名為粉紅呋嚕的劇院下方，以及進入其中所需的三把鑰匙。當角色們準備好前往該地點時，請繼續進行遭遇6，'劇院'。

english: Alley: Summer
zh_tw: 小巷：夏日

english: The characters begin this encounter on the rooftops overlooking the alley. If any characters went to ground during the rooftop chase, start them at one end of the alley instead.
zh_tw: 角色們從俯瞰小巷的屋頂開始這次遭遇。如果任何角色在屋頂追逐中落到地面，讓他們從小巷的一端開始。

english: Hire-Coach
zh_tw: 出租馬車

english: Parked in the middle of the alley is a hire-coach pulled by two {@creature draft horse||draft horses}. The driver, Haru Hamatori (LG male Kozakuran human commoner), wears a feathered cap and matching outfit.
zh_tw: 停在小巷中間的是一輛由兩匹{@creature draft horse||馱用馬}拉動的出租馬車。車伕，春原春（LG男性高倉人族平民），戴著一頂帶羽毛的帽子和配套的服裝。

english: Lord Cassalanter's {@creature doppelganger} valet, in the guise of an elderly tiefling named {@creature Willifort Crowelle|WDH}, sits in the passenger cab, which grants {@quickref Cover||3||half cover}. Standing next to the hire-coach is a {@creature bearded devil} disguised as a cloaked human bodyguard wearing a wide-brimmed hat, and perched on the coach are three {@condition invisible} {@creature imp||imps}. Any {@creature spined devil||spined devils} that survived the previous encounter are also present, having just delivered the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} to Willifort.
zh_tw: 卡薩蘭特勳爵的{@creature doppelganger||變形怪}管家，偽裝成名叫{@creature Willifort Crowelle|WDH|威利福特·克羅威爾}的年邁提夫林，坐在提供{@quickref Cover||3||掩護}的乘客車廂內。站在馬車旁的是一個偽裝成披著斗篷的人類保鏢的{@creature bearded devil||須魔}，戴著寬邊帽，而馬車上則棲息著三隻{@condition invisible||隱形}的{@creature imp||小魔鬼}。在之前的遭遇中倖存下來的任何{@creature spined devil||棘魔}也在場，他們剛剛將{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}交給了威利福特。

english: When he sees the characters, Willifort orders the imps and the spined devils to attack. The bearded devil stays close to Willifort and engages any character who tries to reach the hire-coach.
zh_tw: 當威利福特看到角色們時，他命令小魔鬼和棘魔發起攻擊。長鬍子的魔鬼留在威利福特身邊，並與任何試圖接近僱傭馬車的角色交戰。

english: The hire-coach has AC 14, 45 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.
zh_tw: 僱傭馬車具有14的護甲等級，45點生命值，並對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。

english: If there's any chance that the characters might obtain the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} as the encounter progresses, Willifort orders the driver to move the hire-coach out of the alley as quickly as possible. If the driver is {@condition incapacitated} or killed, the bearded devil climbs into the driver's seat on the back of the coach and steers the vehicle. If the bearded devil is unable to replace the driver, the doppelganger takes the reins. Willifort flees on foot if the hirecoach is destroyed or its horses are unable to move.
zh_tw: 如果隨著遭遇的進行，角色們有可能獲得{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，威利福特就命令駕駛員儘快將僱傭馬車開出小巷。如果駕駛員被{@condition incapacitated||無力}或殺死，長鬍子的魔鬼會爬到馬車後部的駕駛座上並駕駛車輛。如果長鬍子的魔鬼無法替代駕駛員，變形怪將接管韁繩。如果僱傭馬車被摧毀或其馬無法移動，威利福特將步行逃跑。

english: Next Encounter
zh_tw: 下一場遭遇

english: If Willifort escapes and the characters pursue him, proceed with encounter 3, "Street Chase."
zh_tw: 如果威利福特逃跑並且角色們追趕他，請繼續進行遭遇3，"街頭追逐"。

english: Alley: Autumn
zh_tw: 小巷：秋天

english: The characters' quest for the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} first leads them to Fenerus Stormcastle, a lamplighter who rents a small house in the Trades Ward ({@area L1|140}).
zh_tw: 角色們尋找{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}的冒險首先帶領他們來到費內魯斯·風暴堡，一個點燈人，他在商業區租了一間小屋（{@area L1|140}）。

english: Apple Cart
zh_tw: 蘋果車

english: The characters enter the alley from either end. Determine their marching order, then read the following text once they reach the alley's midpoint:
zh_tw: 角色們從巷子的任一端進入。確定他們的行進順序，然後當他們到達巷子的中點時閱讀以下文字：

english: A cart laden with apples comes careening toward you from the opposite direction, rolling downhill. Riding on the cart is a tiefling boy with an eye patch, screaming at the top of his lungs. "Look out!" he shouts.
zh_tw: 一輛滿載蘋果的馬車從對面方向朝你衝來，沿著山坡滾下。一個戴著眼罩的提夫林男孩坐在馬車上，用盡全身力氣尖叫著。"小心！"他大喊道。

english: A character in the path of the apple cart must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or be struck for 5 ({@dice 2d4}) bludgeoning damage and knocked {@condition prone}. A character can forgo the Dexterity saving throw and try to stop the cart bodily, doing so with a successful {@dc 15} Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the character is struck by the cart and falls {@condition prone} as it continues to roll. After plowing through the party, the cart flips on its side, sending apples tumbling down the alley. The tiefling boy is thrown from the cart but not seriously hurt.
zh_tw: 站在蘋果車路徑上的角色必須成功透過一次 {@dc 10} 敏捷豁免，否則將被擊中並受到 5（{@dice 2d4}）點鈍擊傷害，並被擊倒 {@condition prone||伏地}。角色可以選擇放棄敏捷豁免，並嘗試用身體阻止車輛，這需要成功透過一次 {@dc 15} 力量豁免。若豁免失敗，角色將被車輛擊中並在車繼續滾動時倒地 {@condition prone||伏地}。在撞穿隊伍後，車輛側翻，蘋果滾落在小巷中。提夫林男孩被丟擲車外，但沒有受到嚴重傷害。

english: The boy is one of three street urchins who teamed up to steal the apple cart from a nearby street corner. The other two children lost control of the cart at the crest of the alley before they could hop on. They catch up to their friend after the crash, make sure he's all right, and then apologize profusely to anyone who was hurt. The urchins, harmless troublemakers, are detailed in the sidebar "{@area The Three Urchins|14e|x}."
zh_tw: 這個男孩是三個街頭頑童中的一個，他們聯手從一個附近的街角偷走了蘋果車。另外兩個孩子在能夠跳上車之前，在小巷的頂端失去了對車的控制。他們在撞車後追上他們的朋友，確保他沒事，然後向任何受傷的人深表歉意。這些頑童，無害的麻煩製造者，在側邊欄"{@area 三個小淘氣|14e|x}"中有詳細描述。

english: If they are asked about Fenerus, the children know who he is. They describe him as a big man with graying hair who looks like he has been in many fights, based on "the scars he wears on his face." They know nothing more about him, other than that he lives alone.
zh_tw: 如果有人問起費內魯斯，孩子們知道他是誰。他們形容他是一個留著灰白頭髮的大個子，根據他臉上的"傷疤"，看起來好像參與過很多打鬥。他們對他一無所知，只知道他獨居。

english: If the characters don't frighten them away, the children loiter around the alley, eating apples and picking through garbage piles.
zh_tw: 如果角色們沒有嚇跑他們，孩子們會在小巷周圍閒逛，吃蘋果，翻找垃圾堆。

english: Fenerus's House
zh_tw: 費內魯斯的房子

english: The door to Fenerus's house stands open, and the place has been ransacked. Painted in blood on the kitchen wall is a circle with ten equidistant lines radiating outward from its circumference: the sign of {@creature Xanathar|WDH}. A thorough search accompanied by a successful {@dc 12} Wisdom (Perception) check reveals small pools of blood on the kitchen floor. A successful check also verifies that the blood on the floor and wall is fresh.
zh_tw: 費內魯斯家的門敞開著，屋內已被洗劫一空。廚房的牆上用血跡畫著一個圓圈，從圓周向外輻射出十條等距的直線：這是{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的標誌。在廚房的地板上，透過一次成功的{@dc 12}感知（感知）檢定，可以發現幾處小血跡。成功的檢定還確認了地板和牆上的血液都是新鮮的。

english: Fenerus's Story
zh_tw: 費內魯斯的故事

english: Fenerus Stormcastle was the founder of the Blood Hawk Posse, a gang of horse-riding brigands that, to this day, harries travelers on the road to Amphail. When he was drummed out of the gang after a botched raid, Fenerus "retired" to Waterdeep and joined the Guild of Chandlers and Lamplighters.
zh_tw: 費內魯斯·風暴堡是血鷹幫派的創始人，這是一個騎馬強盜團夥，直到今天還在騷擾前往安菲爾的旅行者。當他在一次失敗的襲擊後被幫派驅逐時，費內魯斯"退休"到深水城，並加入了燈籠和燭臺公會。

english: Until recently, Fenerus supplemented his income by spying for the city of Luskan and providing his contacts with information on the political climate in Waterdeep, as well as juicy bits of news overheard on his nightly rounds through the Trades Ward. He has no clue that his contacts are drow members of Bregan D'aerthe, since they wear cloaks and keep to the shadows.
zh_tw: 直到最近，費內魯斯透過為路斯坎城做間諜並提供他在深水城政治氣候以及他在商業區夜間巡邏時聽到的有趣新聞資訊來補充他的收入，他完全不知道他的聯絡人是布雷甘·達耶家族的黑暗精靈成員，因為他們穿著斗篷，總是隱藏在陰影中。

english: Agents of the Lords' Alliance recently labeled Fenerus as a wanted brigand and notified the Lords of Waterdeep, who sent the City Watch to arrest him. Fenerus had the good sense to hide the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} elsewhere and hopes to use it as leverage to gain his freedom as well as forgiveness for past crimes.
zh_tw: 最近，領主聯盟的特工將費內魯斯標記為通緝的強盜，並將此通知了深水城的領主們，他們派遣城市守衛去逮捕他。費內魯斯明智地將{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}藏在別處，並希望利用它作為籌碼，以換取自由以及對過去罪行的寬恕。

english: Shortly after Fenerus's arrest, drow agents of Bregan D'aerthe showed up to collect the stone and were waylaid by {@condition invisible} duergar hiding in the alley. The duergar were members of the Xanathar Guild that had been sent by {@creature Nar'l Xibrindas|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) to retrieve the stone. After searching Fenerus's home and finding nothing, they were waiting for Fenerus to return when the drow showed up. The drow barely got away with their lives.
zh_tw: 費內魯斯被捕後不久，布雷甘·達耶的黑暗精靈特工出現來收集石頭，卻被隱藏在小巷中的{@condition invisible||隱形}的灰矮人伏擊了。這些灰矮人是被{@creature Nar'l Xibrindas|wdh|納爾·澤布林達斯}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）派遣來的，屬於姍娜薩公會的成員，目的是取回石頭。他們在搜查了費內魯斯的家並一無所獲後，正等著費內魯斯回來時，黑暗精靈出現了。黑暗精靈勉強逃過一劫。

english: The Three Urchins
zh_tw: 三個小淘氣

english: Three street urchins, described below, appear in several of this chapter's scenes: {@b Nat} is a lanky, 10-year-old deaf Illuskan girl with a wooden toy sword. She is the leader of the group and communicates using a sign language that she invented and taught to her friends. {@b Jenks} is a portly 9-year-old Turami boy with a cloak, a toy wand, and a stuffed owlbear "familiar." He's shy around strangers but brave when it comes to helping his friends. {@b Squiddly} is a slim 9-year-old tiefling boy with an eye patch, a small bow, and a quiver of toy arrows. He rarely thinks before he talks or acts.
zh_tw: 本章的幾個場景中出現了三個街頭小淘氣，具體描述如下：{@b 自然} 是一個瘦長、10歲的聾啞伊路斯坎人女孩，她有一把木製玩具劍。她是這群孩子的領袖，使用她自己發明並教給朋友的手語進行交流。{@b 詹克斯} 是一個9歲的圖拉米人男孩，身材圓潤，有一件斗篷、一根玩具魔杖和一隻填充的梟熊"夥伴"。他在陌生人面前很害羞，但在幫助朋友時卻很勇敢。{@b 斯奎迪利} 是一個瘦小的9歲提夫林男孩，戴著眼罩，有一張小弓和一箭筒玩具箭。他很少在說話或行動前思考。

english: Jarlaxle in Disguise
zh_tw: 偽裝的賈拉索

english: Before the characters leave the alley, {@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) uses his {@item hat of disguise} to approach them in the guise of {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH}, the Open Lord of Waterdeep:
zh_tw: 在角色們離開小巷之前，{@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH|賈拉索·班瑞}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）使用他的{@item hat of disguise||易容帽}以{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}的身份接近他們，萊拉是深水城的公開領主：

english: A tall, graceful woman in an emerald green cloak approaches you, her long, silver hair billowing out from under her hood. "If you've come looking for Fenerus Stormcastle, I'm afraid you're too late," she says. "It appears {@creature Xanathar|WDH} has gotten to him first. Fenerus had something in his possession that I desire. Perhaps you can help retrieve it."
zh_tw: 一位高大、優雅的女士穿著翠綠色斗篷向你們走來，她長長的銀髮從兜帽下飄逸而出。"如果你們是來找費內魯斯·風暴堡的，恐怕你們來晚了，"她說。"看來{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}已經先一步找到他了。費內魯斯擁有我想要的東西。也許你們可以幫助我取回它。"

english: "Laeral" tells the characters that Fenerus had a sentient magic item in his possession called the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, which knows the location of a large cache of gold that was embezzled from the city by its previous Open Lord. She asks the characters to retrieve the stone, for the good of Waterdeep, and deliver it to her at the Seven Masks Theater in the Dock Ward. "Laeral" offers no reward other than the gratitude of Waterdeep's Open Lord.
zh_tw: "萊拉"告訴角色們，費內魯斯擁有一件名為{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}的有感知魔法物品，它知道由前公開領主從城市貪汙的大量黃金的藏匿地點。她請求角色們為了深水城的利益取回這塊石頭，並將其送到碼頭區的七面具劇院交給她。"萊拉"提供的報酬除了深水城公開領主的感激之情外，沒有其他。

english: Jarlaxle suspects that {@creature Nar'l Xibrindas|wdh}, his spy in the Xanathar Guild, has betrayed him and is now using the resources of Bregan D'aerthe to help the beholder retrieve the stone. Jarlaxle also knows that the Xanathar Guild has a refuge fairly close by, in a cellar complex under the Southern Ward. "Laeral" suggests that the characters search for the stone there. (Jarlaxle doesn't want Nar'l to know that he's onto him, which is why he would rather send a small group of adventurers than call upon a Bregan D'aerthe attack force.)
zh_tw: 賈拉索懷疑{@creature Nar'l Xibrindas|wdh|納爾·澤布林達斯}，他在姍娜薩公會的間諜，已經背叛了他，現在正在利用布雷甘·達耶的資源幫助眼魔取回石頭。賈拉索還知道姍娜薩公會在南區下面有一個相當近的避難所，位於一個地窖群中。"萊拉"建議角色們在那裡尋找石頭。（賈拉索不想讓納爾知道他已經注意到他了，這就是為什麼他寧願派遣一小群冒險者而不是召集布雷甘·達耶的攻擊力量。）

english: Characters who are suspicious of Laeral's intentions can ascertain that she's hiding something with a successful Wisdom (Insight) check contested by Jarlaxle's Charisma (Deception) check. If the characters somehow penetrate Jarlaxle's disguise, he smiles and offers them 10,000 gp if they promptly deliver the stone to him at the Seven Masks Theater. He assures them, in all honesty, that he plans to give the gold back to Waterdeep in exchange for some political goodwill.
zh_tw: 對萊拉的意圖持懷疑態度的角色可以透過成功的感知（洞悉）檢定與賈拉索的魅力（欺瞞）檢定進行對抗，以確定她在隱瞞一些事情。如果角色們設法看穿了賈拉索的偽裝，他會微笑並提出如果他們立即將石頭送到七面具劇院給他，就給他們10,000金幣。他誠實地向他們保證，他計劃將黃金還給深水城以換取一些政治上的好感。

english: Next Encounter
zh_tw: 下一場遭遇

english: If the characters invade the Xanathar Guild refuge, proceed with encounter 9, "Cellar Complex."
zh_tw: 如果角色們入侵了姍娜薩公會的避難所，請繼續進行遭遇9，'地窖群'。

english: Alley: Winter
zh_tw: 小巷：冬季

english: The characters' search for the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} leads them to a snow-covered alley in the Trades Ward that contains a windowless Zhentarim safe house ({@area L1|140}) and a meat shop called Cuttle's Meat Pies ({@area L2|141}).
zh_tw: 角色們對{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}的搜尋引導他們來到商業區一個被雪覆蓋的小巷，那裡有一個沒有窗戶的散塔林會安全屋（{@area L1|140}）和一個叫做卡特爾肉餅店的肉店（{@area L2|141}）。

english: The characters approach from either end of the alley. Hoofprints and wheel ruts in the snow testify that Justyn Rassk's delivery cart passed through the alley recently after a brief stop outside the meat shop. A character who inspects the tracks and succeeds on a {@dc 10} Wisdom (Survival) check can tell that the deliverer visited both the shop and the alley residence. Before the characters can investigate further, they are assaulted by members of the Xanathar Guild.
zh_tw: 角色們從小巷的兩端接近。雪地中的蹄印和車轍證明賈斯汀·拉斯克的送貨車在肉店外短暫停留後，最近透過了這條小巷。一個角色如果檢查這些痕跡並在{@dc 10} 感知（求生）檢定中成功，可以判斷出送貨人既去了商店也去了小巷的住所。在角色們能夠進一步調查之前，他們遭到了姍娜薩公會成員的襲擊。

english: Bugbears Attack
zh_tw: 熊地精攻擊

english: At the end of a dead-end side alley south of areas L1 and L2 is an iron grate that covers an opening to the sewers under the North Ward. Five {@creature bugbear||bugbears} have quietly climbed up through the grate and concealed themselves in the side alley. They pour out and attack the characters, hoping to gain surprise in the blizzard. Characters who have a passive Perception score of 16 or higher aren't {@status surprised}.
zh_tw: 在北區下方L1和L2區域南端的死衚衕盡頭，有一個鐵柵欄覆蓋著通往下水道的開口。五個{@creature bugbear||熊地精}已經悄悄地從柵欄下爬了上來，並在小巷中隱蔽起來。它們突然衝出來攻擊角色，希望在暴風雪中獲得突襲的優勢。擁有16或更高被動感知得分的角色不會被{@status surprised||突襲}。

english: The bugbears were sent by {@creature Xanathar|WDH} to retrieve a prisoner being held in the Zhent safe house, but they're too bloodthirsty to pass up the chance to murder a band of adventurers standing in their way. The wind and snow render the City Watch oblivious to the danger.
zh_tw: 地精是被{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}派來從散塔林會成員安全屋中取回一名囚犯的，但他們太渴望鮮血，不願錯過謀殺一群站在他們路上的冒險家的機會。風和雪使城市守衛對危險毫無察覺。

english: Cuttle's Meat Pies
zh_tw: 卡特爾肉餅店

english: Characters who speak to the proprietor of the meat shop, a portly middle-aged woman named Sora Cuttle (LG female Illuskan human {@creature commoner}), learn that she received an unexpected delivery from Justyn Rassk of the Guild of Butchers. Given that fresh meat is in short supply in winter, Sora could hardly turn it down. If the characters see fit to tell her that the meat came from chopped-up humanoids, Sora falls ill. She has no knowledge of {@creature Thrakkus|wdh}'s nasty handiwork and promises to bring the matter to the attention of the Guild of Butchers and the local magister. Until then, she won't use any of {@creature Thrakkus|WDH}'s meat to make her famous meat pies.
zh_tw: 與肉店老闆交談的角色會瞭解到，店主是一位名叫索拉·卡特爾（LG女性伊路斯坎人人類{@creature commoner||平民}）的豐滿中年婦女，她收到了來自屠夫公會的賈斯汀·拉斯克的一個意外送貨。考慮到冬天鮮肉供應短缺，索拉幾乎無法拒絕。如果角色們覺得合適，告訴她這些肉來自被切碎的人形生物，索拉會感到噁心。她對{@creature Thrakkus|wdh|薩卡斯}的噁心行徑一無所知，並承諾將此事提請屠夫公會和當地地方官注意。在此之前，她不會使用任何{@creature Thrakkus|WDH|薩卡斯}的肉來做她著名的肉餡餅。

english: Sora is suspicious of her two neighbors in {@area L1|140}. They come and go at strange hours, sometimes returning from a night's sojourn with blood on their leather armor. If the characters do Sora the courtesy of warning her about the meat, she happily shares her concerns about her naughty neighbors, along with descriptions of them. One is a pale, gaunt woman in her twenties with dark, stringy hair. The other is a much older, dark-skinned man with a bald head, a half-missing ear, and a short white beard.
zh_tw: 索拉對她在{@area L1|140}的兩位鄰居心存疑慮。她們總在奇怪的時間進出，有時夜歸時皮甲上還帶著血跡。如果角色們好心警告索拉關於肉食的事，她會愉快地分享對這些頑劣鄰居的擔憂，並描述她們的外貌。其中一位是二十多歲的蒼白瘦削女子，留著深色亂髮；另一位則是年長得多的黑皮膚光頭男子，缺了半隻耳朵，蓄著短短的白鬍子。

english: Zhentarim Safe House
zh_tw: 散塔林會安全屋

english: This windowless house is occupied by two Zhents loyal to {@creature Manshoon|WDH}-the same individuals that Sora describes. Their names are Avareen Windrivver (LE female Illuskan human {@creature spy}) and Zorbog Jyarkoth (NE male Turami human {@creature thug}).
zh_tw: 這座沒有窗戶的房子被兩個忠於{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的散塔林會成員佔據——就是索拉描述的那兩個人。他們的名字是阿瓦琳·溫德里弗（LE女性伊路斯坎人人類{@creature spy||間諜}）和佐爾博格·賈爾科斯（NE男性圖拉米人人類{@creature thug||暴徒}）。

english: When the characters first enter the alley, Avareen is in the front doorway of the house, handing the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} to a high-ranking Zhent named Vevette Blackwater (CE female Tethyrian human {@creature swashbuckler|VGM}; see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}). Zorbog is stoking a fire in the fireplace while quietly observing the transaction. With stone in hand, Vevette scrambles up to the rooftops, leaving Avareen and Zorbog to deal with the survivors of the conflict between the characters and the bugbears.
zh_tw: 當角色們首次進入小巷時，阿瓦琳站在房子的前門口，將{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}交給一個名叫薇薇特·黑水（CE女性泰瑟爾人人類{@creature swashbuckler|VGM|風流劍客}；見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）的高階散塔林會成員。佐爾博格在壁爐旁添火，同時靜靜觀察交易。拿到石頭後，薇薇特爬上屋頂，留下阿瓦琳和佐爾博格來對付角色和熊地精之間衝突的生還者。

english: Gagged and tied to a chair in the back room of the house is a known member of the Xanathar Guild-a shield dwarf who wears a leather skullcap stitched with fake beholder eyestalks. The dwarf, {@creature Ott Steeltoes|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), was captured while buying fish food in a Dock Ward market. After the Zhents interrogated Ott, it became clear to them that {@creature Xanathar|WDH} would want him back. He is being held until a ransom is paid, but {@creature Xanathar|WDH} has learned where he is being kept. Any bugbears that survived the initial attack try to rescue Ott, while Avareen and Zorbog do their best to fight them off. If Ott is set free, he runs back to the waiting eyestalks of his insane beholder master. Characters who follow him are led straight to {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s lair (see chapter 5).
zh_tw: 在房子的後室裡，一個被綁在椅子上並塞住嘴巴的姍娜薩公會知名成員——一個戴著縫有假眼魔眼柄的皮製頭巾的盾矮人。這個矮人，{@creature Ott Steeltoes|wdh|奧特·鋼趾}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），在碼頭區市場購買魚食時被捕。經過散塔林會成員審問奧特後，他們意識到{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}會想要他回去。他被扣留，直到支付贖金，但{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}已經知道他被關在哪裡。任何在初次攻擊中倖存下來的地精都會試圖營救奧特，而阿瓦琳和佐爾博格則盡力擊退他們。如果奧特被釋放，他會跑回他瘋狂的眼魔主人等待的眼柄那裡。跟隨他的角色將直接被引到{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的巢穴（見第5章）。

english: Next Encounter
zh_tw: 下一場遭遇

english: Any characters within 10 feet of the Zhents' front door can make a {@dc 14} Wisdom (Perception) check. Those who succeed on the check hear a mocking laugh above the howling wind and glimpse a cloaked figure on a nearby roof, darting away through the blizzard. If the characters chase after this figure, proceed with encounter 5, "Rooftop Chase."
zh_tw: 任何位於散塔林會前門10尺範圍內的角色可以進行一次{@dc 14} 感知（感知）檢定。檢定成功的角色在呼嘯的風聲中聽到一聲嘲弄的笑聲，並瞥見附近屋頂上有一個披著斗篷的身影，在暴風雪中迅速離去。如果角色追趕這個身影，繼續進行遭遇5，"屋頂追逐"。

english: Encounter 2: Mistshore
zh_tw: 遭遇2: 霧岸

english: Mistshore is a run-down Dock Ward neighborhood that reeks of fish and scorched timber. A fire swept through the area a little over a year ago, and most of the buildings are now burned-out shells with (at best) sails for roofs. Fishing poles and nets line the dock, and the 15-foot-deep water is covered by a thick layer of ice during the winter.
zh_tw: 霧岸是一個破敗的碼頭區社群，散發著魚腥味和燒焦木材的氣味。一年多前，一場火災席捲了這個地區，現在大多數建築物都已成為燒燬的外殼，頂多用帆布作為屋頂。碼頭上排列著釣魚竿和漁網，冬季時，15尺深的水被一層厚厚的冰覆蓋。

english: Areas of Mistshore
zh_tw: 霧岸區域

english: Mistshore is a riotous assemblage of ramshackle homes made of wood from old ships and inhabited by impoverished Waterdavians. Several buildings were reduced to ash by the fire last year. Although some were rebuilt, others were ruined beyond repair and are now used as roofless dens by homeless children and {@creature rat||rats}.
zh_tw: 霧岸是由舊船木料搭建的破舊房屋的雜亂無章的集合，居住著貧困的沃特迪普市民。去年的火災將幾座建築物燒成了灰燼。儘管有些建築被重建了，但其他一些則被毀得無法修復，現在被無家可歸的兒童和{@creature rat||老鼠}用作無屋頂的巢穴。

english: The following locations are keyed to map 4.2.
zh_tw: 以下地點標記於地圖 4.2。

english: Mistshore
zh_tw: 霧岸

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: D1. Kraken's Folly
zh_tw: D1. 克拉肯的愚行

english: The Kraken's Folly is a beached pirate ship that some residents of Mistshore use as a tenement. At any given time, {@dice 4d6} {@creature bandit||bandits} loiter on deck, hoping that someone who needs muscle will offer them work. These ruffians live in the rat-infested cabins belowdecks. They are willing to come to the aid of anyone who asks-for a price. Each demands 1 gp to get involved in a fight or create a distraction on behalf of their employer.
zh_tw: "克拉肯的愚行"是一艘擱淺的海盜船，霧岸的一些居民將其用作公寓。任何時候，都有{@dice 4d6}名{@creature bandit||匪徒}在甲板上閒逛，希望有人需要肌肉力量會提供給他們工作。這些惡棍住在下面滿是老鼠的船艙裡。他們願意以價格來幫助任何請求他們的人。每個人都要求1金幣來參與戰鬥或為僱主製造幹擾。

english: D2. Grinda's Residence
zh_tw: D2. 格林達的住所

english: A mad treasure hunter named {@creature Grinda Garloth|WDH} (CN female Illuskan human {@creature mage} who speaks Common, Dwarvish, Halfling, and Undercommon) lives here. Her ramshackle home contains an unmade bed, an alchemist's laboratory, a small stove, a coat rack, a table, a stool, a stuffed chair in poor condition, a wash basin, and a locked wooden sea chest with a {@spell glyph of warding} spell cast on it. Grinda carries the key, and the glyph triggers an explosive runes effect (see the spell description in the {@book Player's Handbook|phb}) if anyone other than Grinda lifts the lid of the chest.
zh_tw: 一個名叫{@creature Grinda Garloth|WDH|格林達·加洛斯}（CN女性伊路斯坎人人類{@creature mage||魔法師}，會說通用語、矮人語、半身人語和地底通用語）的瘋狂尋寶者住在這裡。她破舊的家中有一張未整理的床、一個鍊金術實驗室、一個小爐子、一個衣架、一張桌子、一把凳子、一把狀況不佳的填充椅、一個洗臉盆，以及一個上了鎖的木製海箱，上面施加了{@spell glyph of warding||守衛刻文}法術。格林達拿著鑰匙，如果除了格林達之外的任何人開啟箱子的蓋子，符文就會觸發爆炸符文效果（見{@book 玩家手冊|phb}中的法術描述）。

english: Chest
zh_tw: 箱子

english: Grinda's chest contains a heavy iron key that locks and unlocks the Garloth family mausoleum in the City of the Dead (see "Mistshore: Spring" below).
zh_tw: 格林達的箱子裡有一個沉重的鐵鑰匙，用來鎖住和開啟位於亡者之城的加洛斯家族陵墓（見下文的"霧岸：春季"）。

english: D3. Grinda's Apparatus
zh_tw: D3. 格林達的裝置

english: Grinda and her Apparatus of Kwalish
zh_tw: 格林達和她的誇利什裝置

english: {@creature Grinda Garloth|WDH} keeps her {@item apparatus of Kwalish} here when she's not using the vehicle to hunt for treasure in Deepwater Harbor. While the apparatus is here, it floats in an enclosed dock. Underwater metal doors leading out to the harbor are kept shut by an iron bar across the inside. The apparatus can lift the iron bar automatically; a creature inside the bay can lift it with a successful {@dc 20} Strength (Athletics) check.
zh_tw: 當{@creature Grinda Garloth|WDH|格林達·加洛斯}沒有使用{@item apparatus of Kwalish||誇力許裝置}在深水港搜尋寶藏時，她會將它存放在這裡。當裝置在此處時，它會漂浮在一個封閉的船塢中。通往港口的水下金屬門由內側的一根鐵條保持關閉。裝置可以自動抬起鐵條；位於船塢內的生物可以透過一次成功的{@dc 20}力量（運動）檢定來抬起它。

english: Borrowing the Apparatus
zh_tw: 借用裝置

english: Grinda allows the characters to borrow her {@item apparatus of Kwalish} on the condition that they first use the device to search the bottom of Deepwater Harbor for treasure and give her half of whatever they find. To meet the mage's demands, the characters must spend a day searching the harbor. At the end of the day, the pilot makes an Intelligence (Investigation) check. Multiply the total of the check by 10 to determine the gold piece value of any treasure found. Grinda sells the bounty and gives half to the characters.
zh_tw: 格林達允許角色借用她的{@item apparatus of Kwalish||誇力許裝置}，條件是他們首先使用這個裝置在深水港底部搜尋寶藏，並且給她找到的任何東西的一半。為了滿足法師的要求，角色們必須花一天時間搜尋港口。在一天結束時，駕駛員進行一次智力（調查）檢定。將檢定的總分乘以10，以確定找到的任何寶藏的金幣價值。格林達出售這些戰利品，並將一半給角色們。

english: As the characters search the harbor for treasure, roll any die. If an even number is rolled, an awakened shark named {@creature Obliteros|wdh} attacks them. Grinda has had several close encounters with the shark recently, but fails to mention this to the characters for fear of scaring them off. {@creature Obliteros|wdh} is a {@creature giant shark}, with these changes:
zh_tw: 當角色們在港口搜尋寶藏時，擲任意骰子。如果擲出偶數，則一隻名為{@creature Obliteros|wdh|奧布里特羅斯}的覺醒鯊魚會攻擊他們。格林達最近與這隻鯊魚有過多次近距離的遭遇，但由於擔心嚇跑角色們，她沒有提及此事。{@creature Obliteros|wdh|奧布里特羅斯}是一隻{@creature giant shark||巨鯊}，具有以下變化：

english: The shark's alignment is chaotic evil.
zh_tw: 這隻鯊魚的陣營是混亂邪惡。

english: Its Intelligence score is 10 (+0), and it can speak and understand Aquan.
zh_tw: 它的智力得分是10（+0），並且能夠說和理解水族語。

english: Mistshore: Spring
zh_tw: 霧岸：春季

english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH} has sent forces to collect the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} from {@creature Grinda Garloth|WDH}, known up and down the wharf as an eccentric wizard who owns a submersible contraption that she uses to hunt for treasure on the bottom of Deepwater Harbor. The characters have no trouble getting directions to her Mistshore residence ({@area D2|15a}).
zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩} 已經派遣部隊從{@creature Grinda Garloth|WDH|格林達·加洛斯}那裡收集{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，格林達·加洛斯是碼頭上眾所周知的古怪法師，她擁有一個潛水裝置，用來在深水港底部尋找寶藏。角色們很容易就能找到前往她位於霧岸的住所（{@area D2|15a}）的路線。

english: When the characters arrive at her home, Grinda is holed up inside, having barricaded the doors with furniture. Trying to break down the doors are four members of the Xanathar Guild (CE male human {@creature bandit||bandits}) under the command of a dwarf enforcer named {@creature Noska Ur'gray|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}). A {@creature merrow} also under Noska's command swims beneath the docks. It surfaces to attack when the characters arrive.
zh_tw: 當角色們到達她的家時，格林達正躲在裡面，用傢俱堵住了門。四個姍娜薩公會的成員（CE男性人類{@creature bandit||匪徒}）在名叫{@creature Noska Ur'gray|wdh|諾思卡·厄格雷}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）的矮人執法者的指揮下試圖破門而入。一個{@creature merrow||邁羅人魚}也在諾思卡的指揮下在碼頭下游動。當角色們到達時，它浮出水面進行攻擊。

english: If the characters come to Grinda's defense, Noska orders his thugs to attack them while he takes potshots at the characters with his crossbow. Two rounds later, eight more {@creature bandit||bandits} leap down from the {@i Kraken's Folly} ({@area D1|159}) and join the fray. These hooligans were paid 1 gp each to watch Noska's back. The characters can turn them against Noska by offering a larger bribe (at least 5 gp each).
zh_tw: 如果角色們前來幫助格林達，諾思卡命令他的暴徒們攻擊他們，同時他用他的弩向角色們射擊。兩輪之後，另外八名{@creature bandit||匪徒}從{@i 克拉肯的愚行}（{@area D1|159}）跳下來加入混戰。這些流氓被支付了每人1金幣來保護諾思卡的後方。角色們可以透過提供更高的賄賂（至少每人5金幣）來讓他們反對諾思卡。

english: If the characters turn the hooligans against Noska or reduce the dwarf to half his hit points or fewer, Noska flees. Any remaining Xanathar Guild members cover his escape. Grinda emerges from her residence to thank the characters once the fight has concluded.
zh_tw: 如果角色們讓流氓們反對諾思卡，或者將矮人的生命力減少到一半或更少，諾思卡會逃跑。剩下的姍娜薩公會成員會掩護他的逃跑。戰鬥結束後，格林達會從她的住所出來感謝角色們。

english: Where's the Stone?
zh_tw: 石頭在哪裡？

english: Grinda admits that she has done business with the Xanathar Guild in the past. Her orders were to protect the stone until Noska arrived to claim it, but she changed her mind and decided to keep the stone for herself. She now realizes that decision was a mistake.
zh_tw: 格林達承認她過去曾與姍娜薩公會有過生意往來。她的命令是保護這塊石頭，直到諾思卡來認領它，但她改變了主意，決定自己保留這塊石頭。她現在意識到這個決定是個錯誤。

english: Grinda tells the characters that she gave the stone to her rat familiar and told the creature to stash it in her family's mausoleum in the City of the Dead. The mage gives the characters directions to the site and a key to the mausoleum. (They won't need the key, since the mausoleum is open when they arrive.)
zh_tw: 格林達告訴角色們，她把石頭給了她的老鼠寵物，並告訴這個生物把它藏在亡者之城的家族陵墓裡。這位法師給了角色們前往那裡的指引和陵墓的鑰匙。（他們不需要鑰匙，因為他們到達時陵墓是開著的。）

english: Spy in the Sky
zh_tw: 空中的間諜

english: As the characters leave Mistshore, a {@creature gazer|VGM} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) begins to follow them, staying at least 60 feet away. {@creature Xanathar|WDH} uses it to spy on the characters. Characters who have a passive Perception score of 15 or higher can spot the gazer shortly after the party enters the City of the Dead. The gazer defends itself if attacked.
zh_tw: 當角色們離開霧岸時，一隻{@creature gazer|VGM|凝視者眼魔}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）開始跟隨他們，保持至少60尺的距離。{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}用它來監視角色們。感知被動分數為15或更高的角色可以在隊伍進入亡者之城後不久發現瞪眼怪。如果遭到攻擊，瞪眼怪會進行自衛。

english: Next Encounter
zh_tw: 下一場遭遇

english: Armed with directions to the Garloth mausoleum, the characters can head for the City of the Dead. The spring chain continues with encounter 4, "Mausoleum."
zh_tw: 掌握了前往加洛斯家族陵墓的方向，角色們可以前往亡者之城。春季遭遇鏈繼續進行遭遇4，"陵墓"。

english: Mistshore: Autumn
zh_tw: 霧岸：秋季

english: At the end of their pursuit, the characters corner {@creature Fel'rekt Lafeen|WDH} and {@creature Krebbyg Masq'il'yr|WDH} in Mistshore. The two {@creature drow gunslinger|WDH|drow gunslingers} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) lurk behind the {@i Kraken's Folly} ({@area D1|159}) and wait to be rescued. When the characters confront them, Fel'rekt and Krebbyg stall for time until their escape vehicle arrives. If either drow falls, the other tosses the stone into the harbor to keep it from falling into enemy hands. A character can recover the sunken stone by using a {@spell detect magic} spell to help pinpoint its location.
zh_tw: 在追捕的最後，角色們在霧岸的角落圍堵了{@creature Fel'rekt Lafeen|WDH|菲爾萊科特·拉菲恩}和{@creature Krebbyg Masq'il'yr|WDH|克雷比格·馬斯奇爾}。這兩個{@creature drow gunslinger|WDH|卓爾火槍手}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）潛伏在{@i 克拉肯的愚行}（{@area D1|159}）後面等待救援。當角色們面對他們時，菲爾萊科特和克雷比格拖延時間，直到他們的逃生車輛到達。如果任何一個黑暗精靈倒下，另一個會把石頭扔進海港，以防止它落入敵人手中。一個角色可以透過使用一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術來幫助確定其位置，從而回收沉沒的石頭。

english: Big Belchy
zh_tw: 大噴氣

english: A mechanical dragon turtle, dubbed Big Belchy, sank in Deepwater Harbor almost a century ago. Lantanese gnomes working for Jarlaxle have managed to repair the construct. Two rounds after the characters corner Fel'rekt and Krebbyg, Big Belchy surfaces next to the dock on initiative count 5, close enough that the drow can leap onto its barnacle-encrusted back on their next turns.
zh_tw: 一個被稱為大噴氣的機械龍龜，幾乎一個世紀前沉沒在深水港。為賈拉索工作的蘭檀語侏儒設法修復了這個構裝生物。在角色們將菲爾萊科特和克雷比格逼入角落後的兩個回合，大噴氣在主動性計數5時浮出水面，靠近碼頭，足夠近，以至於在他們的下一個回合，黑暗精靈可以跳到它覆蓋著藤壺的背上。

english: In the round after it surfaces, the mechanism breathes a cloud of steam onto the docks in a 30-foot cube, then begins to move away at a swimming speed of 20 feet. Any creature in the cloud of steam must make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 ({@dice 4d10}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Big Belchy can breathe steam only once. On each of its turns thereafter, it swims a total of 40 feet toward Jarlaxle's flagship, the {@i Eyecatcher}, which is anchored in the middle of the harbor 1 mile away.
zh_tw: 在它浮出水面後的那一輪，機制會向碼頭噴出一團30尺立方的蒸汽，然後以20尺的游泳速度開始移動。任何在蒸汽雲中的生物必須進行一次{@dc 14}敏捷豁免，若失敗則受到22點（{@dice 4d10}）火焰傷害，若成功則受到一半傷害。大貝奇只能噴一次蒸汽。在之後的每一輪，它會向賈拉索的旗艦{@i 奪目號}游泳總計40尺，該旗艦停泊在1英里外的港口中央。

english: Big Belchy has AC 18, 75 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. If it is reduced to 0 hit points, it sinks once more to the bottom of Deepwater Harbor. If the drow are still on its back when it goes down, they swim the rest of the way to the {@i Eyecatcher} but gain two levels of {@condition exhaustion} from the cold water and exertion.
zh_tw: 大貝奇擁有 AC 18，75 點生命值，並對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。如果它的生命值降至 0，它將再次沉入深水港的底部。如果它在下沉時黑暗精靈仍在它的背上，他們將游完剩下的路程前往 {@i 奪目號}，但由於冷水和勞累，他們將獲得兩級 {@condition exhaustion||力竭}。

english: If the drow are defeated while on Big Belchy's back, the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} tumbles off the mechanical dragon turtle's shell and drops into Deepwater Harbor. If the water is deep enough, the characters might need to borrow {@creature Grinda Garloth|WDH}'s {@item apparatus of Kwalish} to recover it.
zh_tw: 如果黑暗精靈在大噴氣的背上被擊敗，{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}會從機械龍龜的殼上滾落，掉入深水港。如果水足夠深，角色們可能需要借用{@creature Grinda Garloth|WDH|格林達·加洛斯}的{@item apparatus of Kwalish||誇力許裝置}來回收它。

english: Next Encounter
zh_tw: 下一場遭遇

english: If a character becomes attuned to the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, it reveals the location of the Vault of Dragons, beneath an old stone windmill in the Sea Ward, and the three keys needed to enter it. When the characters are ready to visit the location, proceed with encounter 10, "Converted Windmill."
zh_tw: 如果一個角色與{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}產生共鳴，它會揭示位於海區一座舊石頭風車下的龍之寶庫的位置，以及進入所需的三把鑰匙。當角色們準備好訪問該地點時，請繼續進行遭遇10，'改造風車'。

english: Mistshore: Winter
zh_tw: 霧岸：冬季

english: The characters head to Mistshore in search of the man they believe has the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}. En route to that destination, the man had his hire-coach make a brief stop in the Castle Ward to drop off his lady friend. She now has the stone-a fact that characters can discover by questioning the man, a bard named Agorn Fuoco.
zh_tw: 角色們前往霧岸尋找他們認為擁有{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}的人。在前往目的地的途中，那名男子讓他僱傭的馬車在城堡區短暫停留，讓他的女性朋友下車。她現在擁有那塊石頭——角色們可以透過詢問那名男子，一個名叫阿戈恩·弗奧科的吟遊詩人，來發現這一事實。

english: Agorn made such a good impression on {@creature Manshoon|WDH} that he was elevated quickly through the ranks of the organization, but his life is full of disappointment otherwise. He has not achieved the fame he craved nor earned the wealth he felt he was entitled to. He has adopted the Zhentarim credo that power comes to those who deserve it and has come to see the Black Network as a new family of sorts. Agorn has come to Mistshore to visit a member of his actual family-his mother, who is gravely ill and lives in abject poverty.
zh_tw: 阿戈恩給{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}留下了深刻的印象，以至於他在組織的等級中迅速提升，但他的生活除此之外充滿了失望。他沒有獲得他渴望的名聲，也沒有得到他認為應得的財富。他採納了散塔林會的信條，認為權力屬於那些值得擁有它的人，並且開始將黑網視為某種新的家庭。阿戈恩來到霧岸拜訪他真正的家庭成員——他病重且生活在極度貧困中的母親。

english: A Waiting Coach
zh_tw: 等待中的馬車

english: Waiting at the edge of the neighborhood is the hirecoach that bore Agorn Fuoco through the blizzard to Mistshore. Two {@creature draft horse||draft horses} stamp their hooves impatiently in the snow. The driver, Rowan Evenwood (LG female Chondathan human {@creature commoner}), was paid extra to wait for Agorn to return. He left in a hurry, and she doesn't know how long she is expected to wait, but her patience has limits.
zh_tw: 在鄰近地區的邊緣，等待著載阿戈恩·弗奧科穿過暴風雪到霧岸的僱傭馬車。兩匹{@creature draft horse||馱用馬}在雪地中不耐煩地跺著蹄子。車伕羅文·伊文伍德（LG女性瓊達斯人人類{@creature commoner||平民}），為了等待阿戈恩返回而額外支付了費用。他匆忙離開，她不知道要等多久，但她的耐心是有限的。

english: A Cold Reception
zh_tw: 冷漠的接待

english: A blizzard is tearing through Mistshore, turning its rotten tenements into dark, looming shapes behind veils of blowing snow. The water around the docks is frozen solid, and impoverished {@creature commoner||commoners} clad in tattered garments gather around sputtering campfires for warmth. These folk are suspicious of anyone they don't recognize and far from welcoming, even toward those who show them charity. These people would tear the clothes from the characters' backs given half a chance.
zh_tw: 一場暴風雪正在霧岸肆虐，將其破舊的公寓變成了被飛雪掩蓋的黑暗、隱約的輪廓。碼頭周圍的水已經完全結冰，而穿著破爛衣物的貧困{@creature commoner||平民}聚集在閃爍的篝火周圍取暖。這些人對任何他們不認識的人都持懷疑態度，並且遠非熱情，即使對那些向他們施捨的人也是如此。只要有機會，這些人甚至會從角色們的背後搶走衣服。

english: Ice Escapades
zh_tw: 冰上冒險

english: Playing on the ice underneath the docks are three street urchins wearing frayed cloaks and gloves. They dart in and out of view, hurling snowballs at each other and laughing as the blizzard batters the structures above them (see "{@area The Three Urchins|14e|x}").
zh_tw: 在碼頭下面的冰上玩耍的是三個穿著磨損斗篷和手套的街頭小淘氣。他們在視線中穿梭，互相投擲雪球，當暴風雪襲擊他們上方的建築物時，他們歡笑著（見"{@area 三個小淘氣|14e|x}"）。

english: When the children see the characters for the first time, their interest is piqued. The children fancy themselves adventurers of sorts, and they are quick to idolize and emulate real-life ones. {@creature Squiddly|WDH} even has the audacity to hurl a snowball at one of them ({@hit 0} bonus to hit). The children know who Agorn Fuoco is because he used to live and play music in Mistshore. They offer to lead characters to his mother's residence.
zh_tw: 當子嗣們第一次看到角色時，他們的興趣被激起了。這些子嗣自詡為某種冒險者，並且他們很快就開始崇拜並模仿現實中的冒險者。{@creature Squiddly|WDH|斯奎迪利}甚至膽敢向其中一人猛投雪球（命中加值{@hit 0}）。子嗣們知道阿戈恩·弗奧科是誰，因為他過去曾在霧岸居住並演奏音樂。他們提出要帶角色去他母親的住所。

english: Mother and Son
zh_tw: 母親與兒子

english: Pick one of the unmarked buildings on map 4.2 to serve as the Fuoco residence. Agorn Fuoco (NE male Turami {@creature bard|VGM}; see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) is inside, trying to smother his bedridden mother, Marta (N female Turami human {@creature commoner} with 1 hit point), with a sack she uses as a pillowcase. With tears born of joy and sadness streaming down his face, Agorn is cutting loose his old family ties and embracing his new family: the Zhentarim. The characters can stop him from committing matricide by pulling him away from his mother before she suffocates.
zh_tw: 在地圖4.2上選擇一個未標記的建築作為弗奧科的住所。阿戈恩·弗奧科（NE男性圖拉米人{@creature bard|VGM|吟遊詩人}；見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）在裡面，試圖用他母親用作枕套的袋子悶死他臥床不起的母親瑪塔（N女性圖拉米人人類{@creature commoner||平民}，有1點生命值），他的臉上流下了既喜悅又悲傷的淚水。阿戈恩正在切斷他與舊家庭的聯絡，擁抱他的新家庭：散塔林會。角色們可以透過在他母親窒息之前將他從母親身邊拉開來阻止他犯下弒母罪。

english: Agorn was moved to perpetrate this act by the play he saw at the theater and by his lady friend, Amath Sercent, to whom he entrusted the Stone of Golorr. He won't give up her location willingly, though magic can be used to pry the information from his lips. Characters can also speak to the hire-coach driver, Rowan Evenwood, who dropped off Agorn's lady friend before transporting Agorn to Mistshore. Amath lives in an old tower in the Castle Ward called Yellowspire.
zh_tw: 阿戈恩是被他在劇院看到的戲劇以及他的女性朋友阿瑪斯·瑟森特所感動，才決定實施這一行為的，他將格洛爾之石交給了阿瑪斯。他不會輕易放棄她的位置，儘管可以使用魔法從他口中撬出資訊。角色們也可以與僱傭馬車司機羅文·伊文伍德交談，她在將阿戈恩的女性朋友放下後，將阿戈恩運送到了霧岸。阿瑪斯住在城堡區一個叫做黃尖塔的舊塔裡。

english: Zhents in the Wind
zh_tw: 風中的散塔林會成員

english: As the characters leave the Fuoco residence, with or without Agorn as their prisoner, they are surrounded by nine Zhentarim {@creature thug||thugs}. The thugs fight to the death while Agorn tries to escape. If he gets away, the characters might encounter him again in chapter 8.
zh_tw: 當角色們帶著或不帶阿戈恩作為俘虜離開弗奧科住所時，他們被九名散塔林會{@creature thug||暴徒}包圍。這些暴徒戰鬥至死，而阿戈恩則試圖逃跑。如果他逃脫了，角色們可能會在第8章再次遇到他。

english: As the Zhents attack and Agorn attempts to flee, the characters hear a child's scream coming from the opposite direction. Through the blowing snow, they can see that one of the urchins, {@creature Jenks|WDH}, has fallen through a thin patch of ice and is in danger of sinking to the bottom of the harbor. His two friends are trying to pull him out of the hole, but he's too heavy. The children are roughly 30 feet away. A character within arm's reach of {@creature Jenks|WDH} can use an action to try to pull the boy from the cold water, doing so with a successful {@dc 11} Strength (Athletics) check. If no adult comes to {@creature Jenks|WDH}'s aid within 1 minute of his falling through the ice, he sinks below the surface and begins to drown as the cold water overcomes him.
zh_tw: 當散塔林會成員發動攻擊而阿戈恩試圖逃跑時，角色們聽到一個孩子的尖叫聲從相反的方向傳來。透過飄舞的雪花，他們可以看到其中一個流浪兒，{@creature Jenks|WDH|詹克斯}，掉入了薄冰層中，面臨沉入港口底部的危險。他的兩個朋友正試圖將他從冰洞中拉出來，但他太重了。孩子們大約在30尺外。一個距離{@creature Jenks|WDH|詹克斯}伸手可及的角色可以使用一個動作嘗試將男孩從冷水中拉出來，這樣做需要進行一次成功的{@dc 11}力量（運動）檢定。如果在他掉入冰洞後1分鐘內沒有成人前來救援{@creature Jenks|WDH|詹克斯}，他將沉入水面下，並因冰冷的海水而開始溺水。

english: If the characters find themselves outmatched by the Zhents, help comes in two forms. Two Harper {@creature spy||spies} sent by {@creature Remallia Haventree|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) appear on the scene. Their names are Salazar Lorrance (CG male Tethyrian human) and Mavia Oxlander (NG female Chondathan human). If the battle doesn't turn quickly in the party's favor, {@creature Grinda Garloth|WDH} (see {@area D2|15a}) appears and uses her magic to aid them.
zh_tw: 如果角色們發現自己在與散塔林會成員的戰鬥中處於劣勢，會有兩方面的幫助到來。由{@creature Remallia Haventree|WDH|蕾米莉亞·港樹}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）派出的兩名豎琴手聯盟{@creature spy||間諜們}出現在現場。他們的名字是薩拉札·洛蘭斯（CG男性泰瑟爾人人類）和瑪維亞·奧克斯蘭德（NG女性瓊達斯人人類）。如果戰鬥沒有很快轉向隊伍有利的方向，{@creature Grinda Garloth|WDH|格林達·加洛斯}（見{@area D2|15a}）出現並使用她的魔法來幫助他們。

english: Next Encounter
zh_tw: 下一場遭遇

english: Armed with information from Agorn Fuoco or his hirecoach driver, the characters might feel compelled to pay a visit to Yellowspire in the Castle Ward. Proceed with encounter 7, "Old Tower."
zh_tw: 根據阿戈恩·弗奧科或他的馬車伕提供的資訊，角色們可能覺得有必要去城堡區的黃尖塔塔樓拜訪。請繼續進行遭遇7，'舊塔樓'。

english: Encounter 3: Street Chase
zh_tw: 遭遇3：街頭追逐

english: For this encounter, use the chase rules and the Urban Chase Complications {@book table|dmg|8|chase complications} in chapter 8 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|dmg}. The chase plays out as a "theater of the mind" experience. Consequently, you don't need a map to run the encounter. The chase occurs outdoors, so be mindful of any weather effects in play.
zh_tw: 對於這次遭遇，請使用第8章中{@book 城主指南|dmg}的追逐規則和城市追逐複雜情況{@book 表格|dmg|8|chase complications}。這次追逐將展開為一種"心靈劇院"體驗。因此，你不需要地圖來執行這次遭遇。追逐發生在戶外，所以請留意任何正在生效的天氣效果。

english: Street Chase: Spring
zh_tw: 街頭追逐：春季

english: A {@creature kenku} in cahoots with the Xanathar Guild has the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} and is running through the streets with it. The kenku is 60 feet away from the characters at the start of the chase.
zh_tw: 一名與姍娜薩公會勾結的{@creature kenku||天狗}拿著{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}在街道上奔跑。追逐開始時，天狗距離角色們60尺遠。

english: If at any point the kenku is {@condition incapacitated}, another {@creature kenku} previously hidden by the rain or fog joins the chase, acting next in the initiative count. It suddenly appears, snatches the stone, and flees with it.
zh_tw: 如果任何時候天狗處於{@condition incapacitated||無力}狀態，另一個之前被雨或霧隱藏的{@creature kenku||天狗}會加入追逐，按照主動性計數的下一個行動。它突然出現，抓起石頭，然後帶著它逃跑。

english: Next Encounter
zh_tw: 下一場遭遇

english: When the characters are close to catching the kenku, or when you want the chase to end, the creature ducks into an old tower. Proceed with encounter 7, "Old Tower."
zh_tw: 當角色們接近抓住天狗時，或者當你想要追逐結束時，這個生物躲進了一座舊塔樓。請繼續進行遭遇7，'舊塔樓'。

english: Street Chase: Summer
zh_tw: 街頭追逐：夏季

english: The characters are pursuing Lord Cassalanter's doppelganger valet, Willifort, as he flees in a hire-coach or on foot. The chase takes place on crowded streets, in front of agog spectators.
zh_tw: 角色們正在追逐卡薩蘭特領主的變形怪僕人威利福特，他乘坐僱傭馬車或步行逃跑。追逐發生在擁擠的街道上，吸引了眾多驚訝的旁觀者。

english: If you haven't been tracking the distance between the doppelganger and the characters, assume the characters are 120 feet away from their quarry at the start of the chase if Willifort is traveling by hire-coach, or 60 feet away if the doppelganger is on foot. The hire-coach has an initiative modifier of +0, and Willifort moves with it. A creature in the hire-coach doesn't need to roll on the Urban Chase Complications table on its turn.
zh_tw: 如果你還沒有追蹤變形怪和角色之間的距離，假設在追逐開始時，如果威利福特乘坐僱傭馬車，角色們距離他們的目標120尺遠，或者如果變形怪步行，則是60尺遠。僱傭馬車的主動性調整值為+0，威利福特隨它移動。在僱傭馬車內的生物在自己的回合不需要在城市追逐複雜性表格上進行滾動。

english: Crowded Street
zh_tw: 擁擠的街道

english: If Willifort flees in a hire-coach, his getaway is thwarted on the third round of the chase when a large crowd blocks the road, forcing the hire-coach to stop. (If the chase occurs on Founders' Day, the crowd is part of the holiday celebration.) The doppelganger jumps out of the hire-coach on his next turn and makes his way through the crowd on foot.
zh_tw: 如果威利福特乘坐僱傭馬車逃跑，在追逐的第三輪時，他會被一大群人擋住道路，迫使馬車停下來。（如果追逐發生在創始人日，人群是節日慶祝活動的一部分。）變形怪在下一回合跳出馬車，並步行穿過人群。

english: Any creature in the crowd has {@quickref Cover||3||half cover}, and any attack that misses the creature because of the cover hits an innocent {@creature commoner} instead.
zh_tw: 人群中的任何生物都有{@quickref Cover||3||掩護}，任何因為掩護而未擊中該生物的攻擊將擊中一個無辜的{@creature commoner||平民}。

english: If Willifort is {@condition incapacitated}, a raven abruptly swoops down, acting next in the initiative count. It snatches the stone and flees with it. This raven is a shapechanged {@creature imp} that works for Lady Cassalanter.
zh_tw: 如果威利福特處於{@condition incapacitated||無力}狀態，一隻烏鴉突然俯衝下來，在主動性計數中下一個行動。它抓起石頭並帶著它逃跑。這隻烏鴉是一隻變形的{@creature imp||小魔鬼}，為卡薩蘭特女士工作。

english: Street Urchins
zh_tw: 街頭小淘氣

english: The chase ends when three street urchins (see "{@area The Three Urchins|14e|x}"), steal the stone, either by pickpocketing it from the doppelganger or by shooting a toy arrow at the raven and causing it to drop the stone. Once they have the stone, the street urchins quickly lose themselves in the crowd. If Willifort the doppelganger is still around, he tries to slip away, believing he still has the stone. The imp, if present, turns {@condition invisible} and circles above the crowd in a futile attempt to find the stone.
zh_tw: 追逐在三個街頭小淘氣（見"{@area 三個小淘氣|14e|x}"）偷走石頭時結束，無論是透過從變形怪身上扒竊還是透過向烏鴉射玩具箭使其掉落石頭。一旦他們拿到石頭，街頭小淘氣就會迅速在人群中消失。如果變形怪威利福特還在附近，他會試圖溜走，以為自己仍然擁有石頭。如果小惡魔在場，它會變為{@condition invisible||隱形}並在人群上空盤旋，徒勞地試圖找到石頭。

english: A character can use an action to search the crowded street by making a {@dc 17} Wisdom (Perception) check. On a successful check, the character spots an iron grate in the street that wasn't closed properly. Lifting it reveals an iron ladder that descends 10 feet to an underground sewer tunnel. Characters who lower themselves into the tunnel can hear the sounds of splashing water and children's voices in the distance and might decide to follow them. (The children are holding hands in the dark and being guided by {@creature Squiddly|WDH}, who has darkvision.)
zh_tw: 一個角色可以使用一個動作在擁擠的街道上進行搜尋，進行一次 {@dc 17} 感知（感知）檢定。如果檢定成功，角色會注意到街道上一個沒有正確關閉的鐵柵欄。揭開它後，會發現一個鐵梯子向下延伸10尺，通往一個地下下水道隧道。角色們如果下到隧道里，可以聽到遠處的水花聲和孩子們的聲音，並可能決定跟隨他們。（這些孩子們在黑暗中手拉著手，由 {@creature Squiddly|WDH|斯奎迪利} 引導，它擁有黑暗視覺。）

english: Next Encounter
zh_tw: 下一場遭遇

english: If the characters follow the street urchins into the sewer, proceed with encounter 9, "Cellar Complex."
zh_tw: 如果角色們跟隨街頭小淘氣進入下水道，請繼續進行遭遇9，'地窖群'。

english: Street Chase: Winter
zh_tw: 街頭追逐：冬季
