english: After leaving the theater, the characters resume their pursuit of the elusive Zhent spy, Vevette Blackwater (CE female Tethyrian human {@creature swashbuckler|VGM}; see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}). She leads them on a merry chase through snowy streets until she is finally caught or until the characters give up the chase. She starts 30 feet away from the characters. If forced to make an ability check or saving throw because of a chase complication, she has advantage on the roll. Also, she can use the Dash action during the chase without having to make Constitution checks to avoid {@condition exhaustion}.
zh_tw: 離開劇院後，角色們繼續追擊難以捉摸的散塔林會成員間諜，薇薇特·黑水（CE女性泰瑟爾人人類{@creature swashbuckler|VGM|風流劍客}；見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）。她帶領他們穿過雪地街道，直到她最終被抓住，或者角色們放棄追逐。她從角色們30尺遠的地方開始。如果因為追逐複雜性而被迫進行屬性檢定或豁免檢定，她在擲骰時有優勢。此外，她可以在追逐中使用衝刺動作，而無需進行體質檢定以避免{@condition exhaustion||力竭}。

english: Where's the Stone?
zh_tw: 石頭在哪裡？

english: If she is caught, Vevette surrenders. She's counting on the law to protect her from serious harm, and she knows she has done nothing to warrant arrest. Vevette no longer has the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, after parting with it back in the theater. She doesn't willingly divulge who has the stone, though the characters can pry the information from her using a {@spell charm person} spell or similar magic.
zh_tw: 如果她被抓住，薇薇特會投降。她指望法律保護她免受嚴重傷害，她知道自己沒有做什麼值得逮捕的事情。薇薇特不再擁有{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，在劇院裡就已經把它交出去了。她不會自願透露誰擁有那塊石頭，儘管角色們可以使用{@spell charm person||魅惑類人}法術或類似的魔法來逼問資訊。

english: If the characters return to the theater, {@creature Remallia Haventree|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) waves them over and tells them that she saw two people exit the theater shortly after they did and then depart together in a hire-coach shortly thereafter. One of them is a bard named Agorn Fuoco, the other a woman unknown to Lady Haventree.
zh_tw: 如果角色們返回劇院，{@creature Remallia Haventree|WDH|蕾米莉亞·港樹}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）會向他們揮手並告訴他們，她看到兩個人在他們離開劇院後不久就離開了劇院，然後很快就一起乘坐了僱傭馬車離開。其中一個是名叫阿戈恩·弗奧科的吟遊詩人，另一個是海文特里女士不認識的女性。

english: Both Remallia and Vevette know that Agorn spends time around the dangerous dockside neighborhood of Mistshore.
zh_tw: 蕾米莉亞和薇薇特都知道阿戈恩常在危險的碼頭社群霧岸附近消磨時間。

english: Next Encounter
zh_tw: 下一場遭遇

english: Proceed with encounter 2, "Mistshore."
zh_tw: 繼續進行遭遇2，'霧岸。'

english: Encounter 4: Mausoleum
zh_tw: 遭遇4：陵墓

english: The City of the Dead is a public park dotted with mausoleums. The place is closed at night, with two City Guard soldiers ({@creature guard||guards}) stationed at each entry gate. A character can slip over a wall undetected with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity (Stealth) check.
zh_tw: 亡者之城是一個點綴著陵墓的公園。此地夜間關閉，每個入口大門都有兩名城市衛兵（{@creature guard||警衛}）站崗。角色若透過一次成功的 {@dc 15} 敏捷（隱匿）檢定，可以不被發現地翻牆進入。

english: At dusk, hundreds of {@item driftglobe||driftglobes} make their way from the inhabited part of the city and congregate in the City of the Dead. They spend the night here, then disperse and return to the waking city at dawn-for a reason no one knows.
zh_tw: 在黃昏時分，成百上千的{@item driftglobe||漂浮之球}從城市居住區出發，匯聚到亡者之城。它們在這裡過夜，然後在黎明時分分散並返回到甦醒的城市——出於某種無人知曉的原因。

english: Sir Ambrose Everdawn (LG male human Tethyrian {@creature knight}), an aging servant of Kelemvor (god of the dead), patrols the cemetery from sunset to sunrise, chasing off grave robbers and making sure the dead stay buried. Characters who creep around the cemetery in the dark have a {@chance 30|30 percent chance} of running into him. If that happens, he escorts them out and alerts the City Guard if they refuse to leave.
zh_tw: 安布羅斯·永曉爵士 (LG男性人類泰瑟爾人 {@creature knight||騎士}), 是凱蘭沃（死者之神）的一位年邁僕人，從日落到日出巡邏墓地，驅趕盜墓賊，確保死者安息。在黑暗中潛行於墓地的角色有{@chance 30|30%的機率}遇到他。如果發生了這種情況，他會護送他們離開，並在他們拒絕離開時通知城防軍。

english: Areas of the Mausoleum
zh_tw: 陵墓區域

english: Rooms in the mausoleum have 8-foot-high ceilings, with 6-foot-high passages and doorways connecting them.
zh_tw: 陵墓內的房間天花板高度為8尺，有6尺高的通道和門道連線它們。

english: The following locations are keyed to map 4.3.
zh_tw: 以下地點對應地圖4.3。

english: Mausoleum
zh_tw: 陵墓

english: Mausoleum, Ground (Player Version)
zh_tw: 陵墓，地面（玩家版）

english: M1. Ground Level
zh_tw: M1. 地面層

english: Unless the text of an encounter says otherwise, the stone double door to the mausoleum is locked. The lock can be picked by a character who makes a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check using thieves' tools, or the door can be forced open with a successful {@dc 25} Strength (Athletics) check.
zh_tw: 除非遭遇的文字另有說明，否則通往陵墓的石制雙門是鎖著的。角色可以使用盜賊工具並透過一次成功的{@dc 15}敏捷檢定來撬開鎖，或者透過一次成功的{@dc 25}力量（運動）檢定強行開啟門。

english: Inside, a family emblem is emblazoned on the floor between four ostentatious marble coffins. The coffins, engraved with the names of those interred within, contain nothing but dust and bones.
zh_tw: 裡面，在四個顯眼的大理石棺材之間的地面上，有一個家族徽章被醒目地展示著。這些棺材上刻有安息者的名字，裡面除了灰塵和骨頭之外空無一物。

english: M2. Underground Crypts
zh_tw: M2. 地下墓穴

english: Empty sconces adorn the walls. Cobwebs and dust indicate that no one has tended to this place in a long time. Stone coffins in alcoves contain dust and bones.
zh_tw: 空蕩的壁燈裝飾著牆壁。蛛網和灰塵表明這個地方已經很長時間沒有人照料了。壁龕中的石棺裡只有灰塵和骨頭。

english: Mausoleum: Spring
zh_tw: 陵墓：春季

english: This encounter begins when the characters come to the Garloth mausoleum seeking the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}. The double door to the mausoleum is open when they arrive.
zh_tw: 當角色們來到加洛斯陵墓尋找{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}時，這個遭遇開始了。他們到達時，陵墓的雙扇門是敞開的。

english: Earlier, {@creature Grinda Garloth|WDH}'s rat familiar arrived to find the mausoleum open and grave robbers inside. They killed the rat, took the stone, and fled along with the skeletal remains of Grinda's ancestors. Characters who search the plundered crypts find neither the rat nor the stone, but they do find a clue left behind by one of the grave robbers (see "Crypt Clue" below). As the characters make their way out, Xanathar Guild members attack them in an attempt to retrieve the stone.
zh_tw: 早些時候，{@creature Grinda Garloth|WDH|格林達·加洛斯}的老鼠寵物到達這裡，發現陵墓的門敞開著，裡面有盜墓者。他們殺死了老鼠，拿走了石頭，並帶著格林達祖先的骸骨逃跑了。搜尋被洗劫的墓穴的角色們既沒有找到老鼠也沒有找到石頭，但他們確實發現了一個盜墓者留下的線索（見下文的"墓穴線索"）。當角色們離開時，姍娜薩公會的成員攻擊他們，試圖奪回石頭。

english: Crypt Clue
zh_tw: 墓穴線索

english: Characters who search the underground crypts can find a shiny steel key lying in the dust on the floor. One of the grave robbers dropped it while looting the crypts.
zh_tw: 搜尋地下墓穴的角色們可以在地板上的灰塵中找到一把閃亮的鋼鑰匙。其中一個盜墓者在盜墓時掉落了它。

english: The characters can take the key to the Metal House of Wonders, the guildhall of the Splendid Order of Armorers, Locksmiths, and Finesmiths in the Dock Ward, or to any local locksmith. In either place, someone can identify the key as the handiwork of a dwarf locksmith in the Trades Ward named Elaspra Ulmarr. Characters who visit Elaspra's shop can learn from her that she made a key for a client who bought one of her excellent locks. She even installed the lock for him. Elaspra won't easily divulge the name of the client or his place of residence. She has great respect for the Harpers, however; a character who belongs to this faction and produces a Harper pin to prove it can pry the information from her with a successful {@dc 13} Charisma (Persuasion) check. A character pretending to be a Harper can fool her with a successful {@dc 16} Charisma (Deception) check.
zh_tw: 角色們可以將鑰匙帶到'金屬奇蹟之屋'，即位於碼頭區的輝煌鎧甲工匠、鎖匠與精工師公會的大廳，或是帶到任何當地鎖匠那裡。無論在哪一處，都會有人認出這把鑰匙是由商業區一位名叫伊拉斯普拉·烏爾瑪爾的矮人鎖匠所打造的。如果角色們訪問伊拉斯普拉的店鋪，可以從她那裡得知，她曾為一位購買了她精品鎖具的客戶打造過一把鑰匙，甚至為他安裝了鎖具。伊拉斯普拉不會輕易透露客戶的名字或住址，但她對豎琴手聯盟組織懷有極大的敬意；如果角色屬於這個組織並出示豎琴手聯盟徽章作為證明，可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 13} 魅力（說服）檢定從她那裡獲取資訊。如果角色偽裝成豎琴手聯盟成員，也可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 16} 魅力（欺瞞）檢定騙取她的信任。

english: Otherwise, the characters must either compel Elaspra to release the information using magic, or they must sneak a peek at her records, which she keeps in an iron safe that can be opened with a {@spell knock} spell or similar magic. To pick the combination lock on the safe, a character must succeed on three {@dc 20} Dexterity (Investigation) checks in a row. Each attempt made to pick the lock requires an action.
zh_tw: 否則，角色們必須使用魔法強迫伊拉斯普拉釋放資訊，或者他們必須偷看她的記錄，這些記錄她放在一個可以用{@spell knock||敲擊術}法術或類似魔法開啟的保險箱中。要開啟保險箱上的密碼鎖，角色必須連續成功進行三次{@dc 20}敏捷（調查）檢定。每次嘗試開鎖都需要一個動作。

english: From Elaspra or her records, the characters learn that she sold the key to a man named Volkarr Kibbens, whose address is an old windmill in the Southern Ward. The key unlocks the door to his apartment, which he shares with another man named Urlaster Ghann.
zh_tw: 從伊拉斯普拉或她的記錄中，角色們得知她把鑰匙賣給了一個名叫沃爾卡·基本斯的男人，他的地址是南區的一箇舊風車。這把鑰匙可以開啟他公寓的門，他和一個叫烏拉斯特·甘恩的另一個男人共享這個公寓。

english: Xanathar Guild Ambush
zh_tw: 姍娜薩公會伏擊

english: As the characters leave the mausoleum, they are jumped by four {@creature duergar}, members of the Xanathar Guild, who slipped past the cemetery guards using their invisibility. The leader, Gorath, accosts the characters in Dwarvish, demands the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, and refuses to believe that they don't have it. If the stone isn't turned over to them promptly, the duergar enlarge themselves and attack. {@creature Xanathar|WDH} watches the battle unfold through the eyes of a gazer (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), which stays out of the fight and tries to remain unseen.
zh_tw: 當角色們離開陵墓時，他們被四名{@creature duergar||灰矮人}伏擊，這些是姍娜薩公會的成員，他們利用隱形能力悄悄溜過了墓地守衛。領袖戈拉斯用矮人語質問角色們，要求交出{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，並且不相信他們沒有這塊石頭。如果石頭沒有立即交給他們，這些灰矮人會變大並發動攻擊。{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}透過一個凝視者眼魔的視角觀察戰鬥的發展（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），凝視者眼魔不參與戰鬥並試圖保持隱蔽。

english: If this encounter occurs at night, there's a {@chance 50|50 percent chance} that Ambrose Everdawn hears the disturbance and investigates, arriving after two duergar fall in battle. The characters can convince him that they're not grave robbers with a successful {@dc 15} Charisma (Persuasion) check. If they're polite, Ambrose escorts them out of the City of the Dead and warns them not to trespass again. Otherwise, he attempts to subdue them and turn them over to the City Guard.
zh_tw: 如果這次遭遇發生在夜晚，有 {@chance 50|50%的機率} 安布羅斯·永晝會聽到動靜並前來調查，戰鬥中有兩名灰矮人倒下後他才會到達。角色們可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 15} 魅力（說服）檢定來說服他他們並非盜墓者。如果他們表現得有禮貌，安布羅斯會護送他們離開亡者之城，並警告他們不要再擅闖。否則，他會試圖制服他們並將他們交給城防軍。

english: Next Encounter
zh_tw: 下一場遭遇

english: Once they trace the key to its owner, the characters can head to the Southern Ward in search of Volkarr Kibbens. The spring chain continues with encounter 10, "Converted Windmill."
zh_tw: 一旦他們追蹤到鑰匙的主人，角色們可以前往南區尋找沃爾卡·基本斯。春季遭遇鏈繼續進行遭遇10，"改造風車"。

english: Mausoleum: Summer
zh_tw: 陵墓：夏季

english: The characters travel to the City of the Dead, which is open to the public from dawn until dusk. One well-maintained mausoleum has the name CASSALANTER engraved above its entrance. The outer door is locked when the characters arrive in search of the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}. A successful {@dc 20} Intelligence (Investigation) check reveals that it has been opened recently, as evidenced by dirt smears on the door. A character can try to pick the lock using thieves' tools, doing so with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check. A {@spell knock} spell or similar magic also opens the door.
zh_tw: 角色們前往亡者之城，該城從黎明到黃昏對公眾開放。一座維護良好的陵墓入口上方刻有卡薩蘭特的名字。當角色們抵達尋找 {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石} 時，外面的門是鎖著的。一次成功的 {@dc 20} 智力（調查）檢定會發現門最近被開啟過，門上的汙漬證明瞭這一點。角色可以嘗試使用盜賊工具開鎖，這需要進行一次成功的 {@dc 15} 敏捷檢定。一個 {@spell knock||敲擊術} 法術或類似的魔法也可以開啟這扇門。

english: Human footprints crisscross through the dust on the upper level. A search of the underground crypt reveals the bodies of three humans-two males and a female, all dressed in hooded robes. Further inspection reveals that the woman is still breathing ({@condition unconscious} with 0 hit points).
zh_tw: 人類足跡在上層的灰塵中交錯。對地下墓穴的搜尋揭示了三具人類屍體——兩名男性和一名女性，都穿著帶兜帽的長袍。進一步檢查發現這名女性仍在呼吸（{@condition unconscious||昏迷}，生命值為0）。

english: Left for Dead
zh_tw: 被留下等死

english: The three cultists were low-ranking members of {@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH}'s cult of Asmodeus. They were betrayed by two cult fanatics acting on orders from Lord Cassalanter, who not only wants the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} but also, as a security precaution, intends to eliminate cult members who know too much about it. These three cultists were felled by daggers and {@spell inflict wounds} spells.
zh_tw: 這三名邪教徒是{@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH|維克托羅·卡薩蘭特}的阿斯蒙蒂斯邪教中的低階成員。他們被兩個按照卡薩蘭特勳爵命令列事的邪教狂信者出賣了，卡薩蘭特勳爵不僅想要{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，而且作為安全預防措施，還打算消滅知道太多關於它的邪教成員。這三名邪教徒被匕首和{@spell inflict wounds||致傷術}法術擊倒。

english: The survivor is Vaelle Lurval (LE female Tethyrian human {@creature cultist}), a 30-year-old Waterdavian florist. She was brought into the cult by her boyfriend, Holiver Tornrudder, who lies dead nearby. The other dead cultist is named Kaeth Warloon.
zh_tw: 生還者是瓦艾爾·勒瓦爾（LE女性泰瑟爾人人類{@creature cultist||邪教徒}），一位30歲的深水城的花商。她是由她的男朋友霍利弗·斷舵引入邪教的，他死在附近。另一個死去的邪教徒叫凱斯·沃倫。

english: If she is healed, Vaelle regains consciousness. She reveals that the cult fanatics, Arn Xalrondar and Seffia Naelryke, would likely have taken the stone to an old windmill in the Southern Ward, where they hold their own ceremonies worshiping Asmodeus. Vaelle can provide directions, or she can lead characters there if she is healed fully, for the sake of avenging her murdered lover.
zh_tw: 如果瓦艾爾得到治療，她會恢復意識。她透露說，邪教狂信者阿恩·薩爾隆達爾和瑟菲亞·奈爾瑞克很可能已經把石頭帶到了南區的一箇舊風車裡，他們在那裡舉行自己的儀式來崇拜阿斯蒙蒂斯。瓦艾爾可以提供方向，或者如果她完全康復，她可以帶領角色們去那裡，以報復她被謀殺的情人。

english: Vaelle believes that the cult fanatics acted on their own, not under Lord Cassalanter's orders. She won't reveal the Cassalanters as the leaders of the cult unless magically compelled to do so.
zh_tw: 瓦艾爾認為邪教狂信者是自行行動的，而不是按照卡薩蘭特勳爵的命令。她不會透露卡薩蘭特家族是邪教的領袖，除非被魔法強迫這樣做。

english: Next Encounter
zh_tw: 下一場遭遇

english: Proceed with encounter 10, "Converted Windmill."
zh_tw: 繼續進行遭遇10，'改造風車。'

english: Villain Lairs
zh_tw: 反派巢穴

english: Chapters 5 through 8 describe the lairs of the main villains. The characters might want to explore the lairs for a variety of reasons, including the following:
zh_tw: 第5章到第8章描述了主要反派的巢穴。角色們可能出於各種原因想要探索這些巢穴，包括以下幾點：

english: Disrupting the villain's operation
zh_tw: 幹擾反派的行動

english: Gaining an audience with the villain (perhaps to forge a truce or an alliance)
zh_tw: 與反派見面（可能是為了締結和平或聯盟）

english: Completing a special mission for a faction (see "Joining Factions,")
zh_tw: 為派系完成一個特殊任務（見"加入派系"）

english: Investigating a false clue given to them as part of a scheme concocted by another villain
zh_tw: 調查作為另一個反派策劃的陰謀的一部分而給他們的假線索

english: Stealing the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} if the villain has it, or finding leads on its whereabouts when the trail goes cold
zh_tw: 如果反派擁有{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，則竊取它；或者當線索中斷時，尋找其下落的線索

english: Mausoleum: Winter
zh_tw: 陵墓：冬季

english: The {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} has revealed that the Vault of Dragons lies beneath the Brandath family mausoleum in the City of the Dead. The characters are unlikely to know it, but the Brandath family is an old one. Lord Dagult Neverember married into it for its wealth, and Lady Brandath gave birth to his son, Renaer. It's a dark irony that Neverember entrusted the location of his embezzled gold to his dead wife's family. {@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh} would be horrified but not surprised to learn the truth.
zh_tw: {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石} 揭示了龍之寶庫位於亡者之城中布蘭達斯家族的陵墓之下。角色們不太可能知道，但布蘭達斯家族是一個古老的家族。達格魯特·無燼領主為了財富而與該家族聯姻，布蘭達斯夫人生下了他的兒子瑞納爾。無燼將他貪汙的黃金位置託付給他已故妻子的家族，這是一種黑暗的諷刺。{@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh|瑞納爾·無燼}如果得知真相，會感到震驚但不會太驚訝。

english: The cemetery is buried in snow, and though some visitors are drawn to its scenic beauty even in winter, the blizzard keeps most of them away. The crumbling mausoleum is sealed tight, and the name BRANDATH is etched above its entrance. Large elm and birch trees grow around the structure, sheltering it as best they can with their leafless boughs.
zh_tw: 墓地被雪覆蓋，儘管一些遊客即使在冬天也被其風景如畫的美麗所吸引，但暴風雪使大多數人遠離。破敗的陵墓密封得嚴嚴實實，其入口上方刻有布蘭達斯的名字。大榆樹和樺樹圍繞著這座建築生長，儘管它們光禿禿的枝條，但仍盡其所能地為它提供庇護。

english: Guardian Treant
zh_tw: 守護者樹精

english: The largest tree growing in front of the entrance is a {@creature treant}. It awakens when one or more creatures approach the entrance and growls, "Only those of Brandath blood are welcome here! Begone!" The treant is particularly surly, it being winter and all.
zh_tw: 生長在入口前方的最大的樹是一隻{@creature treant||樹人}。當一個或多個生物接近入口時，它就會甦醒並咆哮："只有布蘭達斯血統的人在這裡受歡迎！離開！" 這隻樹人特別易怒，畢竟是冬天。

english: If someone other than a Brandath descendant tries to open the mausoleum, the treant animates two nearby trees and then attacks. The treant and its animated allies are too big to enter the mausoleum.
zh_tw: 如果布蘭達斯後裔以外的人試圖開啟陵墓，樹精會活化兩棵附近的樹，然後發動攻擊。樹精及其活化的盟友體型太大，無法進入陵墓。

english: The characters can kill the treant, try to slip past it, or retreat until they learn more about the Brandath family. A day's research followed by a successful {@dc 10} Intelligence (Investigation) check reveals that the characters know one such person: {@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh}. If they ask Renaer to admit them to the Brandath family mausoleum, he agrees to do so. Because the treant can sense that Renaer has Brandath blood in his veins, it allows him and those he calls his friends to enter unmolested, and says to Renaer in passing, "Your mother was a lovely person."
zh_tw: 角色們可以殺死樹人，嘗試悄悄繞過它，或者撤退直到他們瞭解更多關於布蘭達斯家族的資訊。經過一天的研究並透過一個成功的 {@dc 10} 智力（調查）檢定，角色們發現他們認識這樣一個人：{@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh|瑞納爾·無燼}。如果他們請求瑞納爾允許他們進入布蘭達斯家族的地下墓穴，他會同意。因為樹人能感知到瑞納爾體內流淌著布蘭達斯家族的血脈，它允許他以及他稱之為朋友的人不受幹擾地進入，並對瑞納爾隨口說道："你的母親是個可愛的人。"

english: Glyph of Warding
zh_tw: 守衛刻文

english: A {@spell glyph of warding} spell has been cast on the first step leading down to the underground level, set to trigger when a humanoid creature passes over the step. The glyph can't be spotted unless the dust on the floor is cleared away by a {@spell gust of wind} spell or some other means. Once the dust is swept aside, a character who searches the stairs notices the glyph with a successful {@dc 15} Intelligence (Investigation) check.
zh_tw: 在通往地下層的第一級臺階上已經施放了一個 {@spell glyph of warding||守衛刻文} 法術，當一個人形生物透過臺階時，刻文會被觸發。除非透過 {@spell gust of wind||造風術} 或其他方式清除地板上的灰塵，否則無法發現這個刻文。一旦灰塵被掃除，透過一個成功的 {@dc 15} 智力（調查）檢定，角色可以發現這個刻文。

english: If the glyph is triggered, it erupts with magical fire in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on it. The fire spreads around corners. Each creature in the area must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 ({@dice 5d8}) fire damage on a failed saving throw, or half as much damage on a successful one. The glyph disappears after it is triggered.
zh_tw: 如果這個符文被觸發，它會在20尺半徑的球形區域內爆發出魔法火焰。火焰會繞過角落。區域內的每個生物必須進行一次{@dc 15}敏捷豁免，豁免失敗則受到22（{@dice 5d8}）點火焰傷害，豁免成功則受到一半傷害。符文在觸發後消失。

english: Uld's Resting Place
zh_tw: 烏爾德的安息之地

english: A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals an aura of transmutation that emanates from one of the stone coffins on the underground level. This crypt contains the shattered bones of Uld Brandath, a Waterdavian magister who died in a freak accident decades ago. (A gargoyle broke off the corner of a government building and fell on Uld, crushing him.) Guarding his remains are six {@creature crawling claw||crawling claws} made from the hands of murderers who were sentenced to death by Uld. These undead hands spring out and attack when the lid is lifted or shoved aside.
zh_tw: {@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術會顯示地下層一具石棺散發的變化系靈光。墓中放著烏爾德·布蘭達斯的碎骨；他是深水城的裁判官，數十年前死於一場離奇意外：政府建築角落的一尊石像鬼裝飾掉了下來，將他壓死。六隻{@creature crawling claw||蠕行之爪}守護著他的遺骸，它們由曾被烏爾德判處死刑的殺人犯之手製成。棺蓋一旦被掀起或推開，這些不死之手便會躍出攻擊。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Lying amid the bones is Uld's {@item headband of intellect}, which the characters can retrieve once the crawling claws are dealt with.
zh_tw: 在骨頭之中躺著烏爾德的{@item headband of intellect||智力頭帶}，一旦解決了爬行爪，角色們就可以取回它。

english: Path to the Vault
zh_tw: 通往金庫的路

english: The collapsed eastern end of the underground level is actually an illusion that conceals an intact, 10-foot-wide passageway that slopes down. The characters can walk right through the illusion, which has no substance, and a {@spell dispel magic} spell destroys it. The tunnel wends downward for several hundred feet, gradually widening to 20 feet where it ends at the doors to the Vault of Dragons.
zh_tw: 地下層東端的坍塌實際上是一個幻象，它掩蓋了一個完好無損的、10尺寬的斜坡通道。角色們可以直接穿過這個沒有實體的幻象，一個{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}法術可以將其破壞。隧道向下蜿蜒數百尺，逐漸加寬至20尺，最終到達龍之寶庫的門前。

english: Encounter 5: Rooftop Chase
zh_tw: 遭遇5: 屋頂追逐

english: This encounter uses the chase rules in chapter 8 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|dmg}. It also uses the Rooftop Chase Complications table, which applies only to creatures moving across rooftops on foot. Flying creatures needn't roll on the table.
zh_tw: 本次遭遇使用了{@book 城主指南|dmg}第8章中的追逐規則。同時使用了屋頂追逐併發症表，該表僅適用於徒步穿越屋頂的生物。飛行生物無需在該表上擲骰。

english: Rooftop Chase
zh_tw: 屋頂追逐

english: Rooftop Chase Complications
zh_tw: 屋頂追逐併發症

english: result
zh_tw: 結果

english: You come to a 10-foot-wide gap between rooftops. You can jump over the gap if your Strength is 10 or higher (each foot you clear costs 1 foot of movement), and you must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity (Acrobatics) check or fall {@condition prone} on the far rooftop. Or you can cross the gap using a 10-foot-long rope line that stretches between the two rooftops
zh_tw: 你來到兩個屋頂之間一處10尺寬的缺口。如果你的力量達到10或更高，你可以跳過這個缺口（每清除1尺需要消耗1尺的移動力），並且你必須成功透過一個 {@dc 10} 敏捷（體操）檢定，否則你會在遠處的屋頂上摔倒 {@condition prone||伏地}。或者你也可以使用一條10尺長的繩索在兩屋頂之間穿越這個缺口

english: You come to a rooftop that's 10 feet higher than the one you're on. Make a {@dc 10} Strength (Athletics) check. On a failed check, the height change counts as 10 feet of {@quickref difficult terrain||3}.
zh_tw: 你來到一個比你當前所在屋頂高10尺的屋頂。進行一次 {@dc 10} 力量（運動）檢定。如果檢定失敗，高度變化視為 {@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形} 的10尺。

english: You come to a rooftop that's 10 feet lower than the one you're on. Make a {@dc 10} Strength (Athletics) check to jump down safely. On a failed check, you take damage from the fall and land {@condition prone}.
zh_tw: 你來到了一個比你所在位置低10尺的屋頂。進行一次 {@dc 10} 力量（運動）檢定以安全跳下。如果檢定失敗，你會因墜落而受到傷害並 {@condition prone||伏地}。

english: A roof is slippery. Make a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, you fall {@condition prone}.
zh_tw: 屋頂很滑。進行一次 {@dc 10} 敏捷豁免檢定。若檢定失敗，你將 {@condition prone||伏地}。

english: You step on a rotten section of roof, and it collapses underneath you. Make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, you fall partway into the hole in the roof and become stuck. While stuck, you are {@condition prone} and {@condition restrained}. You can use an action on your turn to make a {@dc 10} Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check, ending the effect on a success.
zh_tw: 你踩到了屋頂的腐朽部分，它在你腳下坍塌。進行一個 {@dc 15} 敏捷豁免檢定。如果檢定失敗，你部分掉入屋頂的洞中並被卡住。被卡住時，你處於 {@condition prone||伏地} 和 {@condition restrained||束縛} 狀態。你可以在你的回合使用一個動作進行一個 {@dc 10} 力量（運動）或敏捷（體操）檢定，成功則結束此效果。

english: Roof shingles or tiles give way as you step on them. Make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, you fall {@condition prone} and slide 10 feet back.
zh_tw: 當你踩到屋頂的瓦片或瓦片時，它們會崩裂。進行一個 {@dc 15} 敏捷豁免檢定。如果檢定失敗，你 {@condition prone||伏地} 並向後滑行10尺。

english: A rooftop protuberance such as a chimney or weather vane gets in your way. Make a {@dc 10} Dexterity (Acrobatics) check. On a failed check, the obstacle counts as 5 feet of {@quickref difficult terrain||3}.
zh_tw: 一個屋頂的突出物，如煙囪或風向標，擋住了你的去路。進行一次 {@dc 10} 敏捷（體操）檢定。如果檢定失敗，該障礙物視為 5 尺的 {@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。

english: You startle a flock of birds nesting on the rooftop, and they flutter all around you. Make a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the birds count as 10 feet of {@quickref difficult terrain||3}.
zh_tw: 你驚動了在屋頂築巢的一群鳥，它們在你周圍撲騰。進行一個 {@dc 10} 敏捷豁免檢定。如果檢定失敗，這些鳥會算作 10 尺的 {@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。

english: You trigger a {@spell glyph of warding} spell placed on the roof to discourage burglars. Make a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you are targeted by a {@spell Tasha's hideous laughter} spell, the effect of which lasts 1 minute.
zh_tw: 你觸發了放置在屋頂上的{@spell glyph of warding||守衛刻文}法術以阻止盜賊。進行一次{@dc 13}的感知豁免檢定。若檢定失敗，你將成為{@spell Tasha's hideous laughter||塔莎狂笑術}法術的目標，效果持續1分鐘。

english: Someone on the ground throws a rock, a snowball, or a similar projectile at you. Make a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the attack deals no damage but distracts you and counts as 5 feet of {@quickref difficult terrain||3}.
zh_tw: 地上有人向你投擲石塊、雪球或類似的拋射物。進行一個 {@dc 10} 敏捷豁免檢定。若檢定失敗，攻擊不會造成傷害但會分散你的注意力，並視為 5 尺的 {@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。

english: No complication.
zh_tw: 無意外。

english: Rooftop Chase: Summer
zh_tw: 屋頂追逐：夏季

english: The characters are trying to catch up with three {@creature spined devil||spined devils} that keep low above the rooftops, so as not to be seen by Waterdeep's Griffon Cavalry. The devils are 100 feet away from the characters at the start of the chase.
zh_tw: 角色們正試圖追上三個在屋頂上方低飛的{@creature spined devil||棘魔}，以免被深水城的獅鷲騎兵發現。追逐開始時，魔鬼們距離角色們100尺遠。

english: If the devil carrying the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} becomes {@condition incapacitated}, another devil snatches the stone and flees with it.
zh_tw: 如果攜帶{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}的魔鬼變得{@condition incapacitated||無力}，另一個魔鬼會奪走石頭並帶著它逃跑。

english: Next Encounter
zh_tw: 下一場遭遇

english: When the characters are close to getting the stone, or when you want the chase to end, all remaining spined devils duck into an alley. If the characters lose their quarry, they can question city folk on the ground who saw where the devils went. Continue with encounter 1, "Alley."
zh_tw: 當角色們接近獲得石頭時，或者當你想結束追逐時，所有剩餘的棘魔會躲進一條小巷。如果角色們失去了目標，他們可以詢問地面上的市民，瞭解魔鬼們去了哪裡。繼續進行遭遇1，"小巷"。

english: Rooftop Chase: Autumn
zh_tw: 屋頂追逐：秋季

english: The characters are chasing two {@creature drow gunslinger|WDH|drow gunslingers} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) across windy rooftops in the Dock Ward. The drow stick together as they run, but each one acts on his own initiative count.
zh_tw: 角色們正在追逐兩個{@creature drow gunslinger|WDH|卓爾火槍手}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），穿過碼頭區的風大屋頂。黑暗精靈在逃跑時保持在一起，但每一個都按照自己的主動性計數行動。

english: {@creature Fel'rekt Lafeen|WDH} and {@creature Krebbyg Masq'il'yr|WDH} start out 40 feet ahead of their pursuers. They do nothing but move on their turns, trying to put as much distance between themselves and the characters as possible. Fel'rekt has the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} at the start of the chase, but one drow gunslinger can pass the stone to the other as a reaction as long as the two drow are within 10 feet of each other.
zh_tw: {@creature Fel'rekt Lafeen|WDH|菲爾萊科特·拉菲恩}和{@creature Krebbyg Masq'il'yr|WDH|克雷比格·馬斯奇爾}在追逐者前方40尺處開始。他們在自己的回合中只進行移動，儘可能地拉開自己和角色之間的距離。菲爾萊科特在追逐開始時擁有{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，但只要兩個黑暗精靈彼此之間距離不超過10尺，一個卓爾火槍手就可以作為反應將石頭傳給另一個。

english: Next Encounter
zh_tw: 下一場遭遇

english: The drow keep running across the rooftops until they get to the run-down dockside neighborhood known as Mistshore. Characters who remain in pursuit can follow them all the way there. If all the characters lose their quarry, they can question city folk on the ground who saw the drow heading toward Mistshore. In either case, proceed with encounter 2, "Mistshore."
zh_tw: 黑暗精靈一直穿越屋頂，直到他們到達被稱為霧岸的破舊碼頭區。繼續追蹤的角色可以跟隨他們一直到那裡。如果所有角色都丟失了目標，他們可以詢問地面上看到黑暗精靈朝霧岸方向去的城市居民。無論哪種情況，請繼續進行遭遇2，'霧岸。'

english: Rooftop Chase: Winter
zh_tw: 屋頂追逐：冬季

english: A Zhent named Vevette Blackwater (CE female Tethyrian human {@creature swashbuckler|VGM}; see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) has snatched the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} and is fleeing as fast as she can across icy rooftops during a blizzard. Characters who intend to pursue her are 60 feet away from their quarry at the start of the chase and must also take to the rooftops or lose sight of her.
zh_tw: 一個名叫薇薇特·黑水（CE女性泰瑟爾人人類{@creature swashbuckler|VGM|風流劍客}；見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）的散塔林會成員奪走了{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，並在暴風雪中儘可能快地穿越結冰的屋頂逃跑。打算追捕她的角色在追逐開始時距離她的目標60尺遠，也必須走上屋頂，否則就會失去她的蹤跡。

english: Vevette was a vicious pirate before she joined the Zhentarim and rose to become one of {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s favored lieutenants. She cackles madly in the face of danger and loves a good chase. She knows the streets, alleys, and rooftops of Waterdeep well. If forced to make an ability check or a saving throw because of a chase complication, she has advantage on the roll. Also, she can take the Dash action during the chase without having to make Constitution checks to avoid {@condition exhaustion}.
zh_tw: 薇薇特在加入散塔林會併成為{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的得力副手之前，是一個殘暴的海盜。她在危險面前瘋狂地大笑，並且喜歡精彩的追逐。她非常熟悉深水城的街道、小巷和屋頂。如果因為追逐中的複雜情況而被迫進行屬性檢定或豁免檢定，她在擲骰時有優勢。此外，她在追逐中可以採取衝刺行動，而無需進行體質檢定以避免{@condition exhaustion||力竭}狀態。

english: Next Encounter
zh_tw: 下一場遭遇

english: The chase lasts no more than 5 rounds, after which Vevette drops to the ground and ducks into a theater. Characters who lose sight of her can ask people along her path to help them out. Continue with encounter 6, "Theater."
zh_tw: 追逐不會超過5輪，在追逐結束後，薇薇特降落到地面並躲進一個劇院。失去她視線的角色可以請求她經過路徑上的人們幫助他們。繼續進行遭遇6，'劇院'。

english: Encounter 6: Theater
zh_tw: 遭遇6：劇院

english: Whether the theater is open for business or shut down, it has the following features:
zh_tw: 無論劇院是否對外營業或已關閉，它都有以下特點：

english: Ceilings in the rooms are 10 feet high except in {@area P5|196}, which has a 20-foot-high raftered ceiling. Connecting the rooms are 8-foot-high passages and 7-foot-high doorways.
zh_tw: 房間的天花板高度為10尺，除了{@area P5|196}，那裡有一個20尺高的椽子天花板。連線這些房間的是8尺高的通道和7尺高的門道。

english: The theater is lit by lanterns that have {@spell continual flame} spells cast on them. Speaking a command word inside the theater causes the lights in the theater and backstage to dim; speaking another command word inside the theater restores them to full brightness. All the stage managers know the command words.
zh_tw: 劇院由施加了{@spell continual flame||不滅明焰}法術的燈籠照亮。在劇院內說出一個命令詞會導致劇院和後臺的燈光變暗；在劇院內說出另一個命令詞會將它們恢復到全亮。所有的舞臺經理都知道命令詞。

english: Areas of the Theater
zh_tw: 劇院區域

english: The following locations are keyed to map 4.4.
zh_tw: 以下地點對應地圖 4.4。

english: Theater
zh_tw: 劇院

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: P1. Lobby
zh_tw: P1. 門廳

english: This plush lobby is decorated with red carpet and ornate wallpaper. On display here are several painted wooden mannequins dressed in fancy costumes, each one representing a character from a famous play.
zh_tw: 這個豪華的大廳以紅地毯和華麗的桌布裝飾。這裡展示著幾個穿著花哨服裝的彩繪木製人體模型，每個模型都代表著一個來自著名戲劇的角色。

english: P2. Ticket Booths
zh_tw: P2. 售票亭

english: The western door on each booth is locked. The lock can be picked by a character who succeeds on a {@dc 15} Dexterity check using thieves' tools, or the door can be forced open with a successful {@dc 13} Strength (Athletics) check. The ticket sellers and the stage manager have keys to these doors.
zh_tw: 每個小亭子的西側門都是鎖著的。一個角色可以透過使用盜賊工具進行一次 {@dc 15} 的敏捷檢定來撬開鎖，或者透過一次成功的 {@dc 13} 力量（運動）檢定強行開啟門。售票員和舞臺經理持有這些門的鑰匙。

english: A stack of torn tickets sits on a shelf beneath a counter inside the booth. Prior to a show, each booth holds a ticket seller ({@creature commoner}). Admission to the theater is 1 sp per person.
zh_tw: 一堆撕毀的票卷放在一個櫃檯下的架子上，位於售票亭內。在演出前，每個亭子裡都有一個售票員（{@creature commoner||平民}）。進入劇院的票價是每人1便士。

english: P3. Ticket Offices
zh_tw: P3. 售票處

english: A desk near the far wall in each of these rooms contains notebooks, {@item paper (one sheet)|PHB|papers}, and a lockbox.
zh_tw: 這些房間中靠近遠處牆壁的桌子各有一本筆記本、{@item paper (one sheet)|PHB|檔案}和一隻鎖盒。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The house managers hold the key to each lockbox. A lock can be picked by someone who makes a successful {@dc 12} Dexterity check using thieves' tools, or a lockbox can be forced open with a successful {@dc 15} Strength (Athletics) check. During a performance, each lockbox holds {@dice 10d10} sp. After a performance, both boxes are empty.
zh_tw: 房屋管理者持有每個保險箱的鑰匙。一個鎖可以透過成功進行一個 {@dc 12} 的敏捷檢定並用盜賊工具撬開，或者一個保險箱可以透過成功進行一個 {@dc 15} 的力量（運動）檢定強行開啟。在演出期間，每個保險箱裡裝有 {@dice 10d10} 銀幣。演出結束後，兩個箱子都是空的。

english: P4. Auditorium
zh_tw: P4. 觀眾廳

english: The auditorium has the following features:
zh_tw: 觀眾廳有以下特點：

english: Cushioned seats are arranged in seven tiered rows facing a 5-foot-high wooden stage. Each row has twenty seats.
zh_tw: 有墊子的座位被安排成七排臺階式的座位，面向一個5尺高的木製舞臺。每一排有二十個座位。

english: Behind a raised red curtain are painted backdrops and stage props for the current production.
zh_tw: 在升起的紅色幕布後面是為當前製作準備的彩繪背景和舞臺道具。

english: During a performance, a stage manager ({@creature commoner}) watches from the back of the seating area.
zh_tw: 在表演期間，一位舞臺經理（{@creature commoner||平民}）從座位區的後方觀察。

english: P5. Wing
zh_tw: P5. 翼樓

english: This small offstage area is painted black and has a table that holds fake daggers, swords, and other props. Prop weapons can be used in combat but deal only 1 bludgeoning damage on a hit.
zh_tw: 這個小型的後臺區域被漆成黑色，有一張桌子上擺放著假匕首、劍和其他道具。道具武器可以在戰鬥中使用，但命中時只造成1點鈍擊傷害。

english: P6. Stage Manager's Office
zh_tw: P6. 舞臺經理辦公室

english: This room holds a desk covered in papers. The stage manager ({@creature commoner}) stays here between performances.
zh_tw: 這個房間內有一張堆滿檔案的桌子。舞臺經理（{@creature commoner||平民}）在演出間隙時待在這裡。

english: P7. Green Room
zh_tw: P7. 綠色房間

english: A trio of mismatched couches and a stained beige rug are the main features of this room, whose walls are covered with light green paint. This is where the actors congregate when they aren't on stage or in their dressing rooms.
zh_tw: 這個房間的主要特點是三個不搭配的沙發和一張有汙漬的米色地毯，牆壁上塗著淺綠色油漆。這是演員們不在舞臺上或在化妝室時聚集的地方。

english: P8. Dressing Rooms
zh_tw: P8. 化妝室

english: This room contains clothes racks, tables lined with makeup, and long wall mirrors. During or immediately before a performance, each dressing room holds {@dice 1d3} actors ({@creature commoner||commoners}).
zh_tw: 這個房間有衣架、擺滿化妝品的桌子，以及長牆鏡。在表演中或表演前，每個化妝間有{@dice 1d3}個演員（{@creature commoner||平民}）。

english: Theater: Spring
zh_tw: 劇院：春季

english: The name of the Pink Flumph theater is displayed on a sign mounted to the building's facade. Posters on the outside walls advertise the latest shows, {@i Meet the Goodberrys} and {@i Kiss of the Lamia}. The former is a comical glimpse into the travails of a large halfling family engaged in illicit criminal activity. The latter is a tragic play about an evil Mulhorandi prince who is banished to a desert, {@condition charmed} by a lamia, and sent back with powerful magic items to conquer his homeland in her name.
zh_tw: 粉紅浮虜劇院的名稱顯示在建築立面的標牌上。外牆上的海報宣傳著最新的演出，{@i 遇見好莓果}和{@i 拉迷亞之吻}。前者是一部喜劇，窺視了一個從事非法犯罪活動的大型半身人家庭的艱辛生活。後者是一部悲劇，講述了一位被放逐到沙漠的邪惡穆霍爾蘭迪王子，他被拉彌亞{@condition charmed||魅惑}，並帶著強大的魔法物品返回，以她的名義征服他的故鄉。

english: In the early hours of the morning, the backstage area is abuzz with halfling actors donning costumes, wigs, and makeup in preparation for the afternoon's show. As that show wraps, the cast and musicians for the evening's tragic fare arrive. The actor who plays the evil prince is a woman named Yaliek Iltizmar (N female Rashemi {@creature bard|VGM}; see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), who is also a member of the Harpers. She pays close attention to characters who nose around backstage, then shares any interesting revelations with {@creature Remallia Haventree|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) at the earliest opportunity. If Remallia learns the location of the Vault of Dragons, she sees that the information reaches the Lords of Waterdeep by conveying it to {@creature Mirt|WDH}.
zh_tw: 在清晨的早些時候，後臺區域充滿了忙碌的半身人演員，他們穿戴服裝、假髮和化妝，為下午的演出做準備。當那場演出結束時，晚上悲劇劇目的演員和音樂家們到來。扮演邪惡王子的演員是一位名叫雅利克·伊爾提茲瑪（中立女性拉什米人{@creature bard|VGM|吟遊詩人}；見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）的女性，她也是豎琴手聯盟組織的成員。她密切注意那些在後臺探頭探腦的角色，然後儘早與{@creature Remallia Haventree|WDH|蕾米莉亞·港樹}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）分享任何有趣的發現。如果蕾米莉亞得知了龍之寶庫的位置，她會透過傳達給{@creature Mirt|WDH|米爾特}以確保資訊傳達到深水城領主們那裡。

english: Theater Owner
zh_tw: 劇院老闆

english: The owner of the Pink Flumph, Iokaste Daliano (N female Tethyrian {@creature commoner}), is a selfish, middle-aged widow with no great love of theater. The Pink Flumph was her husband's passion; for Iokaste, it's strictly a means through which she can rub shoulders with the city's elite. She requires the directors to choose plays and hire actors, while she spends her time "on the job" greeting important guests and promising them the finest entertainment. She treats her actors and staff like half-forgotten children, and she turns away characters who come to the theater seeking the Vault of Dragons unless there's something in it for her. Appealing to her greed backfires, since Iokaste wants all the treasure for herself.
zh_tw: 粉紅呋嚕劇院的所有者，伊奧卡斯特·達利亞諾（中立女性泰瑟爾人 {@creature commoner||平民}），是一個自私的中年寡婦，對劇院並無太大熱愛。粉紅呋嚕劇院是她丈夫的激情所在；對伊奧卡斯特來說，它嚴格意義上是一種手段，透過它她可以與城市精英交往。她要求導演選擇劇本和僱傭演員，而她則在"工作"時招待重要客人，並向他們承諾最精彩的娛樂。她對待她的演員和員工就像半被遺忘的孩子，而且她會拒絕那些來到劇院尋找龍之寶庫的角色，除非這對她有利。對她的貪婪提出訴求會適得其反，因為伊奧卡斯特想要所有的財寶都歸自己所有。

english: Path to the Vault
zh_tw: 通往金庫的路

english: One of the dressing rooms ({@area P8|199}) contains a secret trapdoor in the floor that no one knows about. It can be found with a successful {@dc 20} Wisdom (Perception) check. This stone door has an {@spell arcane lock} spell cast on it and can be pulled open with a successful {@dc 30} Strength (Athletics) check. A {@spell knock} spell or similar magic also does the trick.
zh_tw: 其中一個更衣室（{@area P8|199}）的地板上有一個沒人知道的秘密活板門。透過一次成功的{@dc 20}感知（感知）檢定可以發現它。這塊石門被施放了{@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖}法術，需要透過一次成功的{@dc 30}力量（運動）檢定才能拉開。{@spell knock||敲擊術}或類似魔法也能開啟它。

english: Below the trapdoor is a 30-foot-deep shaft containing a wooden ladder. Characters who descend the ladder find themselves at one end of a 20-foot-wide stone passageway that gradually slopes down 100 feet before ending at the entrance to the Vault of Dragons.
zh_tw: 活板門下方是一個深30尺的豎井，裡面裝有一架木梯。角色們如果沿著梯子下降，會發現自己位於一條20尺寬的石質通道的一端，這個通道逐漸向下傾斜100尺，最終到達龍之寶庫的入口。

english: Wishes the Faerie Dragon
zh_tw: 妖精龍的願望

english: Iokaste's late husband, Algondar Daliano, had a violet {@creature faerie dragon (violet)||faerie dragon} companion named Wishes. The faerie dragon detests Iokaste but remains on the payroll, begrudgingly using its magic to enhance performances for the sake of preserving Algondar's legacy. It prefers to remain {@condition invisible} and unseen otherwise. Iokaste refers to it derisively as "the flying serpent."
zh_tw: 伊奧卡斯特的已故丈夫阿爾貢達爾·達利亞諾有一隻名為許願的紫色{@creature faerie dragon (violet)||妖精龍}夥伴。這隻妖精龍討厭伊奧卡斯特，但仍然留在工資單上，不情願地使用它的魔法來提升表演，以此來保留阿爾貢達爾的遺產。它更願意保持{@condition invisible||隱形}狀態，否則不被人所見。伊奧卡斯特輕蔑地稱它為"飛行的蛇"。

english: If the characters threaten it or endanger the theater, Wishes uses its magic to confound and neutralize them. As they make their way to the Vault of Dragons, it follows them invisibly. Once it learns about the gold in the vault, the faerie dragon casts {@spell mirror image} on itself, turns visible, and addresses the characters telepathically. It demands a share of the hoard (at least 5,000 gp), threatens to tip off the City Watch if the characters refuse, and makes good on its threat if the characters don't share the wealth. The faerie dragon doesn't have a hoard of its own, since it gives its earnings to unfortunate Waterdavians by invisibly flying around the city at night and leaving coins on doorsteps, window sills, nightstands, and pillows.
zh_tw: 如果角色們威脅到它或危及劇院，許願會使用它的魔法來迷惑和中立化他們。當他們前往龍之寶庫的路上，它則不可見地跟隨他們。一旦得知金庫中的黃金，妖精龍對自己施放了{@spell mirror image||鏡影術}法術，變得可見，並以心靈感應的方式與角色們對話。它要求分得一部分寶藏（至少5000金幣），如果角色們拒絕，就威脅要向城市守衛告密，並在角色們不分享財富時兌現其威脅。妖精龍沒有自己的寶藏，因為它將自己的收入給予不幸的深水城居民，透過在夜晚不可見地在城市中飛行，在門階、窗臺、床頭櫃和枕頭上留下硬幣。

english: Theater: Autumn
zh_tw: 劇院：秋季

english: At the end of their previous encounter, the characters are no closer to finding the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}. Jarlaxle is waiting for them at the Seven Masks Theater in the Dock Ward. The theater caters to a lower-class clientele, and ship captains and sailors are admitted for free. The owner of the theater is a burly and jovial Shou man with a braided goatee named Rongquan Mystere—another of Jarlaxle's many disguises. When Jarlaxle is away, he entrusts his stage managers to look after things.
zh_tw: 在上次遭遇結束時，角色們仍未找到{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}。賈拉索正在碼頭區的七面具劇院等待著他們。該劇院主要面向底層顧客，船長和水手可免費入場。劇院老闆是一位健壯開朗的梳辮子鬍子獸人，名叫榮泉·密斯特爾——這也是賈拉索眾多偽裝身份之一。當賈拉索離開時，他會委託舞臺經理照看事務。

english: Sapphiria's Booty
zh_tw: 薩菲莉亞的戰利品

english: When the characters first arrive, all doors except the ones leading backstage are locked. Characters who slip in through the back see actors and stagehands bustling about and the director arguing with the playwright while the stage manager looks on helplessly. On the stage, actors walk through their scenes and read their lines to a mostly empty theater. Watching the rehearsal from the front row while smoking a pipe is {@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), disguised as Rongquan. Hidden in the shadows in various spots are four {@creature drow elite warrior||drow elite warriors} ready to fight by Jarlaxle's side.
zh_tw: 當角色們首次到達時，除了通往後臺的門之外，所有的門都被鎖上了。那些透過後門溜進來的角色會看到演員和舞臺工作人員忙碌著，導演正在和劇作家爭論，而舞臺經理無助地看著。在舞臺上，演員們在幾乎空無一人的劇院裡排練，走過他們的場面，念出他們的臺詞。坐在前排觀看排練的同時抽著菸斗的是{@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH|賈拉索·班瑞}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），他偽裝成了榮泉。在各個角落的陰影中隱藏著四名{@creature drow elite warrior||卓爾精英武者}，準備在賈拉索的身邊戰鬥。

english: The play, {@i Sapphiria's Booty}, is a romantic comedy about a blue-haired madam named Sapphiria who runs a thieves' guild out of a festhall. When a charming sea captain arrives with a hold full of booty from a faraway land, Sapphiria decides to steal it. Zaniness ensues when she falls in love with the first mate, who is half her age, while the captain falls in love with her. On one side of the stage is a backdrop resembling the deck of a ship; the other side is decorated to look like a madam's parlor in a brothel, complete with a gaudy chandelier and a fainting couch.
zh_tw: 這部名為{@i 薩菲莉亞的戰利品}的戲劇是一部浪漫喜劇，講述了一位名叫藍寶石的藍髮夫人，她在宴會大廳經營著盜賊公會。當一位迷人的船長帶著來自遙遠土地的滿滿一船艙戰利品抵達時，藍寶石決定將其據為己有。然而，當她愛上了比她年輕一半的大副，而船長卻又愛上了她時，一切變得滑稽起來。舞臺的一側是類似船甲板的背景；另一側則裝飾得像妓院中的夫人客廳，配有華麗的水晶吊燈和一張奢華的躺椅。

english: Westra Moltimmur (CG female Illuskan human {@creature commoner} with Insight +2 and Performance +6), the play's leading lady, is one of Waterdeep's great treasures, and the cast and crew are very protective of her. Now in her seventies and having been married no fewer than seven times, she has a brisk sense of humor and a zest for life. She's also insightful enough to know that "Rongquan Mystere" isn't what he appears to be. She has seen the dark elves who watch over Rongquan and observed him using subtle hand gestures (Drow Sign Language) to communicate with them.
zh_tw: 維絲特拉·莫爾提穆爾（CG女性伊路斯坎人人類{@creature commoner||平民}，洞察力+2和表演+6），是該劇的女主角，也是深水城的寶貴財富，劇組和工作人員對她非常保護。現在她已經七十多歲，已經結過不少於七次婚，她有一種活潑的幽默感和對生活的熱情。她也有足夠洞察力意識到'榮泉·密斯特爾'並不是他表面上的樣子。她見過守護榮泉的黑暗精靈，並觀察到他使用微妙的手勢（卓爾手語）與他們交流。

english: Speaking with Rongquan
zh_tw: 與榮泉對話

english: Jarlaxle has instructed the stage managers to bring all visitors to him. In the guise of Rongquan, he claims to be a member of the Lords' Alliance who answers directly to {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH}. He also seems to know all about the characters' meeting with Laeral (see encounter 1, "Alley") and says he can speak on her behalf. He asks about the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} and is disappointed if the characters don't have it. If they offer up the fake stone recovered in encounter 9, "Cellar Complex," Rongquan immediately realizes it's a fake.
zh_tw: 賈拉索指示舞臺經理將所有訪客帶到他那裡。他偽裝成榮泉，聲稱自己是直接向{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}彙報的領主聯盟的成員。他似乎還知道有關角色與萊拉會面的所有事情（見遭遇1，"小巷"），並表示他可以代表她發言。他詢問有關{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}的情況，如果角色們沒有它，他會失望。如果他們提供了在遭遇9，"地窖複合體"中回收的假石頭，榮泉會立即意識到它是假的。

english: If the characters aren't sure what to do next, Jarlaxle imparts the following information:
zh_tw: 如果角色們不確定接下來該做什麼，賈拉索提供了以下資訊：

english: "My friends, don't be discouraged. The wind is blowing in our direction! I've learned that Fenerus Stormcastle was arrested by the City Watch for theft and taken to a courthouse in the Castle Ward to face the judgment of a magister. No doubt he hid the stone before his capture. You must speak to him right away. You'll need to devise some sort of ruse to get close to Fenerus. I urge against violence, or you might find yourself locked up beside him."
zh_tw: 我的朋友們，不要氣餒。風正朝我們的方向吹來！我得知費內魯斯·風暴堡因盜竊被城市守衛逮捕，並被帶到城堡區的法院面對一位地方官的審判。毫無疑問，他在被捕前藏起了那塊石頭。你們必須立刻和他說話。你們需要設計某種詭計接近費內魯斯。我敦促你們反對暴力，否則你們可能會發現自己被關在他旁邊。

english: If the characters ask why {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH} doesn't question Fenerus herself or bail him out of jail, Jarlaxle laughs and says it would be politically unwise for the Open Lord to be seen negotiating with a man who has committed heinous crimes against the city.
zh_tw: 如果角色們問為什麼{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}不親自質問費內魯斯或者保釋他出獄，賈拉索笑了並說，對於公開領主來說，被看到與一個對城市犯下嚴重罪行的人進行談判，在政治上是不明智的。

english: Jarlaxle could speak to Fenerus himself, but he's not sure if the courthouse is warded against magic. He can't risk the exposure, so he sends the characters instead. If the characters refuse to work for Rongquan, he shrugs his broad shoulders and lets them leave unmolested, figuring they'll try to talk to Fenerus anyway.
zh_tw: 賈拉索本可以親自與費內魯斯交談，但他不確定法院是否被魔法防護。他不能冒暴露的風險，所以他派角色們去。如果角色們拒絕為榮泉工作，他聳聳寬闊的肩膀，讓他們不受幹擾地離開，認為他們無論如何都會嘗試與費內魯斯交談。

english: If the characters attack him, Jarlaxle smiles, whistles for his drow bodyguards, and has at them. If the characters fall in combat, Jarlaxle and his guards stabilize dying party members before dragging all of them to a snowy alley and leaving them there with their gear. After the drow depart, a cold wind tears through the alley and awakens the {@condition unconscious} characters.
zh_tw: 如果角色們攻擊他，賈拉索微笑，吹口哨召喚他的黑暗精靈保鏢，並對角色們發起攻擊。如果角色們在戰鬥中倒下，賈拉索和他的保鏢會在把他們拖到一個雪地小巷並留在那裡與他們的裝備一起之前，先穩定瀕死隊伍成員的狀態。在黑暗精靈離開後，一陣冷風穿過小巷，喚醒了處於{@condition unconscious||昏迷}狀態的角色們。

english: Next Encounter
zh_tw: 下一場遭遇

english: If the characters decide to speak with Fenerus, proceed with encounter 8, "Courthouse."
zh_tw: 如果角色們決定與費內魯斯交談，請繼續進行遭遇8，'法院。'

english: Theater: Winter
zh_tw: 劇院：冬季

english: As this encounter opens, the characters follow a fleeing Zhent swashbuckler into a theater in the Trades Ward called the Brizzenbright. Named after Malkolm Brizzenbright, its dead owner, the establishment has struggled in recent years. It stays open in the winter for its own survival, but the theater is wickedly cold this time of year.
zh_tw: 當這次遭遇開始時，角色們跟隨一個逃跑的散塔林會成員風流劍客進入位於商業區的名為布里曾布萊特的劇院。這個劇院以已故的所有者馬爾科姆·布里曾布萊特的名字命名，近年來經營困難。為了自身的生存，劇院在冬天也保持開放，但在每年的這個時候，劇院裡非常寒冷。

english: Brizzenbright's Ghost
zh_tw: 布里曾布萊特的鬼魂

english: Malkolm Brizzenbright, a {@creature ghost}, greets all visitors in the lobby ({@area P1|191}). Dressed in a suit, his hair unkempt, he floats in plain sight most of the time, waving his hands about in gestures of greeting and salutation. Locals are accustomed to his spectral form and his stock introduction: "Let not this harried visage diminish you, gentlesirs and beautiful ladies, for I am but your friendly host. What fine art have we wrought for you this day? Buy your tickets and behold! You shan't be disappointed!"
zh_tw: 馬爾科姆·布里曾布萊特，一個{@creature ghost||幽魂}，在門廳（{@area P1|191}）迎接所有訪客。他穿著西裝，頭髮凌亂，大部分時間都在明處漂浮，揮手致意和問候。當地人習慣了他的幽靈形態和他標準的介紹："不要讓這副匆忙的面容減少你們的風采，先生們女士們，因為我不過是你們友好的主人。我們今天為你們創造了什麼精彩的藝術？買票吧，看看吧！你不會失望的！"

english: The ghost can engage in light conversation. It is bound to the theater because Malkolm Brizzenbright's soul couldn't bear to leave the place. If the theater were to close down, the ghost would haunt it still, perhaps becoming more deranged over time. Only razing or burning the theater to the ground can force his spirit to depart forever.
zh_tw: 這個鬼魂可以進行輕鬆的對話。它被束縛在劇院裡，因為馬爾科姆·布里曾布萊特的靈魂不忍心離開這個地方。如果劇院關閉，鬼魂仍會出沒在那裡，隨著時間的推移可能變得更加瘋狂。只有將劇院夷為平地或燒燬，才能迫使他的靈魂永遠離開。

english: Snakes in the House
zh_tw: 房中的蛇

english: After a harrowing rooftop chase, Vevette Blackwater (CE female Tethyrian human {@creature swashbuckler|VGM}; see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) has bought a ticket and slipped into the theater during a performance of {@i Blood Wedding} -a play about love, jealousy, and death. In the story, a young woman is brought to a castle by a count, only to fall in love with his younger brother, a man of faith. Her betrayal eats away at the jealous count. He murders his brother on his wedding day and pursues the bride, who hurls herself off the castle battlements in despair. The count is cursed by the gods and transformed into a creature of darkness, damned to live in his castle and feed on blood. A female cellist and two male violinists provide musical accompaniment.
zh_tw: 在經過一場驚險的屋頂追逐後，薇薇特·黑水（CE女性泰希爾人類{@creature swashbuckler|VGM|風流劍客}，參見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）買了一張票，趁著演出《{@i 血色婚禮}時溜進了劇院——這是一部關於愛情、嫉妒和死亡的話劇。故事中，一位年輕女子被一位伯爵帶到城堡，卻愛上了伯爵那虔誠的弟弟。她的背叛令嫉妒的伯爵日漸消沉。伯爵在弟弟婚禮當天殺害了他，並追逐新娘，新娘在絕望中從城堡城牆上跳下。伯爵被眾神詛咒，變成了一隻黑暗生物，註定生活在城堡中並以鮮血為食。一位女性大提琴手和兩位男性小提琴手為演出提供音樂伴奏。

english: The shivering audience includes thirty {@creature commoner||commoners}. Also present is a Zhentarim spy named Agorn Fuoco (NE male Turami {@creature bard|VGM}; see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) and his companion, Amath Sercent (LE female Mulan {@creature priest} of Bane). Agorn is swept up in the drama and fighting back tears while Amath pats his arm gently. Vevette takes a seat behind them and surreptitiously passes the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} to Agorn. Looking on from the back row is {@creature Remallia Haventree|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), a member of the Harpers who suspects Agorn of being a high-ranking Zhent. She has been watching him for a while now, hoping to identify other Zhentarim leaders in Waterdeep. Although Remallia appears to be alone, the two violinists (LG male Illuskan human {@creature spy||spies} with Performance +5) are Harpers under her command. Agorn and Amath are unaware that they're under surveillance.
zh_tw: 戰慄的觀眾中包括三十名{@creature commoner||平民}。還有一位名叫阿戈恩·弗奧科的散塔林會間諜（NE男性圖拉米人 {@creature bard|VGM|吟遊詩人}；見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）和他的夥伴，阿瑪斯·瑟森特（LE女性穆蘭人 {@creature priest||祭司} of 班恩）。阿戈恩被戲劇深深吸引，強忍著淚水，而阿瑪斯輕輕地拍著他的胳膊。薇薇特坐在他們後面，並偷偷地將{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}遞給阿戈恩。在後排觀看的是{@creature Remallia Haventree|WDH|蕾米莉亞·港樹}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），她是豎琴手聯盟組織的成員，懷疑阿戈恩是一個高階散塔林會成員。她已經觀察他有一段時間了，希望識別出深水城的其他散塔林會領導者。儘管蕾米莉亞看起來獨自一人，但那兩個小提琴手（LG男性伊路斯坎人人類{@creature spy||間諜們}，表演+5）是受她指揮的豎琴手聯盟。阿戈恩和阿瑪斯不知道他們正在被監視。

english: Enter the Heroes
zh_tw: 進入英雄

english: The characters are expected to buy tickets before entering the main theater. The house manager chases after them if they don't, threatening to summon the City Watch.
zh_tw: 角色們在進入主劇場之前需要購買門票。如果他們不這麼做，劇院經理會追趕他們，並威脅要召喚城市守衛。

english: A character who makes a successful {@dc 14} Wisdom (Perception) check spots Vevette in the darkened theater. When this happens, Vevette springs from her chair and flees out the nearest door, planning to lead the characters on another merry chase. Remallia and her fellow Harpers watch with interest but don't get involved unless their lives or the lives of innocents are imperiled.
zh_tw: 一個成功透過 {@dc 14} 感知（感知）檢定的角色會在昏暗的劇院中發現薇薇特。當這種情況發生時，薇薇特會從她的椅子上跳起，逃向最近的門，計劃帶領角色們進行另一場歡快的追逐。蕾米莉亞和她的豎琴手聯盟同伴們饒有興趣地觀看著，但除非他們的生命或無辜者的生命受到威脅，否則不會介入。

english: Next Encounter
zh_tw: 下一場遭遇

english: If the characters take the bait, proceed with encounter 3, "Street Chase." Once Vevette's pursuers are out of sight, Agorn Fuoco and Amath Sercent use the distraction to slip away, exiting through the main doors and flagging down a hire-coach.
zh_tw: 如果角色們上鉤，請繼續進行遭遇3，"街頭追逐"。一旦薇薇特的追蹤者消失在視線之外，阿戈恩·弗奧科和阿瑪斯·瑟森特利用這個機會悄悄溜走，透過主門離開並攔下一輛僱傭馬車。

english: Encounter 7: Old Tower
zh_tw: 遭遇7: 舊塔

english: The characters face enemies in a dilapidated tower built by some half-forgotten Waterdavian mage hundreds of years ago. It has the following features:
zh_tw: 角色們面對的敵人位於一座破敗的塔樓，這座塔樓是由幾百年前某個半被遺忘的瓦特達維安法師建造的。它具有以下特點：

english: All doors are unlocked except the one to {@area O5|1b2}.
zh_tw: 除了標有{@area O5|1b2}的門是鎖著的之外，其他所有門都是未上鎖的。

english: The rooms have 15-foot-high ceilings, with 7-foot-high doorways connecting them.
zh_tw: 這些房間有15尺高的天花板，由7尺高的門道連線。

english: The tower is brightly lit by {@spell continual flame} spells cast on wall sconces.
zh_tw: 這座塔由施加在壁燈上的{@spell continual flame||不滅明焰}法術照亮。

english: Areas of the Old Tower
zh_tw: 舊塔區域

english: The following locations are keyed to map 4.5.
zh_tw: 以下地點對應地圖4.5。

english: Tower
zh_tw: 塔樓

english: Tower, First Floor (Player Version)
zh_tw: 塔樓，第一層（玩家版本）

english: O1. Vestibule
zh_tw: O1. 前廳

english: The outer door has a tiny peephole with a closed iron shutter on the inside. Rotting tapestries adorn the walls, and mud and dirt have accumulated on the floor.
zh_tw: 外門上有一個帶內側關閉的鐵百葉窗的小窺視孔。腐爛的掛毯裝飾著牆壁，泥巴和汙垢在地板上積累。

english: O2. Ground Level
zh_tw: O2. 地面層

english: Stone spiral stairs curl up into the tower and down into the cellar. Set into the west wall is a fireplace blackened with soot. A burned heap that used to be a padded leather chair lies near the fireplace.
zh_tw: 螺旋形的石階蜿蜒向上進入塔樓，向下則通往地窖。西牆內嵌有一個因煙燻而變黑的壁爐。壁爐附近有一堆曾經是帶墊子的皮椅的燒焦殘骸。

english: O3. Upper Level
zh_tw: O3. 上層

english: This room, formerly a wizard's laboratory, contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間，曾經是一個法師的實驗室，包含以下特點：

english: A soot-stained fireplace has a lidless iron cauldron hanging on an iron hook in its hearth and a wizard's portrait on the wall above the mantelpiece.
zh_tw: 一個被煙燻黑的壁爐上掛著一個沒有蓋子的鐵鍋，鐵鍋掛在壁爐上的鐵鉤上，壁爐上方的壁爐架上掛著一幅法師的畫像。

english: The floor is littered with shards of broken glass, burned scraps of paper, twisted pieces of metal, and bird droppings.
zh_tw: 地板上散落著碎玻璃片、燒焦的紙片、扭曲的金屬片和鳥糞。

english: Other furnishings include a rocking chair, a trellis table, and the charred remains of a bookshelf, all shrouded in thick cobwebs.
zh_tw: 其他的傢俱包括一個搖椅、一個棚架桌，以及一個書架燒焦的殘骸，所有這些都被厚厚的蛛網覆蓋。

english: Arrow slits line the walls, and pigeons nest in the rafters.
zh_tw: 牆上有箭縫，鴿子在椽子上築巢。

english: Arrow Slits
zh_tw: 箭垛

english: Each arrow slit is 4 feet tall and 1 foot wide-big enough for a Small character or a slim Medium character to squeeze through.
zh_tw: 每個箭縫高4尺，寬1尺，足夠一個小體型角色或一個苗條的中等體型角色擠過去。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: A thorough search of the room yields a random treasure, determined by rolling a {@dice d4} and consulting the Old Tower Treasure table.
zh_tw: 對房間的徹底搜查會得到一件隨機的寶藏，透過擲一個 {@dice d4} 並參照舊塔寶藏表來確定。

english: Old Tower Treasure
zh_tw: 舊塔寶藏

english: Old Tower Treasure Table
zh_tw: 舊塔寶藏表格

english: d4
zh_tw: d4

english: Result
zh_tw: 結果

english: A charred {@item wand of magic missiles} (each time a charge is expended, there's a {@chance 50} chance that nothing happens and the charge is wasted)
zh_tw: 一根燒焦的{@item wand of magic missiles||魔法飛彈魔杖}（每次消耗一次充能時，有{@chance 50}的機率什麼也不會發生，充能被浪費）

english: A {@item potion of healing} mixed with a {@item potion of flying} (if this mixture is imbibed, roll on the {@table Variant: Mixing Potions; Potion Miscibility||Potion Miscibility} table in chapter 7 of the Dungeon Master's Guide to determine the effect)
zh_tw: 一個{@item potion of healing||治療藥水}與{@item potion of flying||飛行藥水}混合的藥水（如果喝下這種混合物，需要在《地下城主指南》第7章的{@table Variant: Mixing Potions; Potion Miscibility||藥水混合}表上擲骰以確定效果）

english: A cracked {@item driftglobe} that emits a flickering light but otherwise functions normally
zh_tw: 一個有裂紋的{@item driftglobe||漂浮之球}，它發出閃爍的光，但除此之外功能正常

english: A burned scroll tube containing two blank sheets of paper that are actually {@item paper bird|wdh|paper birds} (see appendix A)
zh_tw: 一個燒焦的卷軸筒，裡面裝有兩張空白紙張，實際上是{@item paper bird|wdh|紙鳶}（見附錄A）

english: O4. Cellar
zh_tw: O4. 地窖

english: This room contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間包含以下特點：

english: A small, circular wooden table is surrounded by four stools made from empty barrels. A marked deck of playing cards is scattered atop the table, with a few stray cards lying on the floor.
zh_tw: 一張小圓形木桌周圍有四個由空桶製成的凳子。桌上散落著一副標記過的撲克牌，還有一些零散的牌掉在地板上。

english: Three crates are stacked against the south wall. Each contains a twenty-day supply of edible rations.
zh_tw: 三個板條箱堆放在南牆上。每個箱子裡裝有足夠二十天食用的口糧。

english: Set into the north wall is a sturdy oak door with iron fittings and a built-in lock.
zh_tw: 北牆上嵌著一扇堅固的橡木門，配有鐵製配件和內建鎖。

english: Locked Door
zh_tw: 鎖住的門

english: The door to {@area O5|1b2} is locked. The lock can be picked by a character who uses thieves' tools and makes a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check. The door can also be forced open with a successful {@dc 25} Strength (Athletics) check.
zh_tw: 通往 {@area O5|1b2} 的門是鎖上的。使用盜賊工具併成功透過 {@dc 20} 敏捷檢定的角色可以撬開鎖。也可以透過成功進行 {@dc 25} 力量（運動）檢定強行開啟門。

english: O5. Teleportation Circle
zh_tw: O5. 傳送法陣

english: Arcane runes are inscribed in a circle on the floor of this otherwise empty chamber. The circle is a permanent teleportation circle (see the {@spell teleportation circle} spell description in the {@book Player's Handbook|phb}).
zh_tw: 奧秘符文被刻在這間空蕩房間地面上的一個圓圈中。這個圓圈是一個永久的傳送法陣（詳見{@book 玩家手冊|phb}中的{@spell teleportation circle||傳送法陣}法術描述）。

english: Old Tower: Spring
zh_tw: 舊塔：春季

english: The party's elusive quarry, a {@creature kenku}, has taken refuge in an old tower. By the time the characters reach the entrance to the tower, the kenku has taken a hostage and fled to the upper level.
zh_tw: 派對的難以捉摸的目標，一個{@creature kenku||天狗}，已經躲進了一座舊塔樓。當角色們到達塔樓的入口時，天狗已經劫持了一個人質並逃到了上層。

english: Street Urchins
zh_tw: 街頭小淘氣

english: Just prior to the kenku's arrival, three children entered the derelict tower on a dare. If this encounter occurs on or around Trolltide, the children are wearing troll masks. These noncombatants are named {@creature Nat|WDH}, {@creature Jenks|WDH}, and {@creature Squiddly|WDH} (see "{@area The Three Urchins|14e|x}").
zh_tw: 就在天狗到達之前，三個孩子因為一個挑戰而進入了這座廢棄的塔樓。如果這次遭遇發生在或接近巨魔節（巨魔節）期間，孩子們戴著巨魔面具。這些非戰鬥人員分別叫做{@creature Nat|WDH|納特}、{@creature Jenks|WDH|詹克斯}和{@creature Squiddly|WDH|斯奎迪利}（見'{@area 三個小淘氣|14e|x}'）。

english: The kenku has kidnapped {@creature Squiddly|WDH} and taken him upstairs ({@area O3|1ac}). The characters encounter {@creature Nat|WDH} and {@creature Jenks|WDH} in {@area O2|1ab}; they beg the characters to save their young tiefling friend.
zh_tw: 天狗族綁架了{@creature Squiddly|WDH|斯奎迪利}，並把他帶到樓上（{@area O3|1ac}）。角色們在{@area O2|1ab}遇到了{@creature Nat|WDH|納特}和{@creature Jenks|WDH|詹克斯}；他們懇求角色們救出他們年輕的提夫林朋友。

english: Confronting the Kenku
zh_tw: 面對天狗

english: The kenku clutches the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} in one clawed hand and {@creature Squiddly|WDH} the tiefling in the other. When cornered, the creature mimics the sound of a screaming child-its way of threatening to harm the boy unless the characters leave at once. The kenku doesn't respond to verbal threats or attempts at persuasion, but it can be bribed with coin, gemstones, or shiny baubles. It gives up both the stone and the boy in return for 100 gp worth of treasure.
zh_tw: 肯庫用一隻爪子緊握著{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，另一隻爪子抓著提夫林{@creature Squiddly|WDH|斯奎迪利}。當被逼入絕境時，這隻生物會模仿尖叫的孩子的聲——這是他的威脅方式，暗示如果不立即離開，就會傷害那個男孩。肯庫不會回應口頭威脅或勸說嘗試，但可以用硬幣、寶石或閃亮的小玩意賄賂他。他會為了價值100金幣的寶藏放棄石頭和男孩。

english: If the characters and the kenku reach an impasse, {@creature Squiddly|WDH} kicks the kenku in the shin, causing it to release him, and hides under some old furniture. This act initiates combat as the kenku draws its sword.
zh_tw: 如果角色們和天狗（天狗）陷入僵局，{@creature Squiddly|WDH|斯奎迪利}會踢天狗的小腿，導致它放開他，並躲到一些舊傢俱下面。這個行為引發了戰鬥，因為天狗拔出了它的劍。

english: If he has a clear path to the stairs, {@creature Squiddly|WDH} runs down them and rejoins his friends. The three children flee the tower together, disappearing into a nearby alley.
zh_tw: 如果他有一條通往樓梯的清晰路徑，{@creature Squiddly|WDH|斯奎迪利}會跑下樓梯，重新加入他的朋友們。三個孩子一起逃離塔樓，消失在附近的小巷中。

english: Gazer Attack
zh_tw: 凝視者眼魔攻擊

english: When the characters finally obtain the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, three {@creature gazer|VGM|gazers} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) enter {@area O3|1ac} through the arrow slits and attack. They try to incapacitate whichever character has the stone and use their telekinetic rays to steal it. If successful, the gazers take the stone to a nearby alley.
zh_tw: 當角色最終獲得 {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石} 時，三隻 {@creature gazer|VGM|凝視者眼魔}（見 {@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）透過箭縫進入 {@area O3|1ac} 併發起攻擊。它們試圖使持有石頭的角色喪失行動能力，並利用它們的心靈遙控射線奪取石頭。如果成功，眼魔們會將石頭帶到附近的小巷。

english: Next Encounter
zh_tw: 下一場遭遇

english: Whether the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} leaves the tower in the possession of the characters or the gazers, proceed with encounter 1, "Alley."
zh_tw: 無論{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}是留在角色們手中還是被凝視者佔有，都請繼續進行遭遇1，"小巷。"

english: Old Tower: Summer
zh_tw: 舊塔：夏季

english: The old tower, formerly owned by a wizard, was recently bought by Esvele Rosznar, a young noblewoman with a fascinating alter ego (see "The {@creature Black Viper|WDH}" in appendix B).
zh_tw: 這座舊塔，曾屬於一位法師，最近被一位年輕的貴族女性艾絲薇爾·羅茲納爾買下，她有一個迷人的另一個身份（見附錄B中的'{@creature Black Viper|WDH|黑毒蛇}'）。

english: House Rosznar Guards
zh_tw: 羅茲納爾家族守衛

english: Esvele has brought four {@creature guard||guards} with her to the tower. They wear the livery of House Rosznar and stand guard in {@area O1|1aa}.
zh_tw: 艾絲薇爾帶著四名{@creature guard||警衛}來到塔樓。他們穿著羅茲納爾家族的制服，在{@area 區域O1|1aa}站崗。

english: Bought and Paid For
zh_tw: 購買並已支付

english: Through her network of spies, Esvele learned about Lord Neverember's friendship with the tower's previous owner. Not long thereafter, she found the entrance to the Vault of Dragons beneath the tower. Unfortunately for her, she doesn't know what keys are needed to enter it or what lies within. When the characters arrive, Esvele is in {@area O2|1ab}, meeting with the following three guild representatives ({@creature commoner||commoners}):
zh_tw: 透過她的間諜網路，艾絲薇爾瞭解到了無燼領主與塔的前主人之間的友誼。不久之後，她找到了塔下的龍之寶庫的入口。不幸的是，她不知道需要什麼鑰匙才能進入，也不知道里面有什麼。當角色們到達時，艾絲薇爾在{@area O2|1ab}，正在與以下三位公會代表（{@creature commoner||平民}）會面：

english: Sembra Vashir (LN female Calishite human), of the Carpenters', Roofers', and Plaisterers' Guild
zh_tw: 塞姆布拉·瓦希爾（LN女性卡利什人），木工、屋頂工和灰泥工協會的成員

english: Pynt Oomtrowl (CG female rock gnome), of the Cellarers' and Plumbers' Guild
zh_tw: 品特·烏姆特羅爾（CG女性岩石地侏儒），來自地窖工和管道工公會

english: Jarbokken Frostbeard (LG male shield dwarf), of the Guild of Stonecutters, Masons, Potters, and Tile-makers
zh_tw: 賈博肯·霜胡（LG 男性盾矮人），石匠、泥瓦匠、陶工和瓦工公會的成員

english: This meeting is a formality. As the new owner, Esvele is required by law to bring the building up to code. She is gathering cost estimates from the guilds involved but has no intention of proceeding with repairs. The arrival of the characters provides her with a welcome distraction.
zh_tw: 這次會議是一種形式。作為新業主，艾絲薇爾依法必須使建築達到規範。她正在從涉及的公會收整合本估算，但無意進行維修。角色們的到來為她提供了一個受歡迎的分心。

english: Characters will have a tough time convincing Esvele that they have come for any reason other than to break into the Vault of Dragons. Esvele is willing to bring them on as business partners, allowing them access to the vault (preferably when there aren't guild representatives around) in exchange for an equal share of whatever treasure it might contain. She and the characters have each other over a barrel. She can't have them arrested for burglary without the authorities discovering the vault and seizing the tower. And they can't afford to deny the noblewoman what she wants, lest she divulge the vault's location to the authorities in exchange for a reward.
zh_tw: 角色們很難說服艾絲薇爾相信他們來這裡除了闖入龍之寶庫之外還有任何其他原因。艾絲薇爾願意讓他們成為商業夥伴，允許他們進入金庫（最好是在沒有公會代表在場的時候），以換取金庫中可能包含的寶藏的平等份額。她和角色們彼此都處於僵局。她不能在不暴露金庫並讓當局查封塔樓的情況下將他們以入室盜竊罪逮捕。而他們也不能拒絕這位貴族女性的要求，否則她可能會為了獎勵而向當局洩露金庫的位置。

english: Esvele offers to help the characters obtain the keys needed to unlock the Vault of Dragons and insists on accompanying them during their first foray into the vault, claiming all the while that she's capable of looking after herself. However this business with the party unfolds, she tries to conceal her secret identity from the characters for as long as possible.
zh_tw: 艾絲薇爾提出幫助角色們獲得開啟龍之寶庫所需的鑰匙，並堅持在他們第一次進入寶庫時陪同他們，一直聲稱她有能力照顧自己。然而，與隊伍的事務如何展開，她都盡力儘可能長時間地向角色們隱藏她的秘密身份。

english: Esvele doesn't use a key to lock and unlock the door to {@area O5|1b2}. She uses thieves' tools instead.
zh_tw: 艾絲薇爾不是用鑰匙來鎖和解鎖通往 {@area O5|1b2} 的門。她用的是盜賊工具。

english: Path to the Vault
zh_tw: 通往金庫的路

english: The entrance to the vault is hidden behind a secret door in the north wall of {@area O5|1b2}. The secret door was crafted by skilled dwarf engineers and requires a successful {@dc 20} Wisdom (Perception) check to locate. Esvele has already disarmed a magic trap on the door, rendering it safe to open. Beyond it lies a dusty staircase that descends 90 feet to a 20-foot-wide corridor. The hall extends another 90 feet to the vault doors. To one side of the vault doors, a natural fissure in the wall once served as a grick's lair, but Esvele killed the grick and left its corpse on the floor.
zh_tw: 金庫的入口隱藏在{@area O5|1b2}北牆的一扇密門後面。這扇密門由技藝精湛的矮人工程師打造，需要透過一次{@dc 20}的感知（感知）檢定才能發現。艾絲薇爾已經解除了門上的魔法陷阱，使其可以安全地開啟。門後是一條佈滿灰塵的樓梯，向下延伸90尺，通往一條20尺寬的走廊。大廳再延伸90尺便是金庫的大門。在金庫大門的一側，牆上的一個天然裂縫曾作為一隻格利克的巢穴，但艾絲薇爾已殺死了這隻格利克，並將其屍體留在了地上。

english: Old Tower: Autumn
zh_tw: 舊塔：秋季

english: The characters come to this crumbling tower in the Dock Ward looking for the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}. Members of Bregan D'aerthe follow them invisibly. Superstitious locals think the tower is haunted, so they avoid it.
zh_tw: 角色們來到碼頭區這座破敗的塔樓尋找{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}。布雷甘·達耶的成員們無形地跟隨他們。迷信的當地人認為這座塔樓鬧鬼，所以他們避開它。

english: Antimagic Field
zh_tw: 反魔法場

english: The interior of the tower is subject to a permanent {@spell antimagic field} spell. Consequently, no magic functions inside the tower. This effect was left behind by the tower's previous occupant, a wizard hermit who dabbled in "wild magic" and could no longer control it. Because of the antimagic field, the magic lights that normally illuminate the tower have been suppressed. Only a {@spell wish} spell or similar magic can end this antimagic effect.
zh_tw: 塔樓內部永久受到一個{@spell antimagic field||反魔法場}法術的影響。因此，塔樓內沒有任何魔法能夠生效。這個效果是由塔樓的前一位居住者留下的，他是一個涉足"野性魔法"並且無法再控制它的隱士法師。由於反魔法場的存在，通常照亮塔樓的魔法燈光被抑制了。只有透過{@spell wish||祈願術}法術或類似的魔法才能結束這個反魔法效果。

english: Tower Swords
zh_tw: 塔樓之劍

english: Scattered on the floors throughout the tower are six longswords with no traces of rust or blood on them. These blades are {@creature flying sword||flying swords} rendered inert by the antimagic field. If a flying sword is taken from the tower, it animates and attacks.
zh_tw: 塔樓各處地板上散落著六把長劍，它們沒有鏽跡或血跡。這些劍刃是被反魔法場使失去活性的{@creature flying sword||凌空劍}。如果一把飛行劍被帶出塔樓，它就會活化並發動攻擊。

english: Where's the Stone?
zh_tw: 石頭在哪裡？

english: Fenerus hid the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} in the cauldron that hangs in the fireplace on the upper level ({@area O3|1ac}). But it's not there anymore.
zh_tw: 費內魯斯把{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}藏在掛在上層壁爐上的大鍋裡面（{@area O3|1ac}）。但現在它不在那裡了。

english: Before the characters reach {@area O3|1ac}, three {@creature drow gunslinger|WDH|drow gunslingers} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) under the effect of {@item potion of invisibility||potions of invisibility} use their {@spell levitate} spells to scale the outside of the tower and crawl through the arrow slits. While they are inside the tower, their {@spell invisibility} spells are negated by the antimagic field. One of the drow quickly finds the stone and takes it before the characters show up.
zh_tw: 在角色們到達{@area O3|1ac}之前，三名{@creature drow gunslinger|WDH|卓爾火槍手}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）受到{@item potion of invisibility||隱形藥水}的影響，使用他們的{@spell levitate||浮空術}法術爬上塔樓的外牆，並透過箭縫爬進來。當他們在塔樓內部時，他們的{@spell invisibility||隱形}法術被反魔法場抵消了。其中一名黑暗精靈很快就找到了石頭，並在角色們出現之前將其拿走。

english: Unless they were defeated earlier in the adventure, these drow are Jarlaxle's lieutenants: {@creature Fel'rekt Lafeen|WDH}, {@creature Krebbyg Masq'il'yr|WDH}, and {@creature Soluun Xibrindas|wdh}. Replace any that were killed earlier in the adventure with other drow gunslingers, and roll initiative for each drow. Soluun (or his replacement) can't resist a good fight and attacks the characters, buying time for the other drow to escape. Once they're outside the tower, the fleeing drow become {@condition invisible} again as they leap onto a nearby rooftop, but the potions wear off at the end of their next turns, enabling characters to chase after them.
zh_tw: 除非他們在冒險的早些時候被擊敗，否則這些卓爾是賈拉索的副手：{@creature Fel'rekt Lafeen|WDH|菲爾萊科特·拉菲恩}、{@creature Krebbyg Masq'il'yr|WDH|克雷比格·馬斯奇爾} 和 {@creature Soluun Xibrindas|wdh|索倫·希布林達斯}。替換任何在冒險早些時候被殺的卓爾火槍手，併為每個卓爾投擲先攻。索倫（或他的替代者）無法抵擋一場好鬥，攻擊角色們，為其他卓爾爭取逃跑時間。一旦他們離開塔樓，逃走的卓爾在跳到附近的屋頂時再次變得 {@condition invisible||隱形}，但藥劑在他們的下一回合結束時失效，使得角色們可以追趕他們。

english: Next Encounter
zh_tw: 下一場遭遇

english: If the characters pursue the fleeing drow, proceed with encounter 5, "Rooftop Chase."
zh_tw: 如果角色們追趕逃跑的黑暗精靈，繼續進行遭遇5，"屋頂追逐。"

english: Old Tower: Winter
zh_tw: 舊塔：冬季

english: The characters have learned that the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} is with Amath Sercent, a priest of Bane who is allied with {@creature Manshoon|WDH}. She and her acolytes reside in Yellowspire, a Castle Ward tower so named because its bricks have a pale yellow tinge to them. Amath is in the midst of converting the tower into a temple of Bane. A teleportation circle in the basement allows for swift transport to and from Kolat Towers and {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s extradimensional sanctum.
zh_tw: 角色們已經得知{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}在班恩的祭司阿瑪斯·瑟森特那裡，她與{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}結盟。她和她的侍僧們居住在黃尖塔，這是城堡區的一座塔樓，因其磚石帶有淡黃色調而得名。阿瑪斯正在將塔樓改造為班恩的神殿。地下室中的傳送法陣可以快速往返克拉特雙塔和{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的異次元聖所。

english: House of Tyranny
zh_tw: 暴政之屋

english: Amath Sercent (LE female Mulan {@creature priest}) and her four followers (LE male and female {@creature acolyte||acolytes} of mixed ethnicities) dress in common clothing when outside the tower. Inside the structure, they wear fur-lined robes to stay warm. They refer to the tower as the House of Tyranny, and black prints of their right hands, with fingers and thumb held together, cover every interior surface. These handprints mimic the symbol of Bane.
zh_tw: 阿瑪斯·瑟森特（LE女性穆蘭人 {@creature priest||祭司}）和她的四名追隨者（LE男性和女性不同種族的{@creature acolyte||侍僧}）在塔外時穿著普通服裝。在塔內，他們穿著毛皮襯裡的長袍以保持溫暖。他們將這座塔稱為暴政之屋，並且他們右手的黑色手印，手指和拇指併攏，覆蓋了每一個內部表面。這些手印模仿了班恩的象徵。

english: Amath and her followers assemble here for worship but sleep elsewhere. When the characters first arrive, all five have gathered in prayer on the upper floor of the tower ({@area O3|1ac}). Three black {@creature flying snake||flying snakes} nest in the rafters and join any battle here. During this ceremony, Amath and her acolytes hold candles and form a circle around a gagged and blindfolded broadsheet publisher named Shan Chien (N male Shou human {@creature commoner}). The imperious, middle-aged man is shackled to the floor, and Amath carries the key to the shackles. The shackles can be broken by a creature that uses an action to make a successful {@dc 20} Strength (Athletics) check. Picking the shackles' lock requires thieves' tools and a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check.
zh_tw: 阿瑪斯與追隨者在此聚會禮拜，但在別處睡覺。角色們初次到達時，五人全都聚集在塔的上層（{@area O3|1ac}）祈禱。三條黑色的{@creature flying snake||飛蛇}在屋樑上築巢，會加入此處的任何戰鬥。儀式中，阿瑪斯和侍僧們手持蠟燭，圍著一名被堵住嘴、蒙上雙眼的報刊發行人單建（中立，男性壽族人類{@creature commoner||平民}）站成一圈。這名盛氣凌人的中年男子被鐐銬鎖在地板上，鑰匙由阿瑪斯保管。生物可以使用一個動作，成功透過{@dc 20}力量（運動）檢定來扯斷鐐銬。開鎖需要盜賊工具，並成功透過{@dc 15}敏捷檢定。

english: The Banites' ritual is designed to break Shan's will, making him subservient to Bane. Amath has been using this ritual to "turn" broadsheet publishers as part of a larger plot to control the flow of information in the city-a critical element of {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s takeover. Shan was abducted by Amath's acolytes the night before while walking to his home in the Trades Ward. He publishes {@i The Targe}, a broadsheet that offers up vitriolic rants on all manner of local topics, including politics.
zh_tw: 班恩信徒的儀式旨在摧毀山（單）的意志，使其屈服於班恩。阿瑪斯（阿瑪斯）一直利用這一儀式來"轉化"傳單出版商，作為控制城市資訊流的大規模陰謀的一部分——這是{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}接管計劃的關鍵環節。山在前一晚返回位於商業區（商業區）家中的路上被阿瑪斯的信徒綁架。他出版傳單{@i 塔吉}，該傳單對包括政治在內的各種本地話題發表尖銳抨擊。

english: Amath has the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} in her pocket. She is expecting {@creature Manshoon|WDH} or his simulacrum to arrive and retrieve it shortly.
zh_tw: 阿瑪斯口袋裡有{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}。她正期待著{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}或他的副本不久後到達並取回它。

english: Outer Scaffolding
zh_tw: 外部腳手架

english: The tower is encircled by wooden scaffolding covered with ice and snow. Despite its precarious appearance, the scaffolding is secure and safe to walk on, enabling creatures to scale the outside of the tower without having to make ability checks. The scaffolding rattles and creaks, however, and any creature that moves on it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity (Stealth) check or be heard by the tower's occupants.
zh_tw: 塔樓被覆蓋著冰雪的木製腳手架所環繞。儘管看起來搖搖欲墜，但腳手架確實穩固安全，可以行走，使生物能夠無需進行能力檢定即可攀爬塔樓的外部。然而，腳手架會發出嘎吱聲和震動聲，任何在其上移動的生物必須成功透過一個 {@dc 16} 敏捷（隱匿）檢定，否則會被塔樓內的居民聽到。

english: Simulacrum
zh_tw: 擬像術

english: The characters must fight Amath and her acolytes to get the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}. When they finally obtain it, fate deals them an unkind hand as {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s simulacrum (see "{@creature Manshoon|WDH}" in appendix B) arrives by way of the teleportation circle in {@area O5|1b2}. If the characters had the opportunity and the foresight to destroy the circle prior to obtaining the stone, the simulacrum instead must travel to Yellowspire on foot, giving the characters ample time to get away before it arrives as long as they leave within 1 hour after obtaining the stone. The simulacrum tirelessly pursues the stone, and characters who flee would do themselves well not to leave tracks in the snow.
zh_tw: 角色們必須與阿瑪斯及其追隨者戰鬥以獲取{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}。當他們最終獲得它時，命運給了他們不友好的打擊，因為{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的擬像（參見附錄B中的"{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}"）透過{@area O5|1b2}的傳送法陣到達。如果角色們有機會和先見之明在獲得石頭之前摧毀傳送法陣，擬像將不得不徒步前往黃尖塔，為角色們提供充足的時間在他們獲得石頭後1小時內離開。擬像會不知疲倦地追捕石頭，逃離的角色最好不要在雪地上留下蹤跡。

english: Next Encounter
zh_tw: 下一場遭遇

english: If a character becomes attuned to the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, it reveals the location of the Vault of Dragons, under the Brandath family mausoleum in the City of the Dead, and the three keys needed to enter it. When the characters are ready to visit the mausoleum, proceed with encounter 4, "Mausoleum."
zh_tw: 如果一個角色與{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}產生共鳴，它會揭示位於亡者之城布蘭達斯家族陵墓下的龍之寶庫的位置，以及進入所需的三把鑰匙。當角色們準備好參觀陵墓時，請繼續進行遭遇4，"陵墓。"

english: Encounter 8: Courthouse
zh_tw: 遭遇8: 法院

english: People who are arrested by the City Watch are brought to a courthouse and detained until a magister can pass judgment on them. Each courthouse has the following features:
zh_tw: 被城市守衛逮捕的人被帶到法院，並在那裡被拘留，直到地方法官能夠對他們進行審判。每個法院都有以下特點：

english: Two {@creature guard||guards} stand outside each of the front and back doors (leading to areas H1 and H6) at all hours.
zh_tw: 在所有時間裡，每扇前門和後門（通向區域H1和H6）外都站著兩名{@creature guard||警衛}。

english: Rooms have 10-foot-high ceilings, with 8-foot-high passages and 7-foot-high doorways connecting them.
zh_tw: 房間有10尺高的天花板，連線它們的通道和門道高度分別為8尺和7尺。

english: Windows are fitted with iron bars that require a successful {@dc 30} Strength (Athletics) check to bend.
zh_tw: 窗戶上裝有鐵條，需要進行一次成功的 {@dc 30} 力量（運動）檢定才能彎曲。

english: Doors are made of iron-bound oak and unlocked.
zh_tw: 門是由鐵箍橡木製成的，並且是未上鎖的。

english: All areas are brightly lit by {@spell continual flame} spells cast on wall sconces.
zh_tw: 所有區域都由施加在壁燈上的{@spell continual flame||不滅明焰}法術照亮。

english: Cisterns on the roof collect rainwater, which is funneled by pipes down to the showers ({@area H7|1cf}).
zh_tw: 屋頂上的水箱收集雨水，雨水透過管道被引導到淋浴區（{@area H7|1cf}）。

english: Areas of the Courthouse
zh_tw: 法院區域

english: The following locations are keyed to map 4.6.
zh_tw: 以下地點對應地圖4.6。

english: Courthouse
zh_tw: 法院

english: Courthouse, Main Level (Player Version)
zh_tw: 法院，主層（玩家版本）

english: H1. Upstairs Waiting Room
zh_tw: H1. 樓上等候室

english: This room has the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間有以下特點：

english: Two {@creature guard||guards} stand outside the doors to the records rooms ({@area H2|1ca}) at all hours. Behind a desk sits a court clerk ({@creature commoner}). Uncomfortable wood benches line the walls. A copper plaque mounted above each bench says, in Common, "Please have a seat. Someone will be with you shortly."
zh_tw: 兩名{@creature guard||警衛}全天候站在檔案室（{@area H2|1ca}）門外。桌子後面坐著一位書記員（{@creature commoner||平民}）。牆邊擺放著不舒適的木製長椅。每張長椅上方掛著一塊銅牌，上面用通用語寫著："請就座，稍後會有人來為您服務。"

english: Two privies are situated in a corner by the entrance.
zh_tw: 兩個廁所位於入口處的角落。

english: Clerk
zh_tw: 職員

english: The clerk asks visitors what their business is and either directs them to the appropriate area of the courthouse or instructs them to wait. The clerk holds a key to the records rooms ({@area H2|1ca}).
zh_tw: 職員詢問訪客他們的來意，並指引他們前往法院的相應區域或指示他們等待。職員持有記錄室（{@area H2|1ca}）的鑰匙。

english: H2. Records Rooms
zh_tw: H2. 記錄室

english: The doors to these rooms are locked. Inside, shelves lining every available inch of wall space hold boxes of papers dated by month and year. These papers are records of court proceedings and depositions.
zh_tw: 這些房間的門是鎖著的。裡面，每一寸可用的牆面上都排列著架子，架子上放著按月和年份標記的紙盒。這些紙張是法庭程式和證詞的記錄。

english: H3. Clerks' Office
zh_tw: H3. 職員辦公室

english: Two desks pushed together in the middle of the room hold quills, ink, and sheets of paper. Two court clerks ({@creature commoner||commoners}) work here, supporting the magister on duty. Each clerk holds a key to the records rooms ({@area H2|1ca}).
zh_tw: 房間中央並排放置的兩張桌子上擺放著羽毛筆、墨水和紙張。兩名法院職員（{@creature commoner||平民}）在這裡工作，協助值班的地方法官。每位職員都持有記錄室（{@area H2|1ca}）的一把鑰匙。

english: H4. Magister's Office
zh_tw: H4. 地方法官辦公室

english: This grand office contains several plush armchairs and a large walnut desk. The seal of Waterdeep is emblazoned on the wood floor.
zh_tw: 這間宏偉的辦公室內擺放著幾把豪華扶手椅和一張大型胡桃木辦公桌。深水城的徽章銘刻在木地板上。

english: When not overseeing a trial, a magister on duty at the courthouse reviews cases and holds meetings here. If a magister is here, so is a {@creature knight} who serves as a bodyguard.
zh_tw: 當不在監督審判時，值班的地方法官在法院這裡審查案件並舉行會議。如果地方法官在這裡，那麼作為保鏢的{@creature knight||騎士}也會在這裡。

english: H5. Courtroom
zh_tw: H5. 法庭

english: This room has the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間有以下特點：

english: Two {@creature guard||guards} are stationed here at all times.
zh_tw: 這裡始終有兩名{@creature guard||警衛}駐守。

english: If court is in session, the magister is here along with a bodyguard (see {@area H4|1cc}) and anyone else pertinent to the case being tried.
zh_tw: 如果法庭正在開庭，地方法官會和保鏢一起在這裡（見{@area H4|1cc}），以及任何與正在審理的案件相關的人。

english: A magister's cloth-draped desk faces a defendant's box and three rows of pews.
zh_tw: 一個覆蓋著布的地方法官的桌子面對著被告席和三排長椅。

english: Hanging on the west wall are tasseled banners depicting the coats of arms of the City of Waterdeep, the Waterdeep City Watch, and the Waterdeep City Guard, as well as the seal of the Lords of Waterdeep and the symbol of Tyr, god of justice.
zh_tw: 西牆上掛著飾有流蘇的旗幟，上面描繪著深水城、深水城城市守衛、深水城守衛的紋章，以及深水城領主的徽章和正義之神提爾的象徵。

english: H6. Downstairs Waiting Room
zh_tw: H6. 樓下等候室

english: Nobles scheduled to testify in court and those waiting to visit prisoners are held here. The room contains the following features:
zh_tw: 預定在法庭作證的貴族和那些等待探訪囚犯的人都在這裡等候。這個房間包含以下特點：

english: Two {@creature guard||guards} are on duty in this room at all times.
zh_tw: 這個房間裡始終有兩名{@creature guard||警衛}值班。

english: Mismatched couches line the walls.
zh_tw: 不配套的沙發靠牆擺放。

english: Old broadsheets rest in loose piles atop end tables.
zh_tw: 舊報紙隨意堆放在茶几上。

english: H7. Showers
zh_tw: H7. 淋浴室

english: Dirty prisoners are stripped of their clothing and washed here before they are locked in cells. Protruding from the walls are iron nozzles that spew cold water when a chain next to the door is pulled. Drains in the stone-tiled floor keep the room from flooding.
zh_tw: 囚犯在被關進牢房之前，會在這裡脫去衣物並被清洗。牆上突出的鐵噴嘴在門邊的鏈條拉動時會噴出冷水。石磚地板上的排水口防止了房間積水。

english: H8. Cell Block
zh_tw: H8. 牢房區

english: Two {@creature guard||guards} are stationed in this hall at all times.
zh_tw: 這個走廊裡始終有兩名{@creature guard||警衛}駐守。

english: Locked Cells
zh_tw: 上鎖的牢房

english: Five cells are spaced along this hall. The door to each cell is locked from the outside, and the guards stationed here hold the keys. A door's lock can't be picked from inside the cell.
zh_tw: 五個牢房沿著這條走廊隔開。每個牢房的門都是從外面鎖上的，駐守在這裡的守衛持有鑰匙。牢房內的門鎖無法被撬開。

english: H9. Watch Wagon
zh_tw: H9. 守衛馬車

english: This room contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間包含以下特點：

english: Two {@creature veteran||veterans}, members of the City Watch, are here at all times.
zh_tw: 這裡始終有兩名{@creature veteran||老兵}，城市守衛的成員。

english: An armored carriage stands behind a pair of steel doors secured by an iron bar.
