zh_tw: 一輛裝甲馬車位於一對由鐵棒固定的鋼門後面。

english: Armored Carriage
zh_tw: 裝甲馬車

english: Two horses are needed to pull the carriage, which can hold up to eight Medium prisoners at a time. The back door to the carriage is secured with chains and two padlocks. Each veteran on duty has a key that opens one of the padlocks.
zh_tw: 需要兩匹馬來拉動這輛馬車，它一次最多可以容納八名中等體型的囚犯。馬車後門用鏈條和兩個掛鎖固定。每名值班的老兵都有一把能開啟其中一個掛鎖的鑰匙。

english: Barred Outer Doors
zh_tw: 帶柵欄的外門

english: It takes two people to lift the bar that obstructs the doors to the outside. A successful {@dc 21} Strength (Athletics) check enables one person to do it alone.
zh_tw: 需要兩個人才能抬起擋住通往外面的大門的橫杆。成功的 {@dc 21} 力量（運動）檢定允許一個人獨自完成。

english: Courthouse: Summer
zh_tw: 法院：夏季

english: After obtaining the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, the characters are arrested by the City Watch soon after they emerge from the sewers.
zh_tw: 在獲得{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}之後，角色們很快就在從下水道出來後被城市守衛逮捕。

english: Under Arrest
zh_tw: 被逮捕

english: The arresting force consists of twelve {@creature veteran||veterans}, a Watch {@creature sergeant|WDH} and eleven constables. They demand that the characters surrender their weapons and come along quietly. For guidance on how to handle character arrests, see "Breaking the Law,".
zh_tw: 逮捕隊伍由十二名{@creature veteran||老兵}，一名守衛{@creature sergeant|WDH|軍士}和十一個巡警組成。他們要求角色們交出武器並乖乖合作。關於如何處理角色逮捕的指導，請參閱"違法"。

english: The characters are charged with disturbing the peace, a minor offense that carries a fine and results in an edict. The charge stems from their conduct in encounter 3, "Street Chase." Depending on how they comported themselves in previous encounters, the characters might be charged with additional crimes against the city or its citizens, possibly including brandishing weapons without due cause, robbery, assaulting a citizen, or murder. If they resist arrest, they are charged with hampering justice. See the Code Legal handout in appendix C for the penalties associated with such crimes.
zh_tw: 角色們因擾亂公共秩序被控告，這是一種輕微的罪行，會被罰款並導致頒佈法令。這項指控源於他們在遭遇3，"街頭追逐"中的行為。根據他們在之前的遭遇中的行為，角色們可能會被控告對城市或其市民犯有其他罪行，可能包括無故展示武器、搶劫、攻擊市民或謀殺。如果他們抗拒逮捕，他們會被控告妨礙司法。請參閱附錄C中的《法律法典》手冊，瞭解與此類罪行相關的處罰。

english: The Code Legal
zh_tw: 法律法典

english: Characters who give up their visible weapons without a fuss aren't searched, but those who give the Watch a hard time are searched for hidden weapons (and stripped of anything that could potentially cause harm). A character can conceal a Tiny object from the Watch with a successful {@dc 12} Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check. If the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} is found during a search, the Watch {@creature sergeant|WDH} inspects it, concludes that it's nothing of consequence, and returns it to its owner.
zh_tw: 未經抵抗就交出可見武器的角色不會被搜查，但那些給守衛添麻煩的角色會被搜查隱藏武器（並被剝奪任何可能造成傷害的物品）。角色可以透過一次成功的{@dc 12}敏捷（手上功夫）檢定來向守衛隱蔽一個微型物品。如果在搜查過程中發現{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，守衛的{@creature sergeant|WDH|軍士}會檢查它，認為它無關緊要，並將其歸還給其主人。

english: Dock Ward Courthouse
zh_tw: 碼頭區法院

english: Arrested characters are brought to a courthouse in the Dock Ward and confined to cells ({@area H8|1d0}) until their trial. Any items taken from them during their arrest are entrusted to the front desk clerk ({@area H1|1c8}) pending the trial's outcome. A character can take a short rest while incarcerated and use that time to attune to the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}. After {@dice 1d6} hours, word comes down that the magister is prepared to hear the characters' testimony, whereupon the guards in {@area H8|1d0} unlock the characters' cells and escort them to the courtroom ({@area H5|1cd}), where the magister is waiting.
zh_tw: 被捕的角色被帶到碼頭區的法院，並被關押在牢房（{@area H8|1d0}）直到他們的審判。在他們被捕期間被拿走的任何物品都被交給前臺接待員（{@area H1|1c8}）保管，等待審判結果。一個角色可以在被監禁時進行短休，並利用這段時間來調整對{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}的感應。在{@dice 1d6}小時後，訊息傳來，法官准備聽取角色們的證詞，隨後{@area H8|1d0}的守衛開啟角色們的牢房，護送他們到法庭（{@area H5|1cd}），法官在那裡等待。

english: False Captain
zh_tw: 假船長

english: If Lord Cassalanter's {@creature doppelganger} valet is still at large, it kills a Watch captain and uses the victim's uniform to impersonate another Watch captain the characters have met before. Then, in the guise of Hyustus Staget (see "The Watch Arrives"), the doppelganger kills the guards in {@area H8|1d0} with its bare hands and uses their keys to open the characters' cells. "Hyustus" warns them that the magister is corrupt and suggests they flee the city before they're sentenced to death. "Hyustus" offers to deliver messages or items of import on their behalf while they make good their escape. The doppelganger is hoping that the characters will entrust the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} to it for safekeeping. Failing that, it hopes to wrest the stone from them during the chaos of the jailbreak.
zh_tw: 如果卡薩蘭特勳爵的{@creature doppelganger||變形怪}男僕仍然逍遙法外，它會殺死一名守衛隊長並利用受害者的制服冒充角色們之前見過的另一名守衛隊長。然後，以休斯圖斯·斯塔吉特（見"守衛到來"）的身份，變形怪赤手空拳殺死了{@area H8|1d0}的守衛，並使用他們的鑰匙開啟角色們的牢房。"休斯圖斯"警告他們，地方法官是腐敗的，並建議他們在被判處死刑之前逃離這座城市。"休斯圖斯"提出在他們逃跑時代表他們傳遞資訊或重要物品。變形怪希望角色們會將{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}託付給它保管。如果不行，它希望在越獄的混亂中從他們那裡奪取石頭。

english: If the characters refuse to play along, the doppelganger cries out in alarm, bringing the full weight of the courthouse garrison (ten {@creature guard||guards} and two {@creature veteran||veterans}) down upon the characters, whom "Hyustus" accuses of beating the cell block guards to death. These reinforcements have no reason to believe that Captain Staget isn't who he appears to be, and they side with him in any conflict.
zh_tw: 如果角色們拒絕合作，變形怪會驚恐地大喊，引來法院衛戍部隊的全部力量（十名{@creature guard||警衛}和兩名{@creature veteran||老兵}），"休斯圖斯"指控他們打死了牢房區的守衛。這些增援沒有理由不相信斯塔吉特隊長就是他表面上的那個人，他們在任何衝突中都會支援他。

english: If the doppelganger obtains the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, it promptly delivers it to {@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH}. If the characters extricate themselves from the mess they're in, they can retrieve the stone from Cassalanter Villa (see chapter 6).
zh_tw: 如果變形怪獲得了{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，它會立即將其交給{@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH|維克托羅·卡薩蘭特}。如果角色們能夠擺脫他們所處的困境，他們可以從卡薩蘭特別墅（見第6章）取回石頭。

english: Meeting with the Magister
zh_tw: 與地方法官會面

english: The presiding magister is Umbero Zastro, a handsome, eloquent, and fair-minded half-elf in his thirties. He's known for his finely-honed sense of poetic justice and for meting out unconventional punishments.
zh_tw: 主持法官是翁貝羅·扎斯特羅，一位三十多歲、英俊、雄辯、公正的半精靈。他以敏銳的詩意正義感和執行非傳統懲罰而聞名。

english: {@creature Magister Umbero Zastro|wdh} has the statistics of a {@creature noble}, with these changes:
zh_tw: {@creature Magister Umbero Zastro|wdh|大師翁貝羅·扎斯特羅}具有{@creature noble||貴族}的屬性，並有以下變化：

english: He is lawful neutral.
zh_tw: 他是守序中立的。

english: He is unarmed, unarmored (AC 11), and worth 0 XP.
zh_tw: 他沒有武裝，沒有護甲（AC 11），並且價值0經驗值。

english: He has these racial traits: He has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put him to sleep. He has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. He speaks Common and Elvish.
zh_tw: 他具有以下種族特徵：他在對抗{@condition charmed||魅惑}的豁免檢定中有優勢，魔法不能讓他入睡。他具有60尺範圍內的黑暗視覺。他會說通用語和精靈語。

english: The magister has already heard the testimony of the arresting officers, as well as that of any eyewitnesses. The characters are given an hour to plead their case while he asks questions. A character who tries to deceive Zastro must make a Charisma (Deception) check contested by the magister's Wisdom (Insight) check. A character who loses this contest is found guilty of hampering justice, locked up for a tenday, and fined 200 gp, on top of any other punishments meted out for crimes committed against the city and its citizenry. Those who can't or won't pay the fine are sentenced to hard labor for a year in Amendsfarm, a City Guard-run labor camp among the farms of Undercliff.
zh_tw: 地方法官已經聽取了逮捕官員的證詞，以及任何目擊者的證詞。角色們有一個小時的時間來為他們的情況辯護，而他會提出問題。試圖欺騙扎斯特羅的角色必須進行一次魅力（欺瞞）檢定，與地方法官的感知（洞悉）檢定相對抗。輸掉這場對抗的角色將被認定為妨礙司法公正，被監禁十天，並被罰款200金幣，除此之外，還會因為他們對城市及其市民犯下的罪行而受到其他懲罰。那些無法或不願支付罰款的人將被判處在贖罪農場（一個城防軍運營的勞改營，位於崖下區的農場中）進行一年的艱苦勞動。

english: If the characters committed one or more crimes, they are judged guilty and punished accordingly (see the Code Legal handout in appendix C). A character who pleads for leniency and succeeds on a {@dc 14} Charisma (Persuasion) check receives an alternate punishment for crimes that don't carry punishments of death or exile. This check is made with advantage if the character has renown in a respectable faction, such as Force Grey (the Gray Hands), the Emerald Enclave, the Harpers, the Lords' Alliance, or the Order of the Gauntlet. Alternate punishments for lesser crimes include the following:
zh_tw: 如果角色犯下了一項或多項罪行，他們將被判有罪並受到相應的懲罰（見附錄 C 中的《法典》檔案）。對於不涉及死刑或流放的罪行，如果角色請求寬大處理併成功透過一次{@dc 14}魅力（說服）檢定，則可以獲得替代懲罰。如果角色在某個受人尊敬的派系中享有聲望，例如灰色力量（灰手）、翠綠閒庭、豎琴手聯盟、領主聯盟或鐵手套教團，則此檢定具有優勢。對於較輕罪行的替代懲罰包括以下幾種：

english: The character must make beds and clean bedsheets at local orphanages for a tenday, under guard supervision.
zh_tw: 角色必須在警衛的監督下，在當地孤兒院鋪床並清洗床單，為期十天。

english: The character must report to Morana Huldark, a dwarf member of the Guild of Watermen, and scrape barnacles off the docks for a tenday under her close supervision.
zh_tw: 角色必須向莫拉娜·胡達爾克報告，她是水手公會的矮人成員，並在她的嚴密監督下，在為期十天的時間裡刮除碼頭上的藤壺。

english: The character must spend the next month delivering 30-pound casks of drinking water to the guards stationed atop the city walls.
zh_tw: 角色必須在下個月為駐守在城牆頂部的守衛運送30磅重的飲用水桶。

english: For a tenday, the character must stand on a particular street corner every afternoon from highsun to dusk and, like a broadcrier, shout out the crimes of which he or she has been found guilty while accepting the scoldings and verbal lashings of the citizenry.
zh_tw: 在接下來的十天裡，角色必須每天下午從正午到黃昏站在特定的街角，像一個叫賣者一樣大聲喊出自己被判定有罪的罪行，同時接受市民的責罵和口頭鞭撻。

english: Characters who are tricked into acting in accordance with the wishes of the doppelganger can be forgiven for crimes committed during the jailbreak, but only if the doppelganger is apprehended or killed. (It reverts to its true form when it dies.) {@spell Speak with dead} spells can be cast on the cell block guards slain by the doppelganger to obtain testimony that clears the characters of the guards' murder.
zh_tw: 被欺騙按照變形怪的願望行事的角色可以被原諒在越獄期間犯下的罪行，但前提是變形怪被逮捕或殺死。（它在死亡時會變回其真實形態。）可以在變形怪殺死的牢房區守衛身上施展{@spell Speak with dead||死者交談}法術，以獲得證明角色們沒有謀殺守衛的證詞。

english: Next Encounter
zh_tw: 下一場遭遇

english: If a character becomes attuned to the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, it reveals the location of the Vault of Dragons, beneath an old tower in the Sea Ward, and the three keys needed to enter it. When the characters are ready to visit the location, proceed with encounter 7, "Old Tower."
zh_tw: 如果一個角色與{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}（戈洛爾之石）產生共鳴，它將揭示位於海區一座古老塔樓下方的龍之寶庫的位置，以及進入金庫所需的三把鑰匙。當角色們準備去往該地點時，請繼續進行遭遇7，'舊塔'（古老塔樓）。

english: Courthouse: Autumn
zh_tw: 法院：秋季

english: The characters have learned that Fenerus Stormcastle is in the custody of the City Watch at a courthouse in the Castle Ward. If they try to speak with him, they are met by the clerk at the front desk, who informs them that they must schedule a meeting with the magister first, because visitors need her written permission to see him. The clerk says the meeting with the magister can happen no sooner than highsun on the following day but can be persuaded to move up the time for a bribe of 10 gp or more.
zh_tw: 角色們得知費內魯斯·風暴堡爾被城市守衛拘留在城堡區的法院。如果他們試圖與他交談，他們會在前臺遇到一位職員，職員告訴他們必須先與地方法官安排會面，因為訪問者需要她的書面許可才能見他。職員說與地方法官的會面最早只能在第二天的正午進行，但可以透過支付10金幣或更多的賄賂來提前時間。

english: There are alternatives to speaking with the magister, if the characters have sufficient renown in a politically influential faction-or a talent for deception:
zh_tw: 如果角色在政治上有影響力的派系中擁有足夠的聲望，或者擅長欺騙，那麼與大法師交談還有替代方案：

english: A character who has at least 4 renown in the Harpers can convince {@creature Mirt|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) to use his authority as a Lord of Waterdeep to secure Fenerus's release. {@creature Mirt|WDH} has personally lost coin to the Blood Hawk Posse, so helping Fenerus squirm out of jail stings him deeply.
zh_tw: 在豎琴手聯盟中至少擁有4點聲望的角色可以說服{@creature Mirt|WDH|米爾特}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）利用他作為深水城領主的權威來確保費內魯斯的釋放。{@creature Mirt|WDH|米爾特}個人曾因血鷹幫而損失金錢，所以幫助費內魯斯從監獄逃脫對他來說是一種深深的刺痛。

english: A character who has at least 4 renown in the Lords' Alliance can arrange a meeting with {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) at Piergeiron's Palace and convince her to give Fenerus what he wants in exchange for information on the stone's whereabouts. The safe return of Neverember's cache of dragons is more important to her than the fate of one brigand.
zh_tw: 至少在領主聯盟中有4點聲望的角色可以安排在皮爾吉倫的宮殿與{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）會面，並說服她給予費內魯斯他想要的東西，以換取關於石頭下落的資訊。對她來說，安全返回無燼的龍藏比一個強盜的命運更重要。

english: The characters can purposely get themselves arrested in the Castle Ward. Even a minor crime can result in a brief period of incarceration until the magister has time to render judgment. In the meantime, characters can try to speak to Fenerus.
zh_tw: 角色們可以故意讓自己在城堡區被捕。即使是小罪也可能導致短暫的監禁，直到大法師有時間作出判決。與此同時，角色們可以嘗試與費內魯斯交談。

english: The characters can try to infiltrate the courthouse using mundane disguises or magic. Impersonating an official or using magic to influence one is a crime (see the Code Legal handout in appendix C), so they must be stealthy or skilled at deception.
zh_tw: 角色們可以嘗試使用普通的偽裝或魔法潛入法院。冒充官員或使用魔法影響官員是犯罪行為（見附錄C中的《法律法典》手冊），所以他們必須小心謹慎或擅長欺騙。

english: Meeting with the Magister
zh_tw: 與地方法官會面

english: The courthouse magister is {@creature Hester Barch|WDH} (LG female Turami human {@creature acolyte} with Insight +4), a petite woman in her seventies. Magister Barch is slow to anger and fond of sharing lengthy educational anecdotes and parables. Unknown to all but her closest aides, the magister has the innate psionic ability to cast the {@spell detect thoughts} spell without somatic or material components. After using it once, the magister must finish a short or long rest before she can cast the spell again. Wisdom is her spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 12}).
zh_tw: 法院官員是赫絲特·巴奇（{@creature Hester Barch|WDH|赫絲特·巴奇}）（守序善良的圖拉米人類女性{@creature acolyte||侍僧}，洞悉+4），一個七十多歲的小個子女性。巴奇法官不易動怒，喜歡分享冗長的教育軼事和寓言。除了她最親密的助手外，沒有人知道法官天生具有心靈能力，可以在無需姿勢或材料成分的情況下施展{@spell detect thoughts||偵測思想}法術。使用一次後，法官必須完成一次短休或長休才能再次施展該法術。感知是她的施法關鍵屬性（法術豁免{@dc 12}）。

english: The magister is disinclined to agree to any request for a private meeting with Fenerus, on the grounds that he's a shady, unrepentant person and a flight risk. The conditions under which she will permit a meeting are as follows:
zh_tw: 大法師不願意同意任何與費內魯斯私下會面的請求，理由是他是一個可疑的、不知悔改的人，且有逃跑的風險。她將允許會面的條件如下：

english: A character who has at least 3 renown in the Harpers or the Lords' Alliance, or a character who belongs to a Waterdavian noble family, makes a good argument and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Charisma (Persuasion) check.
zh_tw: 在豎琴手聯盟或領主聯盟中擁有至少3點聲望的角色，或屬於深水城貴族家族的角色，提出有力論點併成功透過一項{@dc 15}魅力（說服）檢定。

english: A character who is impersonating a noble or an official makes a good argument and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Charisma (Deception) check. If the check fails, Magister Barch sees through the ruse and uses her {@spell detect thoughts} spell to verify that the character is in fact disguised as a noble or an official-a crime that carries a punishment of flogging followed by imprisonment for up to a tenday, plus a fine of up to 500 gp.
zh_tw: 一個冒充貴族或官員的角色進行了有力的辯論，併成功透過了一個 {@dc 15} 的魅力（欺瞞）檢定。如果檢定失敗，巴奇裁判官會識破這個詭計，並使用她的 {@spell detect thoughts||偵測思想} 法術來確認該角色實際上是偽裝成貴族或官員——這一罪行將帶來鞭刑的懲罰，隨後是最多十天的監禁，以及最高500金幣的罰款。

english: A character tells the magister about the hidden cache of dragons and Fenerus's role in finding it.
zh_tw: 一個角色向地方法官透露了隱藏的龍類藏品以及費內魯斯在找到它的過程中的角色。

english: Talking to Fenerus
zh_tw: 與費內魯斯交談

english: Fenerus Stormcastle (N male Tethyrian {@creature bandit captain}) is confined to a cell in {@area H8|1d0}, waiting to stand trial. He is charged with multiple counts of theft (highway banditry) and assaults against Waterdavian citizens. Fenerus knew it was only a matter of time until someone tipped off the City Watch; he suspects that another member of the Blood Hawk Posse gave him up. The timing is unfortunate for him, since he was planning to earn a small fortune by turning over the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} to his Luskanite contact. Now, he plans to use the stone to escape imprisonment and wipe his criminal record clean.
zh_tw: 費內魯斯·風暴堡爾（N男性泰瑟爾人 {@creature bandit captain||匪幫隊長}）被關押在{@area H8|1d0}的牢房裡，等待審判。他被控多次盜竊（公路匪徒）和攻擊瓦特達文市民。費內魯斯知道遲早會有人向城市守衛告密；他懷疑血鷹團夥的另一名成員出賣了他。對他來說，時機很不巧，因為他原本計劃透過將{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}交給他的路斯坎聯絡人來賺取一小筆財富。現在，他計劃利用這塊石頭逃脫監禁，並清除他的犯罪記錄。

english: If the characters can get close enough to speak with him, Fenerus refuses to divulge the stone's location until he is released and granted immunity for his past crimes. He knows that the presiding magister or a Lord of Waterdeep has the authority to give him what he wants.
zh_tw: 如果角色們能夠接近到足以與他交談，費內魯斯拒絕透露石頭的位置，直到他被釋放並被免除過去罪行的責任。他知道主持審判的大法師或深水城的領主有權力給他他想要的。

english: The only condition under which Magister Barch will consider acquiescing to Fenerus's demands is if the characters convince her that such a decision is good for Waterdeep. To accomplish that, they either must use magic to beguile her (which is a crime and likely to result in the caster's arrest once the effect wears off), or they must tell her about the Vault of Dragons and the stolen gold. In either case, she insists on trying something before letting him off the hook: after taking a short rest, she has Fenerus brought to her courtroom and questions him about the stone. Surreptitiously, she uses her {@spell detect thoughts} spell to scan his surface thoughts in an attempt to discern the stone's location. Given that the stone is foremost in Fenerus's mind, Magistrate Barch learns where it is hidden, shares the information with the characters, and returns Fenerus to his cell.
zh_tw: 巴奇法官唯一會考慮屈服於費內魯斯的要求的條件是，角色們說服她這樣的決定對深水城有利。為了達到這一點，他們要麼必須使用魔法來迷惑她（這是犯罪行為，一旦效果消失很可能導致施法者的逮捕），要麼他們必須告訴她關於龍之寶庫和被盜的黃金。無論是哪種情況，她都堅持在讓他脫鉤前嘗試一些東西：在進行一次短休後，她讓費內魯斯被帶到她的法庭，並就石頭的問題對他進行詢問。她偷偷使用她的{@spell detect thoughts||偵測思想}法術掃描他的表面思想，試圖確定石頭的位置。鑑於石頭在費內魯斯的腦海中是最重要的，法官巴奇得知了它的隱藏位置，與角色們分享了資訊，並將費內魯斯送回他的牢房。

english: Where's the Stone?
zh_tw: 石頭在哪裡？

english: Fenerus hid the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} on the top floor of an old tower in the Dock Ward-a tower warded against all forms of magic. If he is freed, he offers to lead the characters to the tower or provides directions so they can find it on their own.
zh_tw: 費內魯斯將{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}藏在了碼頭區一座古老塔樓的頂層——一座對所有形式的魔法都有防護的塔樓。如果他被釋放，他願意帶領角色們前往那座塔樓，或者提供方向讓他們自己找到它。

english: Next Encounter
zh_tw: 下一場遭遇

english: If the characters learn where Fenerus hid the stone and go after it, proceed with encounter 7, "Old Tower."
zh_tw: 如果角色們得知費內魯斯藏石頭的地點並去追尋它，請繼續進行遭遇7，'舊塔'（古老塔樓）。

english: Encounter 9: Cellar Complex
zh_tw: 遭遇9：地窖群

english: Cellars and sewer tunnels intersect to create small dungeons under Waterdeep. These complexes have the following features:
zh_tw: 地窖和下水道隧道在深水城下交錯形成了小型地牢。這些複合體具有以下特點：

english: Ceilings and doorways are 7 feet high.
zh_tw: 天花板和門道高度為7尺。

english: There are no light sources.
zh_tw: 沒有光源。

english: Areas of the Cellar Complex
zh_tw: 地窖複合體的區域

english: The following locations are keyed to map 4.7. The complex has three distinct sections: the sewer tunnels (areas B1-B3), the southern cellars (areas B4-B9), and the northern cellars (areas B10-B11).
zh_tw: 以下地點對應地圖4.7。這個複合體有三個不同的部分：下水道隧道（區域B1-B3），南部地窖（區域B4-B9）和北部地窖（區域B10-B11）。

english: Cellar Complex
zh_tw: 地窖綜合體

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: B1. Sewer Access
zh_tw: B1. 汙水管道入口

english: This chamber has stone steps and a locked, iron-bound wooden door with a sign mounted on it that reads, in Common, "SEWER ACCESS: AUTHORIZED CITY OFFICIALS ONLY." The door to {@area B2|1e3} is locked. The lock can be picked by a character who makes a successful {@dc 17} Dexterity check using thieves' tools, or the door can be forced open with a successful {@dc 20} Strength (Athletics) check. City Watch captains hold keys to sewer access points that correspond with their assigned wards.
zh_tw: 這個房間有石臺階和一扇鎖著的、鐵箍木門，門上掛著一個標牌，用通用語寫著："下水道入口：僅限授權的城市官員進入。" 通向 {@area B2|1e3} 的門是鎖著的。角色可以透過成功進行一次 {@dc 17} 的敏捷（盜賊工具）檢定來撬開鎖，也可以透過成功進行一次 {@dc 20} 的力量（運動）檢定強行開啟門。城市守衛長持有與其負責區域對應的下水道入口鑰匙。

english: B2. Sewers
zh_tw: B2. 汙水管道

english: Fresh sewage flows along a trough that runs parallel to a stone walkway. The sewage is 3 feet deep. Any creature immersed in it for 1 minute must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or become infected with {@disease sewer plague} (see "Diseases" in chapter 8 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|dmg}).
zh_tw: 新鮮的汙水沿著一條與石砌步道平行的水槽流動。汙水深達3尺。任何在其中浸泡1分鐘的生物必須成功透過一次{@dc 11}體質豁免檢定，否則會感染{@disease sewer plague||下水道瘟疫}（參見《{@book 城主指南|dmg}》第8章的"疾病"部分）。

english: Where the tunnel branches, a stone bridge spans the sewage pouring out of an eastern artery. There's no walkway in this arterial passage that leads to areas B3 and B4.
zh_tw: 隧道分岔處，一座石橋橫跨著從東邊動脈流出的汙水。通往B3和B4區域的這條動脈通道中沒有人行道。

english: B3. Secret Doors
zh_tw: B3. 秘密門

english: Secret doors blend with the surrounding stonework on opposite sides of this sewer tunnel. One door opens into {@area B7|1e8}, the other into {@area B10|1f0}. Characters who have a passive Perception score of 15 or higher spot both secret doors as they pass by. Otherwise, finding a secret door requires a search of the wall and a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check. The secret doors are set high enough that opening them doesn't cause sewage to flow into adjoining areas.
zh_tw: 這汙水隧道的兩側，暗門與周圍的石工完美融合。一道門通向{@area B7|1e8}，另一道門通向{@area b10|1f0}。擁有被動感知值15或更高的角色在路過時會發現這兩道暗門。否則，找到暗門需要搜尋牆壁並透過{@dc 15}感知（洞察）檢定。暗門設定得足夠高，開啟它們不會讓汙水流入相鄰區域。

english: B4. Rusty Iron Door
zh_tw: B4. 生鏽的鐵門

english: A door made of rusted iron is set into the wall above a dry, 1-foot-wide stone ledge. The door's lock corroded long ago, and the door squeals loudly on rusty hinges when opened.
zh_tw: 一扇生鏽的鐵門嵌在牆上，上方是一個乾燥的、1尺寬的石板架。門的鎖早已腐蝕，開啟時門在生鏽的鉸鏈上發出刺耳的響聲。

english: B5. Arrow Slits
zh_tw: B5. 箭縫

english: A brick wall with arrow slits was added to this room at some point. The arrow slits are designed to allow archers to fire at intruders who come through the door at {@area B4|1e5}. The arrow slits provide {@quickref Cover||3||three-quarters cover}.
zh_tw: 這個房間在某個時候增加了一堵帶有箭縫的磚牆。這些箭縫設計用來讓弓箭手射擊從門進入的入侵者，參考區域{@area B4|1e5}。箭縫提供了{@quickref Cover||3||掩護}。

english: B6. Storage Room
zh_tw: B6. 儲藏室

english: An unlocked wooden door closes off this empty room.
zh_tw: 一扇未上鎖的木門關閉著這個空房間。

english: B7. Rubble-Filled Cellar
zh_tw: B7. 填滿碎石的地窖

english: A wall has collapsed, creating a larger space out of two smaller rooms. The air is heavy with dust, and the floor is strewn with rubble, refuse, and rat droppings.
zh_tw: 一面牆倒塌了，將兩個較小的房間合併成一個較大的空間。空氣中瀰漫著灰塵，地板上散落著碎石、垃圾和老鼠糞便。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: The secret door to {@area B3|1e4} is easily spotted from this side (no check required).
zh_tw: 從這邊很容易發現到{@area B3|1e4}的秘密門（不需要檢查）。

english: B8. Sunken Cellar
zh_tw: B8. 下沉地窖

english: This sunken cellar has these features:
zh_tw: 這個下沉的地窖有以下特點：

english: An unlocked iron door is set into the east wall.
zh_tw: 一扇未上鎖的鐵門安裝在東牆上。

english: A crumbling stone staircase against the south wall climbs up to a landing, where a wooden door is held shut with a chain and a padlock.
zh_tw: 南牆上有一段破舊的石階，通向一個平臺，平臺上有一扇木門，用鏈子和掛鎖固定住。

english: Iron Door
zh_tw: 鐵門

english: The door opens into a small, empty storage room with hooks hanging from the ceiling.
zh_tw: 門開啟後是一個小而空的儲藏室，天花板上掛著鉤子。

english: Stairs Up
zh_tw: 向上的樓梯

english: The lock can be picked with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check made using thieves' tools, or the door can be forced open with a successful {@dc 20} Strength (Athletics) check. It opens into an alley behind a boarded-up tenement.
zh_tw: 這把鎖可以透過使用盜賊工具進行一次成功的{@dc 15}敏捷檢定來撬開，或者可以透過進行一次成功的{@dc 20}力量（運動）檢定來強行開啟。它通向一棟已被木板封住的公寓後面的小巷。

english: B9. Rat-Infested Cellar
zh_tw: B9. 老鼠氾濫的地窖

english: These rooms are situated below a hostel ({@chance 75|75 percent chance}) or an orphanage ({@chance 25|25 percent chance}). Harmless rats crawl about, minding their own business.
zh_tw: 這些房間位於一個旅館（{@chance 75|75%的機率})或孤兒院（{@chance 25|25%的機率}）的下方。無害的老鼠在四處爬行，自顧自地忙碌著。

english: B9a
zh_tw: b9a

english: Stone stairs climb 10 feet to a wooden door that opens into a street or alley. Crates and barrels stacked at the bottom of the stairs hold edible foodstuffs, but nothing else of value.
zh_tw: 石階上升10尺到達一扇木門，木門通向街道或小巷。樓梯底部堆放的板條箱和木桶裡裝有可食用的食物，但沒有其他有價值的東西。

english: B9b
zh_tw: B9b

english: A plain wooden door opens into a room containing dusty furnishings in storage. The furniture includes a scratched wooden desk, several wobbly chairs, a coat rack, two small tables, and an empty wooden trunk. There's a {@chance 25|25 percent chance} that one piece of furniture (determined randomly) is a {@creature mimic} that usually feeds on rats but never passes up a bigger meal.
zh_tw: 一扇普通的木門通向一個存放著塵封傢俱的房間。傢俱包括一張有劃痕的木桌、幾把搖晃的椅子、一個衣帽架、兩張小桌子和一個空的木箱。有{@chance 25|25%的機率}其中一件傢俱（隨機確定）是一個{@creature mimic||擬身怪}，它通常以老鼠為食，但絕不會錯過更大的食物。

english: Mimic Present
zh_tw: 存在擬態生物

english: result
zh_tw: 結果

english: A {@creature Mimic} is present
zh_tw: 存在一個{@creature Mimic||擬身怪}

english: There's nothing here
zh_tw: 這裡什麼也沒有

english: B10. Old Tavern Cellar
zh_tw: B10. 舊酒館地窖

english: This spacious, empty cellar has the following features:
zh_tw: 這個寬敞的空地窖有以下特點：

english: Stone pillars and arches support the ceiling.
zh_tw: 石柱和拱門支撐著天花板。

english: Mismatched stonework on either side of a half-demolished wall indicates that this area was once two separate chambers.
zh_tw: 半倒塌牆壁兩側不匹配的石工表明，這個區域曾經是兩個獨立的房間。

english: Stone stairs climb to a bricked-up doorway. (The door once led to an alley behind an old tavern.)
zh_tw: 石階通往一個被磚砌封堵的門道。（這扇門曾經通向一個老酒館後面的小巷。）

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: The secret door to {@area B3|1e4} is easily spotted from this side (no check required).
zh_tw: 從這邊很容易發現到{@area B3|1e4}的秘密門（不需要檢查）。

english: B11. Back Cellars
zh_tw: B11. 後地窖

english: These rooms are extensions of {@area B10|1f0}.
zh_tw: 這些房間是{@area b10|1f0}的延伸。

english: B11a
zh_tw: B11a

english: This room used to be a wine cellar. Its walls are lined with piles of rotting wood (storage racks) and broken bottles.
zh_tw: 這個房間過去是個酒窖。牆壁上排列著腐爛的木頭堆（儲存架）和破碎的瓶子。

english: B11b
zh_tw: B11b

english: Once a cold storage room and root cellar, this empty chamber is choked with dust and cobwebs.
zh_tw: 這個曾經用作冷藏室和根菜儲藏室的空房間，現在充滿了灰塵和蛛網。

english: Cellar Complex: Spring
zh_tw: 地窖綜合體：春季

english: The characters have learned that a halfling necromancer named {@creature Losser Mirklav|wdh} took the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}. He lives in a cellar complex under a powdered wig shop in the Trades Ward. The shop, Dandymops, is closed and locked with an iron gate. The lock can be picked by a character who makes a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check using thieves' tools, or the gate can be forced open with a successful {@dc 25} Strength (Athletics) check. Since the shop is in a highly visible location, an attempt to break into it is 75 percent likely to be noticed by someone who alerts the City Watch. Two {@creature veteran||veterans} of the City Watch arrive in {@dice 1d10} minutes to investigate the shop and talk to witnesses.
zh_tw: 角色們得知一個名叫{@creature Losser Mirklav|wdh|洛瑟·米爾克拉夫}的半身人死靈師拿走了{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}。他住在商業區一家假髮店下方的地窖建築群中。這家名為丹迪莫普斯的店鋪已關閉，並用鐵門鎖住。一個角色若成功使用盜賊工具進行{@dc 15}敏捷檢定，或成功進行{@dc 25}力量（運動）檢定，即可撬開鎖或強行開啟門。由於店鋪位於顯眼位置，闖入的嘗試有75%的機率被注意到，相關人士會通知城市守衛。兩名{@creature veteran||老兵}城市守衛會在{@dice 1d10}分鐘內抵達調查店鋪並與目擊者交談。

english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s {@creature gazer|VGM} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) doesn't follow characters into the shop. It remains outside and waits for Xanathar Guild forces to arrive. If the characters destroyed the gazer in an earlier encounter, another one arrives with the Xanathar Guild forces.
zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的{@creature gazer|VGM|凝視者眼魔}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）不會跟隨角色進入商店。它留在外部，等待姍娜薩公會的力量到來。如果角色們在早期遭遇中摧毀了凝視者眼魔，另一個凝視者眼魔會隨著姍娜薩公會的力量到來。

english: Dungeon Entrance
zh_tw: 地牢入口

english: {@area B1|1e2|u} is the basement of the wig shop and the characters' point of entry into the cellar complex.
zh_tw: {@area B1|1e2|u}是假髮店的地下室，也是角色們進入地窖綜合體的入口點。

english: Misty Sewers
zh_tw: 霧氣濛濛的下水道

english: The dense fog from outside settles in the sewers, and areas B2, B3, and B4 are {@quickref Vision and Light||2||lightly obscured}.
zh_tw: 來自外界的濃霧在下水道中沉降，區域B2、B3和B4處於{@quickref Vision and Light||2||輕度遮蔽}狀態。

english: Necromancer
zh_tw: 死靈師

english: {@creature Losser Mirklav|wdh} is a lightfoot halfling {@creature mage}, with these changes:
zh_tw: {@creature Losser Mirklav|wdh|洛瑟·米爾克拉夫} 是一個輕足半身人{@creature mage||魔法師}，有以下變化：

english: He is chaotic evil and has 31 ({@dice 9d6}) hit points.
zh_tw: 他是混亂邪惡的，擁有31點（{@dice 9d6}）生命值。

english: He has these racial traits: He is Small, and his walking speed is 25 feet. He can move through the space of a Medium or larger creature. He has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition frightened}. He speaks Common and Halfling.
zh_tw: 他擁有以下種族特性：他是小型生物，行走速度為25尺。他可以穿過中型或更大生物的空間。他在對{@condition frightened||恐懼}狀態的豁免檢定上有優勢。他說通用語和半身人語。

english: He has the {@spell animate dead} and {@spell blight} spells prepared, instead of {@spell counterspell} and {@spell greater invisibility}. All his spell slots are currently expended.
zh_tw: 他準備了{@spell animate dead||活化死屍}和{@spell blight||枯萎術}法術，而不是{@spell counterspell||法術反制}和{@spell greater invisibility||高等隱形術}。他所有的法術位目前都已用盡。

english: Losser carries a spellbook bound in stitched flesh that contains all his prepared spells. He also has a key to the padlocked door in {@area B8|1ea} and {@dice 4d10} gp in a pouch made of elf skin and cinched with a rope made of woven dwarf hair.
zh_tw: 洛瑟攜帶著一本用縫製的肉體裝訂的法術書，其中包含了他所有準備好的法術。他還有一把開鎖的鑰匙，用於{@area B8|1ea}的掛鎖門，以及一個由精靈皮膚製成的袋子裡裝有{@dice 4d10}金幣，袋子用由編織的矮人頭髮製成的繩子紮緊。

english: Losser has made several changes to the complex:
zh_tw: 洛瑟對複合體進行了許多改動：

english: {@area B6|1e7|u} contains three beds-two sized for Losser's human apprentices and a smaller bed sized for him.
zh_tw: {@area B6|1e7|u}包含三張床鋪——兩張適合洛瑟的人類學徒的大小，還有一張更小的床鋪適合他。

english: {@area B10|1f0|u} contains twelve {@creature skeleton||skeletons} that attack anyone other than Losser and his apprentices.
zh_tw: {@area b10|1f0|u} 包含十二個{@creature skeleton||骷髏}，它們會攻擊除了洛瑟和他的學徒之外的任何人。

english: {@area B11|1f2|u} contains piles of human bones stolen from the City of the Dead. Losser hasn't gotten around to animating them yet.
zh_tw: {@area B11|1f2|u}包含了從亡者之城偷來的人類骨骼堆。洛瑟還沒有來得及將它們活化。

english: Where's the Stone?
zh_tw: 石頭在哪裡？

english: Before the characters reach Losser, kenku members of the Xanathar Guild break down the door leading into the cellar complex via {@area B8|1ea} and confront the necromancer. The characters find Losser cowering in one corner of {@area B7|1e8}. Two {@creature skeleton||skeletons} stand between him and three {@creature kenku}. The kenku aim to kill the halfling. Lying on the floor around them are four dead kenku and the remains of two destroyed (and previously animated) skeletons.
zh_tw: 在角色們到達洛瑟之前，姍娜薩公會的天狗成員透過{@area B8|1ea}破門而入，進入地窖複合體，並面對死靈師。角色們發現洛瑟蜷縮在{@area B7|1e8}的一個角落裡。兩個{@creature skeleton||骷髏}站在他和三個{@creature kenku||天狗}之間。天狗打算殺死這個半身人。在他們周圍的地板上躺著四隻死去的天狗和兩個被摧毀（並且之前被復活）的骷髏的殘骸。

english: If the characters demand the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, Losser tells them the truth: he surrendered it to the kenku, two of which fled south with it. In {@area B8|1ea}, the characters see one {@creature kenku} standing over the bodies of Losser's murdered human apprentices, Retchyn and Kreela. This kenku is joined by {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s {@creature gazer|VGM} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}). The kenku and the gazer try to hold off the characters for as long as possible, buying time for a second kenku to flee with the Stone of Golorr.
zh_tw: 如果角色們要求得到{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，洛瑟會告訴他們真相：他已經把它交給了天狗，其中兩個帶著它向南逃走了。在{@area B8|1ea}，角色們看到一隻{@creature kenku||天狗}站在洛瑟被謀殺的人類學徒瑞欽和克莉拉的屍體上。這隻天狗被{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的{@creature gazer|VGM|凝視者眼魔}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）加入。天狗和凝視者試圖儘可能長時間地拖延角色，為第二個天狗帶著格洛爾之石逃跑爭取時間。

english: If the characters pursue the stone and leave Losser alive, he eventually slips away and retreats to {@area B11|1f2}.
zh_tw: 如果角色們追蹤石頭並留下洛瑟的性命，他最終會悄悄溜走並撤退到{@area B11|1f2}。

english: Next Encounter
zh_tw: 下一場遭遇

english: Once the characters defeat {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s forces in the cellar, they can chase after the fleeing kenku that has the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} in its clutches. Proceed with encounter 3, "Street Chase."
zh_tw: 一旦角色們在地窖中擊敗了{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的部隊，他們可以追趕逃走的天狗，它緊抓著{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}。繼續進行遭遇3，"街頭追逐"（街頭追逐）。

english: Cellar Complex: Summer
zh_tw: 地窖綜合體：夏季

english: The characters are hot on the trail of three street urchins as the children scamper into the sewers under the Dock Ward.
zh_tw: 角色們緊追著三個街頭頑童，孩子們逃進了碼頭區下面的下水道。

english: Sickening Smell
zh_tw: 令人作嘔的氣味

english: The summer heat makes the sewer smell worse than usual, and characters become {@condition poisoned} by the stench unless they cover their noses with perfumed scarves. The effect lasts until they leave the sewers. The street urchins and other creatures that live in the sewers are accustomed to the smell and aren't {@condition poisoned} in this way.
zh_tw: 夏天的高溫使下水道的氣味比平時更糟，角色們如果不用香水手帕捂住鼻子，就會變得{@condition poisoned||中毒}。這種效果持續到他們離開下水道。街頭頑童和其他生活在下水道的生物已經習慣了這種氣味，不會以這種方式變得{@condition poisoned||中毒}。

english: Search for the Urchins
zh_tw: 搜尋小乞丐

english: The characters approach the cellar complex from the east, eventually coming upon an iron door in the side of the sewer tunnel ({@area B4|1e5}).
zh_tw: 角色們從東邊接近地窖綜合體，最終在下水道隧道的一側發現了一扇鐵門（{@area B4|1e5}）。

english: The street urchins took the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} to {@area B7|1e8} (which serves as their clubhouse), entering the room through a secret door ({@area B3|1e4}). The eldest child, {@creature Nat|WDH}, attuned to the stone, but contact with the aboleth so terrified her that she dropped it, screamed, and ran away. The boys were panicked by her reaction and fled as well, leaving the stone in {@area B7|1e8}. If the characters open the door at {@area B4|1e5}, they startle the children on the other side, causing them to scream at the top of their lungs.
zh_tw: 街頭小乞丐們把{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}帶到了{@area B7|1e8}（作為他們的俱樂部），透過一個秘密門({@area B3|1e4})進入房間。最年長的孩子，{@creature Nat|WDH|納特}，與石頭產生了共鳴，但是與魚人的接觸如此恐怖，以至於她丟下了它，尖叫著逃跑了。其他男孩被她的反應嚇到了，也逃跑了，把石頭留在了{@area B7|1e8}。如果角色們開啟了{@area B4|1e5}的門，他們會驚嚇到另一邊的孩子們，導致他們用最大的聲音尖叫。

english: Communicating through the other children, {@creature Nat|WDH} tells the characters where she dropped the stone and warns them that it's "alive." Neither she nor the boys are eager to see it again.
zh_tw: 透過其他孩子傳達，{@creature Nat|WDH|納特}告訴角色們她把石頭丟在了哪裡，並警告他們它'活著'。她和男孩們都不想再見到它。

english: Chair Today, Gone Tomorrow
zh_tw: 椅子今天在，明天就不見了

english: If the characters head to {@area B7|1e8}, they see the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} underneath a wooden rocking chair. If the street urchins are present, one of them asks, "Where'd that rocking chair come from?"
zh_tw: 如果角色們前往{@area B7|1e8}，他們會看到{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}在一把木製搖椅下面。如果街頭頑童在場，其中一個會問："那把搖椅是從哪裡來的？"

english: The rocking chair is the {@creature mimic} from {@area B9b|1ef}. It heard the urchins' screams and investigated, hoping to snare an easy meal. It attacks anyone who harms it or reaches for the stone.
zh_tw: 搖椅是來自{@area B9b|1ef}的{@creature mimic||擬身怪}。它聽到了頑童們的尖叫聲並進行了調查，希望捕捉到一頓容易的餐食。它會攻擊任何傷害它或伸手去拿石頭的人。

english: Next Encounter
zh_tw: 下一場遭遇

english: Once the characters obtain the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, they can leave the cellar complex. Proceed with encounter 8, "Courthouse."
zh_tw: 一旦角色們獲得了{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，他們就可以離開地窖複合體。繼續進行遭遇8，"法院"（法院）。

english: Cellar Complex: Autumn
zh_tw: 地窖複合體：秋季

english: The characters have been encouraged to explore a Xanathar Guild hideout under the Southern Ward. They enter the location through {@area B1|1e2}. The Xanathar Guild Roster table provides a summary of the forces stationed throughout the complex. The sections that follow describe some of the hideout's features.
zh_tw: 角色們被鼓勵去探索位於南區的姍娜薩公會藏身之地。他們透過{@area B1|1e2}進入該地點。姍娜薩公會名冊表提供了整個建築群中駐紮力量的概要。接下來的部分描述了藏身地的一些特點。

english: Xanathar Guild Roster
zh_tw: 姍娜薩公會名冊

english: Area
zh_tw: 區域

english: Creature(s)
zh_tw: 生物

english: B5
zh_tw: B5

english: 2 {@creature goblin||goblins} behind arrow slits
zh_tw: 2個{@creature goblin||地精}在箭縫後面

english: B6
zh_tw: B6

english: 1 {@creature Half-Ogre (Ogrillon)||half-ogre} that became {@condition poisoned} after drinking six casks of cheap wine
zh_tw: 1個{@creature Half-Ogre (Ogrillon)||半食人魔}在喝了六桶廉價葡萄酒後變得{@condition poisoned||中毒}

english: B7
zh_tw: B7

english: 3 {@creature duergar} and 1 {@creature gazer|vgm} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) standing guard while {@creature Thorvin Twinbeard|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) works on a mechanical beholder (see "Mechanical Beholder" below)
zh_tw: 3名{@creature duergar||灰矮人}和1名{@creature gazer|vgm|凝視者眼魔}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）站崗，而{@creature Thorvin Twinbeard|wdh|索文·雙須}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）正在研究一個機械眼魔（見下文的"機械眼魔"）

english: B8
zh_tw: B8

english: Korgstrod Uxgulm, the {@creature duergar} leader (40 hit points), seated in a stone chair and attended by 3 {@creature kobold||kobolds} (see "Stone of Deception" below)
zh_tw: 科爾格斯特羅德·烏克斯古爾姆，{@creature duergar||灰矮人}首領（40生命值），坐在石椅上，由3個{@creature kobold||狗頭人}（見下文的"欺瞞之石"）侍候

english: 7 {@creature troglodyte||troglodytes} lurking in the shadows
zh_tw: 7個{@creature troglodyte||穴蜥人}潛伏在陰影中

english: B11a
zh_tw: B11a

english: 1 {@creature gibbering mouther} guarding a treasure chest in {@area B11b|1f4} (see "Treasure Chest" below)
zh_tw: 1個{@creature gibbering mouther||囈語之口}在{@area B11b|1f4}守護著一個寶箱（見下文的"寶箱"）

english: Mechanical Beholder
zh_tw: 機械眼魔

english: A mechanical beholder built for the Day of Wonders parade lies on its side in {@area B7|1e8}. {@creature Xanathar|WDH} wants this mechanical version of itself to hover over the crowd, reminding the Lords of Waterdeep of the beholder's superiority, but no one can figure out how to make it fly. A character can use an action to try to activate the machine, doing so with a successful {@dc 10} Intelligence check. The activated beholder shoots dazzling lights from its eyestalks for 1 minute and then stops working.
zh_tw: 一個為奇蹟日遊行而建造的機械眼魔側臥在{@area B7|1e8}。{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}希望這個機械版本的自己能在人群上空盤旋，提醒深水城的領主們眼魔的優越性，但沒人知道如何讓它飛起來。角色可以用一個動作嘗試啟用這個機器，成功透過{@dc 10}智力檢定即可啟用。被啟用的眼魔會從它的眼柄中射出炫目的光芒，持續1分鐘，然後停止工作。

english: If combat breaks out in the cellar complex, {@creature Thorvin Twinbeard|wdh} flees up the stairs in {@area B8|1ea} and uses a key to unlock the door leading outside. He has no loyalty to the other creatures stationed here.
zh_tw: 如果在地窖綜合體中爆發戰鬥，{@creature Thorvin Twinbeard|wdh|索文·雙須}會逃向{@area B8|1ea}的樓梯，並使用一把鑰匙開啟通往外面的門。他對這裡駐紮的其他生物沒有忠誠度。

english: Stone of Deception
zh_tw: 欺騙之石

english: Korgstrod Uxgulm, the duergar leader, has what he believes to be the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}. He found it during a search of Fenerus's house in the Trades Ward. This stone is a clever imitation. It's gray and ovoid with streaks of black, but has no magical powers. Korgstrod has been unable to attune to it and assumes he's unworthy of it, not that the stone is fake.
zh_tw: 科爾格斯特羅德·烏克斯古爾姆，這位灰矮人領袖，擁有他認為是{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}的東西。他在搜查商業區費內魯斯的房子時發現了它。這塊石頭是一個巧妙的仿製品。它是灰色的卵形，帶有黑色的條紋，但沒有魔法力量。科爾格斯特羅德一直無法與它協調，他認為自己不配擁有它，而不是認為這塊石頭是假的。

english: Korgstrod plans to deliver the stone to {@creature Xanathar|WDH} in due time and won't willingly part with it before then. He uses a whip to flog his kobold lackeys and keep them in line. The cowardly kobolds flee into the sewers if Korgstrod is attacked and cower in his presence otherwise.
zh_tw: 科爾格斯特羅德計劃在適當的時候將石頭交給{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}，在那之前他不會自願放棄它。他使用鞭子抽打他的狗頭人手下，以保持他們的紀律。如果科爾格斯特羅德受到攻擊，這些膽怯的狗頭人會逃入下水道，否則他們會在他的面前畏縮。

english: Treasure Chest
zh_tw: 寶箱

english: An old, locked chest in the back of {@area B11b|1f4} can be opened by someone who makes a successful {@dc 13} Dexterity check using thieves' tools. The chest contains 277 cp, 135 sp, a spherical gold beholder pendant with tiny gems for eyes (worth 250 gp), and a {@item spell scroll} of {@spell darkvision}.
zh_tw: 在{@area B11b|1f4}後面的一個古老且上鎖的箱子，可以透過成功進行{@dc 13}的敏捷檢定使用盜賊工具開啟。箱子裡有277銅幣、135銀幣、一個帶有小寶石眼睛的球形金質觀察者吊墜（價值250金幣）和一張{@item spell scroll||法術卷軸}的{@spell darkvision||黑暗視覺}。

english: Next Encounter
zh_tw: 下一場遭遇

english: Whether they find the fake stone or not, characters have little recourse but to consult with "Laeral" at the Seven Masks Theater in the Dock Ward. If they go there, proceed with encounter 6, "Theater."
zh_tw: 無論他們是否找到了假石頭，角色們幾乎沒有其他選擇，只能諮詢碼頭區的七面具劇院中的"萊拉"。如果他們去那裡，請繼續進行遭遇6，"劇院."

english: Encounter 10: Converted Windmill
zh_tw: 遭遇10: 改造的風車

english: This crumbling, two-story stone building was a windmill long before the city rose up around it. The following features apply unless an area description or encounter states otherwise:
zh_tw: 這座破舊的兩層石頭建築早在城市圍繞它建立之前就曾是一個風車。除非某個區域描述或遭遇有其他說明，否則以下特點適用：

english: Rooms have 15-foot-high ceilings, with 10-foot-high passages and 7-foot-high doorways connecting them.
zh_tw: 房間的天花板高15尺，有10尺高的通道和7尺高的門道連線它們。

english: Doors are wooden, closed, and unlocked.
zh_tw: 門是木製的，關閉且未上鎖。

english: The walls are covered with graffiti, and the stone floors are strewn with garbage and detritus. Windows are empty lead frames without glass.
zh_tw: 牆壁上滿是塗鴉，石板地面上散落著垃圾和殘骸。窗戶是空的鉛製框架，沒有玻璃。

english: There are no light sources.
zh_tw: 沒有光源。

english: Areas of the Converted Windmill
zh_tw: 改造風車區域

english: The following locations are keyed to map 4.8.
zh_tw: 以下地點對應於地圖4.8上的關鍵點。

english: Windmill
zh_tw: 風車

english: Windmill, Ground Floor (Player Version)
zh_tw: 風車，一樓（玩家版本）

english: W1. Stone Staircase
zh_tw: W1. 石質樓梯

english: A curved set of stone stairs climbs 20 feet to the upper level. The stairs are covered with bird droppings, broken roof shingles, mud, and mold.
zh_tw: 一組彎曲的石階上升20尺到達上層。這些臺階上覆蓋著鳥糞、破碎的屋頂瓦片、泥土和黴菌。

english: W2. Squatters
zh_tw: W2. 擅自佔地者

english: During the spring, summer, and winter, each of these rooms is home to {@dice 1d6 + 1} squatters ({@creature commoner||commoners}) who have made dens for themselves out of old furnishings and things salvaged from garbage piles. The squatters aren't looking for trouble.
zh_tw: 在春季、夏季和冬季，這些房間中的每一個都是{@dice 1d6 + 1}名擅自佔用者（{@creature commoner||平民}）的家，他們用舊傢俱和從垃圾堆中撿來的東西為自己建造了巢穴。這些擅自佔用者並不尋求麻煩。

english: For some food or coin, a squatter can direct or lead characters to the locked apartment on the upper level ({@area W7|20d}) and describe the apartment's inhabitants. A character can also secure a squatter's cooperation with a successful {@dc 10} Charisma (Intimidation) check.
zh_tw: 為了食物或硬幣，一個占房者可以引導或帶領角色們前往上層被鎖的公寓（{@area W7|20d}），並描述公寓的居住者。角色也可以透過一次成功的{@dc 10}魅力（威嚇）檢定來確保占房者的合作。

english: W3. Privy
zh_tw: W3. 廁所

english: Beyond the door is nothing more than a hole in the floor from which rises a terrible stench.
zh_tw: 門後不過是地板上的一個洞，從洞中升起一股可怕的惡臭。

english: W4. Weak Ceiling/Floor
zh_tw: W4. 脆弱的天花板/地板

english: Area {@b W4a} is directly underneath area {@b W4b}. The floor of the upper chamber collapses under the weight of the first Small or larger creature to walk across it. A character who has the Stonecunning trait or proficiency with mason's tools can tell that the floor is unsafe to walk on.
zh_tw: 區域{@b W4a}直接位於區域{@b W4b}的正下方。上層房間的地板會在第一個小型或更大生物走過時因重量而坍塌。擁有石工天賦或熟練使用石匠工具的角色可以判斷地板不安全，不能行走。

english: Any creature standing on the floor of area W4b when it collapses falls 20 feet, landing in area W4a. Any creature in area W4a when the ceiling falls in must make a {@dc 11} Dexterity saving throw, taking 4 ({@dice 1d8}) bludgeoning damage from falling debris on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
zh_tw: 當區域W4b的地板坍塌時，站在該區域的任何生物會墜落20尺，落在區域W4a中。當區域W4a的天花板坍塌時，該區域內的任何生物必須進行一次{@dc 11}敏捷豁免，失敗則受到4點（{@dice 1d8}）鈍擊傷害，成功則承受一半傷害。

english: W5. Ancient Millstone
zh_tw: W5. 古老的磨石

english: An ancient millstone lies under a jumble of debris that includes machinery and pieces of the collapsed roof. Dust and cobwebs cover everything.
zh_tw: 一塊古老的磨石躺在包括機械和倒塌屋頂碎片的雜物堆下。灰塵和蛛網覆蓋了一切。

english: W6. Pigeon Roosts
zh_tw: W6. 鴿子棲息地

english: Large sections of the roof have caved in above these rooms, leaving holes through which birds and precipitation can enter. The floors are littered with broken shingles, bird droppings, wrecked furnishings, and other detritus, and scores of pigeons roost in the moldy rafters.
zh_tw: 這些房間的大部分屋頂已經坍塌，留下了鳥和降水可以進入的洞。地板上散落著破碎的瓦片、鳥糞、損壞的傢俱和其他碎片，成群的鴿子棲息在發黴的椽子上。

english: W7. Secure Apartment
zh_tw: W7. 安全公寓

english: The north door to this room has been fitted with a shiny new lock that can be picked with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check using thieves' tools. The door can also be unlocked from inside the room, or forced open with a successful {@dc 20} Strength (Athletics) check.
zh_tw: 這個房間的北門安裝了一把閃亮的新鎖，可以透過使用盜賊工具併成功透過 {@dc 15} 敏捷檢定來撬開。這扇門也可以從房間內部解鎖，或者透過成功進行 {@dc 20} 力量（運動）檢定強行開啟。

english: This apartment is in good repair and contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這間公寓維護良好，包含以下特點：

english: A wood-framed, king-sized bed with clean mattresses stands against one wall. (Next to the bed, an unlocked door in the west wall leads to {@area W8|20e}.)
zh_tw: 一張帶有乾淨床墊的木製大號床靠在一面牆上。（床邊，西牆上一扇未上鎖的門通向{@area W8|20e}。）

english: The window was recently repaired and quietly swings open on oiled iron hinges.
zh_tw: 這扇窗戶最近被修理過，可以在塗油的鐵鉸鏈上安靜地開啟。

english: Across from the window, against the wall, stands a wooden armoire.
zh_tw: 在窗戶對面，靠牆處，放著一個木製衣櫃。

english: The armoire holds four clean sets of clothes, two gray cloaks, a heavy crossbow, and a wooden case containing twenty crossbow bolts.
zh_tw: 衣櫃裡有四套乾淨的衣服，兩件灰色斗篷，一把重型十字弓，以及一個裝有二十支十字弓弩箭的木盒。

english: W8. Back Room
zh_tw: W8. 後室

english: The section of conical roof directly above this chamber has mostly collapsed, filling the room with rubble. There's just enough space to open the door.
zh_tw: 這個房間正上方的圓錐形屋頂部分大部分已經坍塌，房間裡充滿了碎石。門剛好有足夠的空間可以開啟。

english: Converted Windmill: Spring
zh_tw: 改造風車：春季

english: The key that the characters found in the mausoleum leads them to an old windmill in the Southern Ward. Volkarr Kibbens and Urlaster Ghann (NE male Illuskan human {@creature commoner||commoners}) are hiding out in a secure apartment on the upper floor ({@area W7|20d}). In combat, they wield shovels that deal damage as clubs. Each carries {@dice 3d6} gp in a pouch.
zh_tw: 角色們在陵墓中發現的鑰匙引導他們來到南區的一箇舊風車。沃爾卡·基本斯和烏拉斯特·甘恩（NE男性伊路斯坎人類{@creature commoner||平民}）藏在上層的一個安全公寓裡（{@area W7|20d}）。在戰鬥中，他們使用鐵鍬作為棍棒造成傷害。每個人身上都攜帶著{@dice 3d6}金幣的袋子。

english: Volkarr and Urlaster were recently hired by {@creature Losser Mirklav|wdh}, a halfling necromancer, to help him break into mausoleums in the City of the Dead. They undertook the job because the pay was good, but they have no loyalty to the necromancer. If the characters confront them, Volkarr and Urlaster attack, but they surrender quickly if overwhelmed and share the following information in exchange for their lives and freedom:
zh_tw: 沃爾卡和烏拉斯特最近被半身人死靈師{@creature Losser Mirklav|wdh|洛瑟·米爾克拉夫}僱傭，幫助他闖入亡者之城的陵墓。他們接受這份工作是因為報酬豐厚，但他們對死靈師沒有任何忠誠。如果角色們面對他們，沃爾卡和烏拉斯特會攻擊，但如果被壓倒性地擊敗，他們會迅速投降，並分享以下資訊以換取他們的生命和自由：

english: {@creature Losser Mirklav|wdh} and his two human apprentices, Retchyn and Kreela, live in a cellar complex under the Trades Ward. The way to their lair is through Retchyn's powdered wig shop, which is called Dandymops.
zh_tw: {@creature Losser Mirklav|wdh|洛瑟·米爾克拉夫}和他的兩名人類學徒，瑞欽和克莉拉，住在商業區下方的地窖綜合體中。通往他們巢穴的路是透過瑞欽的假髮店，這家店叫做丹迪莫普斯。

english: Losser is stealing bones from the City of the Dead to create an army of animated skeletons. (Neither Volkarr nor Urlaster knows why.)
zh_tw: 洛瑟正在從亡者之城偷取骨頭，以建立一支動畫骷髏軍隊。（沃爾卡和烏拉斯特都不知道為什麼。）

english: In the Garloth mausoleum, Losser killed a rat and took the small stone it was carrying. The rat vanished when it died, and Losser thinks the stone is magical.
zh_tw: 在加洛斯陵墓中，洛瑟殺死了一隻老鼠並拿走了它攜帶的小石頭。老鼠死後消失了，洛瑟認為那塊石頭是魔法的。

english: Next Encounter
zh_tw: 下一場遭遇

english: Once the characters set out to find the halfling necromancer, proceed with encounter 9, "Cellar Complex."
zh_tw: 一旦角色們開始尋找半精靈死靈師，請繼續進行遭遇9，'地窖複合體'。

english: Converted Windmill: Summer
zh_tw: 改造風車：夏季

english: The characters head to a decrepit building in the Southern Ward that used to be a windmill. Therein, they expect to find the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} in the clutches of two treacherous {@creature cult fanatic||cult fanatics} named Arn Xalrondar (LE male Tethyrian human) and Seffia Naelryke (LE female Tethyrian human).
zh_tw: 角色們前往位於南區的一座破舊的建築，那裡曾經是一個風車。他們預計會在那裡找到兩個名為阿恩·薩爾隆達爾（LE男性泰瑟爾人人類）和瑟菲亞·奈爾瑞克（LE女性泰瑟爾人人類）的奸詐{@creature cult fanatic||邪教狂信者}手中的{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}。

english: Cult Fanatics
zh_tw: 邪教狂信者

english: Arn and Seffia are waiting in {@area W7|20d}, which they use as an apartment. They keep the door to the apartment locked at all times. They have cleared {@area W8|20e} of debris and painted a pentagram in blood on the floor. At the points of the pentagram are five black globs of wax-the remains of burned candles.
zh_tw: 阿恩和瑟菲亞在{@area W7|20d}等候，他們將其用作公寓。他們總是將公寓的門鎖上。他們已經清理了{@area W8|20e}的碎片，並在地板上用血畫了一個五角星。在五角星的每個角上，有五個黑色的蠟塊——這是燃燒過的蠟燭的殘餘。

english: Lord Cassalanter sent Arn and Seffia on a mission to retrieve the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} from his family's mausoleum. He also gave them secret orders to dispose of three other members of the cult whom he couldn't trust to keep quiet about the stone. Arn and Seffia would be horrified to learn that they failed in so simple a task; they try to correct their mistake by killing Vaelle Lurval if she's with the party (see "Mausoleum: Summer").
zh_tw: 卡薩蘭特領主派遣阿恩和瑟菲亞執行任務，從他家的陵墓中取回{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}。他還秘密命令他們除掉另外三名他不信任的邪教成員，以防他們洩露關於石頭的秘密。如果阿恩和瑟菲亞知道他們在如此簡單的任務中失敗了，他們會感到非常震驚；他們試圖透過殺死瓦艾爾·勒瓦爾（如果她在隊伍中，見"陵墓：夏季"）來糾正他們的錯誤。

english: Devils' Arrival
zh_tw: 魔鬼降臨

english: As characters try to break into the cult fanatics' apartment, three {@creature spined devil||spined devils} arrive. The devils fly to the tower, knock on the apartment window, and are let inside by Seffia, whereupon Arn gives one of them the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}. When the characters enter, they see the devils fly off with the stone. The cult fanatics do everything in their power to enable the devils to escape.
zh_tw: 當角色們試圖闖入邪教狂信者的公寓時，三個{@creature spined devil||棘魔}到達了。魔鬼們飛到塔樓，敲了敲公寓的窗戶，瑟菲亞讓他們進來，然後阿恩給了他們其中一人{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}。當角色們進入時，他們看到魔鬼們帶著石頭飛走了。邪教狂信者盡他們所能地幫助魔鬼逃脫。

english: Next Encounter
zh_tw: 下一場遭遇

english: If the characters deal with the cult fanatics, they can chase after the fleeing spined devils by running across rooftops. Proceed with encounter 5, "Rooftop Chase."
zh_tw: 如果角色們處理了邪教狂信者，他們可以透過在屋頂上奔跑來追趕逃跑的棘魔。繼續進行遭遇5，"屋頂追逐。"

english: Converted Windmill: Autumn
zh_tw: 改造風車：秋季

english: This old stone windmill was converted into a residence over a century ago and has fallen into disrepair. An eccentric Waterdavian artist lives here, and she hasn't been the same since her true love abandoned her. There are no squatters in the residence.
zh_tw: 這座古老的石制風車在一個多世紀前被改造成了住宅，並已年久失修。一位古怪的瓦特達維安藝術家住在這裡，自從她的真愛拋棄了她之後，她就不再是從前的她了。住宅裡沒有擅自佔地者。

english: The outside doors are always locked. A lock can be picked with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check by a character using thieves' tools, or a door can be smashed open with a successful {@dc 15} Strength (Athletics) check. Any attempt to break into the tower is 75 percent likely to be seen or heard by one of {@creature Kalain|wdh}'s neighbors. Eight {@creature veteran||veterans} of the City Watch arrive 10 minutes later to investigate the intrusion.
zh_tw: 外部門總是鎖著的。一個使用盜賊工具的角色可以透過成功的 {@dc 15} 敏捷檢定來撬開鎖，或者透過成功的 {@dc 15} 力量（運動）檢定將門砸開。任何試圖闖入塔樓的行為都有75%的機率被{@creature Kalain|wdh|卡萊恩}的鄰居看到或聽到。十分鐘後，八名{@creature veteran||老兵}城市守衛會趕到現場調查入侵事件。

english: Let Me Paint You a Picture
zh_tw: 讓我為你畫一幅畫

english: {@creature Kalain|wdh}, a famous Waterdavian painter, was commissioned to paint a portrait of Lord Dagult Neverember, then Waterdeep's Open Lord, in 1475 DR. Her meeting with Neverember marked the beginning of a torrid love affair that lasted over a year. One of the many gifts he lavished on her was an estate in the Sea Ward.
zh_tw: {@creature Kalain|wdh|卡萊恩}，一位著名的深水城畫家，在1475 DR年被委託為當時深水城的公開領主達格魯特·無燼領主畫一幅肖像。她與無燼的會面標誌著一段持續了一年多的熱烈愛情故事的開始。他慷慨贈送給她的眾多禮物之一是位於海區的一處房產。

english: Their relationship faltered as Dagult's visits to Neverwinter became more frequent and extended. He made promises to {@creature Kalain|WDH} that he failed to keep, and when she raised the subject of faithful commitment, he treated her poorly, for his true love was Neverwinter. {@creature Kalain|WDH} became enraged after Dagult's rejection and turned to painting monsters that, in her mind, represented him. Her power to harness the Weave clings to the fabric of her works, giving her the ability to bring these monsters to life on command.
zh_tw: 隨著達格魯特對無冬城的訪問變得更加頻繁和延長，他們的關係開始動搖。他向{@creature Kalain|WDH|卡萊恩}做出了他未能兌現的承諾，當她提出忠誠承諾的話題時，他對她不好，因為他的真愛是無冬城。在達格魯特的拒絕之後，{@creature Kalain|WDH|卡萊恩}變得憤怒，並開始畫在她心目中代表他的怪物。她利用編織（魔網）的力量附著在她的作品上，賦予她按命令將這些怪物帶到生活中的能力。

english: Ultimately, Neverember used his influence to ruin {@creature Kalain|wdh} and divorce her from Waterdeep's high society. She was allowed to keep her home, but her works and her reputation were destroyed, slowly and methodically. {@creature Kalain|WDH}'s spirit was broken, leading to the onset of madness. Now she locks herself away, content to let time erode the last of her conscience. She always saw Dagult and Waterdeep as one and the same, and now they are both her mortal enemies.
zh_tw: 最終，無燼利用他的影響力毀滅了{@creature Kalain|wdh|卡萊恩}，並使她與深水城的高社會離婚。她被允許保留她的家，但她的作品和聲譽被慢慢而有系統地摧毀。{@creature Kalain|WDH|卡萊恩}的精神崩潰，導致瘋狂開始。現在她把自己鎖起來，滿足於讓時間侵蝕她最後的良知。她總是把達格魯特和深水城視為一體，現在他們都是她的死敵。

english: Visiting the Residence
zh_tw: 訪問住宅

english: {@creature Kalain|wdh} is unable to behave politely before strangers, for she believes they're all assassins sent by Dagult Neverember to murder her. The only person with whom she's civil is Vhaspar Holmdreg (LG male Illuskan human {@creature priest}), who rents a room in the west wing of the residence and works in the North Ward at the Hospice of St. Laupsenn, a temple of Ilmater, god of suffering. Vhaspar is an old man in his seventies, half blind with cataracts, who brings her food twice a week, firewood three times a week in the winter, and painting supplies every few months. Vhaspar has a key that unlocks the outer doors of {@creature Kalain|WDH}'s residence.
zh_tw: {@creature Kalain|wdh|卡萊恩}無法在陌生人面前表現得禮貌，因為她認為他們都是達格魯特無燼派來謀殺她的刺客。她唯一禮貌對待的人是瓦斯帕·霍姆德雷格（LG男性伊路斯坎人人類{@creature priest||祭司}），他在住宅的西翼租了一個房間，並在北區的St. 勞普森救濟院，即苦難之神伊爾梅特的神廟工作。瓦斯帕是一個七十多歲的老人，因白內障而半盲，他每週給她送兩次食物，冬天每週送三次柴火，每隔幾個月送一次繪畫用品。瓦斯帕有一把鑰匙可以開啟{@creature Kalain|WDH|卡萊恩}住宅的外門。

english: Displayed in every room except {@area W5|20b} is one of {@creature Kalain|WDH}'s paintings. To determine the subject of any given painting, roll a {@dice d12} and consult the Painting Subjects table. It's possible for a subject to appear more than once. The residence is also crawling with rats. If {@creature Kalain|WDH} is attacked, these vermin form six {@creature swarm of rats||swarms of rats} that defend her.
zh_tw: 除了{@area W5|20b}房間外，每個房間都展示了一幅{@creature Kalain|WDH|卡萊恩}的畫作。要確定任何一幅畫作的主題，擲一個{@dice d12}並參考畫作主題表。一個主題可能多次出現。這個住所也充滿了老鼠。如果{@creature Kalain|WDH|卡萊恩}遭到攻擊，這些害蟲會形成六個{@creature swarm of rats||老鼠群}來保護她。

english: Kalain's Paintings
zh_tw: 卡萊恩的畫作

zh_tw: 結果

english: A Painting of an Ankheg
zh_tw: 一幅螳螂蟲的畫

english: A Painting of a Carrion crawler
zh_tw: 一幅食腐爬蟲的畫

english: A Painting of a Displacer beast
zh_tw: 一幅移位獸的畫作

zh_tw: 一幅伊特怪的畫

english: A Painting of a Gargoyle
zh_tw: 一幅石像鬼的畫作

english: A Painting of a Ghast
zh_tw: 一幅幽靈的畫

english: A Painting of a Gibbering mouther
zh_tw: 一幅囈語之口的畫作

english: A Painting of a Hell hound
zh_tw: 一幅地獄獵犬的畫

english: A Painting of a Manticore
zh_tw: 一幅蠍尾獅的畫作

english: A Painting of a Minotaur
zh_tw: 一幅牛頭人畫像

english: A Painting of a Mummy
zh_tw: 一幅木乃伊的畫像

english: A Painting of a Werewolf
zh_tw: 一幅狼人畫作

english: Kalain
zh_tw: 卡萊恩

english: {@creature Kalain|wdh} spends most of her time in {@area W5|20b}, which serves as her studio. It contains moldy scraps of food, empty pots stained with colored paint, discarded brushes, and her easel, which is situated in front of a large, lead-paned window in the north wall. Upon the easel rests a fresh painting of a {@creature displacer beast}. If the characters confront her, {@creature Kalain|WDH} accuses them of being assassins, brings the displacer beast to life, and commands it to attack them.
zh_tw: {@creature Kalain|wdh|卡萊恩}大部分時間都在{@area W5|20b}，這裡作為她的畫室。裡面有發黴的食物殘渣、沾滿顏料的空罐子、丟棄的畫筆，以及她位於北牆一個大的鉛框窗戶前的畫架。畫架上放著一幅新鮮的{@creature displacer beast||移位獸}的畫。如果角色們面對她，{@creature Kalain|WDH|卡萊恩}會指控他們是刺客，讓貘獸活過來，並命令它攻擊他們。

english: {@creature Kalain|WDH} is a half-elf {@creature bard|VGM} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), with these changes:
zh_tw: {@creature Kalain|WDH|卡萊恩} 是一個半精靈{@creature bard|VGM|吟遊詩人}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），有以下變化：

english: She is chaotic evil.
zh_tw: 她是混亂邪惡的。

english: She has these racial traits: She has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition charmed}, and magic can't put her to sleep. She has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. She speaks Common and Elvish.
zh_tw: 她有這些種族特性：她在對抵抗{@condition charmed||魅惑}的豁免檢定上有優勢，魔法不能讓她入睡。她具有60尺範圍內的黑暗視覺。她說通用語和精靈語。

english: Instead of the Song of Rest trait, she has the Art Imitates Life action option.
zh_tw: 她擁有的是藝術模仿生活行動選項，而不是安息之歌特性。

english: Art Imitates Life (3/Day)
zh_tw: 藝術模仿生活（每日3次）

english: {@creature Kalain|wdh} touches one of her paintings and causes its subject to spring forth, becoming a creature of that kind provided its CR is 3 or lower. The creature appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the painting, which becomes blank. The creature is friendly toward {@creature Kalain|WDH} and hostile toward all others. It rolls initiative to determine when it acts. It disappears after 1 minute, when it is reduced to 0 hit points, or when {@creature Kalain|WDH} dies or falls {@condition unconscious}.
zh_tw: {@creature Kalain|wdh|卡萊恩}觸控她的一幅畫作，使其主題跳出畫布，變成那種生物，前提是其挑戰等級(CR)為3或更低。生物出現在畫作5尺範圍內的未佔據空間內，畫作隨即變為空白。生物對{@creature Kalain|WDH|卡萊恩}友好，對所有其他人敵對。它擲骰子以確定其行動時機。生物在1分鐘後消失，當它的生命值降至0點，或當{@creature Kalain|WDH|卡萊恩}死亡或進入{@condition unconscious||昏迷}狀態時也會消失。

english: Path to the Vault
zh_tw: 通往金庫的路

english: A heavy stone trapdoor in the floor of area W4a can be found with a thorough search of the room and a successful {@dc 12} Wisdom (Perception) check. Pulling open the door reveals a stone staircase that descends 120 feet to a 20-foot-wide corridor, which extends for another 60 feet and ends before the doors to the Vault of Dragons. {@creature Kalain|wdh} and Vhaspar know nothing of the vault or the trapdoor that leads to it.
zh_tw: 在區域 W4a 的地板上，一扇沉重的石質活板門可以透過徹底搜尋房間併成功透過 {@dc 12} 感知（感知）檢定找到。拉開這扇門會露出一條向下的石階樓梯，向下延伸 120 尺，通向一條 20 尺寬的走廊，這條走廊再延伸 60 尺，最後止於通往龍之寶庫的門前。{@creature Kalain|wdh|卡萊恩} 和瓦斯帕對這座金庫或通往它的活板門一無所知。

english: Converted Windmill: Winter
zh_tw: 改造風車：冬季

english: An evil dragonborn named {@creature Thrakkus|wdh} has converted an old, fire-scorched windmill in the Field Ward into a butcher's shop. A member of the Guild of Butchers, {@creature Thrakkus|WDH} has a lucrative side business. Zhents loyal to {@creature Manshoon|WDH} pay {@creature Thrakkus|WDH} to chop up people they kill, and he sells the meat on the sly. As Deadwinter Day approaches, this meat is in high demand. The corpses are brought to him in the dead of night, most often delivered by Sidra Romeir (see chapter 8, {@area K2|3db}) in a covered cart pulled by a draft horse.
zh_tw: 一個名叫{@creature Thrakkus|wdh|薩卡斯}的邪惡龍裔將原野區一座老舊、被火燒過的風車改造成了一家屠宰店。作為屠夫公會的成員，{@creature Thrakkus|WDH|薩卡斯}擁有一項利潤豐厚的副業。忠於{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的散塔林會成員支付{@creature Thrakkus|WDH|薩卡斯}來切碎他們殺害的人，然後他秘密地出售這些肉。隨著死冬日的臨近，這種肉的需求很高。屍體通常在深夜被送到他那裡，大多數是由希德拉·羅梅爾（見第8章，{@area K2|3db}）用一匹挽馬拉著的帶篷車送來的。

english: Butchery
zh_tw: 屠宰場

english: A red wooden sign carved to look like a butcher's cleaver hangs above the door of {@creature Thrakkus|wdh}'s butchery, which occupies the westernmost room of the west wing. The butchery is ice cold in the winter and reeks of meat and blood. A bloodstained chopping block dominates the room, and shelves of cut meat wrapped in bloody parchment line the walls. The floor is streaked with blood and covered with bits of gore.
zh_tw: 一塊紅色的木製招牌，雕刻得像屠夫的切肉刀，懸掛在{@creature Thrakkus|wdh|薩卡斯}的屠宰場的門上方，屠宰場位於西翼最西邊的房間。冬天這裡冰冷刺骨，充滿了肉和血的氣味。一個血跡斑斑的砧板佔據了房間的主要位置，牆壁上排列著架子，上面擺放著用血跡斑斑的羊皮紙包裹的切割好的肉。地板上血跡斑斑，覆蓋著一些血肉殘渣。

english: {@creature Thrakkus|WDH} padlocks the door at night. Picking the lock requires a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check using thieves' tools. The door can also be forced open with a successful {@dc 18} Strength (Athletics) check.
zh_tw: {@creature Thrakkus|WDH|薩卡斯} 在晚上鎖門。開鎖需要使用盜賊工具透過一次 {@dc 15} 的敏捷檢定。門也可以透過成功 {@dc 18} 的力量（運動）檢定強行開啟。

english: Larder
zh_tw: 食品儲藏室

english: The chamber next to the butchery has been converted into a larder, the doors to which are padlocked at all hours. The locked doors are otherwise identical to the butchery door (see above). Like the butchery, the larder is frigid in the winter and smells of meat and blood. Six half-frozen humanoid carcasses are stacked under a 10-foot-square canvas tarpaulin near the western wall. {@creature Thrakkus|wdh} hasn't gotten around to cutting them up yet.
zh_tw: 屠宰場旁邊的房間已改造成儲藏室，門上始終掛著掛鎖。上鎖的門與屠宰場的門（見上文）在其他方面是相同的。和屠宰場一樣，儲藏室在冬天也是寒冷的，並且散發著肉和血的氣味。六個半凍僵的人形生物屍體堆放在西牆附近的一個10尺見方的帆布防水油布下。{@creature Thrakkus|wdh|薩卡斯}還沒有來得及把它們切開。

english: Squatters
zh_tw: 非法佔住者

english: The dragonborn allows squatters to dwell in his home. Those who can perform menial chores are spared and fed scraps of cooked meat; the rest end up on the chopping block. These homeless sods are too {@condition frightened} of {@creature Thrakkus|wdh} to speak ill of him, and the City Watch doesn't seem to care about crimes committed in the Field Ward.
zh_tw: 龍裔允許流浪者在他的家中居住。那些能夠做一些瑣碎工作的人被寬恕並獲得熟肉殘渣；其餘的人則會被處決。這些無家可歸的人因為對{@creature Thrakkus|wdh|薩卡斯}的{@condition frightened||恐懼}而不敢說他壞話，而城市守衛似乎對在原野區發生的罪行漠不關心。

english: Thrakkus the Butcher
zh_tw: 屠夫薩卡斯

english: The butcher has no time to suffer fools, and the characters are fools for meddling in his business. {@creature Thrakkus|wdh} spends most of the day in the butchery. At dusk, he retires to his apartment, where he stays until dawn or until someone comes knocking with a body to dispose of. {@creature Thrakkus|WDH} carries keys to the butchery, the larder, and his apartment ({@area W7|20d}).
zh_tw: 屠夫沒有時間容忍傻瓜，而角色們插手他的生意就是愚蠢的。{@creature Thrakkus|wdh|薩卡斯}大部分時間都在屠宰場。黃昏時，他回到自己的公寓，一直待到黎明，或者直到有人敲門要求處理屍體。{@creature Thrakkus|WDH|薩卡斯}攜帶著屠宰場、儲藏室和他公寓（{@area W7|20d}）的鑰匙。

english: {@creature Thrakkus|wdh} is a dragonborn {@creature berserker} of red dragon ancestry, with these changes:
zh_tw: {@creature Thrakkus|wdh|薩卡斯} 是一個紅龍血統的龍裔{@creature berserker||狂戰士}，有以下變化：

english: He is chaotic evil.
zh_tw: 他是混亂邪惡的。

english: He has these racial traits: He can use his action to exhale a 15-foot cone of fire (but can't do this again until he finishes a short or long rest); each creature in the cone must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw, taking {@dice 2d6} fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. He has resistance to fire damage. He speaks Common and Draconic.
zh_tw: 他擁有這些種族特性：他可以使用他的動作吐出一道15尺的錐形火焰（但在完成短休或長休之前不能再次使用）；錐形範圍內的每個生物必須進行一次{@dc 13}敏捷豁免，豁免失敗則受到{@dice 2d6}火焰傷害，豁免成功則受到一半傷害。他對火焰傷害具有抗性。他會說通用語和龍語。

english: Where's the Stone?
zh_tw: 石頭在哪裡？

english: {@creature Thrakkus|wdh} hid the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} in a recent meat delivery to an alley in the Trades Ward. {@creature Thrakkus|WDH} doesn't keep records of his illegal transactions, so the characters must interrogate him or one of the commoners that dwell in his residence.
zh_tw: {@creature Thrakkus|wdh|薩卡斯}將{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}藏在了最近一批送往商業區一條小巷的肉類運輸中。{@creature Thrakkus|WDH|薩卡斯}不記錄他的非法交易，所以角色們必須審問他或者居住在他的住所中的某一個普通人。

english: {@creature Thrakkus|WDH} is belligerent and not eager to give up his Zhent friends. A {@spell charm person} spell or similar magic is needed to compel him to talk. His squatters are another matter; they roll over on {@creature Thrakkus|wdh} quickly to save their own skins once the dragonborn butcher no longer becomes a factor in their well-being. Either approach yields the following information:
zh_tw: {@creature Thrakkus|WDH|薩卡斯}具有挑釁性，並不急於放棄他的散塔林會成員朋友。需要使用{@spell charm person||魅惑類人}法術或類似的魔法來強迫他說話。他的擅自佔地者是另一個問題；一旦龍裔屠夫不再是他們福祉的因素，他們會很快出賣{@creature Thrakkus|wdh|薩卡斯}以保全自己。無論哪種方法都能得到以下資訊：

english: {@creature Thrakkus|WDH}'s last shipment of meat was taken to a shop in the Trades Ward called Cuttle's Meat Pies. It's located in an alley.
zh_tw: {@creature Thrakkus|WDH|薩卡斯} 最後一批肉被送到了商業區一個叫做卡特爾肉餅店的商店。它位於一個巷子裡。

english: The meat was delivered by a member of the Guild of Butchers named Justyn Rassk. {@creature Thrakkus|WDH} paid extra coin to see it delivered "quickly and quietly."
zh_tw: 這些肉是由名為賈斯汀·拉斯克的屠夫公會成員運送的。{@creature Thrakkus|WDH|薩卡斯}額外支付了一些金幣，以確保肉被"迅速且安靜地"送達。

english: Rassk has a blood-spattered horse-drawn cart that he uses to make deliveries outside the Field Ward.
zh_tw: 拉斯克有一輛血跡斑斑的馬車，他用它在原野區外進行送貨。

english: The characters might know Justyn Rassk from their own dealings with the Guild of Butchers (see "Sample Guild Representatives").
zh_tw: 角色們可能透過他們自己與屠夫公會的交易（見"樣品公會代表"）認識賈斯汀·拉斯克。

english: Next Encounter
zh_tw: 下一場遭遇

english: If the characters follow the trail of the meat delivery, proceed with encounter 1, "Alley."
zh_tw: 如果角色們追蹤肉品送貨的蹤跡，請繼續進行遭遇1，"小巷。"

english: Vault Keys
zh_tw: 金庫鑰匙

english: At the end of an encounter chain, a character who is attuned to the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} can learn the location of the Vault of Dragons and what three keys are needed to open its doors. The artifact also reveals that an adult gold dragon named {@creature Aurinax|WDH} guards the vault.
zh_tw: 在一連串遭遇的末尾，一個與{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}共鳴的角色可以得知龍之寶庫的位置以及開啟它的門所需的三把鑰匙。這件神器還揭示了一個名叫{@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯}的成年金龍守護著金庫。

english: The three keys needed to open the vault are chosen by you or determined randomly by rolling on the Vault Keys table. Illusory versions of keys don't open the door.
zh_tw: 開啟金庫所需的三把鑰匙由您選擇或透過在金庫鑰匙表上擲骰子隨機確定。虛幻版本的鑰匙無法開啟門。

english: Every key can be found or procured in Waterdeep. If the characters don't already know the location of a key, they can gather information about it. To do this, a character must spend 1 day and 5 gp researching the location of a key. At the end of this day, the character makes a {@dc 15} Intelligence (Investigation) check, learning the location of the key on a success. If the check fails by 5 or more, the main villain learns of the search and sends lackeys to attack the characters and, if possible, wrest the Stone of Golorr from them:
zh_tw: 每把鑰匙都能在深水城找到或獲得。如果角色還不知道某把鑰匙的位置，他們可以收集相關資訊。為此，角色必須花費1天時間和5金幣研究鑰匙的位置。在這天結束時，角色進行一次{@dc 15}智力（調查）檢定，成功則得知鑰匙的位置。如果檢定失敗且差值達到5或更多，主要反派會得知此次搜尋，並派遣手下攻擊角色，並儘可能從他們手中奪走格洛爾之石：

english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH} sends either five {@creature goblin||goblins} dressed up as children wearing Trolltide masks and a {@creature bugbear} ({@chance 70|70 percent chance}), or four {@creature wererat||wererats} in human form ({@chance 30|30 percent chance}).
zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}派出了五個裝扮成戴著巨魔節面具的孩子的{@creature goblin||地精}和一個{@creature bugbear||熊地精}（有{@chance 70|70% 的機會}的機率），或者四個以人類形態出現的{@creature wererat||鼠人}（有{@chance 30|30%的機率}的機率）。

english: The Cassalanters send two {@creature imp||imps} in raven form, three human {@creature cultist||cultists}, and either a human {@creature cult fanatic} ({@chance 70|70 percent chance}), or four {@creature spined devil||spined devils} ({@chance 30|30 percent chance}).
zh_tw: 卡薩爾特派（卡薩蘭特家族）派出兩隻以烏鴉形態出現的{@creature imp||小魔鬼}，三名人類{@creature cultist||邪教徒}，以及一名人類{@creature cult fanatic||邪教狂信者}（有{@chance 70|70% 的機會}的機率），或者四隻{@creature spined devil||棘魔}（有{@chance 30|30%的機率}的機率）。

english: {@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH} sends {@creature Fel'rekt Lafeen|WDH} and {@creature Krebbyg Masq'il'yr|WDH}, or two other Bregan D'aerthe {@creature drow gunslinger|WDH|drow gunslingers} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), and six {@creature drow}.
zh_tw: {@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH|賈拉索·班瑞} 派遣了 {@creature Fel'rekt Lafeen|WDH|菲爾萊科特·拉菲恩} 和 {@creature Krebbyg Masq'il'yr|WDH|克雷比格·馬斯奇爾}，或者其他兩位布雷甘·達耶的{@creature drow gunslinger|WDH|卓爾火槍手}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），以及六名{@creature drow||卓爾}。

english: {@creature Manshoon|WDH} sends four Zhent {@creature martial arts adept|VGM|martial arts adepts} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}). There's a {@chance 50|50 percent chance} that these Zhents are led by one of {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s lieutenants, either Vevette Blackwater or Agorn Fuoco, if they're still alive (see chapter 8, {@area E8|425}).
zh_tw: {@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}派遣了四名散塔林會的{@creature martial arts adept|VGM|武術高手}（參見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）。有{@chance 50|50%的機率}這些散塔林會成員由{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的副手之一領導，要麼是薇薇特·黑水，要麼是阿戈恩·弗奧科，如果他們仍然存活的話（參見第8章，{@area E8|425}）。

zh_tw: 價值至少1,000 gp的寶石

zh_tw: 一對熊地精的耳朵

zh_tw: 《你的鬍鬚臉龐》表演

zh_tw: 切斷的黑暗精靈手

english: Key Descriptions
zh_tw: 鑰匙描述

english: The keys listed in the Vault Keys table are further described below, in alphabetical order.
zh_tw: 金庫鑰匙表中列出的鑰匙在下方以字母順序進一步描述。

english: Adamantine bar
zh_tw: 精金條

english: The characters can purchase a 10-pound adamantine bar for 1,000 gp. The genasi smiths {@creature Embric|WDH} and {@creature Avi|WDH} (see chapter 2, {@area T3|09d}) can acquire one if the characters think to ask them.
zh_tw: 角色們可以購買一根10磅重的精金條，價格為1000金幣。如果角色們想要詢問，那麼位於第2章{@area T3|09d}中的元素裔鐵匠{@creature Embric|WDH|恩布里克}和{@creature Avi|WDH|阿維}能夠獲得一根。

english: Animated Construct
zh_tw: 活化構裝體

english: Any creature of the construct type works as this key, provided the creature hasn't been destroyed or rendered inoperable. If the characters have befriended {@creature Valetta|wdh}, the dragonborn priest of Gond (see chapter 3), she happily releases Nim the {@creature nimblewright|wdh} into their custody until they no longer have need of it. An object animated by the {@spell animate objects} spell also qualifies as this key.
zh_tw: 任何構造物型別的生物都可以作為這把鑰匙，只要這個生物沒有被摧毀或變得無法操作。如果角色們與{@creature Valetta|wdh|瓦萊塔}，貢德的龍裔牧師（見第3章）建立了友誼，她會很高興地將尼姆——{@creature nimblewright|wdh|秘偶}釋放到他們的監護下，直到他們不再需要它。透過{@spell animate objects||活化物件}法術被活化的物體也符合這把鑰匙的資格。

english: Beardless dwarf
zh_tw: 沒有鬍鬚的矮人

english: Most female dwarves are beardless and thus meet the condition. A male dwarf NPC can be persuaded to shave his beard, either as a consequence of losing a bet or upon receiving some sort of recompense. The characters can also shave a male dwarf they have captured or against whom they have some sort of leverage.
zh_tw: 大多數女性矮人沒有鬍鬚，因此符合條件。男性矮人NPC可以被說服剃掉鬍鬚，這可能是由於輸掉賭注或在收到某種補償後的結果。角色們也可以給一個他們捕獲的男性矮人剃鬚，或者在他們擁有某種影響力的情況下剃鬚。

english: Beholder eyestalk
zh_tw: 眼魔眼梗

english: The eyestalk need not come from a true, living beholder. It can be plucked from a stuffed beholder (see "Old Xoblob Shop") or obtained from a lesser form of beholderkin, such as a gazer or a spectator. The eyestalk also need not be detached. {@creature Xanathar|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) gladly accompanies characters to the vault if that's the way to guarantee getting its share of the treasure. Regardless of the arrangement it makes with the characters, "its share" equates to all the treasure. In other words, {@creature Xanathar|WDH} turns on the party once the vault is unlocked, unless a powerful NPC (such as {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH} or {@creature Vajra Safahr|WDH}) is present to keep the mad beholder in check.
zh_tw: 眼梗不必來自一個真正的、活著的眼魔。它可以從填充的眼魔（見"老索布洛布商店"）上拔下來，或者從一個較低階的眼魔種類，如凝視者眼魔或觀察者眼魔那裡獲得。眼梗也不必是分離的。{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）如果這樣能保證得到它的那份財寶，很樂意陪伴角色們去金庫。無論它與角色們達成什麼協議，"它的份額"等同於所有的財寶。換句話說，一旦金庫被解鎖，{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}就會對隊伍翻臉，除非有一個強大的NPC（如{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}或{@creature Vajra Safahr|WDH|瓦婕拉·莎法爾}）在場來控制這個瘋狂的眼魔。

english: Bronze Dragon Scale
zh_tw: 青銅龍鱗片

english: Zelifarn, a young bronze dragon, has taken up residence in Deepwater Harbor. Many sailors and dock workers have seen the dragon, and {@creature Grinda Garloth|WDH} (see "Encounter 2: Mistshore"), owns an apparatus of Kwalish that characters can use to search for the dragon. Characters who go looking for Zelifarn find him lurking inside a shipwreck 120 feet underwater. As the characters approach the wreck, Zelifarn comes out and tries to scare them away. (He's not done searching the wreck for treasure.) He inflicts harm only in self-defense. A successful {@dc 15} Charisma (Persuasion) check or an offer of treasure worth at least 1,000 gp convinces the dragon to talk with the characters and part with one of his scales. If the characters mention the contents of the Vault of Dragons, Zelifarn demands a promise of 10 percent of the gold before he gives them what they came for.
zh_tw: 澤利法恩，一隻年輕的青銅龍，已經在深水港安家。許多水手和碼頭工人都見過這條龍，而{@creature Grinda Garloth|WDH|格林達·加洛斯}（參見"遭遇2：霧岸"）擁有一臺卡維什的裝置，角色們可以使用它來尋找這條龍。尋找澤利法恩的角色們會在水下120尺處的一艘沉船中發現他潛伏其中。當角色們接近沉船時，澤利法恩會出來並試圖嚇走他們。（他還沒在沉船中搜完寶物。）他只會出於自衛而造成傷害。成功的{@dc 15}魅力（說服）檢定或提供至少價值1000金幣的寶物可以說服這條龍與角色們交談，並贈予他們一片他的鱗片。如果角色們提到龍之寶庫的內容，澤利法恩會要求他們答應分給他10%的黃金，然後才會給他們所需之物。

english: Cask of dwarven ale
zh_tw: 矮人啤酒桶

english: A cask of dwarven ale is easily obtained at any market in Waterdeep for 5 gp. There is a {@chance 20|20 percent chance} that the characters buy a knock-off brand that isn't made by dwarves. Any dwarf character can tell genuine dwarven ale from the fake stuff simply by having a taste.
zh_tw: 在深水城的任何市場上，一桶矮人麥酒可以輕易以5金幣的價格買到。有{@chance 20|20%的機率}角色們會買到一種並非由矮人制造的仿冒品牌。任何矮人角色只需品嚐一下，就能辨別出真正的矮人麥酒與假貨的區別。

english: Drunken elf
zh_tw: 醉酒的精靈

english: Any elf who is {@condition poisoned} from drinking alcohol qualifies as this key.
zh_tw: 任何因飲用酒精而{@condition poisoned||中毒}的精靈都符合這把鑰匙的條件。

english: Gems worth 1,000 gp
zh_tw: 價值1000 gp的寶石

english: One or more gemstones qualify as this key as long as their combined value is 1,000 gp or more. Such gems can be found during the adventure or bought in the markets of Waterdeep.
zh_tw: 只要它們的總價值達到1000金幣或更多，一顆或多顆寶石就可以作為這把鑰匙。這樣的寶石可以在冒險中找到，或在深水城的市場購買。

english: Gift from a queen
zh_tw: 女王的禮物

english: {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH}, the Open Lord of Waterdeep, was once the queen of an ancient kingdom called Stornanter. The characters can recall this fact with a successful {@dc 20} Intelligence (History) check or learn it through information gathering. They can request an audience with Laeral through {@creature Jalester Silvermane|WDH} or {@creature Mirt|WDH}. Laeral gives them a gift—a feather quill given to her by the archmage Elminster himself—if they promise to return the stolen gold to Waterdeep's coffers.
zh_tw: 深水城公開領主{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}，曾是名為斯托南特的古代王國的女王。角色們可以透過成功的{@dc 20}智力（歷史）檢定回憶起這一事實，或者透過資訊收集得知。他們可以透過{@creature Jalester Silvermane|WDH|加萊斯特·銀鬃}或{@creature Mirt|WDH|米爾特}請求與萊拉會面。如果他們承諾將失竊的黃金歸還深水城的金庫，萊拉會贈送他們一件禮物——由大法師伊爾明斯特本人贈送給她的一支羽毛筆。

english: Invisible creature
zh_tw: 隱形生物

english: Any creature under the effect of an {@spell invisibility} spell counts as this key, as do naturally {@condition invisible} creatures.
zh_tw: 任何受到{@spell invisibility||隱形}法術影響的生物都算作這把鑰匙，自然{@condition invisible||隱形}的生物也是如此。

english: Painting of a dwarf miner
zh_tw: 一幅矮人礦工的畫

english: A painting of a dwarf miner priced at {@dice 5d10} gp can be found each day a character spends searching art shops. A character proficient with painter's supplies can create a painting that qualifies as this key. It takes {@dice 3d6} hours to finish the painting.
zh_tw: 每天角色在搜尋藝術品商店時，都可能發現一幅標價為 {@dice 5d10} 金幣的矮人礦工畫像。熟練使用畫家工具的角色可以創作出符合這個關鍵的畫作。完成這幅畫需要 {@dice 3d6} 小時。

english: Pair of bugbear ears
zh_tw: 一對熊地精的耳朵

english: The Xanathar Guild employs {@creature bugbear||bugbears}, and characters can chop the ears off any of them. A live bugbear also counts as this key.
zh_tw: 姍娜薩公會僱傭了{@creature bugbear||熊地精}，角色們可以割下它們的耳朵。一隻活的熊地精怪也被視為這把鑰匙。

english: Performance of "Your Beardy Face"
zh_tw: 《你的鬍鬚臉龐》表演

english: The dwarf love song, "Your Beardy Face," is a duet performed by bagpipers. The characters can obtain this music easily for 1 gp and hire two performers to play the piece for 10 gp each. A character who has proficiency with bagpipes can perform the song, though a successful {@dc 10} Charisma (Performance) check using bagpipes is required for the performance to count as this key. A glass jar in Cassalanter Villa (see chapter 6, {@area C3|2f2}) plays this song when it is uncorked.
zh_tw: 矮人的情歌《你的鬍鬚臉龐》是由風笛手演奏的二重唱。角色可以輕鬆花費1金幣獲得這首樂曲，並僱傭兩位表演者，每人10金幣來演奏。熟練使用風笛的角色可以演奏這首歌曲，但需要透過一次 {@dc 10} 魅力（表演）檢定，使用風笛成功演奏才能使表演被視為這個關鍵。在卡薩蘭特別墅（見第6章 {@area C3|2f2}）的一個玻璃罐子在被開啟時會播放這首歌曲。

english: Severed drow hand
zh_tw: 切斷的黑暗精靈手

english: This ghastly key can be forcibly obtained from a member of Bregan D'aerthe or some other dark elf. If the characters have encountered no drow, they might hear rumors that {@creature Xanathar|WDH} employs a drow advisor.
zh_tw: 這個可怕的鑰匙可以從布雷甘·達耶的成員或其他黑暗精靈那裡強行獲得。如果角色們還沒有遇到過任何黑暗精靈，他們可能會聽說{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}僱傭了一個黑暗精靈顧問。

english: Shapechanger
zh_tw: 變形者

english: Any living creature of the shapechanger subtype, such as a {@creature doppelganger} or a {@creature wererat}, serves as this key. {@creature Bonnie|WDH} the doppelganger (see "Familiar Faces") can be persuaded to accompany the characters if she is friendly toward one or more of them. The characters can also reach out to the Shard Shunners, a local gang of halfling wererats. For an up-front payment of 500 gp, the wererats happily oblige.
zh_tw: 任何具有變形者亞種的生物，如{@creature doppelganger||變形怪}或{@creature wererat||鼠人}，都可以作為這把鑰匙。{@creature Bonnie|WDH|邦妮}這個變形怪（見"熟悉的面孔"）如果對其中一個或多個角色友好，可以被說服陪同角色們。角色們也可以聯絡當地的半身人狼人鼠幫派，即避碎幫。作為預付款500金幣，狼人鼠們很樂意幫忙。

english: Silvered warhammer
zh_tw: 鍍銀戰錘

english: The characters can buy a {@item silvered warhammer|phb} for 115 gp, or they can give a silver bar to {@creature Embric|WDH} and {@creature Avi|WDH} (see chapter 2, {@area T3|09d}) and have the genasi smiths craft one.
zh_tw: 角色們可以購買一把{@item silvered warhammer|phb|鍍銀戰錘}，價格為115金幣，或者他們可以給{@creature Embric|WDH|恩布里克}和{@creature Avi|WDH|阿維}（見第2章，{@area T3|09d}）一塊銀條，並讓這兩位元素裔鐵匠打造一把。

english: Sunlight
zh_tw: 陽光

english: Since the vault lies deep underground, natural sunlight is difficult to come by. Clever characters can buy twenty steel mirrors (5 gp each) and arrange them in places (and at the proper angles) so that sunlight from outside can be reflected underground and shone upon the vault entrance. Setting up these mirrors and getting their alignment just right takes {@dice 2d4 + 2} hours regardless of the number of characters involved.
zh_tw: 由於金庫位於地下深處，自然陽光很難獲得。聰明的人物可以購買二十面鋼鏡（每面5金幣），並將它們放置在適當的地方（並以正確的角度）排列，以便將外界的陽光反射到地下並照射在金庫入口上。無論參與的角色數量，設定這些鏡子並調整它們的正確對齊需要{@dice 2d4 + 2}小時。

english: Unicorn
zh_tw: 獨角獸

english: Although conjuring up a real unicorn is likely beyond the abilities of the characters, they could ask {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH} or {@creature Vajra Safahr|WDH} to cast the {@spell conjure celestial} spell. The characters can gain an audience with Laeral or Vajra through {@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh} or another well-connected NPC. If the characters tell Laeral or Vajra the truth about the Vault of Dragons and promise to turn the gold over to the authorities, either one agrees to accompany the characters to the vault and cast the spell. The unicorn need not be a real unicorn to serve as this key. The Sea Maidens Faire (see chapter 7) uses a unicorn float in its parades, and a stuffed unicorn can be found in Cassalanter Villa (see chapter 6, {@area C18|317}).
