zh_tw: 儘管召喚一隻真正的獨角獸可能超出了角色們的能力範圍，但他們可以請求{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}或{@creature Vajra Safahr|WDH|瓦婕拉·莎法爾}施展{@spell conjure celestial||咒喚聖光}法術。角色們可以透過{@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh|瑞納爾·無燼}或另一個關係網廣泛的NPC與萊拉或瓦婕拉會面。如果角色們告訴萊拉或瓦婕拉關於龍之寶庫的真相，並承諾將黃金交給當局，他們中的任何一個都同意陪同角色們前往寶庫並施展法術。獨角獸不需要是一隻真正的獨角獸才能作為這把鑰匙。海之少女嘉年華（見第7章）在其遊行中使用了一個獨角獸彩車，而在卡薩蘭特別墅（見第6章，{@area C18|317}）可以找到一個填充獨角獸。

english: A gold dragon guards a pile of golden dragons
zh_tw: 一隻金龍守衛著一堆金質龍形雕像

english: Vault of Dragons
zh_tw: 龍之寶庫

english: Once the characters have the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, they can use it to determine the location of the Vault of Dragons and the keys needed to enter it.
zh_tw: 一旦角色們獲得了{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，他們就可以使用它來確定龍之寶庫的位置以及進入所需的鑰匙。

english: Vault Features
zh_tw: 寶庫特點

english: All areas of the vault have the following features:
zh_tw: 寶庫的所有區域都有以下特點：

english: Any spell that tries to contact a creature in the vault fails, as does any spell that attempts to scry on the vault interior or any creatures within. Teleporting into the vault from outside is impossible.
zh_tw: 任何試圖聯絡寶庫內生物的法術都會失敗，同樣，任何試圖探查寶庫內部或其中任何生物的法術也會失敗。從外部透過傳送進入寶庫是不可能的。

english: Walls are made of mortared stone. Doors are solid stone slabs with stone handles and hinges.
zh_tw: 牆壁由砌築的石頭構成。門是實心石板製成，帶有石制的把手和鉸鏈。

english: Except in {@area V9|24b}, there are no light sources.
zh_tw: 除了在{@area V9|24b}，沒有光源。

english: Areas of the Vault
zh_tw: 寶庫區域

english: The following locations are keyed to map 4.9.
zh_tw: 以下位置對應於地圖4.9上的關鍵點。

english: Vault of Dragons
zh_tw: 龍之寶庫

english: Vault of Dragons, Main Level (Player Version)
zh_tw: 龍之寶庫，主層級（玩家版本）

english: V1. Vault Door
zh_tw: V1. 寶庫門

english: A 20-foot-high, 20-foot-wide stone corridor ends before an adamantine double door bearing Dwarvish runes. The doors have neither handles nor hinges. The writing on them reads, "THE THREE KEYS. BRING THEM FORTH."
zh_tw: 一條20尺高、20尺寬的石質走廊在一扇由堅鋼製成的雙門前結束。這扇門既沒有把手也沒有鉸鏈。門上的銘文寫著："三把鑰匙。把它們帶來。"

english: The doors part, sliding back into the walls, when the three correct keys are brought within 5 feet of them. They remain open until {@creature Aurinax|WDH} or someone else speaks the command word to close them ("Azaam"). The keys can open the doors from either side. The doors can't be forced open or damaged in any way, and attempts to circumvent them with magic fail automatically.
zh_tw: 當三把正確的鑰匙被帶到距離門5尺範圍內時，門會分開，滑回牆內。它們會保持開啟狀態，直到{@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯}或其他人說出關閉它們的命令詞("阿扎姆")。這些鑰匙可以從任一側開啟門。門不能被強行開啟或以任何方式損壞，而且使用魔法繞過它們的嘗試會自動失敗。

english: V2. Entrance Foyer
zh_tw: V2. 入口門廳

english: Three age-worn columns support crumbling stone bridges 60 feet overhead, with the ceiling rising another 20 feet beyond that.
zh_tw: 三根經年累月的柱子支撐著上方60尺處破敗的石橋，而天花板在石橋上方再升高20尺。

english: Set into alcoves are twelve sets of double doors made of iron. Each door is 10 feet wide, 10 feet high, and embossed with images of dwarf warriors in plate armor.
zh_tw: 在壁龕中設有十二套鐵製的雙門。每扇門寬10尺，高10尺，上面鑲嵌著穿著板甲的矮人戰士的影象。

english: Crumbling Bridges
zh_tw: 破敗的橋樑

english: The bridges connect {@area V4|23f} to adamantine doors that seal off areas V6, V7, and V8. The eastern half of the northern bridge and the western half of the southern bridge are unstable. Either bridge collapses if more than 150 pounds of weight is applied to it. A creature standing on a section of bridge when it collapses must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or fall 60 feet to the floor below.
zh_tw: 橋樑連線了 {@area V4|23f} 到精金門，這些門封住了區域 V6、V7 和 V8。北部橋樑的東半部和南部橋樑的西半部都不穩固。如果任一座橋樑承受超過 150 磅的重量，它就會坍塌。當橋樑坍塌時，站在橋樑某部分的生物必須成功透過一次 {@dc 15} 敏捷豁免檢定，否則會墜落 60 尺到下面的地面。

english: The middle bridge has a 15-foot-wide gap in it. A character can clear this gap with a running jump-but part of the bridge breaks away under the character's feet on landing, forcing the character to succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or fall to the floor below.
zh_tw: 中間橋樑有一個 15 尺寬的缺口。角色可以透過助跑跳躍越過這個缺口——但橋樑的一部分會在角色著陸時在腳下斷裂，迫使角色成功透過一次 {@dc 15} 敏捷豁免檢定，否則會跌落到下方的地板上。

english: Iron Doors
zh_tw: 鐵門

english: Ten of the double doors are false and refuse to budge. The two sets of doors at the northern end of the west wall push open to reveal {@area V3|23d} beyond.
zh_tw: 十套雙門是假門，無法移動。西牆北端的兩套門推開後會顯露出{@area V3|23d}。

english: V3. Stairs and Fresco
zh_tw: V3. 樓梯和壁畫

english: This hall has the following features:
zh_tw: 這個大廳有以下特點：

english: At the south end of this chamber, expertly carved stairs climb 70 feet to {@area V4|23f}.
zh_tw: 在這個房間的南端，由專家雕刻的樓梯向上攀升70尺到達{@area V4|23f}。

english: The north wall bears a 20-foot-square fresco that depicts dwarves battling goblins.
zh_tw: 北牆上面有一幅20尺見方的壁畫，描繪了矮人與地精戰鬥的場景。

english: Enthralling Fresco
zh_tw: 迷人的壁畫

english: A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals an aura of enchantment magic on the fresco. Any creature within 30 feet of the fresco that can see it must succeed on a {@dc 12} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition charmed} by it for 24 hours. While {@condition charmed} in this way, the creature can't willingly move out of sight of the fresco and defends it to the death. If forcibly moved away from the fresco, the creature tries to find its way back. The creature can't rest while under this effect. After 24 hours, the creature gains one level of {@condition exhaustion} and can repeat the saving throw if it can still see the fresco, ending the effect on a success. A creature that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the effect of the fresco for 24 hours. Destroying at least one 10-foot-square section of the fresco ends the effect for all creatures. Each 10-foot-square section has AC 17, 25 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.
zh_tw: 一個 {@spell detect magic||偵測魔法} 法術會揭示壁畫上附魔魔法的光環。任何在壁畫30尺內並能看見它的生物必須成功透過一個 {@dc 12} 的感知豁免檢定，否則將被 {@condition charmed||魅惑} 24小時。當以這種方式被 {@condition charmed||魅惑} 時，生物無法自願離開壁畫的視線範圍，並會誓死保護它。如果被強行移離壁畫，生物會試圖找到回去的路。在這種效果下，生物無法休息。24小時後，生物獲得一級 {@condition exhaustion||力竭}，並且如果它仍能看見壁畫，可以重複進行豁免檢定，成功時效果終止。成功進行豁免檢定的生物在24小時內對該壁畫的效果免疫。摧毀至少一個10尺見方的壁畫部分會終止對所有生物的效果。每個10尺見方的部分具有AC 17，25點生命值，並對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。

english: V4. Hall of Moradin
zh_tw: V4. 摩拉丁大廳

english: This 20-foot-high hall has the following features:
zh_tw: 這個20尺高的大廳有以下特點：

english: Three pillars running the length of the hall are carved to resemble warhammers, with their square heads pressed against the floor.
zh_tw: 大廳裡縱向排列的三根柱子被雕刻成戰錘的形狀，它們的方形頭部緊貼在地板上。

english: The west wall bears a cracked mosaic that depicts a dwarf smith at a forge, crafting dwarves out of black metal and {@item diamond||diamonds}. (In the south end of the wall is a secret door.)
zh_tw: 西牆上有一幅破裂的馬賽克，描繪了一個矮人鐵匠在鍛造爐前，用黑色的金屬和{@item diamond||鑽石}鍛造矮人。（在牆的南端有一扇秘密門。）

english: Three archways in the east wall lead to crumbling bridges that span the entrance foyer ({@area V2|23a}) and end in front of adamantine doors (leading to areas V6, V7, and V8).
zh_tw: 東牆上的三個拱門通向橫跨入口門廳（{@area V2|23a}）的破敗橋樑，並在通往V6、V7和V8區域的精金門前結束。

english: Black Pudding
zh_tw: 黑布丁

english: A little more than halfway down the hall, a section of the western mural has broken off, forming a heap of shattered tile on the floor. A crack in the wall conceals a {@creature black pudding} that gushes out and attacks characters who inspect the damage.
zh_tw: 在大廳的稍過一半處，西邊壁畫的一部分已經脫落，在地板上形成了一堆破碎的瓦片。牆上的一條裂縫隱藏著一個{@creature black pudding||黑布丁}，它會湧出來攻擊檢查損壞的角色。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: A character who searches the hall for secret doors and succeeds on a {@dc 17} Wisdom (Perception) check notices the outline of a secret door that leads to {@area V5|242}. The door opens automatically when a dwarf (or a creature transformed into a dwarf with an {@spell alter self} spell or similar magic) touches it; otherwise, a successful {@dc 17} Strength (Athletics) check is needed to push open the heavy door.
zh_tw: 一個在廳內搜尋密門併成功透過 {@dc 17} 感知（感知）檢定的角色會注意到一扇通往 {@area V5|242} 的密門的輪廓。當一名矮人（或被 {@spell alter self||變身術} 或其他類似法術轉變為矮人的生物）觸碰到門時，門會自動開啟；否則，需要一個成功的 {@dc 17} 力量（運動）檢定來推開這扇厚重的門。

english: V5. Secret Room
zh_tw: V5. 秘密房間

english: This dust-filled room has lain untouched since the time of the Delzoun dwarves. Green copper urns on platforms overflow with coins, gems, and more.
zh_tw: 這個充滿灰塵的房間自德爾宗矮人時代以來就未被觸動過。平臺上的綠色銅質甕中溢位了硬幣、寶石和更多的東西。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: This room holds five copper urns (worth 25 gp each). Urn 1 contains five tourmalines (worth 100 gp each) mixed in with 200 cp. Urn 2 contains a {@item ring of warmth} mixed in with ten ordinary gold rings (worth 25 gp each) and 650 sp. Urn 3 is piled high with 250 gp. Urn 4 holds 33 blue quartz gemstones (worth 10 gp each). Urn 5 holds a 9-inch-tall silver statuette of a dwarf priest of Moradin with amethyst eyes (worth 250 gp and weighing 10 pounds).
zh_tw: 這個房間有五個銅甕（每個價值25金幣）。甕1裝有五顆電氣石（每顆價值100金幣），與200銅幣混合在一起。甕2裝有一枚{@item ring of warmth||溫暖戒指}，與十個普通金戒指（每個價值25金幣）和650銀幣混合在一起。甕3堆滿了250金幣。甕4裝有33顆藍色石英寶石（每顆價值10金幣）。甕5裝有一個9吋高的銀製矮人牧師摩拉丁雕像，眼睛是紫水晶製成的（價值250金幣，重10磅）。

english: V6. Hammer and Anvil
zh_tw: V6. 錘子與鐵砧

english: The adamantine door to this room has an {@spell arcane lock} spell cast on it, but it swings open when a dwarf or a creature transformed into a dwarf touches it. Another creature can force it open with a successful {@dc 21} Strength (Athletics) check. A {@spell knock} spell or similar magic also opens it. The door swings into the room on stiff adamantine hinges.
zh_tw: 通往這個房間的精金門上被施放了{@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖}法術，但當矮人或變成矮人的生物觸碰它時，門會自行開啟。其他生物可以透過一次成功的{@dc 21}力量（運動）檢定強行開啟它。{@spell knock||敲擊術}法術或類似的魔法也能將其開啟。門透過堅固的精金鉸鏈向內旋轉開啟。

english: The north, east, and south walls of this 20-foot-high room are adorned with dust-covered frescoes depicting dwarf smiths at work in their forges.
zh_tw: 這個20尺高的房間的北面、東面和南面的牆壁上裝飾著覆蓋著灰塵的壁畫，描繪了矮人鐵匠在他們的鍛造爐中工作的情景。

english: An iron anvil sits atop a raised stone block in the middle of the floor. Both fixtures are draped in cobwebs.
zh_tw: 一個鐵砧位於地板中央的一個隆起的石塊上。兩者都被蜘蛛網覆蓋。

english: Frescoes
zh_tw: 壁畫

english: A character who inspects the wall frescoes and succeeds on a {@dc 10} Wisdom (Perception) check notices that the stone hammer being wielded by the smith in the fresco on the south wall can be taken away from where it rests. When removed, it leaves a hammer-shaped indentation in the wall. Etched into the side of the hammer that was facing the wall is the following inscription in Dwarvish runes: "Let hearts be lifted and battles won." The hammer must be removed from its indentation for the inscription to be seen.
zh_tw: 一個角色若檢查壁畫並在進行一次 {@dc 10} 感知（感知）檢定中成功，會注意到南牆壁畫中鐵匠所持的石錘可以從其原位取下。當取下後，牆上會留下一個錘形的凹痕。在錘子面向牆壁的那一側刻有如下矮人符文銘文："願心靈振奮，戰鬥得勝。" 必須將錘子從凹痕中取出，才能看到這段銘文。

english: Iron Anvil
zh_tw: 鐵砧

english: If the characters clear away the cobwebs, they see an inscription on the front of the stone block. Written in Dwarvish runes, it reads as follows: "Let the hammer fall and the anvil ring."
zh_tw: 如果角色們清除掉蜘蛛網，他們會在石塊的正面看到一段銘文。用矮人符文寫成，內容如下：'讓錘子落下，鐵砧響起。'

english: If the anvil is struck by the stone hammer that was taken from the wall, each creature in the room that can hear the anvil ring gains 10 temporary hit points that last for 24 hours. Once the anvil has bestowed this gift, it can't do so again for 24 hours.
zh_tw: 如果鐵砧被從牆上取下的石錘擊中，房間中每個能聽到鐵砧響聲的生物將獲得持續24小時的10點臨時生命值。一旦鐵砧賦予了這份禮物，它在接下來的24小時內就不能再這樣做了。

english: V7. Dumathoin's Secret
zh_tw: V7. 杜馬索因的秘密

english: This room is sealed by an adamantine door similar to the one in {@area V6|244}. The room contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間被一扇與{@area V6|244}中的相似的精金門封閉。房間裡包含以下特點：

english: Four suits of rusted plate armor sans helmets, sized for a dwarf, stand in the corners of this 20-foot-high room. Each suit is draped in cobwebs.
zh_tw: 四套沒有頭盔、鏽跡斑斑的板甲，尺寸適合矮人，擺放在這個20尺高的房間的四個角落。每套盔甲上都覆蓋著蜘蛛網。

english: Dwarvish runes are carved into the far wall. The inscription reads, "A secret never before told will part Dumathoin's lips."
zh_tw: 矮人符文被雕刻在遠牆上。銘文內容為："一個從未被講述的秘密將揭開杜馬索因的嘴唇。"

english: A successful {@dc 14} Intelligence (Religion) check identifies Dumathoin as the dwarven god of secrets. Any dwarf character automatically knows this.
zh_tw: 成功的 {@dc 14} 智力（宗教）檢定可識別出杜馬松是矮人的秘密之神。任何矮人角色自動知曉這一點。

english: Secret Stair
zh_tw: 秘密樓梯

english: The engraving on the wall is a clue that this room holds a secret, specifically a trapdoor so well hidden that it can't be found by using magic or searching. But when any creature in the room speaks aloud a secret, the trapdoor flips open, giving access to a spiral stone staircase that descends 120 feet to {@area V9|24b}. The spoken admission must be true, and it must be something the character has not previously revealed.
zh_tw: 牆上的雕刻是一個線索，表明這個房間隱藏著一個秘密，具體來說是一個如此隱蔽的陷阱門，以至於無法透過使用魔法或搜尋來找到。但是，當房間中的任何生物大聲說出一個秘密時，陷阱門就會翻轉開啟，露出一個螺旋形的石質樓梯，向下延伸120尺至{@area V9|24b}。所說的告白必須是真實的，並且是角色之前未曾透露過的。

english: V8. Ol' Fire Eyes
zh_tw: V8. 老火眼

english: This room has the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間有以下特點：

english: A 10-foot-tall painted statue of an armored male dwarf wielding a battleaxe and wearing a mask stands at the back of this 20-foot-high room.
zh_tw: 一個20尺高的房間的後部，矗立著一尊10尺高的彩繪雕像，雕像是一個身穿盔甲的男性矮人，手持戰斧，戴著面具。

english: Before the statue, set into the floor, is an adamantine trapdoor with a pull ring along one side.
zh_tw: 在雕像前，嵌入地板的是一個帶有一側拉環的精金陷阱門。

english: Trap
zh_tw: 陷阱

english: A successful {@dc 17} Intelligence (Religion) check enables a character to recognize the statue as a depiction of Gorm Gulthyn, the dwarven god of vigilance also known as Fire Eyes. The statue melds seamlessly with the floor and can't be toppled. It also seems impervious to damage. A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals an aura of evocation magic on the statue.
zh_tw: 成功的 {@dc 17} 智力（宗教）檢定使角色能夠認出雕像為戈姆·古爾辛的描繪，即矮人的警戒之神，也被稱為火眼。雕像與地板無縫融合，無法被推倒。它似乎也對傷害免疫。一個 {@spell detect magic||偵測魔法} 法術揭示了雕像上散發出的咒法魔法光環。

english: The trapdoor is false and can't be lifted. Anyone who touches the trapdoor or its pull ring must succeed on a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw or be struck by rays of magical fire that spring from the statue's eyes, dealing 22 ({@dice 4d10}) fire damage. The trap doesn't trigger if the target has {@quickref Cover||3||total cover}.
zh_tw: 這個活板門是虛假的，無法被抬起。任何觸碰活板門或其拉環的人必須成功透過一個 {@dc 18} 的敏捷豁免檢定，否則會被雕像眼中射出的魔法火焰射線擊中，造成 22 點（{@dice 4d10}）火焰傷害。如果目標有 {@quickref Cover||3||掩護}，陷阱不會觸發。

english: Barok Clanghammer
zh_tw: 巴洛克·鏗鎚

english: V9. Main Vault
zh_tw: V9. 主金庫

english: When the characters arrive here for the first time, read:
zh_tw: 當角色們第一次到達這裡時，請閱讀：

english: Although deep underground, this vault is lit by streams of sunlight that pour down from the ceiling, catching motes of dust in their luminous pools. Ornate columns support a thirty-foot-high vaulted ceiling, which is adorned with carvings of dwarves basking in the presence of their gods. Deep alcoves line the walls, and piled in one of them is a vast golden trove.
zh_tw: 儘管位於地下深處，這個金庫被從天花板傾瀉而下的日光流照亮，這些光線在它們明亮的光池中捕捉到了塵埃顆粒。裝飾華麗的柱子支撐著一個三十尺高的拱形天花板，天花板上裝飾著矮人沐浴在他們神明面前的雕刻。深深的壁龕排列在牆壁上，其中一個壁龕裡堆滿了巨大的金色寶藏。

english: Out of the dusty gloom steps an aged dwarf clutching a staff carved and painted to resemble a pair of entwined dragons-one red, one gold. Despite the dwarf's age, his eyes are steady and bright. "I wasn't expecting anyone," he says plainly. "As you can see, the place is a mess. Perhaps you should come back later, after I've tidied up a bit."
zh_tw: 從滿是灰塵的昏暗中走來一個年邁的矮人，他緊握著一根雕刻並漆成一對纏繞的龍形的手杖——一條紅色，一條金色。儘管這個矮人年紀已大，但他的眼神堅定而明亮。"我沒想到會有人來，"他直截了當地說。"正如你所見，這裡一團糟。也許你們應該在我稍微整理一下之後再回來。"

english: The dwarf, who calls himself Barok Clanghammer, is really the {@creature adult gold dragon} {@creature Aurinax|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) in disguise. He guards the gold for Lord Dagult Neverember and holds the {@item dragonstaff of Ahghairon|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix A|WDH|11}) in exchange for his services. Dealing with the gold dragon presents an unusual challenge for the characters, and a peaceful resolution is more likely to benefit them than a violent one.
zh_tw: 這位自稱巴洛克·鏗鎚的矮人，實際上是偽裝的{@creature adult gold dragon||成年金龍}{@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）。他守護著達格魯特·無燼領主的黃金，並持有{@item dragonstaff of Ahghairon|WDH|阿蓋爾倫的龍杖}（見{@adventure 附錄A|WDH|11}）作為其服務的交換。與金龍打交道對角色們來說是一項不尋常的挑戰，和平解決比暴力對抗更可能對他們有利。

english: {@creature Aurinax|WDH} is patient, wise, merciful, and vigilant. He remains in humanoid form until combat breaks out, since he can't easily carry the {@item dragonstaff of Ahghairon|WDH} in dragon form. The dragon attacks only in defense of itself, the staff, or the gold. The only individuals authorized to remove the gold under {@creature Aurinax|WDH}'s watch are Dagult Neverember and his appointed vassals, none of whom are currently in Waterdeep.
zh_tw: {@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯} 耐心、智慧、仁慈且警覺。他一直保持人形，直到戰鬥爆發，因為在龍形態下他不容易攜帶{@item dragonstaff of Ahghairon|WDH|阿蓋爾倫的龍杖}。龍只在自衛、保護法杖或黃金時才會攻擊。在{@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯}的看守下，唯一被授權移走黃金的人是達格魯特·無燼和他的指定封臣，而目前他們都不在深水城。

english: The characters can try to convince {@creature Aurinax|WDH} that they have come on Neverember's behalf. Since he has never met them before or heard Neverember mention them by name, {@creature Aurinax|WDH} is doubtful of their story. Fooling the dragon requires each character within his line of sight to succeed on a Charisma (Deception) check contested by the dragon's Wisdom (Insight) check. If even one character loses the contest, {@creature Aurinax|WDH} senses that the group is lying to him. These checks are made with advantage if {@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh} is with the party, since the dragon remembers meeting Renaer when he was but a child and can easily imagine a scenario in which Dagult Neverember might use his son as his vassal. (The dragon knows nothing of the animosity between Renaer and his father.)
zh_tw: 角色們可以嘗試說服{@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯}，他們是代表無燼而來。由於他以前從未見過他們，也從未聽無燼提及過他們的名字，{@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯}對他們的故事持懷疑態度。欺騙這條龍需要在他視線範圍內的每個角色成功進行一次魅力（欺瞞）檢定，與龍的感知（洞悉）檢定相對抗。即使只有一個角色在對抗中失敗，{@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯}也會感覺到這個團隊在對他撒謊。如果{@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh|瑞納爾·無燼}與隊伍在一起，這些檢定將獲得優勢，因為龍記得他小時候曾經見過瑞納爾，並且可以輕易想象達格魯特無燼可能使用他的兒子作為他的臣民的情況。（龍對瑞納爾和他父親之間的敵意一無所知。）

english: The characters can try to convince the noble dragon that Lord Neverember embezzled the gold from the people of Waterdeep, and that it would be fair and just to see the coin safely returned to its rightful owners. Deep down, {@creature Aurinax|WDH} knows where the gold came from, but the dragon has allowed his greed and his agreement with Lord Neverember to cloud his moral judgment. With a successful {@dc 18} Charisma (Persuasion) check, a character can talk the dragon into allowing the gold to be returned to the people to whom it rightfully belongs. The check is made with advantage if the characters brought a prominent city official with them, such as {@creature Mirt|WDH} or {@creature Vajra Safahr|WDH}, or if one of the characters professes to be a worshiper of Bahamut.
zh_tw: 角色們可以嘗試說服高貴的巨龍，認為無燼勳爵貪汙了深水城居民民的黃金，並且將金幣安全歸還給其合法所有者是公平和公正的。內心深處，{@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯}知道這些黃金的來源，但巨龍讓貪婪和他與無燼勳爵的協議模糊了他的道德判斷。透過一次成功的{@dc 18}魅力（說服）檢定，一個角色可以說服巨龍允許將黃金歸還給其合法主人。如果角色們帶來了一位顯赫的城市官員，比如{@creature Mirt|WDH|米爾特}或{@creature Vajra Safahr|WDH|瓦婕拉·莎法爾}，或者其中一個角色自稱是巴哈姆特的崇拜者，則該檢定將獲得優勢。

english: Any Charisma (Intimidation) check made to influence {@creature Aurinax|WDH} automatically fails. After the first such attempt, all future Charisma checks made by the party to influence {@creature Aurinax|WDH} have disadvantage.
zh_tw: 任何試圖影響{@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯}的魅力（威嚇）檢定都會自動失敗。在第一次這樣的嘗試之後，該隊伍未來所有試圖影響{@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯}的魅力檢定都將處於劣勢。

english: {@creature Aurinax|WDH} uses Legendary Resistance to avoid being {@condition charmed}. If a character tries to charm him with a spell and fails, all future Charisma checks made by the party to influence {@creature Aurinax|WDH} have disadvantage.
zh_tw: {@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯} 使用傳奇抗性來避免被{@condition charmed||魅惑}。如果一個角色試圖用法術魅惑他並且失敗了，那麼該隊伍未來所有試圖影響{@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯}的魅力檢定都將處於劣勢。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Choose two alcoves in the vault. Piled in one alcove are 500,000 gp, the combined weight of which is 10,000 pounds. Scattered on the floor of the second alcove are sixty-five 100 gp gemstones-all that remains of {@creature Aurinax|WDH}'s current food supply.
zh_tw: 在金庫中選擇兩個壁龕。一個壁龕裡堆放著500,000金幣，總重量為10,000磅。第二個壁龕的地板上散落著六十五顆價值100金幣的寶石——這是{@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯}當前食物供應所剩下的全部。

english: {@creature Aurinax|WDH} won't give up his gemstones or the {@item dragonstaff of Ahghairon|WDH} willingly, since they are his payment for guarding the gold. If need be, however, the dragon is willing to use the staff's power on behalf of the city in exchange for more gemstones.
zh_tw: {@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯} 不會自願放棄他的寶石或{@item dragonstaff of Ahghairon|WDH|阿蓋爾倫的龍杖}，因為它們是他守護黃金的報酬。然而，如果必要，龍願意為了更多的寶石而使用法杖的力量來代表這座城市。

english: Leaving the Vault
zh_tw: 離開金庫

english: As the characters leave the vault, with or without the gold, they are confronted by a hostile force sent by the main villain or villains. If the vault doors were left open, the characters encounter these antagonists in {@area V2|23a}; otherwise, they're lurking outside the vault, waiting for the characters to emerge:
zh_tw: 當角色們離開金庫，無論是否攜帶黃金，他們都會遭遇由主要反派或反派們派出的敵對力量。如果金庫門被留開，角色們將在{@area V2|23a}遇到這些對手；否則，他們就潛伏在金庫外，等待角色們出現：

english: If {@creature Xanathar|WDH} is the main villain, {@creature Noska Ur'gray|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) arrives with six {@creature bugbear||bugbears} and a {@creature gazer|VGM} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}). If Noska is dead or otherwise indisposed, the beholder replaces him with {@creature Nar'l Xibrindas|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) and his {@creature grell} bodyguard.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}是主要反派，{@creature Noska Ur'gray|wdh|諾思卡·厄格雷}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）將帶著六隻{@creature bugbear||熊地精}和一隻{@creature gazer|VGM|凝視者眼魔}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）到達。如果諾思卡已死或因其他原因無法行動，眼魔將他替換為{@creature Nar'l Xibrindas|wdh|納爾·澤布林達斯}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）和他的{@creature grell||觸鬚怪}保鏢。

english: If the Cassalanters are the villains, they send three {@creature cult fanatic||cult fanatics} and three {@creature cultist||cultists}. Victoro's {@creature doppelganger} manservant, {@creature Willifort Crowelle|WDH}, leads the group in his tiefling guise unless the characters killed him or otherwise disposed of him earlier in this chapter or in chapter 6.
zh_tw: 如果卡薩蘭特家族是反派，他們派出了三名{@creature cult fanatic||邪教狂信者}和三名{@creature cultist||邪教徒}。維克托羅的{@creature doppelganger||變形怪}男僕，{@creature Willifort Crowelle|WDH|威利福特·克羅威爾}，以他的提夫林偽裝領導著這個小組，除非角色們在本章或第6章早些時候已經殺死了他或以其他方式處理了他。

english: If {@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) is the villain, he arrives with three {@creature drow gunslinger|WDH|drow gunslingers} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}). Replace no-name drow gunslingers with {@creature Fel'rekt Lafeen|WDH}, {@creature Krebbyg Masq'il'yr|WDH}, and {@creature Soluun Xibrindas|wdh} if they are alive and free.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH|賈拉索·班瑞}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）是反派，他將帶著三名{@creature drow gunslinger|WDH|卓爾火槍手}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）到來。如果他們活著並且自由，將無名的卓爾火槍手替換為{@creature Fel'rekt Lafeen|WDH|菲爾萊科特·拉菲恩}、{@creature Krebbyg Masq'il'yr|WDH|克雷比格·馬斯奇爾}和{@creature Soluun Xibrindas|wdh|索倫·希布林達斯}。

english: If {@creature Manshoon|WDH} is the main villain, he sends his simulacrum (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) along with Agorn Fuoco (NE male Turami human {@creature bard|VGM}; see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), Vevette Blackwater (CE female Tethyrian human {@creature swashbuckler|VGM}; see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), and three Zhent {@creature thug||thugs}. If Agorn and Vevette were killed or otherwise disposed of earlier in this chapter or in chapter 8, replace each of them with one additional {@creature thug}.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}是主要反派，他將派出他的擬像（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）以及阿戈恩·弗奧科（NE男性圖拉米人人類{@creature bard|VGM|吟遊詩人}；見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）、薇薇特·黑水（CE女性泰瑟爾人人類{@creature swashbuckler|VGM|風流劍客}；見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）和三名散塔林會成員{@creature thug||暴徒}。如果在本章或第8章早些時候阿戈恩和薇薇特被殺或以其他方式處理，將他們中的每一個替換為一個額外的{@creature thug||暴徒}。

english: The forces sent by {@creature Xanathar|WDH}, the Cassalanters, and {@creature Manshoon|WDH} attack the characters on sight. Jarlaxle, on the other hand, congratulates characters for unlocking the Vault of Dragons and allows them to leave on the condition that they go empty-handed. He intends to see the gold safely returned to the city of Waterdeep but also demands the {@item dragonstaff of Ahghairon|WDH} for his trouble.
zh_tw: 由{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}、卡薩蘭特家族和{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}派出的部隊一見到角色就會發動攻擊。另一方面，賈拉索祝賀角色們解開了龍之寶庫的鎖，並允許他們空手離開，條件是他們必須離開。他打算看到黃金安全地返回深水城，但同時也要求得到{@item dragonstaff of Ahghairon|WDH|阿蓋爾倫的龍杖}作為他所費心力的報酬。

english: If {@creature Aurinax|WDH} is alive, the characters can lure enemies to the dragon. {@creature Aurinax|WDH} attacks any creature that attacks him or tries to steal his staff or the gold. He also defends the characters if he has made a deal with them.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯}還活著，角色們可以誘使敵人去攻擊龍。{@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯}會攻擊任何攻擊他或試圖偷走他的法杖或黃金的生物。如果他與角色們達成了協議，他也會保護角色們。

english: Faction Reinforcements
zh_tw: 派系增援

english: If the characters joined one or more factions in Waterdeep and kept them informed of their progress, you can have reinforcements arrive to help combat the villains or introduce a new element to the situation.
zh_tw: 如果角色們加入了深水城的一個或多個派系，並且一直向他們通報進展情況，你可以安排增援部隊到達，幫助對抗反派或為情況引入新元素。

english: Bregan D'aerthe
zh_tw: 布雷甘·達耶

english: If {@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) isn't the main villain, he arrives with his lieutenants, {@creature Fel'rekt Lafeen|WDH}, {@creature Krebbyg Masq'il'yr|WDH}, and {@creature Soluun Xibrindas|wdh}, or three other {@creature drow gunslinger|WDH|drow gunslingers} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}). Jarlaxle offers to help the characters if they agree to help him secure the gold for Waterdeep and the {@item dragonstaff of Ahghairon|WDH} for himself.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH|賈拉索·班瑞}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）不是主要反派，他將帶著他的副手{@creature Fel'rekt Lafeen|WDH|菲爾萊科特·拉菲恩}、{@creature Krebbyg Masq'il'yr|WDH|克雷比格·馬斯奇爾}和{@creature Soluun Xibrindas|wdh|索倫·希布林達斯}，或者另外三名{@creature drow gunslinger|WDH|卓爾火槍手}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）到達。賈拉索提出幫助角色們，如果他們同意幫助他確保黃金安全運抵深水城，並且將{@item dragonstaff of Ahghairon|WDH|阿蓋爾倫的龍杖}留給他自己。

english: Harpers
zh_tw: 豎琴手聯盟

english: {@creature Mirt|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) arrives with two female human {@creature swashbuckler|VGM|swashbucklers} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}). If he's still alive and not already with the characters, {@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) replaces one of the swashbucklers.
zh_tw: {@creature Mirt|WDH|米爾特}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）帶著兩名女性人類{@creature swashbuckler|VGM|風流劍客}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）到達。如果他仍然活著並且還沒有加入角色們，{@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh|瑞納爾·無燼}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）將取代其中一名風流劍客。

english: Emerald Enclave
zh_tw: 翠綠閒庭

english: Jeryth Phaulkon sends three {@creature swarm of rats||swarms of rats} to assist the characters. Once the characters are no longer in peril, the rats disperse throughout the vault.
zh_tw: 傑瑞斯·波康派出三群{@creature swarm of rats||老鼠群}來協助角色們。一旦角色們不再處於危險之中，這些老鼠就會散佈在整個金庫中。

english: Force Grey
zh_tw: 灰色力量

english: {@creature Vajra Safahr|WDH} sends {@creature Meloon Wardragon|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) to help the characters secure the vault, unaware that Meloon has fallen under {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s sway. If {@creature Xanathar|WDH} is the main villain, Meloon helps the beholder's forces defeat the characters.
zh_tw: {@creature Vajra Safahr|WDH|瓦婕拉·莎法爾} 派遣{@creature Meloon Wardragon|WDH|麥倫·戰龍}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）來幫助角色們確保金庫的安全，但她不知道麥倫已經受到{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的影響。如果{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}是主要反派，麥倫將幫助眼魔的部隊擊敗角色們。

english: Lords' Alliance
zh_tw: 領主聯盟

english: Open Lord {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) arrives with {@creature Jalester Silvermane|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) and six City Guard {@creature veteran||veterans} to help characters secure the gold. Laeral's arrival forces Jarlaxle to be on his best behavior. After assuring Laeral of his good intentions, Jarlaxle cuts his losses and withdraws peacefully. If she is able to speak with {@creature Aurinax|WDH}, Laeral convinces the dragon to relinquish the gold into her custody.
zh_tw: 公開領主{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）帶著{@creature Jalester Silvermane|WDH|加萊斯特·銀鬃}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）和六名城防軍{@creature veteran||老兵}到達，幫助角色們確保黃金的安全。萊拉的到來迫使賈拉索表現得最好。在向萊拉保證他的好意之後，賈拉索減少損失並和平撤退。如果她能夠與{@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯}交談，萊拉說服龍將黃金交給她的監管。

english: Order of the Gauntlet
zh_tw: 鐵手套教團

english: {@creature Hlam|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) arrives and aids the characters as best he can. He and {@creature Aurinax|WDH} met each other many years ago, and they are on fair speaking terms. {@creature Aurinax|WDH} is fond of the monk, and characters who negotiate with the dragon in {@creature Hlam|WDH}'s presence gain advantage on their Charisma (Persuasion) checks.
zh_tw: {@creature Hlam|WDH|胡拉姆}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）到達並盡他所能地幫助角色們。他和{@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯}多年前就相識了，並且他們相處得很融洽。{@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯}喜歡這位僧侶，當角色們在{@creature Hlam|WDH|胡拉姆}面前與龍進行談判時，他們在魅力（說服）檢定上獲得優勢。

english: Zhentarim
zh_tw: 散塔林會

english: The Doom Raiders (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) arrive to help secure the vault, less any members who have been arrested or killed. If {@creature Manshoon|WDH} is the main villain, {@creature Skeemo Weirdbottle|WDH} betrays his fellow Doom Raiders and fights alongside {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s simulacrum. If they and the characters emerge victorious, the surviving Doom Raiders propose to split the take evenly with the characters. If the characters refuse this offer and the Doom Raiders outnumber them, the Zhents turn against them, putting characters who are Zhentarim members in a predicament.
zh_tw: 末日劫掠者（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）到達幫助確保金庫的安全，不包括已經被逮捕或殺死的成員。如果{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}是主要反派，{@creature Skeemo Weirdbottle|WDH|斯齊莫·奇瓶}背叛了他的末日劫掠者同伴，與{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的擬像並肩作戰。如果他們和角色們取得勝利，倖存的末日劫掠者提議與角色們平均分配收益。如果角色們拒絕這個提議，並且末日劫掠者的人數超過他們，散塔林會成員會反對他們，這讓散塔林會的成員角色們陷入困境。

english: Adventure Conclusion
zh_tw: 冒險結局

english: The adventure could play out in any of several ways, depending on who gets the gold and what's done with the treasure.
zh_tw: 冒險可能會以幾種不同的方式展開，這取決於誰得到了金幣，以及這些財寶被如何處理。

english: Dying in the Vault
zh_tw: 在金庫中死去

english: If the characters die in the Vault of Dragons with the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} and the main villain doesn't know the vault's location, the secrets of the vault die with them. Though they succumbed in the process, they succeeded in keeping the gold out of the villain's clutches-a bittersweet victory, indeed.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在龍之寶庫中死去，並且持有{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，而主要反派不知道金庫的位置，那麼金庫的秘密將隨他們一同死去。儘管他們在過程中屈服了，但他們成功地阻止了黃金落入反派之手——這確實是一場苦樂參半的勝利。

english: Removing the Gold
zh_tw: 移除黃金

english: If the characters recover Neverember's hoard and keep it for themselves, word gets out eventually.
zh_tw: 如果角色們找回了無燼的寶藏並自己保留，最終訊息會傳出去。

english: Emissaries of the Harpers, the Lords' Alliance, and the Order of the Gauntlet come to the characters, asking that the gold be returned to Waterdeep. If the characters refuse to give it up, they are stripped of any memberships they might hold in these factions and quickly find themselves in political hot water. The Lords of Waterdeep charge them with the crime of robbery against the citizens of the city. The characters face up to 1 month of hard labor plus damages equal to the value of the stolen currency plus 500 gp. If they try to flee the city, the City Guard apprehends and imprisons them. If they somehow evade the local authorities, the Harpers and agents of the Lords' Alliance pursue them tirelessly.
zh_tw: 豎琴手聯盟的使者、領主聯盟和鐵手套教團來到角色們面前，要求將黃金歸還給深水城。如果角色們拒絕放棄，他們將被剝奪在這些派系中可能持有的任何成員資格，並很快發現自己陷入了政治困境。深水城的領主們指控他們犯有對城市公民的盜竊罪。角色們面臨高達一個月的苦役，外加相當於被盜貨幣價值加上500金幣的賠償。如果他們試圖逃離這座城市，城防軍會逮捕並監禁他們。如果他們設法逃避地方當局，豎琴手聯盟和領主聯盟的代理人將不懈地追捕他們。

english: {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH} is prepared to let the characters keep one-tenth of the treasure (50,000 gp) for themselves. Even that much coin attracts unwanted attention, in the form of several people who beg loans or donations from them:
zh_tw: {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手} 準備讓角色們自己保留寶藏的十分之一（50,000金幣）。即使這麼多的錢幣也吸引了不想要的注意，表現為幾個人向他們乞求貸款或捐款：

english: {@creature Emmek Frewn|WDH} (see "Business Rival: {@creature Emmek Frewn|WDH}") needs 1,500 gp to pay off a loan with interest. If he doesn't repay the coin in a tenday, {@creature Istrid Horn|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) sends Zhentarim thugs to threaten, if not hurt, him. Emmek comes to the characters with hat in hand, preying on their generosity while denying any wrongdoing on his part.
zh_tw: {@creature Emmek Frewn|WDH|埃梅克·弗倫}（見"商業競爭對手：{@creature Emmek Frewn|WDH|埃梅克·弗倫}"）需要1500金幣來連本帶利償還一筆貸款。如果他在十天內不償還這筆錢，{@creature Istrid Horn|WDH|伊思崔德·霍恩}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）會派散塔林會的暴徒來威脅，如果不傷害他的話。埃梅克帶著帽子來到角色們面前，利用他們的慷慨，同時否認自己有任何過錯。

english: {@creature Davil Starsong|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) asks the characters for a donation of 5,000 gp to keep his branch of the Zhentarim afloat in Waterdeep. Recent altercations and legal issues have drained the Doom Raiders' coffers. If the characters refuse, the Doom Raiders are driven out of the city, yielding control of the Zhentarim in Waterdeep to {@creature Manshoon|WDH} (if he's alive).
zh_tw: {@creature Davil Starsong|WDH|達維爾·星歌}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）請求角色們捐贈5000金幣，以維持他在深水城的散塔林會分支。最近發生的爭執和法律問題耗盡了末日劫掠者的金庫。如果角色們拒絕，末日劫掠者將被迫離開這座城市，將深水城散塔林會的控制權讓給{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}（如果他還活著）。

english: {@creature Floon Blagmaar|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) asks the characters to give him 500 gp to cover a hefty gambling debt. If the characters refuse to give Floon the gold, he vanishes without a trace {@dice 1d10} days later.
zh_tw: {@creature Floon Blagmaar|WDH|福盧恩·布拉格瑪}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）要求角色們給他500金幣以償還鉅額賭債。如果角色們拒絕給福盧恩金子，他會在{@dice 1d10}天后無影無蹤地消失。

english: {@creature Volothamp "Volo" Geddarm|ToA|Volothamp Geddarm} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) asks the characters for 5,000 gp to fund an expedition that he hopes will inspire a future book, for which he'll give them special mention in said masterwork. If the characters seem hesitant, Volo reminds them that were it not for his starting them off on this adventure, they wouldn't have the gold in the first place.
zh_tw: {@creature Volothamp "Volo" Geddarm|ToA|瓦羅贊普·格達姆}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）向角色們請求5000金幣來資助一次探險，他希望這次探險能啟發他未來的一本書，並在該書中特別提及他們。如果角色們似乎猶豫不決，瓦羅提醒他們，如果不是他最初引導他們開始這次冒險，他們一開始就不會有這些黃金。

english: Jelenn Urmbrusk, a Masked Lord in debt to {@creature Manshoon|WDH}, requests an interest-free loan of 10,000 gp, which she vows to repay within a year. In exchange, she promises to use her "considerable influence with the Lords of Waterdeep" to help them in the future. If the characters oblige, she makes good on her promise to pay them back and grants them a special favor (see "Marks of Prestige" in chapter 7 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|dmg}). If they refuse, they will have made an enemy of the secret Masked Lord.
zh_tw: 傑倫·烏姆布魯斯克，一位欠{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}債務的蒙面領主，請求一筆10,000金幣的無息貸款，並承諾在一年內償還。作為交換，她承諾將利用她"在深水城領主中的巨大影響力"在未來幫助他們。如果角色們答應，她將履行承諾償還債務，並給予他們一個特殊的恩惠（參見{@book 城主指南|dmg}第7章中的"聲望標記"）。如果他們拒絕，他們將與這位秘密的蒙面領主為敵。

english: Temples, charities, guilds, and down-on-their-luck strangers come knocking from time to time. What they ask for isn't much-a few gold here and there-but it all adds up.
zh_tw: 寺廟、慈善機構、行會以及時運不濟的陌生人時不時地來敲門。他們所要求的並不多——這裡一點金子，那裡一點金子——但累積起來也是一筆不小的數目。

english: Onward and Downward
zh_tw: 向前並向下

english: The characters should be 5th level by the end of this adventure. In the weeks that follow, word of their deeds spreads to every corner of Waterdeep. Finally, a note is delivered to them that reads as follows:
zh_tw: 角色們在這次冒險結束時應該達到5級。在隨後的幾周裡，他們的事蹟傳遍了深水城的每一個角落。最後，他們收到了一封寫著如下內容的便條：

english: Undermountain beckons. See you at the Yawning Portal.
zh_tw: 地脈迷城正召喚著你。呵欠之門見。

english: If the characters want to explore Undermountain, you can continue this campaign up through 20th level with the book {@i Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage}.
zh_tw: 如果角色們想要探索地脈迷城，你可以使用書籍《{@i 深水城: 瘋法師的地城}》繼續這個戰役，直到20級。

english: Chapter 5: Spring Madness
zh_tw: 第5章：春日瘋狂

english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH} has let its paranoia get the better of it, and the beholder trusts no one. The {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} disappeared from its lair while it was brokering a deal that would have merged the Xanathar Guild and the Zhentarim into a single criminal organization. Although the Zhents didn't steal the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, {@creature Xanathar|WDH} believes they did. Once content to merely possess the stone, the beholder is no longer confident of the gold's safety in the Vault of Dragons. {@creature Xanathar|WDH} thinks that the gold would be safer under its watchful gaze, but without the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, it can't remember where the gold is hidden.
zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的偏執情緒已經佔據了上風，這個眼魔不再信任任何人。當它正在促成一項將姍娜薩公會和散塔林會合併為單一犯罪組織的交易時，{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}從它的巢穴中消失了。儘管散塔林會成員並沒有偷走{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，但{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}卻認為他們偷了。曾經滿足於僅僅擁有這塊石頭的眼魔，不再對龍之寶庫中黃金的安全性感到自信。{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}認為在它的警惕目光下，黃金會更安全，但沒有了{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，它記不得黃金藏在哪裡了。

english: Before running this chapter, review the "Beholders" section of the {@book Monster Manual|mm}, particularly the section titled "A Beholder's Lair." Within its lair, {@creature Xanathar|WDH} has access to lair actions, and characters might encounter the beholder's regional effects as well.
zh_tw: 在進行這一章節之前，請先回顧《{@book 怪物圖鑑|mm}》中的"眼魔"（眼魔）部分，特別是標題為"眼魔的巢穴"（眼魔的巢穴）的部分。在其巢穴內，{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}可以使用巢穴行動，角色們也可能會遇到眼魔的區域效果。

english: Characters who don't visit {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s lair in the course of this adventure might have reason to do so in {@i Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage}. In that adventure, the characters are most likely to approach the beholder's lair from Skullport (see {@area X4|278} for details).
zh_tw: 在本冒險中沒有前往{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}巢穴的角色，可能會在{@i 深水城: 瘋法師的地城}中有理由前往。在那個冒險中，角色最有可能從骷髏港接近眼魔的巢穴（詳情見{@area X4|278}）。

english: As they explore {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s lair, characters will see a recurring symbol that looks like a circle with ten equidistant spokes radiating out from its circumference. This symbol is {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s personal rune as well as the symbol used to represent the Xanathar Guild.
zh_tw: 當角色們探索{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的巢穴時，他們會看到一個反覆出現的符號，看起來像一個圓，從它的周長輻射出十個等距的輻條。這個符號是{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的個人符文，也是用來代表姍娜薩公會的符號。

english: Facing Xanathar
zh_tw: 面對姍娜薩

english: Roll percentile dice to determine the beholder's location when the characters arrive, and consult the {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s Location table.
zh_tw: 當角色們到達時，擲百分骰來確定眼魔的位置，並檢視{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的位置表。

english: Xanathar's Location
zh_tw: 姍娜薩的位置

english: Result
zh_tw: 結果

english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH} is talking to {@creature Sylgar|wdh}, its pet fish, in {@area X19|29c}.
zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩} 正在與它的寵物魚{@creature Sylgar|wdh|斯爾嘉}在{@area X19|29c}交談。

english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH} is delivering a rambling sermon to minions in the audience chamber ({@area X18|29a}).
zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩} 正在聽眾室（{@area X18|29a}）向在場的手下們發表一篇冗長的佈道。

english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH} is watching a fight in the Pit of Blood and Fortune ({@area X6|27a}).
zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩} 正在血與命運之坑（{@area X6|27a}）觀看一場戰鬥。

english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH} is contemplating its mortality in the crypt, amid the remains of past Xanathars ({@area X33|2bf}).
zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩} 正在墓穴中沉思其不朽，周圍是過去姍娜薩的遺骸（{@area X33|2bf}）。

english: If the characters attack the beholder, it destroys one character and tries to subjugate the rest. In exchange for their lives, the survivors must agree to help the beholder find the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}. If they refuse, the beholder destroys another character and repeats the offer. This process continues until the characters comply or none are left. Those who agree to the beholder's terms are permitted to leave with their lives.
zh_tw: 如果角色們攻擊眼魔，它會消滅一個角色，並試圖征服其餘的人。作為交換，生還者必須同意幫助眼魔找到{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}。如果他們拒絕，眼魔會再消滅一個角色，並重復提議。這個過程會一直持續，直到角色們遵守或者無一倖存。那些同意眼魔條件的人將被允許帶著他們的生命離開。

english: If the characters give {@creature Xanathar|WDH} the stone, it demands that they accompany it to the Vault of Dragons and help it defeat the vault's draconic guardian. Not fully trusting the characters to keep their part of the bargain, {@creature Xanathar|WDH} brings along its majordomo, {@creature Ahmaergo|WDH}, to keep an eye on them.
zh_tw: 如果角色們給{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}那塊石頭，它會要求他們陪同它前往龍之寶庫，並幫助它擊敗金庫的龍類守衛。{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}並不完全信任角色們會履行他們的交易部分，因此它帶上了它的管家{@creature Ahmaergo|WDH|阿莫戈}來監視他們。

english: If {@creature Xanathar|WDH} is reduced to half its maximum hit points, or if it believes its life to be in mortal danger, it activates its {@item ring of invisibility} and howls to {@creature Ahmaergo|WDH} to "tear the usurpers limb from limb." While {@condition invisible}, {@creature Xanathar|WDH} flies to its sanctum ({@area X19|29c}) by the safest route.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的生命值降至其最大值的一半，或者如果它認為自己的生命處於致命危險之中，它會啟用它的{@item ring of invisibility||隱身戒指}並嚎叫著讓{@creature Ahmaergo|WDH|阿莫戈}"將篡位者撕成碎片"。在{@condition invisible||隱形}狀態下，{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}會沿著最安全的路線飛往它的聖所（{@area X19|29c}）。

english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s greatest weakness is its insane love for its pet fish, {@creature Sylgar|wdh}. A character who uses the fish for leverage can make a {@dc 16} Charisma (Intimidation) check. On a success, the fearsome beholder becomes a blubbering mess and acquiesces to almost any request the character makes. On a failure, {@creature Xanathar|WDH} demands that the character release {@creature Sylgar|WDH} at once or be disintegrated (and makes good on its threat).
zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的最大弱點，是它對其寵物魚 {@creature Sylgar|wdh|斯爾嘉}的瘋狂喜愛。角色可以利用這條魚作為籌碼，進行一次 {@dc 16} 魅力（威嚇）檢定。若成功，這個可怕的眼魔會變成一個哭泣的軟蛋，並幾乎同意角色提出的任何要求。若失敗，{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}會要求角色立即釋放 {@creature Sylgar|WDH|斯爾嘉}，否則將被解離（並且它會兌現這一威脅）。

english: Foiling Xanathar's Operation
zh_tw: 破壞姍娜薩的行動

english: Killing the beholder is probably beyond the characters' capabilities, but they can sabotage its operation in several ways, affecting either the beholder personally or the smooth functioning of the Xanathar Guild. They might even be able to marshal sufficient resources (including enough explosives) to bring down {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s lair.
zh_tw: 殺死眼魔可能超出了角色們的能力範圍，但他們可以透過幾種方式破壞其運作，無論是直接影響眼魔本身還是影響姍娜薩公會的順利運作。他們甚至可能能夠集結足夠的資源（包括足夠的炸藥）來摧毀{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的巢穴。

english: Enrage Xanathar
zh_tw: 激怒姍娜薩

english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s mental state is precarious. Whenever it flies into a rage, the beholder tends to kill random minions.
zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的精神狀況很不穩定。每當它暴怒時，這個眼魔往往會隨機殺死手下。

english: Abduct or Kill Sylgar
zh_tw: 綁架或殺死斯爾嘉

english: Killing or stealing {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s pet fish and preventing the fishkeeper, {@creature Ott Steeltoes|wdh}, from replacing it causes {@creature Xanathar|WDH} to become enraged.
zh_tw: 殺死或偷走{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的寵物魚，並阻止魚塘管理員{@creature Ott Steeltoes|wdh|奧特·鋼趾}替換它，會導致{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}變得憤怒。

english: Destroy the Dream Nullifier
zh_tw: 摧毀夢境消除器

english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s "dream nullifier" in {@area X20|2a2} gives it peace of mind and helps it sleep. Destroying this contraption makes the beholder unhappy.
zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}在{@area X20|2a2}的"夢境中和器"讓它心情平靜，並幫助它睡眠。破壞這個裝置會讓這個眼魔不快樂。

english: Take Its Food Away
zh_tw: 拿走它的食物

english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH} eats meals prepared by the kobold chefs in {@area X30|2ba}. Killing these kobolds or otherwise preventing them from preparing meals makes {@creature Xanathar|WDH} furious.
zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩} 吃由在 {@area X30|2ba} 的狗頭人廚師準備的餐食。殺死這些狗頭人或以其他方式阻止他們準備餐食會讓 {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩} 變得狂怒。

english: Disrupt Command
zh_tw: 擾亂命令

english: Even though the beholder is the supreme leader of the Xanathar Guild, its lieutenants manage the guild's day-to-day operations. The chain of command can be disrupted in any of the following ways.
zh_tw: 儘管眼魔是姍娜薩公會的最高領袖，但其副手們管理著公會的日常運作。可以透過以下任何方式來破壞指揮鏈。

english: Assassination
zh_tw: 暗殺

english: Killing one of {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s most trusted underlings, such as {@creature Ahmaergo|WDH} or {@creature Noska Ur'gray|wdh}, throws the day-to-day operation of the guild into chaos for a tenday.
zh_tw: 殺死{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}最信任的手下之一，比如{@creature Ahmaergo|WDH|阿莫戈}或{@creature Noska Ur'gray|wdh|諾思卡·厄格雷}，會讓公會的日常運作在十天內陷入混亂。

english: Blind Xanathar
zh_tw: 使姍娜薩失明

english: {@creature Nar'l Xibrindas|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) has concocted a poison that can blind {@creature Xanathar|WDH} and throw the guild into chaos.
zh_tw: {@creature Nar'l Xibrindas|wdh|納爾·澤布林達斯}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）配製了一種毒藥，可以使{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}失明，並將公會陷入混亂。

english: Sow Mistrust
zh_tw: 播下不信任

english: If the beholder is tricked into believing there's a conspiracy to kill it or {@creature Sylgar|wdh}, it disintegrates the suspected conspirators, leaving gaping holes in the chain of command.
zh_tw: 如果眼魔被騙相信存在一個陰謀要殺害它或{@creature Sylgar|wdh|斯爾嘉}，它會將被懷疑的陰謀家解體，從而在指揮鏈中留下巨大的空缺。

english: Important Underlings
zh_tw: 重要下屬

english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH} relies on underlings for advice, information, and day-to-day oversight of the Xanathar Guild. The following important underlings are described in appendix B:
zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩} 依賴手下提供建議、資訊以及對姍娜薩公會日常運作的監督。附錄 B 中描述了以下重要的手下：

english: {@creature Ahmaergo|WDH}, dwarf majordomo
zh_tw: {@creature Ahmaergo|WDH|阿莫戈}，矮人管家

english: {@creature Nar'l Xibrindas|wdh}, drow advisor
zh_tw: {@creature Nar'l Xibrindas|wdh|納爾·澤布林達斯}, 黑暗精靈顧問

english: {@creature Nihiloor|WDH}, {@creature mind flayer}
zh_tw: {@creature Nihiloor|WDH|尼希盧爾}, {@creature mind flayer||奪心魔}

english: {@creature Noska Ur'gray|wdh}, dwarf enforcer
zh_tw: {@creature Noska Ur'gray|wdh|諾思卡·厄格雷}, 矮人執行者

english: {@creature Ott Steeltoes|wdh}, dwarf fishkeeper
zh_tw: {@creature Ott Steeltoes|wdh|奧特·鋼趾}，矮人魚塘管理員

english: {@creature Thorvin Twinbeard|wdh}, dwarf engineer
zh_tw: {@creature Thorvin Twinbeard|wdh|索文·雙須}, 矮人工程師

english: Destroy the Lair
zh_tw: 摧毀巢穴

english: {@creature Nar'l Xibrindas|wdh} has smuggled smokepowder into the lair (see {@area X36|2cb}) and, with {@creature Thorvin Twinbeard|wdh}'s help, identified areas that are structurally unstable. If these areas all suffer catastrophic damage, the lair collapses over the course of 1 hour. Characters can learn this information by speaking to Thorvin in {@area X13|28d}. The unstable areas are as follows:
zh_tw: {@creature Nar'l Xibrindas|wdh|納爾·澤布林達斯} 走私了煙粉進入巢穴（見 {@area X36|2cb}），並且在 {@creature Thorvin Twinbeard|wdh|索文·雙須} 的幫助下，確定了結構不穩定的區域。如果這些區域都遭受了災難性的損害，巢穴將在1小時內坍塌。角色可以透過在 {@area X13|28d} 與索文對話來瞭解這些資訊。不穩定的區域如下：

english: {@area X2|273|u}, in the threshold of the secret door
zh_tw: {@area X2|273|u}，在秘密門的門檻上

english: {@area X6|27a|u}, at the top of the stone buttresses
zh_tw: {@area X6|27a|u}，在石拱頂上

english: {@area X17|297|u}, at the base of any three pillars
zh_tw: {@area X17|297|u}，在任意三根柱子的基座

english: {@area X20|2a2|u}, against the back wall
zh_tw: {@area X20|2a2|u}，靠後牆

english: {@area X22|2a5|u}, between the columns
zh_tw: {@area X22|2a5|u}，在柱子之間

english: {@area X30|2ba|u}, anywhere in the kitchen
zh_tw: {@area X30|2ba|u}，在廚房內的任何地方

english: {@area X33|2bf|u}, anywhere in the crypt
zh_tw: {@area X33|2bf|u}，在墓穴的任何地方

english: As its lair collapses, {@creature Xanathar|WDH} uses its Disintegration Ray to carve an escape tunnel and flees to safety with minor injuries. It uses its Telekinetic Ray to transport its pet fish, {@creature Sylgar|wdh}, if it's within range. Underlings can flee with the beholder or through the tunnel to Skullport ({@area X4|278}). Those who can't accomplish either of these things are killed in the collapse.
zh_tw: 當它的巢穴倒塌時，{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩} 使用其解離射線挖掘一條逃生隧道，並帶著輕傷逃到安全地帶。如果它在範圍內，它會使用其心靈射線將其寵物魚{@creature Sylgar|wdh|斯爾嘉}傳送走。手下們可以和眼魔一起逃跑，或者透過隧道逃到骷髏港({@area X4|278})。那些無法做到這兩件事的人在崩塌中喪生。

english: Stealing {@creature Sylgar|WDH}
zh_tw: 偷走{@creature Sylgar|WDH|斯爾嘉}

english: Xanathar's Lair
zh_tw: 姍娜薩的巢穴

english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s lair is an ancient dungeon complex originally built by Netherese wizards and expanded by beholders over time. It connects to the subterranean town of Skullport by way of a long tunnel ({@area X4|278}). A secret staircase ({@area X1|271}) gives access to Waterdeep's sewers.
zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的巢穴是一個古老的地牢複合體，最初由耐瑟瑞爾語法師建造，並隨著時間的推移被眼魔擴充套件。它透過一條長隧道({@area X4|278})與地下城鎮骷髏港相連。一個秘密樓梯({@area X1|271})可以進入深水城的下水道。

english: The lair has the following features, with exceptions noted in the text:
zh_tw: 這個巢穴有以下特點，文字中註明瞭例外情況：

english: Unless noted otherwise, rooms are 20 feet high and hallways are 15 feet high.
zh_tw: 除非另有說明，房間高度為20尺，走廊高度為15尺。

english: Rooms and corridors are brightly lit by {@spell continual flame} spells cast on wall sconces.
zh_tw: 房間和走廊透過施放在壁燈上的{@spell continual flame||不滅明焰}法術明亮地照亮。

english: Most doors are single, circular slabs of stone, 8 feet in diameter and 6 inches thick, with stone hinges on one side. Double doors are 16-foot-wide, 8-foot-high semicircles that split open down the middle. Doorknobs are set into stone fixtures shaped like {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s symbol. ({@creature Xanathar|WDH} can open or close an unlocked door using its Telekinetic Ray, or obliterate a locked one with its Disintegration Ray.)
zh_tw: 大多數門是單一的圓形石板，直徑8尺，厚6吋，一側有石制鉸鏈。雙開門是寬16尺、高8尺的半圓形，中間分開。門把手嵌入到形狀像{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的標誌的石制固定裝置中。({@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}可以使用它的念力射線開啟或關閉一個未上鎖的門，或者用它的解離射線摧毀一個上鎖的門。)

english: Getting to the Lair
zh_tw: 到達巢穴

english: Very few members of the Xanathar Guild have access to the beholder's secret lair. If the characters want to get there, the following factions know where it is and can help them find it.
zh_tw: 姍娜薩公會的極少數成員能夠進入眼魔的秘密巢穴。如果角色們想要到達那裡，以下派系知道它的位置並且可以幫助他們找到它。

english: Bregan D'aerthe
zh_tw: 布雷甘·達耶

english: Jarlaxle has a spy in the Xanathar Guild: the advisor {@creature Nar'l Xibrindas|wdh}, who uses {@spell sending} spells to transmit intelligence to his drow brethren. Bregan D'aerthe knows that the safest route to the beholder's lair is a secret staircase in the sewers of the Castle Ward. Any character who belongs to this faction can get this information from Jarlaxle or another source.
zh_tw: 賈拉索在姍娜薩公會中有一名間諜：顧問{@creature Nar'l Xibrindas|wdh|納爾·澤布林達斯}，他使用{@spell sending||短訊術}法術將情報傳送給他的黑暗精靈同胞。布雷甘·達耶知道到達眼魔巢穴最安全的路線是城堡區下水道中的秘密樓梯。任何屬於這個派系的角色都可以從賈拉索或另一個來源獲得這個資訊。

english: If the party includes at least one Bregan D'aerthe member with renown of 4 or more in the faction, four male {@creature drow} are waiting for the party at the top of the staircase. Their names are Arannis Nur'zekk, Beldar Tlabbath, Rylvar Tlabbath, and Draknafein Uriss. Their orders are to help the characters complete their mission, whatever the cost. These drow also have secret orders to kill {@creature Nar'l Xibrindas|wdh}, if he's still alive, and retrieve Jarlaxle's bag of holding (see {@area X35|2c7}). If you're tracking experience points, each drow gets an equal share of the XP while a member of the adventuring party.
zh_tw: 如果隊伍中至少有一名布雷甘·達耶成員在派系中的聲望達到4或以上，四名男性{@creature drow||卓爾}在樓梯頂部等待隊伍。他們的名字是阿蘭尼斯·努爾澤克、貝爾達爾·特拉巴斯、里爾瓦爾·特拉巴斯和德拉克納菲恩·烏里斯。他們的任務是幫助角色完成他們的任務，不惜一切代價。這些卓爾還有秘密命令，如果{@creature Nar'l Xibrindas|wdh|納爾·澤布林達斯}還活著，就殺死他，並取回賈拉索的持有袋（見{@area X35|2c7}）。如果您正在跟蹤經驗值，每個卓爾在冒險隊伍中時將獲得相等的經驗值份額。

english: Harpers
zh_tw: 豎琴手聯盟

english: Characters who belong to the Harpers can approach {@creature Mirt|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), who knows the location of {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s lair. (He has dealt with the beholder many times as a Lord of Waterdeep.)
zh_tw: 屬於豎琴手聯盟的角色可以接近{@creature Mirt|WDH|米爾特}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），他知道{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的巢穴位置。（作為深水城的領主之一，他曾多次與眼魔打交道。）

english: {@creature Mirt|WDH} leads the characters to a secret staircase in the Castle Ward sewers ({@area X1|271}). As the characters prepare to descend the stairs, {@creature Mirt|WDH} tells them that {@creature Xanathar|WDH} doesn't relate well to humanoids, doesn't trust them as a matter of course, and is prone to imagining conspiracies where none exist. He also tells the characters that {@creature Xanathar|WDH} has a pet fish and is insanely protective of it.
zh_tw: {@creature Mirt|WDH|米爾特} 帶領角色們來到城堡區下水道中的秘密樓梯({@area X1|271})。當角色們準備下樓梯時，{@creature Mirt|WDH|米爾特}告訴他們{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}與類人生物相處得不好，不會理所當然地信任他們，並且傾向於在不存在的地方想象陰謀。他還告訴角色們{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}有一條寵物魚，並且對它保護得非常瘋狂。

english: {@creature Mirt|WDH} won't accompany the adventurers, but he knows a secret that could be helpful: {@creature Thorvin Twinbeard|wdh}, {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s chief engineer, is a Harper informant. {@creature Mirt|WDH} shares this secret with any character who has renown of 4 or higher in the Harper faction.
zh_tw: {@creature Mirt|WDH|米爾特}不會陪同冒險者，但他知道一個可能有幫助的秘密：{@creature Thorvin Twinbeard|wdh|索文·雙須}，{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的首席工程師，是一個豎琴手聯盟的情報員。{@creature Mirt|WDH|米爾特}與任何在豎琴手聯盟派系中聲望達到4級或以上的角色分享這個秘密。

english: Lords' Alliance
zh_tw: 領主聯盟

english: Characters who are members of the Lords' Alliance can reach out to {@creature Jalester Silvermane|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}). Jalester doesn't know the location of {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s lair but can get the details from {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH}.
zh_tw: 屬於領主聯盟的角色可以聯絡{@creature Jalester Silvermane|WDH|加萊斯特·銀鬃}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）。加萊斯特不知道{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的巢穴位置，但他可以從{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}那裡獲取詳細資訊。

english: With the information in hand, Jalester leads the party to a secret staircase in the Castle Ward sewers ({@area X1|271}). As the characters prepare to descend the stairs, Jalester warns them to avoid confronting the paranoid and unpredictable beholder.
zh_tw: 掌握了資訊之後，加萊斯特帶領隊伍來到城堡區下水道中的秘密樓梯({@area X1|271})。當角色們準備下樓梯時，加萊斯特警告他們避免與偏執且不可預測的眼魔對抗。

english: If one or more characters have renown of 4 or higher in the Lords' Alliance, Jalester offers to join the party on its mission into {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s lair. If you're tracking experience points, Jalester gets an equal share of the XP while a member of the adventuring party.
zh_tw: 如果一個或多個角色在領主聯盟中的聲望達到4級或以上，加萊斯特願意加入隊伍，一同進入{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的巢穴執行任務。如果你在記錄經驗點數，加萊斯特作為冒險隊伍成員時將獲得等額的經驗點數份額。

english: Emerald Enclave
zh_tw: 翠綠閒庭

english: Characters who are members of the Emerald Enclave can learn the location of {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s lair by speaking with Jeryth Phaulkon at Phaulkonmere. Jeryth tells them that she has been sending {@creature awakened rat|wdh|awakened rats} into the sewers to find the beholder's lair, and that they recently discovered a secret staircase in the Castle Ward sewers leading down to it ({@area X1|271}). She has one of the awakened rats lead them there. This {@creature rat} has an Intelligence score of 10 and can speak Common.
zh_tw: 翠綠閒庭的成員可以透過與波康莊園的傑瑞斯·波康交談得知{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的巢穴位置。傑瑞斯告訴他們，她一直在派遣{@creature awakened rat|wdh|啟蒙鼠}進入下水道尋找眼魔的巢穴，並且他們最近在城堡區下水道發現了一條通往巢穴的秘密樓梯({@area X1|271})。她讓其中一隻覺醒老鼠帶領他們去那裡。這隻{@creature rat||老鼠}的智力得分是10，並且能說通用語。

english: Zhentarim
zh_tw: 散塔林會

english: Characters who are members of the Zhentarim can approach {@creature Yagra Stonefist|wdh} at the Yawning Portal (see "Familiar Faces"). She recently learned about a "back door" to the beholder's lair from a drunken blabbermouth with ties to the Xanathar Guild. Yagra offers to lead them to a secret staircase in the sewers under the Castle Ward ({@area X1|271}). "Trust me," she says, "it's safer than the route through Undermountain and Skullport."
zh_tw: 屬於散塔林會的成員可以聯絡位於呵欠之門（呵欠之門）的{@creature Yagra Stonefist|wdh|雅格拉·石拳}（見"熟悉的面孔"）。她最近從一個醉酒多嘴且與姍娜薩公會有聯絡的人那裡得知了通往眼魔巢穴的"後門"。雅格拉願意帶領他們前往城堡區下水道下的秘密樓梯（{@area X1|271}）。"相信我，"她說，"這比透過地脈迷城和骷髏港的路線更安全。"

english: Yagra will join their descent if the characters promise to pay her at least 1,000 gp. Otherwise, she wishes them well and heads back to the Yawning Portal. If you're tracking experience points, Yagra gets an equal share of the XP while a member of the adventuring party.
zh_tw: 如果角色們承諾至少支付給她1000金幣，雅格拉將加入他們的下降之旅。否則，她祝願他們好運並返回到呵欠之門。如果你在記錄經驗點數，雅格拉作為冒險隊伍成員時將獲得等額的經驗點數份額。

english: Areas of the Lair
zh_tw: 巢穴區域

english: The following areas correspond to the labels on map 5.1. This lair has two levels connected by staircases and secret doors.
zh_tw: 以下區域對應於地圖5.1上的標籤。這個巢穴有兩個透過樓梯和秘密門連線的層次。

english: Xanathar Lair
zh_tw: 姍娜薩巢穴

english: Xanathar Lair, Level 1 (Player Version)
zh_tw: 姍娜薩巢穴，第1層（玩家版）

english: X1. Staircase of Eyes
zh_tw: X1. 眼睛樓梯

english: Characters are most likely to enter {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s lair by this route: a spiral staircase accessible from the Castle Ward's sewers and hidden behind a secret door. This staircase circumvents a more difficult route through Undermountain and Skullport, which is described in {@i Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage}.
zh_tw: 角色們最有可能透過這種方式進入{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的巢穴：從城堡區的下水道可進入的螺旋樓梯，隱藏在一扇密門後面。這條樓梯繞過了透過地脈迷城和骷髏港的更加困難的路線，後者在{@i 深水城: 瘋法師的地城}中有描述。

english: When the characters find the staircase, read:
zh_tw: 當角色們找到樓梯時，請閱讀：

english: The walls of this narrow, spiraling staircase are carved with opened eyes that glow with a faint, magical light.
zh_tw: 這個狹窄、螺旋形的樓梯牆壁上雕刻著睜開的眼睛，這些眼睛發出微弱的魔法光芒。

english: Characters feel as though they're being watched as they descend the stairs, and the feeling doesn't go away once they enter the beholder's lair. The dimly lit staircase descends for hundreds of feet, ending before a circular stone door that swings open into {@area X2|273}.
zh_tw: 角色們下樓梯時感覺好像被監視，而且一旦他們進入眼魔的巢穴，這種感覺並沒有消失。昏暗的樓梯向下延伸數百尺，最終通向一個圓形的石門，這扇門向內開啟進入{@area X2|273}。

english: X2. Watched Hall
zh_tw: X2. 被監視的大廳

english: This magically lit hall has the following features:
zh_tw: 這個魔法照明的大廳有以下特點：

english: The walls are carved with eyes of all shapes and sizes. Many of the orbs have stone eyelids that open and close at irregular intervals.
zh_tw: 牆壁上雕刻著各種形狀和大小的眼睛。許多眼球有石頭眼瞼，它們不規律地開合。

english: Characters who succeed on a {@dc 14} Wisdom (Perception) check notice a ghostly eyestalk (scrying sensor) protruding from the ceiling directly in front of the double door to the south.
zh_tw: 成功透過一個 {@dc 14} 感知（ 感知）檢定的角色會注意到一個幽靈般的眼梗（偵查感測器）從正南方向的雙扇門前的天花板伸出。

english: A secret door is hidden in the west wall.
zh_tw: 一個秘密門隱藏在西牆中。

english: Blinking Eyes
zh_tw: 閃爍的眼睛

english: The blinking eye carvings are slightly unnerving but harmless.
zh_tw: 這些閃爍的眼睛雕刻有點令人不安，但無害。

english: Scrying Sensor
zh_tw: 偵測感應器

english: The ghostly eyestalk is a magical sensor that allows one of the apprentice wizards in {@area X16|292} to monitor this hall. The eyestalk functions as an extra eye with darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. A character can ascertain the eyestalk's function with a successful {@dc 10} Intelligence (Arcana) check but can't determine who's peering through it, or from where. The eyestalk can't be damaged but is destroyed by a {@spell dispel magic} spell. The sensor is suppressed within the area of an antimagic field.
zh_tw: 幽靈般的眼梗是一種魔法感測器，讓 {@area X16|292} 中的一名學徒法師能夠監視這個大廳。眼梗的功能類似於一個額外的眼睛，具有60尺範圍內的黑暗視覺。角色可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 10} 智力（奧秘）檢定來確定眼梗的功能，但無法確定誰在透過它窺視，或從何處窺視。眼梗不能被損壞，但會被 {@spell dispel magic||解除魔法} 法術摧毀。該感測器在反魔法力場的區域內被抑制。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: The secret door can be found with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check. To open it, one must press a nearby wall carving shaped like an eye. When this is done, the secret door swings inward, revealing a curved hallway ({@area X8|27f}) beyond.
zh_tw: 秘密門可以透過一個成功的{@dc 15}感知（感知）檢定找到。要開啟它，必須按下附近一個形似眼睛的牆雕。當這樣做時，秘密門向內擺動，露出後面一條彎曲的走廊（{@area X8|27f}）。

english: X3. Beholder Zombie Guard
zh_tw: X3. 眼魔殭屍守衛

english: A {@creature beholder zombie} guards this magically lit room. Surrounding it are four {@creature gas spore||gas spores}, which look like immature beholders at first glance. All five creatures float in the middle of the room.
zh_tw: 一個{@creature beholder zombie||眼魔喪屍}守衛著這個被魔法照亮的房間。圍繞在它周圍的是四個{@creature gas spore||毒氣孢子}，它們乍一看像是未成熟的眼魔。所有五個生物都漂浮在房間中央。

english: The beholder zombie is all that remains of a beholder that arose from the Underdark to challenge {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s supremacy. After defeating its rival, {@creature Xanathar|WDH} had the corpse animated and transformed into a lair guardian. The gas spores were added later.
zh_tw: 這個眼魔殭屍是一隻從幽暗地域升起挑戰{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}霸權的眼魔所剩下的全部。在擊敗了它的對手後，{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}讓屍體活化並轉變成了巢穴的守衛。氣體孢子是後來新增的。

english: The beholder zombie allows creatures that brandish the symbol of {@creature Xanathar|WDH} to pass unmolested. Otherwise, it attacks. The gas spores don't attack but explode if they take any damage. The beholder zombie is immune to their Death Burst trait.
zh_tw: 這個眼魔殭屍允許揮舞{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}標誌的生物不受幹擾地透過。否則，它會攻擊。氣體孢子不會攻擊，但如果它們受到任何傷害就會爆炸。眼魔殭屍對它們的死亡爆發特性免疫。

english: X4. Tunnel to Skullport
zh_tw: X4. 通往骷髏港的隧道

english: This magically lit tunnel extends 300 feet eastward off the map. It ends at a staircase that climbs 20 feet to the Guts & Garters Inn, an establishment located in the subterranean town of Skullport, which is under {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s control. See {@i Waterdeep: Dungeon of the Mad Mage} for more information on the inn and Skullport.
zh_tw: 這條魔法照亮的隧道向東延伸300尺，超出了地圖範圍。它終止於一段樓梯，爬升20尺即可到達位於地脈迷城鎮骷髏港（骷髏港）的"腸子與吊帶"旅館（膽腸與吊襪帶旅店），該城鎮處於{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的控制之下。有關旅館和骷髏港的更多資訊，請參見{@i 深水城: 瘋法師的地城}。

english: X5. Horror's Alcove
zh_tw: X5. 恐怖的壁龕

english: A suit of {@creature animated armor} with {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s symbol embossed on its breastplate stands in this alcove, appearing at a glance to be an ornate but inanimate suit of armor on display. It remains inert until it takes damage or is summoned to {@area X6|27a} by {@creature Xanathar|WDH}. (The beholder uses it to keep the spectators in the arena from getting too rowdy.)
zh_tw: 一套{@creature animated armor||活化盔甲}，其胸甲上浮雕著{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的標誌，站在這個壁龕裡，乍一看似乎是一套華麗的但無生命的展示盔甲。它保持靜止直到受到傷害或被{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}召喚到{@area X6|27a}。（眼魔用它來防止競技場中的觀眾過於喧鬧。）

english: X6. Pit of Blood and Fortune
zh_tw: X6. 血與財富之坑

english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH} has turned this room into a gladiatorial arena. It also uses this location to dispose of underlings it no longer trusts in a manner that it considers entertaining.
zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩} 將這個房間改造成了角鬥場。它還利用這個地點以它認為娛樂性的方式處理不再信任的下屬。

english: This area has the following features:
zh_tw: 這個區域有以下特點：

english: A magically lit, circular chamber has a thin layer of blood-soaked sand covering the floor and stone buttresses supporting its 40-foot-high domed ceiling.
zh_tw: 一個被魔法照亮的圓形大廳，地板上覆蓋著一層浸透鮮血的沙子，石質支柱支撐著其40尺高的圓頂天花板。

english: Ten-foot-high stone bleachers hug the northwest half of the room. Staircases lead from the bleachers to other areas of the lair, and a tunnel under the bleachers leads west to the monster cell block ({@area X7|27e}).
zh_tw: 十尺高的石制看臺環繞著房間的西北半部。樓梯從看臺通往巢穴的其他區域，看臺下的一條隧道向西通往怪物牢房區（{@area X7|27e}）。

english: A semicircular recess in the southeast wall has steps leading up to it. Its floor is 5 feet higher than the arena floor, and the alcove is decorated with bouquets of Underdark fungi in stone vases and purple tapestries that bear {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s symbol. Jutting from the curved roof of the alcove is a spectral eyestalk (scrying sensor).
zh_tw: 東南牆上有一個半圓形的凹室，有臺階通向其上方。它的地面比競技場地面高出5尺，凹室裝飾有地下暗河真菌的石瓶花束和帶有{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}標誌的紫色掛毯。從凹室的彎曲屋頂突出的是一個幽靈眼柄（偵查感測器）。

english: A secret door is hidden in the south wall.
zh_tw: 一個秘密門隱藏在南牆中。

english: If {@creature Xanathar|WDH} is elsewhere, the arena is empty but under surveillance (see "Scrying Sensor" below).
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}在其他地方，競技場是空的，但處於監視之下（見下文的"偵查感測器"）。

english: If {@creature Xanathar|WDH} is present, it hovers in the southeast alcove and uses its {@item ring of invisibility} to remain unseen. Standing on the steps of the alcove are two dwarves: {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s majordomo, {@creature Ahmaergo|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), who presides over fight tournaments, and {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s chief enforcer, {@creature Noska Ur'gray|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), who releases arena combatants from {@area X7|27e}. Ten human {@creature bandit||bandits} and five {@creature bugbear||bugbears} (all members of the Xanathar Guild) guzzle ale and heckle combatants from the bleachers, while two {@creature goblin||goblins} serve up salted rat intestines and stirge meat pies.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}在場，它會懸浮在東南壁龕中，並使用它的{@item ring of invisibility||隱身戒指}保持不可見狀態。站在壁龕臺階上的是兩個矮人：{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的管家{@creature Ahmaergo|WDH|阿莫戈}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），他主持格鬥錦標賽，以及{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的首席執法者{@creature Noska Ur'gray|wdh|諾思卡·厄格雷}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），他從{@area X7|27e}釋放競技場戰士。十個人類{@creature bandit||匪徒}和五個{@creature bugbear||熊地精}（所有都是姍娜薩公會的成員）在看臺上暢飲啤酒並嘲諷戰鬥者，而兩個{@creature goblin||地精}則提供鹹味老鼠腸和血蠅肉餡派。

english: Joining a Tournament
zh_tw: 參加錦標賽

english: If the characters enter during a tournament, they see a {@creature minotaur} battling a scarred female halfling, {@creature Samara Strongbones|WDH} (see {@area X7|27e}). The halfling doesn't want to die in a pointless battle and screams for help. If the characters intervene, the arena spectators turn violent and attack them. If the characters let the fight play out, Noska escorts the victor back to {@area X7|27e} while {@creature Ahmaergo|WDH} goads characters into joining the tournament. If the characters aren't willing to enter the tournament, {@creature Ahmaergo|WDH} has them beaten {@condition unconscious} and locked up while {@creature Xanathar|WDH} watches silently.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在錦標賽期間進入，他們會看到一隻{@creature minotaur||牛頭人}正在與一名傷痕累累的女性半身人{@creature Samara Strongbones|WDH|薩馬拉·強骨}（見{@area X7|27e}）戰鬥。這位半身人不想在一場毫無意義的戰鬥中死去，因此大聲呼救。如果角色們幹預，競技場的觀眾會變得暴力並攻擊他們。如果角色們讓戰鬥繼續下去，諾思卡會護送勝利者回到{@area X7|27e}，而{@creature Ahmaergo|WDH|阿莫戈}則會慫恿角色們加入錦標賽。如果角色們不願意參加錦標賽，{@creature Ahmaergo|WDH|阿莫戈}會讓人將他們打到{@condition unconscious||昏迷}並關押起來，而{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}則在一旁默默觀看。

english: Rules for running a tournament are described at the end of this chapter (see "Blood and Fortune"). If a character joins the tournament and wins, or defeats its underlings, {@creature Xanathar|WDH} is impressed enough to grant the party an audience, during which it tries to subjugate them (see "{@area Facing Xanathar|25d|x}").
zh_tw: 舉辦錦標賽的規則將在本章末尾進行描述（參見"血與財富"）。如果某個角色參加了錦標賽並獲勝，或者擊敗了其手下，{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}將深受觸動，同意接見隊伍，並在會面中試圖征服他們（參見"{@area 面對姍娜薩|25d|x}"）。

english: Scrying Sensor
zh_tw: 偵測感應器

english: The spectral eyestalk is a magical sensor, which allows an apprentice wizard in {@area X16|292} to monitor this room. See {@area X2|273} for more information.
zh_tw: 幽靈眼柄是一個魔法感測器，它允許在{@area X16|292}的學徒法師監視這個房間。有關更多資訊，請見{@area X2|273}。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: The secret door in the south wall can be found with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check. It pushes open to reveal {@area X33|2bf} beyond.
zh_tw: 南牆上的暗門可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 15} 感知（感知）檢定發現。推開後可以看到外面的 {@area X33|2bf}。

english: X7. Cell Block
zh_tw: X7. 牢房區

english: This area contains four cells separated by bars. The rectangular iron doors have locks built into them, and {@creature Noska Ur'gray|wdh} carries the keys. Picking a lock requires a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check using thieves' tools. Breaking down a cell door requires a successful {@dc 25} Strength (Athletics) check. The Cell Occupants table lists this area's prisoners.
zh_tw: 這個區域包含四個由鐵欄分隔的牢房。矩形鐵門上裝有門鎖，而 {@creature Noska Ur'gray|wdh|諾思卡·厄格雷} 拿著鑰匙。開鎖需要成功透過 {@dc 15} 的敏捷檢定並使用盜賊工具。強行破門需要成功透過 {@dc 25} 的力量（運動）檢定。囚犯資訊表列出了該區域的犯人。

english: Cell Occupants
zh_tw: 牢房居民

english: Cell
zh_tw: 小房間

english: Prisoners
zh_tw: 囚犯

english: A
zh_tw: A

english: A male half-ogre named Groz, a minotaur named Umpok, and a female orog named Charworl
zh_tw: 一個名叫格羅茲的男性半食人魔，一個名叫烏姆波克的牛頭人，以及一個名叫查爾沃爾的女性魔獸人

english: B
zh_tw: B

english: Kidnapped Waterdavians: Xia Shung (NG female Shou human bard see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), Claudio Benzreck (LN male Tethyrian human noble), and Arthright Grayfalcon (CN male Illuskan swashbuckler see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12})
zh_tw: 被綁架的沃特德文市民：夏·順（NG女性壽族人類吟遊詩人，見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），克勞迪奧·本茲雷克（LN男性特提裡安人類貴族），以及阿爾特賴特·格雷法爾孔（CN男性伊路斯坎浪人，見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）

english: C
zh_tw: C

english: A female drow named Raelyn Auvryndar, recently separated from her companion and subordinate, Zaibon Kyszalt (see {@area X24|2ab})
zh_tw: 一個名叫瑞琳·奧弗林達爾的女性黑暗精靈，最近與她的伴侶和下屬扎伊邦·基薩爾特分離（見{@area X24|2ab}）

english: D
zh_tw: D

english: {@creature Samara Strongbones|WDH}, a female lightfoot halfling, is a Zhentarim spy in league with {@creature Manshoon|WDH}. She is chaotic evil and has these racial traits: She is Small, and her walking speed is 25 feet. She can move through the space of any Medium or larger creature. She has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition frightened}. She speaks Common, Halfling, and Undercommon.
zh_tw: {@creature Samara Strongbones|WDH|薩馬拉·強骨}，一個女性輕盈半身人，是與{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}結盟的散塔林會間諜。她是混亂邪惡的，並且擁有以下種族特性：她體型小，步行速度為25尺。她可以透過任何中等體型或更大的生物的空間。她在對抗{@condition frightened||恐懼}狀態的豁免檢定中具有優勢。她會說通用語、半身人語和地底共同語。

english: X8. Hall of Statues
zh_tw: X8. 雕像大廳

english: This 20-foot-wide, magically lit hallway connects various areas controlled by the Xanathar Guild. It has the following features:
zh_tw: 這個20尺寬的魔法照明走廊連線著由姍娜薩公會控制的各個區域。它有以下特點：

english: Lifelike humanoid statues dot the hall.
zh_tw: 走廊上點綴著栩栩如生的類人雕像。

english: The first time the characters explore the hall, a {@creature deep gnome (svirfneblin)||deep gnome} in clownish garb is dancing and cartwheeling up and down the hall, between the statues.
zh_tw: 當角色第一次探索大廳時，一個穿著小丑服裝的{@creature deep gnome (svirfneblin)||地底侏儒}在大廳裡，在雕像之間跳舞和翻跟斗。

english: Gnome Clown
zh_tw: 侏儒小丑

english: The garishly dressed deep gnome, Flutterfoot Zipswiggle, serves {@creature Xanathar|WDH} as a jester. He carries a packet containing {@item dust of disappearance}. Unknown to Flutterfoot, the beholder has tired of the gnome and plans to turn him to stone when next they meet.
zh_tw: 穿著花哨的地底侏儒，翩足·吉普斯威格，作為小丑為{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}服務。他攜帶著一個包含{@item dust of disappearance||無蹤粉}的小包。翩足不知道，那個眼魔已經厭倦了這個侏儒，並計劃在下次見面時將他變成石頭。

english: Flutterfoot knows the features and layout of {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s lair, as well as the beholder's current whereabouts and the locations of secret doors, except the ones leading to {@area X36|2cb}. He gleefully offers to serve as a guide if the characters correctly answer the following riddle:
zh_tw: 翩足知道{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的巢穴的特點和佈局，以及眼魔當前的位置和秘密門的位置，除了那些通向{@area X36|2cb}的門。如果角色正確回答以下謎語，它會高興地提供作為嚮導的服務：

english: I come with a smile;
zh_tw: 我帶著微笑而來；

english: In slaughter, I rest;
zh_tw: 在屠殺中，我休息；

english: I can be contagious,
zh_tw: 我可能會傳染

english: But my medicine is best.
zh_tw: 但我的藥是最好的。

english: What am I?
zh_tw: 我是什麼？

english: The answer to Flutterfoot's riddle is "laughter." If the characters give the wrong answer, the gnome sprinkles himself with {@item dust of disappearance}, turns {@condition invisible}, and flees.
zh_tw: 翩足的謎語答案是"笑聲"。如果角色們給出了錯誤的答案，侏儒會用{@item dust of disappearance||無蹤粉}撒在自己身上，變得{@condition invisible||隱形}，並逃跑。

english: Lifelike Statues
zh_tw: 栩栩如生的雕像

english: The statues are the {@condition petrified} remains of intruders and Xanathar Guild members that were turned to stone by {@creature Xanathar|WDH}. There are a dozen statues in all: four humans, three goblins, two drow, a dwarf, a halfling, and a tiefling.
zh_tw: 這些雕像是被{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}變成石頭的入侵者和姍娜薩公會成員的{@condition petrified||石化}遺骸。總共有12座雕像：四個人類，三個地精，兩個黑暗精靈，一個矮人，一個半身人和一個提夫林。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: The secret door to {@area X2|273} is clearly visible from this side. It is opened by turning a stone knob on the adjacent wall.
zh_tw: 通往{@area X2|273}的秘密門從這邊看非常明顯。它可以透過轉動旁邊牆上的石把手來開啟。

english: X9. Guild Barracks
zh_tw: X9. 公會兵營

english: This magically lit room has the following features:
zh_tw: 這個被魔法照亮的房間有以下特點：

english: The walls are covered with lewd graffiti written in Common, Dwarvish, {@creature Goblin}, and Undercommon.
zh_tw: 牆壁上塗滿了用通用語、矮人語、{@creature Goblin||地精}語和地底共同語寫的淫穢塗鴉。

english: In the front of the room is a ramshackle wooden table surrounded by empty barrels and casks that serve as stools. Drained tankards are strewn across the tabletop and the floor.
zh_tw: 房間的前方有一張破舊的木桌，周圍是空桶和木桶，它們被當作凳子使用。喝空的酒杯散落在桌面和地板上。

english: A dozen moldy bunk beds are arranged in two rows at the back of the room.
zh_tw: 房間裡的後部排列著兩排共十二張發黴的雙層床。

english: Xanathar Guild Members
zh_tw: 姍娜薩公會成員

english: When they're not watching a tournament in the arena ({@area X6|27a}) or listening to {@creature Xanathar|WDH} give a speech in the audience chamber ({@area X18|29a}), ten human {@creature bandit||bandits}, members of the Xanathar Guild, sleep here. They're so drunk that, for the next few hours, they awaken only if they take damage. Also, they are {@condition poisoned} while they remain intoxicated.
zh_tw: 當他們不在競技場（{@area X6|27a}）觀看錦標賽或在聽眾大廳（{@area X18|29a}）聽{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}演講時，十名人類{@creature bandit||匪徒}，姍娜薩公會的成員，在這裡睡覺。他們醉得如此厲害，以至於在接下來的幾個小時裡，除非受到傷害，否則他們不會醒來。此外，只要他們保持醉酒狀態，他們就會處於{@condition poisoned||中毒}狀態。

english: X10. Noska's Quarters
zh_tw: X10. 諾思卡的住處

english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s enforcer, {@creature Noska Ur'gray|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), resides in this magically lit room when he's not in the arena ({@area X6|27a}). The room contains the following features:
zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的執行者，{@creature Noska Ur'gray|wdh|諾思卡·厄格雷}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），當他不在競技場（{@area X6|27a}）時，就居住在這個被魔法照亮的房間裡。房間包含以下特點：

english: A marble bathtub with clawed feet rests in the middle of the room, next to a large wooden cage containing a {@creature rust monster}. Along the walls are piles of broken and rusted helmets, {@item shield|PHB|shields}, and weapons.
zh_tw: 一個帶爪腳的大理石浴缸位於房間中央，旁邊是一個裝有{@creature rust monster||鏽蝕怪}的大木籠。牆壁旁堆放著破碎和生鏽的頭盔、{@item shield|PHB|盾牌}和武器。

english: Hanging from hooks on the back wall are three mannequins made of straw and canvas, with a multitude of crossbow bolts sticking in them.
zh_tw: 掛在後牆上的鉤子上有三個由稻草和帆布製成的人體模型，上面插滿了眾多的弩箭。

english: Noska keeps the rust monster as a pet and feeds it items from the piles of discarded helms, {@item shield|PHB|shields}, and armaments. He uses the mannequins for target practice. The bathtub, which he has converted into a bed, is padded with straw and mangy furs.
zh_tw: 諾思卡將鏽蝕怪物當作寵物飼養，並用成堆的廢棄頭盔、{@item shield|PHB|盾牌}和武器餵它。他用人體模型進行靶子練習。他將浴缸改造成了床，裡面墊著稻草和破舊的毛皮。

english: Wooden Cage
zh_tw: 木製籠子

english: A simple latch holds the cage door shut. The rust monster can't harm anyone while trapped inside.
zh_tw: 一個簡單的門閂將籠子門保持關閉狀態。鏽蝕怪物在被囚禁在裡面時無法傷害任何人。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Hidden under a pile of rusty weapons is a wooden chest containing Noska's personal hoard: 37 gp, 151 sp, 360 cp, and four bloodstones (worth 50 gp each).
zh_tw: 隱藏在一堆生鏽武器下面的是一個木製箱子，裡面裝有諾思卡的個人寶藏：37金幣，151銀幣，360銅幣，以及四顆血石（每顆價值50金幣）。

english: X11. Ahmaergo's Collection
zh_tw: X11. 阿莫戈的收藏

english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s majordomo fetishizes minotaurs and has decorated this magically lit room accordingly:
zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的管家迷戀著牛頭人，因此相應地裝飾了這個被魔法照亮的房間：

english: A stuffed, glowering minotaur stands at the north end of the room. A large greataxe rests on a wooden rack in front of it.
zh_tw: 一隻填充過的、怒視著的牛頭人站在房間的北端。一把大斧頭靠在它前面的木架上。

english: In the middle of the room is a 10-foot-long, 5-foot wide, 3-foot-high rectangular slab of stone with a hand-carved, miniature model of a stone maze atop it.
zh_tw: 房間中央是一塊10尺長、5尺寬、3尺高的矩形石板，其上雕刻著手工製作的微型石制迷宮模型。

english: Stone Maze
zh_tw: 石質迷宮

english: A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals an aura of conjuration magic around the model maze. A creature that touches the maze becomes the target of a {@spell maze} spell (save {@dc 15}). Once the effect triggers, it can't do so again until the next dawn.
zh_tw: 一個 {@spell detect magic||偵測魔法} 法術會揭示模型迷宮周圍的咒法系魔法光環。觸碰迷宮的生物會成為 {@spell maze||迷宮術} 法術的目標（豁免 {@dc 15}）。一旦效果觸發，直到下一次黎明前都無法再次觸發。

english: Stuffed Minotaur
zh_tw: 填充牛頭人

english: When someone other than {@creature Ahmaergo|WDH} opens the southern door, the skeleton of the stuffed minotaur erupts out of its skin, becoming an animated {@creature minotaur skeleton}, and arms itself with the greataxe. It attacks all intruders, pursuing any who flee into {@area X8|27f} or X12. The minotaur skeleton obeys {@creature Ahmaergo|WDH}'s commands.
zh_tw: 當除了{@creature Ahmaergo|WDH|阿莫戈}之外的人開啟南門時，填充的牛頭人的骨架會從皮膚中爆發出來，變成一個活動的{@creature minotaur skeleton||骷髏牛頭人}，並用大斧武裝自己。它攻擊所有入侵者，追擊任何逃入{@area X8|27f}或X12的人。牛頭人骨架服從{@creature Ahmaergo|WDH|阿莫戈}的命令。

english: X12. Ahmaergo's Quarters
zh_tw: X12. 阿莫戈的住處

english: The magical lights in this room have been dispelled, rendering the chamber dark. Characters who have a light source or darkvision can discern the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間的魔法燈光已經被驅散，使室內變得黑暗。擁有光源或黑暗視覺的角色可以辨認出以下特點：

english: The room has been converted into a maze, its walls made of stacked crates nailed together with boards. The walls rise to meet the 20-foot-high ceiling.
zh_tw: 這個房間已經被改造成了一個迷宮，牆壁由堆疊的板條箱和木板釘在一起構成。牆壁一直延伸到20尺高的天花板。

english: Humanoid bones litter the floor. ({@creature Ahmaergo|WDH} gathered the bones from Undermountain and put them here as grisly decorations.)
zh_tw: 人形生物的骨頭散落在地板上。（{@creature Ahmaergo|WDH|阿莫戈}從地脈迷城收集了這些骨頭，並把它們放在這裡作為可怕的裝飾。）

english: The maze fills the entire room but for a 10-foot-square area in the southwest corner, where {@creature Ahmaergo|WDH} keeps a wooden chest and a bed made from the skulls, bones, hide, and fur of minotaurs.
zh_tw: 迷宮佔據了整個房間，除了西南角一個10尺見方的區域，那裡{@creature Ahmaergo|WDH|阿莫戈}放置了一個木製箱子和一張由牛頭人的頭骨、骨頭、皮和毛製成的床。

english: Getting through the maze takes time but isn't difficult, except that {@creature Ahmaergo|WDH} has rigged a tripwire halfway through. A character in the lead who is searching for traps spots the tripwire with a successful {@dc 12} Wisdom (Perception) check. Once spotted, it can easily be avoided or disarmed. If the trap is triggered, the walls of the maze come crashing down. Every creature in the collapsing maze is hit by debris and must make a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 ({@dice 3d6}) bludgeoning damage on a failed saving throw, or half as much damage on a successful one.
zh_tw: 穿過迷宮需要時間但並不困難，只是{@creature Ahmaergo|WDH|阿莫戈}在迷宮的中途設下了一道絆線。在隊伍前導的角色如果正在搜尋陷阱，可以透過成功的{@dc 12}感知（感知）檢定發現絆線。一旦發現，它就可以輕易避開或解除。如果陷阱被觸發，迷宮的牆壁會崩塌下來。每個在崩塌迷宮中的生物都會被碎片擊中，必須進行{@dc 12}敏捷豁免，失敗則受到10點（{@dice 3d6}）鈍擊傷害，成功則只受一半傷害。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: {@creature Ahmaergo|WDH}'s chest contains 121 gp in a sack made of stitched flesh, a carved malachite figurine of a minotaur (worth 250 gp), and a {@item potion of healing}.
zh_tw: {@creature Ahmaergo|WDH|阿莫戈}的箱子裡包含121金幣，裝在一個由縫合的肉製成的袋子裡，一個雕刻成牛頭人形狀的孔雀石雕像（價值250金幣），以及一瓶{@item potion of healing||治療藥水}。

english: X13. Thorvin's Workshop
zh_tw: X13. 索文的工作室

english: Double doors swing open into a magically lit chamber containing the following:
zh_tw: 雙扇門向內開啟，進入一個被魔法照亮的房間，包含以下內容：

english: {@creature Thorvin Twinbeard|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s engineer, is building a large contraption in the middle of the room. Floating nearby is an albino {@creature gazer|VGM} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}).
