zh_tw: {@creature Thorvin Twinbeard|wdh|索文·雙須}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的工程師，正在房間中央建造一個大型裝置。附近漂浮著一個白化{@creature gazer|VGM|凝視者眼魔}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）。

english: Tools cover stone tables throughout the room. (There are enough tools here to assemble two sets of mason's tools, one set of smith's tools, and two sets of tinker's tools.)
zh_tw: 整個房間的石頭桌子上擺滿了工具。（這裡有足夠多的工具來組裝兩套石匠工具，一套鐵匠工具和兩套修補匠工具。）

english: Other furnishings include a cot and a stack of wooden casks filled with Wyrmwizz Ale (a Skullport brew).
zh_tw: 其他的傢俱包括一張簡易床和一堆裝滿龍尿麥酒（一種骷髏港釀造的啤酒）的木桶。

english: Albino Gazer
zh_tw: 白化凝視者眼魔

english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH} dreamed this gazer into existence and sent it to spy on Thorvin, whose loyalty the beholder is beginning to question. The gazer is itself disloyal. A wizard character can befriend it with a successful {@dc 11} Charisma (Persuasion) check and turn it into their familiar with a {@spell find familiar} ritual. When the gazer becomes a familiar, its alignment changes to match that of its new master.
zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩} 夢見了這隻凝視者眼魔並將其送到索文身邊進行監視，因為這個眼魔開始懷疑索文的忠誠。這隻凝視者眼魔本身也並不忠誠。一名法師角色可以透過成功的 {@dc 11} 魅力（說服）檢定與其成為朋友，並透過 {@spell find familiar||尋獲魔寵} 儀式將其轉化為自己的魔寵。當凝視者眼魔成為魔寵時，它的陣營會變更為與其新主人一致。

english: Thorvin Twinbeard
zh_tw: 索文·雙須

english: When it is finished, Thorvin's contraption will enable {@creature Xanathar|WDH} to pulverize creatures that it petrifies, turning them into a fine powder that can be used to make plaster. The pulverizer consists mainly of a tall stone bin with grinding gears at the bottom, and a chute where the powdered stone pours out.
zh_tw: 當索文的裝置完成後，它將使{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}能夠將被石化的生物粉碎，變成細粉，這些細粉可以用來製作石膏。粉碎機主要由一個高高的石制容器組成，底部有研磨齒輪，還有一個漏斗，粉末狀的石頭從那裡倒出。

english: The pulverizer is a pet project of Thorvin's that allows him to hang around {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s lair and gather information, which he sells to the Harpers. (Thorvin puts the coin he earns from the faction in a bank, far from the beholder's prying eyes.) If one or more characters approach him and claim to be Harpers, Thorvin is upset that they would risk exposing him as a spy, pointing to the albino gazer. If the characters befriend the gazer and promise to go away, Thorvin truthfully answers as many as three questions. He's never seen {@creature Ahmaergo|WDH}'s chambers (areas X11 and X12) but knows the rest of the lair well.
zh_tw: 粉碎機是索文的個人專案，它允許他待在{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的巢穴附近並收集資訊，這些資訊他將其賣給了豎琴手聯盟。（索文把他從派系那裡賺來的錢存入銀行，遠離了眼魔的窺探之眼。）如果有一或多個角色接近他並聲稱自己是豎琴手聯盟，索文會因為他們冒險暴露他是間諜而感到不安，他指向那個白化凝視者眼魔。如果角色們與凝視者眼魔成為朋友並承諾離開，索文會如實回答多達三個問題。他從未見過{@creature Ahmaergo|WDH|阿莫戈}的房間（X11和X12區域），但對巢穴的其他部分非常熟悉。

english: If the characters are looking for a way to mess with {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s operation, Thorvin suggests they coerce {@creature Nar'l Xibrindas|wdh}, the beholder's advisor (see {@area X18|29a}), into giving them the large supply of {@item smokepowder|WDH} that he smuggled into the dungeon. Thorvin also tells them where to plant the {@item smokepowder|WDH} to cause the most damage (see "Destroy the Lair").
zh_tw: 如果角色們在尋找幹擾{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}運作的方法，索文建議他們強迫{@creature Nar'l Xibrindas|wdh|納爾·澤布林達斯}，眼魔的顧問（見{@area X18|29a}），給他們提供他走私進地牢的大量{@item smokepowder|WDH|發煙粉}。索文還告訴他們在哪裡放置{@item smokepowder|WDH|發煙粉}以造成最大的破壞（見"摧毀巢穴"）。

english: X14. Secret Hallway
zh_tw: X14. 秘密走廊

english: This magically lit hall is concealed behind secret doors. It circumvents the audience chamber ({@area X18|29a}) and gently slopes down toward the east. Finding either secret door requires a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check.
zh_tw: 這個被魔法照亮的大廳隱藏在暗門後面。它繞過了覲見室（{@area X18|29a}）並緩緩向東傾斜。找到任一暗門都需要成功透過一次 {@dc 15} 感知（感知）檢定。

english: X15. Stairs to the Maze
zh_tw: X15. 迷宮樓梯

english: Characters at the top of these magically lit stairs can hear loud music and raucous laughter boiling up from below. The staircase descends 20 feet to {@area X28|2b5}.
zh_tw: 站在這些被魔法照亮的樓梯頂部的角色可以聽到下面傳來的響亮的音樂聲和喧鬧的笑聲。樓梯向下延伸20尺到達{@area X28|2b5}。

english: Panopticus
zh_tw: 全視機

english: X16. Panopticus Guard Station
zh_tw: X16. 全視機警衛站

english: This room contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間包含以下特點：

english: Five bald {@creature Panopticus Wizard|wdh|shield dwarves}, their heads covered with purple eye tattoos, sit around the edge of a glowing circle on the floor. Their eyes are scrunched shut, but they are aware of their surroundings.
zh_tw: 五個禿頭的{@creature Panopticus Wizard|wdh|盾矮人}，他們的頭上覆蓋著紫色的眼睛紋身，坐在地板上一個發光圓圈的邊緣。他們的眼睛緊閉，但他們對周圍環境是有意識的。

english: Protruding from the ceiling, directly above the circle, is a large, flaring bronze "bell" similar in shape to the mouth of a tuba.
zh_tw: 從天花板上突出，在圓圈正上方的是一個大的，向外張開的青銅"鍾"，形狀類似於長號的喇叭口。

english: Set into the back of a recessed wall is a secret door that leads to {@area X17|297}.
zh_tw: 嵌入到凹進去牆壁的背面是一個秘密門，它通向{@area X17|297}。

english: Dwarves
zh_tw: 矮人

english: The five {@creature Panopticus Wizard|wdh|tattooed dwarves} operate {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s "panopticus" magical surveillance system. They fight only in self-defense. They are {@creature apprentice wizard|VGM|apprentice wizards} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), with these changes:
zh_tw: 這五個紋身的{@creature Panopticus Wizard|wdh|紋身矮人}操作{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的"全視機"魔法監控系統。他們只在自衛時戰鬥。他們是{@creature apprentice wizard|VGM|學徒法師}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），有以下變化：

english: They are neutral.
zh_tw: 他們是中立的。

english: They have these racial traits: Their walking speed is 25 feet. They have advantage on saving throws against poison and resistance to poison damage. They have darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. They speak Common and Dwarvish.
zh_tw: 他們有這些種族特性：他們的行走速度是25尺。他們在對毒素的豁免檢定上有優勢，並且對毒素傷害有抗性。他們具有60尺範圍內的黑暗視覺。他們說通用語和矮人語。

english: {@creature Nihiloor|WDH} the mind flayer has psychically and surgically altered the dwarves so that they sleep with one eye open and half their brains asleep at any time.
zh_tw: {@creature Nihiloor|WDH|尼希盧爾}這個奪心魔在精神上和外科手術上改變了矮人們，使他們能夠一隻眼睛睡覺，任何時候都有一半大腦處於睡眠狀態。

english: Amplification Bell
zh_tw: 放大鐘

english: The bronze bell is connected to a tube that runs through the stone and into the nearby audience chamber ({@area X18|29a}). The bell amplifies sounds underneath it and transmits those sounds to the audience chamber.
zh_tw: 這個銅鐘連線著一個管道，管道穿過石頭，通向附近的觀眾室（{@area X18|29a}）。鐘下的聲音被放大，並將這些聲音傳送到觀眾室。

english: Scrying Circle
zh_tw: 偵查圈

english: A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals an aura of divination magic around the circle, which the dwarves use to scry on various other locations within the dungeon: the entrance hall ({@area X2|273}), the arena ({@area X6|27a}), the antechamber of madness ({@area X23|2a6}), the recreation hall ({@area X28|2b5}), and the downstairs hall ({@area X32|2be}). One dwarf watches each location and communicates what it sees via the bronze bell. The scrying circle functions for no one else. It is suppressed within an {@spell antimagic field} and can also be dispelled ({@dc 17}). When the circle ceases to exist, the ghostly eyestalk sensors in the above-mentioned locations disappear as well.
zh_tw: 一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術會顯示出這個圈子周圍的預言魔法光環，矮人們利用這個圈子來窺探地下城中其他各個地點：入口大廳（{@area X2|273}）、競技場（{@area X6|27a}）、瘋狂的前廳（{@area X23|2a6}）、娛樂大廳（{@area X28|2b5}）以及樓下大廳（{@area X32|2be}）。每個地點都有一個矮人監視，並透過青銅鈴鐺傳達所看到的內容。這個窺探圈子對其他人無效。它在{@spell antimagic field||反魔法場}中被抑制，並且可以被解除（{@dc 17}）。當該圈子消失時，上述地點的幽靈眼柄感測器也會隨之消失。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: The secret door can be spotted with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check. A pedal hidden in the floor, when stepped on, causes the door to swing inward.
zh_tw: 成功的 {@dc 15} 感知（感知）檢定可以發現這扇秘門。地板上的一個隱藏踏板，被踩下時會導致門向內擺動。

english: X17. Promenade
zh_tw: X17. 長廊

english: Pillars carved with eyes follow the curvature of the hall, and these eyes seem to track creatures as they pass by. This isn't a magical effect but an optical illusion.
zh_tw: 雕刻著眼睛的柱子沿著大廳的彎曲排列，這些眼睛似乎在跟蹤經過的生物。這不是魔法效果，而是一種光學錯覺。

english: Majordomo
zh_tw: 總管

english: If he's not with {@creature Xanathar|WDH} in the arena ({@area X6|27a}), {@creature Ahmaergo|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) is conducting a routine inspection of the dungeon. The characters can hear the dwarf's echoing footfalls as he approaches their location. If he sees intruders and is outnumbered, {@creature Ahmaergo|WDH} retreats to {@area X22|2a5}, heads downstairs to gather reinforcements from {@area X28|2b5}, and leads a search party to capture the interlopers. If he sees only one intruder, he draws his axe and attacks.
zh_tw: 如果他沒有和{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}在競技場（{@area X6|27a}）裡，{@creature Ahmaergo|WDH|阿莫戈}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）正在進行地牢的例行檢查。角色們可以聽到矮人的腳步聲迴盪著向他們的位置靠近。如果他看到入侵者並且人數不足，{@creature Ahmaergo|WDH|阿莫戈}會撤退到{@area X22|2a5}，下樓到{@area X28|2b5}召集援軍，並帶領搜尋隊去捕捉闖入者。如果他只看到一個入侵者，他會拔出斧頭進行攻擊。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: The northernmost end of this hallway displays a fresco of a leafless tree that has lidless eyes embedded in its branches. Pressing a specific eye causes a door-shaped section of the wall to swing open into {@area X16|292}. Characters can find the secret door and the switch with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check.
zh_tw: 這個走廊的最北端展示了一幅無葉樹的壁畫，樹枝上嵌著沒有眼皮的眼睛。按下特定的眼睛會導致牆壁上的一部分像門一樣開啟，通往 {@area X16|292}。角色可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 15} 感知（感知）檢定找到這扇秘密門和開關。

english: X18. Audience Chamber
zh_tw: X18. 聽眾大廳

english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH} greets visitors and makes speeches to its minions in this 40-foot-high domed chamber. Characters who were seen by the scrying sensors anywhere in the dungeon complex can't surprise the creatures here. The magically lit room contains the following features:
zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}在這個40尺高的圓頂大廳中迎接訪客並向其手下發表演講。在地牢複合體的任何地方被偵查感測器看到的角色不能在這裡出其不意地攻擊生物。這個被魔法照亮的房間包含以下特點：

english: The circular floor is tiled in black marble and bears a gold mosaic of {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s symbol.
zh_tw: 圓形地板鋪著黑色大理石，並裝飾有{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}標誌的金色馬賽克。

english: Jutting from the ceiling is a bronze, bell-shaped protuberance. (This fixture is the other end of the sound amplifier described in {@area X16|292}.)
zh_tw: 從天花板上突出的是一個青銅製的鐘形凸起。（這個裝置是位於{@area X16|292}中描述的聲音放大器的另一端。）

english: Displayed against the curved walls are a dozen lifelike statues (the remains of humans, drow, dwarves, goblinoids, and kobolds who defied the beholder).
zh_tw: 沿著彎曲的牆壁展示著一打栩栩如生的雕像（那些反抗眼魔的人類、黑暗精靈、矮人、地精類和狗頭人的殘骸）。

english: Hidden in the floor is a secret trapdoor.
zh_tw: 地板內隱藏著一個秘密陷阱門。

english: While in this room, {@creature Xanathar|WDH} uses its {@item ring of invisibility} to remain unseen and can use a bonus action to activate or deactivate a psychedelic display of magical lights, each one the size of a human eyeball. The lights fill a 10-foot cube in the middle of the room, and the beholder can throw its voice so that it seems to emanate from the same area. Any character who succeeds on a {@dc 13} Wisdom (Insight) check can tell that the display isn't the source of the voice.
zh_tw: 在這個房間內，{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}使用它的{@item ring of invisibility||隱身戒指}保持隱形，並且可以使用一個附贈動作來啟用或關閉一場迷幻的魔法光效，每一個光點都有人類眼球大小。這些光點填充了房間中央的一個10尺立方體，眼魔可以投射它的聲音，使其似乎從同一區域傳出。任何成功透過{@dc 13}感知（洞悉）檢定的角色可以辨別出這個光效並非聲音的來源。

english: If the beholder is here, it's using the psychedelic light display to deliver an incoherent, self-aggrandizing speech to a group of sycophantic underlings consisting of ten human {@creature bandit||bandits} and two {@creature duergar} who have never seen {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s true form. These minions clutch tankards of Wyrmwizz Ale (a cheap Skullport brew) and toast {@creature Xanathar|WDH} whenever the beholder commends itself. {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s treacherous {@creature drow mage} advisor, {@creature Nar'l Xibrindas|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), stands in front of the open door to {@area X19|29c}, clapping weakly at the speech. Floating next to Nar'l is his {@creature grell} bodyguard. If {@creature Xanathar|WDH} has been warned that the characters are near, it wraps up its speech and grants them an audience; see "Facing {@creature Xanathar|WDH}," for more information.
zh_tw: 如果眼魔在這裡，它正在使用迷幻的燈光展示向一群阿諛奉承的下屬發表一篇語無倫次、自我吹噓的演講，這些下屬由十個人類{@creature bandit||匪徒}和兩個{@creature duergar||灰矮人}組成，他們從未見過{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的真正形態。這些手下緊握著龍尿麥酒（一種便宜的骷髏港釀造）的酒杯，每當眼魔稱讚自己時，他們就向{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}敬酒。{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的陰險{@creature drow mage||卓爾魔法師}顧問，{@creature Nar'l Xibrindas|wdh|納爾·澤布林達斯}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），站在通往{@area X19|29c}的敞開的門前，微弱地為演講鼓掌。在納爾旁邊漂浮著他的{@creature grell||觸鬚怪}保鏢。如果{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}已經被警告角色們接近了，它會結束演講，並給予他們一個接見；有關更多資訊，請看"面對{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}"。

english: If {@creature Xanathar|WDH} is elsewhere, this room contains only Nar'l and the grell. Nar'l tries to lure adventurers into a showdown with the beholder. If he is wounded, he flees through the trapdoor in the floor and retreats to {@area X35|2c7} while the grell covers his escape.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}在其他地方，這個房間只包含納爾和觸鬚怪。納爾試圖誘使冒險家與眼魔決鬥。如果他受傷，他會透過地板上的陷阱門逃跑，並撤退到{@area X35|2c7}，而觸鬚怪掩護他的逃跑。

english: If the party includes members of Bregan D'aerthe and Nar'l recognizes them as such, he gives them his vial of {@item eyescratch|WDH} poison so they can blind {@creature Xanathar|WDH} with it. This act of treachery, witnessed by the grell, turns the creature against him.
zh_tw: 如果隊伍中包含布雷甘·達耶成員且納爾認出他們身份，他會將其擁有的{@item eyescratch|WDH|眼撓}交給隊伍用以致盲{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}。這一背叛行為被格里爾眼魔目睹，導致該生物轉而攻擊他。

english: Secret Trapdoor
zh_tw: 秘密陷阱門

english: A hidden trapdoor in the floor can be found with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check. It can be lifted with a successful {@dc 12} Strength (Athletics) check, revealing a wooden ladder that leads down to {@area X29|2b9}.
zh_tw: 成功透過一次 {@dc 15} 感知（感知）檢定可以發現地板上的一個隱蔽活板門。成功透過一次 {@dc 12} 力量（運動）檢定可以將其掀開，露出一架通向 {@area X29|2b9} 的木梯。

english: X19. Xanathar's Sanctum
zh_tw: X19. 姍娜薩的聖所

english: This magically lit room has a flat, 30-foot-high ceiling and contains several features:
zh_tw: 這個被魔法照亮的房間有一個平坦的、30尺高的天花板，並包含幾個特點：

english: Luminous violet particles drift through the air like mist. A successful {@dc 12} Intelligence (Nature) check reveals that these are Underdark spores.
zh_tw: 發光的紫色顆粒像薄霧一樣在空氣中飄蕩。成功的 {@dc 12} 智力（自然）檢定會揭示這些是幽暗地域的孢子。

english: A 20-foot-diameter fishbowl dominates the room. Filled with water, it also contains a small coral reef, a miniature shipwreck, and a sunken treasure chest.
zh_tw: 一個直徑20尺的魚缸佔據了房間的主導地位。裡面裝滿了水，還包括一個小珊瑚礁、一個微型沉船和一個沉沒的寶箱。

english: A smaller fishbowl, 3 feet in diameter, rests on a pedestal next to the larger bowl. A dwarf wearing a skullcap adorned with eyestalks feeds a trout-sized fish that swims in circles in this smaller bowl.
zh_tw: 一個直徑3尺的較小魚缸坐落在較大魚缸旁邊的基座上。一個戴著裝飾有眼柄的頭骨帽的矮人正在給一條在較小魚缸中繞圈遊動的鱒魚大小的魚餵食。

english: A 10-foot-diameter silver mirror is embedded in the western wall. Letters are engraved into its frame.
zh_tw: 一個直徑10尺的銀色鏡子嵌入在西牆中。鏡子的框架上刻有文字。

english: The eastern tunnel starts 10 feet above the floor and gently slopes upward to {@area X21|2a4}. ({@creature Xanathar|WDH} uses this passage as an escape route.)
zh_tw: 東部隧道起始於離地面10尺處，並且緩緩向上傾斜至{@area X21|2a4}。({@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}使用這個通道作為逃跑路線。)

english: If {@creature Xanathar|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) is here, it's {@condition invisible} and speaking affectionately to the fish while the dwarf, {@creature Ott Steeltoes|wdh}, feeds it.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）在這裡，它是{@condition invisible||隱形}狀態，並且在親切地對魚說話，而矮人{@creature Ott Steeltoes|wdh|奧特·鋼趾}正在餵魚。

english: Dwarf Fishkeeper
zh_tw: 矮人魚飼養員

english: {@creature Ott Steeltoes|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) is {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s fishkeeper. If he sees intruders and the beholder isn't present, Ott draws his dagger and stammers, "You shouldn't be here! Stay back, or I'll call the boss!" Ott can't telepathically communicate with {@creature Xanathar|WDH}, but he thinks he can. He closes his eyes and frantically asks for {@creature Xanathar|WDH} to return to its sanctum and disintegrate the intruders.
zh_tw: {@creature Ott Steeltoes|wdh|奧特·鋼趾}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）是{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的魚飼養員。如果他看到入侵者並且眼魔不在場，奧特會拔出他的匕首並結巴地說："你們不應該在這裡！後退，否則我會叫老闆！"奧特不能與{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}進行心靈交流，但他認為自己可以。他閉上眼睛並急切地請求{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}返回其聖所並消滅入侵者。

english: Fishbowls
zh_tw: 魚缸

english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s pet fish, {@creature Sylgar|wdh}, is the only creature that the beholder loves as much as itself. In fact, there have been many Sylgars over the years, but Ott is skilled at acquiring a replacement before {@creature Xanathar|WDH} realizes its beloved pet has died.
zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的寵物魚，{@creature Sylgar|wdh|斯爾嘉}，是眼魔唯一像愛自己一樣愛的生物。實際上，多年來已經有很多個斯爾嘉，但奧特擅長在{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}意識到它心愛的寵物死亡之前獲得一個替代品。

english: {@creature Sylgar|WDH}'s large fishbowl weighs about 6,000 pounds, and the treasure chest at the bottom is real (see "Treasure" below). The small fishbowl weighs 60 pounds and is used primarily for feedings. {@creature Xanathar|WDH} uses its telekinesis ray to transfer {@creature Sylgar|WDH} from one fishbowl to another.
zh_tw: {@creature Sylgar|WDH|斯爾嘉}的大魚缸重約6000磅，底部的寶箱是真實的（見下文的"寶藏"）。小魚缸重60磅，主要用於餵食。{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}使用它的念力射線將{@creature Sylgar|WDH|斯爾嘉}從一個魚缸轉移到另一個魚缸。

english: Mirror
zh_tw: 鏡子

english: Carved into the mirror's frame is the word "Xoblob." A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals an aura of divination magic around the mirror. Speaking the word "Xoblob" within 10 feet of the mirror causes its reflective surface to become a scrying sensor, showing the Old Xoblob Shop and the street in front of it, as seen through the eyes of the stuffed beholder that hangs in the shop's display window (see "Old Xoblob Shop").
zh_tw: 鏡子的框架上刻著"索布洛布"這個詞。一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術揭示了鏡子周圍的占卜魔法光環。在鏡子10尺範圍內說出"索布洛布"這個詞，會使它的反射表面變成一個偵查感測器，顯示出老索布洛布商店和商店前面的街道，就像透過商店展示窗中掛著的填充眼魔的眼睛所看到的那樣（見"老索布洛布商店"）。

english: Spores
zh_tw: 孢子

english: The purple spores are infused with {@i faerzress}, a magical radiation found in the Underdark. A creature that ends its turn in the room must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or suffer a random form of short-term madness, determined by rolling on the Short-Term Madness table in chapter 8 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|dmg}. A creature doesn't need to inhale the spores to be affected by them. Once the madness ends, the creature becomes immune to the spores in this room.
zh_tw: 這些紫色孢子滲入了{@i 費爾茲瑞斯}，一種在幽暗地域中發現的神奇輻射。任何在這個房間內結束其回合的生物必須成功透過一個{@dc 13} 的體質豁免檢定，否則將遭受一種隨機形式的短期瘋狂，這種瘋狂透過在第8章的短期瘋狂表中擲骰決定（參考{@book 城主指南|dmg}）。生物不需要吸入孢子就會受到它們的影響。一旦瘋狂結束，該生物將對這個房間中的孢子免疫。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The treasure chest is unlocked and contains thirty 100 gp gemstones. If {@creature Xanathar|WDH} has retrieved the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, the artifact is also here.
zh_tw: 寶箱沒有上鎖，內含三十顆每顆價值100金幣的寶石。如果{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}已經取回{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，這件神器也在這裡。

english: X20. Dream Nullifier
zh_tw: X20. 夢境消除器

english: This side chamber contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個側室包含以下特點：

english: A 6-foot-diameter bowl made of crystal lattice pulsates with multicolored light as it floats 10 feet off the floor.
zh_tw: 一個直徑6尺的由水晶格子製成的碗在離地面10尺處懸浮，隨著它發出多彩的光芒而脈動。

english: A mangy straw pallet lies on the floor under the bowl. (The fishkeeper, {@creature Ott Steeltoes|wdh}, uses the pallet as a bed.)
zh_tw: 一個破舊的稻草墊子位於碗下面的地面上。（魚飼養員，{@creature Ott Steeltoes|wdh|奧特·鋼趾}，使用這個墊子作為床。）

english: Dream Nullifier
zh_tw: 夢境中和器

english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH} hired a wizard to construct a device that would prevent it from accidentally dreaming another beholder into existence. The bowl-shaped "dream nullifier" magically wakes {@creature Xanathar|WDH} when it starts to dream about other beholders. If the bowl is engulfed by an {@spell antimagic field} or targeted by a {@spell dispel magic} spell or similar effect, it crashes to the floor and shatters into a million pieces.
zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}聘請了一位法師建造了一個裝置，以防止它不小心夢到另一個眼魔的存在。碗狀的"夢境消除器"會在{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}開始夢到其他眼魔時神奇地喚醒它。如果碗被{@spell antimagic field||反魔法場}或被{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}法術或類似效果瞄準，它會墜落到地面並碎成百萬片。

english: X21. Beholder Escape Route
zh_tw: X21. 眼魔逃生路線

english: Set into the floor at the north end of a tunnel that gently slopes down to {@area X19|29c} is a circular stone plug that opens in the ceiling of the hallway below. {@creature Xanathar|WDH} can lift the plug with its telekinesis ray, creating an opening just large enough for it to float through. A character can lift the stone plug with a successful {@dc 19} Strength (Athletics) check.
zh_tw: 位於隧道北端，緩緩向下傾斜至{@area X19|29c}的地板上，有一個圓形的石塞，它可以開啟下方走廊的天花板。{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}可以用它的心靈感應射線舉起石塞，製造一個剛好夠它飄過的開口。一個角色可以透過成功的{@dc 19}力量（運動）檢定來舉起石塞。

english: X22. Arrival Point
zh_tw: X22. 到達點

english: Any creature holding the correct key that steps through the magical portal in {@area Q11|089} of the Xanathar Guild hideout (see chapter 1) appears here, between the columns of rock.
zh_tw: 任何持有正確鑰匙的生物，透過姍娜薩公會藏身之地（見第1章）的{@area Q11|089}中的魔法傳送門，會出現在這裡，位於巖柱之間。

english: A curling staircase in the southwest corner descends 20 feet to {@area X32|2be}.
zh_tw: 西南角的一個螺旋樓梯下降20尺到達{@area X32|2be}。

english: X23. Antechamber of Madness
zh_tw: X23. 瘋狂的前廳

english: This great hall has the following features:
zh_tw: 這個大廳有以下特點：

english: A {@creature kuo-toa whip} and six {@creature kuo-toa} guard the hall. They gather in front of an iron portcullis in the southeast corner and tear bits of flesh off the bones of a recently slain dwarf.
zh_tw: 一隻{@creature kuo-toa whip||寇濤驅策者}和六隻{@creature kuo-toa||寇濤}守衛著大廳。它們聚集在東南角的鐵柵欄前，從最近被殺的矮人骨頭上撕下肉塊。

english: A ghostly eyestalk protrudes from the ceiling in the middle of the hall.
zh_tw: 一個幽靈般的眼柄從大廳中央的天花板突出。

english: The floor is littered with bones and covered with a thin layer of sticky, translucent slime.
zh_tw: 地板上散落著骨頭，覆蓋著一層薄薄的粘稠、半透明的粘液。

english: Kuo-toa
zh_tw: 寇濤

english: These insane creatures are under the control of the mind flayer in {@area X24|2ab} and obey its telepathic commands to the best of their ability. When they detect intruders, they cry out, "Ooop! Ooop!" to alert their illithid master, then charge into battle.
zh_tw: 這些瘋狂的生物受到{@area X24|2ab}中奪心魔的控制，盡其所能地服從其心靈感應命令。當它們探測到入侵者時，會發出"嗚嗚！嗚嗚！"的叫聲來警告它們的奪心魔主人，然後衝進戰鬥。

english: Portcullis
zh_tw: 鐵閘

english: The portcullis between this area and {@area X24|2ab} can be raised with a successful {@dc 22} Strength (Athletics) check, or with a {@spell knock} spell or similar magic. The lever to raise the portcullis is in {@area X24|2ab}.
zh_tw: 這個區域與 {@area X24|2ab} 之間的吊閘可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 22} 力量（運動）檢定、或使用 {@spell knock||敲擊術} 法術或類似魔法來升起。升起吊閘的槓桿位於 {@area X24|2ab}。

english: Scrying Sensor
zh_tw: 偵測感應器

english: The ghostly eyestalk is a magical sensor that allows one of the apprentice wizards in {@area X16|292} to monitor this room. See {@area X2|273} for more information.
zh_tw: 這個幽靈般的眼柄是一個魔法感測器，允許{@area X16|292}中的一位學徒法師監視這個房間。更多資訊請參閱{@area X2|273}。

english: Sticky Slime
zh_tw: 粘軟泥

english: The slime-covered floor is {@quickref difficult terrain||3} for all creatures except kuo-toa, other creatures that have the Slippery trait, and creatures that fly.
zh_tw: 覆蓋著黏液的區域對於所有生物來說都是{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}，除了寇濤魚人、具有滑溜特性的其他生物以及會飛的生物。

english: X24. Extraction Chamber
zh_tw: X24. 提取室

english: A portcullis separates this room from {@area X23|2a6}, and the lever to raise and lower it is set into the north wall. Characters who peer through the bars of the portcullis can see the room's contents:
zh_tw: 一道鐵柵門將這個房間與{@area X23|2a6}隔開，控制升降的槓桿安裝在北牆上。角色們透過鐵柵門的柵欄窺視可以看到房間的內容：

english: In the middle of the room, a blood-spattered chair made of carved stone stands atop a 10-foot-square, 1-foot-high stone slab. Iron manacles are bolted to the chair's armrests.
zh_tw: 在房間中央，一把沾滿血跡的雕刻石椅立在一塊10尺見方、1尺高的石板上。鐵製手銬固定在椅子的扶手上。

english: Trapped in the chair is a {@condition stunned} and weaponless male {@creature drow} in a chain shirt. He is trying to free himself of his bonds but is making no progress.
zh_tw: 被困在椅子上的是一個處於{@condition stunned||震懾}狀態且沒有武器的男性{@creature drow||卓爾}，穿著鎖子甲。他試圖掙脫束縛，但沒有任何進展。

english: Drow Captive
zh_tw: 黑暗精靈俘虜

english: The drow, Zaibon Kyszalt, was captured in Skullport and brought here for interrogation. His superior, Raelyn Auvryndar, was also captured and is confined in {@area X7|27e}. Zaibon wants to free her and escape into Undermountain, where House Auvryndar has outposts.
zh_tw: 這個黑暗精靈，扎伊邦·基薩爾特，在骷髏港被捕並被帶到這裡接受審訊。他的上級，瑞琳·奧弗林達爾，也被俘虜並被關押在{@area X7|27e}。扎伊邦想要解救她並逃到地脈迷城，在奧弗林達爾家族有前哨站的地方。

english: {@creature Nihiloor|WDH} has a key that unlocks the chair's shackles. A character can unlock each shackle with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check using thieves' tools, and a creature shackled to the chair can slip free of these bonds with a successful {@dc 25} Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check.
zh_tw: {@creature Nihiloor|WDH|尼希盧爾} 擁有一把能解鎖椅子鐐銬的鑰匙。一個角色可以使用盜賊工具進行一次成功的 {@dc 15} 敏捷檢定來解鎖每個鐐銬，而被束縛在椅子上的生物可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 25} 敏捷（巧手）檢定掙脫這些束縛。

english: The mind flayer has telepathically interrogated Zaibon and learned about a House Auvryndar plot to conquer Skullport, as well as mounting tensions between the drow houses of Auvryndar and Freth. The mind flayer is getting ready to implant an intellect devourer in Zaibon's skull, then use him to undermine the drow plot and foment war between the drow houses. (Were Zaibon less useful, the mind flayer would have extracted his brain and turned it into an intellect devourer instead.) Zaibon knows nothing of the fate that awaits him.
zh_tw: 奪心魔透過心靈感應審問了扎伊邦，瞭解到了奧弗林達爾家族征服骷髏港的計劃，以及奧弗林達爾和弗雷斯兩個黑暗精靈家族之間日益緊張的關係。奪心魔正準備在扎伊邦的頭骨中植入一個噬腦怪，然後利用他來破壞黑暗精靈的計劃，並在黑暗精靈家族之間煽動戰爭。（如果扎伊邦不那麼有用，奪心魔會提取他的大腦，將其變成一個噬腦怪。）扎伊邦對他即將到來的命運一無所知。

english: Mind Flayer
zh_tw: 奪心魔

english: If the characters haven't already dealt with {@creature Nihiloor|WDH}, the mind flayer interrupts as they interact with Zaibon, entering from {@area X26|2b1} with an {@creature intellect devourer} in its hands. If Zaibon is free of the chair, he tries to get as far away from the mind flayer and its "pet" as he can. {@creature Nihiloor|WDH} doesn't pursue anyone who flees, trusting that they won't get far.
zh_tw: 如果角色們還沒有處理{@creature Nihiloor|WDH|尼希盧爾}，當他們與扎伊邦互動時，奪心魔會中斷他們的行動，從{@area X26|2b1}進入，手裡拿著一個{@creature intellect devourer||噬腦怪}。如果扎伊邦已經從椅子上解脫，他會儘可能遠離奪心魔及其"寵物"。{@creature Nihiloor|WDH|尼希盧爾}不會追擊任何逃跑的人，相信他們逃不遠。

english: Replacing the Mind Flayer
zh_tw: 替換奪心魔

english: {@creature Nihiloor|WDH} the mind flayer has carved out its own lair within {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s lair (areas X23 through X26). If {@creature Nihiloor|WDH} is killed earlier in the adventure, replace it with a mind flayer named Qrr'zarq.
zh_tw: {@creature Nihiloor|WDH|尼希盧爾} 這個奪心魔在{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的巢穴（X23至X26區域）內開闢了自己的巢穴。如果{@creature Nihiloor|WDH|尼希盧爾}在冒險早期被殺死，用一個名叫克爾札克的奪心魔來替換它。

english: Qrr'zarq comes from a colony of mind flayers in Undermountain that wants to implant {@creature Xanathar|WDH} with an illithid tadpole and, through a magical process called ceremorphosis, turn the beholder into a thrall. Qrr'zarq is waiting for an opportunity to implant the tadpole while {@creature Xanathar|WDH} is alone and asleep. The mind flayer doesn't want adventurers to complicate or ruin its brilliant plan, which it keeps to itself. It offers to help characters who agree not to harm it or the beholder.
zh_tw: 克爾札克來自地脈迷城的一個奪心魔群體，該群體想要將一個奪心魔蝌蚪植入{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}體內，並透過一種叫做腦蟲化（奪心魔轉化）的魔法過程，將眼魔變成一個奴隸。克爾札克正在等待一個機會，在{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}獨自睡覺時植入蝌蚪。這個奪心魔不想讓冒險者幹擾或破壞它的宏偉計劃，它自己保守著這個計劃。它願意幫助那些同意不傷害它或眼魔的角色。

english: X25. Food for Thought
zh_tw: X25. 思考的食物

english: This magically lit room contains these features:
zh_tw: 這個被魔法照亮的房間包含以下特點：

english: The room reeks of death and carnage.
zh_tw: 這個房間充滿了死亡和屠殺的惡臭。

english: Three wooden tables are arranged corner to corner, forming a triangle, in the middle of the room. The floor around them is stained with blood.
zh_tw: 房間中央，三張木桌角對角擺放，形成一個三角形。桌子周圍的地板上沾滿了血跡。

english: Atop two of the tables, held down with leather straps, are two humans ({@creature commoner||commoners}) dressed like homeless men. One looks dead, and the other gibbers like a madman. The third table is bare except for an area of sticky blood at one end.
zh_tw: 兩張桌子上，用皮帶固定著兩個打扮成無家可歸者的人類（{@creature commoner||平民}）。一個看起來已經死了，另一個則像瘋子一樣胡言亂語。第三張桌子上除了一端有一塊粘血的區域外，其他部分都是空的。

english: Unhappy Meals
zh_tw: 不愉快的餐點

english: The Xanathar Guild captures homeless Waterdavians and brings them here for {@creature Nihiloor|WDH} to feed on. After devouring their brains, the mind flayer gives their corpses to his kuo-toa thralls to eat.
zh_tw: 姍娜薩公會捕捉無家可歸的深水城的市民並將他們帶到這裡供{@creature Nihiloor|WDH|尼希盧爾}食用。奪心魔吞食他們的大腦後，將他們的屍體交給他的寇濤魚人奴隸食用。

english: The two men, a locksmith named Skarn Zarphoul and a broadcrier named Holvan Ebberek, recently heard a dwarf getting his brain sucked out. Skarn is {@condition stunned} and catatonic from the shock of it, and Holvan is a gibbering lunatic. A {@spell greater restoration} spell or similar magic restores either man's sanity. The men were hooded and brought here separately, so they know nothing of the dungeon's layout or occupants (other than the mind flayer). If their sanity is restored, they are eager to return to their families in Waterdeep.
zh_tw: 這兩個人，一個名叫斯卡恩·扎爾弗爾的鎖匠和一個名叫霍爾萬·埃貝雷克的傳令員，最近聽到了一個矮人的大腦被吸出的聲音。斯卡恩因震驚而處於{@condition stunned||震懾}和精神錯亂狀態，而霍爾萬則變成了一個語無倫次的瘋子。一個{@spell greater restoration||高等復原術}法術或類似的魔法可以恢復這兩個人的理智。這些人被分別蒙上眼睛帶到這裡，所以他們對地牢的佈局或居住者（除了奪心魔之外）一無所知。如果他們的理智得到恢復，他們渴望回到深水城的家人身邊。

english: X26. Devourer Spawning Pool
zh_tw: X26. 吞噬者孵化池

english: This room has the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間有以下特點：

english: In the middle of the area is a 10-foot-diameter, 2-foot-deep circular pool containing luminous green brine. Swimming in the brine are four {@creature intellect devourer||intellect devourers}. If it has not been encountered and defeated elsewhere, {@creature Nihiloor|WDH} the {@creature mind flayer} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) is standing in the pool with the intellect devourers.
zh_tw: 在區域中央是一個直徑10尺、深2尺的圓形水池，裡面充滿了發光的綠色鹽水。鹽水中游動著四隻{@creature intellect devourer||噬腦怪}。如果{@creature Nihiloor|WDH|尼希盧爾}這個{@creature mind flayer||奪心魔}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）在其他地方沒有被遇到並擊敗，它將站在水池中與智力吞噬者一起。

english: Rusty manacles are bolted to the walls. (Hosts for the intellect devourers are chained in these locations.)
zh_tw: 生鏽的手銬固定在牆上。（噬腦怪的宿主被鎖鏈鎖在這些位置。）

english: The brine is a magical substance that radiates an aura of transmutation magic under the scrutiny of a {@spell detect magic} spell. {@creature Nihiloor|WDH} uses it to transform humanoid brains into intellect devourers. The process is far from perfect. A full 90 percent of the brains left in the brine rot and die, while the remaining 10 percent transform after marinating for {@dice 1d4 + 1} days.
zh_tw: 鹽水是一種魔法物質，在{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術的檢查下會散發出變化魔法的光環。{@creature Nihiloor|WDH|尼希盧爾}用它將類人生物的大腦轉化為噬腦怪。這個過程遠非完美。浸泡在鹽水中的大腦中有整整90%會腐爛死亡，而剩下的10%在浸泡{@dice 1d4 + 1}天后會發生轉變。

english: {@creature Nihiloor|WDH} and the intellect devourers make their stand here. If the characters flee, the mind flayer sends the intellect devourers after them and stays behind.
zh_tw: {@creature Nihiloor|WDH|尼希盧爾}和噬腦怪在這裡進行抵抗。如果角色們逃跑，奪心魔會派遣噬腦怪追趕他們，而自己留在後面。

english: X27. Prison
zh_tw: X27. 監獄

english: {@creature Nihiloor|WDH} the mind flayer uses this prison to confine potential hosts for his brood of intellect devourers. Captured characters might find themselves incarcerated here until they can be made into hosts. The area contains the following features:
zh_tw: {@creature Nihiloor|WDH|尼希盧爾}這個奪心魔使用這個監獄來關押他的噬腦怪後代的潛在宿主。被捕獲的角色可能會發現自己被關押在這裡，直到他們可以被變成宿主。這個區域包含以下特點：

english: Eight locked iron doors lead to cells, some of which have bars separating them.
zh_tw: 八扇鎖著的鐵門通向牢房，其中一些牢房之間有用鐵柵欄隔開。

english: Three {@creature kuo-toa whip||kuo-toa whips} stand guard here and attack any creature other than {@creature Nihiloor|WDH} that enters, including other kuo-toa. One of the whips carries the keys to the cell doors on a ring.
zh_tw: 三名{@creature kuo-toa whip||寇濤驅策者}在這裡站崗，攻擊任何進入的生物，除了{@creature Nihiloor|WDH|尼希盧爾}，包括其他的寇濤魚人。其中一名鞭持有牢房門鑰匙，鑰匙掛在一個環上。

english: A 1-foot-tall figurine of an otherworldly creature rests atop a slime-covered alabaster pedestal against the east wall, between two cell doors.
zh_tw: 一個1尺高的異世界生物雕像坐落在東牆邊，兩個牢房門之間，覆蓋著粘液的雪花石膏基座上。

english: Cells
zh_tw: 牢房

english: A character outside a cell can pick its lock with a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check using thieves' tools. Each cell contains a reeking chamber pot and no other furnishings.
zh_tw: 一個在牢房外的角色可以透過使用盜賊工具進行一次成功的{@dc 20}敏捷檢定來撬鎖。每個牢房內都有一個散發惡臭的便壺，沒有其他傢俱。

english: Imprisoned in the westernmost cell along the north wall is Hyustus Staget, a captain of the City Watch whom the characters have met (see "The Watch Arrives"). He was kidnapped while off duty and is without his armor and weapons. If Hyustus has died for whatever reason, replace him with a female human Watch officer named Cressa Galavarco (LG female Tethyrian {@creature veteran} with no armor or weapons). Whoever is here has a date with an intellect devourer.
zh_tw: 被關押在北牆最西端牢房的是休斯圖斯·斯塔吉特，他是城市守衛的隊長，角色們已經見過他（見"警衛到達"）。他在休假時被綁架，沒有穿戴盔甲和武器。如果休斯圖斯因任何原因死亡，請用一位名叫克蕾莎·加拉瓦爾科的女性人類警衛官員（守序善良女性泰瑟爾人 {@creature veteran||老兵}，沒有盔甲或武器）來替換他。無論是誰在這裡，都註定要成為噬腦怪的物件。

english: God Figurine
zh_tw: 神像

english: The figurine on the pedestal is crudely fashioned out of clay. It has the head of a hammerhead shark, the upper torso of a bare-chested male, dragon wings sprouting from its shoulders, and octopus tentacles where its legs should be. The kuo-toa modeled it after an imaginary god they call Garshoogah.
zh_tw: 基座上的雕像是用粘土粗略製成的。它有一個錘頭鯊的頭部，上軀幹是一個赤裸上身的男性，肩膀上長著龍翼，本應是腿部的位置有章魚的觸手。寇濤魚人根據他們想象中的神加爾舒加塑造了它。

english: X28. Guild Recreation Hall
zh_tw: X28. 公會娛樂大廳

english: Deafeningly loud music and chatter fill this magically lit room, which is decorated like a tavern:
zh_tw: 震耳欲聾的音樂和聊天聲充滿了這個被魔法照亮的房間，房間裝飾得像一家酒館：

english: Ten human {@creature bandit||bandits} (members of the Xanathar Guild) sit around two trellis tables, drinking Wyrmwizz Ale, smoking pipes, clapping their hands, and stomping their feet while two {@creature goblin||goblins} wearing chamber pots on their heads dance and sing atop a third table.
zh_tw: 十名人類{@creature bandit||匪徒}（姍娜薩公會的成員）圍坐在兩張藤桌旁，喝著龍尿麥酒，抽著菸鬥，拍手，跺腳，同時兩個{@creature goblin||地精}戴著便桶作為帽子在第三張桌子上跳舞唱歌。

english: If he's not with {@creature Xanathar|WDH} in the arena ({@area X6|27a}), {@creature Noska Ur'gray|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) is here, drinking with the others.
zh_tw: 如果他不是和{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}在競技場({@area X6|27a})，{@creature Noska Ur'gray|wdh|諾思卡·厄格雷}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）就在這裡，和其他一起喝酒。

english: A wooden rack along the east wall holds five large ale barrels with spigots punched into them. Protruding from the ceiling above the barrels is a ghostly eyestalk (scrying sensor).
zh_tw: 東牆邊的木架上放著五個大啤酒桶，桶上裝有龍頭。從桶上方的天花板突出的是一個幽靈般的眼柄（窺視感測器）。

english: Xanathar Guild Members
zh_tw: 姍娜薩公會成員

english: These villains are celebrating the capture of an off-duty City Watch captain (see {@area X27|2b2}). Characters who eavesdrop on the chatter hear one guild member say, "We caught ourselves a Watch captain! {@creature Ahmaergo|WDH} says the boss is happier than a pink flumph, whatever that is. Today, free ale! Tomorrow, {@item gold|PHB} and glory!" This proclamation is followed by loud cheers.
zh_tw: 這些惡棍正在慶祝捉到了一名休假中的城市守衛長（見{@area X27|2b2}）。偷聽他們談話的角色會聽到一個公會成員說，"我們抓到了一個警衛隊長！{@creature Ahmaergo|WDH|阿莫戈}說老闆比粉色的呋嚕還要高興，不管那是什麼。今天，免費啤酒！明天，{@item gold|PHB|金}和榮耀！"這個宣言之後是響亮的歡呼聲。

english: Goblins
zh_tw: 地精

english: The goblins, Lulz and Vellix, are servers who have allowed themselves to get swept up in the reverie. If a fight breaks out, they hide under a table and throw themselves at the mercy of the party if the characters emerge victorious.
zh_tw: 地精盧爾茲和維利克斯是服務員，他們讓自己沉浸在這種狂歡中。如果發生戰鬥，他們會躲在桌子下面，如果角色們獲勝，他們會向隊伍求饒。

english: Scrying Sensor
zh_tw: 偵測感應器

english: The ghostly eyestalk is a magical sensor that allows one of the apprentice wizards in {@area X16|292} to monitor this room. See {@area X2|273} for more information.
zh_tw: 這個幽靈般的眼柄是一個魔法感測器，允許{@area X16|292}中的一位學徒法師監視這個房間。更多資訊請參閱{@area X2|273}。

english: X29. Trapdoor
zh_tw: X29. 活板門

english: At the top of a staircase is a landing with a ladder leading up to a stone trapdoor that requires a successful {@dc 12} Strength (Athletics) check to be lifted. The trapdoor opens into {@area X18|29a} above.
zh_tw: 樓梯頂部是一個平臺，上面有一個梯子通向一塊石制活板門，需要成功透過一個 {@dc 12} 力量（運動）檢定才能將其抬起。活板門通向上面的 {@area X18|29a}。

english: X30. Xanathar's Gourmet Kitchen
zh_tw: X30. 姍娜薩的美食廚房

english: A delightful aroma wafts down the hall from this kitchen, blending the scents of rare spices, savory meats, and fresh herbs. The room contains the following features:
zh_tw: 從這個廚房飄來一股令人愉悅的香氣，混合著稀有香料、美味肉類和新鮮香草的香味。房間包含以下特點：

english: Seven {@creature kobold||kobolds} wearing white toque hats dash between stout tables, frantically preparing meals for {@creature Xanathar|WDH} and arranging the food on silver platters.
zh_tw: 七個戴著白色廚師帽的{@creature kobold||狗頭人}在結實的餐桌間穿梭，瘋狂地為{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}準備餐點，並將食物擺放在銀盤子上。

english: Two {@creature gazer|VGM|gazers} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) dreamed into reality by {@creature Xanathar|WDH} oversee the kobolds and use their telekinesis rays to hoist and deliver food platters.
zh_tw: 兩隻由{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}夢境創造的{@creature gazer|VGM|凝視者眼魔}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）監督著狗頭人，並使用它們的念力射線舉起並傳遞食物託盤。

english: Two iron stoves stand against the east wall, with a slender spice rack nestled between them.
zh_tw: 兩個鐵爐子靠在東牆上，它們之間放著一個細長的調料架。

english: When it comes to meals, {@creature Xanathar|WDH} prefers the finest Sword Coast cuisine, including a healthy diet of mushrooms, as opposed to uncooked meat. All the meals prepared here are for the consumption of {@creature Xanathar|WDH} alone.
zh_tw: 在飲食方面，{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}更喜歡最優質的劍海岸美食，包括豐富的蘑菇飲食，而不是生肉。這裡準備的所有餐點都是僅供{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}獨自享用的。

english: The gazers attack intruders on sight, while the kobolds flee by the easiest route.
zh_tw: 凝視者眼魔在看到入侵者時會發起攻擊，而狗頭人則會尋找最簡便的路線逃跑。

english: Spice Rack
zh_tw: 調料架

english: The rack contains thirty bottles of rare spices worth 10 gp each.
zh_tw: 這個架子上放著三十瓶珍貴的香料，每瓶價值10金幣。

english: X31. The Other Kitchen
zh_tw: X31. 另一個廚房

english: Black smoke follows the stench of burned meat and bread down the hallway. This magically lit kitchen has the following features:
zh_tw: 黑色的煙霧伴隨著燒焦的肉和麵包的惡臭沿著走廊蔓延。這個透過魔法照明的廚房有以下特點：

english: A haggard male halfling frantically tries to cook meat, knead dough, simmer sauce, and mix spices all at once.
zh_tw: 一個面容憔悴的男性半身人正瘋狂地試圖同時烹飪肉品、揉麵團、燉醬和混合香料。

english: An iron stove stands against the south wall, and cooking utensils hang from hooks just beyond the halfling's reach.
zh_tw: 一個鐵爐子靠在南牆上，烹飪用具掛在半身人夠不著的掛鉤上。

english: Halfling Cook
zh_tw: 半身人廚師

english: When the halfling spots the characters, a relieved smile crosses his face. "Finally!" he says excitedly. "I haven't had a break in half a tenday. Make sure you stir the sauce once every five minutes." He then hands the characters his apron, mistaking them for the actual kitchen staff.
zh_tw: 當這個半身人注意到角色們時，他的臉上露出了寬慰的微笑。"終於！"他興奮地說。"我已經有半十天沒有休息了。確保你們每五分鐘攪拌一次醬汁。"然後他把圍裙遞給角色們，誤以為他們是真正的廚房員工。

english: {@creature Bepis Honeymaker|wdh} is a honey merchant who was kidnapped from his Trades Ward home a month ago. The Xanathar Guild tried to ransom him back, but seemingly his relatives either couldn't pay or decided not to. (In truth, his rotten in-laws destroyed the ransom notes and told Bepis' wife and children that he ran away with another family.) {@creature Ahmaergo|WDH} has put him to work as a cook but threatens to give him over to the mind flayer {@creature Nihiloor|WDH} every so often.
zh_tw: {@creature Bepis Honeymaker|wdh|貝皮斯·蜜釀師}是一名蜂蜜商人，一個月前在商業區的家中遭到綁架。姍娜薩公會曾向他的家人勒索贖金，但他的親屬似乎不是付不出來，就是決定不付。（實際上，他那些惡劣的姻親銷毀了勒贖信，並告訴貝皮斯的妻兒，他拋下他們，跟另一個家庭跑了。）{@creature Ahmaergo|WDH|阿莫戈}讓他當廚師，卻不時威脅要把他交給奪心魔{@creature Nihiloor|WDH|尼希盧爾}。

english: Bepis is a strongheart halfling commoner, with these changes:
zh_tw: 貝皮斯是一個勇敢的半身人普通人，有以下變化：

english: Bepis is lawful good.
zh_tw: 貝皮斯是守序善良。

english: He is Small and has 3 ({@dice 1d6}) hit points.
zh_tw: 他是小型生物，擁有 3 ({@dice 1d6}) 點生命值。

english: He has these racial traits: His walking speed is 25 feet. He can move through the space of a Medium or larger creature. He has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition frightened}. He speaks Common and Halfling.
zh_tw: 他有以下種族特性：他的步行速度是每小時25尺。他可以透過中等大小或更大的生物的空間移動。他在對抗{@condition frightened||恐懼}狀態的豁免檢定中具有優勢。他能說通用語和半身人語。

english: X32. Stairs and Scrying Sensor
zh_tw: X32. 樓梯和偵視感應器

english: A staircase curls up to {@area X22|2a5}, and a ghostly eyestalk sprouts from the hallway ceiling. The eyestalk is a magical sensor that allows one of the apprentice wizards in {@area X16|292} to monitor this corridor (see {@area X2|273} for more information).
zh_tw: 一段螺旋樓梯通向{@area X22|2a5}，一個幽靈般的眼柄從走廊天花板上長出。這個眼柄是一個魔法感應器，允許{@area X16|292}中的一名學徒法師監視這個走廊（更多資訊見{@area X2|273}）。

english: X33. Crypt of Xanathars Past
zh_tw: X33. 姍娜薩先輩的墓穴

english: This room contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間包含以下特點：

english: Suspended in floor-to-ceiling crystal cylinders are four dead beholders preserved in embalming fluid. Magical lights illuminate the cylinders from within.
zh_tw: 四個死去的眼魔被懸掛在從地板到天花板的水晶圓柱中，儲存在防腐液裡。魔法燈光從圓柱內部照亮它們。

english: Nine shallow alcoves have murals of beholders painted on their walls. Standing in each alcove is a beholder-shaped copper urn atop a green marble pedestal. The lid of each urn is molded with ten eyestalks. (At the back of the westernmost alcove in the north wall is a secret door.)
zh_tw: 九個淺凹處的牆上繪有眼魔的壁畫。每個凹處都有一個銅甕，形狀像眼魔，放在綠色大理石基座上。每個甕的蓋子上都鑄有十個眼柄。（在北牆最西端凹處的後面有一扇秘密門。）

english: The western wall is carved to display a scowling beholder flanked by two hooded wizards. Beneath each wizard's cowl, one glaring eye is visible.
zh_tw: 西牆雕刻著一個怒視的眼魔，兩側各有一個戴著兜帽的法師。在每個法師的兜帽下，可以看到一隻瞪視的眼睛。

english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), if present, is gazing somberly at the tombs of past Xanathars.
zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），如果它在場，正凝重地凝視著過去姍娜薩的墳墓。

english: Beholder Urns
zh_tw: 眼魔骨灰盒

english: The copper urns contain the dust of disintegrated beholders. If the dust from an urn is poured out, it coalesces into the vague shape of a floating beholder for a few seconds, makes a growling noise, then loses cohesion and falls to the floor.
zh_tw: 這些銅製骨灰盒內裝有解體後的眼魔的灰燼。如果將骨灰盒中的灰燼倒出，它會在幾秒鐘內凝聚成模糊的漂浮眼魔形狀，發出咆哮聲，然後失去凝聚力，落到地面上。

english: Crystal Crypts
zh_tw: 水晶墓穴

english: Each crystal cylinder has AC 10, 15 hit points, resistance to slashing and piercing damage, and vulnerability to bludgeoning damage. If a cylinder is shattered, the fluid within it washes across the floor as the dead beholder lands with a wet plop and expels {@dice 1d4} baby {@creature gas spore||gas spores} that grow to full size in 30 days. Any character infected by these gas spores gains the following flaw until the disease is cured: "I hate other beholders. If I see a beholder, I must try to destroy it."
zh_tw: 每個水晶柱子的AC為10，有15點生命值，對揮砍和穿刺傷害有抗性，對鈍擊傷害有弱點。如果柱子被砸碎，裡面的液體會隨著死亡的眼魔落地時發出溼噠噠的聲音而流到地板上，同時釋放出{@dice 1d4}個幼年{@creature gas spore||毒氣孢子}，這些孢子在30天內長到成年大小。任何被這些瓦斯孢子感染的角色在疾病治癒之前都會獲得以下缺陷：'我討厭其他眼魔。如果我看到一個眼魔，我必須嘗試摧毀它。'

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: The secret door can be found with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check. It pulls open to reveal {@area X6|27a} beyond.
zh_tw: 透過成功的 {@dc 15} 感知（感知）檢定可以發現這個密門。拉開後可以看到後面的 {@area X6|27a}。

english: Wall Carvings
zh_tw: 牆雕

english: Any character who studies the carvings on the west wall and succeeds on a {@dc 12} Wisdom (Perception) check notices that each wizard's eye is a button that can be pushed. If a character pushes either button, or uses an object or spell to do so, the beholder carving on the wall discharges a green ray that the character can dodge with a successful {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw. If the ray hits, the character appears to be disintegrated but is actually teleported to {@area X34a|2c5} or X34b, depending on which button was pushed. Once a button is pushed, it locks in place for 1 hour and can't be pushed again until that time elapses. A character can forcibly reset a button by making a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check using thieves' tools.
zh_tw: 任何研究西牆雕刻並透過 {@dc 12} 感知（感知）檢定的角色會注意到每個法師的眼睛都是一個可以按下的按鈕。如果角色按下任一按鈕，或使用物品或法術來按下按鈕，牆上的眼魔雕刻會釋放一道綠色射線，角色可以透過成功的 {@dc 16} 敏捷豁免來躲避。如果射線擊中，角色看起來像是被瓦解，但實際上被傳送到 {@area X34a|2c5} 或 X34b，具體取決於按下的是哪個按鈕。一旦按鈕被按下，它會鎖定1小時，在此期間無法再次按下。角色可以透過成功的 {@dc 20} 敏捷檢定使用盜賊工具強行重置按鈕。

english: X34. Wizard Tombs
zh_tw: X34. 法師墓穴

english: These crypts were built to hold the remains of two wizards who lived in this dungeon complex long before {@creature Xanathar|WDH} took it over. Only one wizard is entombed here, however. The fate of the other wizard is unknown. Both chambers are encased in solid stone and brightly lit by {@spell continual flame} spells cast on wall sconces.
zh_tw: 這些墓穴是為了安放兩位法師的遺骸而建造的，這兩位法師在{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}接管這個地下城之前就已經生活在這裡了。然而，這裡只安葬了一位法師。另一位法師的命運未知。兩個墓室都被堅固的石頭所包圍，並且由施放在牆壁壁燈上的{@spell continual flame||不滅明焰}法術照亮。

english: X34a
zh_tw: X34a

english: In the middle of this tomb rests a gold marble sarcophagus, its lid carved in the likeness of a longhaired human wizard who wears a robe adorned with closed eyes. The sarcophagus can't be pried open or damaged, but if a spell is cast within the tomb, the eyes of the robe open all at once-an eerie yet harmless effect-and the lid slowly levitates into the air, revealing the contents of the sarcophagus: a shriveled, inanimate mummy wearing {@item eyes of charming}. After 1 minute, the eyes on the lid close as it slowly sinks back down, resealing the sarcophagus until another spell is cast within the tomb.
zh_tw: 這個墓室中央安放著一個黃金大理石製成的石棺，其蓋子上雕刻著一位長髮人類法師的形象，他身穿一件裝飾有閉眼圖案的長袍。石棺無法撬開或損壞，但如果在墓室內施放法術，長袍上的眼睛會同時睜開——這是一個詭異但無害的效果——蓋子緩緩升空，露出石棺的內容：一個乾癟的、無生命的木乃伊，戴著{@item eyes of charming||魅惑鏡片}。1分鐘後，蓋子上的眼睛閉合，蓋子緩緩下沉，重新封閉石棺，直到墓室內再次施放法術。

english: A character who dons the {@item eyes of charming} can see, through its blue lenses, a blue metal tile shaped like a four-pointed star on the west wall. The tile is invisible otherwise, but can be found with a tactile search and a successful {@dc 17} Wisdom (Perception) check. When a creature touches the tile, all creatures in the tomb are instantly teleported to the arena ({@area X6|27a}).
zh_tw: 一個角色戴上 {@item eyes of charming||魅惑鏡片} 後，可以透過其藍色鏡片看到西牆上有一個形狀像四角星的藍色金屬瓦片。該瓦片在其他情況下是看不見的，但可以透過觸覺搜尋和一次成功的 {@dc 17} 感知檢定找到。當一個生物觸控到瓦片時，墓穴中的所有生物會立即被傳送到競技場 ({@area X6|27a})。

english: X34b
zh_tw: X34b

english: This tomb is empty except for an invisible, blue metal tile on the west wall. It functions identically to the one in {@area X34a|2c5}.
zh_tw: 這個墓室除了西牆上的一個不可見的藍色金屬瓦片外，是空的。它的功能與{@area X34a|2c5}中的瓦片完全相同。

english: X35. Nar'l Xibrindas's Office
zh_tw: X35. 納爾·澤布林達斯的辦公室

english: The {@spell continual flame} spells that once lit this room have been dispelled. Characters need light sources or darkvision to see here. The room contains the following features:
zh_tw: 曾經照亮這個房間的{@spell continual flame||不滅明焰}法術已經被解除。角色需要光源或暗視能力才能在這裡看清東西。房間包含以下特徵：

english: Two open crates rest against the north wall.
zh_tw: 兩個開啟的箱子靠在北牆上。

english: A stone desk in the southwest corner is completely free of papers. The chair behind it is carved with a spider motif.
zh_tw: 西南角的一張石制書桌上沒有任何紙張。後面的椅子上雕刻有蜘蛛圖案。

english: Bare stone bookshelves stand against the east wall.
zh_tw: 東牆上立著空蕩蕩的石制書架。

english: Crates
zh_tw: 板條箱

english: One crate contains fifty stuffed beholder dolls. The other contains thirty onyx trophies (worth 25 gp each) depicting a smiling beholder being caressed by hands. The dolls and trophies are among the prizes given to winners of {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s combat tournaments.
zh_tw: 一個箱子裡裝有五十個填充的眼魔玩偶。另一個箱子裡裝有三十個黑曜石獎盃（每個價值25金幣），上面雕刻著一個被手撫摸的笑臉眼魔。這些玩偶和獎盃是{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的格鬥錦標賽獲勝者獲得的獎品之一。

english: Desk
zh_tw: 書桌

english: The chair behind the desk has a secret compartment under its left armrest that can be found and opened with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check. This tiny compartment contains a small black key that unlocks both of the desk drawers. A character can pick each lock with a successful {@dc 17} Dexterity check using thieves' tools.
zh_tw: 辦公桌後的椅子在左側扶手下方有一個秘密隔間，可以透過一個成功的 {@dc 15} 感知（感知）檢定找到並開啟。這個小小的隔間裡有一把黑色小鑰匙，可以開啟辦公桌的兩個抽屜。角色可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 17} 敏捷檢定使用盜賊工具來開鎖。

english: The first drawer holds Nar'l's spellbook, a sturdy tome bound in black leather and wrapped in webbing. It contains all the spells that Nar'l has prepared, plus the {@spell sending} spell.
zh_tw: 第一個抽屜裡放著納爾的法術書，一本結實的黑皮書，用蛛網包裹著。它包含了納爾準備的所有法術，還有{@spell sending||短訊術}法術。

english: The second drawer contains a {@item bag of holding} that belongs to {@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH}. Nar'l borrowed this magic item and used it to smuggle kegs of {@item smokepowder|WDH} into {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s lair (see {@area X36|2cb}).
zh_tw: 第二個抽屜裡有一個屬於{@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH|賈拉索·班瑞}的{@item bag of holding||次元袋}。納爾借用了這個魔法物品，並用它將桶裝的{@item smokepowder|WDH|發煙粉}偷運進{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的巢穴（見{@area X36|2cb}）。

english: Secret Doors
zh_tw: 暗門

english: A stone bookshelf in the southeast corner of this room rotates into the wall, revealing a secret passage that curves north. A character can find this secret door with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check, or simply by pushing on the bookshelf.
zh_tw: 這個房間東南角的一個石制書架旋轉進入牆壁，露出了一條向北彎曲的秘密通道。角色可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 15} 感知（覺察）檢定發現這扇秘密門，或者直接推動書架也可以。

english: A second secret door at the end of the curved hall can be found without an ability check; it pulls open to reveal a dark and dusty chamber ({@area X36|2cb}) beyond.
zh_tw: 彎曲走廊盡頭的第二個秘密門無需屬性檢定就可以找到；拉開它，就會揭示一個黑暗且佈滿灰塵的房間（{@area X36|2cb}）。

english: X36. Secret Room
zh_tw: X36. 秘密房間

english: Smokepowder Keg
zh_tw: 煙霧粉桶

english: This room has the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間有以下特點：

english: The room is unlit and choked with dust and cobwebs.
zh_tw: 這個房間沒有照明，充滿了灰塵和蜘蛛網。

english: Twenty kegs of smokepowder are neatly stacked in the middle of the room. Each keg has a paper label, written on which are the words "{@b SMOKEPOWDER! DO NOT OPEN!}" in Common and Elvish.
zh_tw: 二十桶煙霧粉整齊地堆放在房間中央。每個桶上都有一個紙標籤，上面用通用語和精靈語寫著"{@b 煙霧粉！不要開啟！}"。

english: Neither {@creature Xanathar|WDH} nor its loyal underlings know this room exists. When Nar'l found it, he asked to have the adjoining room ({@area X35|2c7}) turned into his office so that he could keep this room secret. The only other individual who knows about this room is {@creature Thorvin Twinbeard|wdh}, {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s chief engineer, but he's not inclined to tell the beholder about it.
zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}及其忠誠的下屬都不知道這個房間的存在。當納爾發現它時，他請求將相鄰的房間（{@area X35|2c7}）變成他的辦公室，以便他能保守這個房間的秘密。唯一知道這個房間的另一個人是{@creature Thorvin Twinbeard|wdh|索文·雙須}，{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的首席工程師，但他並不想告訴眼魔這件事。

english: Kegs
zh_tw: 小桶

english: Each keg comes with a fuse and holds 5 pounds of {@item smokepowder|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix A|WDH|11}). To collapse {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s lair, at least two kegs must be placed at each weak point (see "Destroy the Lair").
zh_tw: 每個桶都配有一根導火線，並且裝有5磅的{@item smokepowder|wdh|發煙粉}（見{@adventure 附錄A|WDH|11}）。要摧毀{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的巢穴，至少需要在每個弱點放置兩個桶（見"摧毀巢穴"）。

english: Special Events
zh_tw: 特殊事件

english: You can use one or both of the following special events as the characters make their way through {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s lair, or as they try to thwart {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s agents in Waterdeep.
zh_tw: 當角色們穿過{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的巢穴，或者試圖阻止{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}在深水城的代理人時，你可以使用以下一個或兩個特殊事件。

english: Blood and Fortune
zh_tw: 血與財富

english: The beholder holds gladiatorial tournaments whenever it needs a little violence to brighten its day. The winners of a tournament receive trophies, and wagers are made on the sly.
zh_tw: 眼魔每當需要一點暴力來提亮它的一天時，就會舉行角鬥士錦標賽。錦標賽的獲勝者會收到獎盃，而且會有秘密的賭注。

english: A single tournament has twelve combatants and consists of three fights with short rests in between. Failure to heed the following rules result in a combatant's disqualification:
zh_tw: 一個錦標賽有十二名戰士，包括三場戰鬥，中間有短休。不遵守以下規則將導致戰士被取消資格：

english: All tournament combatants must wait in {@area X7|27e} until they're called to {@area X6|27a} to fight.
zh_tw: 所有錦標賽戰士必須在{@area X7|27e}等待，直到他們被叫到{@area X6|27a}去戰鬥。

english: During a fight event, no combatant can leave the arena or attack anyone who isn't a combatant in that event.
zh_tw: 在戰鬥事件中，沒有戰士可以離開競技場或攻擊任何不是該事件戰士的人。

english: Tournament Structure
zh_tw: 錦標賽結構

english: {@creature Noska Ur'gray|wdh} takes the twelve combatants and assembles them in four teams of three. To keep the fights interesting, Noska tries to even out the teams as much as possible. A team might have all player characters, all NPCs, or a combination of the two.
zh_tw: {@creature Noska Ur'gray|wdh|諾思卡·厄格雷} 將十二名戰士組織成四支隊伍，每隊三人。為了保持戰鬥的趣味性，諾思卡儘量讓各隊實力均衡。一支隊伍可能全部由玩家角色組成，全部由NPC組成，或者兩者的組合。

english: The first fight pits team 1 against team 2. The second fight pits team 3 against team 4. The third and final fight pits the winning teams of the previous two fights against one another. A fight ends when all combatants on one team are {@condition incapacitated}, killed, or disqualified.
zh_tw: 第一場戰鬥是隊伍1對抗隊伍2。第二場戰鬥是隊伍3對抗隊伍4。第三場，也是最後一場戰鬥，是前兩場戰鬥中獲勝的隊伍相互對抗。當一隊的所有戰士都處於{@condition incapacitated||無力}狀態、被殺或被取消資格時，戰鬥結束。

english: Winning the Tournament
zh_tw: 贏得錦標賽

english: Each member of the winning team who survives the third fight receives a stuffed {@creature Xanathar|WDH} doll with a pocket in its mouth that holds a 100 gp gemstone, and an onyx trophy carved to look like a smiling beholder being caressed by hands (worth 25 gp).
zh_tw: 在第三場戰鬥中存活下來的每個獲勝隊伍的成員都會收到一個填充的{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}玩偶，玩偶的嘴裡有一個口袋，裡面裝著一顆價值100金幣的寶石，以及一個雕刻成被手撫摸的笑臉眼魔的黑曜石獎盃（價值25金幣）。

english: Tournament Wagers
zh_tw: 錦標賽賭注

english: Spectators like to place side bets on their favorite teams. The maximum wager is 10 gp. A character who places a wager on the team that wins the tournament receives winnings equal to five times the wager.
zh_tw: 觀眾喜歡在他們最喜歡的隊伍上下注。最大賭注為10金幣。在贏得錦標賽的隊伍上下注的角色將獲得相當於賭注五倍的贏利。

english: Trolltide Slaughter
zh_tw: 巨魔節屠殺

english: Trolltide is a fun springtime holiday for most Waterdeep denizens, including {@creature Xanathar|WDH}, but the beholder has planned a cruel twist on the holiday this year.
zh_tw: 巨魔節對於大多數深水城居民來說是一個有趣的春季節日，包括{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}，但這個眼魔今年為節日計劃了一個殘酷的轉折。

english: The Xanathar Guild recently captured some trolls in Undermountain. The trolls are fitted with eyeless helms and ball-and-chain shackles around their ankles. They are then set loose in different wards of the city during Trolltide. When the characters happen upon such a scene, read:
zh_tw: 姍娜薩公會最近在地脈迷城捕獲了一些巨魔。這些巨魔被戴上沒有眼睛的頭盔，並在腳踝上戴上帶有鐵球和鏈條的腳鐐。然後在巨魔節節日期間，它們被釋放到城市的不同區域。當角色們偶然遇到這樣的場景時，請閱讀：

english: Children in troll masks run through the fog and drizzle, knocking on doors and stopping adults in the streets. Those who aren't placated with candied apples, sticks of salted meat, and other treats perpetrate all manner of tricks. A grumpy old woman has a rat thrown in her face. A burly dwarf has his pipe pilfered.
zh_tw: 戴著巨魔面具的孩子們在霧濛濛的細雨中奔跑，敲響門扉，在街道上攔住成年人。那些不給糖果蘋果、鹹肉條和其他零食的人會遭受各種惡作劇。一個脾氣暴躁的老婦人臉上被扔了一隻老鼠。一個健壯的矮人被偷走了他的菸鬥。

english: A small crowd of onlookers is gathered around a ten-foot-tall wicker effigy of a troll, stamping their feet as two young men struggle to set the likeness ablaze with sputtering torches.
zh_tw: 一小群圍觀者聚集在一個十尺高的巨魔柳條雕像周圍，他們跺著腳，因為兩個年輕人正努力用閃爍的火把點燃這個雕像。

english: Suddenly a white-haired man bolts toward the crowd, his face a mask of terror. Behind him lurches a massive, green-skinned giant dragging a ball and chain across the cobbled street. A blind helm covers the troll's eyes, but its mouth is a veritable cavern of sharp teeth. It flails its arms, slashing at the fog around it, and lets out a horrible wail of frustration. The crowd panics at the sight of it and flees into the mist and rain. Meanwhile, two members of the City Watch sneak up behind the blind troll, hoping to strike a mortal blow.
zh_tw: 突然一個白髮男子驚恐地衝向人群，臉上寫滿恐懼。他身後蹣跚跟隨著一個拖著鐵球鎖鏈的綠色巨怪，鎖鏈在鵝卵石街道上刮出刺耳聲響。巨怪雙目被盲盔遮蔽，但那張血盆大口布滿獠牙。它暴躁地揮舞雙臂劈砍周圍霧氣，發出令人膽寒的挫敗嚎叫。目睹此景的人群在雨霧中四散奔逃。此刻兩名城市守衛正潛行至盲眼巨怪背後，企圖給予致命一擊。

english: The white-haired man is a Waterdavian noble of no real accomplishments named Bromas Sultlue. When he sees the characters, he shouts, "It's a troll! Do something!" If the characters intervene, the two City Watch {@creature veteran||veterans} fight alongside them. These constables act on the same initiative count. On their initiative count each round, there's a noncumulative {@chance 20|20 percent chance} that another {@creature veteran} arrives and joins the fray.
zh_tw: 白髮男子是一位名叫布洛馬斯·薩爾特盧的水深城貴族，他沒有真正的成就。當他看到角色們時，他會大喊："有巨魔！快做點什麼！"如果角色們介入，兩名城市守衛{@creature veteran||老兵}會與他們並肩作戰。這些警官在同一先攻值上行動。在他們的每輪先攻值上，有{@chance 20|20%的機率}非累積地出現另一名{@creature veteran||老兵}老兵加入戰鬥。

english: The {@creature troll} is {@condition blinded} while wearing the eyeless helm, and the ball-and-chain shackles clamped around its ankles reduce its walking speed to 20 feet. In this state, its challenge rating is 4 (1,100 XP). As the characters battle the troll, children in troll masks bravely pelt the creature with candied apples.
zh_tw: 這個{@creature troll||巨魔}戴著沒有眼睛的頭盔時處於{@condition blinded||目盲}狀態，腳踝上的鐵球和鏈條腳鐐使其行走速度降低到20尺。在這種狀態下，它的挑戰等級是4（1,100 XP）。當角色們與巨魔戰鬥時，戴著巨魔面具的孩子們勇敢地用糖果蘋果投擲這個生物。

english: {@creature Nat|WDH}, {@creature Jenks|WDH} and {@creature Squiddly|WDH} have a Trolltide scare
zh_tw: {@creature Nat|WDH|納特}、{@creature Jenks|WDH|詹克斯} 和 {@creature Squiddly|WDH|斯奎迪利} 有一個巨魔節驚嚇

english: Development
zh_tw: 發展

english: If the characters contribute to the defeat of the troll, the City Watch is grateful. Bromas Sultlue congratulates them and spends the next tenday recounting every detail of the battle to friends and family members. The story of the characters' heroism spreads, and they gain many new patrons at their tavern. For the next six tendays, when determining the tavern's profitability, add 20 to rolls on the Running a Business table (see "Tavern Keeping Expenses"). Thereafter, add 10 to such rolls to represent Waterdeep's lingering fondness for the "Trollslayers of Trollskull Alley."
zh_tw: 如果角色們幫助擊敗了巨魔，城市守衛會非常感激。布羅瑪斯·蘇特盧會祝賀他們，並在接下來的十天裡向朋友和家人講述戰鬥的每一個細節。角色們英勇的故事傳播開來，他們在酒館贏得了許多新的贊助人。在接下來的六個十天裡，當確定酒館的盈利能力時，在"經營業務"表上擲骰子時加上20（見"酒館維護費用"）。此後，為了代表深水城對"巨魔顱骨巷的巨魔殺手"的持續喜愛，在此類擲骰子上加上10。

english: Chapter 6: Hell of a Summer
zh_tw: 第6章：炎熱的夏天

english: Victoro and {@creature Ammalia Cassalanter|WDH} struck a deal with Asmodeus, Lord of the Nine Hells. Three years ago, they traded away the souls of their children to escape financial ruin. The soul of their eldest son, Osvaldo, was taken immediately. What was left behind was transformed into a chain devil, which the Cassalanters confined to their attic. Their two youngest children, Terenzio and Elzerina, are doomed to lose their souls when they turn nine years old a mere ten days after Founders' Day, a midsummer festival that celebrates Waterdeep's founding.
zh_tw: 維克托羅和{@creature Ammalia Cassalanter|WDH|阿瑪利亞·卡薩蘭特}與九層地獄之王阿斯蒙蒂斯達成了一筆交易。三年前，他們為了逃避財務破產，將自己的孩子們的靈魂交易了出去。他們的長子奧斯瓦多的靈魂立即被帶走。留下的部分被轉變成了一個鎖鏈魔鬼，卡薩蘭特家族將其囚禁在他們的閣樓裡。他們的兩個最小的孩子，特倫齊奧和艾爾澤琳娜，在創立者節後的僅僅十天，也就是慶祝深水城建立的仲夏節日時，他們九歲生日時註定要失去他們的靈魂。

english: After the deal was struck, the Cassalanters enjoyed a miraculous comeback. Their banking and money-lending business thrived while their competition suffered. The disappearance of their eldest son (and heir apparent) earned them sympathy. Their philanthropic endeavors bought them legitimacy and new friends. They became the envy of Waterdavian nobility in short order. Seemingly blessed, the Cassalanters attracted new followers to their cult of devil worship, which was Asmodeus's plan all along.
zh_tw: 交易達成後，卡薩蘭特家族奇蹟般地東山再起。他們的銀行和放貸業務蓬勃發展，而他們的競爭對手卻遭受了損失。他們長子（也是繼承人）的失蹤為他們贏得了同情。他們的慈善事業為他們贏得了合法性和新朋友。他們很快成為了水深貴族羨慕的物件。看似受到祝福的卡薩蘭特家族吸引了新信徒加入他們崇拜魔鬼的邪教，這正是阿斯蒙蒂斯一直以來的計劃。

english: Reneging on a contract with Asmodeus is a luxury no mortal can afford, but there is a way for Lord and Lady Cassalanter to save the souls of Terenzio and Elzerina. A clause in the contract allows them to preserve their remaining (and future) children's lives by instead paying "one shy of a million gold coins, and the sacrifice of one shy of one hundred unfortunate souls." The Cassalanters have most of the coin they need, but they require the gold from the Vault of Dragons to buy their children's salvation without bankrupting themselves.
zh_tw: 違背與阿斯蒙蒂斯的契約是凡人無法承擔的奢侈，但卡薩蘭特勳爵和夫人有辦法拯救特倫齊奧和艾爾澤琳娜的靈魂。契約中有一個條款允許他們透過支付"不足一百萬金幣，以及不足一百個不幸靈魂的犧牲"來保留他們剩餘的（和未來的）孩子的生命。卡薩蘭特家族已經擁有他們所需的大部分金幣，但他們需要來自龍之寶庫的黃金來購買他們孩子的救贖，而不會讓自己破產。

english: Victoro is in charge of locating the Vault of Dragons and securing the gold within it. Ammalia, for her part, plans to sacrifice ninety-nine souls in one fell swoop by throwing a feast on Founders' Day featuring {@condition poisoned} food. Both the souls and the gold must be paid to Asmodeus at the same time. Foiling either one of these schemes spells doom for the Cassalanters' plot and their youngest children.
zh_tw: 維克托羅負責定位龍之寶庫並確保其中的黃金。阿瑪利亞則計劃在創立者節舉辦一場宴會，透過提供{@condition poisoned||中毒}食物一舉犧牲九十九個靈魂。這些靈魂和黃金必須同時支付給阿斯蒙蒂斯。破壞這兩個計劃中的任何一個都意味著卡薩蘭特家族的陰謀和他們最小的孩子的厄運。

english: Cult of Asmodeus
zh_tw: 阿斯蒙蒂斯教派

english: Lord and Lady Cassalanter are the heads of a secretive cult of Asmodeus. The cult convenes at midnight once every tenday in the temple of Asmodeus beneath Cassalanter Villa. During rituals of worship, members of the cult, including Lord and Lady Cassalanter, wear crimson robes, golden masks, and golden sacrificial daggers. The masks and daggers are worth 75 gp each for the gold alone.
zh_tw: 卡薩蘭特勳爵和夫人是阿斯蒙蒂斯隱秘崇拜團的首領。這個崇拜團每十天的午夜在卡薩蘭特別墅下的阿斯蒙蒂斯神廟舉行集會。在崇拜儀式中，包括卡薩蘭特勳爵和夫人在內的崇拜團成員，穿著深紅色的長袍，戴著金色的面具，手持金色的祭祀匕首。單是黃金，面具和匕首每個就值75金幣。

english: Meet the Cassalanters
zh_tw: 遇見卡薩蘭特家族

english: The Cassalanters
zh_tw: 卡薩蘭特家族

english: Each member of the Cassalanter family relaxes in different parts of the house and reacts separately to the discovery of characters intruding in their home. Lord and Lady Cassalanter are often out of the house on business, especially as Founders' Day draws near; they return home an hour before dinner.
zh_tw: 卡薩蘭特家族的每個成員在房子的不同部分放鬆，並對發現角色闖入他們家中的行為作出不同的反應。卡薩蘭特勳爵和夫人經常因業務外出，尤其是隨著創立者節的臨近；他們在晚餐前一小時回家。

english: Lady Ammalia Cassalanter
zh_tw: 阿瑪利亞·卡薩蘭特夫人

english: Lady Cassalanter reacts with surprise to the sight of uninvited guests, but quickly conceals her feelings with a welcoming smile. She attempts to gain the intruders' confidence by pretending to believe that they are guests of Victoro's and saying that she simply was not told of their presence. With this pretense established, she tries to learn the characters' true intentions, casting {@spell charm person} on the party using a 5th-level spell slot (affecting up to five creatures within 30 feet) if necessary. Using magic in this way is illegal, but Ammalia has a lot of goodwill banked in Waterdeep-enough to curry favor with a magistrate.
zh_tw: 卡薩蘭特夫人對不速之客的出現感到驚訝，但她很快用一個熱情的微笑掩飾了自己的感情。她試圖透過假裝相信他們是維克托羅的客人，並表示她只是沒有被告知他們的到來，來贏得入侵者的信任。一旦建立了這個假設，她就試圖瞭解角色們真正的意圖，必要時利用5環法術位施展{@spell charm person||魅惑類人}法術（影響30尺內多達五個生物）。以這種方式使用魔法是違法的，但阿瑪利亞在深水城有很多良好的社會關係——足以贏得一位地方法官的青睞。

english: During the hours when Ammalia is home and awake, her location in the villa can be determined randomly:
zh_tw: 在阿瑪利亞在家且醒著的時候，她在別墅中的位置可以透過隨機方式確定：

english: Ammalia's Location
zh_tw: 阿瑪利亞的位置

english: Result
zh_tw: 結果

english: She's tending to her butterfly garden ({@area C25|328}).
zh_tw: 她在照料她的蝴蝶花園（{@area C25|328}）。

english: She's smoking on the balcony ({@area C25a|32a}).
zh_tw: 她在陽臺上吸菸（{@area C25a|32a}）。

english: She's weeping before Osvaldo in the attic  ({@area C24|325}).
zh_tw: 她在閣樓前向奧斯瓦多哭泣（{@area C24|325}）。

english: Lord Victoro Cassalanter
zh_tw: 維克托羅·卡薩蘭特勳爵

english: {@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH} reacts with fiery rage to the sight of uninvited guests. He demands to know their names and calls for the butler, {@creature Willifort Crowelle|WDH}, to show them out. If he has the chance, he subtly casts {@spell dominate person} on one of the characters using an 8th-level spell slot (extending its duration to 8 hours) to plant a spy among their ranks. As soon as the intruders are gone, he retires to his office ({@area C6|2fa}) and uses his action to take total control of the dominated character. The dominated character reports to the City Watch that the party broke into Cassalanter Villa and must be arrested for their crime.
zh_tw: {@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH|維克托羅·卡薩蘭特}對不請自來的客人的出現反應激烈，充滿憤怒。他要求知道他們的名字，並叫管家{@creature Willifort Crowelle|WDH|威利福特·克羅威爾}送他們出去。如果他有機會，他會巧妙地對其中一個角色施放{@spell dominate person||支配類人}法術，使用8級的法術位（將其持續時間延長至8小時）在他們的隊伍中安插一個間諜。一旦入侵者離開，他就回到自己的辦公室（{@area C6|2fa}），並使用他的行動完全控制被支配的角色。被支配的角色向城市守衛報告說，這個隊伍闖入了卡薩蘭特別墅，必須因他們的罪行被逮捕。

english: During the hours when Victoro is home and awake, his location in the villa can be determined randomly:
zh_tw: 在維克托羅在家且醒著的時候，他在別墅中的位置可以透過隨機方式確定：

english: Victoro's Location
zh_tw: 維克托羅的位置

english: Result
zh_tw: 結果

english: He's in his office ({@area C6|2fa}).
zh_tw: 他在辦公室（{@area C6|2fa}）。

english: He's in the reading room ({@area C4|2f6}).
zh_tw: 他在閱覽室（{@area C4|2f6}）。

english: He's with Ammalia at one of the three locations  mentioned above.
zh_tw: 他和阿瑪利亞在上述提到的三個地點之一。

english: Cassalanter Lore
zh_tw: 卡薩蘭特家族傳說

english: A successful {@dc 15} Intelligence (History) check reveals the following information about Cassalanter Villa and its inhabitants:
zh_tw: 進行一次成功的 {@dc 15} 智力（歷史）檢定將揭示以下關於卡薩蘭特莊園及其居民的資訊：

english: The Cassalanters fell on hard times a few years back, but they have since reversed their fortunes and restored their lucrative banking and money-lending business.
zh_tw: 幾年前，卡薩蘭特家族遭遇了困難時期，但從那時起他們扭轉了命運，恢復了他們有利可圖的銀行和放貸業務。

english: Victoro and Ammalia's eldest son disappeared three years ago when the family was on the verge of bankruptcy. They have two surviving children, young twins named Terenzio and Elzerina.
zh_tw: 維克托羅和阿瑪利亞的長子在三年前家族瀕臨破產時消失了。他們還有兩個存活下來的孩子，是一對名叫特倫齊奧和艾爾澤琳娜的年幼雙胞胎。

english: Lord {@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH} is the only living heir of the late Caladorn Cassalanter, a former Masked Lord and a hero of the North.
zh_tw: 勳爵{@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH|維克托羅·卡薩蘭特}是已故卡拉多恩·卡薩蘭特唯一的在世繼承人，卡拉多恩曾是蒙面領主，也是北方的英雄。

english: Over the years, the Cassalanters have founded a number of philanthropic societies and made generous donations to temples dedicated to good-aligned deities. They are known to worship Siamorphe, a demigod whose ethos is the nobility's right and responsibility to rule.
zh_tw: 多年來，卡薩蘭特家族創立了多個慈善社團，並向致力於善良陣營神祇的神廟慷慨捐贈。他們以崇拜希亞摩芙而聞名，希亞摩芙是一位半神，其理念是貴族統治的權利和責任。

english: Terenzio and Elzerina
zh_tw: 特倫齊奧和艾爾澤琳娜

english: The Cassalanter twins aren't members of their parents' cult and have no other friends, since they are privately tutored and rarely allowed to leave the estate. Around strangers, Terenzio becomes suspicious and meek, while Elzerina seems brash and outgoing. Both children are incredibly excited to meet friendly strangers and treat their "new friends" to a trip around the house. They help the characters sneak through the villa, since the children know they aren't supposed to have guests.
zh_tw: 卡薩蘭特家的雙胞胎並不是他們父母邪教組織的成員，而且他們沒有其他朋友，因為他們接受的是家庭教育，很少被允許離開莊園。在陌生人面前，特倫齊奧變得多疑和膽怯，而艾爾澤琳娜則顯得魯莽和外向。兩個孩子都非常興奮地遇到友好的陌生人，並帶他們的"新朋友"參觀房子。他們幫助角色們在別墅中潛行，因為孩子們知道他們不應該有客人。

english: During the hours when the children are awake, their location in the villa can be determined randomly:
zh_tw: 在孩子們醒著的時候，他們在別墅中的位置可以透過隨機方式確定：

english: Terenzio and Elzerina's Location
zh_tw: 特倫齊奧和艾爾澤琳娜的位置

english: Result
zh_tw: 結果

english: They're playing in their room ({@area C18|317}).
zh_tw: 他們在房間裡玩耍（{@area C18|317}）。

english: They're in the library ({@area C3|2f2}).
zh_tw: 他們在圖書館（{@area C3|2f2}）。

english: They're chasing butterflies in the garden ({@area C25|328}).
zh_tw: 他們在花園裡追逐蝴蝶（{@area C25|328}）。

english: Terenzio and Elzerina have places in the house that their parents have forbade them from visiting-and that they are excited to explore, now that they have friends to accompany them. These locations are as follows:
zh_tw: 特倫齊奧和艾爾澤琳娜在房子裡有父母禁止他們去的地方——現在有了朋友的陪伴，他們很興奮地想要探索這些地方。這些地點如下：

english: Their father's office ({@area C6|2fa})
zh_tw: 他們父親的辦公室（{@area C6|2fa}）

english: The attic ({@area C24|325})
The wine cellar area (C28)
zh_tw: 酒窖區域（C28）

english: If asked about their parents, Terenzio and Elzerina report that their parents are searching for some missing dragons. (What their parents plan to do with a bunch of scary, winged reptiles is beyond them, and Terenzio and Elzerina are too scared to ask.) If befriended, they reveal that their father keeps a journal in his office ({@area C6|2fa}).
zh_tw: 如果被問及他們的父母，特倫齊奧和艾爾澤琳娜會報告說他們的父母正在尋找一些失蹤的龍。（他們的父母打算用一群可怕、有翅膀的爬行動物做什麼，這對他們來說是難以理解的，特倫齊奧和艾爾澤琳娜也太害怕而不敢問。）如果成為了朋友，他們會透露他們的父親在他的辦公室（{@area C6|2fa}）裡放著一本日記。

english: If asked about their older brother, Osvaldo, Terenzio and Elzerina repeat what their parents have told them: he's attending school in a faraway city (they don't recall which one). Neither knows the cruel fate that has befallen Osvaldo (see {@area C24|325}) or suspects that a similar fate awaits them.
zh_tw: 如果被問及他們的哥哥奧斯瓦多，特倫齊奧和艾爾澤琳娜會重複父母告訴他們的話：他在一個遙遠的城市上學（他們不記得是哪一個）。兩人都不知道奧斯瓦多遭遇了怎樣殘酷的命運（見{@area C24|325}），也不懷疑類似的命運正等待著他們。

english: Head Servants
zh_tw: 主要僕人

english: The head servants of Cassalanter Villa are members of the cult. These four servants are described below. All appear to be tieflings, though one is not. The following changes apply to the tieflings' stat blocks:
zh_tw: 卡薩蘭特別墅的主要僕人是邪教組織的成員。這四位僕人的描述如下。他們看起來都是提夫林人，儘管其中一位並不是。以下更改適用於提夫林人的統計資料塊：

english: The tieflings are lawful evil.
zh_tw: 這些提夫林人是守序邪惡的。

english: They have these racial traits: They know the thaumaturgy cantrip, and Charisma is their spellcasting ability for this spell. They have resistance to fire damage. They have darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. They speak Common and Infernal.
zh_tw: 他們具有以下種族特徵：他們知道戲法系的魔法，魅力是他們施放這個法術的能力。他們對火焰傷害有抗性。他們具有60尺範圍內的黑暗視覺。他們說通用語和地獄語。

english: Willifort Crowelle
zh_tw: 威利福特·克羅威爾

english: Willifort dresses in a sharp black suit and wears thin-rimmed spectacles. He's a {@creature doppelganger} that usually takes the form of an aging male tiefling, and he greets all guests in the entrance hall ({@area C1|2ee}).
zh_tw: 威利福特穿著一套鋒利的黑色西裝，戴著細框眼鏡。他是一個{@creature doppelganger||變形怪}，通常以一個年長的男性提夫林的形象出現，並在入口大廳（{@area C1|2ee}）迎接所有客人。

english: As the Cassalanters' chief butler and Lord Victoro's personal attendant, {@creature Willifort Crowelle|WDH} makes a point of knowing everything that transpires within the villa. If the Cassalanters have guests, he escorts them during their entire visit, using stealth if necessary. He ushers nosy guests away from areas or objects that might link the Cassalanters with the Asmodeus-worshiping cult.
zh_tw: 作為卡薩蘭特家族的首席管家和維克托羅勳爵的個人侍從，{@creature Willifort Crowelle|WDH|威利福特·克羅威爾}特別注重瞭解別墅內發生的每一件事情。如果卡薩蘭特家族有客人，他會在客人整個訪問期間陪同他們，必要時使用隱秘手段。他會把好奇的客人從可能將卡薩蘭特家族與崇拜阿斯蒙蒂斯的邪教聯絡起來的區域或物品引導開。

english: Tissina Khyret
zh_tw: 蒂西娜·凱瑞特

english: Madame Khyret is the personal attendant to {@creature Ammalia Cassalanter|WDH} and is the family's chief housemaid.
zh_tw: 凱瑞特夫人是{@creature Ammalia Cassalanter|WDH|阿瑪利亞·卡薩蘭特}的個人侍從，也是這個家庭的首席女僕。

english: Madame Khyret dresses in a long black gown and wears a headdress with black tassels. She is an aging tiefling {@creature cult fanatic}, and she spends most of her time in the master sitting room ({@area C19|31a}).
zh_tw: 凱瑞特夫人穿著一件長長的黑色禮服，戴著帶有黑色流蘇的頭飾。她是一位年邁的提夫靈{@creature cult fanatic||邪教狂信者}，她大部分時間都待在主人的客廳({@area C19|31a})。

english: Laiba "Nana" Rosse
zh_tw: 萊巴 '娜娜' 羅斯

english: {@creature Laiba "Nana" Rosse|wdh|Laiba Rosse}, better known as "Nana," is the caretaker and private tutor for Terenzio and Elzerina, and she does her best to keep track of their every move. Even so, the two often sneak away from her watchful eye.
zh_tw: {@creature Laiba "Nana" Rosse|wdh|萊巴·羅斯}，更廣為人知的名字是'娜娜'，是特倫齊奧和艾爾澤琳娜的看護人和私人教師，她儘自己最大的努力來跟蹤他們的每一個行動。即便如此，這兩個孩子經常從她的警惕目光中溜走。

english: Nana dresses in flowing red robes. She is a female tiefling {@creature cult fanatic} who relaxes in the twins' playroom ({@area C17|316}) when she's not with the children.
zh_tw: 娜娜穿著飄逸的紅色長袍。她是一位女性提夫靈{@creature cult fanatic||邪教狂信者}，當她不和孩子們在一起時，她會在雙胞胎的遊樂室({@area C17|316})中放鬆。

english: Jandar Chergoba
zh_tw: 詹達爾·切爾戈巴

english: As the head chef of Cassalanter Villa, {@creature Jandar Chergoba|wdh|Jandar} determines each day's menu and oversees all activity in the kitchen.
zh_tw: 作為卡薩蘭特別墅的主廚，{@creature Jandar Chergoba|wdh|詹達爾}決定每天的選單並監督廚房裡的所有活動。

english: Jandar is a male tiefling {@creature cult fanatic}. He is often in the kitchen ({@area C10|303}).
zh_tw: 詹達爾是一位男性提夫靈{@creature cult fanatic||邪教狂信者}。他經常在廚房({@area C10|303})。

english: Facing the Cassalanters
zh_tw: 面對卡薩蘭特家族

english: Lord and Lady Cassalanter are formidable spellcasters and devoted to one another. If one is assailed within Cassalanter Villa, the other arrives as quickly as possible.
zh_tw: 卡薩蘭特勳爵和夫人是強大的施法者，並且彼此深愛。如果其中一人在卡薩蘭特別墅內受到攻擊，另一人會儘可能快地趕到。

english: A direct confrontation with the Cassalanters will likely result in defeat for the characters, or-if the characters and the Cassalanters both escape with their lives-their arrest for assaulting nobility. The Cassalanters have no desire to kill the characters, even in self-defense. They take great pains to divide and subdue the party with their magic while not inflicting grievous harm.
zh_tw: 與卡薩蘭特家族的直接對抗很可能會導致角色們的失敗，或者——如果角色們和卡薩蘭特家族都能倖存下來——因為攻擊貴族而被逮捕。卡薩蘭特家族並不想殺死角色們，即使是出於自衛。他們非常小心地使用魔法來分散和制服隊伍，同時不造成嚴重傷害。

english: If the characters reduce Ammalia to 30 hit points or fewer and Victoro is with her, he banishes her to safety for a few brief moments while he continues fighting. If either Victoro or Ammalia is reduced to 30 hit points or fewer and the other Cassalanter isn't present, they try to negotiate with or bribe their assailants.
zh_tw: 如果角色們將阿瑪利亞的命中點數減少到30點或更少，而維克托羅在她身邊，他會在繼續戰鬥的同時，將她傳送到安全的地方短暫躲避。如果維克托羅或阿瑪利亞的命中點數減少到30點或更少，而另一位卡薩蘭特不在場，他們會嘗試與攻擊者談判或賄賂。

english: The Cassalanters don't fear being arrested, since they have faith that their wealth, reputations, and contacts will keep them out of prison. They do fear the ticking clock of Founders' Day. They plead for the characters to allow them to carry out their plan, if only to save Terenzio's and Elzerina's lives.
zh_tw: 卡薩蘭特家族並不害怕被逮捕，因為他們相信他們的財富、聲譽和人脈可以讓他們免於入獄。他們真正害怕的是創始日的倒計時。他們懇求角色們允許他們執行他們的計劃，哪怕只是為了救特倫齊奧和艾爾澤琳娜的命。

english: Disrupting the Cassalanters' Operation
zh_tw: 幹擾卡薩蘭特家族的行動

english: Killing or injuring the Cassalanters carries grave legal consequences, but the characters can hinder the Cassalanters by destroying or stealing Ammalia's stash of midnight tears poison ({@area C22|31f}), destroying the statue of Asmodeus in the temple ({@area A7|345}), or keeping Lord Neverember's gold out of their clutches.
zh_tw: 殺害或傷害卡薩蘭特家族成員將帶來嚴重的法律後果，但角色們可以透過破壞或偷走阿瑪利亞存放的午夜之淚毒藥({@area C22|31f})，破壞神廟中的阿斯蒙蒂斯雕像({@area A7|345})，或者阻止他們得到無燼領主的黃金來阻礙卡薩蘭特家族。

english: Gathering Information
zh_tw: 收集資訊

english: If the Cassalanters are the main villains, the characters might come to their villa if their search for the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} or the Vault of Dragons hits a dead end. {@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH} keeps information related to his own search for the stone and the Vault of Dragons in his office ({@area C6|2fa}).
zh_tw: 如果卡薩蘭特家族是主要反派，角色們可能會在尋找{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}或龍之寶庫的過程中來到他們的別墅。{@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH|維克托羅·卡薩蘭特}將與他自己尋找石頭和龍之寶庫相關的資訊儲存在他的辦公室({@area C6|2fa})。

english: Cassalanter Villa
zh_tw: 卡薩蘭特莊園

english: When the characters first come near the gates of Cassalanter Villa, read or paraphrase the following:
zh_tw: 當角色們第一次接近卡薩蘭特別墅的大門時，請閱讀或轉述以下內容：

english: Cassalanter Villa's stark white walls and gleaming crimson roof and turrets stand out even among the other opulent estates of the Sea Ward. A three-story mansion lies in the midst of picturesque green gardens dappled with hedges and water features. The estate is surrounded by a tall white brick wall, with a single wrought-iron gate as an entrance. The Cassalanter family crest-a green Y overlapping a stylized goose being fed-is emblazoned on the gate, and armored guards stand at attention on either side.
zh_tw: 卡薩蘭特別墅的潔白牆壁和閃耀的深紅色屋頂及塔樓，即使在海區其他豪華莊園中也格外顯眼。一棟三層的豪宅坐落在風景如畫的綠色花園中，花園裡點綴著樹籬和水景。莊園被一堵高高的白色磚牆所環繞，唯一的入口是一座鍛鐵大門。卡薩蘭特家族的徽章——一個綠色的歪字重疊在一隻被餵食的鵝的圖案上——被鑲嵌在大門上，兩旁站著全副武裝的守衛。

english: Cassalanter Villa is an extravagant manse with dozens of lavish chambers for the masters of the house and their guests-but its splendor belies the terrible secret it holds. The temple of Siamorphe that once lay beneath the estate has been desecrated by Victoro and Ammalia's devil-worship. Now, this great chapel is dedicated to the Lord of the Nine Hells.
zh_tw: 卡薩蘭特別墅是一座奢華的豪宅，擁有數十個豪華的房間供房屋的主人和他們的客人使用——但它的輝煌掩蓋了它所持有的可怕秘密。曾經位於莊園下方的希亞摩芙神廟已經被維克托羅和阿瑪利亞的魔鬼崇拜所褻瀆。現在，這座宏偉的禮拜堂奉獻給了九層地獄之主。

english: Approaching Cassalanter Villa
zh_tw: 接近卡薩蘭特別墅

english: The grounds of the Cassalanters' estate are patrolled by hired {@creature guard||guards}. Two of them stand outside the gate of the estate, two more stand outside the front door of the house, and a total of six patrol the grounds at any time. These guards are humans and are outfitted in livery that bears the crest of House Cassalanter.
zh_tw: 卡薩蘭特家族的莊園由僱傭的{@creature guard||警衛}巡邏。其中兩個站在莊園大門外，另外兩個站在房子的前門外，任何時候都有六名守衛在莊園內巡邏。這些守衛是人類，他們穿著帶有卡薩蘭特家族徽章的制服。

english: The house is surrounded by a well-manicured lawn. A cobblestone path leads from the estate's exterior gate to both the front entrance ({@area C1|2ee}) and the entrance to the coach house (area CH1). The villa's grounds feature numerous deciduous trees and meticulously tended gardens.
zh_tw: 房子周圍是一片精心修剪的草坪。一條鵝卵石小徑從莊園的外門通向正門入口({@area C1|2ee})和馬車房入口(區域CH1)。別墅的場地上有許多落葉樹和精心照料的花園。

english: Spotted by the Guards
zh_tw: 被守衛發現

english: Characters who try to infiltrate Cassalanter Villa are more likely to be arrested than to be killed. The security detail around Cassalanter Villa is meant to raise an alarm and deter petty thieves, not to stop determined adventurers. If the guards spot an intruder, they do the sensible thing: call the authorities.
zh_tw: 試圖潛入卡薩蘭特別墅的角色更有可能被逮捕而不是被殺死。卡薩蘭特別墅周圍的安保細節旨在發出警報並阻止小賊，而不是阻止決心冒險的探險者。如果守衛發現入侵者，他們會做明智的事情：呼叫當局。

english: The City Watch has small, single-person "watch boxes" set up on nearly every street corner in the Sea Ward, including the intersection just outside the gates of Cassalanter Villa. If a guard sounds the alarm, the Watch member on duty fetches a force of forty City Watch {@creature veteran||veterans} to cordon off the property.
zh_tw: 城市守衛在海區的幾乎每個街角都設有小型單人"觀察箱"，包括卡薩蘭特別墅大門外的十字路口。如果守衛發出警報，值班的警衛成員會召集一支由四十名城市守衛{@creature veteran||老兵}組成的隊伍來封鎖該物業。

english: Reinforcements
zh_tw: 援軍

english: If the City Watch gets involved, Lord and Lady Cassalanter become worried that someone has caught onto their plot. The number of guards patrolling the grounds doubles, and Victoro dispenses with all human guards inside the house. Whenever a guard is mentioned in an interior area, that guard is now a {@creature bearded devil} disguised as a human. A disguised devil looks like a muscular, bearded male human in house livery. A creature that observes one closely can, with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check, notice its "beard" writhing.
zh_tw: 如果城市守衛介入，卡薩蘭特勳爵和夫人會擔心有人識破了他們的陰謀。巡邏庭院的守衛數量會翻倍，而維克托羅會將屋內所有人類守衛撤換。每當在室內區域提到守衛時，那名守衛現在是一個偽裝成人類的{@creature bearded devil||須魔}。偽裝的魔鬼看起來像是一個穿著家徽制服的肌肉發達的鬍鬚男子。如果一個生物近距離觀察它，並透過一次成功的{@dc 15} 感知（感知）檢定，可以注意到它的"鬍鬚"在蠕動。

english: Denizens of Cassalanter Villa
zh_tw: 卡薩蘭特別墅的居民

english: Cassalanter Villa is home to no one but Lord and Lady Cassalanter, their children, their personal attendants, and their guards.
