All the other servants who work at the villa live in dingy homes in the Dock Ward or the Field Ward and travel across the city in the wee hours of the morning to arrive before the Cassalanters awake.
zh_tw: 卡薩蘭特別墅除了卡薩蘭特勳爵和夫人、他們的孩子、私人侍從和守衛外，沒有其他人居住。所有在別墅工作的其他僕人住在碼頭區或原野區陰暗的家中，並在清晨穿越城市，以便在卡薩蘭特家族醒來之前到達。

english: With the exception of their personal attendants, the Cassalanters replenish their servants regularly. Most move on to other jobs, but occasionally a servant discovers the secret vault ({@area C29|330}), visits the forbidden attic ({@area C24|325}), or otherwise learns too much. Such folk are fated to become sacrifices to Asmodeus.
zh_tw: 除了他們的私人侍從外，卡薩蘭特家族定期補充他們的僕人。大多數僕人會轉到其他工作，但偶爾有僕人會發現秘密金庫({@area C29|330})，訪問禁止的閣樓({@area C24|325})，或以其他方式瞭解到太多。這樣的人們註定要成為阿斯蒙蒂斯的祭品。

english: Villa Features
zh_tw: 別墅特點

english: The following features are found throughout the villa:
zh_tw: 別墅內發現以下特點：

english: Ceilings in rooms are 25 feet high, with 7-foot-high corridors and doorways connecting them.
zh_tw: 房間的天花板高25尺，走廊和連線它們的門道高7尺。

english: Doors are made of exotic hardwood. If a door is locked, the lock can be picked by a character who makes a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check using thieves' tools, or the door can be forced open by a character who makes a successful {@dc 20} Strength (Athletics) check. Victoro, Ammalia, and the head butler, Willifort, hold keys to every room in the house.
zh_tw: 門由異域硬木製成。如果門被鎖上，可以使用盜賊工具並透過敏捷鑑定成功（{@dc 15}）的角色來開鎖，或者透過力量（運動）鑑定成功（{@dc 20}）的角色來強行開啟。維克托羅、阿瑪利亞和管家威利福特持有這棟房子裡每個房間的鑰匙。

english: Floors are made of wood and covered with soft woolen carpets. Creatures walking in carpeted rooms have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
zh_tw: 地板由木材製成，並鋪有柔軟的羊毛地毯。在鋪有地毯的房間裡行走的生物在敏捷（隱匿）檢定上有優勢。

english: All areas are well lit by oil lamps, lanterns, or chandeliers.
zh_tw: 所有區域都由油燈、燈籠或吊燈提供良好的照明。

english: The Cassalanters keep no silver objects (with the exception of coins) in their house, since silver is harmful to devils.
zh_tw: 卡薩蘭特家族在他們的房子裡不存放任何銀器（硬幣除外），因為銀對魔鬼是有害的。

english: Areas of the Villa
zh_tw: 別墅區域

english: The following areas correspond to the labels on map 6.1. The villa connects to the temple of Asmodeus through a secret door in {@area C28|32e}.
zh_tw: 以下區域對應於地圖6.1上的標籤。別墅透過一個秘密門在{@area C28|32e}與阿斯蒙蒂斯神廟相連。

english: If the occupants or features of a location change during the Founders' Day party, the text includes a "Founders' Day" section describing those changes.
zh_tw: 如果創始人日派對期間某個地點的居住者或特徵發生變化，文字中將包含一個"創始人日"部分，描述這些變化。

english: Cassalanter Villa
zh_tw: 卡薩蘭特莊園

english: Cassalanter Villa, Main Area (Player Version)
zh_tw: 卡薩蘭特別墅，主要區域（玩家版本）

english: Guest House
zh_tw: 客房

english: The Cassalanters host guests in this stately guest house.
zh_tw: 卡薩蘭特家族在這座莊嚴的客房中招待客人。

english: CG1. Mud Room
zh_tw: CG1. 泥巴房

english: Guests can remove and store dirty cloaks and boots here.
zh_tw: 客人可以在這裡移除並存放髒斗篷和靴子。

english: CG2. Storage
zh_tw: CG2. 儲存室

english: Guests can store their traveling gear here.
zh_tw: 客人可以將他們的旅行裝備存放在這裡。

english: CG3. Dining Room
zh_tw: CG3. 餐廳

english: This room is furnished with two dining tables, each surrounded by six chairs.
zh_tw: 這個房間配備了兩張餐桌，每張餐桌周圍有六把椅子。

english: CG4. Kitchen
zh_tw: CG4. 廚房

english: Guests are expected to dine with the Cassalanters in the manor but can prepare their own breakfast here.
zh_tw: 賓客們被期望在莊園與卡薩蘭特一家共進晚餐，但可以在這裡自行準備早餐。

english: CG5. Parlor
zh_tw: CG5. 客廳

english: This room is furnished with a billiard table, a card table, and four luxurious armchairs.
zh_tw: 這個房間配備了一張檯球桌、一張牌桌和四把豪華扶手椅。

english: CG6. Sitting Room
zh_tw: CG6. 客廳

english: This room features an upright piano and four luxurious armchairs.
zh_tw: 這個房間的特徵是一架立式鋼琴和四把豪華扶手椅。

english: CG7. Bedrooms
zh_tw: CG7. 臥室

english: Each room contains a bed for two, a pair of wardrobes, a small vanity with matching stool, and a storage trunk for valuables.
zh_tw: 每個房間內設有一張雙人床、一對衣櫃、一個帶配套凳子的小型梳妝檯和一個用於存放貴重物品的儲藏箱。

english: CG8. Master Bedroom
zh_tw: CG8. 主臥室

english: This room has a balcony and contains a large canopied bed, a standing mirror in a gilded frame, a writing desk and matching chair, a dresser, a tall wardrobe, and an owlbear throw rug draped over a padded chair with matching ottoman.
zh_tw: 這個房間有一個陽臺，包含一張大型帶頂棚的床、一個鍍金框架的立式鏡子、一張寫字檯和配套的椅子、一個梳妝檯、一個高大的衣櫃，以及一張鋪在布甲椅子上的梟熊地毯，配有配套的腳凳。

english: Coach House
zh_tw: 馬車房

english: The Cassalanters own three carriages-one for their banking business, one for public appearances, and one for private use. They also own six horses: four {@creature draft horse||draft horses} to pull carriages and two {@creature riding horse||riding horses}. The horses are kept in stalls that are cleaned every morning just before dawn. Tack, bridles, feed, and other necessities for the horses are stored in the coach house as well.
zh_tw: 卡薩蘭特家族擁有三輛馬車——一輛用於他們的銀行業務，一輛用於公共場合露面，一輛用於私人使用。他們還擁有六匹馬：四匹{@creature draft horse||馱用馬}用來拉馬車，兩匹{@creature riding horse||乘用馬}。這些馬被養在馬廄裡，每天黎明前都會被打掃乾淨。馬具、馬勒、飼料以及其他馬匹必需品也存放在馬車房裡。

english: C1. Entrance Hall
zh_tw: C1. 入口大廳

english: This hall has the following features:
zh_tw: 這個大廳有以下特點：

english: A magnificent harpsichord sits in the hall.
zh_tw: 大廳裡放著一架宏偉的羽管鍵琴。

english: A crimson carpet runs down the hall toward an open door to the foyer.
zh_tw: 一條深紅色的地毯沿著大廳延伸至通往門廳的敞開的門。

english: Light from a crystal chandelier reflects off more than three dozen holy symbols of Siamorphe perched on wall shelves, each in the form of a silver chalice with a golden sun etched on its outside.
zh_tw: 水晶吊燈的光芒反射在牆上架子上擺放的三十多個希亞摩芙的聖徽上，每個聖徽都是一個銀色的聖盃，上面刻有一個金色的太陽。

english: If the characters are expected guests, {@creature Willifort Crowelle|WDH} (see "Head Servants,") awaits them here and guides them to the smoking room ({@area C12|308}) to meet with Lord Cassalanter. He allows them to explore the house while they wait but follows them doggedly.
zh_tw: 如果角色是預期中的客人，{@creature Willifort Crowelle|WDH|威利福特·克羅威爾}（見"首席僕人"）會在這裡等候他們，並引導他們前往吸菸室（{@area C12|308}），與卡薩蘭特勳爵會面。他允許他們在等待時探索房子，但是會堅持不懈地跟隨他們。

english: Founders' Day
zh_tw: 創始人日

english: The hall is filled with chatty guests holding flutes of sparkling wine. One is playing the harpsichord.
zh_tw: 大廳裡滿是手持起泡酒的健談客人。其中一人正在彈奏羽管鍵琴。

english: C2. Garden Mudroom
zh_tw: C2. 花園泥房

english: This room has the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間有以下特點：

english: A guard dressed in House Cassalanter livery sits idly on a crate, watching the outside door.
zh_tw: 一名穿著卡薩蘭特家族制服的守衛無所事事地坐在一個板條箱上，監視著外門。

english: The floor is caked with mud. Several rows of muddy boots and gardening gloves are strewn about the floor.
zh_tw: 地板上沾滿了泥巴。幾排泥濘的靴子和園藝手套散落在地板上。

english: Founders' Day
zh_tw: 創始人日

english: Esvele Rosznar, the {@creature Black Viper|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), is hiding in an alcove and putting on her {@creature Black Viper|WDH} mask and hood. She is wearing a sleek black leather suit, and a frilly ball gown lies at her feet. Esvele has slipped away from her overbearing parents, Rolteme and Azalea Rosznar, and is preparing to sneak through the villa and rob the Cassalanters blind.
zh_tw: 艾絲薇爾·羅茲納爾，{@creature Black Viper|WDH|黑毒蛇}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），正藏在一個凹室裡，戴上她的{@creature Black Viper|WDH|黑毒蛇}面具和兜帽。她穿著一件光滑的黑色皮衣，一件褶皺的舞會禮服放在她的腳邊。艾絲薇爾已經從她專橫的父母，羅特米和阿扎莉亞·羅茲納爾那裡溜走，正在準備悄悄穿過別墅，把卡薩蘭特家族洗劫一空。

english: The characters can convince the {@creature Black Viper|WDH} to help them as they scour Cassalanter Villa by succeeding on a {@dc 14} Charisma (Intimidation or Persuasion) check. If Esvele decides to help the characters, she fights alongside them and discovers treasure and secret doors automatically.
zh_tw: 角色們可以透過成功進行一次 {@dc 14} 魅力（威嚇或說服）檢定，說服 {@creature Black Viper|WDH|黑毒蛇} 在他們搜查卡薩蘭特別墅時幫助他們。如果艾絲薇爾決定幫助角色們，她會與他們並肩作戰，並自動發現寶藏和秘密門。

english: C3. Library
zh_tw: C3. 圖書館

english: This is the Cassalanters' private library. It contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這是卡薩蘭特家族的私人圖書館。它包含以下特點：

english: The scent of old parchment hangs thick in the air.
zh_tw: 舊羊皮紙的氣息在空氣中瀰漫著濃重的氣味。

english: The walls are lined with tall shelves packed with colorful, leather-bound books. Each bookshelf is outfitted with a ladder on a rolling track to enable people to reach the highest books.
zh_tw: 牆壁上排列著高大的書架，書架上擺滿了色彩繽紛的皮革裝訂書籍。每個書架都配有一個可滾動軌道的梯子，以便人們能夠取到最高層的書籍。

english: Shelves that take up the entire southwest wall hold not books but eighty wide-necked glass bottles filled with swirling mist and sealed with corks.
zh_tw: 佔據整個西南牆的架子上沒有書籍，而是擺放著八十個寬口玻璃瓶，裡面裝滿了旋轉的霧氣，並用軟木塞密封。

english: Hanging on the north wall between two bookshelves is a 7-foot-tall portrait of Lord and Lady Cassalanter holding two infant children and standing beside their teenage son, Osvaldo. (This portrait conceals a secret door.)
zh_tw: 在兩個書架之間的北牆上掛著一幅7尺高的肖像畫，畫中的卡薩蘭特勳爵和夫人抱著兩個嬰兒站在他們十幾歲的兒子奧斯瓦多旁邊。（這幅肖像畫隱藏著一個秘密門。）

english: If Terenzio and Elzerina are here, they're playing on the sliding ladders.
zh_tw: 如果特倫齊奧和艾爾澤琳娜在這裡，他們就在滑梯上玩耍。

english: Books
zh_tw: 書籍

english: None of the books are magical.
zh_tw: 這些書都不是魔法書。

english: Jars of Mist
zh_tw: 迷霧罐

english: The glass bottles on the southwest shelf contain magically captured sounds, including songs, operas, and recorded lectures. Uncorking a bottle temporarily releases its auditory contents into the library, after which the sound returns to its bottle. Breaking a bottle releases the sound, but the sound dissipates after it plays once. All the bottles are labeled. Sample contents include the following:
zh_tw: 西南架上的玻璃瓶中裝有魔法捕捉的聲音，包括歌曲、歌劇和錄製的講座。拔掉瓶塞會暫時將瓶中的聲音釋放到圖書館中，之後聲音會返回到瓶子裡。打破瓶子會釋放聲音，但聲音播放一次後就會消散。所有的瓶子都有標籤。樣本內容包含以下：

english: "Ahghairon's Dragonward," a lecture given by Khelben Arunsun about the dragonward that protects Waterdeep (see "Ahghairon's Dragonward").
zh_tw: 《阿蓋爾倫的龍之結界》，由凱爾本·奧羅桑講述的關於保護深水城的龍衛的講座（見《阿蓋爾倫的龍之結界》）。

english: "Canticle of the Silver Chalice," a hymn to the demigod Siamorphe. {@i Wulfgar and the Crystal Shard}, an epic opera detailing the adventures of a barbarian, a dwarf, and a drow in Icewind Dale.
zh_tw: "銀盃頌歌,"一首獻給半神希亞摩芙的讚美詩。{@i 沃夫加與水晶碎片},一部史詩歌劇,詳細描述了一位野蠻人、一位矮人和一位卓爾在冰風谷的冒險經歷。

english: "Your Beardy Face," a traditional dwarven love song popular in the Moonsea region.
zh_tw: "你的鬍鬚臉龐"，一首在月海地區流行的傳統矮人情歌。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: The Cassalanter family portrait hides a secret door. Tilting the painting causes the door to swing outward on hidden hinges, revealing the pantry ({@area C11|305}) beyond. A character can notice a slight gap beneath the secret door with a successful {@dc 18} Wisdom (Perception) check.
zh_tw: 卡薩蘭特家族的肖像畫隱藏著一扇秘密門。將畫作傾斜會使門在隱藏的鉸鏈上向外擺動，露出後面的儲藏室（{@area C11|305}）。角色可以透過一次成功的{@dc 18} 感知（感知）檢定注意到秘密門下方的一條細微縫隙。

english: C4. Reading Room
zh_tw: C4. 閱覽室

english: This reading nook has the following features:
zh_tw: 這個閱讀角落有以下特點：

english: Light pours into this room through four tall bay windows that look out on the butterfly garden ({@area C25|328}).
zh_tw: 四扇高大的凸窗將光線引入這個房間，窗外是蝴蝶花園的景色({@area C25|328})。

english: Furnishings include a luxurious armchair and a small side table where an empty wine glass sits atop a small book.
zh_tw: 傢俱包括一個豪華的扶手椅和一個小邊桌，上面放著一個空酒杯，酒杯放在一本小書的上面。

english: A door in the northern wall has a butterfly-shaped, stained-glass peephole.
zh_tw: 北牆上的門上有一個蝴蝶形狀的彩色玻璃窺視孔。

english: If {@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) is here, he's reading a historical text titled {@i The Rise and Fall of Hellgate Keep} and taking notes in his journal.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH|維克托羅·卡薩蘭特}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）在這裡，他正在閱讀一本名為{@i 地獄門要塞的興衰}的歷史文獻，並在他的日記本上做筆記。

english: Journal
zh_tw: 日誌

english: The small book on the side table is a journal that {@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH} uses to take notes while reading. It mostly contains dry observations on atlases of Faerûn and history books. A character who flips through the journal and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Intelligence (Investigation) check can pick out a few notes made by Victoro that are unrelated to his reading:
zh_tw: 側邊桌上的小冊子是 {@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH|維克托羅·卡薩蘭特} 閱讀時用來做筆記的日記本。裡面大多是對費倫地圖集和歷史書籍的枯燥觀察。一個角色如果翻看日記本，並在 {@dc 15} 智力（調查）檢定中成功，可以發現維克托羅記錄的幾則與閱讀無關的筆記：

english: "Neverember's dragons are an answer to our prayers."
zh_tw: "無燼的龍是我們祈禱的回應。"

english: "The Cassalanter mausoleum. Inform Y. G." (The initials refer to Lady {@creature Yalah Gralhund|wdh}.)
zh_tw: "卡薩蘭特家族的陵墓。通知歪.G.（首字母縮寫指的是{@creature Yalah Gralhund|wdh|雅拉·格勞洪德}女士。）"

english: "Golorr is an aboleth. Now it all makes sense."
zh_tw: "格洛爾是一個阿波羅斯。現在一切都說得通了。"

english: If the characters are still searching for the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} in chapter 4, you can include in this journal a clue regarding the stone's location. (If the Cassalanters have the stone, it's hidden in {@area C6|2fa} when it's not in use.)
zh_tw: 如果角色們在第4章仍在尋找{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，你可以在這本日誌中包含一個關於石頭位置的線索。（如果卡薩蘭特家族擁有這塊石頭，當它不使用時，它被藏在{@area C6|2fa}。）

english: C5. Foyer
zh_tw: C5. 門廳

english: Two {@creature guard||guards} in House Cassalanter livery are stationed in this marble-floored foyer at all hours. It has seven exits:
zh_tw: 兩名穿著卡薩蘭特家族制服的{@creature guard||警衛}在這個大理石地板的門廳裡全天候站崗。這裡有七個出口：

english: A door to the entrance hall ({@area C1|2ee})
zh_tw: 通往入口大廳的門({@area C1|2ee})

english: An open arch that leads to a spacious dining room ({@area C9|300})
zh_tw: 一個通往寬敞餐廳（{@area C9|300}）的開放式拱門

english: Three unmarked doors on the east wall (to areas C6, C7, and C8)
zh_tw: 東牆上的三扇無標記門（通向C6、C7和C8區域）

english: A grand staircase that ascends to the second floor ({@area C13|30a})
zh_tw: 一座宏偉的樓梯，通往二樓（{@area C13|30a}）

english: An unassuming door under the stairs that leads to the cellar ({@area C26|32b})
zh_tw: 樓梯下的一扇不起眼的門，通向地窖（{@area C26|32b}）

english: Founders' Day
zh_tw: 創始人日

english: The foyer is filled with lavish bouquets in ceramic floor vases and wealthy guests chatting loudly and drinking sparkling wine, while the gentle music of a string quartet drifts down from upstairs.
zh_tw: 門廳裡擺放著豪華的花束，插在陶瓷地面花瓶中，富有的客人們大聲聊天，喝著起泡酒，而樓上傳來的絃樂四重奏的柔和音樂在空中飄蕩。

english: C6. Victoro's Office
zh_tw: C6. 維克托羅的辦公室

english: The door to this room is locked. The room contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間的門是鎖著的。房間裡包含以下特點：

english: Tall stacks of legal tomes and financial ledgers rest atop a solid mahogany desk.
zh_tw: 高高的法律書籍和財務賬本堆放在堅固的桃花心木桌子上。

english: A freestanding suit of bronze armor (complete with helm, gauntlets, and greatsword) stands just inside the door.
zh_tw: 一具獨立的青銅盔甲（包括頭盔、手套和大劍）就立在門內。

english: If {@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) is here, he's seated behind the desk with fingers steepled, deep in thought.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH|維克托羅·卡薩蘭特}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）在這裡，他會坐在桌子後面，手指交叉，深陷沉思。

english: Armor
zh_tw: 護甲

english: The suit of armor standing by the door is a {@creature helmed horror}. It obeys Victoro's commands. When Victoro isn't present, it attacks anyone who opens the door without a key or anyone not of Cassalanter blood who opens Victoro's desk. The Cassalanter children know about this construct and warn friendly characters about it.
zh_tw: 門邊的盔甲是一具{@creature helmed horror||恐怖鎧甲}。它服從維克托羅的命令。當維克托羅不在場時，它會攻擊任何沒有鑰匙就開門的人，或者任何不是卡薩蘭特家族血統的人開啟維克托羅的書桌。卡薩蘭特的孩子們知道這個構造物，並會向友好的角色提醒它。

english: Desk
zh_tw: 書桌

english: Victoro's desk is locked and can be opened with Victoro's golden key. A character can pick the lock by succeeding on a {@dc 18} Dexterity check using thieves' tools. The desk drawer contains thirteen sealed scroll tubes, a signed contract inside each one. These contracts outline the terms of loans made by Victoro to various nobles, merchants, and guilds. The drawer also has a secret compartment that characters can find with a successful {@dc 18} Wisdom (Perception) check. It holds a holy symbol of Asmodeus crafted from solid gold (worth 250 gp).
zh_tw: 維克托羅的桌子被鎖上了，可以使用維克托羅的金鑰匙開啟。角色可以使用盜賊工具進行{@dc 18}的敏捷檢定來撬開鎖。桌子抽屜裡有十三個密封的卷軸筒，每個卷軸筒內有一份已簽署的合同。這些合同詳細列出了維克托羅向各種貴族、商人和公會提供的貸款條款。抽屜中還有一個暗格，角色可以透過成功的{@dc 18}感知（感知）檢定發現。暗格裡有一個由純金製成的阿斯蒙蒂斯符號（價值250金幣）。

english: Stone of Golorr
zh_tw: 格洛爾之石

english: If the Cassalanters have the artifact and aren't using it, it is also hidden in the desk's secret compartment.
zh_tw: 如果卡薩蘭特家族擁有這個神器並且沒有使用它，它也會被藏在書桌的秘密隔間裡。

english: C7. Cloakroom
zh_tw: C7. 斗篷室

english: This walk-in cloakroom contains the Cassalanter family's expensive coats and cloaks, and it also has room for the garments of up to one hundred guests.
zh_tw: 這個步入式衣帽間存放著卡薩蘭特家族昂貴的外套和斗篷，同時也有足夠的空間容納多達一百位客人的衣物。

english: C8. Covered Porch
zh_tw: C8. 有蓋門廊

english: This covered porch is the entryway typically used by the Cassalanters' servants. Ten servants (human {@creature commoner||commoners}) eat here at mealtimes.
zh_tw: 這個有頂的門廊通常是卡薩蘭特家族的僕人們使用的入口。有十名僕人（人類{@creature commoner||平民}）在用餐時間在這裡吃飯。

english: C9. Family Dining Room
zh_tw: C9. 家庭餐廳

english: This room holds the following noteworthy features:
zh_tw: 這個房間包含以下值得注意的特點：

english: A dozen chairs surround a beautifully carved dining table in the middle of the room.
zh_tw: 一打椅子圍繞著房間中央一個雕刻精美的餐桌擺放。

english: The table is set with golden plates, utensils, goblets, and candlesticks. Silk napkins add to the display.
zh_tw: 餐桌上擺放著金色的盤子、餐具、高腳杯和燭臺。絲綢餐巾增添了裝飾效果。

english: The Cassalanters dine here as a family, sometimes inviting a guest or two to join them.
zh_tw: 卡薩蘭特家族在這裡一起用餐，有時會邀請一兩位客人加入他們。

english: Founders' Day
zh_tw: 創始人日

english: During the party, the dining table is converted into a card table. Ten wealthy nobles are playing a high-stakes game of Three Dragon Ante. A character can play a round by betting 5 gp and making a {@dc 15} Intelligence check, adding a proficiency bonus if the character is proficient with gaming sets. On a successful check, the character wins 10 gp. On a failed check, the character loses the stake.
zh_tw: 在聚會上，餐桌被臨時改造成了牌桌。十位富有的貴族正在玩一場高賭注的《三龍賭局》。角色可以透過下注5金幣並進行一次{@dc 15}的智力檢定來參與一局，如果角色熟練使用遊戲工具則可以在檢定中加上熟練加值。檢定成功時，角色贏得10金幣。如果檢定失敗，角色將輸掉下注。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The gold table settings and candlesticks are worth 2,500 gp in total.
zh_tw: 這些金制餐具和燭臺總共價值2500金幣。

english: C10. Kitchen
zh_tw: C10. 廚房

english: From sunrise until an hour after sundown, this kitchen is a hive of activity:
zh_tw: 從日出到日落後的一個小時，這個廚房是一片繁忙的景象：

english: A half dozen chefs run to and fro, seasoning meat, mixing batter, and otherwise preparing an impressive variety of food.
zh_tw: 六位廚師來回忙碌，調味肉類，攪拌麵糊，以及準備各種令人印象深刻的食物。

english: A rotund, red-faced man in a tall white hat barks orders at his underlings, brandishing a sharp knife with every instruction.
zh_tw: 一個身材圓潤、面色紅潤的男子戴著一頂高高的白色帽子，一邊發號施令，一邊揮舞著一把鋒利的刀子。

english: Stairs in this room lead to the banquet kitchen on the second floor ({@area C14|30d}).
zh_tw: 這個房間內的樓梯通往二樓的宴會廚房({@area C14|30d})。

english: The head chef, {@creature Jandar Chergoba|wdh} (see "Head Servants,"), oversees six chefs (human {@creature commoner||commoners}). If Jandar believes the characters are a threat, he shouts "For'zaal," causing ten knives to magically rise from the counters and attack. These knives are {@creature flying sword||flying swords} that deal 4 ({@dice 1d6 + 1}) piercing damage on a hit.
zh_tw: 主廚，{@creature Jandar Chergoba|wdh|詹達爾·切爾戈巴}（見"主要僕人"），監督著六位廚師（人類{@creature commoner||平民}）。如果詹達爾認為角色們是威脅，他會喊出'弗爾札爾'，使得十把刀從櫃檯上神奇地升起並攻擊。這些刀是{@creature flying sword||凌空劍}，在擊中時造成4（{@dice 1d6 + 1}）點穿刺傷害。

english: Founders' Day
zh_tw: 創始人日

english: {@creature Jandar Chergoba|wdh|Jandar} isn't here. Instead, he's preparing Ammalia's {@condition poisoned} feast in a cooking pavilion out on the estate's sprawling lawn.
zh_tw: {@creature Jandar Chergoba|wdh|詹達爾} 不在這裡。相反，他正在莊園廣闊的草坪上的一個烹飪亭裡準備阿瑪利亞的{@condition poisoned||中毒}盛宴。

english: C11. Pantry
zh_tw: C11. 食品儲藏室

english: This room contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間包含以下特點：

english: Casks of ale, fresh water, and cooking oil are stacked in the middle of the room.
zh_tw: 啤酒桶、淡水和食用油堆積在房間中央。

english: Shelves of foodstuffs and ingredients line the walls.
zh_tw: 食物和食材的架子沿著牆壁排列。

english: The back wall of the pantry is one large wine rack that contains a variety of splendid bottled wines. (This wine rack conceals a secret door.)
zh_tw: 食品儲藏室的後牆是一個大型的葡萄酒架，裡面存放著各種精美的瓶裝葡萄酒。（這個葡萄酒架隱藏著一個秘密門。）

english: Locked Iron Box
zh_tw: 鎖住的鐵箱

english: {@creature Jandar Chergoba|wdh}, the head chef, keeps his golden sacrificial dagger, golden mask, and crimson robes (see "Cult of Asmodeus,") in a locked iron box underneath a sack of potatoes. The box can be unlocked with Jandar's golden key, or by a character who makes a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check using thieves' tools. A character can also pry it open with a successful {@dc 25} Strength (Athletics) check.
zh_tw: {@creature Jandar Chergoba|wdh|詹達爾·切爾戈巴}，這位主廚，將他的金色祭祀匕首、金色面具和深紅色長袍（見"阿斯蒙蒂斯的教團"）藏在一袋土豆下方的鐵製鎖箱中。這個箱子可以用詹達爾的金色鑰匙開啟，或者透過一個角色使用盜賊工具成功透過一個 {@dc 15} 的敏捷檢定來解鎖。一個角色也可以透過一個成功的 {@dc 25} 的力量（運動）檢定來撬開它。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: The secret door to the library ({@area C3|2f2}) can be detected by a character who makes a successful {@dc 18} Wisdom (Perception) check. The character discovers that lifting a bottle of Baldur's Gate pinot noir from the rack unlocks the door and allows it to be pushed open.
zh_tw: 通往圖書館的密門（{@area C3|2f2}）可以由成功透過 {@dc 18} 感知（感知）檢定的角色發現。角色會發現從架子上拿起一瓶博德之門黑皮諾紅酒可以解鎖門並允許它被推開。

english: C12. Smoking Room
zh_tw: C12. 吸菸室

english: This room contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間包含以下特點：

english: One {@creature guard} in House Cassalanter livery stands here, absentmindedly examining the regal portraits that adorn the walls and rest on fancy easels in various spots.
zh_tw: 一名穿著卡薩蘭特家族制服的{@creature guard||警衛}站在這裡，心不在焉地檢視著裝飾牆壁的王室肖像畫，這些肖像畫擺放在各個地方的精美畫架上。

english: Fine armchairs arranged throughout the room smell faintly of pipeweed; the scent is almost obscured by incense and delicate perfume.
zh_tw: 房間裡擺放著精緻的扶手椅，散發著微弱的菸鬥草氣味；這股氣味幾乎被薰香和淡雅的香水味所掩蓋。

english: If Lord Cassalanter has invited the characters to his home for any reason, he meets them here. If the conversation turns to business, he has Willifort bring his guests glasses of fine brandy and pipes filled with pipeweed.
zh_tw: 如果卡薩蘭特勳爵因任何原因邀請角色們到他家，他會在這裡與他們會面。如果談話轉向商業，他會吩咐威利福特為他的客人帶來上等白蘭地和裝滿菸鬥草的菸鬥。

english: Portraits
zh_tw: 肖像

english: The portraits on the walls depict several generations of Cassalanters. The ones on the easels, more recently painted, include the following:
zh_tw: 牆上的肖像畫描繪了卡薩蘭特家族的幾個世代。畫架上最近繪製的包括以下幾位：

english: A somber young Victoro with his beaming human father
zh_tw: 一位憂鬱的年輕維克托羅與他笑容滿面的父親

english: A wedding portrait, showing Victoro and Ammalia smiling and carefree
zh_tw: 一幅婚禮肖像，展示了維克托羅和阿瑪利亞面帶微笑、無憂無慮的樣子

english: Twelve-year-old Osvaldo holding a ceremonial rapier
zh_tw: 十二歲的奧斯瓦多手持一把儀式用劍

english: Ammalia sitting with baby Terenzio and Elzerina in her lap while Victoro reads them a fairy tale
zh_tw: 阿瑪利亞坐著，懷裡抱著嬰兒特倫齊奧和艾爾澤琳娜，而維克托羅正在給他們讀童話故事

english: C13. Ballroom
zh_tw: C13. 舞廳

english: This elegant ballroom contains the following noteworthy features:
zh_tw: 這個優雅的舞廳包含以下值得注意的特點：

english: In the center stands an eerie, human-sized wood-and-cloth mannequin with a painted face. It is dressed like a ballroom dancer.
zh_tw: 在中心位置矗立著一個令人毛骨悚然的、真人大小的木製布偶，它的面部被塗上了顏料。它穿著打扮像是一個舞廳舞者。

english: The polished marble floor is a dazzling mosaic that depicts a silver chalice with the image of a golden sun on its outside. Characters who succeed on a {@dc 10} Intelligence (Religion) check recognize it as the holy symbol of Siamorphe, demigod of nobility.
zh_tw: 拋光的大理石地板是一幅令人眼花繚亂的馬賽克，描繪了一個外部刻有金色太陽圖案的銀色聖盃。成功透過 {@dc 10} 智力（宗教）檢定的角色會認出這是貴族半神希亞摩芙的神聖象徵。

english: Gilded mirrors and handsome tapestries festoon the walls. Along the west wall, windows with crimson drapes stretch from the floor to the ceiling.
zh_tw: 鍍金的鏡子和精美的掛毯裝飾著牆壁。沿著西牆，帶有深紅色簾子的窗戶從地板延伸到天花板。

english: Despite its grandeur, this ballroom seems strangely dismal without anyone dancing in it. Stairs lead down to the foyer ({@area C5|2f8}) and up to a hallway outside areas C17 and C19.
zh_tw: 儘管這個舞廳宏偉壯觀，但如果沒有人在其中跳舞，它看起來異常陰鬱。樓梯向下通往門廳（{@area C5|2f8}），向上通往C17和C19區域外的走廊。

english: Dancing Construct
zh_tw: 舞動構裝生物

english: The dressed "mannequin" is a magical construct that serves as a dance partner. It has the statistics of a {@creature nimblewright|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) but has no effective attacks and is worth 0 XP. When a humanoid bows or curtsies before the construct, it makes the other gesture while a {@spell magic mouth} spell plays a recorded message in Common: "Which dance would you like? Galliard? Pavane? Waltz?" The construct follows its partner's lead until the dance ends, when it becomes still again.
zh_tw: 穿著打扮的"人體模特"是一個魔法構裝生物，充當舞伴。它具有{@creature nimblewright|WDH|秘偶}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）的具體數值，但沒有有效的攻擊，並且價值為0 XP。當一個類人生物在構裝生物前鞠躬或行屈膝禮時，它會做出另一個手勢，同時一個{@spell magic mouth||魔嘴術}法術播放用通用語語錄制的資訊："你想跳哪種舞蹈？加利亞爾德？帕凡？華爾茲？"構裝生物跟隨其夥伴的引導，直到舞蹈結束，然後再次靜止不動。

english: Founders' Day
zh_tw: 創始人日

english: During the party, dozens of wealthy masked guests dance to a lively waltz played by a string quartet.
zh_tw: 在派對上，數十位富有的戴面具的客人在絃樂四重奏演奏的活潑華爾茲音樂中跳舞。

english: C14. Banquet Kitchen
zh_tw: C14. 宴會廚房

english: The banquet kitchen is an additional cooking space used in conjunction with the main kitchen during social functions. It is otherwise empty, and its doors are locked.
zh_tw: 宴會廚房是社交活動時與主廚房一起使用的額外烹飪空間。它通常為空，並且門是鎖著的。

english: Founders' Day
zh_tw: 創始人日

english: The kitchen is bustling with activity as four chefs (human {@creature commoner||commoners}) prepare an array of pies for the noble guests.
zh_tw: 廚房裡活動繁忙，四位廚師（人類{@creature commoner||平民})正在為貴族客人準備一系列餡餅。

english: C15. Banquet Hall
zh_tw: C15. 宴會廳

english: The only piece of furniture in this expansive hall is a long wooden {@creature dining table mimic|wdh|dining table} that happens to be a giant {@creature mimic} in disguise. It has the statistics of a normal mimic, with these changes:
zh_tw: 這間寬敞的大廳中唯一的傢俱是一張長長的木製{@creature dining table mimic|wdh|餐桌}，它實際上是一隻巨大的{@creature mimic||擬身怪}偽裝而成。它具有普通擬怪的屬性，但有以下變化：

english: The mimic is Large and has 75 ({@dice 10d10 + 20}) hit points.
zh_tw: 這個擬身怪體型龐大，擁有75點生命值（{@dice 10d10 + 20}）。

english: As an action, it can make three attacks: two with its pseudopods and one with its bite.
zh_tw: 作為一個動作，它可以進行三次攻擊：兩次使用它的偽足，一次使用它的咬擊。

english: It has a challenge rating of 3 (700 XP).
zh_tw: 它的挑戰等級為3（700經驗值）。

english: The mimic is well treated by the Cassalanters and won't harm any member of the household. It obeys only Lord and Lady Cassalanter.
zh_tw: 擬身怪受到卡薩蘭特家族的良好對待，不會傷害家中任何成員。它只服從卡薩蘭特勳爵和夫人。

english: Founders' Day
zh_tw: 創始人日

english: The room is outfitted with dozens of chairs, and the table is filled with food. Two dozen party guests are gorging themselves here at any time. Four doppelgangers from the Yawning Portal have slipped into the party disguised as nobles. Their leader, {@creature Bonnie|WDH} (see "Familiar Faces"), poses as a minor noblewoman going by the name Lymeria Lhaurilstar; she was hoping to have a fun night at the party, but she's willing to help the characters if they need aid.
zh_tw: 房間裡擺放著幾十把椅子，桌子上擺滿了食物。任何時候都有兩打派對客人在這裡大吃特吃。來自呵欠之門的四個變形怪潛入派對，偽裝成貴族。他們的領袖，{@creature Bonnie|WDH|邦妮}（見"熟悉的面孔"），偽裝成一位名叫莉梅莉亞·勞里爾斯塔爾的小貴族女士；她原本希望在派對上度過一個愉快的夜晚，但如果角色們需要幫助，她也願意提供援助。

english: C16. Piano Room
zh_tw: C16. 鋼琴室

english: A gleaming grand piano is pushed against the wall of this dusty room. Behind it are several unmarked closets.
zh_tw: 這間佈滿灰塵的房間裡，一架閃亮的三角鋼琴靠牆擺放。鋼琴後面有幾個未標記的壁櫥。

english: This room is generally empty unless a social event is taking place or Nana Rosse is giving the Cassalanter children a piano lesson.
zh_tw: 除非正在舉行社交活動，或者羅絲奶奶正在給卡薩蘭特家的孩子們上鋼琴課，否則這個房間通常是空的。

english: Founders' Day
zh_tw: 創始人日

english: Wealthy guests are chatting here and using the powder rooms ({@area C16b|314}).
zh_tw: 富有的客人在這裡聊天，並使用化妝間（{@area C16b|314}）。

english: C16a. Storage Closet
zh_tw: C16a. 儲藏壁櫥

english: This closet holds crates filled with winter blankets, mops, and other household necessities.
zh_tw: 這個壁櫥裡裝滿了裝有冬季毛毯、拖把和其他家庭必需品的板條箱。

english: C16b. Powder Rooms
zh_tw: C16b. 化妝間

english: These rooms are locked. They contain mirrors and are largely unused except during social functions.
zh_tw: 這些房間是鎖著的。它們裡面有鏡子，除了社交活動時使用外，大部分時間都閒置著。

english: Founders' Day
zh_tw: 創始人日

english: Fancy nobles are waiting in line to freshen up.
zh_tw: 時髦的貴族們正在排隊整理儀容。

english: C17. Playroom
zh_tw: C17. 遊戲室

english: This room contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間包含以下特點：

english: Strewn about on the floor are giant stuffed toys, jack-in-the-boxes, dolls, and a rocking horse shaped like a warhorse.
zh_tw: 地板上散佈著巨大的填充玩具、小丑盒、洋娃娃，以及一個形狀像戰馬的搖搖馬。

english: A large mobile in the form of a butterfly hangs from the ceiling, turning listlessly.
zh_tw: 一隻蝴蝶形狀的大型旋轉掛飾懸掛在天花板上，無力地轉動著。

english: If she hasn't been dealt with elsewhere, the twins' nanny, {@creature Laiba "Nana" Rosse|wdh|Laiba Rosse} (see "Head Servants"), sits here and crochets dolls for the children.
zh_tw: 如果她沒有在別處被處理，雙胞胎的保姆，{@creature Laiba "Nana" Rosse|wdh|萊巴·羅斯}（見"主要僕人"），會坐在這裡為孩子們編織洋娃娃。

english: C18. Twins' Bedroom
zh_tw: C18. 雙胞胎的臥室

english: The twins' bedroom contains the following features:
zh_tw: 雙胞胎的臥室包含以下特點：

english: Two four-poster beds take up the bulk of this room.
zh_tw: 這個房間的主體是兩張四柱床。

english: At night, the room is cluttered with dozens of toys. In the morning, the toys are returned to their toy boxes by a housemaid.
zh_tw: 晚上，房間裡堆滿了幾十件玩具。早上，玩具會被一名女僕放回玩具箱中。

english: A life-sized stuffed unicorn stands in one corner.
zh_tw: 一個真人大小的填充獨角獸站在房間的一個角落。

english: If Terenzio and Elzerina are here. Terenzio is dressed in a crude dragon costume and is being chased around the room by his sister, who is wearing a knight's helm and swinging a wooden sword.
zh_tw: 如果特倫齊奧和艾爾澤琳娜在這裡。特倫齊奧穿著一件簡陋的龍裝，被他的妹妹追著在房間裡跑，妹妹戴著騎士頭盔，揮舞著木劍。

english: Stuffed Unicorn
zh_tw: 填充獨角獸

english: This inanimate object counts as an actual unicorn for the purpose of opening the Vault of Dragons (see "Vault Keys").
zh_tw: 這個無生命的物體在開啟龍之寶庫（見"寶庫鑰匙"）的目的上被視為一頭真正的獨角獸。

english: C-18a-C18b. Closets
zh_tw: C18a–C18b. 衣櫥

english: These closets are filled with stuffed animals and spare blankets.
zh_tw: 這些壁櫥裡裝滿了填充動物玩具和備用毯子。

english: C19. Master Sitting Room
zh_tw: C19. 主人休息室

english: Lady Cassalanter's attendant, {@creature Tissina Khyret|wdh} (see "Head Servants"), spends most of her time here when she's not with her mistress. The room is furnished for comfort and includes overstuffed chairs, fainting couches, and a wine bar.
zh_tw: 卡薩蘭特夫人的侍從，{@creature Tissina Khyret|wdh|蒂西娜·凱瑞特}（見"主要僕人"），當她不陪伴她的女主人時，大部分時間都在這裡度過。這個房間佈置得很舒適，包括有填充過多的椅子、躺椅和酒吧。

english: C20. Linen Closet
zh_tw: C20. 亞麻壁櫥

english: This closet is packed with folded bedsheets and other assorted linens. Two of the downy duvets stacked in this room are {@creature rug of smothering||rugs of smothering} that attack any creature that isn't a Cassalanter or one of their servants. Any combat in this room draws the attention of both {@creature Laiba "Nana" Rosse|wdh|Laiba Rosse} ({@area C17|316}) and {@creature Tissina Khyret|wdh} ({@area C19|31a}).
zh_tw: 這個壁櫥裡塞滿了摺疊好的床單和其他各種亞麻布。這個房間裡堆放的兩個羽絨被是{@creature rug of smothering||害蟲裹屍布}，它們會攻擊任何不是卡薩蘭特家族成員或其僕人的人。這個房間裡的任何戰鬥都會吸引{@creature Laiba "Nana" Rosse|wdh|萊巴·羅斯}（{@area C17|316}）和{@creature Tissina Khyret|wdh|蒂西娜·凱瑞特}（{@area C19|31a}）的注意。

english: Lockbox
zh_tw: 鎖箱

english: {@creature Willifort Crowelle|WDH} and {@creature Tissina Khyret|wdh} keep their cult regalia (see "Cult of Asmodeus"), in a gold-embellished lockbox hidden under a stack of quilts bearing images of flying devils. The box can be unlocked with either Willifort's or Tissina's golden key, or by a character who succeeds on a {@dc 14} Dexterity check using thieves' tools. It can also be pried open with a successful {@dc 16} Strength (Athletics) check.
zh_tw: {@creature Willifort Crowelle|WDH|威利福特·克羅威爾}和{@creature Tissina Khyret|wdh|蒂西娜·凱瑞特}將他們的邪教服飾（見"阿斯蒙蒂斯邪教"）藏在一個裝飾著金色花紋的鎖箱中，鎖箱隱藏在一堆描繪飛翔魔鬼圖案的被子下面。箱子可以用威利福特或蒂西娜的金鑰匙開啟，或者由成功透過{@dc 14}敏捷檢定使用盜賊工具的角色開啟。也可以透過成功進行{@dc 16}力量（運動）檢定將其撬開。

english: C21. Master Bedroom
zh_tw: C21. 主臥室

english: The door to this room is locked. The room contains the following noteworthy features:
zh_tw: 這個房間的門是鎖著的。房間裡包含以下值得注意的特點：

english: The walls are adorned with nine friezes, each one depicting a layer of the Nine Hells.
zh_tw: 牆壁上裝飾著九個浮雕，每個浮雕描繪了九層地獄中的一層。

english: A four-poster bed draped in deep red curtains and tipped with gold spires stands before an ornate door carved from dark hardwood with a gold latch. (This door is locked and leads to {@area C22|31f}.)
zh_tw: 一張掛著深紅色窗簾並飾有金色尖頂的四柱床，位於一扇由深色硬木雕刻而成並配有金色門閂的精美門前。（這扇門是鎖著的，通向{@area C22|31f}。）

english: A search of the room reveals a golden lockbox tucked under the bed.
zh_tw: 搜查這個房間會發現床下藏著一個金色的鎖盒。

english: Golden Lockbox
zh_tw: 金色鎖盒

english: Both Victoro and Ammalia keep their cult regalia (see "Cult of Asmodeus"), in a solid gold lockbox (worth 750 gp) hidden under their bed. The box can be unlocked with either Victoro's or Ammalia's golden key, or by a character who makes a successful {@dc 14} Dexterity check using thieves' tools. It can also be pried open with a successful {@dc 16} Strength (Athletics) check.
zh_tw: 維克托羅和阿瑪利亞都將他們的邪教法衣（見"阿斯蒙蒂斯教派"）藏在他們床下的一個堅固金鎖盒中（價值750金幣）。盒子可以使用維克托羅或阿瑪利亞的金鑰匙開啟，或者透過一個成功進行 {@dc 14} 敏捷檢定並使用盜賊工具的玩家開啟。也可以透過成功進行 {@dc 16} 力量（運動）檢定來撬開。

english: If the box is opened by any means other than a golden key, poison gas sprays out from holes in the underside of the lid, filling a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on the box. This trap can't be disarmed. Any creature in its area must make a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw, taking 22 ({@dice 4d10}) poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The gas dissipates quickly.
zh_tw: 如果箱子被除金鑰匙以外的任何方式開啟，毒氣會從蓋子底部的孔中噴出，填充以箱子為中心的15尺半徑的球形區域。此陷阱無法被解除。區域內的任何生物必須進行一次{@dc 13}體質豁免檢定，若豁免失敗則受到22（{@dice 4d10}）點毒素傷害，若成功則傷害減半。毒氣會迅速消散。

english: C22. Ammalia's Private Study
zh_tw: C22. 阿瑪利亞的私人書房

english: The door to this room is locked. The room contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間的門是鎖著的。房間裡包含以下特點：

english: The walls are lined with bookshelves packed with thick tomes.
zh_tw: 牆壁上排列著擺滿了厚重書籍的書架。

english: A grimoire with a red leather cover sits on a desk carved from dark oak.
zh_tw: 一本帶有紅色皮革封面的魔法書放在由深色橡木雕刻而成的桌子上。

english: A ladder leads up to a trapdoor in the ceiling.
zh_tw: 一架梯子通向天花板上的一個活板門。

english: Bookshelves
zh_tw: 書架

english: The books on the shelves include works of fiction and nonfiction.
zh_tw: 書架上的書籍包括小說和非小說作品。

english: Desk
zh_tw: 書桌

english: Aside from the grimoire (described below), the desk holds an ornate golden candlestick (worth 125 gp), a golden inkwell (worth 25 gp), and a feathered quill pen (worth 15 gp). The desk drawer contains a wax seal bearing the Cassalanter crest, {@creature Ammalia Cassalanter|WDH}'s spellbook (which contains all the spells she has prepared), and ten vials of jet-black poison known as midnight tears (see "Poisons" in chapter 8 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|dmg}). Ammalia plans to taint the Founders' Day feast with the poison (see "Special Events").
zh_tw: 除了法術書（如下所述），桌子上還有一個華麗的黃金燭臺（價值125金幣）、一個黃金墨水瓶（價值25金幣）和一支羽毛筆（價值15金幣）。桌子的抽屜裡有一個印有卡薩蘭特家族徽章的火漆印章、{@creature Ammalia Cassalanter|WDH|阿瑪利亞·卡薩蘭特}的法術書（裡麵包含了她準備的所有法術），以及十瓶被稱為"午夜之淚"的深黑色毒藥（參見{@book 城主指南|dmg}第8章中的"毒藥"）。阿瑪利亞計劃用這種毒藥汙染奠基日宴會（參見"特殊事件"）。

english: Red Grimoire
zh_tw: 紅色魔法書

english: The tome on the desk, bound in crimson leather, details a diabolical ritual that Ammalia and Victoro enacted to first contact the archdevil Asmodeus. Opening it reveals nothing but blank pages with a few drops of dry blood on them. If a drop of humanoid blood is spilled on any page, Infernal text on that page becomes legible, remaining so until the book is closed. The blood remains even after the text vanishes.
zh_tw: 桌子上的這本書，用深紅色皮革裝訂，詳細描述了阿瑪利亞和維克托羅首次與大惡魔阿斯蒙蒂斯接觸時進行的惡魔儀式。開啟它，除了空白頁和幾滴幹血之外，什麼也沒有。如果任何一頁上滴上一滴類人生物的血，那一頁上的地獄文字就會變得清晰可讀，並且會一直保持這樣，直到書被合上。即使文字消失，血跡也會保留下來。

english: Any character with the Ritual Casting feature (or the Ritual Caster feat) who spends 24 hours reading the book can master the ritual described within. The ritual takes 11 minutes to cast and requires incense and a vial of unholy water (which are consumed during the performance of the ritual). At the end of the ritual, a proxy of Asmodeus appears and grants its summoner the benefit of a {@spell commune} spell. The proxy is formed of incense smoke and resembles a pit fiend. A character must finish a long rest before performing the ritual again.
zh_tw: 任何具有儀式施法特性（或儀式施法者特長）的角色，如果花費24小時閱讀這本書，便可以掌握書中描述的儀式。儀式需要11分鐘來施放，並需要焚香和一瓶聖水（在進行儀式時消耗）。儀式結束時，一個阿斯蒙蒂斯的代理會出現，並授予召喚者一個{@spell commune||通神術}法術的好處。代理由焚香菸霧形成，看起來像一個深獄煉魔。一個角色必須在再次進行儀式前完成一次長休。

english: Trapdoor
zh_tw: 活板門

english: The trapdoor in the ceiling is the entrance to the attic.
zh_tw: 天花板上的活板門是通往閣樓的入口。

english: C23. Attic Landing
zh_tw: C23. 閣樓平臺

english: A thick scent of sulfur pervades the attic. The only illumination is a beam of light that shines feebly through a shuttered window at the west end of the room.
zh_tw: 閣樓裡瀰漫著濃重的硫磺氣味。唯一的照明是一束透過房間西端帶百葉窗的窗戶微弱照射進來的光線。

english: This attic is soundproof as long as no doors are open. Osvaldo's howling can be heard outside the attic only if the trapdoor between this room and {@area C22|31f} and the door between this room and {@area C24|325} are both open at the same time. Additionally, creatures that have telepathy can't communicate telepathically with creatures outside the attic unless the doors are open.
zh_tw: 只要不開啟門，這個閣樓就是隔音的。只有在閣樓與{@area C22|31f}之間的活板門和閣樓與{@area C24|325}之間的門同時開啟時，才能在外面聽到奧斯瓦多的嚎叫。此外，除非門是開啟的，否則具有心靈感應能力的生物無法與閣樓外的生物進行心靈感應交流。

english: Terenzio and Elzerina have heard howling coming from the attic two or three times in their lives and are curious about what lurks there.
zh_tw: 特倫齊奧和艾爾澤琳娜在他們的一生中曾兩三次聽到閣樓傳來的嚎叫聲，並對那裡潛伏的東西感到好奇。

english: Osvaldo
zh_tw: 奧斯瓦多

english: C24. Osvaldo's Prison
zh_tw: C24. 奧斯瓦多的監獄

english: If {@creature Ammalia Cassalanter|WDH} or {@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) or both are present, the door to this room is unlocked but closed. Otherwise, it's locked shut, and Victoro and Ammalia carry the only keys. When the characters first open the door, read:
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Ammalia Cassalanter|WDH|阿瑪利亞·卡薩蘭特}或{@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH|維克托羅·卡薩蘭特}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）或兩者都在場，這個房間的門是開著但未上鎖的。否則，門是鎖著的，維克托羅和阿瑪利亞持有唯一的鑰匙。當角色第一次開啟門時，請閱讀：

english: You are greeted with a wave of incoherent howling, as if opening the door broke down a dam that had been holding back a madman's screams.
zh_tw: 你被一陣不連貫的嚎叫聲所迎接，就好像開啟門打破了一直阻擋著一個瘋子尖叫的大壩。

english: {@creature Osvaldo Cassalanter|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) shrieks and moans at all hours of the day. He is trying desperately to get someone to hear him and come to his rescue. If one or both of his parents are here, he spits curses at them as they weep before him.
zh_tw: {@creature Osvaldo Cassalanter|WDH|奧斯瓦多·卡薩蘭特}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）在白天的任何時候都會尖叫和呻吟。他絕望地試圖讓某人聽到他的聲音並來救他。如果他的一個或兩個父母在這裡，他會在他們面前哭泣時向他們吐出詛咒。

english: Guarding the room are two {@creature imp||imps} in spider form. They answer to Lord Cassalanter, and their job is to kill birds, {@creature rat||rats}, and other vermin that find their way into the attic. They attack anyone who tries to free Osvaldo or threatens other family members present.
zh_tw: 守衛這個房間的是兩隻以蜘蛛形態出現的{@creature imp||小魔鬼}。它們聽從卡薩蘭特勳爵的命令，任務是殺死飛進閣樓的鳥類、{@creature rat||老鼠}和其他害蟲。它們會攻擊任何試圖釋放奧斯瓦多或威脅在場其他家庭成員的人。

english: The Cassalanter heir apparent is a soulless abomination thanks to his parents' thoughtless greed. His empty shell of a body has been transformed into a {@creature chain devil} that his parents have imprisoned using his own chains. A 10-foot-diameter pentagram has been burned into the floor around him. A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals a powerful aura of abjuration magic emanating from the symbol.
zh_tw: 卡薩蘭特家族的法定繼承人因為父母的無思貪婪變成了一個沒有靈魂的怪物。他那空洞的身體已經被轉化成了一個{@creature chain devil||鏈魔}，他的父母用他自己的鎖鏈將他囚禁起來。在他周圍的地板上燒製了一個直徑10尺的五角星。一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術揭示了從這個符號發出的強大防護魔法光環。

english: Osvaldo's chains are wrapped around the beams and timbers that frame the room. He can't damage the house, nor can he break his own chains. He can only howl impotently at the misery being inflicted on him. He is thoroughly insane and can't be reasoned with.
zh_tw: 奧斯瓦多的鏈條纏繞在構成房間框架的梁和木樑上。他無法破壞房子，也無法掙斷自己的鏈條。他只能無力地對加諸於他的痛苦嗥叫。他完全瘋了，無法與之理論。

english: A successful {@dc 15} Intelligence (Arcana) check reveals that the pentagram prevents Osvaldo from manipulating his chains, and that the effect ends if another creature enters the area encompassed by the pentagram. The magic of the pentagram can also be dispelled ({@dc 15}). If he is freed, Osvaldo regains control of his chains and attacks indiscriminately. If he is reduced to 0 hit points, the chain devil cries out for his mother before melting into a pool of sickening black ichor.
zh_tw: 一次成功的 {@dc 15} 智力（奧秘）檢定揭示出五角星阻止了奧斯瓦多操縱他的鎖鏈，並且如果有另一個生物進入五角星所包圍的區域，效果將終止。五角星的魔法也可以被解除（{@dc 15}）。如果奧斯瓦多被釋放，他將重新控制他的鎖鏈並無差別地攻擊。如果他的生命值被降低到0，鏈魔在融化成令人作嘔的黑色膿液之前會呼喊他的母親。

english: C24a. Attic Storage
zh_tw: C24a. 閣樓儲藏室

english: This room contains derelict furnishings draped in black linens: chairs, coat racks, freestanding mirrors, dress mannequins, and the like. These draped objects take on a sinister countenance in the gloom but are harmless.
zh_tw: 這個房間裡存放著被黑色亞麻布覆蓋的廢棄傢俱：椅子、衣帽架、獨立式鏡子、服裝模特等。這些被覆蓋的物品在昏暗中顯得陰森，但實際上是無害的。

english: C25. Butterfly Garden
zh_tw: C25. 蝴蝶花園

english: In the spring, {@creature Ammalia Cassalanter|WDH}'s gardens attract caterpillars, which transform into butterflies come summer. Lady Cassalanter's butterfly garden is the envy of her peers. The sweet scent of flowers and herbs filters up from the planters and rose bushes.
zh_tw: 春天時，{@creature Ammalia Cassalanter|WDH|阿瑪利亞·卡薩蘭特}的花園吸引了毛毛蟲，到了夏天它們就會變成蝴蝶。卡薩蘭特夫人的蝴蝶花園讓她的同行羨慕不已。從種植箱和玫瑰花叢中飄來花香和草本植物的甜美香氣。

english: If Terenzio and Elzerina are here, they are frolicking in the garden. If {@creature Ammalia Cassalanter|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) is here, she's watching the children or tending to her garden. Six {@creature imp||imps} in raven form hang around the butterfly garden and occasionally prey on Ammalia's prized pets when their mistress isn't looking. Despite their insolence, Ammalia uses these imps as spies. She sends them on missions throughout the city. They also warn Ammalia of trespassers and attack anyone who threatens a member of her family.
zh_tw: 如果特倫齊奧和艾爾澤琳娜在這裡，他們會在花園裡嬉戲。如果{@creature Ammalia Cassalanter|WDH|阿瑪利亞·卡薩蘭特}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）在這裡，她會看著孩子們或照料她的花園。六隻以烏鴉形態出現的{@creature imp||小魔鬼}在蝴蝶花園周圍徘徊，偶爾在主人不注意的時候捕食阿瑪利亞的珍貴寵物。儘管它們傲慢無禮，阿瑪利亞還是將這些小惡魔用作間諜。她派它們在城市中執行任務。它們還會警告阿瑪利亞有入侵者，並攻擊任何威脅她家庭成員的人。

english: Founders' Day
zh_tw: 創始人日

english: During the party, two young, hotblooded nobles have accidentally offended one another. They have changed into dueling garb and are fighting with rapiers to resolve their differences while onlookers drink wine and cheer them on.
zh_tw: 在派對期間，兩位年輕熱血的貴族無意中冒犯了對方。他們換上了決鬥服裝，用劍來解決他們的分歧，而旁觀者則喝著酒為他們加油鼓勁。

english: C25a. Garden Balcony
zh_tw: C25a. 花園陽臺

english: This balcony overlooks the grounds of the Cassalanter estate and even offers a view of the Sea of Swords beyond the outer wall of the Sea Ward.
zh_tw: 這個陽臺俯瞰著卡薩蘭特莊園的地面，甚至可以看到海牆外的劍海。

english: If {@creature Ammalia Cassalanter|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) is here, she's smoking and either staring dismally out toward the ocean or watching her children in the garden below ({@area C25|328}).
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Ammalia Cassalanter|WDH|阿瑪利亞·卡薩蘭特}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）在這裡，她正在吸菸，要麼憂鬱地凝視著海洋，要麼看著下面的花園中她的孩子（{@area C25|328}）。

english: C26. Cellar
zh_tw: C26. 地下室

english: This cellar is kept free of dust and cobwebs by servants. It is unsettlingly cold, no matter the time of year. It contains spare furniture, a laundry tub, and trunks full of old clothing.
zh_tw: 這個地下室由僕人們保持乾淨，沒有灰塵和蛛網。無論一年中的什麼時候，這裡都異常寒冷。它包含了備用傢俱、洗衣盆和裝滿舊衣服的箱子。

english: C27. False Vault
zh_tw: C27. 假金庫

english: The door to this vault is made of solid iron and sports three different locks. Victoro and Ammalia each have a set of keys for them. Opening the door without the keys requires a character to succeed on three consecutive {@dc 20} Dexterity checks using thieves' tools. On a failed check, all three locks reset. The door has AC 19, a damage threshold of 10, 90 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. A creature can break it down with a successful {@dc 27} Strength (Athletics) check.
zh_tw: 這個金庫的門由實心鐵製成，並配備了三把不同的鎖。維克托羅和阿瑪利亞各自擁有一套鑰匙。如果沒有鑰匙，角色需要連續三次成功透過 {@dc 20} 的敏捷檢定，使用盜賊工具來開啟門。如果任何一次檢定失敗，所有三把鎖都會重置。這扇門的 AC 為 19，傷害閾值為 10，生命值為 90，並且對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。一個生物可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 27} 力量（運動）檢定將其擊破。

english: The vault is empty.
zh_tw: 金庫是空的。

english: Cold Trap
zh_tw: 寒冷陷阱

english: If a creature enters the vault without first saying "Gold is my shield," an intense blast of magical cold fills the room. All creatures in the vault at that time must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw, taking 36 ({@dice 8d8}) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
zh_tw: 如果生物在進入金庫前沒有先說出"黃金是我的盾牌"，一陣強烈的魔法寒冷將充斥整個房間。當時在金庫內的所有生物必須進行一次{@dc 16}體質豁免檢定，若失敗則受到36點（{@dice 8d8}）寒冷傷害，若成功則只受到一半的傷害。

english: A {@spell detect magic} spell reveals the secret to disabling the trap: a tiny magical glyph is inscribed in the middle of the ceiling. If this glyph is dispelled with a successful casting of {@spell dispel magic} ({@dc 16}), the trap ceases to function.
zh_tw: 一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術揭示了禁用陷阱的秘密：在天花板中央刻有一個微小魔法符文。如果透過成功施放{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}（{@dc 16}）來驅散此符文，陷阱將停止運作。

english: C28. Wine Cellar
zh_tw: C28. 酒窖

english: This cellar contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個地下室包含以下特點：

english: The east wall is lined with nearly thirty casks of wine.
zh_tw: 東牆排列著近三十桶葡萄酒。

english: A faint draft comes from the south end of the wine cellar. The draft betrays the location of a secret door.
zh_tw: 從酒窖南端傳來一陣微弱的氣流。這股氣流洩露了一扇秘密門的位置。

english: The servants rarely spend much time here, since the cellar is unlit and cold. Characters feel a strange sense of foreboding here.
zh_tw: 僕人們很少在這裡花太多時間，因為地下室沒有照明並且很冷。角色們在這裡感到一種奇怪的不祥預感。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: A faded holy symbol of Siamorphe, a silver chalice bearing a golden sun symbol, is painted on the south wall. If the sun symbol is pushed, the wall grinds open, revealing {@area C29|330} beyond. A character who searches the wall automatically detects the secret door and can, with a successful {@dc 10} Wisdom (Perception) check, figure out how to open it.
zh_tw: 南牆上繪有一個褪色的神聖符號，代表著希亞摩芙，一個銀色的聖盃上帶著金色的太陽符號。如果按下太陽符號，牆壁便會移動開啟，顯露出後面的{@area C29|330}區域。一個搜尋牆壁的角色會自動發現這扇秘密門，並且可以透過一次成功的{@dc 10}感知（感知）檢定來弄清楚如何開啟它。

english: C29. Secret Vault
zh_tw: C29. 秘密金庫

english: Most of the Cassalanters' wealth is tied up in investments, but the family keeps a stack of twenty 5-pound silver trade bars (worth 25 gp each) here for emergencies. At the back of the vault is a dark staircase that descends 30 feet to the temple of Asmodeus ({@area A1|335}).
zh_tw: 卡薩蘭特家族的大部分財富都投資在投資上，但家族在這裡存放了一堆二十個5磅重的銀貿易條（每個價值25金幣）以備緊急情況。金庫的後部是一個黑暗的樓梯，向下延伸30尺到達阿斯蒙蒂斯的神廟（{@area A1|335}）。

english: Founders' Day
zh_tw: 創始人日

english: In addition to the treasure noted above, the vault contains five hundred sacks containing 1,000 gp each (liquidated family assets). If the Cassalanters were successful in looting the Vault of Dragons, the vault contains an additional five hundred sacks (the sum total of the treasure taken from the vault), for a total of 1,000,000 gp. The gold remains here until it's taken down to the temple (see "Special Events").
zh_tw: 除了上述的財寶外，金庫中還有五百個袋子，每個袋子裡有1000金幣（家族資產的變現）。如果卡薩蘭特家族成功洗劫了龍之寶庫，金庫中將額外增加五百個袋子（從金庫中取出的財寶總和），總共為1000000金幣。這些金幣會一直存放在這裡，直到被送到神廟（見"特殊事件"）。

english: Temple of Asmodeus
zh_tw: 阿斯蒙蒂斯神廟

english: Beneath Cassalanter Villa lies a secret temple where Victoro leads a cult that worships Asmodeus. Cult members include evil-minded nobles as well as deluded commoners lured by the prospect of wealth and status. The entire cult gathers in the temple at midnight on the first day of every tenday for a dark mass. During these ceremonies, they pledge their devotion to the Lord of the Nine Hells, call out the names of their enemies, and beseech Asmodeus to visit ruin upon their foes. They also drink wine, share gossip, and offer the occasional sacrifice. For the Cassalanters, these events are opportunities to flaunt their power and impose their will on their lessers.
zh_tw: 卡薩蘭特別墅下面隱藏著一座秘密神廟，維克托羅在那裡領導著一個崇拜阿斯蒙蒂斯的邪教。邪教成員包括心懷惡意的貴族以及被財富和地位前景所誘騙的愚蠢平民。每個月的第一天午夜，整個邪教會在神廟聚集進行黑暗彌撒。在這些儀式中，他們向九層地獄之王宣誓效忠，呼喊他們敵人的名字，並懇求阿斯蒙蒂斯給他們的敵人帶來毀滅。他們還喝葡萄酒，分享八卦，並偶爾獻上祭品。對卡薩蘭特家族來說，這些活動是炫耀他們權力和對下層人士施加意志的機會。

english: Temple Features
zh_tw: 廟宇特徵

english: The following general features apply to the temple:
zh_tw: 以下一般特點適用於神廟：

english: Rooms are dimly lit by flickering candles placed in tall, slender, wrought-iron candlesticks.
zh_tw: 房間由放置在高大、細長、鍛鐵燭臺上的閃爍蠟燭微弱照明。

english: Ceilings in rooms are 10 feet high unless noted otherwise. Passages are 8 feet tall, with 7-foot tall doorways.
zh_tw: 除非另有說明，房間天花板高度為10尺。通道高度為8尺，門道高度為7尺。

english: Doors are made of iron-banded wood.
zh_tw: 門是由鐵箍加固的木頭製成的。

english: Cultists who aren't members of the nobility wear cheap red robes, devil masks, and wooden amulets that bear the symbol of Asmodeus.
zh_tw: 不是貴族成員的邪教徒穿著廉價的紅色長袍，戴著魔鬼面具，佩戴著刻有阿斯蒙蒂斯標誌的木製護身符。

english: Areas of the Temple
zh_tw: 神殿各區域

english: The following areas correspond to the labels on map 6.2. The temple is connected to Cassalanter Villa by a staircase that connects with {@area A1|335}. Also, an underground stream ({@area A9|34c}) leads away from the temple's lower level and eventually lets out in the Mud Flats northwest of Waterdeep.
zh_tw: 以下區域對應於地圖6.2上的標籤。神廟透過一個樓梯與{@area A1|335}連線，與卡薩蘭特別墅相連。此外，一條地下河流（{@area A9|34c}）從神廟的下層流走，最終流向深水城西北的泥灘。

english: Changes to the temple that occur during cult gatherings are noted in the "Cult Gathering" sections.
zh_tw: 在"邪教集會"部分中註明瞭邪教集會期間神廟發生的變化。

english: Temple of Asmodeus
zh_tw: 阿斯蒙蒂斯神廟

english: Temple of Asmodeus, Lower Level (Player Version)
zh_tw: 阿斯蒙蒂斯神廟，下層（玩家版本）

english: A1. Hall of the Damned
zh_tw: A1. 被詛咒者的大廳

english: The features of this hall are readily apparent:
zh_tw: 這個大廳的特點非常明顯：

english: In the middle of the hall, a spiral staircase descends 20 feet to the lower level ({@area A3|33a}).
zh_tw: 大廳中央，一個螺旋樓梯向下延伸20尺到達下層（{@area A3|33a}）。

english: The faint sound of chanting is audible coming from a corridor to the northwest.
zh_tw: 從西北方向的走廊傳來微弱的吟唱聲。

english: To the south are three cells with iron-banded wooden doors. A small, barred window is embedded in each door at the height of a human's eye. The cell doors face a stone pillar. Hanging from a hook on the pillar is a ring of keys.
zh_tw: 在南方有三個帶有鐵箍木門的牢房。每個門上都有一個小的帶柵欄的窗戶，高度與人眼平齊。牢房門面向一個石柱。一個鑰匙圈掛在柱子上的鉤子上。

english: Cells
zh_tw: 牢房

english: When the Cassalanters decide to sacrifice humans in their rituals, they lure homeless Waterdavians to their estate and confine them in these cells. The keys to unlock the doors hang from the stone pillar. A lock can be picked by a character who makes a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check using thieves' tools. All three cells are currently empty.
zh_tw: 當卡薩蘭特家族決定在儀式中犧牲人類時，他們會引誘無家可歸的水手到他們的莊園，並將他們關在這些牢房中。解鎖門的鑰匙掛在石柱上。一個角色可以透過使用盜賊工具成功透過{@dc 15}敏捷檢定來撬開鎖。目前，所有三個牢房都是空的。

english: Chanting
zh_tw: 吟唱聲

english: The sound is that of a prayer to Asmodeus being recited by the cultists in {@area A7|345}.
zh_tw: 這個聲音是邪教徒在{@area A7|345}中對阿斯蒙蒂斯的祈禱。

english: A2. Balconies
zh_tw: A2. 陽臺

english: Two crumbling balconies with stone railings overlook the temple's ceremonial hall ({@area A7|345}). The distance to the floor below is 20 feet.
zh_tw: 兩個搖搖欲墜的陽臺，帶有石欄杆，俯瞰著神廟的儀式大廳（{@area A7|345}）。到下面地板的距離是20尺。

english: Collapsing Floor
zh_tw: 坍塌的地板

english: The balcony floors have weakened with age. Any Medium or larger creature that steps onto a 5-foot-square marked C on the map must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw as the floor crumbles and falls away, leaving a gaping hole. On a failed save, the creature falls 20 feet and lands {@condition prone} on the floor below ({@area A7|345}) amid stone debris. On a success, the creature avoids the fall by leaping to an adjacent, unoccupied space. The sound of the collapsing floor can be heard throughout the temple.
zh_tw: 陽臺的地板因年代久遠而變得脆弱。任何中型或更大的生物踏上地圖上標記為C的5尺方格時，必須進行一次{@dc 15}敏捷豁免，因為地板會碎裂並塌陷，留下一個巨大的洞。如果豁免失敗，該生物將跌落20尺並{@condition prone||伏地}在下方的地板上（{@area A7|345}），周圍是石頭碎片。如果豁免成功，該生物可以透過跳到相鄰的無人空間來避免跌落。地板塌陷的聲音在整個寺廟中都能聽到。

english: A3. Anterior Vestibule
zh_tw: A3. 前廳

english: The spiral staircase from {@area A1|335} ends at this chamber.
zh_tw: 從{@area A1|335}的螺旋樓梯通向這個房間。

english: Asmodeus Portrait
zh_tw: 阿斯蒙蒂斯肖像

english: Mounted on the back wall of an alcove to the north is an 18-foot-high, 9-foot-wide portrait in a gilded frame. The picture depicts a strikingly handsome and impeccably dressed bearded man with small horns protruding from his forehead. He carries a ruby-tipped cane. Any character who succeeds on a {@dc 10} Intelligence (Religion) check recognizes the figure as Asmodeus.
zh_tw: 在北側壁龕的後牆上掛著一幅18尺高、9尺寬的鍍金框肖像畫。畫中是一位英俊非凡、衣著考究的留須男子，額頭上突出著小小的角。他手持著一根鑲有紅寶石的手杖。任何成功透過{@dc 10}智力（宗教）檢定的角色都能認出這位人物是阿斯蒙蒂斯。

english: Cult Gathering
zh_tw: 邪教集會

english: During cult gatherings, a {@creature bearded devil} guards each of the doors leading to {@area A7|345}.
zh_tw: 在邪教集會期間，每個通往{@area A7|345}的門前都有一隻{@creature bearded devil||須魔}守衛。

english: A4. Family Crypt
zh_tw: A4. 家族墓穴

english: Twelve stone sarcophagi are packed into deep recesses in the walls. The plaster lid of each sarcophagus is carved in the likeness of a noble clutching a chalice that bears a symbol of the sun. The sarcophagi contain nothing but dust and bones.
zh_tw: 十二個石棺被緊密地放置在牆壁深處的凹槽中。每個棺材的石膏蓋子上都雕刻著一位貴族的肖像，他們緊握著一個帶有太陽標誌的聖盃。這些棺材裡除了塵土和骨頭之外，什麼也沒有。

english: The spirits of several dead members of the Cassalanter family are bound to this crypt. They manifest as three dark, vaporous {@creature specter||specters} plus a {@creature ghost} that looks like the insubstantial image of a handsome, clean-shaven man of knightly bearing clad in plate armor. These undead attack any living creatures but can't leave the crypt or approach within 5 feet of any creature that wears a holy symbol of Asmodeus.
zh_tw: 卡薩蘭特家族幾位已故成員的靈魂被困在這座墓穴中。他們以三團黑暗的霧氣狀{@creature specter||惡靈}和一個看起來像身穿板甲、騎士風範的英俊剃鬚男子虛幻形象的{@creature ghost||幽魂}顯現。這些不死生物會攻擊任何活物，但無法離開墓穴或接近任何佩戴阿斯蒙蒂斯聖徽生物5尺範圍內。

english: The ghost is all that remains of Caladorn Cassalanter, a former Masked Lord and hero of Waterdeep. The ghost halts its attack and calls off the specters if a character wears or presents a holy symbol of Siamorphe. After it is shown such a symbol, the ghost guides characters to its personal crypt ({@area A4a|33e}).
zh_tw: 這個鬼魂是卡拉多恩·卡薩蘭特的唯一遺留之物，他是前蒙面領主，也是深水城的英雄。如果角色佩戴或展示希亞摩芙的聖徽，鬼魂會停止攻擊並撤銷幽靈。在展示了這樣一個聖徽之後，鬼魂會引導角色前往其私人的墓穴（{@area A4a|33e}）。

english: A4a. Caladorn's Crypt
zh_tw: A4a. 卡拉多恩的墓穴

english: A dusty stone sarcophagus occupies this crypt, its plaster lid carved in the likeness of a handsome, clean-shaven nobleman clutching a chalice engraved with the symbol of the sun. The likeness resembles the ghost of Caladorn Cassalanter (see above).
zh_tw: 一口布滿灰塵的石棺佔據著這座墓穴，石膏棺蓋上雕刻著一位英俊、乾淨利落貴族的肖像，他緊握一隻刻有太陽符號的聖盃。該肖像類似於卡拉多恩·卡薩蘭特（見上文）的幽靈形象。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Caladorn's bones have turned to dust, but his suit of {@item +1 plate armor} remains. Also lying in the dust is a {@item mace of disruption}. If Caladorn's ghost is present when one or both magic items are removed from the sarcophagus, it asks, "Do you vow to use these items to defeat the forces of darkness?" An answer in the affirmative is sufficient to lay the ghost to rest. Before vanishing for good, it says, "Use the mace to destroy the effigy of evil incarnate. End the corruption to restore my family's honor." (The "effigy" is the statue of Asmodeus in {@area A7|345}.)
zh_tw: 卡拉多恩的骨頭已經化為塵土，但他的{@item +1 plate armor||+1 板甲}依然存在。同樣躺在灰塵中的還有一把{@item mace of disruption||瓦解之錘}。如果當一個或兩個魔法物品從石棺中移走時卡拉多恩的鬼魂在場，它會問："你們發誓要使用這些物品來打敗黑暗勢力嗎？" 肯定的回答足以使鬼魂安息。在永遠消失之前，它說："使用釘頭錘摧毀邪惡化身的雕像。結束腐敗以恢復我家族的榮譽。" ("雕像"是{@area A7|345}中的阿斯蒙蒂斯雕像。)

english: A4b. Empty Crypt
zh_tw: A4b. 空墓穴

english: This crypt contains nothing but dust and cobwebs.
zh_tw: 這個墓穴除了灰塵和蛛網之外什麼也沒有。

english: A5. Cultists' Chamber
zh_tw: A5. 邪教徒的密室

english: This room has the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間有以下特點：

english: Six wooden cots stand against the north and south walls.
zh_tw: 六張木製床鋪靠在南北牆上。

english: The west wall is carved with four bas-reliefs of pit fiends.
zh_tw: 西牆上刻有四個深獄煉魔的浮雕。

english: Tired cultists sleep here after ceremonies, particularly if they drank too much wine.
zh_tw: 疲倦的邪教徒在儀式後在這裡睡覺，特別是如果他們喝了太多酒。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: Behind one of the bas-reliefs is a secret door, which can be detected with a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom (Perception) check. Pushing against the sculpture causes a secret door to swing open into {@area A6|343}.
zh_tw: 在其中一塊淺浮雕後面有一扇秘密門，成功透過 {@dc 13} 感知（感知）檢定即可發現。推動雕塑會導致秘密門向 {@area A6|343} 方向開啟。

english: A6. Secret Vestry
zh_tw: A6. 秘密聖器室

english: This room is hidden behind two secret doors that aren't disguised on the inside, where a stone knob on each door allows it to be pulled open with ease. The room contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間被兩扇秘密門隱藏起來，門內沒有偽裝，每扇門上的石制把手可以輕鬆地拉開。房間包含以下特點：

english: Against the south wall stand two black wardrobes with nine-pointed stars carved into their doors.
zh_tw: 靠南牆放著兩個黑色的衣櫥，門上雕刻著九角星。

english: A pair of tall, slender mirrors are mounted on the west wall, their stone frames carved with serpents.
zh_tw: 一對高挑、苗條的鏡子掛在西牆上，它們的石框上雕刻著蛇。

english: Stacked in the middle of the room are six casks of wine used for cult celebrations.
zh_tw: 房間中央堆放著六桶用於邪教慶祝活動的葡萄酒。

english: Each wardrobe contains five complete outfits of cult regalia sized for adult humans: red robes, devil masks, and wooden amulets shaped in the symbol of Asmodeus.
zh_tw: 每個衣櫥裡都裝有五套成人尺寸的邪教儀式服裝：紅色長袍、魔鬼面具和刻有阿斯蒙蒂斯象徵的木製護身符。

english: Cult Gathering
zh_tw: 邪教集會

english: An hour before a cult gathering, five human cultists are here donning their regalia.
zh_tw: 在邪教集會前一個小時，五名人類邪教徒在這裡穿戴他們的儀式服裝。

english: A7. Ceremonial Hall
zh_tw: A7. 儀式大廳

english: This hall has a 30-foot-high vaulted ceiling and a pair of 20-foot-high balconies (see {@area A2|338}) overlooking it. Its other features as follows:
zh_tw: 這個大廳有一個30尺高的拱形天花板和一對20尺高的陽臺（見{@area A2|338}）。它的其他特點如下：

english: Rows of flickering candles in iron candlesticks form a pathway to a 30-foot-tall stone statue at the west end of the hall. The statue depicts a smiling, bearded man of diabolical bent, with small horns protruding from his brow and cloven hooves instead of feet. At the base of the statue, clutched in a stone claw erupting from the floor, is a 3-foot-deep, 9-foot-diameter stone bowl filled with crackling flames.
zh_tw: 大廳西端有一座30尺高的石雕，石雕描繪了一個微笑的、長著小角和分蹄的惡魔傾向的長鬍子男人。在雕像底座上，一隻從地板上伸出的石爪緊握著一個3尺深、9尺直徑的石碗，裡面充滿了噼啪作響的火焰。沿著鐵燭臺上閃爍的蠟燭排成的路徑通向這座雕像。

english: Three human {@creature cultist||cultists} wearing red robes, devil masks, and wooden holy symbols of Asmodeus kneel before the statue, feverishly chanting an infernal hymn. (During a cult gathering, the number of cultists present increases dramatically.)
zh_tw: 三名身穿紅色長袍、戴著魔鬼面具、手持阿斯蒙蒂斯木質聖徽的人類{@creature cultist||邪教徒}跪在雕像前，狂熱地吟唱著地獄頌歌。（在邪教集會期間，在場的邪教徒數量會大幅增加。）

english: The walls around the statue are covered by large tapestries that depict scenes of human debauchery. (Behind the north tapestry is a rough-hewn passage that leads to {@area A9|34c}.)
zh_tw: 雕像周圍的牆壁上掛著大型掛毯，上面描繪著人類放蕩的場景。（北面掛毯後面是一條粗糙的通道，通向{@area A9|34c}。）

english: The Cassalanters' ritual to save Terenzio and Elzerina plays out here (see "Special Events").
zh_tw: 卡薩蘭特人的儀式，為了拯救特倫齊奧和艾爾澤琳娜，就在這裡進行（見"特殊事件"）。

english: Cult Gathering
zh_tw: 邪教集會

english: If the cult is here in force, thirty human {@creature cultist||cultists} stand in neat rows before the statue, chanting to Asmodeus with wooden goblets in hand while their leader, {@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), tosses offerings into the bowl. Roughly half of the cultists are members of the nobility; the rest are Waterdavian rabble brought into the cult to fill out the ranks. Standing around the perimeter are {@creature Willifort Crowelle|WDH}, {@creature Tissina Khyret|wdh}, {@creature Laiba "Nana" Rosse|wdh|Laiba Rosse}, and {@creature Jandar Chergoba|wdh} (see "Head Servants"). Their job is to make sure the other cultists behave themselves while {@creature Ammalia Cassalanter|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) walks gracefully through the crowd with a golden decanter, ceremonially pouring wine into the cultists' goblets for toasting to the Lord of the Nine Hells. Lady Cassalanter's six {@creature imp||imps} (see {@area C25|328}) are perched invisibly on the statue.
zh_tw: 如果邪教在此聲勢浩大，三十名人類{@creature cultist||邪教徒}在雕像前排成整齊的佇列，手持木杯向阿斯蒙蒂斯吟唱，而他們的領袖{@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH|維克托羅·卡薩蘭特}（參見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）將供品投入碗中。大約一半的邪教徒是貴族成員；其餘的是被引入邪教以填補隊伍的深水城平民。站在周圍的是{@creature Willifort Crowelle|WDH|威利福特·克羅威爾}、{@creature Tissina Khyret|wdh|蒂西娜·凱瑞特}、{@creature Laiba "Nana" Rosse|wdh|萊巴·羅斯}和{@creature Jandar Chergoba|wdh|詹達爾·切爾戈巴}（參見"主要僕從"）。他們的任務是確保其他邪教徒在{@creature Ammalia Cassalanter|WDH|阿瑪利亞·卡薩蘭特}（參見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）優雅地穿過人群時保持秩序，她手持金色酒壺，儀式性地將酒倒入邪教徒的杯中，為九獄之主幹杯。卡薩蘭特夫人的六隻{@creature imp||小魔鬼}（參見{@area C25|328}）隱形地棲息在雕像上。

english: Devil Statue and Sacrificial Bowl
zh_tw: 魔鬼雕像和祭品碗

english: The statue once depicted Siamorphe, but the Cassalanters used {@spell stone shape} spells to recast it into an image of their dread lord, Asmodeus. The massive bowl at the foot of the statue was also fashioned with {@spell stone shape} spells; it radiates a strong aura of conjuration magic when subjected to a {@spell detect magic} spell or similar magic. Magical flames erupt from the bowl as long as it remains intact. Any creature that enters the flames or starts its turn in them takes {@dice 4d10} fire damage. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by this damage turns to ashes. Nonmagical objects tossed into the flames are destroyed.
zh_tw: 這座雕像曾經描繪了希亞摩芙，但卡薩蘭特家族使用了 {@spell stone shape||塑石術} 法術將其重塑為他們畏懼的領主阿斯蒙蒂斯的形象。雕像腳下的巨大碗也是用 {@spell stone shape||塑石術} 法術製成的；當它被施以 {@spell detect magic||偵測魔法} 法術或類似的魔法時，會散發出強烈的咒法魔法氣息。只要碗保持完整，魔法火焰就會從碗中噴發出來。任何進入火焰或在其內開始回合的生物都會受到 {@dice 4d10} 點火焰傷害。任何因這種傷害而降至 0 點生命值的生物都會變成灰燼。投入火焰的非魔法物品會被摧毀。

english: If the statue is struck by a {@item mace of disruption}, it cracks and falls to pieces, shattering the bowl as it tumbles down. Any member of the cult who witnesses the destruction of the statue takes 11 ({@dice 2d10}) psychic damage.
zh_tw: 如果雕像被{@item mace of disruption||瓦解之錘}擊中，它會裂開並碎成碎片，同時墜落時打碎了碗。任何目擊雕像被摧毀的邪教成員會受到11（{@dice 2d10}）點心靈傷害。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: The secret door leading to {@area A6|343} can be found with a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom (Perception) check. Pushing on that section of wall causes it to swing open.
zh_tw: 透過一次成功的 {@dc 13} 感知（感知）檢定可以發現通往 {@area A6|343} 的密門。推動該部分牆壁會使其擺動開啟。

english: Stream
zh_tw: 溪流

english: Flowing behind the statue is a stream that enters and exits through 1-foot-high, 2-foot-wide arched culverts.
zh_tw: 雕像後面流淌著一條小溪，它透過1尺高、2尺寬的拱形涵洞進入和離開。

english: A8. Storage Closet
zh_tw: A8. 儲物間

english: Against the back wall of this closet stands an unlocked cabinet with a black rug laid out before it. The cabinet contains a golden decanter (worth 125 gp) and shelves holding wooden wine goblets.
zh_tw: 在這個壁櫥的後牆邊，有一個未上鎖的櫃子，櫃子前鋪著一塊黑色地毯。櫃子裡有一個金質酒壺（價值125金幣）和架子上擺放著木製酒杯。

english: Cult Gathering
zh_tw: 邪教集會

english: The cabinet is empty, as the decanter and goblets are being put to use in {@area A7|345}.
zh_tw: 這個櫃子是空的，因為那個玻璃瓶和高腳杯正在{@area A7|345}被使用。

english: A9. Stream and Pool
zh_tw: A9. 小溪與池塘

english: An underground stream flows through the west side of the temple and into a 5-foot-deep pool here before meandering northwest and emerging in the Mud Flats.
zh_tw: 一條地下小溪流經寺廟的西側，然後流入這裡的一個5尺深的池塘，之後蜿蜒向西北方向流去，並在泥沼地露出。

english: Special Events
zh_tw: 特殊事件

english: If the Cassalanters fail to obtain the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, the following events don't come to pass. As a consequence, Terenzio and Elzerina are transformed into {@creature lemure||lemures} as their souls are forfeit ten days after Founders' Day. Shattered by their failure and their loss, Victoro and {@creature Ammalia Cassalanter|WDH} vow to destroy those who thwarted them.
zh_tw: 如果卡薩蘭特家族未能獲得{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，以下事件就不會發生。因此，特倫齊奧和艾爾澤琳娜在創始人節後十天，他們的靈魂被沒收，變成了{@creature lemure||劣魔}。維克托羅和{@creature Ammalia Cassalanter|WDH|阿瑪利亞·卡薩蘭特}因失敗和失去親人而心碎，發誓要摧毀那些阻撓他們的人。

english: Getting the Gold
zh_tw: 獲取金子

english: This event can occur only on Founders' Day or sooner.
zh_tw: 這個事件只能在創始人節或更早的時間發生。

english: Armed with the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} and the keys to unlock the Vault of Dragons, {@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH} enters the vault, uses a {@spell disguise self} spell to appear as Lord Dagult Neverember, and tricks {@creature Aurinax|WDH} the gold dragon into relinquishing the gold. A dozen House Cassalanter {@creature guard||guards} disguised as members of the City Guard stuff the gold into sacks while a dozen more haul the sacks to a pair of waiting carriages for safe transport back to Cassalanter Villa. Each sack holds 1,000 gp, and each carriage can hold fifty sacks (50,000 gp) at a time. Getting the gold from the Vault of Dragons to Cassalanter Villa takes ten round trips (five per carriage) and the better part of a day. Three {@condition invisible} {@creature imp||imps} accompany each carriage, which is driven by a {@creature bearded devil} wearing a hat and a high-collared cape to conceal its true nature. Upon arrival at Cassalanter Villa, each carriage is met by a dozen {@creature guard||guards} in House Cassalanter livery, who unload the sacks of gold and place them in {@area C29|330}.
zh_tw: 這個事件只能在創始人節或更早的時間發生。持有{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}和解鎖龍之寶庫的鑰匙，{@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH|維克托羅·卡薩蘭特}進入金庫，使用一個{@spell disguise self||易容術}法術將自己偽裝成達格魯特·無燼爵，並欺騙{@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯}這條金龍放棄金子。一打卡薩蘭特家族的{@creature guard||警衛}偽裝成城防軍的成員，將金子塞進麻袋，而另外一打則將麻袋運送到兩輛等待的馬車上，安全地運回卡薩蘭特別墅。每個麻袋裝有1,000金幣，每輛馬車一次可以裝載五十個麻袋（50,000金幣）。從龍之寶庫將金子運送到卡薩蘭特別墅需要十次往返（每輛馬車五次），並且需要大半天的時間。每輛馬車由三個{@condition invisible||隱形}的{@creature imp||小魔鬼}陪同，由戴著帽子和高領斗篷以掩蓋其真實身份的{@creature bearded devil||須魔}駕駛。到達卡薩蘭特別墅後，每輛馬車都由一打穿著卡薩蘭特家族制服的{@creature guard||警衛}迎接，他們解除安裝金子的麻袋並將它們放置在{@area C29|330}。

english: {@creature Jenks|WDH} catches sight of Lady Cassalanter in the summer street
zh_tw: {@creature Jenks|WDH|詹克斯} 在夏日街道上瞥見了卡薩蘭特夫人

english: Day of the Damned
zh_tw: 受詛咒的日子

english: This event occurs only if the Cassalanters obtain the gold from the Vault of Dragons.
zh_tw: 這個事件只有在卡薩蘭特家族從龍之寶庫獲得金子時才會發生。

english: {@creature Ammalia Cassalanter|WDH} hosts a grand party on Founders' Day that begins in the early afternoon and ends at midnight. Wealthy guests begin to arrive in the late afternoon and gather inside the villa, away from the sun and heat, while one hundred of Waterdeep's poorest residents-most brought from the Field Ward-gather under pavilions set up on the lawn. Hired actors dressed as Waterdeep's founders parade around, and bards play lively tunes. No one suspects that the food in the pavilion tents has been laced with midnight tears-a poison that will slay the impoverished guests at the stroke of midnight. Ammalia is immune to poison and thus partakes freely of the delicious food. Wealthy guests who remain holed up in Cassalanter Villa eat and drink at separate tables and are spared a grisly end.
zh_tw: {@creature Ammalia Cassalanter|WDH|阿瑪利亞·卡薩蘭特}在創始人節舉辦了一場盛大的派對，從午後開始，一直持續到午夜。富有的賓客在下午晚些時候開始抵達，聚集在別墅內，遠離陽光和炎熱，而來自深水城最貧窮的一百名居民——大多數是從原野區帶來的——聚集在草坪上搭建的帳篷下。僱傭的演員裝扮成深水城的創始人遊行，吟遊詩人演奏活潑的旋律。沒有人懷疑帳篷裡的食物被摻入了午夜之淚——一種毒藥，將在午夜鐘聲敲響時殺死貧窮的賓客。阿瑪利亞對毒藥免疫，因此可以自由地享用美味的食物。留在卡薩蘭特別墅內的富有賓客在單獨的桌子上吃喝，避免了悲慘的結局。

english: An hour before midnight, the entertainers disperse as Ammalia begins making toasts to her wealthy guests, turning them into unwitting accomplices by virtue of their presence and thus ensuring their silence. Meanwhile, house guards prevent any of the rabble from leaving, forcibly detaining anyone who tries to flee. Unless the characters prevent the poor folk from eating the tainted food, those attendees consume the poison and perish at the stroke of midnight.
zh_tw: 在午夜前一個小時，表演者們散去，因為阿瑪利亞開始向她的富有賓客敬酒，透過他們的存在將他們變成不知情的共犯，從而確保他們的沉默。與此同時，家衛阻止任何暴民離開，強行拘留任何試圖逃跑的人。除非角色們阻止窮人吃下被汙染的食物，否則那些與會者會攝入毒藥，並在午夜鐘聲敲響時喪生。

english: While Ammalia plays host, Victoro instructs his cultists to remove the sacks of gold from House Cassalanter's vault ({@area C29|330}) and hurl them into the sacrificial bowl ({@area A7|345}). They finish shortly before midnight. At the stroke of midnight, as the poison does its work, Ammalia keeps an eye on her wealthy guests and orders Tessina Khyret to notify Victoro that the deed is done. Standing before the statue of Asmodeus in the temple, Victoro summons a {@creature barbed devil} and informs it that payment has been made in full. The devil declares (in Infernal) that the payment is "satisfactory" and informs Victoro that the souls of Terenzio and Elzerina will not be taken to the Nine Hells. It then disappears whence it came, leaving the Cassalanters to bask in their triumph.
zh_tw: 當阿瑪利亞擔任主人時，維克托羅指示他的邪教徒從卡薩蘭特家族的金庫({@area C29|330})中移走金袋，並將它們投入祭祀碗中({@area A7|345})。他們在午夜前不久完成。隨著午夜鐘聲的敲響，毒藥開始發揮作用，阿瑪利亞監視著她的富有賓客，並命令蒂西娜·凱瑞特通知維克托羅事情已經完成。站在神廟中阿斯蒙蒂斯的雕像前，維克托羅召喚了一個{@creature barbed devil||蝟魔}，並告知它已全額支付。魔鬼（用地獄語）宣佈支付是"令人滿意"的，並告知維克托羅特倫齊奧和艾爾澤琳娜的靈魂不會被帶到九層地獄。然後它消失在它來的地方，留下卡薩蘭特家族沉浸在他們的成功中。

english: After the party, in the dark hours of morning, the corpses of the dead are cast into the fiery bowl in {@area A7|345}, leaving no evidence of foul play. In the days and months that follow, Victoro and Ammalia use threats of diabolical retribution to silence witnesses and wield their political clout to quash criminal investigations.
zh_tw: 派對結束後，在凌晨的黑暗時刻，死者的屍體被投入{@area A7|345}的火盆中，沒有留下任何犯罪的痕跡。在隨後的幾天和幾個月裡，維克托羅和阿瑪利亞利用惡魔報復的威脅來封口證人，並利用他們的政治影響力來壓制刑事調查。

english: Chapter 7: Maestro's Fall
zh_tw: 第7章：大師的隕落

english: Jarlaxle, the leader of Bregan D'aerthe, sees membership in the Lords' Alliance as his path to power beyond Luskan. As the secret lord of a city with an unsavory reputation, he has had a hard time getting a seat at the table with other cities of the North when it comes to trade and defense of the region. Thus, he plans to use the stolen gold to bargain with {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH} for inclusion in the alliance, and to oust Neverwinter and its lord Dagult Neverember-Jarlaxle's fiercest political opponent-from the group.
zh_tw: 賈拉索，布雷甘·達耶的領袖，將加入領主聯盟視為超越路斯坎的權力之路。作為一個名聲不佳的城市的秘密領主，他在與其他北方城市就貿易和地區防禦進行談判時一直難以獲得一席之地。因此，他計劃利用被盜的金子與{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}討價還價，以求加入聯盟，並將無冬城及其領主達格魯特·無燼爵——賈拉索最激烈的政治對手——從集團中驅逐出去。

english: Facing Jarlaxle
zh_tw: 面對賈拉索萊

english: As the characters investigate the Sea Maidens Faire, they could run into Jarlaxle, especially if they take a kick-in-the-door approach and storm the vessels of the traveling carnival. When Jarlaxle learns that the characters are aboard one of his ships, he arranges to meet with them in the guise of Zardoz Zord. If they refuse, Jarlaxle orders his crew to cast the characters overboard-or takes care of the job himself if he must.
zh_tw: 當角色們調查海之少女嘉年華時，他們可能會遇到賈拉索，特別是如果他們採取破門而入的方式，衝進旅行嘉年華的船隻。當賈拉索得知角色們在他的一艘船上時，他安排以扎多茲·佐德的身份與他們見面。如果他們拒絕，賈拉索命令他的船員將角色們扔到船外——或者如果必須的話，他會親自處理這個工作。

english: If he thinks the adventurers can be trusted, Jarlaxle proposes that they join his search for the Vault of Dragons. He intends to return the gold to {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH}, less 5,000 gp for the characters in exchange for their help. He offers another 5,000 gp for their help in recovering the {@item dragonstaff of Ahghairon|WDH}. If the characters accept, Jarlaxle upholds his end of the agreement. Once the gold is secure, he gives the characters their cut.
zh_tw: 如果他認為冒險家們值得信賴，賈拉索提議他們加入他對龍之寶庫的搜尋。他打算將金子還給{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}，扣除5000金幣作為角色們幫助的報酬。他還提供另外5000金幣作為他們幫助找回{@item dragonstaff of Ahghairon|WDH|阿蓋爾倫的龍杖}的報酬。如果角色們接受，賈拉索會履行他協議的承諾。一旦金子安全，他會給角色們他們的份額。

english: If the characters don't agree to Jarlaxle's terms, or if they assault him, he tries to knock them {@condition unconscious} and leave them without clothes or equipment in a gutter in the Dock Ward. He stores their equipment in {@area J16|37d} aboard the {@i Eyecatcher}, with the exception of any magic items. Those he stashes in {@area U4|3ae} aboard the {@i Scarlet Marpenoth}, his secret submarine.
zh_tw: 如果角色們不同意賈拉索的條款，或者如果他們襲擊他，他會嘗試將他們擊{@condition unconscious||昏迷}，並將他們赤身裸體、失去裝備地丟在碼頭區的溝渠中。他會將他們的裝備存放在{@i 奪目號}上的{@area J16|37d}，除了任何魔法物品。那些他會藏在{@i 緋紅瑪佩諾斯}上的{@area U4|3ae}，這是他的秘密潛艇。

english: In the unlikely event that Jarlaxle is killed, Bregan D'aerthe raises him from the dead within a tenday. Once he's back in action, he tries to recover any gear that was stolen from him.
zh_tw: 在賈拉索被殺這種不太可能發生的事件中，布雷甘·達耶會在十天內將他復活。一旦他恢復行動，他會嘗試追回任何被偷走的裝備。

english: Disrupting Jarlaxle's Operation
zh_tw: 破壞賈拉索的行動

english: Characters can hinder Jarlaxle in the ways described in the following two subsections.
zh_tw: 角色們可以透過以下兩個小節中描述的方式阻礙賈拉索。

english: Destroy the Figureheads
zh_tw: 摧毀船首像

english: The figureheads on Jarlaxle's ships ({@area J8|36d}) create illusions around drow crew members, making them appear human. If a figurehead is destroyed, the drow on that ship remain belowdecks to ensure that they don't draw unwanted attention.
zh_tw: 賈拉索船隻上的船首像({@area J8|36d})會在卓爾船員周圍製造幻象，使他們看起來像人類。如果船首像被摧毀，那艘船上的卓爾會留在甲板下，以確保他們不會引起不必要的注意。

english: Sink or Steal a Vessel
zh_tw: 擊沉或偷走船隻

english: If the characters sink or steal one of his sailing ships or the {@i Scarlet Marpenoth}, Jarlaxle tasks his crew members with finding out what went wrong. In the case of a sunken ship, such wanton destruction could also involve the City Watch, especially if the act results in people drowning.
zh_tw: 如果角色們擊沉或偷走了他的帆船或{@i 緋紅瑪佩諾斯}，賈拉索會指派他的船員找出問題所在。在船隻沉沒的情況下，這種任意的破壞也可能涉及城市守衛，特別是如果這種行為導致人員溺水。

english: Sea Maidens Faire
zh_tw: 海之少女嘉年華

english: The Eyecatcher
zh_tw: 奪目號

english: {@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH}'s seafaring carnival travels up and down the Sword Coast in three ships. The {@i Eyecatcher}, Jarlaxle's flagship, is ostentatious. Mounted underneath it is the {@i Scarlet Marpenoth}, a submarine of Lantanese design. The second ship, the {@i Heartbreaker}, is primarily used to transport performers, strange creatures, and {@item wagon|PHB|wagons}. The third ship, the {@i Hellraiser}, transports musicians and decorative floats. The {@i Heartbreaker} and the {@i Hellraiser} are presently docked, while the {@i Eyecatcher} is anchored in the harbor.
zh_tw: {@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH|賈拉索·班瑞}的海上嘉年華由三艘船隻在劍海岸上下航行。{@i 奪目號}是賈拉索的旗艦，非常顯眼。在其下方裝備的是{@i 緋紅瑪佩諾斯}，一艘蘭檀尼斯設計的潛水艇。第二艘船，{@i 碎心號}，主要用於運輸表演者、奇異生物和{@item wagon|PHB|四輪貨車}。第三艘船，{@i 煽亂號}，用於運輸音樂家和裝飾性的彩車。{@i 碎心號}和{@i 煽亂號}目前停泊在碼頭，而{@i 奪目號}則錨定在港口。

english: All three ships are crewed by drow who are magically disguised to appear human. Despite their disguises, the drow still have the Sunlight Sensitivity trait.
zh_tw: 這三艘船都由卓爾族組成，他們透過魔法偽裝成人類。儘管他們偽裝了，卓爾族仍然具有日光敏感特性。

english: Approaching the Ships
zh_tw: 接近船隻

english: The {@i Heartbreaker} and the {@i Hellraiser} are docked across from each other at the same pier in the Dock Ward. The characters need only walk up a ramp from the pier to {@area J1|364} on either ship. The pier is so busy that no one takes notice of the characters until they are on a vessel.
zh_tw: {@i 碎心號}和{@i 煽亂號}停泊在碼頭區同一個碼頭的對面。角色們只需從碼頭走上坡道到達任一船隻的{@area J1|364}區域。碼頭非常繁忙，以至於沒有人注意到角色們，直到他們登上一艘船隻。

english: Jarlaxle's flagship is anchored in Deepwater Harbor, a mile away from his other ships. To reach the {@i Eyecatcher}, the characters must travel there by using another vessel, by swimming, or by flying. If the characters approach in a vessel known to the crew, such as a rowboat from another of Jarlaxle's ships, the characters arouse no suspicion until they are seen on deck. The crew of the {@i Eyecatcher} crew sends word to Jarlaxle immediately if the characters approach in an unknown vessel.
zh_tw: 賈拉索的旗艦停泊在深水港，距離他的其他船隻一英里遠。要到達{@i 奪目號}，角色們必須使用另一艘船隻、游泳或飛行來前往。如果角色們乘坐船員熟知的船隻接近，例如來自賈拉索其他船隻的小艇，角色們在甲板上被看到之前不會引起懷疑。如果角色們乘坐未知的船隻接近，{@i 奪目號}的船員會立即通知賈拉索。

english: If the characters approach the {@i Eyecatcher} in an underwater vehicle, such as {@creature Grinda Garloth|WDH}'s {@item apparatus of Kwalish} (see chapter 4), the character piloting must succeed on a {@dc 12} Dexterity (Stealth) check to keep the vehicle from being spotted by the crew of the {@i Scarlet Marpenoth}. If the characters approach by swimming, each of them must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity (Stealth) check to avoid being spotted by the crew of the {@i Eyecatcher}.
zh_tw: 如果角色們使用水下交通工具接近 {@i 奪目號}，例如 {@creature Grinda Garloth|WDH|格林達·加洛斯} 的 {@item apparatus of Kwalish||誇力許裝置}（見第4章），駕駛的角色必須成功透過一次 {@dc 12} 敏捷（隱匿）檢定，以避免被 {@i 緋紅瑪佩諾斯} 的船員發現。如果角色們透過游泳接近，他們每個人都必須成功透過一次 {@dc 10} 敏捷（隱匿）檢定，以避免被 {@i 奪目號} 的船員發現。

english: Crews
zh_tw: 船員

english: The characters can learn valuable information by interrogating crew members and carnival performers.
zh_tw: 角色們可以透過審問船員和嘉年華表演者來獲取有價值的資訊。

english: Ship Captains
zh_tw: 船隻船長

english: Although Zardoz Zord ({@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH}) commands the fleet, each ship has its own captain: a Bregan D'aerthe {@creature drow mage} disguised as a slender, well-dressed human. These captains know of Jarlaxle's plans. They communicate with each other and with Jarlaxle by way of {@spell sending} spells, which they prepare instead of {@spell fly}.
zh_tw: 儘管扎多茲·佐德（{@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH|賈拉索·班瑞}）指揮著整個艦隊，但每艘船都有自己的船長：一個偽裝成身材苗條、穿著考究的人類的布雷甘·達耶{@creature drow mage||卓爾魔法師}。這些船長知道賈拉索的計劃。他們透過{@spell sending||短訊術}法術相互溝通以及與賈拉索溝通，他們會準備這個法術而不是{@spell fly||飛行術}。

english: Velgos Ephezzrin captains the {@i Hellraiser} in the guise of a human named Fergus Crabwater. He enjoys wine a little too much, and characters have advantage on Charisma checks made to interact with him during a meal.
zh_tw: 維爾戈斯·埃菲茲林以人類身份弗格斯·克拉布沃特的偽裝擔任{@i 煽亂號}的船長。他非常喜歡葡萄酒，角色們在用餐時與他互動的魅力檢定中有優勢。

english: Tylan Ilueph captains the {@i Heartbreaker} as a human named Klarr Besham. He's a humorless taskmaster whose tarantula familiar is always on his shoulder.
zh_tw: 提蘭·伊盧埃夫以人類身份克拉爾·貝沙姆的偽裝擔任{@i 碎心號}的船長。他是一個沒有幽默感的嚴厲監工，他的狼蛛魔寵總是在他的肩膀上。

english: Llorath Pharn captains the {@i Eyecatcher} as a human named Tarwind Arryhook. He loves games of chance and can't resist a good wager.
zh_tw: 洛拉斯·法恩以人類身份塔爾溫德·阿里胡克的偽裝擔任{@i 奪目號}的船長。他喜歡賭博遊戲，無法抗拒一個好的賭注。

english: A successful {@dc 15} Charisma (Deception or Persuasion) check and the mention of Zardoz Zord's name is enough to gain an audience with a ship captain.
zh_tw: 一個成功的 {@dc 15} 魅力（欺瞞或說服）檢定，並提到扎多茲·佐德的名字，足以獲得與船長的會面機會。

english: If the characters capture one of the captains and succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma (Intimidation) check, they learn the following information by asking the right questions:
zh_tw: 如果角色們捕獲了一名船長併成功透過一個 {@dc 15} 魅力（威嚇）檢定，他們透過提出正確的問題將瞭解到以下資訊：

english: "The Sea Maidens Faire and all its ships are under the command of Captain Zardoz Zord of Luskan." (A ship captain won't divulge Zord's true identity unless magically compelled to do so.)
zh_tw: "海之少女嘉年華及其所有船隻都在路斯坎的扎多茲·佐德船長的指揮下。"（除非被魔法強迫，否則船隻船長不會透露佐德的真實身份。）

english: "Zord has a cabin aboard the {@i Eyecatcher} and spends a lot of time there with Margo Verida and Khafeyta Murzan, two of the Faire's star performers."
zh_tw: "佐德在{@i 奪目號}上有一間小屋，他經常和瑪戈·維里達和卡菲塔·穆爾贊，兩位集市的明星表演者，在那裡度過很多時間。"

english: "A year ago, the Sea Maidens Faire visited the island nation of Lantan, where Zord acquired a submarine called the {@i Scarlet Marpenoth}. The submarine is mounted underneath the {@i Eyecatcher."} "Zord has operatives searching for an artifact called the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, which leads to a place called the Vault of Dragons." (For security, the captains aren't kept informed as to the mission's progress.)
zh_tw: "一年前，海之少女嘉年華訪問了島國蘭檀，在那裡佐德獲得了一艘名為{@i 緋紅瑪佩諾斯}的潛水艇。潛水艇裝備在{@i 奪目號}下方。" "佐德有特工正在尋找一個叫做{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}的神器，它指向一個叫做龍之寶庫的地方。"（出於安全考慮，船長們沒有被告知任務的進展。）
