english: "Zord has drow spies in Waterdeep-{@creature Fel'rekt Lafeen|WDH}, {@creature Krebbyg Masq'il'yr|WDH}, and {@creature Soluun Xibrindas|wdh}. All carry Lantanese firearms."
zh_tw: "佐德在深水城有卓爾間諜——{@creature Fel'rekt Lafeen|WDH|菲爾萊科特·拉菲恩}、{@creature Krebbyg Masq'il'yr|WDH|克雷比格·馬斯奇爾}和{@creature Soluun Xibrindas|wdh|索倫·希布林達斯}。他們都攜帶蘭檀尼斯火器。"

english: "Our disguises are powered by a magical figurehead fixed to the fore of each ship."
zh_tw: "我們的偽裝是由固定在每艘船船首的魔法船首像所驅動的。"

english: Sailors
zh_tw: 水手們

english: The {@i Eyecatcher}, the {@i Heartbreaker}, and the {@i Hellraiser} are crewed by twenty sailors each: three {@creature drow elite warrior||drow elite warriors} (mates) and seventeen {@creature drow}, all magically disguised as slender humans while aboard their vessel. All are loyal members of Bregan D'aerthe, and all know that Zardoz Zord is {@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH} in disguise. They know nothing about the {@i Scarlet Marpenoth} or Jarlaxle's plans.
zh_tw: {@i 奪目號}、{@i 碎心號}和{@i 煽亂號}每艘船上都有二十名水手：三名{@creature drow elite warrior||卓爾精英武者}（大副）和十七名{@creature drow||卓爾}，當他們在船上時，他們都透過魔法偽裝成苗條的人類。他們都是布雷甘·達耶的忠誠成員，並且都知道扎多茲·佐德是偽裝的{@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH|賈拉索·班瑞}。他們對{@i 緋紅瑪佩諾斯}或賈拉索的計劃一無所知。

english: The crew has orders not to fraternize with strangers or guests. Characters who question crew members can learn the following:
zh_tw: 船員們接到命令不得與陌生人或客人交往。提出問題的角色可以瞭解到以下資訊：

english: "Zardoz Zord is master of the Sea Maidens Faire. If you want to meet him, talk to a ship captain." (A sailor won't divulge Zord's true identity unless magically compelled to do so.)
zh_tw: "扎多茲·佐德是海之少女嘉年華的主人。如果你想見他，就去找一位船隻船長談談。"（除非被魔法強迫，否則水手不會透露佐德的真實身份。）

english: "The Sea Maidens Faire is based out of Luskan."
zh_tw: "海之少女嘉年華以路斯坎為基地。"

english: Carnies
zh_tw: 嘉年華工作人員

english: Most of the carnival performers and workers are human {@creature commoner||commoners} trained to perform a handful of tasks or stunts. (Performers have proficiency in the Performance skill.) They're kept in the dark about most things, but they're not oblivious. With a successful {@dc 10} Charisma check, a character can cajole or trick a carny into revealing one of the following pieces of information:
zh_tw: 大多數嘉年華的表演者和工作人員都是經過訓練以執行一些任務或特技的 {@creature commoner||平民}。（表演者擅長表演技能。）他們對大多數事情一無所知，但並非完全無知。透過一次成功的 {@dc 10} 魅力檢定，角色可以哄騙或誘使一名嘉年華工作人員透露以下一條資訊：

english: "Zardoz Zord uses magic to get from the {@i Eyecatcher} to the other boats. I've never seen him in a rowboat."
zh_tw: "扎多茲·佐德使用魔法從{@i 奪目號}到其他船隻。我從未見過他乘坐小艇。"

english: "The sailors communicate with each other using odd hand signals." (Members of Bregan D'aerthe use Drow Sign Language.)
zh_tw: "水手們使用奇怪的手勢相互交流。"（布雷甘·達耶的成員使用卓爾手語。）

english: "All the sailors have an aversion to sunlight."
zh_tw: "所有的水手都不喜歡陽光。"

english: "Have you noticed the sailors have the slightest hint of an Elvish accent?"
zh_tw: "你有沒有注意到水手們有一絲精靈口音？"

english: "All the crew members are men. Very odd."
zh_tw: "所有的船員都是男性。非常奇怪。"

english: Discovering the Drow
zh_tw: 發現黑暗精靈

english: Any character who spends 1 hour observing a ship's crew can make a {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check. With a successful check, the character notices that most crew members speak Common with an Elvish accent and exchange hand signals when they think no one is looking. A drow character recognizes the hand signals as Drow Sign Language.
zh_tw: 任何花費1小時觀察船隻船員的角色可以進行一次{@dc 15}感知（感知）檢定。檢定成功後，角色會注意到大多數船員在說話時帶有精靈口音，並在他們認為沒人注意時交換手勢。卓爾角色會認出這些手勢是卓爾手語。

english: The changes wrought by the magic of the ships' figureheads (see {@area J8|36d}) fail to hold up to physical inspection, meaning that characters who interact with crew members have a chance to notice the illusion. For example, a character who grabs one of the sailors by the ear would quickly realize by touch that the ear is pointed, not rounded as it appears. Additionally, any drow character who boards one of these ships instantly takes on the illusory form of a human of the same gender, height, and weight, because of the magic of the ship's figurehead.
zh_tw: 船隻船首像的魔法變化（見{@area J8|36d}）無法經受住物理檢查，這意味著與船員互動的角色有機會注意到這個幻象。例如，一個抓住水手耳朵的角色會很快透過觸控意識到耳朵是尖的，而不是看起來的圓形。此外，任何登上這些船隻的卓爾角色會立即因為船首像的魔法而變成相同性別、身高和體重的人類的幻象形態。

english: Ship Features
zh_tw: 船隻特點

english: Each ship has the statistics of a {@item sailing ship} (see the Airborne and Waterborne Vehicles table in chapter 5 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|dmg}) as well as the features described in the following subsections.
zh_tw: 每艘船都具有{@item sailing ship||帆船}（參見{@book 城主指南|dmg}第5章的空載和水載載具表）的統計資料，以及與以下小節中描述的特性。

english: Alarms
zh_tw: 警報

english: If intruders are detected or a fight breaks out on one of the ships, the entire crew (one {@creature drow mage} captain, three {@creature drow elite warrior||drow elite warriors}, and seventeen {@creature drow}) mobilizes to combat the threat. The drow prefer to take captives or render enemies {@condition unconscious} rather than kill them. Captives are thrown in the brig ({@area J15|37b}) until Jarlaxle decides what to do with them, and their gear is stowed in the armory ({@area J16|37d}).
zh_tw: 如果入侵者被發現或在其中一艘船上發生戰鬥，整個船員（一名{@creature drow mage||卓爾魔法師}船長，三名{@creature drow elite warrior||卓爾精英武者}和十七名{@creature drow||卓爾}）會動員起來對抗威脅。卓爾族更願意俘虜敵人或使敵人{@condition unconscious||昏迷}，而不是殺死他們。俘虜被扔進禁閉室({@area J15|37b})，直到賈拉索決定如何處理他們，他們的裝備被存放在軍械庫({@area J16|37d})。

english: Ceilings
zh_tw: 天花板

english: Cabins, holds, and passageways have 8-foot-high ceilings with 6-foot-high doorways connecting them.
zh_tw: 船艙、貨艙和通道的天花板高度為8尺，連線它們的門高度為6尺。

english: Doors
zh_tw: 門

english: Unless otherwise noted, doors are made of wood. A door's lock can be picked by a character who makes a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check using thieves' tools, or a door can be forced open by a character who makes a successful {@dc 15} Strength (Athletics) check. A ship's captain has keys to all locked doors aboard his vessel.
zh_tw: 除非特別說明，門通常由木頭製成。角色可以透過使用盜賊工具成功透過一項{@dc 15}敏捷檢定來撬開門鎖，或者透過成功透過一項{@dc 15}力量（運動）檢定來強行開啟門。船長擁有船上所有上鎖門的鑰匙。

english: Elevator Platforms
zh_tw: 電梯平臺

english: Each ship is equipped with an elevator platform that can be lowered and raised with a lever to make loading and unloading cargo easier. When not in use, this platform stays in the lowest cargo hold of each ship. See the descriptions of the cargo holds for more information.
zh_tw: 每艘船都配備了一個可以透過扳動杆來升降的電梯平臺，以方便裝卸貨物。當不使用時，這個平臺會停留在每艘船的最底層貨艙中。更多資訊請參見貨艙的描述。

english: Lighting
zh_tw: 光照

english: Areas belowdecks are brightly lit by hanging lanterns.
zh_tw: 甲板下的區域由懸掛的燈籠提供明亮的照明。

english: Rigging
zh_tw: 索具

english: Rigging can be climbed without an ability check.
zh_tw: 無需屬性檢定即可攀爬索具。

english: Areas of the Ships
zh_tw: 船隻區域

english: The {@i Eyecatcher}, the {@i Heartbreaker}, and the {@i Hellraiser} have the same general configuration and occupants, corresponding to map 7.1. Exceptions are noted in an area's description and on the map.
zh_tw: {@i 奪目號}、{@i 碎心號}和{@i 煽亂號}具有相同的一般配置和居住者，對應於地圖7.1。例外情況在區域描述和地圖上註明。

english: Ships
zh_tw: 船隻

english: Ships, Main Deck (Player Version)
zh_tw: 船隻，主甲板（玩家版本）

english: J1. Main Deck
zh_tw: J1. 主甲板

english: Three sailors ({@creature drow}) and a mate ({@creature drow elite warrior}) are on deck at all times. If the characters board the ship and ask to speak with the captain, the mate asks their business before even thinking about disturbing him.
zh_tw: 三名水手({{@creature drow||卓爾}})和一名大副({{@creature drow elite warrior||卓爾精英武者}})始終在甲板上。如果角色們登上船隻並要求與船長交談，大副會先詢問他們的來意，然後才考慮是否打擾他。

english: Jolly Boats
zh_tw: 小艇

english: Four rowboats are stacked on top of each other on this deck. Ropes and pulleys are used to hoist these boats in and out of the water.
zh_tw: 四艘划艇在這個甲板上堆疊在一起。使用繩索和滑輪將這些小船吊入水中或吊出水面。

english: J2. Storage
zh_tw: J2. 儲藏室

english: The smell of tar permeates this cluttered cabin, which contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個雜亂的小屋充滿了柏油的氣味，包含以下特點：

english: Barrels of tar are secured with nets to the starboard wall below mounted tools.
zh_tw: 右舷牆邊固定著用網固定的瀝青桶，工具安裝在上方。

english: Against the port wall, tight rolls of white canvas are stacked on top of each other and secured with rope.
zh_tw: 左舷牆邊，緊卷的白色帆布堆疊在一起，並用繩子固定。

english: J3. Mates' Cabin
zh_tw: J3. 船員艙

english: This cabin has the following features:
zh_tw: 這間小屋有以下特點：

english: Twin hammocks hang perpendicular to one another. Two off-duty mates ({@creature drow elite warrior||drow elite warriors}) relax in the hammocks.
zh_tw: 兩個吊床彼此垂直懸掛。兩個休息中的高階戰士（{@creature drow elite warrior||卓爾精英武者}）在吊床上放鬆。

english: Three walnut chests sit under the hammocks. The chests are unlocked.
zh_tw: 三個胡桃木箱放在吊床下。箱子是未上鎖的。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Each chest holds two sets of {@item common clothes|phb}, a {@item waterskin|phb} filled with wine, and a pouch containing {@dice 3d6} gp and {@dice 4d10} sp.
zh_tw: 每個箱子裡裝有兩套{@item common clothes|phb|普通服裝}，一個裝滿酒的{@item waterskin|phb|水袋}，以及一個袋子，裡面裝有{@dice 3d6}金幣和{@dice 4d10}銀幣。

english: J4. Crew Cabins
zh_tw: J4. 船員艙室

english: Each of these cabins holds four hammocks. One off-duty sailor ({@creature drow}) rests in each cabin.
zh_tw: 這些艙室每個都裝有四個吊床。每個艙室中都有一個休息中的水手（{@creature drow||卓爾}）在休息。

english: J5. Galley
zh_tw: J5. 廚房

english: Heat and savory scents burst from this cramped cabin, which contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個狹小的艙室充滿了熱氣和誘人的香味，包含以下特點：

english: A busy cook ({@creature commoner}) works a frying pan with one hand and stirs a pot with the other over a small stove.
zh_tw: 一個忙碌的廚師（{@creature commoner||平民}）一隻手拿著煎鍋，另一隻手在小爐子上攪拌著鍋。

english: Dirty dishes are stacked in a washbasin.
zh_tw: 髒碗碟堆在洗手盆裡。

english: A table holds foods in various states of preparation.
zh_tw: 一張桌子上擺放著各種準備階段的食物。

english: The cook is too busy to speak with characters, and is quick to holler in alarm if attacked, drawing the attention of the crew.
zh_tw: 廚師太忙了，沒有時間與角色交談，如果遭到攻擊，他會迅速大聲呼救，引起船員的注意。

english: J6. Pantry
zh_tw: J6. 食品儲藏室

english: Secured to the walls are racks of cooking ingredients, including jars of spices, sacks of flour, and casks of lard.
zh_tw: 固定在牆上的是烹飪原料架，包括裝有香料的罐子、麵粉袋和豬油桶。

english: J7. Dining Cabin
zh_tw: J7. 餐廳艙

english: The crew dines here throughout the day. At any given time, the cabin contains the following:
zh_tw: 船員們整天在這裡用餐。在任何給定時間，艙室包含以下內容：

english: Six sailors ({@creature drow}) are enjoying a meal.
zh_tw: 六名水手（{@creature drow||卓爾}）正在享用一餐。

english: Aboard the {@i Heartbreaker} or the {@i Hellraiser}, the sailors are joined by {@dice 1d4} carnies ({@creature commoner||commoners}). Furnishings include a table, ten stools, and two oak cabinets containing dishes, {@item tankard|PHB|tankards}, and utensils.
zh_tw: 在{@i 碎心號}或{@i 煽亂號}上，水手們加入了{@dice 1d4}名狂歡者（{@creature commoner||平民}）。設施包括一張桌子、十張小凳子和兩個橡木櫥櫃，裡面裝有盤子、{@item tankard|PHB|大杯}和餐具。

english: J8. Forecastle
zh_tw: J8. 前甲板

english: The forecastle is within sight of the sailors on the main deck ({@area J1|364}), the aft castle lower deck ({@area J9|36f}), and the aft castle upper deck ({@area J11|375}).
zh_tw: 前甲板位於主甲板上的水手們（{@area J1|364}）、後甲板下層甲板（{@area J9|36f}）和後甲板上層甲板（{@area J11|375}）的視線範圍內。

english: Figurehead
zh_tw: 船首像

english: A gilded wooden figurehead of a female elf with flowing hair sticks out from the ship's prow, reaching forth with both hands. Since the figurehead is unpainted, there's no way to tell that it depicts a drow, but a character who inspects the figurehead closely and succeeds on a {@dc 13} Wisdom (Perception) check notices a tiny embossed spider on its forehead.
zh_tw: 一個鍍金的女性精靈木製船首像從船頭伸出，雙手向前伸展，長髮飄逸。由於船首像未上色，無法辨別它描繪的是一個卓爾精靈，但仔細觀察船首像並透過{@dc 13}感知（感知）檢定的角色會注意到其額頭上有一個微小的浮雕蜘蛛。

english: A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar magic reveals an aura of illusion magic around the figurehead-the effect that makes every drow aboard the ship appear as a human. A drow's gender, height, and weight are unchanged; the illusion affects only appearance, not voice or mannerisms. Casting {@spell dispel magic} on a disguised drow causes the illusion around it to wink out only for a moment. An {@spell antimagic field} suppresses the figurehead's magic within the field's area. Destroying the figurehead ends the effect throughout the ship. A figurehead has AC 15, 50 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.
zh_tw: 一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似的魔法可以揭示船首像周圍的幻象魔法光環——這種效果使得船上的所有黑暗精靈看起來像人類。黑暗精靈的性別、身高和體重保持不變；幻象隻影響外觀，不影響聲音或舉止。對偽裝的黑暗精靈施放{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}法術會使周圍的幻象暫時消失。一個{@spell antimagic field||反魔法場}法術可以抑制船首像在領域內的魔法。摧毀船首像將在整個船上結束這種效果。船首像的AC為15，有50點生命值，並對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。

english: J9. Aft Castle Lower Deck
zh_tw: J9. 後甲板下層甲板

english: This deck has the following features:
zh_tw: 這層甲板有以下特點：

english: Two sailors ({@creature drow}) are here at all times.
zh_tw: 這裡始終有兩名水手（{@creature drow||卓爾}）在場。

english: Stairs to port and starboard climb to the aft castle upper deck ({@area J11|375}) and the captain's wheel.
zh_tw: 左舷和右舷的樓梯通向後甲板上層甲板（{@area J11|375}）和船長的舵輪。

english: Anchor
zh_tw: 錨

english: The ship's anchor is accessed from this deck. It can be raised or lowered by one creature in 10 rounds (1 minute), by two creatures in 5 rounds, by three creatures in 3 rounds, or by four creatures in 1 round.
zh_tw: 船錨可以透過這層甲板操作。一隻生物可以在10輪（1分鐘）內升起或降下它，兩隻生物可以在5輪內，三隻生物可以在3輪內，四隻生物可以在1輪內完成。

english: J10. Captain's Cabin
zh_tw: J10. 船長艙

english: Regardless of which ship the characters are on, this opulent cabin contains the following features:
zh_tw: 無論角色們在哪艘船上，這個豪華的艙室包含以下特點：

english: Stylish purple drapes cover the large windows that look out over the harbor.
zh_tw: 時尚的紫色窗簾覆蓋著可以俯瞰海港的大窗戶。

english: To one side of a central pillar rests a comfortable bed, its oak headboard carved to resemble a kraken. An oak dining table surrounded by six high-backed chairs rests on the opposite side of the central pillar.
zh_tw: 在中央柱子的一側是一張舒適的床，它的橡木床頭板雕刻成類似克拉肯的形狀。中央柱子的對面放著一張橡木餐桌，周圍環繞著六把高背椅。

english: Other furnishings include a glass-doored cabinet containing shelves of books, a wooden trunk sealed with a padlock, and a small writing desk.
zh_tw: 其他的傢俱包括一個帶有玻璃門的櫥櫃，裡面擺放著書架上的書籍，一個用掛鎖封閉的木製箱子，以及一張小寫字檯。

english: Captain
zh_tw: 船長

english: Each ship's captain ({@creature drow mage}) can usually be found here, with a {@creature nimblewright|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) acting as an attendant and bodyguard.
zh_tw: 每艘船的船長（{@creature drow mage||卓爾魔法師}）通常可以在這裡找到，同時會有一名{@creature nimblewright|WDH|秘偶}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）充當侍從和保鏢。

english: A captain is happy to meet with characters who ask to speak with him, mostly to gauge whether they pose a threat. If the characters are polite, the captain invites them to join him for a meal. If the characters grow tiresome or threatening, he commands them to leave the ship at once, sounding an alarm if they refuse.
zh_tw: 船長很樂意與要求會見他的角色見面，主要是為了判斷他們是否構成威脅。如果角色們表現得禮貌，船長會邀請他們與他共進一餐。如果角色們變得煩人或具有威脅性，他會命令他們立即離開船隻，如果他們拒絕，他會發出警報。

english: Fastened to each captain's belt is a ring holding a number of keys. One key unlocks the trunk in this cabin; other keys unlock any locked doors on the captain's ship.
zh_tw: 每位船長的腰帶上都繫著一個鑰匙環，上面掛著許多鑰匙。其中一把鑰匙可以開啟這間艙室的箱子；其他鑰匙可以開啟船長船上的任何鎖著的門。

english: Book Cabinet
zh_tw: 書櫃

english: Each captain keeps a modest collection of mundane books. Each hides his spellbook in a secret space under the bottom shelf, which can be found with a successful {@dc 14} Wisdom (Perception) check. The spellbook contains the following spells: {@spell cone of cold}, {@spell control water}, {@spell counterspell}, {@spell detect magic}, {@spell fireball}, {@spell fly}, {@spell greater invisibility}, {@spell ice storm}, {@spell mage armor}, {@spell magic missile}, {@spell misty step}, {@spell Rary's telepathic bond}, {@spell sending}, {@spell shield}, {@spell suggestion}, {@spell thunderwave}, {@spell water breathing}, and {@spell web}.
zh_tw: 每位船長都收藏了一些普通的書籍。每位船長都將自己的法術書藏在底架下的一個秘密空間中，只有透過一次成功的 {@dc 14} 感知（感知）檢定才能找到。法術書中包含以下法術：{@spell cone of cold||寒冰錐}, {@spell control water||操控水體}, {@spell counterspell||法術反制}, {@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}, {@spell fireball||火球術}, {@spell fly||飛行術}, {@spell greater invisibility||高等隱形術}, {@spell ice storm||冰風暴}, {@spell mage armor||法師護甲}, {@spell magic missile||魔法飛彈}, {@spell misty step||迷蹤步}, {@spell Rary's telepathic bond||拉瑞心靈聯結}, {@spell sending||短訊術}, {@spell shield||護盾術}, {@spell suggestion||暗示術}, {@spell thunderwave||雷鳴波}, {@spell water breathing||水下呼吸}, 和 {@spell web||蛛網術}。

english: Locked Trunk
zh_tw: 鎖著的箱子

english: A successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check by a character using thieves' tools opens the padlock, or it can be broken off with a successful {@dc 20} Strength (Athletics) check. The trunk contains folded clothes, 250 gp in a sack, {@dice 1d6} pearls (worth 100 gp each) in a silk pouch, a {@item potion of water breathing}, and a bottle of excellent wine (worth 25 gp), bearing a label in the shape of an eye patch and the name "One-Eyed Jax" in Common.
zh_tw: 一個角色使用盜賊工具進行成功的{@dc 20}敏捷檢定可以開啟掛鎖，或者可以用成功的{@dc 20}力量（運動）檢定將其撬開。箱子裡有摺疊的衣服，一個裝有250金幣的袋子，一個絲質小袋中的{@dice 1d6}顆珍珠（每顆價值100金幣），一瓶{@item potion of water breathing||水下呼吸藥水}，以及一瓶優質葡萄酒（價值25金幣），酒瓶上有一個眼罩形狀的標籤和通用語中的名字"獨眼傑克斯"。

english: J11. Aft Castle Upper Deck
zh_tw: J11. 後甲板上層甲板

english: This highest deck of the ship is within sight of the forecastle ({@area J8|36d}), the main deck ({@area J1|364}), and the aft castle lower deck ({@area J9|36f}). It has the following features:
zh_tw: 這艘船最高的甲板位於前甲板（{@area J8|36d}）、主甲板（{@area J1|364}）和後甲板下層甲板（{@area J9|36f}）的視線範圍內。它有以下特點：

english: The ship's wheel stands atop the deck.
zh_tw: 船舵位於甲板的頂部。

english: Two sailors ({@creature drow}) are stationed here at all times.
zh_tw: 這裡始終有兩名水手（{@creature drow||卓爾}）駐守。

english: Wheel
zh_tw: 輪子

english: If the ship is sailing with a full crew, a character who has proficiency with water vehicles can stand at the wheel and steer the vessel.
zh_tw: 如果船隻配備完整的船員出航，一個擅長水上交通工具的角色可以站在舵輪處並駕駛船隻。

english: J12. Upper Cargo Hold
zh_tw: J12. 上層貨艙

english: This hold contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個貨艙包含以下特點：

english: Large grilled doors in the ceiling open to allow goods to be moved to and from this hold using the cargo elevator. A 15-foot-by-10-foot section of floor opens to reveal the lower cargo hold ({@area J17|380} aboard the {@i Eyecatcher} or the {@i Hellraiser}; {@area J19|385} aboard the {@i Heartbreaker}). Crates and barrels stacked to the ceiling are tied down to ensure that they don't move. These containers hold food and water for the crew and the carnies.
zh_tw: 天花板上的大格柵門開啟，允許貨物透過貨物電梯進出這個貨艙。15尺乘10尺的地面部分開啟，露出下層貨艙（在{@i 奪目號}或{@i 煽亂號}上是{@area J17|380}；在{@i 碎心號}上是{@area J19|385}）。堆到天花板的板條箱和桶被固定，確保它們不會移動。這些容器裝有船員和隨行人員的食物和水。

english: Cargo Elevator
zh_tw: 貨物電梯

english: To activate an elevator platform, a creature must stand on the platform and use an action to pull a lever up or down. The platform can't be raised higher than the main deck ({@area J1|364}) or lowered deeper than a ship's lowest cargo hold.
zh_tw: 要啟用電梯平臺，一個生物必須站在平臺上，並使用動作拉桿上下移動。平臺不能升得比主甲板（{@area J1|364}）更高，也不能降得比船的最低貨艙更深。

english: The trapdoor in the floor opens when the cargo elevator is raised. If the platform is raised to {@area J1|364}, the trapdoor remains open until the elevator platform returns to this area or {@area J17|380} (J19 on the {@i Heartbreaker}).
zh_tw: 當地板上的活板門在貨物電梯升起時開啟。如果平臺升到{@area J1|364}，活板門會保持開啟狀態，直到電梯平臺返回該區域或{@area J17|380}（在{@i 碎心號}上為J19）。

english: J13. Head
zh_tw: J13. 船頭

english: The reek of urine fills the cramped head. Privies-each little more than a bench seat with a hole open to the water below-are this room's only features.
zh_tw: 狹小的船頭充滿了尿味。廁所——每個都不過是一張帶有通向下面水體的洞的長凳座位——是這個房間唯一的特點。

english: J14. Carnies' Cabins
zh_tw: J14. 隨行人員艙室

english: Eight narrow cabins are fitted with hammocks, each of which holds a resting carnival performer or worker ({@creature commoner}). Carnies call for help when they are confronted by intruders and fight only in self-defense.
zh_tw: 八個狹窄的艙室配備了吊床，每張吊床上都有一個休息中的嘉年華表演者或工作人員（{@creature commoner||平民}）。當隨行人員遇到入侵者時，他們會呼救，並且只有在自衛時才會戰鬥。

english: J15. Brig
zh_tw: J15. 囚籠

english: A door made of crisscrossing iron bars and fitted with a sturdy lock seals off this cabin, whose only feature is a chamber pot. The captain carries the key to the door. The lock can be picked by a character who makes a successful {@dc 17} Dexterity check using thieves' tools (made with disadvantage from inside the cell). A successful {@dc 23} Strength (Athletics) check forces the door open. The door has AC 19, a damage threshold of 10, 27 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.
zh_tw: 一扇由交錯鐵條製成並配有堅固鎖具的門封住了這間小屋，屋內唯一的設施是一個便桶。船長持有這扇門的鑰匙。使用盜賊工具的角色可以嘗試解鎖，需要成功透過一個 {@dc 17} 的敏捷檢定（在牢房內進行此檢定會受到劣勢影響）。成功透過一個 {@dc 23} 的力量（運動）檢定可以強行開啟這扇門。該門擁有 AC 19，傷害閾值為 10，27 點生命值，並且對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。

english: Jailed Sailor
zh_tw: 被監禁的水手

english: There's a {@chance 25|25 percent chance} that a sailor ({@creature drow}) is being held in the brig after punching a crewmate during an argument.
zh_tw: 在爭吵中打了一個同伴後，有{@chance 25|25%的機率}一名水手（{@creature drow||卓爾}）被關在囚籠裡。

english: Brig Occupant
zh_tw: 囚籠中的囚犯

english: result
zh_tw: 結果

english: A Sailor is here
zh_tw: 這裡有一名水手

english: The cells are empty
zh_tw: 囚籠是空的

english: J16. Armory
zh_tw: J16. 軍械庫

english: The drow store their weapons and armor here while the ship is at sea. If the characters are captured and stripped of their equipment, their nonmagical belongings are stowed here. The cabin has the following features:
zh_tw: 黑暗精靈在船上航行時將他們的武器和盔甲存放在這裡。如果角色們被捕並且被剝奪了裝備，他們的非魔法物品也會被存放在這裡。這個艙室有以下特點：

english: Empty weapon racks and armor hooks line the walls.
zh_tw: 空的武器架和盔甲掛鉤排列在牆上。

english: Stairs lead down into the ship's belly.
zh_tw: 樓梯通向船的腹部。

english: Safe (Eyecatcher Only)
zh_tw: 保險箱（僅奪目號）

english: The armory aboard the {@i Eyecatcher} also features a 750-pound cast iron safe with a combination lock. Jarlaxle and his lieutenants ({@creature Fel'rekt Lafeen|WDH}, {@creature Krebbyg Masq'il'yr|WDH}, and {@creature Soluun Xibrindas|wdh}) know the combination: 1-20-59. A character can pick the lock with a successful {@dc 25} Dexterity (Investigation) check using thieves' tools. Each attempt takes 1 minute. A {@spell knock} spell or similar magic also opens the safe, which contains three pistols, twelve leather packets of smokepowder, three leather pouches containing twenty bullets each, and 250 gp in a sack.
zh_tw: 在{@i 奪目號}號上的軍械庫中，還有一個750磅重的鑄鐵保險箱，配備了密碼鎖。賈拉索和他的副官們（{@creature Fel'rekt Lafeen|WDH|菲爾萊科特·拉菲恩}、{@creature Krebbyg Masq'il'yr|WDH|克雷比格·馬斯奇爾}和{@creature Soluun Xibrindas|wdh|索倫·希布林達斯}）知道密碼：1-20-59。一個角色可以透過一次成功的{@dc 25}敏捷（調查）檢定使用盜賊工具來撬開鎖。每次嘗試耗時1分鐘。一個{@spell knock||敲擊術}法術或類似的魔法也可以開啟保險箱，裡面有三把手槍、十二包皮革包裹的煙霧粉末、三個皮革小袋，每個袋子裝有二十顆子彈，以及一個裝有250金幣的袋子。

english: Stairs
zh_tw: 樓梯

english: The stairs lead to {@area J17|380} on the {@i Eyecatcher} or the {@i Hellraiser}, or to {@area J20|387} on the {@i Heartbreaker}.
zh_tw: 樓梯通向{@i 奪目號}或{@i 煽亂號}上的{@area J17|380}，或者通向{@i 碎心號}上的{@area J20|387}。

english: J17. Lower Cargo Hold
zh_tw: J17. 下層貨艙

english: {@i Eyecatcher and Hellraiser only}
zh_tw: {@i 僅限奪目號和煽亂號}

english: The fantastical floats of the Sea Maidens Faire are broken down and kept in the lower cargo hold of the Hellraiser, while the {@i Eyecatcher} holds pieces of broken and experimental floats. (See {@area J19|385} for a description of the {@i Heartbreaker's} lower cargo hold.)
zh_tw: 海之少女嘉年華的奇幻花車被拆解並儲存在煽亂號的底層貨艙中，而{@i 奪目號}號則存放著破損和實驗性質的花車部件。（關於{@i 碎心號}號底層貨艙的描述，請參見{@area J19|385}。）

english: Cargo Elevator
zh_tw: 貨物電梯

english: If the cargo elevator platform is lowered to this area while creatures are in the 15-foot-by-10-foot space where the platform lands, each of those creatures must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or take 11 ({@dice 2d10}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone} and {@condition restrained} until the platform is raised. A creature that succeeds on its saving throw moves to a space of its choice next to the elevator platform without provoking opportunity attacks.
zh_tw: 如果貨梯平臺在降到這個區域時，有生物位於平臺降落的15尺乘10尺空間內，每個這些生物必須成功透過一次 {@dc 10} 敏捷豁免，否則將受到11 ({@dice 2d10}) 點鈍擊傷害，並被擊倒 {@condition prone||伏地} 和 {@condition restrained||束縛}，直到平臺升起。成功透過豁免的生物可以移動到一個它選擇的與電梯平臺相鄰的空間，且不會引發藉機攻擊。

english: Hellraiser's Hold
zh_tw: 煽亂號的貨艙

english: The hold of the {@i Hellraiser} is mostly cleared out on days when parades are scheduled, except for empty storage trunks. On other days, it contains the following paraphernalia:
zh_tw: 在安排遊行的日子，{@i 煽亂號}的貨艙大部分被清空，除了空的儲物箱。在其他日子裡，它包含以下物品：

english: Various trunks filled with musician, dancer, acrobat, and clown costumes
zh_tw: 裝滿音樂家、舞者、雜技演員和小丑服裝的各種箱子

english: Casks holding confetti, glitter, and body paint
zh_tw: 裝有五彩紙屑、閃粉和人體彩繪顏料的桶

english: Bundles of wooden stilts (4 and 8 feet high)
zh_tw: 成捆的木製高蹺（4尺和8尺高）

english: Papier-mâché beholders mounted atop 10-foot poles
zh_tw: 紙製眼魔模型安裝在10尺高的杆子上

english: A float topped by a life-size mechanical unicorn ridden by a mechanical drow ranger waving two scimitars (when a lever under the float is pulled, the unicorn farts a 15-foot cone of confetti, which it can do twice before needing to be refilled)
zh_tw: 一個頂部裝飾著真人大小的機械獨角獸的彩車，由一個揮舞兩把彎刀的機械黑暗精靈遊俠駕駛（當彩車下面的槓桿被拉動時，獨角獸會放屁形成一個15尺的五彩紙屑錐形區域，它可以這樣做兩次，之後需要重新裝填）

english: A float topped with two mechanical goblins that repeatedly punch each other when wound up
zh_tw: 一個頂部裝飾有兩個機械地精的彩車，當它們被上發條時會反覆互相打拳

english: A float bearing a mechanical armored knight battling a mechanical pit fiend (when wound up, the knight cleaves with its sword while the devil flaps its wings)
zh_tw: 一個裝飾有機械裝甲騎士與機械深獄煉魔戰鬥的彩車（當它被上發條時，騎士揮舞著劍劈砍，而魔鬼則拍打著翅膀）

english: Deflated black, blue, green, red, and white dragon balloons (they float magically when filled with air, and their size is Huge while inflated)
zh_tw: 放氣的黑色、藍色、綠色、紅色和白色龍形氣球（當它們充滿空氣時會神奇地漂浮，充氣時的大小為巨型）

english: An enormous tarrasque puppet for five puppeteers
zh_tw: 一個巨大的泰拉斯奎木偶，供五名木偶操縱者操作

english: Wagon covers decorated with tassels and painted with colorful patterns and creatures
zh_tw: 裝飾有流蘇和彩繪有彩色圖案及生物的貨車篷布

english: Horse and ox harnesses, all brightly decorated
zh_tw: 裝飾鮮豔的馬和牛的挽具

english: Eyecatcher's Hold
zh_tw: 奪目號的貨艙

english: The aft section of the hold of the Eyecatcher is guarded by four giant spiders painted in bright colors. These arachnids have been trained by Jarlaxle since they were hatchlings, and they can pass themselves off as inanimate float decorations by remaining perfectly still until they attack. They aren't hostile toward drow, whose true nature they sense despite the ship's illusion magic. Characters who have a passive Wisdom (Perception) score of 17 or higher realize that the spiders are a threat before the creatures attack.
zh_tw: 奪目號的貨艙後部由四隻被塗上鮮豔顏色的巨大蜘蛛守護。這些蜘蛛自孵化以來就由賈拉索訓練，它們可以透過保持完全靜止來偽裝成無生命的彩車裝飾，直到它們發動攻擊。它們對黑暗精靈沒有敵意，儘管船上有幻象魔法，它們仍能感知到黑暗精靈的真實本性。感知（感知）被動檢定達到17或更高的角色會在這些生物攻擊前意識到蜘蛛是威脅。

english: All sorts of damaged and unfinished attractions are stored here, including the following:
zh_tw: 這裡存放了各種損壞和未完成的景點，包括以下內容：

english: A number of broken clockwork monsters
zh_tw: 一些損壞的發條怪物

english: Half-completed or broken wagon covers and puppets
zh_tw: 半成品或損壞的貨車篷布和木偶

english: A deflated balloon of an oversized flumph that has a small gash in it (a mending cantrip can repair the damage)
zh_tw: 一個放氣的超大型呋嚕氣球，上面有一個小裂口（一個修復戲法可以修復損傷）

english: An undecorated float, topped with an unpainted mechanical gold dragon made of canvas stretched over a wooden frame
zh_tw: 一個未裝飾的彩車，頂部是一個未上漆的機械金龍，由帆布覆蓋在木製框架上

english: Rigged with a glass canister of flammable gas, the mechanical gold dragon is designed to breathe fire when a lever is pulled. Pulling the lever cracks the canister and sets the dragon on fire. If the fire breaks out here and isn't extinguished promptly, it spreads to other parts of the hold after 1 minute. Crew members in other parts of the ship detect smoke 5 minutes later, by which time the hold is a raging inferno. Crew members will focus on saving the submarine (if it's still attached) before abandoning ship.
zh_tw: 這個機械金龍裝置有一個裝有易燃氣體的玻璃罐，設計上是當拉動槓桿時會噴火。拉動槓桿會使罐子破裂並使龍著火。如果火勢在這裡爆發並且沒有及時撲滅，1分鐘後它會蔓延到貨艙的其他部分。船上其他部分的船員5分鐘後會察覺到煙霧，到那時貨艙已經成為一個猛烈的火海。船員們會先專注於拯救潛艇（如果它還連線著），然後才會棄船。

english: J18. Craft Supplies
zh_tw: J18. 工藝用品

english: {@i Eyecatcher and Hellraiser only}
zh_tw: {@i 僅限奪目號和煽亂號}

english: Each of these cabins contains materials used to decorate floats:
zh_tw: 這些艙室中的每一個都包含用於裝飾彩車的材料：

english: Glitter, feathers, fabric, {@item paper (one sheet)|PHB|paper}, scissors, sewing needles, spools of colored thread, and flasks of glue are strewn over small tables.
zh_tw: 閃光粉、羽毛、布料、{@item paper (one sheet)|PHB|紙張}、剪刀、縫紉針、彩色線卷以及膠水瓶散落在小桌子上。

english: Schematics for parade floats are tacked to the walls alongside various tools.
zh_tw: 遊行彩車的圖紙被釘在牆上，旁邊擺放著各種工具。

english: J19. Lower Cargo Hold
zh_tw: J19. 下層貨艙

english: {@i Heartbreaker only}
zh_tw: {@i 僅限碎心號}

english: Beastly odors fill the hold of the {@i Heartbreaker}, becoming stronger as the characters get closer to the creature pens ({@area J20|387}). The hold is mostly empty on parade days. On other days, it contains disassembled wagons (axles, wheels, and cages) that are used to pull exotic creatures through crowded streets. Tools needed to assemble and repair the wagons hang from hooks on the walls.
zh_tw: {@i 碎心號}的貨艙充滿了野獸的氣味，當角色們接近生物圍欄（{@area J20|387}）時，氣味變得更加強烈。在遊行日，貨艙基本上是空的。在其他日子裡，它包含用於拉著異國情調生物穿過擁擠街道的拆卸式貨車（軸、輪子和籠子）。組裝和修理貨車所需的工具掛在牆上的掛鉤上。

english: Cargo Elevator
zh_tw: 貨物電梯

english: If the cargo elevator platform is lowered to this area while creatures are in the 15-foot-by-10-foot space where the platform lands, each of those creatures must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or take 11 ({@dice 2d10}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone} and {@condition restrained} until the platform is raised. A creature that succeeds on its saving throw moves to a space of its choice next to the elevator platform without provoking opportunity attacks.
zh_tw: 如果貨梯平臺在降到這個區域時，有生物位於平臺降落的15尺乘10尺空間內，每個這些生物必須成功透過一次 {@dc 10} 敏捷豁免，否則將受到11 ({@dice 2d10}) 點鈍擊傷害，並被擊倒 {@condition prone||伏地} 和 {@condition restrained||束縛}，直到平臺升起。成功透過豁免的生物可以移動到一個它選擇的與電梯平臺相鄰的空間，且不會引發藉機攻擊。

english: J20. Creature Pens
zh_tw: J20. 生物圍欄

english: {@i Heartbreaker only}
zh_tw: {@i 僅限碎心號}

english: This section of the hold reeks of animal musk and waste. When they're not being paraded through city streets in cage-wagons, the monstrous attractions of the Sea Maidens Faire growl, chortle, stamp, snort, and roar in closed stalls. Two handlers ({@creature commoner||commoners} with proficiency in Animal Handling) walk from stall to stall, carrying buckets of food and speaking softly to the creatures.
zh_tw: 這個貨艙部分充滿了動物的麝香和廢物的氣味。當它們不乘坐籠式貨車在城市街道上游行時，海之少女嘉年華的怪物景點在封閉的圍欄中咆哮、咯咯笑、跺腳、噴鼻息和吼叫。兩名馴獸員（擅長動物馴養的{@creature commoner||平民}）手提食物桶，輕聲對這些生物說話，從一間圍欄走到另一間。

english: Each pen is effectively a cell equipped with a sliding door that can be double-latched from the outside. A wagon assembled in {@area J19|385} can be backed up to any pen. With the pen door open, a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Animal Handling) check then coaxes a caged creature into the back of a wagon. This check is made with advantage if food is given to the creature. If this check fails by 5 or more, the creature escapes, panics, and begins attacking indiscriminately as it tries to win its freedom. Any such ruckus alerts the animal handlers or other crew members if they are nearby.
zh_tw: 每個圍欄實際上是一個配有滑動門的牢房，可以從外部雙重鎖定。在{@area J19|385}組裝的馬車可以倒車到任何圍欄。當圍欄門開啟時，一個成功的{@dc 15}感知（動物馴養）檢定可以誘使籠中的生物進入馬車的後部。如果給生物提供食物，這個檢定將具有優勢。如果檢定失敗且差值達到5或更多，生物將逃脫、恐慌，並開始無差別地攻擊，試圖贏得自由。任何這樣的騷亂都會提醒附近的動物馴養師或其他船員。

english: The following creatures are kept in the twelve pens:
zh_tw: 以下生物被關在十二個圍欄裡：

english: Two {@creature ape||apes}
zh_tw: 兩隻{@creature ape||猿}

english: Four {@creature giant fire beetle||giant fire beetles}
zh_tw: 四隻{@creature giant fire beetle||巨火甲蟲}

english: One {@creature rhinoceros}
zh_tw: 一頭{@creature rhinoceros||犀牛}

english: One {@creature hippogriff}
zh_tw: 一隻{@creature hippogriff||駿鷹}

english: One {@creature tiger}
zh_tw: 一隻{@creature tiger||虎}

english: One {@creature axe beak}
zh_tw: 一隻{@creature axe beak||斧嘴鳥}

english: One {@creature allosaurus}
zh_tw: 一隻{@creature allosaurus||異特龍}

english: Two {@creature death dog||death dogs}
zh_tw: 兩隻{@creature death dog||亡命惡犬}

english: Two {@creature panther||panthers}
zh_tw: 兩隻{@creature panther||豹}

english: One {@creature giant vulture}
zh_tw: 一隻{@creature giant vulture||巨禿鷲}

english: One {@creature owlbear}
zh_tw: 一隻{@creature owlbear||梟熊}

english: One {@creature polar bear}
zh_tw: 一隻{@creature polar bear||白熊}

english: The death dogs and the giant vulture are evil, and the giant vulture can understand Common (though it can't speak). They seize any chance to escape and revel in the suffering of other creatures.
zh_tw: 死亡犬和巨型禿鷲是邪惡的，巨型禿鷲能理解通用語（儘管它不會說）。它們抓住任何逃脫的機會，並在其他生物的痛苦中找到樂趣。

english: J21. Handlers' Cabin
zh_tw: J21. 馴獸師小屋

english: {@i Heartbreaker only}
zh_tw: {@i 僅限碎心號}

english: This cabin contains hammocks for the two handlers who work in {@area J20|387}. If the creatures have been taken on parade, the handlers are asleep in their hammocks.
zh_tw: 這個小屋為在{@area J20|387}工作的兩名馴獸師提供了吊床。如果這些生物被帶去遊行，馴獸師們會在吊床上睡覺。

english: J22. Beast Supplies
zh_tw: J22. 獸類物資

english: {@i Heartbreaker only}
zh_tw: {@i 僅限碎心號}

english: Supplies and food for the creatures in {@area J20|387} are stored here:
zh_tw: 為{@area J20|387}中的生物儲備的物資和食物存放在這裡：

english: Haunches of meat hanging from the ceiling give this cabin a sickly-sweet scent.
zh_tw: 掛在天花板上的大塊肉使這個小屋散發出一種令人作嘔的甜味。

english: {@item shovel|PHB|Shovels}, ropes, chains, {@item bucket|PHB|buckets}, bales of hay, and several large crates are pushed against the walls.
zh_tw: {@item shovel|PHB|鏟子}、繩索、鎖鏈、{@item bucket|PHB|吊桶}、一捆捆乾草以及幾個大箱子被推到了牆邊。

english: The crates hold a variety of lichens, mosses, and fungi that are fed to the herbivorous creatures. A successful {@dc 20} Intelligence (Nature) check identifies the vegetation as native to the Underdark, and the haunches of animal meat as deep rothé—an ox-like creature raised for its meat by drow in the Underdark.
zh_tw: 這些箱子裡裝著各種地衣、苔蘚和真菌，用於餵食草食性生物。成功的 {@dc 20} 智力（自然）檢定可以識別這些植物為幽暗地域的原生物種，而動物肉塊則是深地洛斯獸——一種由幽暗地域的卓爾飼養的類似牛的生物，主要用來提供肉食。

english: J23. Gunslingers' Hold
zh_tw: J23. 槍手據點

english: {@i Heartbreaker and Hellraiser only}
zh_tw: {@i 只有碎心號和煽亂號}

english: No one is allowed down here without the captain's permission, and the guards have orders to kill trespassers on sight. This area contains the following features:
zh_tw: 沒有船長的許可，任何人都不允許進入這裡，守衛們接到命令，發現入侵者立即格殺勿論。這個區域包含以下特點：

english: Two {@creature drow gunslinger|WDH|drow gunslingers} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) stand guard outside {@area J27|390}.
zh_tw: 兩名{@creature drow gunslinger|WDH|卓爾火槍手}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）在{@area J27|390}外站崗。

english: The hold is filled with barrels containing ale and fresh water. The barrels are held down by cargo nets hooked to the floor.
zh_tw: 貨艙裡堆滿了裝有麥芽酒和淡水的木桶。這些木桶被固定在地板上的貨物網固定住。

english: Drow Gunslingers
zh_tw: 卓爾火槍手

english: The drow take cover behind the walls that divide this area as they shoot. They fight to the death to keep intruders from reaching {@area J27|390}.
zh_tw: 黑暗精靈利用分隔這個區域的牆壁作為掩護進行射擊。他們誓死戰鬥，以阻止入侵者接近{@area J27|390}。

english: J24. Cleaning Supplies
zh_tw: J24. 清潔用品

english: These closets hold mops, brushes, {@item bucket|PHB|buckets}, and soap used for scrubbing the decks.
zh_tw: 這些櫃子裡放著拖把、刷子、{@item bucket|PHB|吊桶}和用於擦洗甲板的肥皂。

english: J25. Gunslingers' Cabins
zh_tw: J25. 槍手艙

english: {@i Heartbreaker and Hellraiser only}
zh_tw: {@i 只有碎心號和煽亂號}

english: These two cabins are the quarters of the drow gunslingers in {@area J23|38a}. Each contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這兩個艙室是{@area J23|38a}中卓爾火槍手的住處。每個艙室包含以下特點：

english: A hammock hangs on the wall opposite the door.
zh_tw: 門對面的牆上掛著一個吊床。

english: A wooden mannequin and a walnut chest rest against the wall by the door.
zh_tw: 一個木製人體模型和一個胡桃木箱子靠在門邊的牆上。

english: The mannequins double as armor racks, though no armor currently adorns them.
zh_tw: 人體模型兼作盔甲架，儘管目前沒有盔甲裝飾它們。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Each chest holds two sets of {@item common clothes|phb}, a {@item waterskin|phb} filled with wine, and a pouch containing {@dice 3d6} gp and {@dice 4d10} sp.
zh_tw: 每個箱子裡裝有兩套{@item common clothes|phb|普通服裝}，一個裝滿酒的{@item waterskin|phb|水袋}，以及一個袋子，裡面裝有{@dice 3d6}金幣和{@dice 4d10}銀幣。

english: J26. Lockers
zh_tw: J26. 儲物櫃

english: {@i Heartbreaker and Hellraiser only}
zh_tw: {@i 只有碎心號和煽亂號}

english: Lining this hall are eight closets used as storage lockers by the workers and performers of the Sea Maidens Faire. They contain traveling clothes and outerwear hanging on hooks, as well as boots and shoes.
zh_tw: 沿著這條走廊排列著八個儲物櫃，由海之少女嘉年華的工人和表演者用作儲物櫃。裡面掛著旅行服裝和外套，以及靴子和鞋子。

english: J27. Smokepowder Storage
zh_tw: J27. 煙霧粉儲藏室

english: {@i Heartbreaker and Hellraiser only}
zh_tw: {@i 只有碎心號和煽亂號}

english: The locked door to this forward cabin has a wooden sign nailed to the outside that reads, in Common and Elvish, "RESTRICTED AREA. DO NOT ENTER." The room contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這扇通向前艙的門被鎖上了，門外側釘著一個木牌，上面用通用語和精靈語寫著"限制區域。禁止入內。"這個房間包含以下特點：

english: Twenty wooden kegs are secured to the walls with ropes. Each keg has a paper label, written on which are the words "SMOKEPOWDER! EXPLOSIVE!" in Common and Elvish.
zh_tw: 二十個木桶被繩索固定在牆上。每個桶上都有一個紙標籤，上面用通用語和精靈語寫著"火藥！易爆！"。

english: A shelf above the kegs is lined with wooden boxes.
zh_tw: 桶上方的架子上排列著木盒。

english: Boxes
zh_tw: 箱子

english: Ten wooden boxes on the shelf each contain one hundred pistol bullets.
zh_tw: 架子上的十個木盒子，每個盒子裡都裝有一百發手槍子彈。

english: Kegs
zh_tw: 小桶

english: Each keg holds five pounds of {@item smokepowder|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix A|WDH|11}). When one keg explodes, all other kegs within the area of effect explode as well. If half the kegs explode at once, the blast blows a hole in the forward hull large enough to sink the ship. If all twenty kegs explode at once, the blast blows half the ship to smithereens, shatters windows throughout the Dock Ward, and can be heard as far away as the Field Ward.
zh_tw: 每個桶裝有五磅的{@item smokepowder|WDH|發煙粉}（見{@adventure 附錄A|WDH|11}）。當一個桶爆炸時，所有在影響區域內的其他桶也會隨之爆炸。如果一半的桶同時爆炸，爆炸會在船頭吹出一個足夠大的洞，使船沉沒。如果二十個桶同時爆炸，爆炸會將船的一半炸成碎片，震碎碼頭區的所有窗戶，並且聲音可以傳到遠處的原野區。

english: J28. Walk-in Closets
zh_tw: J28. 步入式衣櫥

english: {@i Eyecatcher only}
zh_tw: {@i 僅限奪目號}

english: The doors to these closets are locked from the outside.
zh_tw: 這些儲物櫃的門從外面被鎖上了。

english: Port Closet
zh_tw: 左舷儲物櫃

english: This closet abuts Jarlaxle's cabin ({@area J30|399}) and contains tailored outfits and cloaks for every season and occasion, as well as towels. Against the back wall stands a wooden mannequin wearing an eye patch. A secret door along one wall can be detected with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check.
zh_tw: 這個衣櫥與賈拉索的艙室（{@area J30|399}）相鄰，裡面存放著為每個季節和場合量身定製的服裝和斗篷，以及毛巾。靠後牆立著一個戴眼罩的木製人體模特。沿著一面牆的秘密門可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 15} 感知（感知）檢定發現。

english: Starboard Closet
zh_tw: 右舷儲物櫃

english: This closet abuts the guest cabin ({@area J29|396}) and contains a half-dozen gowns and two soft fur cloaks on hangers, ladies' hats on hooks, and fancy towels and shoes on shelves. A secret door along one wall can be detected with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check.
zh_tw: 這個櫥櫃緊鄰客艙（{@area J29|396}），裡面掛著六件禮服和兩件柔軟的毛皮斗篷，鉤子上掛著幾頂女帽，架子上放著精美的毛巾和鞋子。如果能成功透過 {@dc 15} 感知（感知）檢定，可以發現一面牆上的秘密門。

english: J29. Guest Cabin
zh_tw: J29. 客房

english: {@i Eyecatcher only}
zh_tw: {@i 僅限奪目號}

english: This richly appointed cabin is set aside for special guests. It contains a large bed, a wooden chest, a freestanding mirror, and a dresser with a lyre atop it. Empty wine bottles roll back and forth across the floor as the ship moves. The bed holds three giggling figures:
zh_tw: 這個裝飾豪華的艙室是為特別嘉賓準備的。它包含一張大床、一個木製箱子、一個獨立式鏡子和一個上面放著里拉琴的梳妝檯。空酒瓶隨著船的移動在地板上滾來滾去。床上躺著三個咯咯笑的身影：

english: {@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), in the guise of Zardoz Zord (absent if he's marshalling the Day of Wonders parade; see "Special Events").
zh_tw: {@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH|賈拉索·班瑞}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），化身為扎多茲·佐德（如果他在組織奇蹟日遊行；見"特別事件"）。

english: Margo Verida, a female Amnian human {@creature bard|VGM} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12})
zh_tw: 瑪戈·維里達，一位女性阿姆尼亞人類{@creature bard|VGM|吟遊詩人}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）

english: Khafeyta Murzan, a female Mulhorandi human {@creature swashbuckler|VGM} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12})
zh_tw: 卡菲塔·穆爾贊，一位女性穆爾霍蘭迪人類{@creature swashbuckler|VGM|風流劍客}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）

english: Margo and Khafeyta both joined the Sea Maidens Faire within the past year-Margo as a lyrist, Khafeyta as an acrobat. Jarlaxle has taken a romantic interest in both women, who are also in love with each other.
zh_tw: 瑪戈和卡菲塔在過去一年裡都加入了海之少女嘉年華——瑪戈作為抒情詩人，卡菲塔作為雜技演員。賈拉索對這兩位女性都產生了浪漫興趣，而這兩人也彼此相愛。

english: Margo and Khafeyta are polite but terse. Both are neutral good. If attacked, they grab their weapons and other belongings and flee through a secret door (see below).
zh_tw: 瑪戈和卡菲塔很有禮貌但言辭簡潔。兩人都是中立善良。如果遭到攻擊，她們會拿起武器和其他物品，並透過一個秘密門逃跑（見下文）。

english: If separated from Jarlaxle and compelled to divulge information about their host, Margo and Khafeyta reveal some or all of the following facts:
zh_tw: 如果與賈拉索分開並被迫透露有關他們主人的資訊，瑪戈和卡菲塔會透露以下一些或全部事實：

english: Zardoz Zord is a drow named Jarlaxle in disguise.
zh_tw: 扎多茲·佐德是一個偽裝成賈拉索的黑暗精靈。

english: Each ship in the Sea Maidens Faire is crewed by drow. The ships' figureheads cast illusions on the drow, making them appear human.
zh_tw: 海之少女嘉年華的每艘船都由黑暗精靈組成船員。船的船首像對黑暗精靈施加幻術，使他們看起來像人類。

english: Jarlaxle wants the Lords' Alliance to recognize his city, Luskan, as a new member, and he wants to push Neverwinter out of the alliance.
zh_tw: 賈拉索希望領主聯盟承認他的城市，路斯坎，為新成員，並希望將無冬城驅逐出聯盟。

english: A year ago, the Sea Maidens Faire visited the island nation of Lantan, where Jarlaxle obtained a Lantanese submarine and several clockwork servants.
zh_tw: 一年前，海之少女嘉年華訪問了島嶼國家蘭檀，在那裡賈拉索獲得了一艘蘭檀潛艇和幾個發條僕人。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: A secret door leading to a walk-in closet ({@area J28|393}) can be found with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check.
zh_tw: 透過一次成功的 {@dc 15} 感知（感知）檢定，可以發現一扇通往步入式衣櫥的密門（{@area J28|393}）。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Margo's lyre is worth 30 gp. An unlocked chest at the foot of the bed holds four sets of costume clothing and a jewelry box containing six gold bracelets (worth 25 gp each), two diamond rings (worth 250 gp each), and a pearl necklace (worth 500 gp).
zh_tw: 瑪戈的里拉琴價值30金幣。床腳的未上鎖箱子裡裝有四套服裝和一隻珠寶盒，珠寶盒內含有六個金手鐲（每個價值25金幣）、兩個鑽戒（每個價值250金幣）以及一條珍珠項鍊（價值500金幣）。

english: J30. Zardoz Zord's Cabin
zh_tw: J30. 扎多茲·佐德的艙室

english: {@i Eyecatcher only}
zh_tw: {@i 僅限奪目號}

english: The doors to this cabin are locked. If anyone other than Jarlaxle turns the handle of either door, a {@spell magic mouth} spell activates and shouts, "By Lolth's teeth, have you no manners?" The sound is loud enough to be heard by Jarlaxle (if he is in {@area J29|396}), and he comes to investigate.
zh_tw: 這間艙室的門被鎖上了。如果除了賈拉索之外的任何人轉動任一扇門的把手，一個{@spell magic mouth||魔嘴術}法術就會被啟用並大聲喊道：'以羅絲的牙齒為誓，你們沒有禮貌嗎？'聲音足夠大，足以讓賈拉索（如果他在{@area J29|396}）聽到，他會過來調查。

english: The room contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間包含以下特點：

english: The sweet smell of lavender permeates the cabin. (The scent is created by magic and can be dispelled.)
zh_tw: 薰衣草的甜美香味瀰漫整個艙室。（這種香味是由魔法創造的，可以被驅散。）

english: A {@creature nimblewright|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) stands in a small alcove next to a chess table. An empty wine bottle on the table is labeled "One-Eyed Jax" in Common.
zh_tw: 一個{@creature nimblewright|WDH|秘偶}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）站在國際象棋桌旁的一個小壁龕裡。桌上的一個空酒瓶用通用語標著"獨眼傑克"。

english: Behind a purple curtain, a bed is covered by a soft blue blanket and matching pillows. Next to the bed is a wooden chest with clawed feet.
zh_tw: 在紫色簾子後面，床被柔軟的藍色毯子和相配的枕頭覆蓋著。床邊有一個有爪形腳的木製箱子。

english: Nimblewright
zh_tw: 秘偶

english: The {@creature nimblewright|wdh} serves Jarlaxle as a servant, and it obeys its master's commands without question. Absent orders, it attacks anyone who discovers the trapdoor in the floor (see below).
zh_tw: 這個{@creature nimblewright|wdh|秘偶}作為僕人服侍賈拉索，它會毫無疑問地服從主人的命令。如果沒有命令，它會攻擊任何發現地板上的陷阱門的人（見下文）。

english: Secret Doors
zh_tw: 暗門

english: Any character who searches the cabin and succeeds on a {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check finds a secret door leading to a walk-in closet ({@area J28|393}) and a secret trapdoor in the floor.
zh_tw: 任何搜查小屋並在 {@dc 15}感知檢定中成功的角色都會發現一扇通往步入式衣櫥的秘密門（{@area J28|393}）以及地板上的一個秘密活板門。

english: The trapdoor has an {@spell arcane lock} spell cast on it, but rapping on it three times suppresses the spell for 1 minute. Alternatively, the trapdoor can be forced open with a successful {@dc 25} Strength (Athletics) check.
zh_tw: 活板門上被施放了{@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖}法術，但敲擊它三次可以壓制該法術1分鐘。另外，透過一次成功的{@dc 25}力量（運動）檢定也可以強行開啟活板門。

english: Below the trapdoor, a metal ladder descends to the bottom of a 10-foot-long, 3-foot-diameter steel tube with a circular metal hatch at the bottom. The hatch is opened by turning its valve wheel, which grants access to {@area U1|3a8} on the {@i Scarlet Marpenoth}. This area is magically pressurized to keep water from entering the ship if the hatch is opened while the submarine isn't docked.
zh_tw: 陷阱門下方，一個金屬梯子向下延伸至一個10尺長、3尺直徑的鋼製管道底部，管道底部有一個圓形金屬艙口。艙口可以透過轉動其閥門輪開啟，這將通往{@i 緋紅瑪佩諾斯}上的{@area U1|3a8}區域。如果潛艇沒有靠岸，這個區域會被魔法加壓以防止水進入船內。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The chess set features jade pieces shaped like drow and is worth 2,500 gp.
zh_tw: 這個國際象棋套裝採用翡翠製成，棋子形狀像黑暗精靈，價值2500金幣。

english: J31. Training Area
zh_tw: J31. 訓練區

english: {@i Eyecatcher only}
zh_tw: {@i 僅限奪目號}

english: Jarlaxle trains here regularly. The space contains the following features:
zh_tw: 賈拉索經常在這裡訓練。這個空間包含以下特點：

english: Ropes are strung throughout the area like webs.
zh_tw: 繩子像蜘蛛網一樣遍佈整個區域。

english: Four rapiers hang from a wooden rack attached to the mast.
zh_tw: 四把刺劍掛在桅杆上的木製架子上。

english: Five beat-up mannequins made of wood, straw, and canvas stand about the room. Each holds a wooden sword and a wooden shield.
zh_tw: 房間裡散佈著五個由木頭、稻草和帆布製成的破舊人體模型。每個模型都拿著一把木劍和一面木盾。

english: A dartboard mounted on one wall has a shiny dagger sticking into it.
zh_tw: 飛鏢靶安裝在一面牆上，上面插著一把閃閃發光的匕首。

english: Attack Mannequins
zh_tw: 攻擊型人體模型

english: As a bonus action, Jarlaxle can command the five magic mannequins to animate and attack a single target of his choice. Each mannequin has the statistics of {@creature animated armor}. Mannequins that take damage become inanimate until Jarlaxle uses another bonus action to reanimate them. A mannequin targeted by a {@spell mending} cantrip regains 1 hit point.
zh_tw: 作為附贈動作，賈拉索可以命令五個魔法模特活化並攻擊他選擇的單一目標。每個模特擁有{@creature animated armor||活化盔甲}的具體數值。受到損傷的模特將變得無生命，直到賈拉索使用另一個附贈動作來重新活化它們。被{@spell mending||修復術}法術咒語目標的模特恢復1點生命值。

english: Dagger
zh_tw: 匕首

english: The dagger in the dartboard is a {@item +1 dagger}.
zh_tw: 飛鏢靶上的匕首是一把{@item +1 dagger||+1 匕首}。

english: Ropes
zh_tw: 繩索

english: The ropes make all parts of this area {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. As part of its movement, a creature can maneuver around the ropes with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity (Acrobatics) check, negating the ropes' effect for that creature until the end of its turn.
zh_tw: 繩索使得該區域的所有部分變為{@quickref difficult terrain||3||困難地形}。作為其移動的一部分，生物可以透過成功的{@dc 15}敏捷（體操）檢定繞過繩索，從而在該生物回合結束前消除繩索對其的影響。

english: J32. Jarlaxle's Sauna
zh_tw: J32. 賈拉索的桑拿室

english: {@i Eyecatcher only}
zh_tw: {@i 僅限奪目號}

english: The door to this room is closed with an exterior hook latch. When the door is opened, clouds of steam billow out from the area beyond. This steam is created magically and can be dispelled with a successful casting of dispel magic ({@dc 14}). The room holds only a wooden bench.
zh_tw: 這扇門被一個外部的鉤鎖鎖住。當門被開啟時，蒸汽的雲霧從門外的區域湧出。這些蒸汽是透過魔法產生的，可以透過成功施放解除魔法（{@dc 14}）來驅散。房間裡只有一張木製長凳。

english: Steam
zh_tw: 蒸汽

english: The steam has no adverse effect for the first hour. For each additional hour spent in this room, a creature must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or gain one level of {@condition exhaustion}. Creatures immune to fire damage automatically succeed on this save.
zh_tw: 蒸汽在第一小時內不會產生不良影響。在這房間內每多待一小時，生物必須成功透過一次 {@dc 11} 體質豁免檢定，否則會獲得一級 {@condition exhaustion||力竭}。對火焰傷害免疫的生物自動透過此檢定。

english: Scarlet Marpenoth
zh_tw: 緋紅瑪佩諾斯

english: Scarlet Marpenoth
zh_tw: 緋紅瑪佩諾斯

english: Jarlaxle's submarine, the {@i Scarlet Marpenoth}, is mounted underneath the {@i Eyecatcher} and can be seen only by creatures under the water. Jarlaxle retreats here if the {@i Eyecatcher} comes under attack.
zh_tw: 賈拉索的潛艇，{@i 緋紅瑪佩諾斯}，安裝在{@i 奪目號}下方，只能被水下的生物看到。如果{@i 奪目號}遭到攻擊，賈拉索會撤退到這裡。

english: Drow Crew
zh_tw: 黑暗精靈船員

english: The magic that conceals the true appearance of drow aboard Jarlaxle's ships doesn't extend to the {@i Scarlet Marpenoth}. Characters who encounter drow while sneaking around the submarine are questioned. If the drow don't get the answers they want, they attack. Any nearby drow who hear a fight break out will investigate and team up to repel boarders.
zh_tw: 隱藏賈拉索船上黑暗精靈真實面貌的魔法並不適用於{@i 緋紅瑪佩諾斯}。當角色在潛艇周圍潛行時遇到黑暗精靈，他們會遭到質問。如果黑暗精靈沒有得到他們想要的答案，他們會發起攻擊。任何附近的黑暗精靈如果聽到打鬥聲將會進行調查，並聯手擊退登船者。

english: Gnome Engineers
zh_tw: 侏儒工程師

english: Rock gnome {@creature engineer|wdh|engineers} maintain and operate the {@i Scarlet Marpenoth}. These gnomes are {@creature apprentice wizard|VGM|apprentice wizards} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), with these changes:
zh_tw: 岩石侏儒{@creature engineer|wdh|工程師}負責維護和操作{@i 緋紅瑪佩諾斯}。這些侏儒是{@creature apprentice wizard|VGM|學徒法師}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），有以下變化：

english: The gnomes are neutral good.
zh_tw: 這些侏儒是中立善良的。

english: They are Small and have 7 ({@dice 2d6}) hit points each.
zh_tw: 它們體型為小型，每個有7點生命值（{@dice 2d6}）。

english: They have these racial traits: They have advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws against magic. Their walking speed is 25 feet. They have darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. They speak Common and Gnomish.
zh_tw: 他們具有以下種族特性：他們在對抗魔法的所有感知、感知和魅力豁免檢定上具有優勢。他們的步行速度是25尺。他們具有60尺範圍內的暗視能力。他們說通用語和侏儒語。

english: The gnomes know a great deal about submarines and very little about everything else. They are treated well by Jarlaxle, but a successful {@dc 15} Charisma (Intimidation) check or a bribe of 100 gp or more can convince a gnome to surrender its master keys, tamper with the engine, or pilot the submarine as the characters direct.
zh_tw: 侏儒們對潛艇瞭解甚深，但對其他事物知之甚少。他們受到了賈拉索的良好對待，但一次成功的{@dc 15}魅力（威嚇）檢定或100金幣及以上的賄賂可以說服一個侏儒交出他的主鑰匙，破壞引擎，或按照角色的指示駕駛潛艇。

english: Submarine Features
zh_tw: 潛艇特點

english: The {@i Scarlet Marpenoth} has AC 20, 300 hit points, a damage threshold of 15, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. The submarine's structural integrity fails when the vessel drops to 0 hit points, whereupon it floods and sinks. The submarine is worth 15,000 gp intact and requires at least one pilot and one engineer to operate. It has a maximum speed of 2 miles per hour and can hold up to 10 passengers plus 2 tons of cargo.
zh_tw: {@i 緋紅瑪佩諾斯}的護甲等級為20，有300點生命值，傷害閾值為15，並對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。當潛艇的生命值降至0點時，其結構完整性會失效，隨後潛艇會進水並沉沒。如果保持完好，潛艇的價值為15000金幣，操作它至少需要一名駕駛員和一名工程師。它的最大速度為每小時2英里，可以搭載多達10名乘客以及2噸貨物。

english: The submarine has the following general features:
zh_tw: 這艘潛艇具有以下一般特點：

english: Interior spaces are unlit. (The drow and the gnomes rely on darkvision to see.)
zh_tw: 內部空間沒有照明。（黑暗精靈和侏儒依靠暗視來觀察。）

english: All furnishings and features are bolted down.
zh_tw: 所有的傢俱和設施都已固定。

english: Chambers are 8 feet high, with 6-foot-high passages and doorways connecting them.
zh_tw: 各個艙室高度為8尺，由6尺高的通道和門道相連。

english: Air magically circulates through a complex ventilation system and small metal grills set into the floors.
zh_tw: 空氣透過一個複雜的通風系統和小金屬格柵魔法迴圈，這些格柵嵌入在地板中。

english: Doors are made of steel and have AC 19, 27 hit points, a damage threshold of 10, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. A door's lock can be picked by a character who makes a successful {@dc 18} Dexterity check using thieves' tools. A door can be forced open by a character who succeeds on a {@dc 25} Strength (Athletics) check. Jarlaxle and the gnomes aboard the {@i Scarlet Marpenoth} have keys to all locked doors. All doors are airtight while closed.
zh_tw: 門由鋼鐵製成，具有 AC 19、27 點生命值、10 點傷害閾值，並且對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。門的鎖可以被使用盜賊工具併成功透過 {@dc 18} 敏捷檢定的人物撬開。門可以被成功透過 {@dc 25} 力量（運動）檢定的人物強行開啟。賈拉索和 {@i 緋紅瑪佩諾斯} 號上的侏儒擁有所有上鎖門的鑰匙。所有門在關閉時都是氣密的。

english: Areas of the Scarlet Marpenoth
zh_tw: 赤紅瑪佩諾斯號的區域

english: The following locations are keyed to map 7.2.
zh_tw: 以下位置對應於地圖7.2上的關鍵點。

english: Scarlet Marpenoth
zh_tw: 緋紅瑪佩諾斯

english: Scarlet Marpenoth, Upper Deck (Player Version)
zh_tw: 赤紅瑪佩諾斯號，上甲板（玩家版本）

english: U1. Entrance Hatch
zh_tw: U1. 入口艙口

english: Characters descending from Zardoz Zord's cabin on the {@i Eyecatcher} ({@area J30|399}) arrive in this chamber. From this side, the circular metal hatch is opened by turning its valve wheel. This area is magically pressurized to keep water from entering the {@i Scarlet Marpenoth} if the hatch is opened while the submarine isn't docked to the {@i Eyecatcher}. But if both the outer hatch and the inner door are opened underwater, the submarine will flood.
zh_tw: 從扎多茲·佐德在{@i 奪目號}({@area J30|399})上的艙室下來的角色會到達這個房間。從這一側，圓形金屬艙口可以透過轉動其閥門輪開啟。這個區域被魔法加壓，以防止水進入{@i 緋紅瑪佩諾斯}，如果潛艇沒有停靠在{@i 奪目號}上就開啟艙口。但如果在水下同時開啟外艙口和內門，潛艇將會進水。

english: U2. Engine Room
zh_tw: U2. 引擎室

english: The door to this area is locked. A plaque on the door reads "ENGINE ROOM" in Common and Gnomish. The room has the following features:
zh_tw: 這個區域的門被鎖上了。門上的牌子用通用語和侏儒語寫著"引擎室"。房間有以下特點：

english: The engine room is filled with machines that hiss, whir, and clatter constantly. A rock gnome named Breena Bafflestone monitors the machinery at all times. Nearby is a copper speaking tube, which enables her to communicate with the control room command center ({@area U7b|3b7}).
zh_tw: 引擎室內充斥著不斷髮出嘶嘶聲、嗡嗡聲和咔嗒聲的機器。一個名叫布麗娜·巴夫爾斯通的巖地侏儒始終監視著這些機械。附近有一個銅製的傳聲管，使她能夠與控制室指揮中心（{@area U7b|3b7}）進行通訊。

english: Drawers in the walls contain screwdrivers, wrenches, and other tools.
zh_tw: 牆壁內的抽屜裡存放著螺絲刀、扳手和其他工具。

english: To port and starboard, 3-foot-high, 2½-foot-wide passageways lead deeper into the machinery. Medium creatures must squeeze to move through these passages.
zh_tw: 在左右舷，3尺高，2½尺寬的通道通向機械的深處。中等體型的生物必須擠過這些通道。

english: Machinery
zh_tw: 機械

english: The engine is a quasi-magical machine that controls the submarine's propulsion and depth and powers the fins and rudder that control direction. A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar magic reveals an aura of transmutation magic throughout the area.
zh_tw: 引擎是一種類似魔法的機器，它控制著潛艇的推進和深度，併為控制方向的鰭和舵提供動力。一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似的魔法揭示了整個區域的變形魔法氣息。

english: A character who has proficiency with tinker's tools can use the tools to disable the engine with a successful {@dc 15} Intelligence check. The same check reactivates the disabled engine. Whether it succeeds or fails, each check represents 10 minutes of work. The engine can also be destroyed. It has AC 16, 50 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.
zh_tw: 一個熟練使用修補匠工具的角色可以使用這些工具，透過成功的 {@dc 15} 智力檢定來禁用引擎。同樣的檢定可以重新啟動被禁用的引擎。無論成功與否，每次檢定代表10分鐘的工作時間。引擎也可以被摧毀。它具有 AC 16、50 點生命值，並且對毒素和精神傷害免疫。

english: U3. Soluun's Stateroom
zh_tw: U3. 索倫的客艙

english: If he has not been encountered and disposed of elsewhere, a {@creature drow gunslinger|WDH} named {@creature Soluun Xibrindas|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) is here, worshiping before a shrine of Lolth. His stateroom has the following features:
zh_tw: 如果之前沒有在其他地方遇到並處理掉他，一個名叫{@creature Soluun Xibrindas|wdh|索倫·希布林達斯}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）的{@creature drow gunslinger|WDH|卓爾火槍手}會在這裡，在洛絲的神龕前祈禱。他的豪華艙室具有以下特點：

english: The port alcove contains a net hammock and a steel footlocker.
zh_tw: 左側凹室裡有一個網狀吊床和一個鋼製儲物箱。

english: A black metal shrine of Lolth covered in tiny spider statuettes stands against one wall. At its top is a sculpture of the demon goddess, with the head and upper body of a female drow and the lower body of a spider.
zh_tw: 一個黑色的洛斯神龕，上面覆蓋著細小的蜘蛛小雕像，靠在一面牆上。在它的頂部是惡魔女神的雕塑，頭部和上半身是女性暗精靈，下半身是蜘蛛。

english: A Lantanese diving suit hangs in the closet to the south.
zh_tw: 一件蘭檀尼斯潛水服掛在南邊的壁櫥裡。

english: Diving Suit
zh_tw: 潛水服

english: This experimental device consists of a pressure-resistant padded suit, made of canvas with iron fittings and iron gauntlets. A fishbowl helmet attaches to the suit's collar and functions as a {@item cap of water breathing}.
zh_tw: 這個實驗裝置包括一套耐壓的墊料服裝，由帆布製成，配有鐵製配件和鐵手套。一個魚缸頭盔連線在服裝的領口上，功能為一個{@item cap of water breathing||水下呼吸帽}。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The shrine weighs 50 pounds and is worth 125 gp as an art object. The footlocker contains a pouch holding 50 gp and a {@item potion of healing}. The potion's crystal flask, shaped like a spider, is worth 25 gp.
zh_tw: 神龕重50磅，作為藝術品價值125金幣。儲物箱內有一個袋子，裝有50金幣，以及一瓶{@item potion of healing||治療藥水}（治療藥水）。藥水的水晶瓶，形狀像蜘蛛，價值25金幣。

english: U4. Jarlaxle's Stateroom
zh_tw: U4. 賈拉索的客艙

english: The door to this tidy cabin is locked. The cabin contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個整潔的小艙室的門是鎖著的。艙室包含以下特點：

english: The scent of lavender magically permeates the cabin. (The scent is created by magic and can be dispelled.)
zh_tw: 薰衣草的香味神奇地瀰漫整個小屋。（這種香味是由魔法創造的，可以被驅散。）

english: A hammock is suspended in the starboard alcove. A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar magic reveals that the wall behind the hammock radiates an aura of transmutation magic.
zh_tw: 一個吊床懸掛在右側凹室。一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似的魔法揭示了吊床後的牆壁散發出變形魔法的氣息。

english: Other furnishings include a tall harp with a stool nearby, a harpsichord with a matching bench, a freestanding mirror, and a large wooden trunk.
zh_tw: 其他的傢俱包括一把高大的豎琴，旁邊有一個凳子，一架大鍵琴配有相應的長凳，一個獨立的鏡子，以及一個大木箱。

english: Closet
zh_tw: 壁櫥

english: The locked closet aft of the cabin contains a wooden rack stocked with sixty bottles of wine. Each one is a rare vintage worth 25 gp.
zh_tw: 位於艙室後面的上鎖的壁櫥內有一個木架，上面擺放著六十瓶葡萄酒。每一瓶都是價值25金幣的稀有陳年佳釀。

english: Magic Window
zh_tw: 魔法窗戶

english: Touching the wall behind the hammock renders the wall transparent from this side, and touching it again makes this "window" go away. When the wall is transparent, creatures in the cabin can see out, but creatures outside the submarine can't see in.
zh_tw: 觸控吊床後面的牆壁會使牆壁從這一側變得透明，再次觸控則會使這個"窗戶"消失。當牆壁透明時，艙室內的生物可以看到外面，但潛艇外的生物則看不到裡面。

english: Wooden Trunk
zh_tw: 木製行李箱

english: The trunk isn't locked. Lifting the lid causes panels in the front and sides to open, releasing a {@creature swarm of mechanical spiders|wdh} that attacks anyone other than Jarlaxle. This swarm has the statistics of a {@creature swarm of spiders||swarm of insects (spiders)}, with these changes:
zh_tw: 箱子沒有上鎖。抬起蓋子會使得前面和側面的面板開啟，釋放出一個機械蜘蛛群{@creature swarm of mechanical spiders|wdh|機械蜘蛛群}，它會攻擊除了賈拉索以外的任何人。這個群集具有{@creature swarm of spiders||蟲群（蜘蛛）}的具體數值，並且有以下變化：

english: The swarm is made up of Tiny constructs.
zh_tw: 這群生物由小型構裝生物組成。

english: It doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.
zh_tw: 它不需要空氣、食物、飲水或睡眠。

english: The swarm has vulnerability to lightning damage, is immune to {@condition exhaustion}, and can't be {@condition charmed}, {@condition frightened}, {@condition paralyzed}, {@condition petrified}, knocked {@condition prone}, or {@condition poisoned}.
zh_tw: 這個群體對閃電傷害易受傷害，對{@condition exhaustion||力竭}免疫，且不能被{@condition charmed||魅惑}、{@condition frightened||恐懼}、{@condition paralyzed||麻痺}、{@condition petrified||石化}、擊倒{@condition prone||伏地}或{@condition poisoned||中毒}。

english: The chest has a secret compartment in the bottom that can be detected and opened with a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom (Perception) check. If Jarlaxle has the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, he keeps it in the secret compartment, along with any magic items he might have claimed from the characters. The compartment is otherwise empty.
zh_tw: 箱子底部有一個秘密隔間，可以透過成功的 {@dc 13} 感知（感知）檢定檢測並開啟。如果賈拉索擁有 {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，他會將其儲存在秘密隔間中，連同他可能從角色那裡獲得的任何魔法物品。否則，隔間是空的。

english: U5. Fel'rekt's Stateroom
zh_tw: U5. 菲爾萊科特的客艙

english: If he has not been encountered and defeated elsewhere, a {@creature drow gunslinger|WDH} named {@creature Fel'rekt Lafeen|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) is here, cleaning his pistol. His stateroom contains a net hammock and a steel footlocker.
zh_tw: 如果角色們尚未在其他地方遇見並擊敗他，一名叫做{@creature Fel'rekt Lafeen|WDH|菲爾萊科特·拉菲恩}的{@creature drow gunslinger|WDH|卓爾火槍手}（見{@adventure 附錄B|WDH|12}）就在此處擦拭手槍。他的艙室裡有一張網狀吊床和一個鋼製床腳箱。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Fel'rekt's footlocker contains 65 gp in a pouch, a comb carved from dragon bone (worth 5 gp), and a pair of obsidian dice (worth 25 gp).
zh_tw: 菲爾萊科特的行李箱裡有一個包含65金幣的小袋，一把由龍骨雕刻的梳子（價值5金幣），以及一對黑曜石骰子（價值25金幣）。

english: U6. Krebbyg's Stateroom
zh_tw: U6. 克雷比格的客艙

english: If he has not been encountered and defeated elsewhere, a {@creature drow gunslinger|WDH} named {@creature Krebbyg Masq'il'yr|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) is here, sharpening his sword. His stateroom contains a net hammock and nothing else.
zh_tw: 如果他沒有在其他地方遇到並被擊敗，一個名為{@creature Krebbyg Masq'il'yr|WDH|克雷比格·馬斯奇爾}的{@creature drow gunslinger|WDH|卓爾火槍手}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）在這裡，正在磨利他的劍。他的客艙裡有一個網狀吊床，除此之外別無他物。

english: U7. Control Room
zh_tw: U7. 控制室

english: The control room has two levels: an observation deck (U7a) and a command center (U7b), with two ladders running between levels. Two circular soundproof windows are embedded in the port and starboard bulkheads. The window panes are made of glassteel, a resilient metal magically rendered transparent. Curious {@creature merfolk} who live in Deepwater Harbor investigate the submarine from time to time, and might be seen peering through the windows.
zh_tw: 控制室有兩層：一個觀察甲板（U7a）和一個指揮中心（U7b），兩層之間有兩架梯子相連。兩個圓形隔音窗戶嵌入在左舷和右舷的艙壁中。窗戶的玻璃是由鋼化玻璃製成的，這是一種經過魔法處理變得透明的彈性金屬。居住在深水港的好奇的{@creature merfolk||人魚}不時地調查這艘潛艇，有時可能會看到他們透過窗戶窺視。

english: U7a. Observation Deck
zh_tw: U7a. 觀察甲板

english: If {@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) is forced to retreat to the submarine, he is here when the characters first arrive. The observation deck is an elevated, 10-foot-high metal platform with a grilled floor, supported by two metal columns. Two padded swivel chairs are bolted to the deck, which is enclosed by a thin steel railing. The height of each chair can be adjusted to accommodate a Small or Medium creature. Between the two chairs is a bronze periscope that can be raised or lowered whenever the submarine is detached from the {@i Eyecatcher}.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH|賈拉索·班瑞}（參見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）被迫撤退到潛艇中，他會在角色初次到達時在此處。觀察甲板是一個抬高的10尺高的金屬平臺，地面有格柵，由兩根金屬柱支撐。甲板上固定了兩把帶襯墊的旋轉椅，由薄鋼欄杆圍住。每把椅子的高度可以調節，以適應小型或中型生物。兩把椅子之間是一個青銅潛望鏡，當潛艇與{@i 奪目號}分離時，可以升高或降低。

english: U7b. Command Center
zh_tw: U7b. 指揮中心

english: Three rock gnome {@creature engineer|wdh|engineers} named Lorella Middenpump, Tervaround Waggletop, and Anverth Leffery are on duty here, along with two {@creature drow elite warrior||drow elite warriors} named Karabal L'enz and Marro Qaz'arrt. The drow guard the control room and keep the gnomes on task.
zh_tw: 三名岩石侏儒{@creature engineer|wdh|工程師}，名為洛雷拉·米登泵(洛蕾拉·米登龐普)、特瓦拉文·瓦格託普(特瓦朗德·瓦格爾托普)和安弗斯·萊弗里(安弗斯·萊弗里)，以及兩名{@creature drow elite warrior||卓爾精英武者}，名為卡拉巴爾·倫茲(卡拉巴爾·倫茲)和馬羅·卡扎特(馬羅·卡扎爾特)，在這裡值班。侏儒們負責控制室的運作，而侏儒則負責監督侏儒們的工作。

english: Lorella sits in the pilot's swivel chair, which is bolted to the floor and can be lowered or raised to accommodate a Small or Medium creature. The chair is situated before a panel of dials, levers, and buttons. Tervaround and Anverth stand by the back wall, monitoring gauges and performing system checks. A copper speaking tube enables them to communicate with Breena Baffle stone in the engine room ({@area U2|3a9}).
zh_tw: 洛瑞拉坐在飛行員的旋轉椅子上，這把椅子固定在地板上，可以降低或升高以適應小型或中型生物。椅子位於一排儀表、操縱桿和按鈕前。特瓦拉德和安弗斯站在後牆旁邊，監控儀表並進行系統檢查。一個銅製傳聲管使他們能夠與引擎室（{@area U2|3a9}）中的布里娜·巴弗斯通溝通。

english: The gnomes can pilot the {@i Scarlet Marpenoth} without needing to make a check. Any other creature must succeed on a {@dc 20} Intelligence check to figure out the controls. From the control panel, the pilot can detach the submarine from the {@i Eyecatcher}, as well as control its speed, direction, and depth. The pilot can electrify the outer hull for 1 minute, after which the system requires 1 hour to recharge. Any creature that comes into contact with or starts its turn in contact with the outer hull when it's electrified must make a {@dc 15} Dexterity check, taking 22 ({@dice 4d10}) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature wearing metal armor has disadvantage on this saving throw.
zh_tw: 侏儒們可以在不需要進行檢定的情況下操控{@i 緋紅瑪佩諾斯}。任何其他生物必須透過一次{@dc 20}的智力檢定才能弄清楚操控方式。透過控制面板，駕駛員可以將潛艇從{@i 奪目號}上分離，並控制其速度、方向和深度。駕駛員可以使外部船體通電1分鐘，之後系統需要1小時來重新充能。任何與通電的外部船體接觸或在接觸外部船體時開始其回合的生物，必須進行一次{@dc 15}的敏捷檢定，檢定失敗時受到22點（{@dice 4d10}）閃電傷害，成功時則受到一半傷害。穿戴金屬盔甲的生物在此豁免檢定中具有劣勢。

english: U8. Engineers' Staterooms
zh_tw: U8. 工程師的客艙

english: Each of these four compartments contains an off-duty rock gnome {@creature engineer|wdh} sleeping in a small hammock, beneath which are two steel footlockers. The four rock gnomes are named Cockaby Fapplestamp, Ellywick Fiddlefen, Gerbo Reese, and Zaffrab Horcusporcus.
zh_tw: 這四個艙室中每個都包含一個下班休息的岩石侏儒{@creature engineer|wdh|工程師}，他睡在一個小吊床上，吊床下面有兩個鋼製儲物箱。這四個岩石侏儒的名字叫科卡比·法普爾斯坦普，艾利維克·菲德爾芬，格爾博·里斯，以及扎夫拉布·霍克斯普魯斯。

english: Footlockers
zh_tw: 腳鎖箱

english: Each footlocker belongs to a particular gnome engineer stationed aboard the {@i Scarlet Marpenoth}. Both contain folded clothes sized for a gnome. One of them also holds a set of grease-stained overalls and a set of tinker's tools that belong to the gnome asleep in the bunk. There is a {@chance 25|25 percent chance} that a footlocker also contains a clockwork toy, a fire starter, or a music box (as described in the "{@race gnome (rock)||Rock Gnome}" section in chapter 2 of the {@book Player's Handbook|phb}).
zh_tw: 每個行李箱都屬於一個特定的侏儒工程師，他們駐紮在{@i 緋紅瑪佩諾斯}上。它們都包含了適合侏儒尺寸的摺疊衣物。其中一個還裝有一套沾滿油汙的工作服和一套屬於睡在鋪位上的侏儒的修補工具。有一個{@chance 25|25%的機率}，一個行李箱還包含一個發條玩具、一個點火器或一個音樂盒（如在{@book 玩家手冊|phb}第二章的{@race gnome (rock)||岩石侏儒}部分中描述的）。

english: U9. Dining Room
zh_tw: U9. 餐廳

english: This room has the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間有以下特點：

english: A walnut dining table is surrounded by eight padded swivel chairs. The height of each chair can be adjusted to accommodate a Small or Medium creature.
zh_tw: 一張胡桃木餐桌周圍有八把帶墊子的旋轉椅子。每把椅子的高度都可以調節，以適應小型或中型生物。

english: Soft, ambient music fills the room, created by magic.
zh_tw: 柔和的環境音樂充滿整個房間，這是由魔法創造的。

english: U10. Galley
zh_tw: U10. 廚房

english: This room has the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間有以下特點：

english: An iron stove sits in one corner.
zh_tw: 一個鐵爐子放在房間的一個角落裡。

english: In the opposite corner stands a steel food preparation table with utensils dangling above it. Built into the table is a lidded steel box attached to a pedal on the floor below. When the pedal is pumped, water and moving brushes scrub dishes and utensils that have been placed into the box.
zh_tw: 在對面的角落裡，有一張鋼製食品準備臺，上面懸掛著一些用具。桌子內建有一個帶蓋的鋼製盒子，下面的地板上連線著一個踏板。當踩下踏板時，水和移動的刷子會清洗放入盒子裡的盤子和用具。

english: A cart holds cutlery and dishes.
zh_tw: 一輛手推車裝有餐具和碟子。

english: U11. Pantry
zh_tw: U11. 食品儲藏室

english: Metal shelves lining the walls hold fresh fruit, vegetables, casks of wine, and meat. Two steel barrels (one containing ale, the other drinking water) stand beneath the shelves.
zh_tw: 牆壁上的金屬架子上擺放著新鮮的水果、蔬菜、酒桶和肉類。兩個鋼桶（一個裝著麥芽酒，另一個裝著飲用水）放在架子下面。

english: U12. Privy
zh_tw: U12. 廁所

english: This privy has a toilet and a washbasin, both attached to pipes. Above the basin is a hinged mirror, behind which is a compartment containing soap and towels.
zh_tw: 這個私室有一個馬桶和一個洗手盆，兩者都連線著管道。洗手盆上方是一個帶鉸鏈的鏡子，鏡子後面是一個隔間，裡面放著肥皂和毛巾。

english: U13. Air System
zh_tw: U13. 空氣系統

english: The door to this area is locked. A plaque on this door reads "AIR SYSTEM" in Common and Gnomish. The room has the following features:
zh_tw: 這個區域的門被鎖上了。門上的牌子用通用語和侏儒語寫著"空氣系統"。房間有以下特點：

english: The area is filled with machines that hiss, whir, and clatter constantly.
zh_tw: 這個區域充滿了不斷髮出嘶嘶聲、嗡嗡聲和咔嗒聲的機器。

english: Drawers in the walls contain screwdrivers, wrenches, and other tools.
zh_tw: 牆壁內的抽屜裡存放著螺絲刀、扳手和其他工具。

english: To port and starboard, 3-foot-high, 2½-foot-wide passageways lead deeper into the machinery. Creatures that are Medium or larger must squeeze to move through these passages.
zh_tw: 在左舷和右舷，3尺高，2½尺寬的通道深入到機器內部。體型為中等或更大的生物必須擠壓才能透過這些通道。

english: Machinery
zh_tw: 機械

english: The quasi-magical machinery in this area generates and circulates fresh air throughout the submarine. A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar magic reveals an aura of conjuration magic throughout the area.
zh_tw: 這個區域的類似魔法的機械產生並在整個潛艇中迴圈新鮮空氣。一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似的魔法揭示了整個區域的咒語魔法氣息。

english: A character who has proficiency with tinker's tools can use them to disable the machinery with a successful {@dc 15} Intelligence check. The same check reactivates the disabled machinery. Whether it succeeds or fails, each check represents 10 minutes of work. The machinery can also be destroyed. It has AC 16, 50 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage.
zh_tw: 一個熟練使用修補工具的角色可以利用它們來禁用機械裝置，成功透過一次 {@dc 15} 智力檢定即可。同樣的檢定可以重新啟動被禁用的機械。無論成功與否，每次檢定都代表 10 分鐘的工作時間。機械裝置也可以被摧毀。它擁有 AC 16，50 點生命值，並且對毒性和心靈傷害免疫。

english: When this machinery shuts down, air stops pumping throughout the vessel. Unless the air system is reactivated, creatures trapped in the submarine that need oxygen to breathe will begin to suffocate after two days (see "Suffocating" in chapter 8 of the {@book Player's Handbook|phb}).
zh_tw: 當這套機械裝置停工時，空氣將停止在船內迴圈。除非空氣系統被重新啟用，否則被困在潛艇中需要氧氣呼吸的生物將在兩天後開始窒息（參見{@book 玩家手冊|phb}第8章的"窒息"）。

english: Special Events
zh_tw: 特殊事件

english: You can use one or more of the following events if the characters take an interest in the Sea Maidens Faire.
zh_tw: 如果角色對海之少女嘉年華感興趣，您可以使用以下一個或多個事件。

english: The Friendly Dragon
zh_tw: 友好的龍

english: In the water ahead, a large shape speeds toward you. As it gets closer, you recognize it as a dragon with bronze-colored scales. Slewing to a stop, the creature gives a toothy grin, then raises a claw in a small wave. "Well met!" it chirps.
zh_tw: 在前方的水中，一個巨大的身形向你快速遊來。隨著它的接近，你認出它是一隻有著青銅色鱗片的龍。它突然停下，露出一個滿是牙齒的微笑，然後抬起一隻爪子輕輕揮動。"幸會！"它尖聲說道。

english: Zelifarn, a {@creature young bronze dragon}, recently moved into Deepwater Harbor. He has spent the past several months scouring wrecks at the bottom of the harbor for treasure and stashing precious baubles in a hidden underwater cave. Recently, he noticed a strange craft mounted on the underside of the {@i Eyecatcher}. His attempts to treat with the crew have met with no success, but he's curious to know more. Since the characters appear to be headed toward a rendezvous with the {@i Eyecatcher}, Zelifarn would like them to find out all they can about the underwater vessel without raising suspicion. The dragon promises to meet them again after they have completed their mission. In exchange for information, he offers to give the party a barnacle-covered chest that he found recently. He hasn't opened it yet, so its contents are unknown to him, but he can smell gold inside.
zh_tw: 澤利法恩（澤利法恩），一隻{@creature young bronze dragon||青年青銅龍}，最近搬進了深水港。他在過去的幾個月裡一直在港口底部搜尋沉船的寶藏，並將珍貴的飾品藏在一個隱蔽的水下洞穴中。最近，他注意到在{@i 奪目號}的底部安裝了一艘奇怪的船隻。他試圖與船員交涉，但未獲成功，不過他對此非常好奇，想要了解更多。由於角色們似乎正前往與{@i 奪目號}的會合地點，澤利法恩希望他們能在不引起懷疑的情況下儘可能地瞭解這艘水下船隻。龍承諾在任務完成後再次與他們見面。作為資訊的交換，他答應給隊伍一個他最近找到的覆蓋著藤壺的箱子。他還沒有開啟它，所以裡面的內容對他來說還是未知的，但他能聞到裡面有黃金的味道。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Zelifarn approaches the characters again as they leave the {@i Eyecatcher}. If they tell him more about the contents of the submarine and he believes that they're being truthful, he gives them the promised reward: an old chest with a rusted lock that can be busted or pried open with a successful {@dc 13} Strength (Athletics) check. It contains 300 sp plus a golden amulet shaped like an octopus with amethyst eyes (worth 250 gp).
zh_tw: 當角色們離開 {@i 奪目號} 時，澤利法恩再次接近他們。如果他們告訴他更多關於潛艇內容的資訊，並且他相信他們說的是實話，他會給予他們承諾的獎勵：一個帶有生鏽鎖的舊箱子，可以透過一次成功的 {@dc 13} 力量（運動）檢定來砸開或撬開。箱子裡有300枚銀幣，以及一個形如章魚、鑲嵌紫水晶眼睛的金色護身符(價值250金幣)。

english: A secret compartment in the chest's lid can be found with a successful {@dc 11} Wisdom (Perception) check. It contains a stoppered wooden scroll tube that holds a {@item spell scroll} of {@spell revivify}.
zh_tw: 成功透過一次 {@dc 11} 感知（感知）檢定可以發現箱蓋上的一個秘密隔間。裡面裝有一個帶塞的木製卷軸筒，裡面放有一張 {@item spell scroll||法術卷軸} 的 {@spell revivify||回生術}。

english: A Night to Remember
zh_tw: 難忘的一夜

english: If the characters stake out the ships of the Sea Maidens Faire, they observe strange activity on the pier during their first night of surveillance:
zh_tw: 如果角色們監視海之少女嘉年華的船隻，在他們監視的第一個晚上，他們會注意到碼頭上奇怪的活動：

english: A thick fog unexpectedly rises along the water, engulfing vessels and docks alike. As the gray miasma thickens, the creaking sound of shifting ships becomes increasingly haunting. Suddenly, you spot three shadows gliding through the gloom like elves slipping through a forest. Where they came from and where they're going, you don't know.
zh_tw: 一場濃霧意外地沿著水面升起，吞沒了船隻和碼頭。隨著灰色的瘴氣越來越濃，船隻移動時發出的吱吱聲變得越來越令人毛骨悚然。突然，你看到三個影子在霧中滑行，就像精靈穿過森林一樣。它們從哪裡來，要到哪裡去，你並不知道。

english: The shadowy figures are the three {@creature drow gunslinger|WDH|drow gunslingers} {@creature Fel'rekt Lafeen|WDH}, {@creature Krebbyg Masq'il'yr|WDH}, and {@creature Soluun Xibrindas|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}). If any of these drow are dead or otherwise indisposed, replace them with drow elite warriors. The drow used the cover of the fog to come ashore in one of the {@i Eyecatcher's} {@item rowboat||rowboats}. The boat is tied off at the end of the pier between the {@i Heartbreaker} and the {@i Hellraiser}.
zh_tw: 這些模糊的身影是三位{@creature drow gunslinger|WDH|卓爾火槍手}：{@creature Fel'rekt Lafeen|WDH|菲爾萊科特·拉菲恩}、{@creature Krebbyg Masq'il'yr|WDH|克雷比格·馬斯奇爾}和{@creature Soluun Xibrindas|wdh|索倫·希布林達斯}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）。如果這些地精中的任何一個已經死亡或因其他原因無法行動，請用地精精英戰士替換他們。地精們利用霧的掩護，乘坐{@i 吸引眼球的}的一艘{@item rowboat||划艇}上岸。小艇系在碼頭的末端，位於{@i 碎心號}和{@i 煽亂號}之間。

english: These Bregan D'aerthe spies are on their way to a secret meeting with {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}). The Open Lord is waiting for them in an alley in the Dock Ward, under the cloak of an {@spell invisibility} spell. She remains {@condition invisible} for the entire meeting.
zh_tw: 這些布雷甘·達耶間諜正前往與{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}的秘密會面（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）。這位公開領主正在碼頭區的一個小巷裡等待他們，身上披著{@spell invisibility||隱形}的效果。她在整個會面期間都保持{@condition invisible||隱形}狀態。

english: Harper spies in Luskan recently warned Laeral that Jarlaxle might be in Waterdeep. She reached out to him with a {@spell sending} spell to arrange this meeting, in the hope of finding out his plans. The characters can follow the drow spies to the rendezvous. If the drow realize they're being followed, they make no effort to shake their pursuers. If they're attacked, they scatter and try to complete their mission before heading back to the {@i Eyecatcher}.
zh_tw: 路斯坎的豎琴手聯盟間諜最近警告萊拉，賈拉索可能在深水城。她用了一個{@spell sending||短訊術}法術與他聯絡，安排這次會議，希望瞭解他的計劃。角色們可以跟蹤地精間諜到達會合點。如果地精意識到被跟蹤，他們不會努力擺脫追蹤者。如果他們遭到攻擊，他們會分散並試圖完成他們的任務，然後再返回{@i 奪目號}。

english: If a battle erupts and escape appears impossible, the drow fight to the death. A City Watch patrol consisting of six {@creature veteran||veterans} arrives {@dice 1d4} minutes later to make arrests.
zh_tw: 如果戰鬥爆發且逃脫似乎不可能，黑暗精靈會戰鬥到死。一支由六名{@creature veteran||老兵}組成的城市守衛巡邏隊將在{@dice 1d4}分鐘後到達進行逮捕。

english: Jarlaxle's Letter
zh_tw: 賈拉索的信

english: One of the Bregan D'aerthe spies carries a letter for Laeral. It bears the wax seal of Luskan and is written in Jarlaxle's elegant hand, in Elvish. It reads as follows:
zh_tw: 其中一名布雷甘·達耶的間諜攜帶著一封給萊拉的信。信上蓋有路斯坎的蠟封，是用賈拉索優雅的手筆，用精靈語書寫的。信的內容如下：

english: To Her Ageless Majesty, {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH}, the Witch-Queen of Stornanter, Lady of the North, She of the Seven Sisters, Chosen of Mystra, and Open Lord of Waterdeep:
zh_tw: 致她永恆的陛下，{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}，斯托南特的女巫女王，北方女士，七姐妹之一，密斯特拉的選民，以及深水城的公開領主：

english: Your spies are to be commended! Rest assured, my presence in your fair city is purely recreational-though if fortune smiles upon me, this visit could benefit us both.
zh_tw: 你的間諜值得稱讚！放心，我在你們美麗的城市的存在純屬娛樂 - 儘管如果幸運眷顧我，這次訪問可能會讓我們雙方都受益。

english: Your predecessor left the City of Splendors in a sorry state, but you have done wonders to lift the spirit of the citizenry during your short time in office. I know how politics offends you, so forgive me for taking this opportunity to point out the obvious. We can make both our cities stronger and strike back at he who robbed Waterdavians of their wealth and dignity. I'm speaking, of course, of that dirty sack of rats, Dagult Neverember. That's the phrase you used to describe him yesterday to the emissary from Mirabar, is it not? Evidently, my spies are also to be commended!
zh_tw: 你的前任讓輝煌之城陷入了一個可悲的狀態，但在你短暫的任期內，你已經奇蹟般地提振了市民的精神。我知道政治讓你感到不快，所以請原諒我藉此機會指出顯而易見的事實。我們可以使我們的兩個城市變得更強大，並且反擊那個剝奪了深水城居民財富和尊嚴的人。我當然指的是那個骯髒的老鼠袋，達格魯特·無燼。這是你昨天對來自米拉巴的使者描述他的話，不是嗎？顯然，我的間諜們也值得稱讚！

english: Why let Neverember get away with his crimes against Luskan and Waterdeep? Can we be allies, if not friends? These are the questions that haunt my dreams, as surely as I haunt yours.
zh_tw: 為何讓無燼爾逃脫他對路斯坎和深水城的罪行？我們能否成為盟友，如果不是朋友的話？這些問題困擾著我的夢境，正如我肯定困擾著你的夢境一樣。

english: Sincerely, J
zh_tw: 真誠地，J

english: Laeral isn't surprised that Jarlaxle lacks the courage to meet her in person. She thanks the drow messengers for delivering the letter, cautions them to mind the City Watch and the City Guard, and heads back to the Palace of Waterdeep. The drow spies return whence they came.
zh_tw: 萊拉並不驚訝賈拉索缺乏親自見她的勇氣。她感謝暗精靈信使送來信件，提醒他們注意城市守衛和城市守衛，並返回深水宮。暗精靈間諜返回他們來時的地方。

english: Conversation with Laeral
zh_tw: 與萊拉的對話

english: If Laeral becomes aware of the characters, she appears before them and asks what business they have with Bregan D'aerthe. If the characters have not met the Open Lord before, she might impress them with her plainspoken manner and lack of pretense. Alone and outside the political maelstrom, she acts more like an adventurer than a city official.
zh_tw: 如果萊拉意識到角色們的存在，她會出現在他們面前，並詢問他們與布雷甘·達耶有什麼業務。如果角色們之前沒有見過公開領主，她可能會以她的坦率方式和缺乏矯揉造作給他們留下深刻印象。獨自一人，遠離政治漩渦，她的行為更像是一個冒險家而不是一個城市官員。

english: If the characters inquire about the letter, she shows it to them and asks their opinions on Luskan's joining the Lords' Alliance. In her mind, Luskan is a greedy pirate state that can't be trusted under any circumstances. If the characters feel similarly, she trusts them enough to ask for their help in finding and securing Lord Neverember's hidden cache of dragons. In exchange, she promises them a 5,000 gp reward and Waterdeep's gratitude.
zh_tw: 如果角色們詢問關於信件的事情，她會展示給他們看，並詢問他們對路斯坎加入領主聯盟的看法。在她看來，路斯坎是一個貪婪的海盜國家，在任何情況下都不可信。如果角色們有類似的感覺，她足夠信任他們，請求他們幫助尋找並確保無燼爾勳爵隱藏的龍金劫。作為交換，她承諾給他們5000金幣的獎勵和深水城的感激之情。

english: {@creature Nat|WDH}, {@creature Jenks|WDH} and {@creature Squiddly|WDH} enjoy a windy autumn day on the docks
zh_tw: {@creature Nat|WDH|納特}、{@creature Jenks|WDH|詹克斯} 和 {@creature Squiddly|WDH|斯奎迪利} 在碼頭上享受一個多風的秋天。

english: Day of Wonders Parade
zh_tw: 奇蹟之日遊行

english: The Day of Wonders is the grandest parade of the fall season, and Jarlaxle wants the Sea Maidens Faire to be a part of it. In the guise of Zardoz Zord, he pays a visit the day before the holiday to the House of Inspired Hands, Waterdeep's temple of Gond, to coordinate with the acolytes in charge of organizing the parade. He presents a detailed plan that commingles the attractions of the Sea Maidens Faire with the bizarre inventions of the temple-a plan that is well received.
zh_tw: 奇蹟日是秋季最盛大的遊行，賈拉索希望海之少女嘉年華能成為其中的一部分。以扎多茲·佐德的身份，他在節日前一天訪問了巧手之屋，即深水城的貢德神廟，與負責組織遊行的祭司們協調。他提出了一個詳細的計劃，將海之少女嘉年華的景點與神廟的奇異發明相結合——這個計劃受到了熱烈歡迎。

english: The evening before the Day of Wonders, workers begin assembling the wagons and floats of the Sea Maidens Faire on the pier. Early the following morning, the docks are a hive of activity as performers practice their routines and caged creatures are offloaded one by one. An hour before highsun on this crisp and windy autumn day, the Sea Maidens Faire makes its way to the House of Inspired Hands to meet up with the Gond worshipers and their contraptions.
