From there, the parade strikes out in earnest, marching through Waterdeep's streets to the cheers of the local folk. Zardoz Zord serves as grand marshal, leading the parade on the back of a rainbow-feathered {@creature diatryma|WDH} summoned using his {@item feather of diatryma summoning|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix A|WDH|11}). For Jarlaxle, the parade is a chance to show off and be cheered; he has no ulterior motive for participating in the event.
zh_tw: 在奇蹟日的前夕，工人們在碼頭上開始組裝海之少女嘉年華的馬車和花車。第二天一大早，碼頭便熱鬧非凡，表演者們練習著他們的節目，籠中的生物被一隻只卸下。在這個清爽多風的秋日高陽前的一個小時，海之少女嘉年華前往巧手之屋與貢德的崇拜者們及其精巧裝置匯合。從那裡，遊行隊伍正式出發，穿過深水城的街道，受到當地居民的歡呼。扎多茲·佐德擔任大元帥，騎著一隻用他的{@item feather of diatryma summoning|WDH|戴翠瑪召喚羽飾}召喚的彩虹羽毛的{@creature diatryma|WDH|不飛鳥}引領遊行（見{@adventure 附錄A|WDH|11}）。對於賈拉索來說，這次遊行是一個炫耀和受到歡呼的機會；他參與此活動並無其他隱秘動機。

english: While the Boss Is Away
zh_tw: 當老闆不在時

english: As the Sea Maidens Faire parades through Waterdeep, the characters can slip aboard one or more of Jarlaxle's ships. If things turn violent aboard a ship, its captain uses a {@spell sending} spell to contact Jarlaxle. Jarlaxle is supremely confident that his crews can overcome any threat, so he doesn't rush to their defense at the first sign of trouble. Only if the characters do considerable damage will he treat their attack as a setback.
zh_tw: 當海之少女嘉年華遊行穿過深水城時，角色們可以悄悄登上賈拉索的一艘或多艘船。如果船上發生暴力事件，其船長會使用一個{@spell sending||短訊術}法術聯絡賈拉索。賈拉索極其自信他的船員能夠克服任何威脅，所以他不會在麻煩的第一個跡象時就匆忙去防禦。只有當角色們造成相當大的損害時，他才會將他們的攻擊視為一個挫折。

english: If the characters escape a confrontation on the ships but leave behind witnesses who can identify them, it takes Bregan D'aerthe several days to track them down (assuming Jarlaxle hasn't already met them). Although killing the characters would be easy at that point, Jarlaxle would rather put them to work for him. He has them watched but doesn't provoke hostilities until such time as the reward clearly outweighs the risks.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在船上逃脫了對抗，但留下了可以識別他們的目擊者，布雷甘·達耶需要幾天時間才能追蹤到他們（假設賈拉索還沒有見過他們）。儘管在那個時候殺死角色們會很容易，但賈拉索更願意讓他們為他工作。他監視著他們，但在獎勵明顯超過風險之前，他不會挑起敵意。

english: Escaped Bear
zh_tw: 逃脫的熊

english: The Sea Maidens Faire parade ends where it started-at the docks. As the attractions are being loaded back onto their ships, the Faire's {@creature polar bear} gets loose, fleeing into the Dock Ward before its handlers can corner it. News of the escaped bear spreads quickly, and sightings are frequent. If the characters impressed one of the drow ship captains, he contacts them by way of a {@spell sending} spell and asks for help. He wants the bear retrieved before the City Guard finds and kills it, offering a reward of either 250 gp or a {@item potion of water breathing}.
zh_tw: 海之少女嘉年華遊行在它開始的地方——碼頭結束了。當景點被重新裝載到他們的船上時，遊行的{@creature polar bear||白熊}逃脫了，在它的馴獸員能夠圍住它之前逃進了碼頭區。逃跑的熊的訊息迅速傳播開來，目擊事件頻繁發生。如果角色們給其中一個暗精靈船長留下了深刻印象，他會透過一個{@spell sending||短訊術}法術聯絡他們並請求幫助。他希望在城防軍發現並殺死熊之前將其找回，提供250金幣或一瓶{@item potion of water breathing||水下呼吸藥水}作為獎勵。

english: The characters can track and corner the polar bear with a successful {@dc 16} Intelligence (Investigation) or Wisdom (Survival) check. Whether a check succeeds or fails, each attempt represents 1 hour of searching. If the characters find the bear within 4 hours, it can be lured back to the Sea Maidens Faire with food or a successful {@dc 14} Wisdom (Animal Handling) check. The captain then makes good on the promised reward. If the characters don't find the bear, members of the City Guard get to it first and kill it.
zh_tw: 角色們可以透過成功的 {@dc 16} 智力（調查）或感知（求生）檢定來追蹤並圍堵北極熊。無論檢定成功或失敗，每次嘗試都代表1小時的搜尋時間。如果角色們在4小時內找到北極熊，可以使用食物或成功的 {@dc 14} 感知（動物馴養）檢定將其引誘回"海之少女嘉年華"。隨後，船長會兌現承諾的獎勵。如果角色們沒有找到北極熊，城防軍的成員會先找到並殺死它。

english: Chapter 8: Winter Wizardry
zh_tw: 第8章：冬季魔法

english: {@creature Manshoon|WDH} yearns to rule Waterdeep as a tyrant, take over the Zhentarim, and use both seats of power to plunder and control the Sword Coast. He needs the gold in the Vault of Dragons to pay off Masked Lords and Zhentarim leaders whose support will be instrumental when the time comes to oust Lady {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH} as Open Lord. {@creature Manshoon|WDH} has a long list of powerful enemies, among them the Harpers, Elminster of Shadowdale, Halaster Blackcloak of Undermountain, and the Blackstaff of Waterdeep. These enemies would quickly move against {@creature Manshoon|WDH} if they learned he was hiding in Waterdeep. For his evil plans to succeed, {@creature Manshoon|WDH} must operate in the shadows for the time being.
zh_tw: {@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}渴望作為暴君統治深水城，掌控散塔林會，並利用這兩個權力位置來掠奪和控制劍灣。他需要龍之寶庫中的黃金來收買那些在時機成熟時推翻{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}作為公開領主的蒙面領主和散塔林會領袖。{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}有一長串強大的敵人，其中包括豎琴手聯盟、陰影谷的伊爾明斯特、地脈迷城的海拉斯特·黑斗篷以及深水城的黑杖。這些敵人如果得知{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}潛藏在深水城，將立即採取行動對付他。為了實現他的邪惡計劃，{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}目前必須隱藏在暗處。

english: Facing Manshoon
zh_tw: 面對曼松

english: A head-on battle with {@creature Manshoon|WDH} isn't likely to go well for the characters. That said, the wizard's greatest weakness is that he has powerful enemies in Waterdeep. The risk of exposure keeps him hidden, and the characters can thwart him by furnishing his enemies with proof that he's alive (after a fashion) and operating in Waterdeep. When it comes to {@creature Manshoon|WDH} clones, deciding to "let the city deal with it" is a wise course of action.
zh_tw: 與{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}正面交鋒對角色們來說不太可能有好結果。話雖如此，這位法師的最大弱點是他有強大的敵人在深水城。暴露的風險使他隱藏起來，角色們可以透過向他的敵人提供證據，證明他活著（以某種方式）並在深水城活動，來挫敗他。當涉及到{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}克隆體時，選擇"讓城市處理它"是一個明智的行動方針。

english: If the characters find themselves at the evil wizard's mercy, {@creature Manshoon|WDH} will gladly trade their pitiful lives for the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} and the keys to unlock the Vault of Dragons. In exchange for helping him get the gold, he promises the characters 10 percent of the trove (50,000 gp). {@creature Manshoon|WDH} has no intention of honoring this agreement, but it can help buy the characters some time.
zh_tw: 如果角色們發現自己處於邪惡法師的憐憫之下，{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}將非常樂意用他們的可憐生命交換{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}以及開啟龍之寶庫的鑰匙。作為幫助他獲得黃金的交換，他承諾給角色們寶藏的10%（50000金幣）。{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}無意履行這一協議，但這可以幫助角色們爭取一些時間。

english: If the characters manage to kill {@creature Manshoon|WDH} and the local authorities are made aware of the act, no murder charges are filed. Rather, the characters' actions are celebrated. {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH} summons them to the Palace of Waterdeep to thank them officially, in her capacity as Open Lord. Sometime later, {@creature Vajra Safahr|WDH} invites them to Blackstaff Tower to thank them for their service and offer them membership in Force Grey.
zh_tw: 如果角色們設法殺死{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}，並且當地當局得知了這一行為，不會有謀殺指控被提起。相反，角色們的行動將被慶祝。{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}以公開領主的身份，召喚他們到深水宮正式感謝他們。過了一段時間，{@creature Vajra Safahr|WDH|瓦婕拉·莎法爾}邀請他們到黑杖塔感謝他們的服務，並邀請他們加入灰色力量團隊。

english: Disrupting Manshoon's Operation
zh_tw: 打亂曼松的行動

english: Characters can hinder {@creature Manshoon|WDH} in the following ways.
zh_tw: 角色可以透過以下方式阻礙{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}。

english: Release the Barlgura
zh_tw: 釋放惡猿魔

english: If the characters free the barlgura demon in {@area K15|3fc} and allow it to roam Kolat Towers, {@creature Manshoon|WDH} loses many followers to the demon's rampage.
zh_tw: 如果角色們在 {@area K15|3fc} 釋放了巴洛戈魔並允許它在克拉特雙塔內遊蕩，{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松} 的許多追隨者將在這場惡魔的暴行中喪生。

english: Report Manshoon
zh_tw: 舉報曼松

english: Delivering proof that {@creature Manshoon|WDH} is hiding in Waterdeep to {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH}, {@creature Mirt|WDH}, the Harpers, Force Grey, the Blackstaff, the Lords' Alliance, the Order of the Gauntlet, the City Watch, or the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors triggers a far-reaching effort to oust him from the city. Such proof can be obtained from any of {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s lieutenants, who can be captured and turned over for interrogation. These lieutenants include Sidra Romeir ({@area K2|3db}), {@creature Manafret Cherryport|wdh} ({@area K3|3de}), {@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh} ({@area E5|41d}), Vevette Blackwater and Agorn Fuoco ({@area E8|425}), and {@creature Zhent Martial Arts Adept|wdh|Havia Quickknife} and {@creature Zhent Martial Arts Adept|wdh|Mookie Plush} ({@area E10|42a}).
zh_tw: 向{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}、{@creature Mirt|WDH|米爾特}、豎琴手聯盟、灰色力量、黑杖、領主聯盟、鐵手套教團、城市守衛或警戒法師與護衛教團提供{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}藏身於深水城的證據，將引發一場旨在將其驅逐出城的廣泛行動。這些證據可以從{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的任何副官處獲得，他們可以被捕獲並交予審訊。這些副官包括希德拉·羅梅爾（{@area K2|3db}）、{@creature Manafret Cherryport|wdh|馬納弗雷特·切裡波特}（{@area K3|3de}）、{@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh|厄斯圖爾·弗洛克辛}（{@area E5|41d}）、薇薇特·黑水和阿戈恩·弗奧科（{@area E8|425}）以及{@creature Zhent Martial Arts Adept|wdh|哈維亞·快刀}和{@creature Zhent Martial Arts Adept|wdh|穆基·普拉什}（{@area E10|42a}）。

english: The ledger in {@area E13|430} also contains proof of {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s malfeasance. Giving it to {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH}, {@creature Vajra Safahr|WDH}, {@creature Mirt|WDH}, or a magister provides enough evidence for them to act on.
zh_tw: 位於{@area E13|430}的賬簿中還包含了{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}瀆職的證據。將其交給{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}、{@creature Vajra Safahr|WDH|瓦婕拉·莎法爾}、{@creature Mirt|WDH|米爾特}或一名治安官，將為他們提供足夠的證據來採取行動。

english: Once {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s whereabouts are established, the City Guard cordons off and surrounds Kolat Towers. The Blackstaff and the Watchful Order assist as needed. If the characters deactivated the force field, the siege is brief and {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s forces are routed. If the force field remains in place, the Watchful Order can deactivate it.
zh_tw: 一旦確定了{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的行蹤，城防軍就會封鎖並包圍克拉特雙塔。黑杖和警戒法師與護衛教團會根據需要提供協助。如果角色們停用了力場，圍攻將是短暫的，{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的勢力將被擊潰。如果力場仍然存在，警戒法師與護衛教團可以將其停用。

english: When all is said and done, {@creature Manshoon|WDH} is forced to retreat to his extradimensional sanctum. From there, he continues his search for the Vault of Dragons while fending off attackers.
zh_tw: 當一切都說完了，{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}被迫退回到他的超維避難所。從那裡，他繼續尋找龍之寶庫，同時抵禦攻擊者。

english: Steal Manshoon's Spellbook
zh_tw: 偷取曼松的魔法書

english: Stealing the spellbook from {@area E13|430} causes {@creature Manshoon|WDH} to slow his search for the Vault of Dragons while he either tries to replace it or sends a simulacrum (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) and other forces to retrieve it.
zh_tw: 從{@area E13|430}偷走法術書會導致{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}在尋找龍之寶庫的同時放慢速度，因為他要麼試圖替換它，要麼派出一個模擬像（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）和其他力量來取回它。

english: Kolat Towers
zh_tw: 克拉特雙塔

english: This dilapidated, two-towered edifice stands tall in the Southern Ward. Its neighbors are aware of the magical force field that surrounds it, and they can see light from {@spell continual flame} spells spilling out of the windows. Despite these persistent magical effects, most folk believe the structure is abandoned. Others think it's haunted by the ghosts of the Kolat brothers. They're wrong, of course.
zh_tw: 這座破敗不堪的雙塔建築矗立在南區。它的鄰居們知道有魔法力場包圍著它，他們可以看到來自{@spell continual flame||不滅明焰}法術的光線從窗戶中溢位。儘管有這些持續的魔法效果，大多數人認為這座建築被廢棄了。其他人認為它被克拉特兄弟的鬼魂所困擾。當然，他們錯了。

english: {@creature Manshoon|WDH} posts no visible guards outside Kolat Towers, since he wants others to believe the site is abandoned. The evil wizard and his underlings come and go using teleportation circles inside the towers.
zh_tw: {@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}在克拉特雙塔外沒有設定可見的守衛，因為他希望其他人相信這個地方被廢棄了。這位邪惡的法師和他的下屬使用塔內的傳送法陣進出。

english: Force Field
zh_tw: 防禦力場

english: An invisible field of magical force surrounds and covers Kolat Towers. The field is paper-thin and stands just outside the outer wall of the estate, extending upward to contain the buildings in their entirety. Nothing can pass through the barrier, including air, fog, rain, and snow. Creatures that don't realize the field is there bounce off it, with birds especially prone to striking it. The ground outside the field is regularly littered with the tiny corpses of birds that broke their necks hitting it, and street cleaners come by every morning to sweep them up.
zh_tw: 一個看不見的魔法力場環繞並覆蓋了克拉特雙塔。這個力場薄如紙，位於莊園外牆的外側，向上延伸以完全包含建築物。任何東西都不能穿過這個屏障，包括空氣、霧、雨和雪。那些沒有意識到力場存在的生物會反彈回來，特別是鳥類更容易撞上它。力場外的地面經常散落著因撞擊而折斷脖子的小鳥的屍體，街頭清潔工每天早上都會來清掃它們。

english: Digging under the Force Field
zh_tw: 在力場下挖掘

english: There are no openings in the force field, which extends 1 foot underground. It takes 1 hour for a character with a shovel to dig a hole deep enough for a Medium creature to squeeze through, going under the field to the other side of the towers' outer wall. Since Kolat Towers is surrounded by other buildings, there's a {@chance 75|75 percent chance} that any digging attracts {@dice 2d6} members of the City Watch ({@creature veteran||veterans}), who put a stop to it.
zh_tw: 力場沒有開口，且向地下延伸1尺。一名角色用鏟子挖掘一個足夠中型生物擠過的洞需要1小時，從而從力場下方穿過，進入高塔外牆的另一側。由於克拉特雙塔周圍有其他建築物，挖掘有{@chance 75|75%的機率}吸引{@dice 2d6}名城市守衛（{@creature veteran||老兵}）前來制止。

english: Using Magic to Bypass the Force Field
zh_tw: 使用魔法繞過力場

english: Characters can use magic such as a {@spell dimension door} or {@spell misty step} spell to teleport from one side of the force field to the other. A {@spell disintegrate} spell or a successful {@spell dispel magic} ({@dc 19}) spell cast at the field creates a 10-foot-square opening that lasts for 1 minute.
zh_tw: 角色可以使用諸如{@spell dimension door||任意門}或{@spell misty step||迷蹤步}這樣的法術來從力場的一側傳送到另一側。{@spell disintegrate||解離術}法術或在力場上成功施放的{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}（{@dc 19}）會創造一個持續1分鐘的10尺見方的開口。

english: Destroying the Force Field
zh_tw: 摧毀力場

english: A magic rune in {@area K18|403} generates the force field. Destroying that rune ends the effect.
zh_tw: 在{@area K18|403}的魔法符文產生力場。摧毀那個符文將結束這個效果。

english: Kolat Towers Features
zh_tw: 克拉特雙塔特點

english: The following general features apply to Kolat Towers:
zh_tw: 以下一般特點適用於克拉特雙塔：

english: Kolat Towers is a multistory structure, with each level standing 20 feet higher than the one below it. Its rooms have 15-foot-high ceilings, with 7-foot-high doorways connecting them.
zh_tw: 克拉特雙塔是一座多層結構，每層比下面的一層高出20尺。它的房間有15尺高的天花板，7尺高的門道連線著它們。

english: Climbing the outside walls without equipment requires a successful {@dc 15} Strength (Athletics) check.
zh_tw: 在沒有裝備的情況下攀爬外牆需要進行一次成功的 {@dc 15} 力量（運動）檢定。

english: Each of the doors in the towers, as well as the door in the outer wall, is made of iron-bound oak and has AC 16, 27 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. If a door is locked, it can be picked by a character who makes a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check using thieves' tools, or it can be forced open with a successful {@dc 20} Strength (Athletics) check. {@creature Manshoon|WDH}, {@creature Manafret Cherryport|wdh}, and {@creature Zhent Martial Arts Adept|wdh|Havia Quickknife} have keys to the locked doors.
zh_tw: 塔樓中的每一扇門，以及外牆上的門，都是由鐵皮包裹的橡木製成，具有AC 16，27點生命值，並且對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。如果一扇門被鎖上，角色可以透過使用盜賊工具成功透過{@dc 15}敏捷檢定來撬開它，或者透過成功進行{@dc 20}力量（運動）檢定來強行開啟。{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}、{@creature Manafret Cherryport|wdh|馬納弗雷特·切裡波特}和{@creature Zhent Martial Arts Adept|wdh|哈維亞·快刀}持有被鎖門的鑰匙。

english: Windows have leaded frames and dirty glass panes. They are latched from within and swing inward on iron hinges. A successful {@dc 11} Dexterity check using thieves' tools opens a window from the outside.
zh_tw: 窗戶裝有鉛製框架和骯髒的玻璃窗格。它們從內部閂上，並在鐵鉸鏈上向內擺動。成功使用盜賊工具進行一個 {@dc 11} 的敏捷檢定可以從外部開啟一扇窗戶。

english: Unless otherwise noted, all areas are brightly lit by {@spell continual flame} spells cast on wall sconces.
zh_tw: 除非另有說明，所有區域都由施放在壁燈上的{@spell continual flame||不滅明焰}法術明亮地照亮。

english: Some of the staircases in Kolat Towers are invisible. They are revealed by a {@spell see invisibility} spell or similar magic. A creature traversing stairs it can't see can move on the steps at half speed without any problem. A creature that moves any faster than half speed must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity (Acrobatics) check or slip, tumble down the stairs, and fall {@condition prone} at the bottom of them.
zh_tw: 克拉特雙塔中的一些樓梯是隱形的。它們可以透過{@spell see invisibility||識破隱形}法術或類似的魔法顯現出來。一個看不見樓梯的生物可以在梯級上以半速移動而沒有任何問題。一個移動速度快於半速的生物必須成功進行一次{@dc 10}敏捷（體操）檢定，否則會滑倒，從樓梯上滾下來，並在底部{@condition prone||伏地}。

english: Kolat Towers Lore
zh_tw: 克拉特雙塔傳說

english: With a successful {@dc 15} Intelligence (History) check, a character can recall the following information about Kolat Towers. An NPC familiar with Waterdeep's history, such as {@creature Mirt|WDH} or Volo, can also provide this information.
zh_tw: 當角色成功透過一次 {@dc 15} 智力（歷史）檢定，可以回憶起以下關於克拉特雙塔的資訊。熟悉深水城歷史的 NPC，例如 {@creature Mirt|WDH|米爾特} 或瓦羅，也可以提供這些資訊。

english: Kolat Towers once belonged to two eccentric brothers, Duhlark and Alcedor Kolat. Both were wizards.
zh_tw: 克拉特雙塔曾經屬於兩位古怪的兄弟，杜拉克和阿爾塞多·克拉特。他們都是法師。

english: Over time, the brothers discovered new ways to harness magic, but Duhlark became paranoid that others might steal their secrets. He encased Kolat Towers in a magical force field.
zh_tw: 隨著時間的推移，兄弟倆發現了利用魔法的新方法，但杜拉克變得偏執，擔心其他人可能會竊取他們的秘密。他用魔法力場將克拉特雙塔包裹起來。

english: Duhlark's paranoia continued to grow, until he suspected Alcedor of selling their secrets. Alcedor left the towers, never to be heard from again, and Duhlark became a recluse who died in his own fortress.
zh_tw: 杜拉克的偏執不斷增長，直到他懷疑阿爾塞多出賣了他們的秘密。阿爾塞多離開了塔樓，從此杳無音信，而杜拉克成為了一個隱居者，最終在自己的堡壘中去世。

english: Areas of Kolat Towers
zh_tw: 克拉特雙塔區域

english: The following encounter locations are keyed to map 8.1.
zh_tw: 以下遭遇地點對應於地圖8.1。

english: Kolat Towers
zh_tw: 克拉特雙塔

english: Kolat Towers, Level 1 (Player Version)
zh_tw: 克拉特雙塔，第一層（玩家版本）

english: K1. Storeroom
zh_tw: K1. 儲藏室

english: The outer door is locked from the inside, and the room has neither heat nor light sources. Crates stacked around the room are packed with meat, and bear the seal of the Fellowship of Salters, Packers, and Joiners.
zh_tw: 外門從內部鎖上，房間內既沒有暖氣也沒有光源。房間周圍堆放的板條箱裝滿了肉，上面印有鹽商、打包工和聯工團的印章。

english: K2. Dining Room
zh_tw: K2. 餐廳

english: This room contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間包含以下特點：

english: Three Zhents in black armor sit around a stone dining table, playing Three-Dragon Ante (a card game). The table is set with silver.
zh_tw: 三名穿著黑色盔甲的散塔林會人圍坐在一張石制餐桌旁，玩著三龍前奏（一種紙牌遊戲）。餐桌上擺放著銀器。

english: Eight moth-eaten banners hang from the walls. Each bears an arcane sigil that represents a different one of the eight schools of magic.
zh_tw: 八面被蟲蛀的橫幅懸掛在牆上。每個橫幅上都有一個代表八種不同魔法學派的神秘符號。

english: Zhents
zh_tw: 散塔林會成員

english: The card players are Sidra Romeir (LE female Calishite human {@creature veteran}) and two subordinates (LE male Tethyrian human {@creature thug||thugs}). Since the force field around Kolat Towers keeps out riffraff, Sidra assumes the characters are guests of {@creature Manshoon|WDH} arriving for a clandestine meeting. If the characters give her no reason to believe otherwise, she and her thugs escort them wherever they ask to go. If it becomes clear that the characters don't belong in the towers, Sidra and her thugs attack. Combat in this area draws the attention of {@creature Manafret Cherryport|wdh} in {@area K3|3de}, who investigates.
zh_tw: 玩牌的人是希德拉·羅梅爾（LE女性卡利什人類{@creature veteran||老兵}）和兩個下屬（LE男性特提裡安人類{@creature thug||暴徒}）。由於克拉特雙塔周圍的力場阻擋了閒雜人等，希德拉認為角色們是{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的秘密會議的客人。如果角色們沒有給她理由讓她相信不是這樣，她和她的暴徒們會護送他們去他們想去的任何地方。如果很明顯角色們不屬於塔樓，希德拉和她的暴徒們會發起攻擊。這個區域的戰鬥會引起{@area K3|3de}中{@creature Manafret Cherryport|wdh|馬納弗雷特·切裡波特}的注意，他會來調查。

english: Sidra wears a {@item teleporter ring|WDH} (see "Teleporter Rings").
zh_tw: 希德拉佩戴著一枚{@item teleporter ring|WDH|傳送戒指}（見"傳送戒指"）。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Silverware on the table is worth 100 gp.
zh_tw: 桌上的銀器價值100金幣。

english: K3. Kitchen
zh_tw: K3. 廚房

english: Mouthwatering scents fill this room, which contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間充滿了令人垂涎的香氣，包含以下特點：

english: If he hasn't already been drawn elsewhere, a portly halfling stands atop a stool and cooks at an iron stove.
zh_tw: 如果他還沒有被吸引到其他地方，一個胖乎乎的半身人站在凳子上，在鐵爐上烹飪。

english: A green, ghostly hand floats above a trellis table, holding a knife and cutting carrots and celery.
zh_tw: 一隻綠色的幽靈手漂浮在格子桌上方，握著一把刀切著胡蘿蔔和芹菜。

english: A staircase curves up one wall, leading to {@area K7|3ea}.
zh_tw: 一段樓梯沿著一面牆盤旋而上，通向{@area K7|3ea}。

english: Zhent Cook
zh_tw: 散塔林會成員廚師

english: The halfling, {@creature Manafret Cherryport|wdh}, is one of {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s lieutenants. He loves to cook, and uses his mage hand cantrip to cut vegetables. He assumes the characters are intruders unless convinced otherwise. Any ability check to do so is made with disadvantage, since Manafret knows that {@creature Manshoon|WDH} would have informed him if guests were expected. If the mage suspects the characters are intruders, he surreptitiously pours a vial of assassin's blood ({@dc 10} Constitution save, on a failure 10 ({@dice 3d6}) poison damage and {@condition poisoned} for 24 hours, half damage on a success and not {@condition poisoned}) into the stew before asking them to taste it and give him an honest critique. He then cries out to the guards in {@area K2|3db} and attacks. Combat in this area draws the attention of the Zhents in areas K2 and K7, who investigate.
zh_tw: 半身人{@creature Manafret Cherryport|wdh|馬納弗雷特·切裡波特}是{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的副手之一。他喜歡烹飪，並使用法師之手戲法切菜。除非角色們說服他，否則他會把他們當成入侵者。由於馬納弗雷特知道，若預期有客人來訪，{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}一定會先通知他，因此說服他的任何屬性檢定都具有劣勢。若這位法師懷疑角色們是入侵者，他會偷偷將一瓶刺客之血倒進燉菜，再請他們品嚐並坦誠評論。這種毒藥需進行{@dc 10}體質豁免，失敗則受到10（{@dice 3d6}）點毒素傷害並陷入{@condition poisoned||中毒}狀態24小時；成功則傷害減半，且不會{@condition poisoned||中毒}。隨後，他會高聲呼叫{@area K2|3db}的守衛並發動攻擊。本區域的戰鬥會引起K2與K7區域的散塔林會成員注意，他們會前來檢視。

english: {@creature Manafret Cherryport|wdh|Manafret} is a lightfoot halfling {@creature mage}, with these changes:
zh_tw: {@creature Manafret Cherryport|wdh|馬納弗雷特} 是一個光足半精靈{@creature mage||魔法師}，有以下變化：

english: Manafret is neutral evil and has 31 ({@dice 9d6}) hit points.
zh_tw: 馬納弗雷特是中立邪惡，擁有31（{@dice 9d6}）點生命值。

english: He has these racial traits: He is Small, and his walking speed is 25 feet. He can move through the space of a Medium or larger creature. He has advantage on saving throws against being {@condition frightened}. He speaks Common and Halfling.
zh_tw: 他擁有以下種族特性：他是小型生物，行走速度為25尺。他可以穿過中型或更大生物的空間。他在對{@condition frightened||恐懼}狀態的豁免檢定上有優勢。他說通用語和半身人語。

english: Manafret wears a teleporter ring (see "Teleporter Rings").
zh_tw: 馬納弗雷特佩戴著一枚傳送戒指（見"傳送戒指"）。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: A cupboard holds a dozen jars of herbs and spices. Among them is a flask labeled "Assassin's Blood," which contains six doses of the poison.
zh_tw: 一個櫥櫃裡放著一打草藥和香料罐。其中有一個標有"刺客之血"的瓶子，裡面裝有六劑毒藥。

english: K4. Musty Library
zh_tw: K4. 黴味圖書館

english: This musty room is situated at the bottom of the main tower, and it has no door on level 1. It contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個發黴的房間位於主塔的底部，並且在1層沒有門。它包含以下特點：

english: A suit of dented plate armor stands in the center of the room.
zh_tw: 一套凹陷的板甲站在房間中央。

english: Tomes are packed into built-in stone bookshelves, with a tall alcove above each shelf holding a gargoyle. (Two of these sculptures are living {@creature gargoyle||gargoyles}.) An in-progress game of Dragonchess sits on a marble table in a reading nook.
zh_tw: 書籍被塞進內建的石制書架裡，每個書架上方都有一個高高的凹室，裡面放著一個石像鬼。（這些雕塑中有兩隻活生生的{@creature gargoyle||石像鬼}。）一場正在進行的龍棋遊戲擺放在閱讀角的大理石桌子上。

english: A stone staircase spirals up to {@area K6|3e6}.
zh_tw: 一段石制樓梯螺旋上升至{@area K6|3e6}。

english: Gargoyles
zh_tw: 石像鬼

english: The two real gargoyles are indistinguishable from the inanimate gargoyle statues in the high alcoves. When intruders start poking around the room, the gargoyles swoop down and attack.
zh_tw: 這兩隻真正的石像鬼與高凹室內的無生命石像鬼雕像無法區分。當入侵者開始在房間裡四處窺探時，石像鬼會俯衝下來並發動攻擊。

english: Tomes
zh_tw: 書籍

english: Any character who spends an hour searching the bookshelves finds a fat tome titled {@i Flumph Mating Rituals}, with an embossed image of two flumphs on the cover, their tendrils entwined. The cover is a false one, wrapping around a tome bound in dragon hide-a disguised spellbook that contains the following wizard spells: {@spell arcane lock}, {@spell burning hands}, {@spell comprehend languages}, {@spell counterspell}, {@spell darkvision}, {@spell dimension door}, {@spell find familiar}, {@spell levitate}, {@spell sending}, and {@spell unseen servant}. (You can replace any of these spells with a spell of the same level.)
zh_tw: 任何花費一小時搜尋書架的角色會發現一本厚重的書，標題為{@i 呋嚕交配儀式}，封面上有兩隻浮空怪的浮雕圖案，它們的觸鬚交織在一起。封面是一個假封面，包裹著一本用龍皮裝訂的書——一本偽裝的魔法書，其中包含以下法師法術：{@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖}、{@spell burning hands||燃燒之手}、{@spell comprehend languages||通曉語言}、{@spell counterspell||法術反制}、{@spell darkvision||黑暗視覺}、{@spell dimension door||任意門}、{@spell find familiar||尋獲魔寵}、{@spell levitate||浮空術}、{@spell sending||短訊術}和{@spell unseen servant||隱形僕役}。（你可以用同等級的法術替換其中任何一個。）

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The Dragonchess set is made of hand-carved ivory and is worth 500 gp.
zh_tw: 這副龍棋套裝由手工雕刻的象牙製成，價值500金幣。

english: K5. Garbage-Filled Room
zh_tw: K5. 垃圾填滿的房間

english: This room is on level 1 of the outermost tower but isn't accessible from that floor. It reeks of garbage and has the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間位於最外層塔樓的1層，但不能從那一層進入。它散發著垃圾的惡臭，並且有以下特點：

english: Ankle-deep refuse fills the chamber.
zh_tw: 房間裡積滿了齊踝深的垃圾。

english: Black scorch marks stretch from floor to ceiling along the walls and the stairs, which lead up to {@area K10|3f0}.
zh_tw: 黑色的燒焦痕跡沿著牆壁和通往{@area K10|3f0}的樓梯從地板延伸到天花板。

english: {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s servants throw their garbage here. The Kolat brothers created some magic items in this room, and an experiment gone awry caused the scorch marks.
zh_tw: {@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的僕人們把垃圾扔到這裡。克拉特兄弟在這個房間裡製造了一些魔法物品，一次實驗出錯導致了燒焦的痕跡。

english: K6. Main Tower Landing and Ledge
zh_tw: K6. 主塔平臺和壁架

english: Level 2 of the main tower has the following features:
zh_tw: 主塔的第二層有以下特點：

english: A stone landing with no railings has a door leading to {@area K7|3ea} and a stone spiral staircase descending to {@area K4|3e1}. An invisible staircase with no railings (see "Kolat Towers Features"), hugs the wall as it climbs from the landing to {@area K11|3f3}.
zh_tw: 一個沒有欄杆的石質平臺有一個通往{@area K7|3ea}的門，以及一個螺旋石梯，向下通往{@area K4|3e1}。一個看不見的樓梯沒有欄杆（見"克拉特雙塔特點"），它緊貼著牆壁，從平臺攀升至{@area K11|3f3}。

english: Across from the landing, a wide stone ledge protrudes from the northeast wall beneath a window. A pair of identical wooden chests sits atop the ledge. (One chest is real. The other is a {@creature mimic}.)
zh_tw: 在平臺對面，一個寬闊的石壁架從東北牆的窗戶下方突出。一對相同的木製箱子位於壁架上方。（其中一個箱子是真的。另一個是一個{@creature mimic||擬身怪}。）

english: Ledge
zh_tw: 巖架

english: There's no easy way to access the ledge, which is 8 feet away from the landing and at the same height. Characters can try to jump onto the ledge, or they can hook a rope onto the railing on the level above ({@area K11|3f3}) and swing across the gap. They can also use magic to cross. Anyone who falls off the landing or the ledge lands in {@area K4|3e1}, 20 feet below.
zh_tw: 沒有簡單的方法可以到達那個巖架，它距離平臺8尺遠，且在同一高度。角色可以嘗試跳上巖架，或者他們可以將繩索鉤在上層的欄杆上（{@area K11|3f3}），然後蕩過空隙。他們也可以使用魔法來穿越。任何從平臺或巖架上掉下來的人都會落在{@area K4|3e1}，下方20尺處。

english: Mimic
zh_tw: 擬身怪

english: A character who touches the mimic becomes adhered to it. The mimic attacks if disturbed or when a character inspects the real chest next to it.
zh_tw: 觸控擬身怪的角色會被粘附在它上面。如果受到幹擾，或者當角色檢查它旁邊的真實箱子時，擬身怪會發起攻擊。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: The genuine chest is unlocked and contains thirteen items, each of which can be used as an arcane focus: two crystals (worth 10 gp each), an orb (worth 20 gp), four rods (worth 10 gp each), and six wands (worth 10 gp each).
zh_tw: 真正的箱子沒有上鎖，包含十三個物品，每個都可以用作奧術法器：兩塊水晶（每塊價值10金幣），一個球體（價值20金幣），四根魔杖（每根價值10金幣），以及六根法杖（每根價值10金幣）。

english: K7. Reading Room
zh_tw: K7. 閱覽室

english: This room contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間包含以下特點：

english: A burly half-orc clad in black leather armor sits in an overstuffed chair in the northernmost corner of the room, reading a book.
zh_tw: 一個魁梧的半獸人穿著黑色皮甲，坐在房間最北角的一張填充過度的椅子上，正在閱讀一本書。

english: Large framed pictures of cities and landscapes hang on the walls, and a worn, blood-spattered rug covers the floor. Other furnishings include a pair of rocking chairs, a couch, and an ottoman.
zh_tw: 牆上掛著城市和風景的大型框架畫，地板上鋪著一條磨損且血跡斑斑的地毯。其他的傢俱包括一對搖椅、一張沙發和一個腳凳。

english: Mouthwatering scents rise from a staircase that curves down to the kitchen ({@area K3|3de}).
zh_tw: 令人垂涎的香氣從通往廚房（{@area K3|3de}）的螺旋樓梯上升起。

english: Zhent
zh_tw: 散塔林會成員

english: {@creature Yorn|wdh} the Terror is reading a copy of {@book Volo's Guide to Monsters|vgm}, autographed on the title page by the author with an added note that reads, in Common: "For {@creature Yorn|WDH}. I hope you find the orc chapter illuminating!"
zh_tw: {@creature Yorn|wdh|約恩} 恐懼正在閱讀一本{@book 瓦羅怪物指南|vgm}，標題頁上有作者的親筆簽名，並附有一句用通用語寫的註釋："致{@creature Yorn|WDH|約恩}。希望你能從獸人章節中有所啟發！"

english: {@creature Yorn|wdh} is a half-orc {@creature thug}, with these changes:
zh_tw: {@creature Yorn|wdh|約恩} 是一個半獸人{@creature thug||暴徒}，有以下變化：

english: {@creature Yorn|WDH} is neutral evil.
zh_tw: {@creature Yorn|WDH|約恩} 是中立邪惡。

english: He has these racial traits: When reduced to 0 hit points, he drops to 1 hit point instead (but can't do this again until he finishes a long rest). He has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. He speaks Common and Orc.
zh_tw: 他擁有以下種族特性：當生命值降至0點時，他的生命值反而降至1點（但在完成一次長休之前不能再這樣做）。他具有60尺範圍內的黑暗視覺。他說通用語和獸人語。

english: {@creature Yorn|wdh} values his own well-being above all else. He is initially indifferent toward intruders. If {@creature Yorn|WDH} believes the characters aren't a threat, he's happy to chat with them about the inhabitants and the layout of Kolat Towers. He has never visited {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s extraplanar sanctum, but he does know that the teleportation circle in {@area K22|40b} is the way to get there.
zh_tw: {@creature Yorn|wdh|約恩}最看重自己的福祉。他最初對入侵者漠不關心。如果{@creature Yorn|WDH|約恩}認為角色們不構成威脅，他很樂意與他們談論克拉特雙塔的居民和佈局。他從未參觀過{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的跨維度聖所，但他確實知道{@area K22|40b}中的傳送法陣是到達那裡的方式。

english: Combat in this area draws the attention of {@creature Manafret Cherryport|wdh} in {@area K3|3de}, who investigates.
zh_tw: 這個區域的戰鬥引起了{@area K3|3de}中{@creature Manafret Cherryport|wdh|馬納弗雷特·切裡波特}的注意，他會進行調查。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: {@creature Yorn|wdh} carries 36 cp, 20 sp, 12 gp, 8 taols, and a gem-studded ivory toothpick (worth 25 gp) in a pouch.
zh_tw: {@creature Yorn|wdh|約恩} 攜帶著36枚銅幣，20枚銀幣，12枚金幣，8枚塔奧爾幣，以及一個鑲有寶石的象牙牙籤（價值25金幣）在一個小袋中。

english: K8. Apprentice Bedroom
zh_tw: K8. 學徒臥室

english: This narrow room contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個狹窄的房間包含以下特點：

english: Three single beds are bunched less than an arm's length apart beneath a staircase that leads up to {@area K12|3f4}.
zh_tw: 三張單人床緊挨在一起，距離不到一個手臂的長度，位於一個通往{@area K12|3f4}的樓梯下方。

english: At the foot of each bed is a wooden chest.
zh_tw: 每張床的床腳都有一個木製的箱子。

english: The Kolat brothers once took on apprentices, who slept here. {@creature Manshoon|WDH} now allows his own apprentices—Ered Payno, Havi Termock, and Savara Firethorn—to do the same. All three can be found in {@area K15|3fc}.
zh_tw: 克拉特兄弟曾經收過學徒，他們在這裡睡覺。{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}現在允許他自己的學徒——埃雷德·帕伊諾、哈維·特莫克和薩瓦拉·火棘——也這樣做。這三個人都可以在{@area K15|3fc}找到。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Inside each chest is a set of {@item common clothes|phb}, a spare spell {@item component pouch|phb}, {@item candle|PHB|candles}, ink, pens, {@item paper (one sheet)|PHB|paper}, and {@dice 3d6} gp. Each chest also holds a spellbook that contains all the spells its owner has prepared. In addition, Ered's spellbook contains {@spell burning hands}, {@spell knock}, and {@spell lightning bolt}; Havi's spellbook contains {@spell charm person}, {@spell detect thoughts}, and {@spell major image}; and Savara's spellbook contains {@spell comprehend languages}, {@spell phantasmal force}, and {@spell phantom steed}.
zh_tw: 每個箱子裡都有一套{@item common clothes|phb|普通服裝}，一個備用的法術{@item component pouch|phb|材料包}，{@item candle|PHB|蠟燭}，墨水，筆，{@item paper (one sheet)|PHB|紙張}，以及{@dice 3d6}金幣。每個箱子還裝有一本法術書，包含其所有者準備的所有法術。此外，埃雷德的法術書中包含{@spell burning hands||燃燒之手}，{@spell knock||敲擊術}，和{@spell lightning bolt||閃電束}；哈維的法術書中包含{@spell charm person||魅惑類人}，{@spell detect thoughts||偵測思想}，和{@spell major image||高等幻影}；薩瓦拉的法術書中包含{@spell comprehend languages||通曉語言}，{@spell phantasmal force||魅影之力}，和{@spell phantom steed||魅影駒}。

english: K9. Bridge and Walkway
zh_tw: K9. 橋和步行道

english: A wooden bridge connects the two towers 20 feet above the ground, and a walkway attached to the bridge encircles the outside of the outer tower. The bridge and the tower walkway lack railings. Their planks and stones groan and crack underfoot but are safe to walk on.
zh_tw: 一座木橋將兩座塔連線起來，距離地面20尺，橋上連線的步行道環繞著外塔的外圍。橋和塔的步行道沒有欄杆。腳下的木板和石頭會發出吱吱嘎嘎的聲音，但走起來是安全的。

english: K10. Wizard Statue
zh_tw: K10. 法師雕像

english: This level of the outer tower consists of a landing and a narrow ledge with the following features:
zh_tw: 外塔的這一層由一個平臺和一條狹窄的壁架組成，具有以下特點：

english: The landing is 10 feet square and is met by two staircases. One descends 20 feet to {@area K5|3e5}, and one ascends 20 feet to {@area K20|408}.
zh_tw: 這個平臺面積為10尺見方，由兩條樓梯連線。一條向下20尺通向{@area K5|3e5}，另一條向上20尺通向{@area K20|408}。

english: The narrow ledge built into the southeast wall has a life-size statue of a bearded human wizard standing atop it. The wizard looks angry and is leveling a stone wand at the door to {@area K9|3ef}.
zh_tw: 東南牆上建造的狹窄壁架上有一個真人大小的長鬍子人類法師雕像站在上面。這位法師看起來很生氣，正用石制魔杖指向{@area K9|3ef}的門。

english: Statue
zh_tw: 雕像

english: The statue depicts Duhlark Kolat, and a {@spell detect magic} spell or similar magic reveals an aura of transmutation magic around it. The first time a character steps onto the landing, the statue levitates 1 foot above the ledge and intones the following warning in Common:
zh_tw: 這尊雕像描繪的是杜拉克·克拉特，而一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似的魔法揭示了它周圍的變形魔法光環。當角色第一次踏上平臺時，雕像會懸浮在壁架上方1尺處，並用通用語發出以下警告：

english: "I am Duhlark Kolat, the great wizard and master of this tower! How dare you invade my home! Leave at once or be destroyed by magic beyond your comprehension!"
zh_tw: "我是杜拉克·克拉特，這座塔的偉大法師和主人！你們怎敢侵入我的家園！立即離開，否則將被你們無法理解的魔法摧毀！"

english: The threat is empty, but the statue continues to levitate for 1 minute before sinking back down to the ledge. The magic resets after 1 hour. While it is levitating, the statue can be easily pushed or pulled around.
zh_tw: 這個威脅是空洞的，但雕像繼續懸浮1分鐘後才沉回落到壁架上。魔法在1小時後重置。在它懸浮的時候，雕像可以被輕易地推或拉移動。

english: Casting {@spell dispel magic} on the statue while it's floating causes it to fall, topple off the ledge, and shatter in {@area K5|3e5} below. Anyone in that area when the statue falls must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or take 22 ({@dice 4d10}) bludgeoning damage.
zh_tw: 在雕像漂浮時對其施放{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}會導致其墜落，從邊緣翻落，並在下方的{@area K5|3e5}區域摔碎。雕像墜落時在該區域的任何人必須成功透過一個{@dc 10}敏捷豁免檢定，否則將受到22（{@dice 4d10}）點鈍擊傷害。

english: K11. Laboratory
zh_tw: K11. 實驗室

english: This room consists of a ledge connected to the levels above and below by invisible staircases (see "Kolat Towers Features"). One staircase descends 20 feet to {@area K6|3e6}, and the other climbs 20 feet to {@area K15|3fc}. The area contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間由一個巖架構成，透過不可見的樓梯與上下層相連（見"克拉特雙塔特點"）。一條樓梯向下延伸20尺至{@area K6|3e6}，另一條樓梯向上爬升20尺至{@area K15|3fc}。該區域包含以下特點：

english: Shattered glass covers the floor, and a large wooden trellis table has been knocked on its side.
zh_tw: 破碎的玻璃覆蓋了地板，一個大木製格子架桌子被撞倒了。

english: A large empty cabinet dominates the back wall.
zh_tw: 一個大型空櫃子佔據了後牆的主要位置。

english: This laboratory has been picked clean by {@creature Manshoon|WDH} and contains nothing of value.
zh_tw: 這個實驗室已經被{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}徹底搜刮乾淨，裡面沒有任何有價值的東西。

english: K12. Staff Display
zh_tw: K12. 法杖展示區

english: This room contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間包含以下特點：

english: A half-dozen staffs of various styles are hung proudly on the walls at the top of the landing.
zh_tw: 在樓梯頂部的牆上自豪地掛著半打不同風格的法杖。

english: A staircase descends to {@area K8|3ed}.
zh_tw: 一條樓梯向下通往{@area K8|3ed}。

english: Staffs
zh_tw: 法杖

english: Each staff is different in construction and style: a twisted birch branch, a sturdy oak dowel, a glittering haft of stone, a steel pole carved with blue runes, a dimpled copper staff topped with a copper crescent moon, and a blown-glass cane capped with a black marble orb.
zh_tw: 每根法杖在構造和風格上都各不相同：一根扭曲的樺樹枝，一根堅固的橡木棍，一根閃閃發光的石制柄，一根雕刻有藍色符文的鋼杆，一根頂部帶有銅製新月的銅質手杖，以及一根頂部鑲有黑色大理石球的吹制玻璃手杖。

english: All six {@creature flying Staff|wdh|staffs} animate and attack interlopers who enter the area without being escorted by {@creature Manshoon|WDH} or one of his lieutenants. The staffs have the same statistics as {@creature flying sword||flying swords}, except they deal bludgeoning damage on a hit. If a fight breaks out in this area, the creatures in {@area K14|3fa} come to investigate.
zh_tw: 所有六個{@creature flying Staff|wdh|法杖}在沒有{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}或他的一個副手陪同的情況下，會活化並攻擊進入該區域的入侵者。這些法杖的具體數值與{@creature flying sword||凌空劍}相同，只是在命中時造成鈍擊傷害。如果這個區域發生戰鬥，{@area K14|3fa}中的生物會過來調查。

english: K13. Holding Cell
zh_tw: K13. 拘留室

english: The door to this room has a narrow, barred window set into it. The door is locked and trapped (see below). As the characters approach the door, read:
zh_tw: 這個房間的門上有一個狹窄的帶柵欄的窗戶。門被鎖上了並且設有陷阱（見下文）。當角色們接近門時，閱讀：

english: A raspy voice calls out from beyond the door. "If you be good, let us rid these towers of evil's stench. If you be evil, open the door so we may battle, and my eternal boredom can end." Beyond the door's barred window, a gargoyle lurks in a stone cell, challenging you in a low growl. "Come on, then!"
zh_tw: 一個刺耳的聲音從門的另一邊傳來。"如果你們是好人，讓我們清除這些塔樓中的邪惡氣息。如果你們是邪惡的，開啟門讓我們戰鬥，這樣我的永恆無聊就可以結束了。"在門的帶柵欄的窗戶之外，一個石像鬼潛伏在石制牢房中，用低沉的咆哮向你們發出挑戰。"那就來吧！"

english: Trapped Door
zh_tw: 陷阱門

english: A {@spell glyph of warding} spell has been cast on the door, set to trigger when it is opened by anyone other than {@creature Manshoon|WDH}. The glyph, which resembles an ornate letter M, can be found with a successful {@dc 18} Intelligence (Investigation) check. The glyph targets the creature that opens the door with a {@spell blindness/deafness} spell (save {@dc 18}).
zh_tw: 一道{@spell glyph of warding||守衛刻文}已經被施加在門上，設定會在被{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}之外的任何人開啟時觸發。這個符文類似於一個華麗的字母M，可以透過成功的{@dc 18}智力（調查）檢定找到。符文會以{@spell blindness/deafness||目盲術/耳聾術}法術（豁免{@dc 18}）為目標開啟門的生物。

english: Lady Gondafrey
zh_tw: 岡達弗蕾女士

english: Duhlark Kolat long ago trapped a magical experiment in this cell: a {@creature gargoyle} that has been imbued with the personality of a human knight of Tyr (god of justice) named {@creature Lady Gondafrey|wdh}. This gargoyle has an Intelligence score of 10 and an alignment of lawful good. It speaks Common, and its face looks more humanoid than gargoyle. {@creature Manshoon|WDH} is amused by the creature, so he keeps it alive but locked in the cell.
zh_tw: 杜拉克·克拉特很久以前在這個牢房裡困住了一個魔法實驗：一個被賦予了提爾（正義之神）的人類騎士個性的{@creature gargoyle||石像鬼}，名叫{@creature Lady Gondafrey|wdh|岡達弗蕾女士}。這個石像鬼擁有10的智力得分和守序善良的陣營。它說通用語，它的臉看起來更像人類而不是石像鬼。{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}對這生物感到好笑，所以他讓它活著但鎖在牢房裡。

english: If the characters free {@creature Lady Gondafrey|WDH}, she offers to fight alongside them; however, she quickly turns against any character who exhibits cruel or unlawful behavior. She can offer helpful information about Kolat Towers, and she is familiar with both the layout of the towers and the current occupants of the place. She knows that {@creature Manshoon|WDH} resides in an extraplanar sanctum accessible through a teleportation circle that his lieutenants can activate using special rings. The gargoyle doesn't know where the teleportation circle is located, nor does she know why Duhlark transferred her consciousness into her present form.
zh_tw: 如果角色們釋放了{@creature Lady Gondafrey|WDH|岡達弗蕾女士}，她會提出與他們並肩作戰；然而，她會迅速反對任何表現出殘忍或非法行為的角色。她可以提供有關克拉特雙塔的有用資訊，她熟悉塔樓的佈局以及當前居住在那裡的人。她知道{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}居住在一個可以透過他的副手使用特殊戒指啟用的傳送陣進入的位面聖所。這個石像鬼不知道傳送陣的位置，也不知道為什麼杜拉克將她的意識轉移到了她現在的形式。

english: The gargoyle retains fragmented memories of the life of {@creature Lady Gondafrey|WDH}, a native Waterdavian who served in the City Watch. After identifying Duhlark Kolat as a suspect in several local disappearances, she darkened his doorstep in 1379 DR, the Year of the Lost Keep. Annoyed by this invasion of his privacy and not in his right mind, Duhlark captured {@creature Lady Gondafrey|WDH}, used a spell to meld her form with that of a gargoyle, and imprisoned her.
zh_tw: 這個石像鬼保留了{@creature Lady Gondafrey|WDH|岡達弗蕾女士}生活的片段記憶，她是一個本地的深水城居民，曾在城市守衛服役。在1379 DR年，也就是失落要塞年，她將杜拉克·克拉特認定為幾起當地失蹤案的嫌疑人，並因此出現在他的家門口。杜拉克因這次侵犯他的隱私而惱怒，並且他當時並不清醒，於是他捕獲了{@creature Lady Gondafrey|WDH|岡達弗蕾女士}，使用了一個法術將她的身體與石像鬼融合，並把她囚禁起來。

english: If the gargoyle travels with the party, roll a {@dice d10} each day at dawn. On a roll of 1, {@creature Lady Gondafrey|wdh}'s alignment becomes chaotic evil for 24 hours as the gargoyle's innate demeanor exerts itself. In this state, the creature tries to orchestrate the characters' deaths, going so far as to attack lone characters.
zh_tw: 如果石像鬼隨隊伍同行，在每天黎明時擲一個{@dice d10}。如果擲出1，{@creature Lady Gondafrey|wdh|岡達弗蕾女士}的陣營在接下來的24小時內變為混亂邪惡，因為石像鬼的天性開始顯現。在這種狀態下，這個生物試圖策劃角色們的死亡，甚至攻擊單獨的角色。

english: K14. Servants' Quarters
zh_tw: K14. 僕人區

english: This room contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間包含以下特點：

english: Furnishings include four beds, a small table with four chairs, and tattered window curtains.
zh_tw: 傢俱包括四張床、一張小桌子和四把椅子，以及破舊的窗簾。

english: Four Zhent {@creature thug||thugs} relax here-one trying to rest, two others playing cards, and the fourth sitting on the edge of a bed, re-stringing a heavy crossbow.
zh_tw: 四名散塔林會{@creature thug||暴徒}在這裡放鬆——一個試圖休息，另外兩個在打牌，第四個坐在床邊，重新給一把重型十字弓裝弦。

english: The thugs work for {@creature Manshoon|WDH} and leap up to attack anyone they don't recognize as one of their own. A successful {@dc 17} Charisma (Deception) check convinces these Zhents that the characters are their allies.
zh_tw: 這些暴徒為 {@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松} 工作，並會攻擊任何他們不認為是自己人的目標。成功的 {@dc 17} 魅力（欺瞞）檢定可以說服這些贊塔幫成員，認為角色是他們的盟友。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Resting in small piles and neat stacks on the table are 74 cp, 52 sp, 19 gp, and 4 taols.
zh_tw: 桌上堆著大小不一、排列整齊的錢幣：74枚銅幣、52枚銀幣、19枚金幣，以及4枚塔奧爾幣。

english: K15. Summoning Chamber
zh_tw: K15. 召喚室

english: This room is connected to the levels above and below by invisible staircases (see "Kolat Towers Features"), one descending 20 feet to {@area K11|3f3} and the other climbing 20 feet to {@area K16|3fd}. This area contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間透過隱形樓梯與上面的樓層和下面的樓層連線（見"克拉特雙塔特點"），一個向下20尺到達{@area K11|3f3}，另一個向上20尺到達{@area K16|3fd}。這個區域包含以下特點：

english: A 10-foot-diameter circle of runes has been drawn on the floor in blood that is now dried. Smoke billows from four iron braziers placed around the circle.
zh_tw: 一個直徑10尺的符文圈已經用現在已經乾燥的血畫在地板上。煙霧從圍繞圓圈放置的四個鐵火盆中滾滾而出。

english: Three {@creature apprentice wizard|VGM|apprentice wizards} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) stand outside the circle, chanting an incantation. A {@creature barlgura} is slumped motionless within the circle.
zh_tw: 三名{@creature apprentice wizard|VGM|學徒法師}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）站在圈外，唸誦著咒語。一隻{@creature barlgura||惡猿魔}在圈內無動於衷地倒著。

english: The three wizards here are {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s apprentices—Ered Payno (LE male Damaran human), Havi Termock (CE female Chondathan human), and Savara Firethorn (NE female Tethyrian human). Each wears a teleporter ring (see "Teleporter Rings"). The magical incantation that the three are reciting has quelled the barlgura and rendered it {@condition unconscious}. If any of them stop chanting, the demon awakes and becomes enraged, though it remains bound within the circle. Whenever it takes damage, the barlgura can attempt a {@dc 10} Charisma check. On a successful check, it breaks out of the circle and attacks any creature it can reach.
zh_tw: 這裡的三位巫師是{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的學徒——埃雷德·派諾（LE男性大馬拉人人類）、哈維·特爾莫克（CE女性瓊達珊人人類）和薩瓦拉·火棘（NE女性泰希安人人類）。每個人都戴著傳送戒指（見"傳送戒指"）。三位巫師正在吟唱的魔法咒語已經壓制了巴古拉惡魔並使其{@condition unconscious||昏迷}。如果他們中的任何一位停止吟唱，惡魔就會醒來並變得憤怒，儘管它仍然被束縛在法陣中。每當它受到傷害時，巴古拉惡魔可以嘗試進行一次{@dc 10}魅力檢定。如果檢定成功，它將掙脫法陣並攻擊任何它能觸及的生物。

english: Freeing the barlgura disrupts {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s operation, forcing the wizard to spend time and resources defeating the fiend and replacing slain underlings.
zh_tw: 釋放惡猿魔會干擾{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的行動，迫使這位法師花費時間和資源擊敗這個惡魔並替換被殺死的手下。

english: K16. Construct Workshop
zh_tw: K16. 構造物工坊

english: The invisible staircase from {@area K15|3fc} ends in front of a closed door. The door is unlocked and opens into the room, which contains the following:
zh_tw: 來自{@area K15|3fc}的隱形樓梯在一扇關閉的門前結束。這扇門沒有上鎖，開啟後通向房間，房間內包含以下內容：

english: Bits of clay, stone, bone, and metal litter the floor and cover a wooden table in the middle of the room.
zh_tw: 地板上散落著粘土、石頭、骨頭和金屬碎片，房間中央的木桌上也覆蓋著這些材料。

english: The floor creaks and tilts slightly when stepped on, and it can be seen to be detached from the walls. Two oversized iron clamps on opposite sides of the room hold the floor in place. Each of these rusty mechanisms is attached to an iron lever.
zh_tw: 地板在踩踏時會吱吱作響並輕微傾斜，可以看到它與牆壁分離。房間兩側各有一個超大號的鐵夾子固定著地板。每個生鏽的機械裝置都連線著一個鐵桿。

english: A wooden staircase once climbed 20 feet to the next level, but it has partially collapsed.
zh_tw: 曾經有一座木製樓梯爬上20尺到達下一層，但它已經部分坍塌。

english: The Kolat brothers once crafted constructs in this workshop. The magical clamped floor was built as a precaution in case one of the experiments went berserk.
zh_tw: 克拉特兄弟曾在這個工坊中製造構造物。魔法夾緊的地板是作為一種預防措施建造的，以防其中一個實驗失控。

english: When a creature that doesn't work for {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s Zhentarim enters this room without being escorted, the metal scraps on the floor fly together, forming a suit of {@creature animated armor} that attacks. When the armor is reduced to 10 hit points or fewer, it tries to pull one of the levers on its next turn.
zh_tw: 當一個不為{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的散塔林會工作的生物未經護送進入這個房間時，地板上的金屬碎片會飛到一起，形成一個{@creature animated armor||活化盔甲}並進行攻擊。當盔甲的生命值降至10點或更少時，它會在下一個回合嘗試拉動其中一個杆。

english: Floor Clamps
zh_tw: 地板夾具

english: Pulling a lever is an action that causes both clamps to release the floor, which is then magically driven upward into the ceiling. Creatures standing on the floor are knocked {@condition prone} and must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw as they slam into the ceiling, taking 22 ({@dice 4d10}) bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The floor then settles a few feet below the ceiling, cutting off access to the stairs down to {@area K15|3fc} but leaving characters free to climb up the collapsed staircase to {@area K17|400}. (The magical floor was designed to prevent a berserk golem from reaching the lower chambers of the towers, and potentially the city beyond, while the Kolat brothers dealt with it.) After 10 minutes, the floor descends to its normal level and the clamps lock it down again.
zh_tw: 拉動槓桿是一個動作，會導致兩個夾子釋放地板，然後地板會被魔法驅動向上撞向天花板。站在地板上的生物會被擊倒 {@condition prone||伏地}，並且必須在撞擊天花板時進行一次 {@dc 20} 的敏捷豁免檢定，失敗則受到 22 ({@dice 4d10}) 點鈍擊傷害，成功則只受到一半傷害。地板隨後會停留在天花板下方几尺處，切斷通往 {@area K15|3fc} 的樓梯通道，但允許角色攀爬坍塌的樓梯前往 {@area K17|400}。（這個魔法地板的設計是為了防止狂暴的魔像進入塔樓的下層區域，甚至可能進入城市，而克拉特兄弟則負責處理它。）10 分鐘後，地板會降回原位，夾子會再次將其鎖定。

english: Partially Collapsed Stairs
zh_tw: 部分坍塌的樓梯

english: A creature can climb the stairs to {@area K17|400} with a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity (Acrobatics) check. If the check fails, the creature falls 10 feet.
zh_tw: 生物可以成功透過一次 {@dc 10} 敏捷（體操）檢定來攀爬樓梯前往 {@area K17|400}。如果檢定失敗，該生物會墜落10尺。

english: K17. Flesh Golem
zh_tw: K17. 血肉魔像

english: This unlit hallway contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個未點亮的走廊包含以下特點：

english: Any character who inspects the hall for traps and succeeds on a {@dc 17} Wisdom (Perception) check notices 1-inch-diameter holes drilled into the walls at ankle height, set at regular intervals along the length of the passage.
zh_tw: 任何檢查大廳陷阱併成功透過 {@dc 17} 感知（感知）檢定的角色，會注意到牆壁踝部高度有直徑1吋的孔洞，這些孔洞沿通道長度方向以等距間隔排列。

english: A {@creature flesh golem} stands in front of the door to {@area K18|403}.
zh_tw: 一個{@creature flesh golem||血肉魔像}站在通往{@area K18|403}的門前。

english: A one-way secret door is set into the innermost wall.
zh_tw: 一扇單向秘密門嵌入在最內側的牆壁中。

english: Golem Trap
zh_tw: 魔像陷阱

english: The flesh golem was created by Duhlark Kolat. {@creature Manshoon|WDH} chose to leave it here and instructed his lieutenants not to disturb it. It moves to attack anyone other than Duhlark who approaches within 10 feet of it. A character disguised as Duhlark (using the statue in {@area K10|3f0} as a model) can fool the golem with a successful {@dc 10} Charisma (Deception) check.
zh_tw: 這個血肉魔像是由杜拉克·克拉特創造的。{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}選擇將其留在這裡，並指示他的副手不要打擾它。它會攻擊任何靠近它10尺範圍內、除杜拉克以外的其他人。一個偽裝成杜拉克的角色（使用{@area K10|3f0}中的雕像作為模型）可以透過一次成功的{@dc 10}魅力（欺瞞）檢定來欺騙這個魔像。

english: The golem stands on a pressure plate. When it steps off the plate to attack someone out of its reach, the weight on the plate is lifted, causing poison gas to erupt from the holes in the walls. When the trap triggers, each creature in the hall must make a {@dc 12} Constitution saving throw, taking 10 ({@dice 3d6}) poison damage on a failed saving throw, or half as much damage on a successful one. The gas lingers for 1 minute unless dispersed with a {@spell gust of wind} spell or similar magic. While the gas persists, a creature in the hall must repeat the saving throw at the start of each of its turns. The golem is immune to the poison gas.
zh_tw: 魔像站在一個壓力板上。當它離開壓力板去攻擊一個它夠不到的敵人時，壓力板上的重量被移除，導致牆壁上的孔洞噴出毒氣。當陷阱觸發時，大廳中的每個生物必須進行一次 {@dc 12} 體質豁免檢定，若失敗則受到 10（{@dice 3d6}）點毒素傷害，若成功則受到一半傷害。毒氣會持續 1 分鐘，除非被 {@spell gust of wind||造風術} 法術或類似的魔法驅散。當毒氣存在時，大廳中的生物在每回合開始時必須重複進行豁免檢定。魔像對毒氣免疫。

english: One-Way Secret Door
zh_tw: 單向暗門

english: A character who makes a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check notices the secret door that leads to {@area K19|406}. This door opens normally only from inside {@area K19|406}, and only a {@spell knock} spell or similar magic can force it open from this side.
zh_tw: 一個角色如果成功透過了 {@dc 15} 的感知（感知）檢定，會注意到通往 {@area K19|406} 的密門。這扇門通常只能從 {@area K19|406} 內部正常開啟，只有 {@spell knock||敲擊術} 法術或類似的魔法才能從這一側強行開啟它。

english: K18. Arcane Rune
zh_tw: K18. 奧術符文

english: This unlit hall is choked with dust and cobwebs. It contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個未點亮的走廊裡滿是灰塵和蜘蛛網。它包含以下特點：

english: An elaborate rune is inscribed on the back wall at the southernmost end of the hall. (The rune isn't visible from the doorway to {@area K17|400}.)
zh_tw: 在大廳最南端的後牆上刻有一個複雜的符文。（從通往{@area K17|400}的門道看不到這個符文。）

english: A secret door is set into the innermost wall.
zh_tw: 一扇秘密門嵌入在最內側的牆壁中。

english: Arcane Rune
zh_tw: 奧術符文

english: A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar magic reveals a powerful aura of conjuration magic around the rune. A successful {@dc 15} Intelligence (Arcana) check confirms that this rune sustains the force field around Kolat Towers, and that the rune can be destroyed. It has AC 10, 22 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. The rune can't be dispelled normally, but each successful dispel magic cast on it ({@dc 19}) deals 16 ({@dice 3d10}) force damage to it.
zh_tw: 一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似的魔法會揭示符文周圍強大的咒法魔法靈光。成功的{@dc 15}智力（奧秘）檢定確認此符文維持著克拉特雙塔周圍的力場，並且符文可以被破壞。它的AC為10，22點生命值，並且對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。符文無法被正常解除，但每次成功對其施放的{@dc 19}解除魔法會對它造成16點（{@dice 3d10}）力場傷害。

english: The first time damage is dealt to the rune, a {@creature red slaad} magically springs forth from it and attacks all creatures in the hallway.
zh_tw: 當符文第一次受到傷害時，一個{@creature red slaad||史拉紅蟾}會透過魔法從其中跳出，並攻擊走廊裡的所有生物。

english: When the rune is destroyed, the force field around Kolat Towers disappears.
zh_tw: 當符文被摧毀時，圍繞克拉特雙塔的力場消失了。

english: Secret Door
zh_tw: 暗門

english: A character who makes a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check notices the secret door that leads to {@area K19|406}.
zh_tw: 一個成功透過 {@dc 15} 感知（感知）檢定的人物會注意到通往 {@area K19|406} 的密門。

english: K19. Duhlark's Bedroom
zh_tw: K19. 杜拉克的臥室

english: This room is accessible through either of the secret doors that lead to areas K17 and K18. It contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間可以透過通往K17和K18區域的任意一扇秘密門進入。它包含以下特點：

english: A {@creature flameskull} bobs in the middle of the room, which is choked with dust and cobwebs.
zh_tw: 一個{@creature flameskull||燃焰之顱}在房間中央浮動，房間裡滿是灰塵和蜘蛛網。

english: An oval canopy bed veiled in cobwebs sits across from two narrow bookshelves.
zh_tw: 一張橢圓形的天篷床被蜘蛛網覆蓋著，它位於兩個狹窄書架的對面。

english: The room smells like a tomb.
zh_tw: 這個房間聞起來像墳墓。

english: {@creature Manshoon|WDH} found Duhlark Kolat's skeletal remains in the bed and transformed his skull into a flameskull. He left the rest of the bones alone, hidden behind cobwebs. The flameskull attacks anyone other than {@creature Manshoon|WDH} who confronts it, shouting, "Get out of my house!" between casting spells and throwing off fire rays.
zh_tw: {@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}在床中發現了杜拉克·克拉特的骷髏遺骸，並將他的頭骨變成了一個燃焰之顱。他沒有動其餘的骨頭，將它們隱藏在蜘蛛網後面。燃焰之顱會攻擊任何面對它的人，除了{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}，它在施法和發射火焰射線之間會大喊："滾出我的房子！"

english: Bookshelves
zh_tw: 書架

english: {@creature Manshoon|WDH} removed any tomes of value from the bedroom, leaving noticeable gaps on the shelves between mundane books on a variety of esoteric subjects.
zh_tw: {@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}從臥室中移走了所有有價值的書籍，留下了書架上在各種深奧主題的普通書籍之間的明顯空隙。

english: Among the volumes on one shelf is a false book titled {@i The Man from Damara}—a wooden block painted to resemble a book, which is wired to a secret compartment in the base of the shelf. A character can detect the shelf and discern how to open it with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check. Tugging on the book causes the compartment to pop open, revealing Duhlark's {@item wand of binding} hidden inside.
zh_tw: 在一排書架上有一本假書，名為{@i 來自達馬拉的男人}——一個塗成書本形狀的木塊，與書架底部的秘密隔間相連。角色可以透過一次成功的{@dc 15}感知（感知）檢定發現該書架並辨別如何開啟它。拉動這本書會使隔間彈開，露出藏在其中的杜拉克的{@item wand of binding||定身魔杖}。

english: K20. Alcedor's Private Library
zh_tw: K20. 阿爾塞多的私人圖書館

english: This room has the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間有以下特點：

english: A tall oak bookshelf contains a few scattered books (all mundane and worthless), but is mostly bare. Above the bookshelf hangs a beautifully crafted sign that reads "Alcedor" in Common.
zh_tw: 一個高大的橡木書架上散落著幾本書籍（都是普通且無價值的），但大部分是空的。書架上方掛著一個精美製作的標牌，用通用語寫著"阿爾塞多"。

english: A staircase descends 20 feet to {@area K10|3f0}.
zh_tw: 一段樓梯向下延伸20尺至{@area K10|3f0}。

english: K21. Duhlark's Private Library
zh_tw: K21. 杜拉克的私人圖書館

english: This room has the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間有以下特點：

english: A tall oak bookshelf holds a few dozen books. Above the bookshelf hangs a beautifully crafted sign that reads "Duhlark" in Common.
zh_tw: 一個高大的橡木書架上擺放著幾十本書籍。書架上方掛著一個精美製作的標牌，用通用語寫著"杜拉克"。

english: A staircase ascends 20 feet to {@area K22|40b}.
zh_tw: 一段樓梯向上延伸20尺至{@area K22|40b}。

english: Bookshelf
zh_tw: 書架

english: The bookshelf holds thirty books in total. If any of them are disturbed, they fly off the shelves and form a swarm that attacks all creatures in the room. The {@creature swarm of books|wdh|book collection} has the statistics of a {@creature swarm of bats}, with these changes:
zh_tw: 書架上總共有三十本書。如果任何一本書被擾動，它們會從書架上飛出，形成一個群體攻擊房間裡的所有生物。{@creature swarm of books|wdh|書籍收藏}的具體數值與{@creature swarm of bats||蝙蝠群}相同，有以下變化：

english: The books lack the Echolocation and Keen Hearing traits.
zh_tw: 這些書沒有回聲定位和敏銳聽力的特性。

english: Replace the swarm's Bites attack option with a Slam attack option that deals the same amount of bludgeoning damage.
zh_tw: 將群體的咬擊攻擊選項替換為撞擊攻擊選項，造成相同量的傷害。

english: If there are no creatures to attack on its turn, the book collection returns to the bookshelf. The books are otherwise nonmagical and cover a wide array of subjects.
zh_tw: 如果在其回合沒有生物可以攻擊，書籍群會返回到書架上。這些書本身是非魔法的，並且涵蓋了廣泛的主題。

english: K22. Teleportation Circle
zh_tw: K22. 傳送法陣

english: A staircase rising from {@area K21|409} leads to this highest chamber of the outer tower. It contains the following features:
zh_tw: 從{@area K21|409}升起的樓梯通向這座外塔的最高房間。它包含以下特點：

english: A {@creature spectator} floats in the middle of the room, and four {@creature flying snake||flying snakes} flutter above the rafters.
zh_tw: 一個{@creature spectator||觀察者眼魔}在房間中央漂浮，四條{@creature flying snake||飛蛇}在椽子上方盤旋。

english: Runes inscribed on the floor form a large, faintly glowing circle.
zh_tw: 地板上刻著符文，形成了一個微弱發光的大圓圈。

english: Five wooden treasure chests with sturdy padlocks rest against the walls.
zh_tw: 五個帶有堅固掛鎖的木製寶箱靠牆放置。

english: Guardians
zh_tw: 守衛

english: The spectator guards the treasure chests and attacks intruders who aren't being escorted by {@creature Manshoon|WDH} or one of his lieutenants. The flying snakes join the battle, fighting as allies of the spectator.
zh_tw: 觀察者眼魔守護著寶箱，並攻擊未經{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}或其副手護送的入侵者。飛行蛇加入戰鬥，作為觀察者眼魔的盟友作戰。

english: Teleportation Circle
zh_tw: 傳送法陣

english: The teleportation circle functions as described under the {@spell teleportation circle||spell of the same name} in the {@book Player's Handbook|phb}. Additionally, a creature wearing a {@item teleporter ring|WDH} (see "Teleporter Rings"), can use this circle to access the teleportation circle in {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s sanctum ({@area E1|413}). A {@item teleporter ring|WDH} that is brought within 5 feet of the circle begins to hum softly.
zh_tw: 傳送法陣的功能與{@book 玩家手冊|phb}中描述的{@spell teleportation circle||同名法術}相同。此外，佩戴{@item teleporter ring|WDH|傳送戒指}（見"傳送戒指"）的生物可以使用此法陣進入{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}聖所（{@area E1|413}）中的傳送法陣。當{@item teleporter ring|WDH|傳送戒指}被帶到法陣5尺範圍內時，會開始發出柔和的嗡鳴聲。

english: Treasure Chests
zh_tw: 寶箱

english: The padlocks on the chests are illusory but feel real to the touch. A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar magic reveals an aura of illusion magic around each one. Attempts to pick or break the locks fail, but a {@spell knock} spell or similar magic causes a lock to open. {@i Chest 1} has the image of an anvil carved into its lid. It contains a set of smith's tools (worth 20 gp). {@i Chest 2 } has iron bands and contains a set of painter's supplies (worth 10 gp), as well as three small pots of colored paint (blue, red, and yellow). {@i Chest 3} has tiny clawed feet and contains six blank spellbooks with leather covers (worth 50 gp each). {@i Chest 4} has a flat lid with a city scene painted on it. It contains a scholar's pack (worth 40 gp) and a book of Dwarvish phrases. A character who doesn't speak Dwarvish can use the book to communicate on a rudimentary level with friendly dwarves. {@i Chest 5} is inlaid with silver and topped with a silver statuette of a rearing hippogriff (worth 25 gp). Inside is a wooden rack that holds eight glass vials—six containing {@item potion of healing||potions of healing} and two containing individual doses of {@item essence of ether} (see "Poisons" in chapter 8 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|dmg}). The poison can be identified with a successful {@dc 13} Intelligence (Nature) check.
zh_tw: 箱子上的掛鎖是幻術，但摸起來感覺真實。使用{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似魔法可以揭示每個箱子上環繞著幻術魔法的靈光。試圖撬開或破壞鎖會失敗，但使用{@spell knock||敲擊術}或類似魔法會使鎖開啟。{@i 1號箱}的蓋子上雕刻有鐵砧的圖案，裡面有一套鍛造工具（價值20 gp）。{@i 箱子 2}有鐵箍，裡面有一套畫家的工具（價值10 gp），以及三小罐彩色顏料（藍色、紅色和黃色）。{@i 3號箱}有小爪子般的腳，裡面有六本空白法術書，封皮為皮革製成（每本價值50 gp）。{@i 4號箱}的平蓋子上繪有城市場景，裡面有一個學者揹包（價值40 gp）和一本矮人語短語書。不會說矮人語的角色可以使用這本書與友好的矮人進行基本交流。{@i 5號箱}鑲嵌有銀飾，頂部有一個銀色的小雕像，描繪了一隻站立起來的獅鷲（價值25 gp）。裡面有一個木架，上面放著八個玻璃瓶——六瓶裝有{@item potion of healing||治療藥水}，兩瓶裝有單獨的{@item essence of ether||乙醚精}劑量（見《{@book 城主指南|dmg}》第8章"毒藥"）。透過成功的{@dc 13}智力（自然）檢定可以識別毒藥。

english: Extradimensional Sanctum
zh_tw: 超維度聖所

english: {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s extradimensional sanctum exists in a finite demiplane. Created by the original {@creature Manshoon|WDH}, it is known to the wizard's clones, and it currently serves as the lair of the clone described in this adventure.
zh_tw: {@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的超維避難所存在於一個有限的半位面中。它由原始的{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}創造，為法師的克隆體所知，目前作為本冒險中描述的克隆體的巢穴。

english: Outside {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s sanctum, the demiplane is a vast void filled with swirling purple mist. Any creature that enters this mist is teleported to {@area E1|413} and must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw, taking 22 ({@dice 4d10}) force damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
zh_tw: 在{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的聖所外，這個半位面是一個充滿旋轉紫色霧氣的廣闊虛空。任何進入這片霧氣的生物都會被傳送到 {@area E1|413}，並且必須進行一次 {@dc 18} 體質豁免檢定，若失敗則受到 22 ({@dice 4d10}) 點力場傷害，若成功則受到一半的傷害。

english: There are no cardinal directions in this extradimensional space; compasses spin futilely in the absence of north, south, east, and west.
zh_tw: 在這個超維度空間中沒有基本方向；指南針在沒有北、南、東、西的情況下徒勞地旋轉。

english: Sanctum Features
zh_tw: 避難所特點

english: These features apply to all areas in the extradimensional sanctum:
zh_tw: 這些特點適用於超維避難所的所有區域：

english: Rooms have 10-foot-high ceilings, with 8-foot-high passages and 7-foot-high doorways connecting them. The walls, floors, and ceilings throughout are made of seamless alabaster.
zh_tw: 房間有10尺高的天花板，連線它們的通道和門道高度分別為8尺和7尺。整個避難所的牆壁、地板和天花板都是由無縫的雪花石膏製成。

english: Doors are made of iron and have AC 19, 27 hit points, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. A locked door can be picked by someone who makes a successful {@dc 17} Dexterity check using thieves' tools, or can be forced open with a successful {@dc 25} Strength (Athletics) check. As an action, {@creature Manshoon|WDH} or his simulacrum can lock or unlock any door in the sanctum by touch.
zh_tw: 門由鐵製成，擁有AC 19、27點生命值，並且對毒素和心靈傷害免疫。被鎖上的門可以由使用盜賊工具併成功透過{@dc 17}敏捷檢定的人撬開，或者透過成功透過{@dc 25}力量（運動）檢定強行開啟。作為一個動作，{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}或他的擬像可以透過觸碰來鎖定或解鎖聖域內的任何門。

english: Except where noted, areas of the sanctum are brightly lit by {@spell continual flame} spells cast on wall sconces.
zh_tw: 除非另有說明，避難所的區域由施放在壁燈上的{@spell continual flame||不滅明焰}法術明亮照明。

english: Teleporter Rings
zh_tw: 傳送戒指

english: To access {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s extraplanar sanctum, one needs a {@item teleporter ring|WDH}: a brass signet ring bearing a stylized M, and which emanates an aura of conjuration magic when targeted by a {@spell detect magic} spell or similar magic. {@creature Manshoon|WDH} gives these rings to his most trusted servants.
zh_tw: 要進入{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的位面聖所，需使用一枚{@item teleporter ring|WDH|傳送戒指}：這是一枚刻有風格化字母M的黃銅印章戒指，當受到{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似魔法作用時，會散發出咒法魔法的靈光。{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}將這些戒指交予他最信任的僕從。

english: As an action, a creature wearing a teleporter ring can activate the teleportation circle either in {@area K22|40b} or {@area E1|413}, teleporting itself and up to six other willing creatures from one circle to the other.
zh_tw: 作為一個動作，佩戴傳送戒指的生物可以啟用{@area K22|40b}或{@area E1|413}中的傳送法陣，將自己和多達六名其他願意的生物從一個圈傳送到另一個圈。

english: Areas of the Sanctum
zh_tw: 避難所區域

english: The following locations are keyed to map 8.2.
zh_tw: 以下位置對應於地圖8.2上的關鍵點。

english: Sanctum
zh_tw: 聖所

english: Player Version
zh_tw: 玩家版本

english: E1. Arrival Point
zh_tw: E1. 到達點

english: This room is the extradimensional sanctum's anchor to the Material Plane, and one can teleport to this chamber from other places on the Material Plane. The room has the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間是超維避難所與物質界的錨點，人們可以從物質界的其他地方傳送到這個房間。這個房間有以下特點：

english: A teleportation circle is inscribed on the alabaster floor here. Characters teleported to this area from {@area K22|40b} appear within the circle.
zh_tw: 這個雪花石膏地板上刻有一個傳送法陣。從{@area K22|40b}傳送到這個區域的角色會出現在圈內。

english: The ceiling and three of the walls are made of 6-inch thick sheets of transparent glass, through which the swirling purple mist that fills the demiplane can be seen. The fourth wall is made of alabaster and has a locked iron door set into it (leading to {@area E2|417}).
zh_tw: 天花板和三面牆壁由6吋厚的透明玻璃板製成，透過這些玻璃可以看到充滿半位面的旋轉紫霧。第四面牆壁由雪花石膏製成，上面有一扇上鎖的鐵門（通向{@area E2|417}）。

english: A black-robed female human with a bald, scarred head watches this room through a glass window set into the wall of another room ({@area E3|41b}).
zh_tw: 一個穿著黑袍的人類女性，有著光頭和有疤痕的頭部，透過另一個房間（{@area E3|41b}）牆壁上的一個玻璃窗戶監視著這個房間。

english: Dreadful Host
zh_tw: 可怕的主人

english: The figure watching through the window is {@creature Kaevja Cynavern|wdh} (see {@area E3|41b}), and she can see through the purple mist between the two rooms easily enough. She uses a {@spell sending} spell to contact {@creature Manshoon|WDH} as soon as the characters arrive. {@creature Manshoon|WDH} sends his simulacrum (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) to unlock the door to {@area E2|417} and greet the new arrivals. It takes 1 minute for the simulacrum to arrive (from {@area E7|420}), during which time Kaevja uses another {@spell sending} spell to inform a random character that "Your gracious host is on the way, and looks forward to meeting you."
zh_tw: 窗外注視的人影是{@creature Kaevja Cynavern|wdh|凱夫賈·西納文}（參見{@area E3|41b}），她能夠輕鬆透過兩間房間之間的紫色霧氣看到情況。一旦角色到達，她會使用{@spell sending||短訊術}聯絡{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}。{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}會派他的擬像（參見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）去解鎖{@area E2|417}的門並迎接新來者。擬像需要1分鐘的時間到達（從{@area E7|420}出發），在這期間，卡芙嘉會再次使用{@spell sending||短訊術}告知隨機角色："尊貴的主人正在趕來，他期待著與您見面。"

english: When the simulacrum arrives, it passes itself off as {@creature Manshoon|WDH} as it welcomes the characters to its extradimensional sanctum. It offers a guided tour, gesturing for the characters to enter {@area E2|417} ahead of it. If they comply, it triggers the alarm in {@area E2|417} and attacks.
zh_tw: 當副本到達時，它將自己冒充為{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}，並以它的身份歡迎角色們來到其超維避難所。它提供了一次導遊服務，示意角色們在它之前進入{@area E2|417}。如果他們遵從，它就會觸發{@area E2|417}的警報併發起攻擊。

english: Glass Walls
zh_tw: 玻璃牆

english: Each 5-foot section of glass wall has AC 13, 30 hit points, and immunity to acid, poison, and psychic damage. The purple mist that fills the demiplane doesn't enter this area even if the glass is shattered.
zh_tw: 每5尺長的玻璃牆部分具有AC 13，30點生命值，並對酸性、毒素和心靈傷害免疫。即使玻璃被打破，充滿半位面的紫色霧氣也不會進入這個區域。

english: Teleportation Circle
zh_tw: 傳送法陣

english: The teleportation circle functions as described under the {@spell teleportation circle||spell of the same name} in the {@book Player's Handbook|phb}. Additionally, a creature wearing a {@item teleporter ring|WDH} (see "Teleporter Rings"), can use this circle to access the teleportation circle in Kolat Towers ({@area K22|40b}). A {@item teleporter ring|WDH} that is brought within 5 feet of the circle begins to hum softly.
zh_tw: 傳送法陣的功能與{@book 玩家手冊|phb}中同名法術的{@spell teleportation circle||同名法術}描述相同。此外，佩戴{@item teleporter ring|WDH|傳送戒指}（見"傳送戒指"）的生物可以使用這個圈訪問克拉特雙塔中的傳送法陣（{@area K22|40b}）。如果將{@item teleporter ring|WDH|傳送戒指}帶到圈的5尺範圍內，它將開始柔和地嗡嗡作響。

english: E2. Foyer
zh_tw: E2. 門廳

english: The door to {@area E1|413} is locked. All other doors leading from this room are unlocked. This foyer has the following features:
zh_tw: 通往{@area E1|413}的門是鎖著的。從這個門廳通向其他房間的門都是開著的。這個門廳有以下特點：

english: Set into the alabaster floor is a large symbol in black marble, depicting a winged snake biting a coin. Characters recognize this as the symbol of the Zhentarim. (The coin conceals an alarm mechanism.)
zh_tw: 雪花石膏地板上鑲嵌著一個由黑色大理石製成的大型符號，描繪了一條帶翼的蛇在咬一枚硬幣。角色們認出這是散塔林會（黑暗兄弟會）的標誌。（這枚硬幣隱藏了一個警報機制。）

english: Hanging on the walls are twelve metal masks bearing human-like visages.
zh_tw: 牆上掛著十二個金屬面具，上面刻有人臉的面容。

english: Alarm Mechanism
zh_tw: 警報機制

english: The 1-foot-diameter, disk-shaped tile that serves as the coin in the Zhentarim symbol is actually a pressure plate. When pressed or stepped on, it sounds a magic gong that can be heard throughout the sanctum. The alarm can be disabled by someone who makes a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check using thieves' tools, but it triggers accidentally if the check fails by 5 or more. The alarm brings the following defenders, who attack all intruders in the room:
zh_tw: 直徑一尺的盤形瓷磚，作為散塔林會標誌的硬幣，實際上是一個壓力板。當被按下或踩踏時，它會敲響一個在整個聖所都能聽到的魔法鑼。警報可以透過成功進行{@dc 20}敏捷檢定並使用盜賊工具來解除，但如果檢定失敗超過5點或更多，警報將意外觸發。警報會召喚以下守衛者，他們攻擊房間內的所有入侵者：

english: {@creature Kaevja Cynavern|wdh} (see {@area E3|41b})
zh_tw: {@creature Kaevja Cynavern|wdh|凱夫賈·西納文}（見{@area E3|41b}）

english: The {@creature Manshoon simulacrum|wdh} (see {@area E7|420})
zh_tw: {@creature Manshoon simulacrum|wdh|曼松的擬像}（見{@area E7|420}）

english: Vevette Blackwater and Agorn Fuoco (see {@area E8|425})
zh_tw: 薇薇特·黑水和阿戈恩·弗奧科（見 {@area E8|425}）

english: {@creature Zhent Martial Arts Adept|wdh|Havia Quickknife} and {@creature Zhent Martial Arts Adept|wdh|Mookie Plush} (see {@area E10|42a})
zh_tw: {@creature Zhent Martial Arts Adept|wdh|哈維亞·快刀} 和 {@creature Zhent Martial Arts Adept|wdh|穆基·普拉什}（見{@area E10|42a}）

english: Alarm Responders
zh_tw: 警報響應者

english: If the characters manage to overcome all these foes, they are free to explore the sanctum. {@creature Manshoon|WDH} awaits them in {@area E12|42e}.
zh_tw: 如果角色們設法戰勝了所有這些敵人，他們就可以自由地探索避難所。{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}在{@area E12|42e}等待他們。

english: Characters who are reduced to 0 hit points by {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s defenders are knocked {@condition unconscious}. If the entire party is defeated, the {@condition unconscious} characters are stripped of their spellbooks and magic items (including any {@item teleporter ring|WDH|teleporter rings} they obtained in Kolat Towers). They then awaken in a back alley of Waterdeep with 1 hit point each. If the characters return to Kolat Towers, they find the place cleared out and the teleportation circle in {@area K22|40b} permanently dispelled.
zh_tw: 被{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的守衛將生命值降至0的角色會進入{@condition unconscious||昏迷}狀態。如果整個隊伍被擊敗，{@condition unconscious||昏迷}的角色將被剝奪他們的法術書和魔法物品（包括他們在克拉特雙塔中獲得的任何{@item teleporter ring|WDH|傳送戒指}）。然後他們會在深水城的一條後巷中醒來，每個人只剩下1點生命值。如果角色們返回克拉特雙塔，他們會發現那裡已經被清空，並且{@area K22|40b}中的傳送法陣被永久性地解除了。

english: Masks of Manshoon
zh_tw: 曼松的面具

english: The masks belong to {@creature Manshoon|WDH} and have been worn by him in the past. A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar magic reveals an aura of evocation magic around each one. Any creature that dons a mask takes 9 ({@dice 2d8}) lightning damage. Once this effect triggers, the mask becomes nonmagical and harmless.
zh_tw: 這些面具屬於{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}，並且他過去曾經佩戴過。一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似的魔法可以揭示每個面具周圍的咒語魔法光環。任何戴上面具的生物都會受到9點（{@dice 2d8}）閃電傷害。一旦這個效果被觸發，面具就會變成非魔法的，並且變得無害。

english: E3. Guard Station
zh_tw: E3. 守衛站

english: A 5-foot-square window in this area looks out toward {@area E1|413}. Unless she has been drawn elsewhere, {@creature Kaevja Cynavern|wdh} stands watch in front of the window.
zh_tw: 這個區域有一個5尺見方的窗戶，朝向 {@area E1|413}。除非她被引到別處，{@creature Kaevja Cynavern|wdh|凱夫賈·西納文} 站在窗戶前守望。

english: Kaevja was a Red Wizard of Thay until she saw an opportunity to study magic under {@creature Manshoon|WDH}. Before he accepted her, {@creature Manshoon|WDH} forced her to remove her distinctive Thayan head tattoos and to trade in her Red Wizard robes for black ones.
zh_tw: 凱夫賈曾是賽爾的紅袍法師，直到她看到了在{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}下學習魔法的機會。在他接受她之前，{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}強迫她移除了她那獨特的賽爾頭部紋身，並將她的紅袍法師長袍換成了黑色的。

english: {@creature Kaevja Cynavern|wdh} is a female Mulan human {@creature mage}, with these changes:
zh_tw: {@creature Kaevja Cynavern|wdh|凱夫賈·西納文} 是一位女性穆蘭人人類 {@creature mage||魔法師}，有以下變更：

english: Kaevja is lawful evil. She knows Common, Draconic, Dwarvish, and Elvish.
zh_tw: 凱夫賈是守序邪惡。她懂得通用語、龍語、矮人語和精靈語。

english: She has the {@spell sending} spell prepared instead of the {@spell fly} spell, and she carries a yellow {@i elemental gem}.
zh_tw: 她準備好了 {@spell sending||短訊術} 法術，而不是 {@spell fly||飛行術} 法術，並且攜帶了一顆黃色的 {@i 元素寶石}。

english: In battle, Kaevja breaks the {@i elemental gem}, summoning an {@creature earth elemental} and commanding it to attack her enemies.
zh_tw: 在戰鬥中，凱夫賈打破 {@i 元素寶石}，召喚一個 {@creature earth elemental||土元素} 並命令它攻擊她的敵人。

english: E4. Pantry
zh_tw: E4. 食品儲藏室

english: This room contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間包含以下特點：

english: Floor-to-ceiling shelves are stuffed with breads, cheeses, dried meats, nuts, and a few baskets of fresh produce.
zh_tw: 從地板到天花板的架子上堆滿了麵包、乳酪、乾肉、堅果，以及一些裝有新鮮農產品的籃子。

english: Two barrels labeled "WATER" and two labeled "ALE" are crammed into a corner.
zh_tw: 兩個標有"水"的桶和兩個標有「麥酒」的桶被塞在角落裡。

english: E5. Laboratory
zh_tw: E5. 實驗室

english: This room contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間包含以下特點：

english: Beakers, bottles, and test tubes are set on a marble table in the middle of this room, next to a basin of water.
zh_tw: 燒杯、瓶子和試管擺放在這個房間中央的大理石桌上，旁邊是一個水盆。

english: One staircase descends 10 feet to {@area E2|417}, and another ascends 10 feet to {@area E6|41f}.
zh_tw: 一條樓梯向下延伸10尺到 {@area E2|417}，另一條向上延伸10尺到 {@area E6|41f}。

english: Urstul Floxin
zh_tw: 厄斯圖爾·弗洛克辛

english: If he survived earlier encounters with the characters, {@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) stands at the table, dourly scrubbing lab equipment. He is being punished for allowing the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} to slip through his fingers (during the events of chapter 3). Nevertheless, he remains loyal to {@creature Manshoon|WDH}. If he is confronted, Urstul feigns anger toward the wizard and offers to help the characters defeat him, but this ruse can be seen through by someone who makes a successful {@dc 14} Wisdom (Insight) check. Given the chance, Urstul leads the characters to {@creature Manshoon|WDH}, then attacks them to prove his unwavering loyalty in front of his master.
zh_tw: 如果他在之前的遭遇中倖存下來，{@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh|厄斯圖爾·弗洛克辛}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）會站在桌旁，陰沉地擦洗實驗室裝置。他因為讓{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}從手中溜走（在第3章的事件中）而受到懲罰。儘管如此，他仍然忠於{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}。如果他被質問，厄斯圖爾會假裝對法師發怒，並主動提出幫助角色們擊敗他，但這種詭計可以被成功透過{@dc 14}感知（洞悉）檢定的人識破。如果有機會，厄斯圖爾會將角色們帶到{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}面前，然後攻擊他們，以在主上面前證明他的堅定忠誠。

english: If the characters fall for Urstul's ruse but nevertheless demand that he relinquish his weapons in order to accompany them, the Zhent assassin laughs at them and attacks.
zh_tw: 如果角色們被厄斯圖爾的詭計所欺騙，但仍然要求他交出武器以便陪同他們，這位散塔林會成員刺客會嘲笑他們並攻擊。

english: E6. Binding Chamber
zh_tw: E6. 繫結室

english: A circle inscribed with runes is carved into the alabaster floor of this room. It radiates an aura of abjuration magic when targeted by a {@spell detect magic} spell or similar magic.
zh_tw: 這個房間的雪花石膏地板上刻有一個符文環繞的圓圈。當被 {@spell detect magic||偵測魔法} 法術或類似魔法瞄準時，它散發出防護魔法的氣息。

english: {@creature Manshoon|WDH} uses the circle to bind extraplanar creatures. When a celestial, an elemental, a fey, or a fiend is summoned inside the circle, it can't voluntarily leave that area until its summoner uses an action to suppress the circle's magic for 1 minute. The magic is also suppressed if any part of the circle falls within an {@spell antimagic field}, or if {@spell dispel magic} ({@dc 17}) is successfully cast on it.
zh_tw: {@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松} 使用這個法陣來束縛跨位面生物。當天界生物、元素生物、精類生物或惡魔被召喚到法陣內時，它無法自願離開該區域，除非召喚者用一個動作來壓製法陣的魔法1分鐘。如果法陣的任何部分位於 {@spell antimagic field||反魔法場} 範圍內，或者 {@spell dispel magic||解除魔法} ({@dc 17}) 成功對其施放，法陣的魔法也會被壓制。

english: E7. Manshoon's Simulacrum
zh_tw: E7. 曼松的模擬像

english: This room is extremely cold and contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間極其寒冷，包含以下特點：

english: Frigid air blows into the room through small vents in the floor. In the middle of the room is an open sarcophagus carved from ice, which contains a humanoid figure made of snow.
zh_tw: 寒冷的空氣透過地板上的小通風口吹進房間。房間中央是一個由冰雕刻而成的開放式石棺，裡面裝著一個由雪製成的人形生物。

english: The back wall is made of 5-inch-thick curved glass. Frost covers the glass, partially blotting out the swirling purple mist of the demiplane beyond.
zh_tw: 後牆由5吋厚的彎曲玻璃製成。霜覆蓋在玻璃上，部分遮擋了另一邊半位面上旋轉的紫色霧氣。

english: Simulacrum
zh_tw: 擬像術

english: If it hasn't been summoned elsewhere, {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s simulacrum (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) is standing before the glass wall with its back to the door. The simulacrum resembles a robed wizard with long black hair, pale skin, and an articulated metal left hand and forearm. Its face is concealed behind a steel mask that bears a smiling visage. The simulacrum attacks anyone it doesn't recognize.
zh_tw: 如果它沒有被召喚到其他地方，{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的模擬像（見 {@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）背對著門站在玻璃牆前。模擬像看起來像是一個穿著長袍的法師，有著長長的黑髮、蒼白的皮膚，以及一個可動的金屬左手和前臂。它的臉被一個帶著微笑表情的鋼製面具遮住。模擬像會攻擊它不認識的任何人。

english: Extreme Cold
zh_tw: 極度寒冷

english: The rules for {@hazard extreme cold} (see chapter 5 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|dmg}) apply in this room.
zh_tw: 該房間適用{@hazard extreme cold||極度寒冷}規則（參見{@book 城主指南|dmg}第5章）。

english: Glass Wall
zh_tw: 玻璃牆

english: Each 5-foot section of glass wall has AC 13, 30 hit points, and immunity to acid, poison, and psychic damage. The purple mist that fills the demiplane doesn't enter this room even if the glass is shattered.
zh_tw: 每段5尺的玻璃牆具有AC 13，30生命值，並對酸性、毒素和心靈傷害免疫。即使玻璃被打碎，填充半位面的紫色霧氣也不會進入這個房間。

english: Simulacrum Sarcophagus
zh_tw: 模擬像石棺

english: This ice-carved container weighs 1,000 pounds and begins to melt if taken out of the room. The snow figure in the sarcophagus is part of the material component of a {@spell simulacrum} spell. {@creature Manshoon|WDH} can use it to create a new simulacrum if his current one is destroyed.
zh_tw: 這個由冰雕成的容器重1000磅，如果被帶出房間就會開始融化。石棺中的雪人是 {@spell simulacrum||擬像術} 法術的一個材料成分。如果當前的模擬像被摧毀，{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松} 可以使用它來創造一個新的模擬像。

english: E8. Reading Room
zh_tw: E8. 閱讀室

english: This room contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間包含以下特點：

english: Delightful warmth radiates from a brazier of green flame encircled by eight cushioned chairs.
zh_tw: 從八個帶墊子的椅子環繞的綠色火焰火盆中散發出令人愉悅的溫暖。

english: Unless they've been drawn elsewhere, two of {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s lieutenants are here: Vevette Blackwater (CE female Tethyrian human {@creature swashbuckler|VGM}; see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) and Agorn Fuoco (NE male Turami human {@creature bard|VGM}; see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}). Vevette is relaxing in a chair, while Agorn strums a lyre.
zh_tw: 除非他們被引到其他地方，{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的兩位副手在這裡：薇薇特·黑水（CE 女性泰瑟爾人人類 {@creature swashbuckler|VGM|風流劍客}；見 {@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）和阿戈恩·弗奧科（NE 男性圖拉米人人類 {@creature bard|VGM|吟遊詩人}；見 {@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）。薇薇特正坐在椅子上休息，而阿戈恩正在彈奏里拉琴。

english: An alabaster staircase ascends 10 feet to {@area E9|428}.
zh_tw: 一段雪花石膏製成的樓梯上升10尺至{@area E9|428}。

english: Zhents
zh_tw: 散塔林會成員

english: Vevette and Agorn are two of {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s most trusted followers. Vevette commands the wizard's forces against the Xanathar Guild, while Agorn commands those who oppose the Zhents that aren't loyal to {@creature Manshoon|WDH}. At the moment, they are resting in the sanctum while awaiting orders from {@creature Manshoon|WDH}.
zh_tw: 薇薇特和阿戈恩是 {@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松} 最信任的追隨者之二。薇薇特指揮法師的部隊對抗姍娜薩公會，而阿戈恩指揮那些反對不屬於 {@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松} 忠誠的散塔林會成員的人。目前，他們正在聖所中休息，同時等待來自 {@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松} 的命令。

english: Green Flame Brazier
zh_tw: 綠焰火盆

english: A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar magic reveals an aura of evocation magic around the brazier. The brazier casts a {@spell fireball} spell (save {@dc 15}) centered on itself whenever a creature in the room speaks the words "green flame" aloud. Once the brazier has cast this spell, it can't do so again for another 24 hours. Agorn knows this feature of the brazier, and he uses it in combat if the situation is desperate.
zh_tw: 一個 {@spell detect magic||偵測魔法} 法術或類似的魔法會顯示出一個環繞著祭壇的塑能魔法靈光。每當房間內的生物大聲說出 "綠色火焰" 這個詞時，祭壇會在自身中心施放一個 {@spell fireball||火球術} 法術（豁免 {@dc 15}）。一旦祭壇施放過這個法術，它在接下來的24小時內無法再次施放。阿戈恩知道祭壇的這個特性，並在情況危急時用於戰鬥中。

english: E9. Library
zh_tw: E9. 圖書館

english: Alabaster shelves line every wall and jut out into the center of this room, all of them packed with books that deal with subjects of interest to wizards. {@creature Manshoon|WDH} has amassed a sizable collection, including ten rare volumes he removed from Duhlark Kolat's collection.
zh_tw: 雪花石膏製成的書架沿著每面牆排列，並延伸到房間中央，上面擺滿了對法師感興趣的書籍。{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松} 積累了相當大的藏書量，包括他從杜拉克·克拉特的收藏中移除的十本稀有卷冊。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Each rare book is worth 50 gp, and the entire collection is worth 5,000 gp.
zh_tw: 每本稀有書籍價值50金幣，整個收藏的價值為5000金幣。

english: E10. Audience Chamber
zh_tw: E10. 接見室

english: High-ranking Zhents who desire an audience with {@creature Manshoon|WDH} come here. The room contains the following features:
zh_tw: 希望與 {@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松} 會面的高階散塔林會成員人員會來到這裡。這個房間包含以下特點：
