english: The area is split into two levels, with alabaster steps climbing 3 feet to a smaller raised platform overlooking the larger area. The platform is bare except for three golden banners hanging on the back wall, each displaying the symbol of the Zhentarim—a black, winged snake biting a coin.
zh_tw: 這個區域被分為兩個層次，雪花石膏臺階上升3尺到達一個較小的升高平臺，俯瞰著更大的區域。平臺除了後牆上掛著的三面金色旗幟外，別無他物，每面旗幟上都展示著散塔林會的標誌——一條黑色的、有翼的蛇在咬著一枚硬幣。

english: The lower part of the room contains a black marble table surrounded by high-backed wooden chairs. The table stands out in stark contrast against the alabaster walls and floor.
zh_tw: 房間的下半部分包含一張黑色大理石桌，周圍是高背木椅。這張桌子與雪花石膏的牆壁和地板形成鮮明對比。

english: If they haven't been drawn elsewhere, two of {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s followers are sparring and engaged in mock fisticuffs atop the table.
zh_tw: 如果他們沒有被引到其他地方，{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的兩名追隨者正在桌子上進行格鬥和模擬拳擊。

english: Zhents
zh_tw: 散塔林會成員

english: Two female lightfoot halflings—{@creature Zhent Martial Arts Adept|wdh|Havia Quickknife} and {@creature Zhent Martial Arts Adept|wdh|Mookie Plush}—believe that {@creature Manshoon|WDH} is the rightful leader of the Zhentarim. They serve him fearlessly, and will sacrifice themselves to ensure that his plans come to fruition. They are {@creature martial arts adept|VGM|martial arts adepts} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), with these changes:
zh_tw: 兩位女性輕足半身人——{@creature Zhent Martial Arts Adept|wdh|哈維亞·快刀}和{@creature Zhent Martial Arts Adept|wdh|穆基·普拉什}——認為{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}是散塔林會的合法領袖。她們無畏地為他服務，並會為他的計劃能夠成功實施而犧牲自己。她們是{@creature martial arts adept|VGM|武術高手}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），並有以下變化：

english: Havia and Mookie are lawful evil.
zh_tw: 哈維亞和穆基是守序邪惡。

english: They have 49 ({@dice 11d6 + 11}) hit points each.
zh_tw: 它們每個有49點（{@dice 11d6 + 11}）生命值。

english: They have these racial traits: They are Small, and their walking speed is 25 feet. They can move through the space of a Medium or larger creature. They have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition frightened}. They speak Common and Halfling.
zh_tw: 他們具有以下種族特徵：體型為小型，步行速度為25尺。他們可以透過中型或更大型生物的空間。他們在豁免檢定中對被{@condition frightened||恐懼}有優勢。他們說通用語和半身人語。

english: Havia and Mookie each wear a {@item teleporter ring|WDH} (see "Teleporter Rings").
zh_tw: 哈維亞和穆基每人都佩戴著一個 {@item teleporter ring|WDH|傳送戒指}（見"傳送戒指"）。

english: E11. Zhent Quarters
zh_tw: E11. 散塔林會成員宿舍

english: This room contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間包含以下特點：

english: Pressed against the walls of this room are five wooden beds (three sized for humans, two for halflings).
zh_tw: 這個房間的牆壁上緊挨著五張木床（三張適合人類，兩張適合半身人）。

english: Next to each bed is a wooden chest.
zh_tw: 每張床旁邊都有一個木製箱子。

english: An alabaster staircase descends to {@area E12|42e}.
zh_tw: 一個雪花石膏樓梯向下通往 {@area E12|42e}。

english: {@creature Kaevja Cynavern|wdh}, Vevette Blackwater, Agorn Fuoco, {@creature Zhent Martial Arts Adept|wdh|Havia Quickknife}, and {@creature Zhent Martial Arts Adept|wdh|Mookie Plush} all sleep here.
zh_tw: {@creature Kaevja Cynavern|wdh|凱夫賈·西納文}、薇薇特·黑水、阿戈恩·弗奧科、{@creature Zhent Martial Arts Adept|wdh|哈維亞·快刀} 和 {@creature Zhent Martial Arts Adept|wdh|穆基·普拉什} 都在這裡睡覺。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: In addition to folded clothes and worthless personal effects, each of the chests holds treasure.
zh_tw: 除了疊好的衣服和無價值的個人物品外，每個箱子裡都裝有寶藏。

english: Kaevja's chest contains a gold amulet inset with a red crystal rune (worth 250 gp). A successful {@dc 15} Intelligence (Arcana) check reveals that the rune is a symbol of evocation, though the amulet is nonmagical.
zh_tw: 凱夫賈的寶箱中有一枚鑲有紅色水晶符文（價值250金幣）的金質護身符。成功的{@dc 15}智力（奧秘）檢定可以揭示出這枚符文是召喚術的象徵，儘管護身符本身沒有魔法效果。

english: Vevette's chest has three {@item potion of healing||potions of healing}.
zh_tw: 薇薇特的箱子裡有三瓶{@item potion of healing||治療藥水}。

english: Agorn's chest contains a bundle of love letters from someone named Tamzyn. Hidden in one of the envelopes is an elegant platinum necklace (worth 250 gp), featuring a tiny cameo containing a sketched portrait of a beautiful Turami woman.
zh_tw: 阿戈恩的箱子裡裝有來自一個名叫塔姆津的人的一束情書。在一個信封裡隱藏著一條優雅的白金項鍊（價值250金幣），上面有一個小巧的浮雕，內含一位美麗的圖拉米人女性的素描肖像。

english: In Havia's chest is a golden comb shaped like a stylized dragon with tiny rubies for eyes (worth 250 gp).
zh_tw: 哈維亞的箱子裡有一把金色的梳子，形狀像一條風格化的龍，眼睛上鑲嵌著細小的紅寶石（價值250金幣）。

english: Mookie's chest contains a tiny halfling doll. Stuffed inside the doll is a pouch that holds five 100 gp pearls.
zh_tw: 穆基的箱子裡有一個小巧的半身人玩偶。玩偶裡面塞著一個小袋，裝有五顆價值100金幣的珍珠。

english: E12. Manshoon's Quarters
zh_tw: E12. 曼松的住處

english: {@creature Manshoon|WDH}
zh_tw: {@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}

english: No one aside from {@creature Manshoon|WDH} is allowed down here. The alabaster stairs that lead to this room descend 10 feet farther to {@area E13|430}.
zh_tw: 除了{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}之外，沒有人被允許進入這裡。通往這個房間的雪花石膏樓梯再向下延伸10尺到達{@area E13|430}。

english: This room contains the following features:
zh_tw: 這個房間包含以下特點：

english: Across from the stairs stands a large bed with purple sheets. Sitting on the edge of the bed is a handsome young male human in elegant robes. Long black hair partially conceals his angelic face as he attaches a metal appendage to the withered stump of his left arm.
zh_tw: 樓梯對面是一張大床，鋪著紫色床單。坐在床邊的是一位英俊的年輕男性人類，穿著優雅的長袍。他長長的黑髮部分遮住了他那天使般的面孔，因為他正在給他左臂枯萎的殘肢安裝一個金屬附件。

english: The only other piece of furniture is a table with legs carved to resemble winged serpents. Displayed on the table is a metal mask with an intimidating, tyrannical visage.
zh_tw: 房間裡唯一的另一件傢俱是一張桌子，桌腿雕刻成有翼的蛇形。桌上展示著一個金屬面具，面具上有一個令人生畏、暴君般的面容。

english: The handsome young figure is {@creature Manshoon|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), who is much older than he looks.
zh_tw: 這位英俊的年輕人是 {@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}（見 {@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），他的實際年齡遠比看起來要大。

english: This version of {@creature Manshoon|WDH} isn't spoiling for a fight. He commends the characters for making it this far and shows no concern for the Zhents they defeated to reach him, since he considers all his followers expendable.
zh_tw: 這個版本的 {@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松} 並不尋求戰鬥。他對角色們能夠到達這裡表示讚賞，並且對他們擊敗的散塔林會成員毫不關心，因為他認為所有的追隨者都是可以犧牲的。

english: The characters' best chance of survival is to convince {@creature Manshoon|WDH} that they can be cowed or bribed into working for him. Weary of his conflict with the Xanathar Guild, {@creature Manshoon|WDH} suggests that the characters prove their usefulness to him by hunting down and killing {@creature Xanathar|WDH} in its lair (see chapter 5). {@creature Manshoon|WDH} also demands that they keep his presence in Waterdeep a secret for now, saying that he will reward them for their discretion "when the time comes." In exchange, he allows the characters to return to Waterdeep and promises them positions of power in his organization once {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s death is confirmed. He has no intention of making good on this promise, but refusing to work for him puts the characters in a tight spot, since the evil archwizard can't risk exposure.
zh_tw: 角色們生存的最佳機會是說服 {@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松} 他們可以被嚇倒或被賄賂為他工作。厭倦了與姍娜薩公會的衝突，{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松} 建議角色們透過追捕並殺死其巢穴中的 {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}（見第5章）來證明他們對他的用處。{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松} 還要求他們暫時保守他在深水城的存在的秘密，說他會為他們的謹慎在"時機成熟時"給予獎勵。作為交換，他允許角色們返回深水城，並承諾一旦確認了 {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩} 的死亡，他將在組織中給予他們權力地位。他無意兌現這一承諾，但拒絕為他工作會讓角色們陷入困境，因為這位邪惡的大法師不能冒險曝光。

english: If a fight breaks out, {@creature Manshoon|WDH} grabs his {@item staff of power} (which he hides under the bed) and holds his ground. For more information on how to play {@creature Manshoon|WDH}, see "Facing {@creature Manshoon|WDH}" at the beginning of this chapter.
zh_tw: 如果發生戰鬥，{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松} 會抓起他的 {@item staff of power||威力法杖}（他藏在床下）並堅守陣地。有關如何扮演 {@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松} 的更多資訊，請參見本章開頭的"面對 {@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}"。

english: Tyrant's Mask
zh_tw: 暴君面具

english: The mask on the table is nonmagical, but {@creature Manshoon|WDH} likes to put it on before meeting with his followers.
zh_tw: 桌上的面具是非魔法的，但 {@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松} 喜歡在會見他的追隨者之前戴上它。

english: E13. Manshoon's Study
zh_tw: E13. 曼松的書房

english: The alabaster stairs end here. The room contains the following features:
zh_tw: 雪花石膏樓梯在這裡結束。這個房間包含以下特點：

english: A plush lavender carpet covers the floor.
zh_tw: 一塊柔軟的淡紫色地毯覆蓋著地板。

english: In one far corner of the room, a low table is set between two purple couches. The table has a thin drawer built into it.
zh_tw: 在房間的一個遠角，一張低矮的桌子擺放在兩張紫色沙發之間。這張桌子內建有一個薄抽屜。

english: In the other far corner, {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s spellbook rests atop a black marble lectern protected by an {@condition invisible} {@creature helmed horror}. The construct attacks anyone other than {@creature Manshoon|WDH} who disturbs the book (becoming visible as it does so). It obeys {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s commands if he is present, and it fights until destroyed.
zh_tw: 在房間的另一個遠角，{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的咒語書放在一個由一個{@condition invisible||隱形}的{@creature helmed horror||恐怖鎧甲}保護的黑色大理石講臺上。這個構裝生物會攻擊任何除了{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}之外擾亂書籍的人（在這樣做的時候變得可見）。如果{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}在場，它會服從他的命令，並戰鬥直到被摧毀。

english: Table
zh_tw: 表格

english: The table's drawer has an {@spell arcane lock} spell cast on it. The spell can be bypassed by someone who makes a successful {@dc 25} Dexterity check using thieves' tools, or with a {@spell knock} spell or similar magic. The drawer can also be forced open with a successful {@dc 21} Strength (Athletics) check. Inside is a leather-bound ledger that provides a paper trail implicating {@creature Manshoon|WDH} in two blackmail schemes. An hour spent studying the ledger uncovers the following information:
zh_tw: 桌子的抽屜上被施放了{@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖}法術。該法術可以透過使用盜賊工具成功透過{@dc 25}敏捷檢定的人，或使用{@spell knock||敲擊術}法術或類似魔法來繞過。抽屜也可以透過成功透過{@dc 21}力量（運動）檢定強行開啟。裡面是一本皮革裝訂的賬本，提供了紙面線索，將{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}與兩個勒索計劃聯絡起來。花一個小時研究賬本可以揭示以下資訊：

english: Corylus Thann, a racist Waterdavian noble, is paying the Zhentarim not to reveal that he hired Zhent thugs to assault non-humans.
zh_tw: 科里勒斯·坦恩，一個種族主義的沃特迪普貴族，正在向散塔林會支付費用，以防止他們透露他僱傭散塔林會成員暴徒襲擊非人類。

english: Jelenn Urmbrusk, a Waterdavian noble, receives regular payments from the Zhentarim to offset monies he loses in bad investments.
zh_tw: 傑倫·烏姆布魯斯克，一位沃特迪普貴族，定期從散塔林會那裡收到款項，以彌補他在不良投資中的損失。

english: The ledger doesn't reveal that Corylus Thann and Jelenn Urmbrusk are Masked Lords, or that {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s blackmail of them also forces them to use their influence to cover up or dismiss crimes perpetrated by {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s forces in Waterdeep. If the authorities obtain the ledger, they round up anyone suspected of having ties to {@creature Manshoon|WDH} or the Zhentarim, which disrupts the wizard's operation (see "Disrupting {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s Operation"). Surprisingly, neither Corylus nor Jelenn is arrested or even questioned.
zh_tw: 賬簿沒有透露科里勒斯·坦恩和傑倫·烏姆布魯斯克是蒙面領主，也沒有透露 {@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松} 對他們的勒索還迫使他們利用他們的影響力來掩蓋或駁回由 {@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松} 的部隊在深水城犯下的罪行。如果當局獲得賬簿，他們將圍捕任何涉嫌與 {@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松} 或散塔林會有聯絡的人，這會破壞法師的行動（見"破壞 {@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松} 的行動"）。令人驚訝的是，科里勒斯和傑倫既沒有被逮捕，甚至沒有被審問。

english: Slipped into the ledger is a piece of paper with a list of names in {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s handwriting. {@creature Manshoon|WDH} keeps this list of Masked Lords whose identities he knows, with check marks indicating the ones he's blackmailing:
zh_tw: 在賬簿中夾著一張紙，上面有一份名字列表，是 {@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松} 的手寫。{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松} 保留這份他知道身份的蒙面領主名單，用勾號表示那些他正在勒索的人：

english: {@creature Mirt|WDH}
zh_tw: {@creature Mirt|WDH|米爾特}

english: Corylus Thann √
zh_tw: 科里勒斯·坦恩 √

english: Thardouk Starbuckler
zh_tw: 薩杜克·星盾

english: Jelenn Urmbrusk √
zh_tw: 傑倫·烏姆布魯斯克 √

english: Dorgar Adarbrent
zh_tw: 多爾加·阿達布倫特

english: Manshoon's Spellbook
zh_tw: 曼松的咒語書

english: This spellbook weighs 20 pounds and is covered in beholder hide. It contains all the spells {@creature Manshoon|WDH} has prepared (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) plus the following spells: {@spell alarm}, {@spell alter self}, {@spell animate dead}, {@spell antimagic field}, {@spell arcane lock}, {@spell blight}, {@spell dispel magic}, {@spell dominate monster}, {@spell dream}, {@spell etherealness}, {@spell Evard's black tentacles}, {@spell feather fall}, {@spell fireball}, {@spell fly}, {@spell gaseous form}, {@spell geas}, {@spell gentle repose}, {@spell glyph of warding}, {@spell hold monster}, {@spell major image}, {@spell mass suggestion}, {@spell phantom steed}, {@spell protection from evil and good}, {@spell scrying}, {@spell symbol}, {@spell telekinesis}, {@spell teleport}, {@spell teleportation circle}, {@spell Tenser's floating disk}, {@spell tongues}, {@spell true seeing}, {@spell vampiric touch}, {@spell wall of fire}, and {@spell wish}. Stealing or destroying this spellbook disrupts {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s operation (see "Disrupting {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s Operation"), since he must devote time and resources to retrieving or replacing it.
zh_tw: 這本咒語書重20磅，封面是眼魔的皮。它包含了所有{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}準備的咒語（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）以及以下咒語：{@spell alarm||警報術}、{@spell alter self||變身術}、{@spell animate dead||活化死屍}、{@spell antimagic field||反魔法場}、{@spell arcane lock||秘法鎖}、{@spell blight||枯萎術}、{@spell dispel magic||解除魔法}、{@spell dominate monster||支配怪物}、{@spell dream||託夢術}、{@spell etherealness||以太化}、{@spell Evard's black tentacles||艾伐黑觸手}、{@spell feather fall||羽落術}、{@spell fireball||火球術}、{@spell fly||飛行術}、{@spell gaseous form||氣化形體}、{@spell geas||指使術}、{@spell gentle repose||遺體防腐}、{@spell glyph of warding||守衛刻文}、{@spell hold monster||定身怪物}、{@spell major image||高等幻影}、{@spell mass suggestion||群體暗示術}、{@spell phantom steed||魅影駒}、{@spell protection from evil and good||防護善惡}、{@spell scrying||探知術}、{@spell symbol||徽記術}、{@spell telekinesis||心靈遙控}、{@spell teleport||傳送術}、{@spell teleportation circle||傳送法陣}、{@spell Tenser's floating disk||譚森浮碟術}、{@spell tongues||巧言術}、{@spell true seeing||真知術}、{@spell vampiric touch||吸血鬼之觸}、{@spell wall of fire||火牆術} 和 {@spell wish||祈願術}。偷竊或摧毀這本咒語書會破壞{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的行動（見"破壞{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的行動"），因為他必須投入時間和資源來取回或替換它。

english: If {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH} has the opportunity to trade for {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s spellbook, she offers the characters a {@item sailing ship} and a set of {@item bracers of archery} for it. {@creature Vajra Safahr|WDH} offers the characters membership in Force Grey, a {@item cape of the mountebank}, and a {@item wand of lightning bolts} for the book.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}有機會交換{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的咒語書，她會為它提供給角色們一艘{@item sailing ship||帆船}和一套{@item bracers of archery||射手護腕}。{@creature Vajra Safahr|WDH|瓦婕拉·莎法爾}為這本書提供給角色們加入灰色力量的會員資格、一件{@item cape of the mountebank||江湖騙子披風}和一根{@item wand of lightning bolts||閃電束魔杖}。

english: Stone of Golorr
zh_tw: 格洛爾之石

english: If {@creature Manshoon|WDH} has the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, he keeps it in the drawer of the table along with his ledger.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}擁有{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，他會將它和賬簿一起放在桌子的抽屜裡。

english: Special Events
zh_tw: 特殊事件

english: You can use one or more of the following special events before or after the characters explore Kolat Towers and {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s extradimensional sanctum.
zh_tw: 在角色探索克拉特雙塔和{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的超維度聖所之前或之後，您可以使用以下一個或多個特殊事件。

english: Blackmailed Lords
zh_tw: 被勒索的領主

english: The events described in this section might occur if the characters obtain the ledger from {@area E13|430} and use the information in it to confront either Corylus Thann or Jelenn Urmbrusk about their suspicious dealings with {@creature Manshoon|WDH}. The Thann and Umbrusk families have walled estates in the Sea Ward.
zh_tw: 如果角色們從{@area E13|430}獲得賬簿，並利用其中的資訊來面對科里勒斯·坦恩或傑倫·烏姆布魯斯克，詢問他們與{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}可疑交易的情況，本節描述的事件可能會發生。坦恩和烏姆布魯斯克家族在海區擁有圍牆的莊園。

english: Corylus Thann
zh_tw: 科里勒斯·坦恩

english: The Thanns are Waterdeep's most prominent vintners and have deep roots in the city. Corylus (LE male Tethyrian human {@creature noble}) is happy to let other members of his family manage the wine business while he focuses on his duties as a Masked Lord. Unfortunately, he lacks the principles and sound judgment that have led to House Thann's success in the past. He also places the welfare of humans above non-humans. In the past, he has used Zhentarim thugs to inflict harm on non-humans who sought positions of political power in the city. Now the Zhents are blackmailing Corylus, threatening to expose his bigotry unless he uses his influence as a Masked Lord to cover up their illegal activities.
zh_tw: 坦恩家族是深水城最著名的葡萄酒商，在這座城市有著深厚的根基。科里勒斯（LE 男性泰瑟爾人人類 {@creature noble||貴族}）樂於讓他家族的其他成員管理葡萄酒業務，而他則專注於作為蒙面領主的職責。不幸的是，他缺乏原則和健全的判斷力，這些曾使坦恩家族在過去取得成功。他還把人類的福祉置於非人類之上。過去，他曾利用散塔林會暴徒對尋求城市政治權力的非人類造成傷害。現在，散塔林會成員正在勒索科里勒斯，威脅要揭露他的偏執，除非他利用作為蒙面領主的影響力來掩蓋他們的非法活動。

english: The characters are most likely to encounter Corylus as he travels through the city by coach, accompanied by six human {@creature guard||guards} who watch his back and keep the rabble at bay. Corylus refuses to speak with the party. If the characters become an annoyance, he has eight crooked members of the City Watch (human {@creature veteran||veterans}) crack down on them, then uses his position as Masked Lord to clear any charges leveled against these Watch members. Corylus refuses to be indebted to anyone, so any attempt by the characters to curry favor with him is met with suspicion, if not outright hostility. Even if they dispose of {@creature Manshoon|WDH}, Corylus refuses to acknowledge that he owes them anything.
zh_tw: 角色們最有可能在科里勒斯乘坐馬車穿城而過時遇到他，他身邊有六名人類{@creature guard||警衛}保護他的後背並驅散人群。科里勒斯拒絕與隊伍交談。如果角色們變得討厭，他會讓八名腐敗的城市守衛（人類{@creature veteran||老兵}）對他們進行打壓，然後利用他作為蒙面領主的地位清除對這些警衛成員的任何指控。科里勒斯拒絕欠任何人人情，所以角色們任何試圖討好他的嘗試都會遭到懷疑，如果不是公然敵意的話。即使他們除掉了{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}，科里勒斯也拒絕承認他欠他們任何東西。

english: Jelenn Urmbrusk
zh_tw: 傑倫·烏姆布魯斯克

english: Jelenn (N female Tethyrian human {@creature noble}) is a proud woman in her fifties who desperately wants to get out of debt. Several bad investments ruined her money-lending business, and most of her reliable customers have turned to other providers such as the Cassalanters. Jelenn could have borrowed money from any of a number of nobles in the city or sold off some of the property her family owns in Waterdeep, but doing so would have turned her private financial woes into local gossip. Fear of that exposure led her to borrow money from the Zhentarim instead—a decision she has come to regret. The Zhents working for {@creature Manshoon|WDH} promise to keep their relationship secret on the condition that she do everything in her power to further the group's welfare in Waterdeep.
zh_tw: 傑倫（N 女性泰瑟爾人人類 {@creature noble||貴族}）是一位五十多歲的驕傲女性，她迫切想要擺脫債務。幾筆糟糕的投資破壞了她的放貸業務，而且她的大多數可靠客戶已經轉而求助於其他供應商，如卡薩蘭特家族。傑倫本可以向城市中的許多貴族借錢，或者出售她家族在深水城擁有的一些財產，但這樣做會將她私人的財務困境變成當地的八卦。對曝光的恐懼導致她選擇從散塔林會那裡借錢——一個她後來開始後悔的決定。為{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}工作的散塔林會成員承諾會保守他們的關係秘密，條件是她必須盡一切努力在深水城推進該組織的利益。

english: When not dealing with her slimy creditors, Jelenn is occupied with Masked Lord business. She has no time for a face-to-face meeting with anyone she doesn't know. Characters can confront her as she comes or goes to and from her villa, but she never travels without sixteen {@creature guard||guards} who form a protective wall around her. If the characters brazenly mention {@creature Manshoon|WDH} or the Zhentarim by name to her, Jelenn demands that they leave her alone or face dire consequences. Jelenn's threat is mostly bluster, since she's not eager to make enemies.
zh_tw: 當傑倫不在處理她那些令人討厭的債權人時，她忙於蒙面領主的事務。她沒有時間與任何她不認識的人進行面對面的會面。角色們可以在她進出別墅時面對她，但她從不單獨旅行，總有十六名{@creature guard||警衛}圍繞她形成一個保護牆。如果角色們厚顏無恥地提到{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}或散塔林會的名字，傑倫要求他們不要打擾她，否則將面臨嚴重後果。傑倫的威脅大多是虛張聲勢，因為她並不想樹立敵人。

english: If the characters free Jelenn from the yoke of the Black Network by defeating {@creature Manshoon|WDH}, her debt is effectively canceled. In her delight, she grants them a special favor (see "Special Favors" in chapter 7 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|dmg}). On the other hand, if they threaten to go to the press with {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s ledger in an attempt to blackmail or discredit her, she pretends to go along with them while secretly using her influence as a Masked Lord to make their lives difficult.
zh_tw: 如果角色們透過擊敗{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}使傑倫掙脫了黑網的枷鎖，她的債務實際上就被取消了。欣喜之下，她會給予他們一項特殊恩惠（見{@book 城主指南|dmg}第7章的"特殊恩惠"）。另一方面，如果他們威脅要拿著{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的賬本去媒體曝光，試圖勒索或抹黑她，她會假裝順從他們，同時秘密利用她作為蒙面領主的權勢來給他們製造麻煩。

english: Deadwinter Day Feast
zh_tw: 寒冬日盛宴

english: The Fellowship of Innkeepers—in conjunction with the Bakers' Guild, the Guild of Butchers, and the Vintners', Distillers', and Brewers' Guild—decides to hold a Deadwinter Day feast for the residents of Trollskull Alley. Broxley Fairkettle (see "Sample Guild Representatives"), asks the characters if they would be willing to host the feast in their tavern. He believes the gesture would be appreciated by their neighbors, in light of the recent deaths in the area (see chapter 3).
zh_tw: 客棧老闆聯盟——與麵包師公會、屠夫公會以及釀酒師、蒸餾師和啤酒製造商公會聯合——決定為巨魔顱骨巷的居民舉辦一個寒冬日盛宴。布羅克斯利·費爾凱特（見"樣本公會代表"），詢問角色們是否願意在他們的酒館舉辦盛宴。他認為鑑於該地區最近發生的死亡事件（見第3章），這一舉動會受到鄰居們的歡迎。

english: If the characters offer up their tavern for the feast, guild representatives arrive to stock and decorate it for the event. During the three days before the holiday, the tavern is bustling with activity and excitement. Hundreds show up on the day of the feast to partake—not only residents of Trollskull Alley, but also folk from neighboring streets. There's plenty of food to go around, but the tavern practically groans under the weight of the crowd, and additional tables are set up outside to handle the overflow. People don't appear to mind, even as heavy snow begins to fall. Members of the City Watch are on hand to make sure everyone behaves.
zh_tw: 如果角色們提供他們的酒館來舉辦盛宴，公會代表會來儲備物資併為活動裝飾酒館。節日的前三天，酒館裡充滿了活動和興奮的氣氛。在盛宴當天，有數百人出現參加——不僅有巨魔顱骨巷的居民，還有來自鄰近街道的人們。食物充足，但酒館幾乎在人群的重壓下吱吱作響，還在外邊增設了額外的桌子來處理超額的人流。即使開始下起了大雪，人們似乎也不介意。城市守衛的成員在場確保每個人都表現良好。

english: Nothing violent happens during the Deadwinter Day feast, but the tavern suffers damage as a result of the crowds. The Carpenters', Roofers', and Plaisterers' Guild offers to make repairs for free, but the characters must close the establishment for a tenday to facilitate the work. The closure has no effect on business in the long term, however, since the feast fosters such goodwill that clients return in force when the tavern reopens.
zh_tw: 在寒冬日盛宴期間沒有發生任何暴力事件，但由於人群的原因，酒館遭受了損壞。木匠、屋頂工和石膏匠公會提出免費進行維修，但角色們必須關閉酒館十天以便進行工作。然而，關閉對長期業務沒有影響，因為盛宴培養瞭如此良好的意願，以至於當酒館重新開業時，客戶們會大量回歸。

english: The feast is a great opportunity for characters to hobnob with neighbors, guild members, and City Watch constables, as well as to gather information on local happenings.
zh_tw: 盛宴是角色們與鄰居、公會成員和城市守衛警官交往的絕佳機會，同時也是收集有關當地事件資訊的好時機。

english: {@creature Nat|WDH}, {@creature Jenks|WDH} and {@creature Squiddly|WDH} make the best of Waterdeep's harsh winter
zh_tw: {@creature Nat|WDH|納特}、{@creature Jenks|WDH|詹克斯} 和 {@creature Squiddly|WDH|斯奎迪利} 充分利用了深水城嚴酷的冬天

english: Secret Simulacrum
zh_tw: 秘密模擬像

english: If the characters make an enemy of {@creature Manshoon|WDH}, he tries to capture one of them and replace that character with a magical duplicate created using the {@spell simulacrum} spell. If one of the players is absent for a game session and circumstances allow it, {@creature Manshoon|WDH} targets that character for replacement while the rest of the party is distracted by other matters. You don't need to roleplay the character's capture; just assume it happens. To create a simulacrum of the character, {@creature Manshoon|WDH} needs some hair, fingernail clippings, or other piece of the character's body. Once he obtains the necessary components from the captured character, he creates the simulacrum and sends it to the party with instructions to spy on the group and undermine it from within.
zh_tw: 如果角色們與{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}成為敵人，他會試圖捕獲其中一人，並使用{@spell simulacrum||擬像術}法術創造一個魔法複製品來替換那個角色。如果某位玩家在某次遊戲會議中缺席，並且情況允許，{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}會在隊伍忙於其他事務時將該角色作為替換目標。你不需要扮演角色的捕獲過程；只需假設它發生了。為了創造角色的模擬像，{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}需要一些頭髮、指甲剪下的小片或角色身體的其他部分。一旦他從被捕獲的角色那裡獲得了所需的元件，他就會創造模擬像，並指示它去監視小組並從內部破壞它。

english: If {@creature Manshoon|WDH} embeds a simulacrum within the party, talk privately to the player whose character has been replaced. Then have that player run the simulacrum until it is destroyed or the character it replaced is reintroduced. The simulacrum has the same statistics as the character, but it has only half the character's hit point maximum and can't gain levels.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}在隊伍中嵌入了一個模擬像，私下與被替換角色的玩家交談。然後讓那個玩家操作模擬像，直到它被摧毀或者被它替換的角色重新引入。模擬像擁有與角色相同的具體數值，但它只有角色最大生命值的一半，並且不能升級。

english: Chapter 9: Volo's Waterdeep Enchiridion
zh_tw: 第9章：瓦羅的深水城手冊

english: Welcome, Traveler! You have in your hands the foremost and most up-to-date guide to the city—smiled over by none other than its Open Lord, Lady {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH}. This chapbook will serve you well until my seminal work on the subject, Volo's Guide to Waterdeep—sadly long out of print, but now a tome prized by collectors—can be updated and printed anew. Ask any broadsheet seller, innkeeper, shopkeeper, tavern owner, or bookseller if they'll soon have copies of the new edition for sale!
zh_tw: 歡迎，旅行者！您手中的這本是關於這座城市最前沿、最新的指南——由我們的公開領主，女士 {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手} 親自微笑推薦。這本小冊子將會很好地為您服務，直到我關於這個主題的開創性作品，《瓦羅的深水城指南》——遺憾的是已經絕版很久了，但現在已成為收藏家們珍視的鉅著——能夠更新並重新印刷。問問任何報紙銷售商、旅館老闆、店主、酒館老闆或書商，他們是否很快就會有新版出售的副本！

english: Entering Waterdeep
zh_tw: 進入深水城

english: Likely you have already arrived in Waterdeep and borne witness to some of its many wonders. But in case this pamphlet has found its way beneath your worthy eyes in anticipation of your visit, due to the commendable efforts of some friend or family member who loves you dearly, I shall explain briefly the circumstances of entry.
zh_tw: 你可能已經抵達深水城，並親眼目睹了它的許多奇蹟。但是，如果這本小冊子是因為某些深愛你的朋友或家人的值得稱讚的努力，在你的訪問之前就落入了你尊貴的眼睛，我將簡要解釋入境的情況。

english: You will have traveled through lands claimed and controlled by the Lords of Waterdeep long before you see its walls. If you've come from the south by the Trade Way, you'll have met the City Guard at their post at Zundbridge. From the north by way of the Long Road, you'll have passed under their watchful eyes at the town of Rassalantar. And whether by land or sea, you'll likely also have been spotted by the Griffon Cavalry—even if you have not spotted them.
zh_tw: 在你看到深水城的城牆之前，你已經穿越了水深城領主們聲稱並控制的土地。如果你從南方沿著貿易之路來，你會在宗德橋的哨所遇到城防軍。如果你從北方沿著長路來，你會在拉薩蘭塔爾鎮經過他們警覺的目光。無論你是走陸路還是海路，你很可能也已經被獅鷲騎兵發現——即使你沒有發現他們。

english: Worry not. Waterdeep is a welcoming city, and you have nothing to fear from these guardians unless you lead a rampaging army of orcs, a horde of gnolls, or similar. They don't even require a toll be paid. (Beware any City Guard who demands a toll, and report the incident to a magister of Waterdeep at your earliest convenience.)
zh_tw: 不必擔心。深水城是一個熱情好客的城市，除非你領導著一支暴走的獸人軍隊，一群鬣狗人群落，或類似的情況，否則你無需擔心這些守護者。他們甚至不需要支付通行費。（如果遇到要求通行費的城防軍，請小心，並在方便的時候儘快向深水城的一位法官報告此事。）

english: If you travel in a large caravan or on a ship, you will be required to register with a magister at the gate at which you arrived or with the harbor magister. Magisters can easily be recognized by the black robes they wear (and, in fact, are commonly called "black robes" as a result) and the City Guard force that always accompanies them. Be aware that magisters can pass a sentence without a trial. It behooves you to treat them with proper respect.
zh_tw: 如果你乘坐大型商隊或乘船旅行，你需要在到達的城門處向法官登記，或向港口法官登記。法官們很容易透過他們穿的黑色長袍辨認（事實上，他們通常被稱為"黑袍"，因此得名），以及總是伴隨他們的城防軍力量。請注意，法官可以在沒有審判的情況下作出判決。你應該以適當的尊重對待他們。

english: If you travel overland in a small party or alone, you aren't required to register with a magister unless your stay extends beyond a tenday. At that point, you must register with a magister either at the harbor, the gates, or the city courts. Discovery of your failure to do so can result in a fine or forced labor. Of course, registration subjects you to monthly taxation. But as a truculent old acquaintance from the Dales once told me, "The sheep gives the shepherd its fleece or there'll be mutton for dinner." That is, the magisters will get you either way, so you might as well register up front.
zh_tw: 如果你以小隊或單獨的方式陸路旅行，除非你的停留時間超過十天，否則不需要向法官登記。到那時，你必須在港口、城門或城市法院向法官登記。如果你被發現沒有這麼做，可能會被罰款或強迫勞動。當然，登記會讓你受到每月的徵稅。但正如谷地的一個好鬥的老熟人曾經告訴我的，'羊要麼給牧羊人它的羊毛，要麼晚餐就有羊肉吃。'也就是說，法官們無論如何都會找到你，所以你最好一開始就登記。

english: That said, many canny visitors with business for a month or a season betimes avail themselves of the hospitality of inns in Undercliff, the pleasant farmland east of the city proper. The less well-off often find accommodation in the Field Ward. Because neither are official wards of the city, they aren't subject to taxation. Note, however, that because both these areas have yet to be formally accepted as wards of the city, they don't benefit from the securities of Guild Law or the protection of the Watch. If you choose to follow this path, be on your guard. Fools rush in where auditors fear to tread.
zh_tw: 話雖如此，許多精明的訪客，如果業務需要一個月或一個季節，常常會選擇住在城市東側宜人的農田崖下區的旅館裡。不那麼富裕的人經常在原野區找到住處。因為這兩個地區都不是城市的官方區域，所以它們不受徵稅。不過，請注意，由於這兩個地區還沒有被正式接受為城市的區域，它們不享受公會法的安全保障或守望者的保護。如果你選擇走這條路，要提高警惕。愚者衝進審計師不敢踏足的地方。

english: Regardless of what size party you arrive with or by what means, if you arrive by night or in winter, expect to register. In winter and at night the gates are shut. Ships aren't expected at night or as a regular occurrence after the first frost of the coming season, and are often met at docking by a magister—or by a contingent of the Guard who will hold travelers aboard until a magister can be summoned.
zh_tw: 不論你以何種規模的隊伍到達，或透過什麼方式，在夜晚或冬季到達時，都請準備登記。在冬季和夜間，城門是關閉的。船隻在夜間或在即將到來的季節首次霜降之後，通常不會預期到達，而且經常在靠岸時由法官或一隊守衛接待，他們會將旅行者留在船上，直到法官到來。

english: None of these rules apply to the city's least used gate, the West Gate. This smaller gate opens onto the Mud Flats—a mucky beach used by clam diggers, shore fishers, and those brave enough to bathe in the cold waves. Those who make a living through fishing with nets or traps also use this gate, keeping their small boats on the beach to avoid docking fees. Locals register with the Guard as they exit and as they enter. No magister is stationed at the gate, but no new arrivals to Waterdeep are accepted here.
zh_tw: 這些規則都不適用於城市最少使用的城門——西門。這個較小的城門通向泥灘——一個泥濘的海灘，被挖蛤人、岸邊捕魚者以及那些勇敢到在冰冷的海浪中洗澡的人使用。那些透過網或陷阱捕魚為生的人也使用這個城門，他們把小船停在海灘上以避免停泊費。當地人在進出時向守衛登記。沒有法官駐守在這個城門，但這裡不接受任何新到達深水城的人。

english: If you approach by air, expect a vigorous pursuit by and confrontation with the Griffon Cavalry. Only specially licensed individuals and mounts can fly over Waterdeep. It is best to land well outside the city and approach on foot.
zh_tw: 如果你透過空中接近，預計會遭到獅鷲騎兵的積極追擊和對抗。只有特別許可的個人和坐騎才能飛越深水城。最好在城市外圍著陸，然後步行進入。

english: Your Arrival in the City
zh_tw: 你抵達城市

english: The splendors that await you in Waterdeep are legendary. Each of the city's wards is detailed in this work, telling you what to expect depending on where you are, as well as what thrilling things you might see and do. Before that, however, there are the small matters of knowing something of the history of the place you visit, and of understanding how to comport yourself in the Sword Coast's grandest metropolis.
zh_tw: 在深水城等待你的輝煌是傳奇的。這座城市的每個區域都在這部作品中詳細描述，告訴你根據你所在的地點可以期待什麼，以及你可能看到和做的激動人心的事情。然而，在此之前，還有一些小事情需要了解，比如瞭解你訪問的地方的歷史，以及理解如何在劍海岸最宏偉的大都市中表現自己。

english: A Long History (in Brief)
zh_tw: 悠久的歷史（簡述）

english: There shall come a time when our city and its deepwater bay shall grow in fame and fortune across many realms and many worlds. Folk shall know of Waterdeep, our City of Splendors, and sing its praises. I have seen it thus, and I endeavor to make it true.
zh_tw: 將會有一個時刻，我們的城市和它的深水灣將在許多領域和世界中聲名遠揚，財富增長。人們將會知道深水城，我們輝煌的城市，並歌頌它的榮耀。我已如此預見，我努力使之成真。

english: Ahghairon, the first Open Lord of Waterdeep, circa 1032 DR
zh_tw: 阿蓋爾倫，深水城的第一位公開領主，大約在1032年DR（龍歷）

english: People have inhabited the plateau upon which Waterdeep stands for longer than human histories record. But as is the way across the dangerous North, civilization at the foot of Mount Waterdeep has crested and ebbed in great waves. Elf scholars assure me that it was once the site of Aelinthaldaar, the capital of their ancient empire of Illefarn. So it was already a glorious place when a dwarf prospector named Melair discovered mithral beneath the mountain. In agreement with the Illefarni, Melair called kith and kin to mine under the mountain and in the plateau, and thus Clan Melairkyn came to rule below as the Illefarni did above.
zh_tw: 人類歷史記載之前，深水城所在的高原就已經有人居住。但正如北方危險地帶的常態，深水城山腳下的文明在巨大的浪潮中起伏不定。精靈學者向我保證，這裡曾經是艾林塔拉爾，伊勒法恩古老帝國的首都。因此，當一個名叫梅拉爾的矮人勘探者在山下發現了秘銀時，這裡已經是一個輝煌的地方。與伊勒法恩人達成協議後，梅拉爾召集了他的族人和親屬在山下和高原上採礦，因此梅拉爾克林家族開始在地下統治，就像伊勒法恩人在地面上統治一樣。

english: But this fruitful alliance lasted less than the lifetime of a dwarf, for the emperor of the elves—what they call a "coronal"—commanded that all leave in the Retreat, that great exodus of elves from Faerûn to their mystical isle of Evermeet. Not all elves agreed with this edict, and many were determined to stay. Well, what emperor has ever willingly allowed another to sit in his throne? The coronal had all of Aelinthaldaar razed by magic, and the remaining elves splintered into separate kingdoms. The Melairkyn, of course, saw this as a breaking of their bargain, and never again did they deal with elves. Instead, they tunneled ever deeper under the mountain, never to be heard from again.
zh_tw: 但這個富有成效的聯盟持續的時間還不到一個矮人的一生，因為精靈的皇帝——他們稱之為'精靈王'——命令所有人在撤退中離開，在精靈從費倫到他們神秘的永聚島島的大遷徙中。並非所有的精靈都同意這個法令，許多人決心留下來。嗯，哪個皇帝願意心甘情願地讓別人坐在他的寶座上呢？精靈王用魔法將艾林塔拉爾全部夷為平地，剩下的精靈分裂成獨立的王國。當然，梅拉爾克林家族將這視為他們協議的破裂，從此他們再也沒有與精靈打交道。相反，他們在山下挖掘得越來越深，從此再也沒有人聽到他們的訊息。

english: So it was that the humans who came to the deepwater harbor found it empty and suitable for their own purposes. For more than a thousand years, folk lived and traded at the site of what would become Waterdeep, but their identities remain a mystery—with a curious exception. We know that at some point during this period, the wizard Halaster Blackcloak built his tower at the base of Mount Waterdeep and came to rule the lands around—until he, like the Melairkyn, vanished under the mountain.
zh_tw: 於是，來到深水港的人類發現它空無一人，非常適合他們自己的目的。在超過一千年的時間裡，人們在將成為深水城的地方生活和交易，但他們的身份仍然是個謎——有一個奇怪的例外。我們知道，在這段時期的某個時候，法師海拉斯特·黑袍在深水城山腳下建造了他的塔，並開始統治周圍的土地——直到他，像梅拉爾克林家族一樣，在山下消失了。

english: Various warlords later claimed the plateau's harbor as their own, but it was one known as Nimoar who is best remembered. A History of Waterdeep: Age One, The Rise of the Warlord records how Nimoar raised a wooden stockade to protect the settlement around the harbor, claiming rule over the town that by then was being called "Nimoar's Hold, the Town of Waters Deep." War between orcs and elves in lands farther north drove hordes of trolls south to claw at the fledgling city, and amid this danger, Nimoar died of old age. Many bloody struggles unfolded between local folk and {@creature troll||trolls}, until the magic of a youth named Ahghairon turned the fortunes of war against the "everlasting ones, "which were destroyed or scattered. Ahghairon improved slowly in skill and power with the passage of the years, until he became a great mage. He is said to have discovered a supply of potions of longevity, or learned the art of making such, for he lived on and on, still physically in his prime for decade after decade. {@i A History of Waterdeep: Age Two}, The Lords' Rule Begins records that in the year 1032 DR, Ahghairon (then in his 112th winter) argued with Raurlor, who was then Warlord of Waterdeep. Raurlor wanted to use Waterdeep's acquired wealth and strength of arms to create a northern empire. Ahghairon defied him before all the people, and Raurlor ordered the mage to be chained. But when Ahghairon magically turned aside all who sought to lay hands on him, Raurlor struck at the mage with his own sword. Ahghairon then rose into the air, just out of reach, and used his magic to transmute Raurlor's blade into a hissing serpent. When the serpent struck Raurlor, he died in full view of his shocked followers.
zh_tw: 後來的幾位軍閥都聲稱擁有高原上的港口，但其中最被銘記的是一位名為尼莫爾的人。《深水城歷史：第一紀元，軍閥的崛起》記錄了尼莫爾如何建立了一座木製柵欄以保護港口周圍的定居點，並宣稱統治這個當時被稱為"尼莫爾的據點，深水之城"的城鎮。北方更遠地區的獸人與精靈之間的戰爭驅使巨魔群南下攻擊這座新興城市，而在這種危險中，尼莫爾因年老去世。當地民眾與{@creature troll||巨魔}之間發生了許多血腥衝突，直到一位名為阿蓋爾倫的年輕人用魔法扭轉了戰局，對抗"永恆者"，最終將其摧毀或驅散。隨著歲月的流逝，阿蓋爾倫的技藝和力量逐漸增強，直到他成為了一位偉大的法師。據說他發現了長生藥水的來源，或學會了製作這種藥水的藝術，因為他一直活了下來，身體依然處於巔峰狀態，幾十年如一日。{@i 《深水城的歷史：第二紀元》}，領主的統治開始，記錄了在DR 1032年，阿蓋爾倫（當時已經度過了112個冬天）與當時擔任深水城軍閥的勞爾洛發生了爭執。勞爾洛想利用深水城積累的財富和軍力建立一個北方帝國。阿蓋爾倫在所有人面前違抗了他，勞爾洛下令將這位法師鎖起來。但當阿蓋爾倫用魔法使所有試圖抓住他的人退卻時，勞爾洛親自揮劍攻擊法師。阿蓋爾倫隨後升入空中，正好超出了攻擊範圍，並用魔法將勞爾洛的劍變成了一條嘶嘶作響的蛇。當蛇攻擊勞爾洛時，他在驚愕的追隨者面前死亡。

english: Ahghairon then gathered the leaders of Waterdeep's armies and powerful families. While runners sought to bring them to the castle, flames roared and crackled in the empty warlord's throne at Ahghairon's bidding, so that none could sit there. Then, when the gathered host of worthies met in the audience chamber, the wizard seated himself on the flaming throne. Immediately the fires died away, leaving both the throne and Ahghairon unharmed.
zh_tw: 然後阿蓋爾倫召集了深水城軍隊的領袖和有權勢的家族。當信使試圖將他們帶到城堡時，火焰在阿蓋爾倫的命令下，在空蕩蕩的軍閥寶座上咆哮和噼啪作響，以至於沒有人能坐在那裡。然後，當聚集的顯要人物在接見室會面時，法師坐在了火焰寶座上。火焰立即熄滅，寶座和阿蓋爾倫都毫髮無損。

english: From this seat-the very one on which the Open Lord sits to this day-Ahghairon decreed how the city would be governed. While he would sit as lord openly, a council of other lords of nearly equal power would rule with him. But the identity of those other lords would be hidden even from each other, thus preventing any of them from being approached and influenced by bribe or threat. So it was that Ahghairon established Waterdeep's system of governance.
zh_tw: 從這個座位——也就是公開領主至今仍然坐著的那個座位——阿蓋爾倫宣佈了城市將如何治理。雖然他會公開坐著作為領主，但其他幾乎擁有同等權力的領主組成的議會將與他一起統治。但那些其他領主的身份甚至對彼此都是隱藏的，從而防止他們中的任何一個被賄賂或威脅所接近和影響。因此，阿蓋爾倫建立了深水城的治理體系。

english: Ahghairon was instrumental in establishing many of Waterdeep's other institutions, such as its black-robed magisters, its Griffon Cavalry, and the city's many guilds. The first Open Lord ruled wisely for over two centuries before the magic sustaining his health failed. He now lies entombed in his tower, which you can still see standing in the courtyard of the Palace of Waterdeep. Beware that you don't approach too close, however, lest you stumble into the invisible barrier-a "force cage," I am told-that surrounds the tower.
zh_tw: 阿蓋爾倫在建立深水城的許多其他機構中發揮了重要作用，例如其穿黑袍的法官、獅鷲騎兵以及城市的許多公會。第一位公開領主明智地統治了兩個多世紀，直到維持他健康的魔法失效。他現在被安葬在他的塔中，你仍然可以看到它矗立在深水宮的庭院裡。不過，請注意不要靠得太近，以免你不慎走進圍繞塔樓的無形屏障——我聽說是一個"力場牢籠"。

english: Within that barrier lie additional protective wards, as demonstrated by the floating bones of the last person who tried to defy them. The name of this poor soul has been lost to time, but the miscreant was likely a wizard who sought to steal the magic treasures that had been entombed with their former owner. Now they hang in the air beyond the invisible force cage in rough semblance of their natural position, occasionally displaced temporarily by strong winds or mischievous children with long sticks.
zh_tw: 在那個屏障內還有額外的保護咒語，正如試圖挑戰它們的最後一個人的漂浮骨頭所展示的。這個可憐人的名字已經隨著時間而遺失，但這個罪犯很可能是一個法師，他試圖偷走與他們前主人一起被埋葬的魔法寶藏。現在，他們懸掛在無形力場牢籠之外的空中，大致保持著他們自然的位置，偶爾被強風或惡作劇的孩子們用長棍暫時移位。

english: Ahghairon's wise rule is celebrated on the first day of Eleasis, which has come to be known as Ahghairon's Day. For more about this day, see "City Celebrations."
zh_tw: 阿蓋爾倫明智的統治在伊萊西斯的第一天被慶祝，這一天已經被稱為阿蓋爾倫日。關於這一天的更多資訊，請參見"城市慶典"。

english: Many significant events stand out in Waterdeep's history. But none have had so great an effect on daily life than the three apocalyptic periods known as the Time of Troubles, the Spellplague, and the Sundering-the most recent (and hopefully final). On all these occasions, the actions of gods at war with one another led to the loss or the twisting of magic in the world. During the Time of Troubles, Waterdeep stood at the center of events. But the effects of the more recent crises can still be seen in the city today, even though they occurred a great distance from where Waterdeep stands.
zh_tw: 在深水城的歷史上，許多重大事件脫穎而出。但沒有哪個事件對日常生活的影響能超過被稱為動盪時期、魔法瘟疫和分裂的三個末日時期——最後一個（希望是最後的）最近。在所有這些場合，神祇之間的戰爭行為導致了世界上魔法的喪失或扭曲。在動盪時期，深水城站在事件的中心。但更近期危機的影響至今仍可在城市中看到，儘管它們發生在遠離深水城的地方。

english: When the gods walked among mortals during the Time of Troubles, they were cast down to the world by the mysterious Overgod Ao in 1358 DR. Until then, none but the gods had known of Ao's existence, and since then, we have learned little more. As all know, the crisis began with the theft of the Tablets of Fate by the vile and ambitious gods Bane and Myrkul, later joined by Bhaal. These mystic artifacts supposedly determine the extent of the gods' power, and dictate how they use that power. As punishment for this affront, Ao cast down the gods (or the ones that humans worshiped, at any rate) and then demanded that they return the tablets to him.
zh_tw: 在動盪時期，眾神行走在凡人之間，他們被神秘的至高神奧（Ao）在1358年DR（龍歷）降下到這個世界。在那之前，除了眾神之外，沒有人知道奧的存在，從那時起，我們對此瞭解得也不多。眾所周知，這場危機始於卑鄙而野心勃勃的神祇貝恩（班恩）和米爾庫爾（米爾寇），後來巴哈爾（巴爾）也加入了他們的行列，偷走了命運石板。這些神秘的神器據說決定了眾神的力量範圍，並規定了他們如何使用這種力量。作為對這一冒犯的懲罰，奧將眾神（或至少是人類所崇拜的那些神）降下，並隨後要求他們將石板歸還給他。

english: But Ao was not omniscient, it seems, nor overly wise. The gods didn't seek out the tablets, and thus it was left to mortal heroes to sort out the mess. They did so, their efforts culminating in Waterdeep. It was on the slopes of Mount Waterdeep that Ao was last seen, when he granted godhood to the human heroes Kelemvor, Midnight (who became Mystra), and Cyric.
zh_tw: 但奧似乎並非全知全能，也不是特別明智。眾神沒有去尋找石板，因此只能由凡人英雄來解決這個爛攤子。他們做到了，他們的努力最終在深水城達到高潮。正是在深水城山的斜坡上，奧最後一次被看到，當時他賦予了人類英雄凱勒莫（凱蘭沃）、午夜（成為了神秘女士密斯特拉）和賽瑞克（希瑞克）神性。

english: It is no surprise, then, that Waterdeep has since attracted a steady stream of pilgrims who worship Midnight at Mystra's temple and pay homage to Kelemvor in the City of the Dead. It might surprise you, though, to learn that Waterdavians had a short-lived penchant for worshiping Ao. The Cynosure-that great marble-pillared structure on the edge of the Market, now rented out for private and public events-was built as a temple to Ao. But his worship fell from favor when all prayers to him went unanswered, and folk realized they had no idea what he stood for or who he was. You can visit the Cynosure to see sculptures and paintings of all the major participants and events in the Time of Troubles. Entrance is free to the public on any day when no event (such as a meeting of guilds, a noble's coming-of-age ball, or some such) is scheduled.
zh_tw: 因此，深水城自那以後吸引了源源不斷的朝聖者，他們在神秘女士的神廟中崇拜午夜（密斯特拉），並在亡者之城向凱勒莫（凱蘭沃）表示敬意，這並不令人驚訝。然而，你可能會感到驚訝的是，深水城居民曾短暫地熱衷於崇拜奧（Ao）。辛諾蘇爾——那個位於市場邊緣的巨大大理石柱結構，現在被租用為私人和公共活動——原本是作為奧的神廟建造的。但當他所有的祈禱都得不到回應，人們意識到他們對他所代表的或他是誰一無所知時，對他的崇拜便失寵了。你可以參觀辛諾蘇爾，看到動盪時期所有主要參與者和事件的雕塑和繪畫。在沒有安排任何活動（例如公會會議、貴族成年舞會等）的任何一天，公眾可以免費入場。

english: In the Year of Blue Fire (1385 DR), the Spellplague gripped the world. None knew it at the time, but it has since been divined that Cyric's long hatred for Mystra boiled over and led to his murder of the goddess of magic. I was absent from the world at this time-indisposed by the force of an {@spell imprisonment} spell. Elminster has since explained the events to me, but I must confess that much of what he said made little sense. It was a long lecture having something to do with stars, "crystal spheres," and "demiplanar reality mirrors." Suffice it to say, parts of our world switched with parts of another one, and magic was again disrupted.
zh_tw: 在藍火之年（1385 DR），魔瘟症席捲了世界。當時無人知曉，但事後得知，希瑞克對密斯特拉的長期仇恨終於爆發，導致他謀殺了魔法女神。我當時不在這個世界上——被一股{@spell imprisonment||禁錮術}的力量所困擾。伊爾明斯特後來向我解釋了這些事件，但我必須承認，他所說的大部分內容都難以理解。那是一次冗長的講座，涉及星星、"晶壁系"和"半位面現實鏡"等。簡而言之，我們世界的部分區域與另一個世界的部分區域互換了，魔法再次受到了幹擾。

english: During this period, the powerful magical fields that protect and affect Waterdeep became unstable. This led to the disastrous activation of most of Waterdeep's amazing walking statues during an earthquake. In the years before, the walking statues were often hidden on the Ethereal Plane, to be called forth only in times of great peril. Many in the city doubted that such massive, sapient constructs were even real, let alone that they guarded the city invisibly. The Spellplague confirmed their existence for all to see, though, and each carved a swath of destruction through Waterdeep before it was stopped. Now the walking statues stand about the city in various states of readiness or disarray-one of the most obvious of Waterdeep's so-called splendors.
zh_tw: 在這個時期，保護並影響深水城的強大魔法領域變得不穩定。這導致在一次地震期間，深水城大多數驚人的行走雕像災難性地被啟用。在那些年之前，行走雕像經常被隱藏在以太位面，只有在極大危險時才會被召喚出來。城市中的許多人懷疑這些巨大的、有智慧的構造物是否真實存在，更不用說它們是否無形地守護著城市了。然而，魔法瘟疫證實了它們的存在，讓所有人都能看到，每個雕像在被停止之前都在深水城中開闢了一條毀滅之路。現在，行走雕像以各種準備或混亂的狀態矗立在城市中——這是深水城所謂的輝煌之一。

english: After the Spellplague came the Sundering. Elf scholars insist on calling it the Second Sundering, asserting that the creation of Evermeet thousands of years ago was a similar happening. Regardless of the name you give it, the event that unfolded beginning in 1482 DR was the result of another world-called Abeir, I am told-passing again into our own. The gods were once more cast into the mortal realm, this time embodied in mortal beings known as Chosen. The old troublemaker Ao seems to be the cause of it all, though why he chose to cast down the gods was a matter of dispute even among those entities while they were with us.
zh_tw: 魔法瘟疫之後是分裂。精靈學者堅持稱之為第二次分裂，他們堅稱數千年前永聚島的創造是一個類似的事件。不管你給它什麼名字，從1482年DR開始展開的事件是另一個世界——被稱為阿貝爾，我被告知——再次進入我們自己的世界的結果。眾神再次被投入凡人領域，這一次體現在被稱為被選者（選民）的凡人之中。那個老麻煩製造者奧似乎是這一切的原因，儘管他為什麼要將眾神降下，即使在他們與我們在一起的時候，也是那些實體之間的爭議問題。

english: Apparently, all of this was foreseen by Waterdeep's legendary wizard Khelben Arunsun, and it was only through his wisdom and the efforts of Elminster, {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH}-now the Open Lord of Waterdeep-and a handful of others that the world was saved. According to Elminster, Ao remade the Tablets of Fate as a result, restoring the divine order and separating Abeir from Toril. But take that as you may. According to that roguish longbeard, he saves the world without anyone noticing every other month or so.
zh_tw: 顯然，這一切都被深水城的傳奇巫師凱爾本·奧羅桑所預見到，正是透過他的智慧以及伊爾明斯特、{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}——現任深水城的公開領主——以及少數其他人的努力，世界得以拯救。據伊爾明斯特所說，奧因此重鑄了命運之碑，恢復了神聖秩序並將阿貝爾與託瑞爾分離。但隨你如何理解。據那個狡黠的長鬚老頭所說，他幾乎每隔一個月就會在不為人知的情況下拯救一次世界。

english: The Sea Maiden's Faire Parade
zh_tw: 海之少女的公平遊行

english: Surviving in the City
zh_tw: 在城市中生存

english: Waterdeep is, by and large, the most civilized city on the Sword Coast. Yet civilized doesn't mean safe, nor does it mean easy to navigate. Many day-to-day elements of life in Waterdeep that residents take for granted are, to new arrivals, a bevy of wonders and dangers not seen in any other settlement within a thousand miles. Here's what you need to know to survive your first few hours in the city. Mark this section for frequent reference!
zh_tw: 總的來說，深水城是劍海岸上最文明的城市。然而，文明並不意味著安全，也不意味著容易導航。深水城生活中許多日常元素，居民們視為理所當然，對新來的人來說，是一系列在千里之內任何其他定居點都看不到的奇觀和危險。以下是你在城市中度過最初幾個小時所需要知道的。請經常參考這一部分！

english: The Code Legal
zh_tw: 法律法典

english: Waterdeep is no village led by hidebound hierarchs or petty fiefdom ruled by the whim of a warlord. It is a city of laws molded by Tyr's spirit of justice. As a rule, you can trust members of the City Watch to do their duty diligently, and you can expect that the city's magisters will be fair. If you have cause to come before the Masked Lords or the Open Lord herself, rest assured that if your cause be just, justice will be done. If, however, you find yourself in the wrong, know that though it might take time to weigh that wrong on Tyr's scales, his hammer will fall—and it will be wielded by Waterdeep with a vengeance.
zh_tw: 深水城不是一個由僵化等級制度領導的村莊，也不是一個由軍閥的一時興起統治的小封地。這是一座由提爾正義精神塑造的法律之城。通常，你可以信任城市守衛會勤勉地履行他們的職責，你可以期待城市的法官會是公正的。如果你有理由出現在蒙面領主或公開領主本人面前，請放心，如果你的理由是正當的，正義將會實現。然而，如果你發現自己做錯了，要知道，儘管可能需要時間在提爾的天平上衡量那個錯誤，他的錘子將會落下——它將由深水城以復仇的方式揮舞。

english: Unlike in less civilized settlements, punishment for crimes in Waterdeep isn't typically used as public entertainment. Scheduled executions occur behind the high walls of Castle Waterdeep, and floggings are carried out in the watch post nearest the sentencing. The Watch makes every effort to take individuals into custody quietly, so as not to disrupt other citizens. Those bystanders generally return the favor by giving altercations between criminals and the Watch a wide berth.
zh_tw: 與未開化的定居點不同，深水城的犯罪懲罰通常不作為公共娛樂。預定的處決在深水堡的高牆內進行，而鞭刑則在最接近判決地點的崗哨執行。守衛盡一切努力安靜地將個人拘留，以免擾亂其他市民。那些旁觀者通常會回報這種好意，透過遠離罪犯和守衛之間的衝突。

english: Waterdeep has a complex library of law and custom set by precedent, the main body of which can be read in the Code Legal. This document is available in multiple languages at the Palace of Waterdeep, and (in the Common tongue) provided on request by the magisters at the gates and in the harbor. Be aware that the Code Legal provides only an outline of typical sentences for various offenses, and magisters have broad discretion when meting out justice as they see fit. Any Masked Lord can overturn a magister's ruling, but there's rarely a Masked Lord around when you need one.
zh_tw: 深水城擁有一個複雜的法律和習俗體系，由先例設定，其主體可以在《法典》中閱讀。這份檔案在深水宮有多種語言版本，並且（用通用語）由城門和港口的法師們應要求提供。請注意，《法典》僅提供了各種罪行典型刑罰的大綱，法師們在施以正義時有廣泛的自由裁量權。任何戴面具的領主都可以推翻法師的裁決，但當你需要一個戴面具的領主時，他們很少在場。

english: Arms, Armor, and Combat
zh_tw: 武器、盔甲和戰鬥

english: Individuals accustomed to the rough-and-tumble life in much of the North are often surprised by the fact that Waterdavians go about unarmed and unarmored. Yet Waterdeep doesn't have any law that forbids carrying weapons or armor. Instead, it has a culture of civility that makes such behavior unnecessary.
zh_tw: 習慣了北方大部分地區粗獷生活的人們通常會對深水城居民不攜帶武器和不穿戴盔甲的事實感到驚訝。然而，深水城並沒有法律禁止攜帶武器或盔甲。相反，它有一種文明的文化，使得這種行為變得不必要。

english: Dueling has long been illegal in Waterdeep, as has any sort of act involving assault. Individuals caught brawling by the Watch will all be arrested and judged regardless of who started the fracas, or why. (The tavern brawls that typically break out under the influence of too much drink will often be overlooked by the Watch, as long as the proprietor doesn't seek payment for damages and no one is significantly injured.) Sport fighting, such as boxing or wrestling, is legal only if it occurs in a location registered with the city for that purpose. Additionally, any blade more than one foot in length is subject to an extra tax whenever it is sold, which helps to explain why Waterdavians prefer to carry knives and knuckledusters for self-defense.
zh_tw: 在深水城，決鬥長期以來一直是非法的，任何涉及攻擊行為的行為也是如此。被守衛抓到鬥毆的個人都將被逮捕並接受審判，不管誰挑起了爭端，或者為什麼。（通常在飲酒過量的影響下爆發的酒吧鬥毆通常會被守衛忽視，只要店主不要求賠償損失，沒有人受到嚴重傷害。）拳擊或摔跤等運動性格鬥只有在城市為此目的註冊的地點進行時才是合法的。此外，任何超過一尺長的刀片在銷售時都要額外徵稅，這有助於解釋為什麼深水城居民更傾向於攜帶刀具和指節銅套進行自衛。

english: Businesses and individuals do employ armed guards, but except for nobles or foreign envoys, few people travel about the city with such protection. As such, the sight of armed and armored individuals walking the streets who aren't in the livery of the city or one of its noble houses inspires caution in most Waterdavians. Folk assume that you wouldn't bother lugging around such equipment unless you either intend violence or expect that it might soon be visited upon you.
zh_tw: 商業機構和個人確實會僱傭武裝警衛，但除了貴族或外國使節外，很少有人在城市中帶著這種保護四處走動。因此，看到穿著武裝和盔甲的個人在街頭行走，而且他們並不屬於城市的制服或某個貴族家族，大多數深水城居民會感到警惕。人們會假設，你不會自找麻煩攜帶這樣的裝備，除非你打算使用暴力，或者預計很快會有暴力降臨在你身上。

english: City Watch
zh_tw: 城市守衛

english: The first soldiers you see in service to the city will be the members of the City Guard who patrol the roads leading to Waterdeep, watch the walls, guard civic structures, and protect magisters. Waterdeep's streets, however, are policed by an altogether different force: the City Watch. The similarity of their names often confuses newcomers, so I offer this handy mnemonic: "The Guard guards the walls while the Watch watches all."
zh_tw: 你在為城市服務時首先看到的士兵將是城市守衛隊的成員，他們巡邏通往深水城的道路，監視城牆，守衛市政建築，並保護地方法官。然而，深水城的街道是由一個完全不同的力量來維護治安的：城市守衛隊。他們的名字相似經常讓新來的人感到困惑，所以我提供這個方便的助記方法：'警衛守護城牆，而警衛隊監視一切。'

english: You can recognize any member of the City Watch by the uniform: a green-and-goldenrod doublet and a tall steel helmet. Each typically carries a long truncheon, a dagger, and a buckler. Because most citizens in Waterdeep don't bear weapons, these tools prove a more than ample deterrent to criminal activity. Members of the Watch typically don't carry crossbows or other weapons to attack at range, but running from the Watch—though it may be a time-honored tradition for local miscreants—rarely works out for newcomers to the city. I guarantee that all members of the Watch know the streets they patrol and that area's residents better than you do, even if you stay in Waterdeep for ten seasons.
zh_tw: 你可以透過制服識別城市守衛的任何成員：一件綠色和金盞花色的緊身上衣和一頂高鋼盔。每個守衛通常攜帶一根長警棍、一把匕首和一個小盾牌。因為深水城的大多數市民不攜帶武器，這些裝備足以有效阻止犯罪活動。守衛成員通常不攜帶弩或其他遠端攻擊武器，但是逃離守衛——儘管這可能是當地不良分子的悠久傳統——對於新來乍到的人來說很少能成功。我保證所有守衛成員都比你要熟悉他們巡邏的街道和那個區域的居民，即使你在深水城待上十季。

english: The City Watch has watch posts throughout the city. These stations are often off the main thoroughfares, tucked away in small courtyards or at cross streets. A watch post can be recognized by the green-and-gold lantern outside it, lit even during the day with a {@spell continual flame} spell. A watch post serves as an organizational headquarters and armory. Anyone who wishes to report a crime may do so at a watch post in the event a Watch constable can't be found elsewhere. A watch post typically contains a few holding cells where people arrested for crimes can be detained until they're marched to a courthouse jail before standing trial.
zh_tw: 城市守衛在整個城市設有守望站。這些站點通常不在主幹道上，而是藏在小的庭院或十字路口旁。守望站可以透過外面掛著的綠色和金色燈籠來識別，即使白天也會透過{@spell continual flame||不滅明焰}法術保持點亮。守望站作為組織的總部和軍械庫。若在其他地方找不到守衛警官，想報告犯罪的人可以在守望站進行報案。守望站通常設有幾間拘留室，關押被捕的罪犯，直到他們被押送到法院監獄等待審判。

english: Small squads head out from the watch posts on daily and nightly rounds of the city streets, or on special assignments involving protection or investigation. A mere pair of Watch operatives might discreetly patrol in the Castle Ward; in contrast, squads of eight walk the Dock Ward, increasing to as many as a dozen at night. If Watch members spot trouble they can't handle, they blow shrill tin whistles to summon more of their members-an act that alerts nearby citizens as well.
zh_tw: 小隊從警衛哨所出發，每天和每晚巡邏城市街道，或者執行涉及保護或調查的特殊任務。僅有的一對警衛隊成員可能會在城堡區謹慎巡邏；相比之下，八人小隊在碼頭區巡邏，晚上增加到多達十二人。如果警衛隊成員發現他們無法處理的麻煩，他們會吹響尖銳的錫哨子召喚更多成員——這種行為也會提醒附近的市民。

english: City Watch members follow a strict code of conduct that makes them one of the most trusted police forces aside from paladin-patrolled Elturgard. As long as you don't engage in unlawful behavior, you can expect to be left untroubled by the Watch.
zh_tw: 城市守衛成員遵循嚴格的行為準則，這使他們成為除了由聖武士巡邏的艾爾圖加德之外最受信任的警察力量之一。只要你不從事非法行為，你可以期待不會被守衛所打擾。

english: Watch Talk
zh_tw: 守衛談話

english: Members of the City Watch employ a sort of slang in dealing with the public. As a visitor, it behooves you to know what they mean.
zh_tw: 城市守衛成員在與公眾打交道時使用一種俚語。作為訪客，瞭解他們的意思對你是有益的。

english: "What befalls?" means "Someone tell me what's going on here."
zh_tw: 「何事？」意即「誰來告訴我這裡發生了什麼事。」

english: "Hold!" means "Don't move a muscle."
zh_tw: 「站住！」意即「一步也不許動。」

english: "Down arms!" means "Drop your weapons."
zh_tw: 「卸下兵刃！」意即「放下你們的武器。」

english: "Talk truth!" means "Answer me" or "Tell the whole story."
zh_tw: 「據實以告！」意即「回答我」或「把事情完整說出來。」

english: "Robes" references the black robes-in other words, one of the magisters. "Do we need robes here?" or something similar should be taken as a threat.
zh_tw: "長袍"指的是黑色長袍——換句話說，就是指其中一位法師。"我們需要在這裡穿長袍嗎？"或類似的問法應該被視為一種威脅。

english: The Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors
zh_tw: 警戒法師與護衛教團

english: Expect to be questioned at the gate, or when you register with a magister, regarding your ability to cast arcane magic. Wizards, sorcerers, and other arcane spellcasters who intend to stay in Waterdeep for any length of time are required to register with the city, and will be strongly encouraged to join the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors, headed by the Blackstaff.
zh_tw: 在城門處或在向法官註冊時，預計會被詢問關於你施放奧術魔法的能力。打算在深水城停留一段時間的法師、術士和其他奧術施法者需要向城市註冊，並且將被強烈鼓勵加入由黑杖領導的警戒法師與護衛教團。

english: Members of the Watchful Order are expected to render service to the city when called upon, acting as temporary members of the City Watch or City Guard. Their expertise often helps investigators determine whether magic was used to commit a crime in the city. Members can also expect to be tapped for assistance during and after fires, natural events that cause multiple casualties, or other nonmagical disasters.
zh_tw: 當被召喚時，警覺秩序的成員預計要為城市提供服務，擔任城市守衛或城市守衛的臨時成員。他們的專業知識經常幫助調查人員確定是否使用魔法在城市中犯罪。成員還可以預期在火災期間及之後、造成多人傷亡的自然事件或其它非魔法災害中被要求提供援助。

english: Members of the Watchful Order form a more or less sociable association in the city, working together to keep an eye on any spellcasters who opt not to join their guild. Any havoc caused by a spellcaster in Waterdeep risks drawing the wrath of the Lords of Waterdeep-so it behooves the Watchful Order to watch all its members.
zh_tw: 警惕的秩序成員在城市中形成了一個或多或少社交的協會，他們共同工作，監視那些選擇不加入他們公會的施法者。任何在深水城由施法者引起的混亂都有可能引起水深城領主的憤怒——因此，警惕的秩序有必要監視其所有成員。

english: Coinage
zh_tw: 幣制

english: As should be expected of any city of standing, Waterdeep mints its own coins. All taxes, fines, and guild fees must be paid either in Waterdavian coin or the currency of any member settlement of the Lords' Alliance. Though no law requires you to pay for goods or services in Waterdavian coin, the drudgery of weighing foreign currency and checking its purity prompts many retailers and operators of swift-exchange businesses-including drays and hire-coaches-not to accept anything but coins minted in Waterdeep.
zh_tw: 正如任何有地位的城市所預期的那樣，深水城鑄造自己的貨幣。所有的稅收、罰款和行會費用必須用深水城貨幣或領主聯盟任何成員定居點的貨幣支付。雖然沒有法律要求您必須用深水城貨幣支付商品或服務，但稱量外幣和檢查其純度的繁瑣促使許多零售商和快速兌換業務的經營者——包括貨車和出租馬車——不接受除深水城鑄造的硬幣以外的任何貨幣。

english: Though you can trade your coinage for Waterdeep currency with anyone willing to do so, the exchequers at the Palace of Waterdeep make exchanges with no associated fee. The queue there can be quite long, necessitating that you make an appointment-often a day or more in advance. For a swifter transaction, I recommend any member of the Guild of Trusted Pewterers and Casters, or of the Jewelers' Guild. Both have the most reliable scales and abide by guild-wide rates of exchange.
zh_tw: 儘管你可以與任何願意的人交換你的貨幣為深水城的貨幣，但在深水宮的兌換處進行兌換不會產生任何相關費用。那裡的隊伍可能會相當長，需要你預約——通常需要提前一天或更久。為了更快的交易，我推薦任何受信任的錫鑞器和鑄幣公會的成員，或珠寶公會的成員。兩者都有最可靠的秤，並遵守公會的匯率。

english: Be sure to exchange taols and harbor moons before leaving the city, as their value greatly diminishes elsewhere!
zh_tw: 確保在離開城市前兌換掉塔奧爾幣和港灣月幣，因為它們在其他地方的價值會大幅降低！

english: {@b Nib}
zh_tw: {@b 尖兒}

english: Copper coin about the size of a thumbnail (1 nib = 1 common copper coin)
zh_tw: 大約拇指大小的銅幣（1 尖兒 = 1枚普通銅幣）

english: {@b Shard}
zh_tw: {@b 碎子}

english: Silver coin, slightly smaller than the nib (1 shard = 10 nibs)
zh_tw: 銀幣，略小於尼布（1 沙德 = 10 尼布）

english: {@b Taol}
zh_tw: {@b 陶爾}

english: Brass coin, about two inches square with a hole large enough for a nib to fit in (1 taol = 200 nibs)
zh_tw: 黃銅幣，大約兩吋見方，中間有一個足夠尼布大小的孔（1 塔奧爾幣 = 200 尼布）

english: {@b Dragon}
zh_tw: {@b 龍}

english: Gold coin, half again as large as a nib (1 dragon = 100 nibs)
zh_tw: 金幣，大小是尼布的一半多一點（1 龍幣 = 100 尼布）

english: {@b Sun}
zh_tw: {@b 太陽}

english: Platinum coin, twice as large as a nib (1 sun = 1,000 nibs)
zh_tw: 鉑金幣，大小是尼布的兩倍（1太陽 = 1,000尼布）

english: {@b Harbor Moon}
zh_tw: {@b 灣月}

english: Platinum crescent inset with electrum, about three inches long with a hole large enough for a nib to fit in (1 harbor moon = 5,000 nibs)
zh_tw: 鑲嵌電金銀幣的半月形硬幣，大約三吋長，中間有一個足夠尼布硬幣放入的孔（1海港月亮 = 5,000尼布）

english: Taxes and Fees
zh_tw: 稅費

english: As established in the first year of the reign of the previous Open Lord, Dagult Neverember, Waterdeep collects a monthly tax from all who live within its official wards. The tax is 1 shard per person above the age of ten years, and is collected door-to-door by patrols of the City Guard on the last day of each month.
zh_tw: 正如前一位公開領主達格魯特·無燼統治的第一年所確定的，深水城向所有居住在其官方區域內的人每月徵收一次稅。稅款是每人一枚碎片幣，年齡超過十歲的人需要繳納，由城防軍的巡邏隊在每個月的最後一天挨家挨戶收取。

english: Individuals who so desire can pay a single dragon in tax and receive a writ exempting them for twelve months, but the writ must be produced every month when the Guard calls, or a new payment is required. If the Guard knocks at a door and receives no answer, a notice of lien with an estimation of tax is affixed to the door. The debt must be dealt with before the next month ends, with payment to be made to any magister.
zh_tw: 有此意願的個人可以支付一枚龍幣作為稅費，並獲得一份免稅令，有效期為十二個月，但每月守衛召喚時必須出示這份免稅令，否則需要重新支付。如果守衛敲門而無人應答，一份附有稅費估算的留置權通知將被貼在門上。債務必須在下個月結束前處理，款項需支付給任何一位法師。

english: Those who have no fixed residence can still be taxed if they are confronted in any building, be it an inn or an outhouse. So if you're out and around on the last day of the month, you'll no doubt experience "taxing traffic" as the streets become clogged with people trying to avoid the collectors.
zh_tw: 即使沒有固定住所的人，如果他們在任何建築物內，無論是旅館還是小屋，被攔截，仍然可以被徵稅。所以如果你在月底的最後一天外出，你無疑會經歷"徵稅交通堵塞"，因為街道上擠滿了試圖躲避收稅員的人群。

english: Waterdeep also raises revenue by charging other fees, such as the following: {@b 1 nib} per day for rental of a stall in the Market {@b 1 shard} (above and beyond any fines imposed) from anyone convicted by a magister, per conviction {@b 1 dragon} per conveyance leaving the city, empty or full {@b 5 dragons} per ship that touches dock in Waterdeep (except for city ships and diplomatic vessels), collected from the captain and covering a stay of up to fourteen days (a ship that leaves the harbor and returns during that time pays the tax upon reentry)
zh_tw: 深水城還透過收取其他費用來增加收入，例如以下費用：市場攤位租賃每天收費{@b 1個筆尖}，無論是否被法師定罪，每人每次定罪額外收費{@b 1片碎片}，離開城市的車輛每次收費{@b 1 條龍}，無論空載還是滿載，停靠在深水城碼頭的每艘船收費{@b 5條龍}（城市船隻和外交船隻除外），由船長支付，覆蓋最多十四天的停留時間（在那段時間內離開港口並返回的船隻在重新進入時需支付稅費）。

english: In times of trouble, direct taxes can also be imposed: {@b A fire tax} (usually 1 dragon per household), levied whenever a fire destroys a large portion of the city {@b A wall tax} or harbor tax (usually 1 dragon per household) raised to directly pay for needed repairs or expansions {@b A lance tax} raised to provide a payroll for mercenaries hired by the city when required (usually 1 shard per household each tenday until the Lords repeal the tax)
zh_tw: 在困難時期，還可以直接徵收稅款：{@b 火災稅}（通常每戶1龍幣），每當火災摧毀城市大部分地區時徵收；{@b 城牆稅}或港口稅（通常每戶1龍幣），用於直接支付所需的維修或擴建費用；{@b 長矛稅}用於在城市需要時為僱傭的僱傭兵提供工資（通常每戶每十天1碎片幣，直到領主廢除該稅）。

english: Getting About
zh_tw: 出行

english: Perambulating is the superior manner of experiencing the city and all its splendors. But if you've come with your own conveyance, the weather is inclement, or some other reason drives you to use the roads, the following are facts you need to know.
zh_tw: 步行是體驗這座城市及其所有輝煌的更佳方式。但如果你自帶交通工具，天氣惡劣，或者有其他原因促使你使用道路，以下是你需要知道的事實。

english: Traffic and Travel
zh_tw: 交通與旅行

english: Waterdeep is a city of broad boulevards that thrum with traffic. All day and well into the night, a bewildering melee of wagons, {@item cart|PHB|carts}, horse and pony riders, {@item carriage|PHB|carriages}, buggies, hire-coaches, and Waterdeep's signature towering drays (further discussed below) surges through its major thoroughfares. Fortunately, most roads are flanked by paved sidewalks that give pedestrians plenty of space, and most of the widest roads have raised dividers that allow an individual crossing a street a safe space to step out of the fray and wait for traffic to pass.
zh_tw: 深水城是一個擁有寬闊大道的城市，車輛川流不息。從早到晚，甚至深夜，馬車上、{@item carriage|PHB|四輪客車}、騎馬者、{@item cart|PHB|二輪貨車}、輕便馬車、出租馬車以及深水城標誌性的高聳拖車（將在下文中進一步討論）在其主要幹道上湧動。幸運的是，大多數道路兩旁都有鋪砌的人行道，為行人提供了充足的空間，而最寬的道路上還設有抬高的分隔帶，使行人過街時可以有一個安全的空間，避開車流並等待車輛透過。

english: The city's centuries-old layout dictates its traffic patterns today. Waterdeep lies on a plateau adjacent to a long mountain that shields much of it from the sea. In the southern third of the city, where the land slopes up from the harbor, the High Road and the Way of the Dragon are the two main south-north roads. These converge both at the Waymoot near the southern gate, and in the heart of the Trades Ward where the city is at its narrowest-bounded by Castle Waterdeep, high on a spur of the mountain, and the walls of the City of the Dead. The conjoined boulevard then splits to the north, continuing as the High Road, and to the west as a boulevard called Waterdeep Way, heading toward the Palace of Waterdeep (not to be confused with Waterdeep Castle, which it passes hard by). In the middle of the city, six boulevards run north from Waterdeep Way, where they meet the road that encircles the Market. On the other side of the Market, five boulevards continue north.
zh_tw: 這座城市的古老佈局決定了今天的交通模式。深水城位於一個高原上，緊鄰一座長長的山脈，這座山脈從海上保護了它的大部分。在城市的南部三分之一，土地從港口向上傾斜，高地路（高路）和龍道（龍道）是兩條主要的南北向道路。這兩條路在南門附近的路會廣場匯合，也在商業區（商業區）中心匯合，那裡是城市最狹窄的地方——被建在山的突出部分上的深水堡（深水堡）和亡者之城（亡者之城）的牆壁所界定。然後，聯合大道向北分成高地路，向西則分成一條名為深水城大道（深水大道）的林蔭大道，通往深水宮（深水宮），（不要與它經過的深水堡混淆）。在城市的中部，六條林蔭大道從深水城大道向北延伸，在那裡它們與環繞市場的路相匯合。在市場的另一邊，五條林蔭大道繼續向北延伸。

english: The aforementioned boulevards, along with the Street of the Singing Dolphin in the Sea Ward, are the major arteries of the city. Hire-coaches and drays can be most frequently found on those streets, and traffic is at its most hectic there. Most other roads in the city run east to west, but regardless of their direction, traffic elsewhere is generally less hectic and thus safer to cross.
zh_tw: 前述的林蔭大道，以及海區的歌唱海豚街，是這座城市的主要交通幹道。出租馬車和貨車最常出現在這些街道上，交通也最為繁忙。城市中大多數其他道路都是東西向的，但無論它們的方向如何，其他地方的交通通常不那麼繁忙，因此過馬路相對更安全。

english: Street Signs
zh_tw: 街道標誌

english: Thanks to the Scriveners', Scribes', and Clerks' Guild, Waterdeep has a remarkable custom of labeling its streets, and even many of its alleyways and courts. The method of identification varies by ward and neighborhood (including brass plates, carvings in stone, and stencil-painted wooden signs), but street names are typically displayed on the corners of buildings at intersections, roughly a dozen feet above ground. The name of the road you travel on will be on the wall nearest, while the name of the crossing road will be around the corner. Simply ingenious!
zh_tw: 得益於文書、抄寫員和職員公會，深水城有一個非凡的習俗，即對其街道進行標記，甚至包括許多小巷和庭院。標識方法因區域和社群而異（包括黃銅牌、石刻和模板噴塗的木牌），但街道名稱通常顯示在建築物的角落處的交叉口，大約離地面一打尺高。你正在走的路的名稱將在最近的牆上，而交叉路的名稱將在拐角處。真是巧妙極了！

english: Landmarks
zh_tw: 地標

english: Proud Mount Waterdeep provides a useful landmark for general orientation. It stands stark across the skyline to the west, its far slopes dropping right into the sea. A spur of the mountain juts inland, and atop the easternmost point of this spur stands Castle Waterdeep. If you can see these landmarks, it's relatively easy to orient yourself. The mountain peak looms over the southern third of the city near the port in the south. The City of the Dead lies opposite the northern ridge of Mount Waterdeep, which descends down to the Field of Triumph, the city's great coliseum.
zh_tw: 自豪的深水山是一般定位的有用地標。它矗立在西邊的天際線上，其遠處的山坡一直延伸到海中。山脈的一條支脈向內陸延伸，在這條支脈的最東端矗立著深水堡。如果你能看到這些地標，那麼相對容易確定自己的位置。山峰高聳在城市南部靠近港口的三分之一地區上空。亡者之城位於深水山北脊的對面，北脊向下延伸至勝利之地，即這座城市的大型競技場。

english: One of Waterdeep's titanic walking statues, no longer mobile, offers another way to orient yourself on a local scale. At nine stories tall, twice the height of any buildings nearby, the Honorable Knight stands guard in a block of buildings between Snail Street and the Way of the Dragon. Positioned as it is nigh the place where four wards meet, you can use it to judge where you stand. If it is south and west of your position, you are in the Trades Ward. North and west? The Southern Ward. South and east? The Castle Ward. North and east? You're in the Dock Ward.
zh_tw: 深水城的一個巨大的行走雕像，現在已經不能移動，提供了另一種在地方尺度上定位自己的方法。榮譽騎士雕像高達九層，是附近任何建築物高度的兩倍，在蝸牛街（蝸牛街）和龍之路（龍道）之間的建築群中站崗。由於它幾乎位於四個區域的交匯處，你可以用它來判斷你的位置。如果在你的位置南面和西面，你就在商業區（商業區）。北面和西面？那是南區（南區）。南面和東面？城堡區（城堡區）。北面和東面？你在碼頭區（碼頭區）。

english: Traffic Wardens
zh_tw: 交通管理員

english: During particularly heavy traffic and at congested areas such as the great oval road around the Market, you might see a member of the City Watch serving as a traffic warden. Traffic wardens signal with small blue hand flags for traffic to proceed, and with yellow flags for traffic to hold. A traffic warden can often be heard blowing a whistle. When you hear it, look to the warden to see if you are being signaled. Failure to take care might result not only in accident but also arrest.
zh_tw: 在交通特別繁忙和擁堵的地區，比如圍繞市場的巨大橢圓形道路上，你可能會看到城市守衛的成員擔任交通管理員。交通管理員用小藍手旗示意交通繼續，用黃旗示意交通停止。交通管理員經常可以聽到吹哨子。當你聽到哨聲時，看向管理員，看看是否在向你發訊號。未能注意可能不僅會導致事故，還可能導致被捕。

english: The Unflappable Waterdavian
zh_tw: 泰然自若的深水城居民

english: Natives of the City of Splendors are notoriously slow to take offense. A Waterdavian plainly states their feelings as a warning, so that one is apt to hear "I don't find that amusing, friend," said pleasantly before real anger is shown. Some visitors misinterpret such behavior as cowardice or ignorance ("He was too stupid to realize I insulted him!"). For those who act on such misjudgments, however, surprise and regret are the usual results.
zh_tw: 輝煌之城的居民出了名地不容易生氣。一個深水城居民會直接表達他們的感受作為警告，所以人們常常會聽到"朋友，我不覺得那有趣，"在真正生氣之前愉快地說。有些訪客誤解這種行為是懦弱或無知（"他太笨了，沒意識到我侮辱了他！"）。然而，對於那些基於這種錯誤判斷採取行動的人，驚訝和遺憾通常是常見的結果。

english: Most Waterdavians are also slow to take fright unless facing magic or monsters. A swaggering warrior threatening them is quite likely to be stared at calmly, or even sneered at. "The only mortals that Waterdavians fear are a few unstable wizards and the Lords," {@creature Durnan|WDH} often says to those who are surprised by the nonchalance of the Yawning Portal's regulars concerning the open entrance to Undermountain in their midst. "And only when they've incurred the wrath of said persons themselves."
zh_tw: 大多數深水城居民除非面對魔法或怪物，否則不太容易感到害怕。一個傲慢的戰士威脅他們時，很可能會被冷靜地注視，甚至被嘲笑。"深水城居民唯一懼怕的凡人是一些不穩定的巫師和領主們，" {@creature Durnan|WDH|杜爾南} 經常對那些對地脈迷城的開放入口表現得漠不關心的呵欠之門常客們感到驚訝的人說道。"而且只有當他們自己激怒了這些人時。"

english: Drays
zh_tw: 鼠窩

english: These towering vehicles are, I believe, unique to Waterdeep. Invented by exiles from Lantan in the last century, a dray is a long, glassed-in carriage with bench seating that provides additional open-air bench seating on its roof. The driver sits at the level of the roof seating, providing a vantage point to see over other traffic and make eye contact with other dray drivers. You can enter this contraption through the back whenever it stops or slows down enough to make mounting the rear step safe.
zh_tw: 我相信這些高聳的車輛是深水城獨有的。在上個世紀，由來自蘭檀的流亡者發明，一輛大載客馬車是一種長長的、有玻璃窗的馬車，內部設有長凳座位，並在其頂部提供額外的露天長凳座位。駕駛員位於屋頂座位的水平位置，提供了一個視角，可以俯瞰其他交通並與其他大載客馬車駕駛員進行眼神交流。當它停下來或減慢速度足以讓登上後臺階安全時，你可以從後面進入這個裝置。

english: A fare taker stands at the back of the lower seating area to take your coin (typically 2 to 4 nibs). You can choose to ride inside or ascend the spiral stairway at the rear to ride atop the vehicle. Most drays run on the main north-south boulevards, but some circle the Market, and a few run along the smaller east-west roads in rough areas. Be warned that when the demand for drays is high-during rain or snow, or to get to or from an event at the Field of Triumph-conditions become crowded and perfect for pickpockets.
zh_tw: 一個收費員站在下層座位區的後面收取你的硬幣（通常是2到4個尼布）。你可以選擇坐在車內，或者爬上後面的螺旋樓梯，坐在車輛頂部。大多數貨車沿著主要的南北向林蔭大道行駛，但有些環繞市場，還有一些在較貧窮地區的較小東西向道路上行駛。請注意，當貨車需求高時——在雨中或雪中，或者去往或離開勝利之地的活動時——條件會變得擁擠，非常適合扒手。

english: Hire-Coaches
zh_tw: 出租馬車

english: If you desire to travel in relative comfort and be the master of your destination, simply give a spirited wave and shout to any hire-coach driver who has no passengers. Each of these handsome, two-wheeled black coaches comfortably seats two travelers (perhaps four if you're quite slim and very well acquainted), who ride facing the road ahead. The hire-coach's driver sits high and to the rear of the carriage, manipulating the horses by means of long reins and a short whip on a rod. The fare must be agreed upon and paid before the journey, but only rarely will the cost exceed a half-dozen shards.
zh_tw: 如果你希望旅行時相對舒適，並且能夠自主決定目的地，只需向任何沒有乘客的出租馬車司機揮手並大聲喊叫。這些漂亮的雙輪黑色馬車舒適地容納兩名旅客（如果你非常苗條且非常熟悉，可能是四個），他們面對前方的道路騎行。出租馬車的司機坐在馬車後方較高位置，透過長韁繩和短鞭（安裝在杆上）操縱馬匹。車費必須在旅程開始前商定並支付，但費用很少超過半打碎片幣。

english: Carriages
zh_tw: 馬車

english: The well-to-do-or those who want to ride in luxury during a day out-can hire a full carriage, many of which are as finely outfitted as those owned by the nobility. Up to eight can take such a ride in silken comfort. Prices and services vary, but generally you agree to rent the carriage, the services of the driver, and any attendant servants or guards for a full day.
zh_tw: 經濟寬裕的人——或者那些希望在外出時享受豪華體驗的人——可以租用一輛完整的馬車，其中許多馬車的裝飾與貴族擁有的馬車一樣精緻。多達八人可以享受這種絲綢般的舒適乘坐體驗。價格和服務各不相同，但通常你會同意租用馬車、司機的服務以及任何隨從僕人或警衛的全天服務。

english: Travel in Winter
zh_tw: 冬季旅行

english: The folk of Waterdeep often remain indoors in the colder months, particularly when it rains or snows. The flow of trade and travelers into the city slows to a trickle during winter, and as a result, traffic diminishes and drays and hire-coaches become more scarce. Fortunately, the Fellowship of Carters and Coachmen works with the Wheelwrights' Guild and the Wagon-makers' and Coach Builders' Guild to convert the drays and hirecoaches that do operate into sledges, so that some are available even in the worst weather.
zh_tw: 深水城的人們在寒冷的月份通常會待在室內，特別是下雨或下雪時。冬季進入城市的貿易和旅行者減少到涓涓細流，因此交通量減少，運貨車和出租馬車變得更加稀少。幸運的是，卡特和馬車伕團與車輪製造者公會以及四輪馬車製造商和馬車製造商公會合作，將那些仍在運營的運貨車和出租馬車改造成雪橇，以便即使在最惡劣的天氣中也有一些可用。

english: Nobility
zh_tw: 貴族血統

english: Spotting a Noble
zh_tw: 發現貴族

english: Nobility in Waterdeep are granted the right to bear arms. In the legal code of the city, this means not merely the ability to carry a weapon, but the right to retain up to seventy equipped soldiers. These soldiers always wear a house's colors and the house's "arms of grace"-a heraldic device often borne on a shield, worn as a cloak pin, or affixed to a helmet. Others throughout the city, even foreign dignitaries, are permitted to retain only up to sixteen armed warriors, and laws against impersonating those in the employ of the nobility mean that other mercenaries and bodyguards most often dress plainly, so as not to be mistaken for the retinue of a noble. So your first clue that you might be in the company of a noble is the sight of a large number of armed and uniformed soldiers.
zh_tw: 深水城的貴族被賦予了攜帶武器的權利。在城市的法律中，這不僅僅意味著攜帶武器的能力，還包括保留多達70名裝備齊全的士兵的權利。這些士兵總是穿著家族的顏色和家族的"恩典武器"——一個紋章裝置，通常刻在盾牌上，作為斗篷別針佩戴，或者固定在頭盔上。城市中的其他人，甚至是外國政要，只被允許保留最多16名武裝戰士，而且有法律禁止冒充貴族僱員，這意味著其他僱傭兵和保鏢通常穿著樸素，以免被誤認為是貴族的隨從。因此，你可能與貴族在一起的第一個線索是看到大量武裝和穿著制服的士兵。

english: Many nobles, particularly younger ones seeking entertainment, travel without an entourage of guards or only in the company of other nobles. In this case, you'll know you're in the presence of nobility because of the deference others give them. Follow suit, and you should be fine.
zh_tw: 許多貴族，特別是尋求娛樂的年輕貴族，會不帶隨從或僅與其他貴族一起旅行。在這種情況下，你會因為別人對他們的尊重而知道你在貴族面前。效仿他們，你應該會沒事。

english: Above all, be polite. Always address a known noble as "Lord" or "Lady." A short bow or a nod of the head to acknowledge a noble upon each meeting and parting is customary. Obsequiousness and servility is something all Waterdavians scorn, but you should also beware of acting in an overly familiar, boastful, or disrespectful way when in the presence of any noble. Though this sort of behavior isn't a crime, and laws against dueling prevent a noble from initiating a direct armed confrontation, the noble families of Waterdeep have immense power in the city, often in unexpected quarters. Many have influence in nations as distant as Calimshan and Cormyr. Be assured that any slighting of a noble will not be forgotten or easily forgiven.
zh_tw: 首先，要有禮貌。總是用"大人"或"夫人"來稱呼已知的貴族。每次見面和分別時，簡短的鞠躬或點頭是習慣性的禮節。過分諂媚和卑躬屈膝是所有深水城居民所鄙視的，但你也應該避免在任何貴族面前表現得過於熟絡、自誇或不尊重。雖然這種行為不構成犯罪，並且有關決鬥的法律禁止貴族發起直接的武裝對抗，但深水城的貴族家族在城市中擁有巨大的權力，往往在意想不到的領域。許多人在像卡利姆沙和科米爾這樣遙遠的國家都有影響力。可以肯定的是，對貴族的任何冒犯都不會被忘記，也不會容易被原諒。

english: If you're not certain whether someone is a noble, address the gentleman as "Saer" or the gentlewoman as "Goodwoman." Neither will give offense, and generally a noble will politely correct you as to their actual title.
zh_tw: 如果你不確定某人是否是貴族，可以稱呼男士為'閣下'或女士為'女士'。這兩種稱呼都不會冒犯人，通常貴族會禮貌地糾正你的稱呼，告訴你他們實際的頭銜。

english: A Wondrous People
zh_tw: 一個奇妙的民族

english: Whenever you find yourself in a bustling city, you're likely to spot a wonderful variety of folk. You hear words in languages utterly foreign to you, and you smell dishes both delectable and strange. Waterdeep is the ultimate city of such delights, and before long, the alien thing becomes familiar to you, and the stranger becomes your friend.
zh_tw: 每當你身處繁華的城市中，你很可能會看到各種精彩的人們。你聽到完全陌生的語言中的話語，聞到既美味又奇怪的菜餚。深水城就是這樣一個樂趣的終極之城，不久，陌生的東西變得熟悉，陌生人成為你的朋友。

english: The people of Waterdeep are among the greatest of its splendors. Fashion, comportment, love-these things are practiced with an art and a zest in the city uncommon elsewhere. Visit a festhall or festival and see for yourself! And don't miss the cross-dressing performers who regale audiences with humor and song. Fabulous-that word doesn't begin to describe it, especially when they enhance the merriment with magic.
zh_tw: 深水城的人們是這座城市最壯觀的景象之一。時尚、舉止、愛情——這些事情在這座城市中以一種罕見於其他地方的藝術和熱情被實踐。親自去節日大廳或節日慶典看看！不要錯過那些以幽默和歌曲娛樂觀眾的變裝表演者。奇妙——這個詞還不足以形容，尤其是當他們用魔法增加歡樂時。

english: The city is also a haven for those who define for themselves what it means to be a man or a woman, those who transcend gender as the gods do, and those who redefine entirely who they are. What confidence! I never tire of witnessing it. I have seen folk in Waterdeep whose lives are more magical than the marvels possible with spells.
zh_tw: 這座城市對於那些為自己定義男性或女性意義的人，那些像神一樣超越性別的人，以及那些完全重新定義自我的人來說，也是一個避風港。多麼的自信！我永遠看不厭。我在深水城見過的人們，他們的生活比魔法咒語所能創造的奇蹟還要神奇。

english: Nobles and Patronage
zh_tw: 貴族與贊助

english: Nobles in Waterdeep are patrons of and investors in all manner of businesses in the city and abroad, as well as the many expressions of the arts. They spend coin to fund celebrations, contests at the Field of Triumph, upkeep at the city's temples and shrines, civic projects, guild events, and charitable actions such as burial of the unknown dead. Their motives are manifold, but their actions-no matter the reason-earn them loyalty and high regard from those who benefit from their largesse.
zh_tw: 深水城的貴族是城市內外各種商業的贊助人和投資者，也是藝術的多種表現形式的投資者。他們花費金錢資助慶典、勝利之地的比賽、城市神殿和神龕的維護、市政專案、行會活動，以及慈善行為，如為無名死者提供葬禮。他們的動機多種多樣，但無論出於何種原因，他們的行為都為他們贏得了那些從他們的慷慨中受益的人的忠誠和高度尊重。

english: Seeking patronage from a noble without having been introduced to that person is considered an insult, so you must first befriend someone in a noble's employ or circle of influence. Doing so is no guarantee of ultimate success; much time and coin can be wasted trying to curry favor with an acquaintance of a noble who turns out to be unscrupulous or of little help for some other reason. My advice is to do something deserving of attention, whatever your vocation, and someone from the noble families of Waterdeep will eventually show an interest.
zh_tw: 在沒有被介紹的情況下尋求貴族的贊助被認為是一種侮辱，所以你必須首先與貴族的僱員或影響圈中的某人建立友誼。即便如此，也不能保證最終成功；你可能在試圖討好一個最終證明是不擇手段或由於其他原因幫助不大的貴族熟人時，浪費大量時間和金錢。我的建議是，無論你的職業是什麼，做一些值得關注的事情，深水城的貴族家族最終會表現出興趣。

english: Know a Noble's Business
zh_tw: 瞭解貴族的生意

english: In the words of that quarrelsome acquaintance of mine from the Dales, "Before you strut your stuff in the chickens' preening circle, get to know the other cocks first." This colorful aphorism applies well to the affairs of nobility, because when you have interaction with a noble, you are at the same time dealing with one's entire family-as well as a network of business associates and allies. That situation can put you in a troublesome spot if you are unaware of the noble's connections.
zh_tw: 用我那位來自谷地的好爭論的朋友的話說，"在你到雞群中炫耀之前，先了解其他的公雞。" 這句生動的格言非常適合貴族的事務，因為當你與貴族互動時，你同時也在與一個人的整個家族——以及一個商業夥伴和盟友的網路打交道。如果你不瞭解貴族的聯絡，這種情況可能會讓你陷入困境。

english: Waterdeep at Night
zh_tw: 深水城之夜

english: Guilds and Guild Law
zh_tw: 公會和公會法
