english: No aspect of life in Waterdeep goes untouched by at least one of its more than forty guilds. Virtually every profession has an associated guild, and there's hardly a citizen of the city who doesn't belong to one or more guilds, or doesn't work for someone who does. As a visitor to Waterdeep, you need to know this, lest you run afoul of "Guild Law." Guild Law isn't technically in the legal code of Waterdeep, but guilds are mentioned in the oldest surviving legal documents-penned by Ahghairon himself-and the rules of Guild Law are respected by wise city folk.
zh_tw: 深水城生活中的任何方面都至少受到其四十多個行會中一個的影響。幾乎所有的職業都有相應的行會，而且幾乎沒有一個城市居民不屬於一個或多個行會，或者不為屬於行會的人工作。作為深水城的訪客，你需要知道這一點，以免觸犯"行會法"。行會法技術上不在深水城的法律條文中，但行會在最古老的現存法律檔案中被提及——由阿蓋爾倫本人撰寫——而且行會法的規則受到明智市民的尊重。

english: Guilds take their laws seriously, as do members of the City Watch and the magisters. If you flout a guild's traditions, you can expect not only public scorn but also a visit from enforcers of the law. In addition, many guilds have their own codes of accusation, trial, and punishment, such as:
zh_tw: 公會對他們的法律非常重視，城市守衛和法官也是如此。如果你蔑視一個公會的傳統，你不僅可以預期會受到公眾的鄙視，還會受到法律執行者的訪問。此外，許多公會都有自己的指控、審判和懲罰的規則，例如：

english: A member of the Bakers' Guild who sells bread baked in the wrong shape will be drenched with water and coated in his own flour.
zh_tw: 麵包師公會的成員如果出售烘烤成錯誤形狀的麵包，將會被水淋溼並裹上自己的麵粉。

english: Heckling a member of the Jesters' Guild will result in the offending party being jeered at in public by no less than four guild members for a period of four days.
zh_tw: 嘲笑小丑公會的成員將導致冒犯者在四天內被不少於四名公會成員公開嘲笑。

english: Any ship that unloads its cargo without due observance or aid by the Guild of Watermen shall have its cargo seized or thrown into the harbor.
zh_tw: 任何未按規定觀察或在水手行會的幫助下解除安裝貨物的船隻，其貨物將被沒收或扔進海港。

english: Many guilds have codes that entwine each other, complicating matters even more for the outsider. In Neverwinter, if you want to construct a building, you simply purchase the land and hire workers to build it. In Waterdeep, the Surveyors', Map-, and Chart-makers' Guild must first be consulted upon designation of the plat, then brought in to draw or approve the construction plan. The Cellarers' and Plumbers' Guild must then clear and prepare the site, only after which will you be able to hire members of the Carpenters', Roofers', and Plaisterers' Guild to erect the structure.
zh_tw: 許多公會的規則相互交織，這使得外人面臨的情況變得更加複雜。在無冬城，如果你想建造一棟建築，你只需購買土地並僱傭工人來建造它。在深水城，必須首先諮詢測量員、地圖和圖表製作者公會，以確定土地的劃分，然後讓他們來繪製或批准施工計劃。隨後，地窖管理員和管道工公會必須清理和準備場地，之後你才能僱傭木匠、屋頂工和石膏工公會的成員來建造結構。

english: Moreover, the work will not be complete until members of the Guild of Fine Carvers and the Guild of Stonecutters, Masons, Potters, and Tile-makers design and craft any decorative elements of wood, stone, or ceramics, and after the Most Careful Order of Skilled Smiths and Metalforgers has manufactured and installed any door hinges. If the building is to be connected to the sewers or a city water supply, the Cellarers' and Plumbers' Guild must be called upon again to do that work. Want glazed windows installed? For that, you need to hire members of the Guild of Glassblowers, Glaziers, and Spectacle-makers.
zh_tw: 此外，只有當細木工藝師行會和石雕工、泥瓦匠、陶工和瓷磚製造商行會的成員設計並製作了任何木製、石制或陶瓷的裝飾元素，並且在最細心的技能鐵匠和金屬鍛造師行會製造並安裝了所有門鉸鏈之後，這項工作才算完成。如果建築物需要連線到下水道或城市供水系統，那麼地窖管理員和管道工行會必須再次被召集來完成這項工作。想要安裝上釉窗戶嗎？為此，你需要僱傭玻璃吹制工、玻璃安裝工和眼鏡製造商行會的成員。

english: If you do business in the city as anything other than a purchaser of goods and services, I strongly advise you to seek out a local solicitor and pay to be guided through the process. No guild of solicitors exists, so be sure your choice comes highly recommended by individuals you can trust. To learn the peculiarities of any guild's rules, consult someone on duty at the guild headquarters or ask a senior guild member.
zh_tw: 如果你在城市中做生意，身份不僅僅是購買商品和服務的顧客，我強烈建議你尋找一位當地的律師並支付費用，以便他們引導你完成整個過程。沒有律師公會存在，所以請確保你的選擇是由你信任的人高度推薦的。要了解任何公會規則的特殊性，可以諮詢公會總部值班的人員或詢問資深公會成員。

english: All that said, working at a guild-related profession without being a member of that guild isn't illegal. Guild members have no lawful recourse to interfere in the business of someone who chooses to not join the organization. But if you practice a trade or operate a business without becoming a member of the appropriate guild, word spreads, and you'll find that your coin isn't good for purchasing the goods or services of anyone who is a guild member. Since that group includes virtually everyone who sells the necessities of life or offers shelter for a fee, the benefits of joining a guild swiftly become apparent to those who procrastinate in this regard.
zh_tw: 話雖如此，從事與行會相關的職業而沒有成為該行會成員並不是非法的。行會成員沒有法律依據去幹涉選擇不加入該組織的人的生意。但是，如果你從事某個行業或經營某個業務而沒有成為相應行會的成員，訊息會傳開，你會發現你的貨幣無法用來購買任何行會成員的商品或服務。由於這個群體包括幾乎所有出售生活必需品或收費提供住宿的人，加入行會的好處對於那些在這方面拖延的人很快就會變得顯而易見。

english: The Wards of Waterdeep
zh_tw: 深水城各大區

english: Newcomers to the city of Waterdeep are often confused by the importance that Waterdavians give to wards. In other cities, such as Baldur's Gate and Neverwinter, districts are bounded by rivers or walls. But in Waterdeep, one can traverse from ward to ward by crossing a street-a fact that offers the drivers of hire-coaches some amusement when an ignorant tourist requests a ride to an adjacent ward.
zh_tw: 新來深水城的人常常對深水城居民給予區域的重要性感到困惑。在其他城市，如博德之門和無冬城，區域是由河流或牆壁界定的。但在深水城，一個人可以透過穿過一條街道從一個區域走到另一個區域——這一事實為出租馬車的司機提供了一些娛樂，當一個無知的遊客請求乘車去相鄰的區域時。

english: Each ward has its own history, legends, and traditions based around who lived there in the past, famous or infamous events, and the uncanny things that continue to occur. For example, children (and even some adults) hop on one foot when crossing Asmagh's Alley in the Castle Ward. Why? Well, Asmagh was an apothecary who {@condition poisoned} many patients, then buried them upright beneath the alley under cover of night. He was discovered, and some say that as many as eighty bodies were subsequently pulled up from holes under the alley's wide flagstones. Though this happened over a century ago, children passing through the alley still sing a song: "Hop for the hollows, hop for the dead, hop on the flagstones, hop on their heads." As you stroll down Warrior's Way or the Street of Silver, listen for the children's delighted screams and go give it a try.
zh_tw: 每個街區都有自己基於過去居住者、著名或臭名昭著的事件以及持續發生的離奇事物的歷史、傳說和傳統。例如，孩子們（甚至一些成年人）在穿過城堡區的阿斯瑪格小巷時會單腳跳躍。為什麼？嗯，阿斯瑪格是一位藥劑師，他{@condition poisoned||中毒}了許多病人，然後在夜間將他們直立埋葬在小巷下。他被發現了，有人說隨後從小巷寬石板下的洞中挖出了多達八十具屍體。儘管這發生在一個多世紀以前，但經過小巷的孩子們仍然唱著一首歌："為空洞跳躍，為死者跳躍，在石板上跳躍，在他們的頭上跳躍。"當你漫步在戰士之路或銀街時，聽聽孩子們欣喜的尖叫聲，不妨也去試試。

english: These shared stories and traditions impart to each ward a different culture, just as much as distinctions of class and wealth. Yet nothing drives residents to identify with their wards as much as festivals and sport. Nearly every race and parade in the city features a competition between wards as part of the festivities. On such days, homes and businesses fly the colors of their wards, trot out their mascots, and sing rousing songs that celebrate where they live. If you stay in the city for even a month, you're sure to see some version of this display of civic spirit.
zh_tw: 這些共享的故事和傳統賦予每個區域不同的文化，就像階級和財富的區別一樣。然而，沒有什麼比節日和運動更能促使居民認同他們所在的區域。城市中幾乎所有的種族和遊行都以區域間的競爭作為慶祝活動的一部分。在這樣的日子裡，家庭和企業都會展示他們所在區域的顏色，展示他們的吉祥物，並唱起振奮人心的歌曲來慶祝他們居住的地方。如果你在城市裡待上哪怕一個月，你肯定會看到這種公民精神展示的某種版本。

english: Speak like a Native
zh_tw: 像當地人一樣說話

english: The many idioms and slang expressions of Waterdavians would take a whole book to explore, but here I explain a few that might otherwise mystify.
zh_tw: 深水城居民的許多成語和俚語表達需要整本書來探索，但在這裡我解釋一些可能會讓人迷惑的。

english: {@b "Dabbler but no master" and "No mastery blazing forth"} These idioms trace their origin to Ahghairon, who early on in his studies of magic humbly said, "I am no wizard. I am a dabbler but no master of magic; it seems no mastery burns within me." Both now serve as expressions of false modesty applied to any skill or craft, not just magic use.
zh_tw: {@b "涉獵者但非大師"和"沒有顯露出精通"} 這些成語起源於阿蓋爾倫，在他對魔法的研究初期謙遜地說："我不是法師。我是一個涉獵者，但不是魔法的大師；似乎我內心沒有燃燒的精通之光。" 現在這兩個成語都作為對任何技能或手藝的虛假謙虛的表達，而不僅僅是魔法的使用。

english: {@b "Sharpjaws," "fastfists," "bullyblades," and "alleyblades"} Those who boast of martial skill but who shrink from violence or lack real ability are "sharpjaws." In sharp contrast are Waterdeep's "fastfists" (any lout easily provoked to violence), "bullyblades" (battle-hardened mercenaries hired as muscle), and "alleyblades" (muggers and thieves).
zh_tw: {@b "銳顎","快手","惡霸刀","巷刀"} 那些誇耀武術技能但卻迴避暴力或缺乏真實能力的人被稱為"利嘴者"。與之形成鮮明對比的是深水城的"快拳者"（任何容易被激怒而施暴的粗人）、"惡霸風流劍客"（作為打手僱傭的身經百戰的傭兵）和"巷戰風流劍客"（搶劫犯和小偷）。

english: {@b "Longride" and "Last ride"} To a caravan merchant, a drover, or a farmer from the lands around Waterdeep, as well as any Waterdavian who rides for sport, recreation, hunting, or falconry, the late afternoon is "longride," and dusk is "last ride."
zh_tw: {@b "長途旅行" 和 "最後一程"} 對於一個商隊商人、趕牛人或來自深水城周邊土地的農民，以及任何為了運動、娛樂、打獵或鷹獵而騎馬的深水城居民來說，下午晚些時候是 "長途騎行"，而黃昏是 "最後一騎"。

english: {@b "Which the greater thief?"} Tuezaera Hallowhand was a famous "lone cat" thief of Waterdeep in the 1200s DR, who disappeared suddenly and is thought to have come to a violent end. She once robbed a wizard and wrote this on his wall with a fingertip dipped in his favorite red wine: "I take things. You take freedom with your spells. Which of us is the greater thief?" Waterdavians now use this phrase in argument with one another over all kinds of matters when comparing wrongs done.
zh_tw: {@b "哪個是更大的小偷？"} 圖澤拉·哈洛漢德是1200年代深水城著名的"獨行貓"竊賊，她突然失蹤並被認為遭遇了暴力結局。她曾搶劫了一位巫師，並用手指蘸著他最愛的紅酒在牆上寫道："我偷東西。你用你的法術偷取自由。我們中誰是更大的竊賊？"如今，深水城的居民在各種事務的爭論中，當比較誰做得更過分時，都會使用這句話。

english: {@b "Doth thy mirror crack?" or "Hurl but think not?" or "Take but not count cost? Be nothing, then!"} {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH}, then the Lady Mage of Waterdeep when she was married to Khelben "Blackstaff" Arunsun, once publicly rebuked an overambitious wizard of the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors thusly: "If I hurl spells but think not of consequences, I am nothing. If I take lives but count not the cost, I am nothing. If I steal in the night and see not the faces of the devastated come the next morning, I am nothing. If I make decrees like a ruler but undertake none of the other responsibilities of the throne, I am nothing. And if I do all these things in the name of the Watchful Order, I am less than nothing. Doth thy mirror crack?"
zh_tw: {@b "你的鏡子裂了嗎？"或者"投擲但不考慮後果？"或者"拿走但不計算代價？那就什麼也不是吧！"} 當時作為深水城的女法師，也是和凱爾本 "黑杖" 阿倫森結婚後的萊拉·銀手{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}，曾這樣公開斥責警戒法師與護衛教團的一位過於雄心勃勃的法師："如果我施展法術但不考慮後果，那我什麼都不是。如果我奪取生命但不計算代價，那我什麼都不是。如果我在夜晚偷竊，第二天早晨沒有看到那些被摧毀者的面孔，那我什麼都不是。如果我像統治者一樣制定法令，但不承擔王位的其他責任，那我什麼都不是。如果我以警戒法師與護衛教團的名義做所有這些事情，那我連什麼都不如。你的鏡子裂了嗎？"

english: These scornful words are remembered and used almost daily in Waterdeep even a century later.
zh_tw: 即使在一個世紀後的深水城，這些輕蔑的話語仍然被人們銘記並幾乎每天都在使用。

english: Sea Ward
zh_tw: 海區

english: The Sea Ward stands proud on the high ground above Mount Waterdeep's sunset shadow. The rich and the powerful (or those who wish you to think such of them, and can afford the rent) reside or run their businesses here. When the warlords and pirates of early Waters Deep gained enough gold, they built fortresses on what used to be fields of grass tousled by sea wind. You can still see the remains of some of those old castles incorporated into the palatial homes of the noble families that dwell in the Sea Ward. For the best all-around view of the glittering homes enshrouded by garden walls, go to where Diamond Street and Delzorin Street cross, nigh to Mystra's House of Wonder, and simply spin in a circle.
zh_tw: 海區自豪地坐落在深水城山日落陰影的高地上。富人和有權勢的人（或者那些希望你這樣認為的人，並且能付得起租金的人）在這裡居住或經營他們的業務。當早期深水城的軍閥和海盜獲得足夠的金幣時，他們在曾經被海風吹拂的草地上建造了堡壘。你仍然可以看到一些那些古老城堡的遺蹟被納入居住在海區的貴族家族的豪華住宅中。要想獲得被花園牆環繞的閃閃發光的房屋的最佳全景，可以去鑽石街和德爾佐林街交匯處，靠近密斯特拉的奇蹟之屋，然後簡單地轉一圈。

english: Blue and gold are the Sea Ward's colors in competitions, and the ward's mascot is the sea lion-a fanciful combination of fish and feline. There's a persistent but patently false legend that the famous Lion Gate at the Field of Triumph is the gaping maw of a sea lion. The architectural designs for the gates show this to be false, however, and they can be viewed in the Map House-the guildhall of the Surveyors', Map-, and Chart-makers' Guild in the Castle Ward.
zh_tw: 藍色和金色是海區在競賽中的顏色，該區的吉祥物是海獅——一種魚和貓的奇特組合。有一個持續存在但明顯是錯誤的傳說，認為著名的位於勝利之地的獅子門是一隻海獅張開的大嘴。然而，大門的建築設計證明這是虛假的，這些設計可以在地圖之屋——城堡區測量員、地圖和圖表製作者行會的行會大廳中看到。

english: Must-see locations in the Sea Ward begin, of course, with the Field of Triumph, but just across the street is the no less remarkable House of Heroes-the largest temple in the city. Dedicated to Tempus, its many grand halls celebrate the city's champions of both battle and sport. The winners of ward competitions are paraded here after their victories, often carried on shoulders or passed from hand to hand over the heads of a crowd. It is a sight you shouldn't miss.
zh_tw: 海區必看的地點當然首先是凱旋場，但就在街對面同樣引人注目的是英雄之家——城市中最大的神廟。它奉獻給坦帕斯，其許多宏偉的大廳慶祝城市在戰鬥和運動中的英雄。區域競賽的獲勝者在勝利後會在這裡遊行，經常被扛在肩上或在人群頭上傳遞。這是你不應該錯過的景象。

english: You should also visit the House of Wonder. This is surely the most splendid temple dedicated to the gods of magic—with Mystra foremost among them, of course—in all the world. Although your eye will be drawn to its ornate towers, brilliant mosaics, and magical displays, look also for the humble violets growing amid the ostentation. These delicate flowers were Ahghairon's favorite, and they are planted about the temple in memory of him.
zh_tw: 你也應該參觀奇蹟之屋。這無疑是世界上供奉魔法之神——當然，以神秘女士密斯特拉為首——的最壯觀的神殿。儘管你的目光會被其華麗的塔樓、燦爛的馬賽克和魔法展示所吸引，也要注意那些在奢華中生長的紫羅蘭。這些精緻的花兒是阿蓋爾倫最喜歡的，它們被種植在神殿周圍以紀念他。

english: Two other temples in the ward are as impressive, but in different ways. The beauteous House of the Moon has the tallest tower of any temple in the city, rising some seventy-five feet above the street. At its top, priests of Selûne bask in the light of the moon in all seasons. The House of Inspired Hands, dedicated to Gond, presents an altogether less peaceful experience. Here, all the great innovative minds of the city invent and experiment, attempting to create everything from flying machines to stronger door hinges. But don't expect a museum of marvels such as can be found in Baldur's Gate. At this site, "worship is work," as anyone at the temple is liable to tell you.
zh_tw: 本區另有兩座同樣令人印象深刻、卻各具特色的神殿。美麗的月之屋擁有全城神殿中最高的塔，塔頂高出街面約75尺。塞倫涅的祭司一年四季都在塔頂沐浴月光。獻給貢德的巧手之屋則遠不如前者寧靜。城中偉大的創新者在此發明、實驗，試圖打造從飛行機器到更堅固門鉸鏈的各種事物。不過，別期待這裡有博德之門那樣的奇妙博物館。在此處，正如神殿裡任何人都可能告訴你的：「工作即崇拜。」

english: If you're looking for some good fortune, you should surely visit the Tower of Luck, a temple complex dedicated to Tymora. The "tower" in question is actually a many-pillared atrium ingeniously roofed over with glass. Beneath the roof, a bronze sculpture of a diminutive Tymora, depicted as a laughing young girl, appears to be leaping from the very top of an astounding fountain. To pay your respects and make a wish, you come around to the fountain on a walkway and toss your coin to Tymora. Managing to land it in her outstretched hand is a sure sign of her favor.
zh_tw: 如果你在尋找好運，你當然應該去拜訪幸運之塔，這是一個專門獻給提莫拉的寺廟建築群。所謂的"塔"實際上是一個有許多柱子的中庭，巧妙地用玻璃封頂。在屋頂下，一個銅製的小提莫拉雕塑，被描繪成一個大笑的年輕女孩，似乎正從一個驚人的噴泉頂部跳躍。為了表示敬意並許願，你來到一個步道上的噴泉邊，把你的硬幣扔給提莫拉。如果能夠成功地落在她伸出的手中，那肯定是她青睞的明確跡象。

english: If you need to refresh yourself during your travels, or perhaps to primp before an important meeting or a night out, visit Sune's faithful at the Temple of Beauty. Its marbled public baths and mirrored salons are open from before dawn to after dusk. There's no fee for these services, or for the advice and aid of the temple's many pleasant attendants, but donations are encouraged.
zh_tw: 如果您在旅行中需要恢復精力，或者在重要會議或外出前想要打扮一下，請拜訪位於美麗神廟的蘇恩的信徒們。它的大理石公共浴室和鏡子沙龍從黎明前一直開放到黃昏後。這些服務，以及寺廟裡許多愉快的服務員的建議和幫助，都是免費的，但鼓勵捐款。

english: Two parks in the Sea Ward might also be worth your time. The Shrines to Nature, just a block away from the Tower of Luck, are resplendent gardens dedicated to nature gods like Mielikki and Silvanus. The park is closed to all except residents of the Sea Ward. Yet from beyond the iron fence that surrounds it, you can catch glimpses of the superb shrines, statues, and fountains within. The Heroes' Garden is the only green space in the city that is open to the public besides the City of the Dead, but it is tucked away so far to the north in the Sea Ward that it gets few visitors-which is a pity, since the fine statuary in this lush garden portrays many of the figures important to the city's history.
zh_tw: 海區的兩個公園也許值得你花時間去參觀。自然之神神殿，距離幸運之塔僅一個街區之遙，是壯麗的花園，專門獻給像梅麗凱和西爾瓦努斯這樣的自然神。這個公園對海區居民之外的所有人關閉。然而，從圍繞它的鐵柵欄之外，你可以一窺內部的精美神殿、雕像和噴泉。英雄花園是城市中除了亡者之城外唯一對公眾開放的綠地，但它位於海區北端，因此很少有遊客——這是很遺憾的，因為這座鬱鬱蔥蔥的花園中精美的雕塑描繪了對城市歷史有重要意義的許多人物。

english: I hesitate to mention a last location in the Sea Ward, and I will not reveal where to find it, for reasons that will soon become apparent. There is a house in the Sea Ward without windows or doors. You can't see it from the street, and those who live near it will not speak of it to others. You'll know you are near it when you see blue tiles on the streets and walls leading into an alley that passes under the surrounding buildings. At night, these tiles glimmer dimly with the blue light of foxfire. More than one route leads into the Blue Alley, as this place is known, but there are precious few ways out. Most who enter don't come back. If you see blue tiles, turn around and walk away before it is too late.
zh_tw: 我猶豫是否要提及海區的最後一個地點，並且我不會透露在哪裡找到它，原因很快就會變得明顯。海區有一座沒有窗戶或門的房子。你從街上看不見它，住在它附近的人也不會與他人談論它。當你看到街道和牆壁上鋪著藍色瓷磚，通向穿過周圍建築物的小巷時，你就會知道你靠近了。在夜晚，這些瓷磚會微弱地閃爍著藍綠色的熒光。進入這個被稱為藍巷的地方有不止一條路線，但出來的路卻非常少。大多數進入的人都不會回來。如果你看到藍色瓷磚，趁還來得及轉身離開。

zh_tw: 快速正義

english: North Ward
zh_tw: 北區

english: For the best experience in the North Ward, go there just before dawn, buy a broadsheet, and settle in at a café with a view of the street. Watch as the ward comes quietly to life around you. At first, it will be so silent that you'll be able to hear the resident a street over who opens her sash for fresh air and clears her throat. Then the birdsong will begin, and shortly thereafter, you'll hear and then see the drays arriving with servants. These aren't the live-in staff used by noble houses, but people hired to come and work for a day. Most of them come from less affluent parts of the city, arriving with the tools of their trade and outfitted in their customary garb: launderers and cooks in white, chimney sweeps and housecleaners in black, valets and child-minders in gray, gardeners in green, and tutors in blue.
zh_tw: 要在北區獲得最佳體驗，就在黎明前去那裡，買一份報紙，然後在一家有街道景觀的咖啡館安頓下來。觀察周圍社群在你周圍悄然甦醒。起初，這裡會非常安靜，以至於你能聽到街道對面開窗透氣並清嗓子的居民。然後，鳥鳴聲會開始，不久之後，你會聽到並看到運貨車帶著僕人到來。這些不是貴族家庭使用的住家員工，而是被僱來工作一天的人。他們大多來自城市不太富裕的地區，帶著他們的工具並穿著他們習慣的服裝：洗衣工和廚師穿白色，煙囪清潔工和清潔工穿黑色，貼身男僕和保姆穿灰色，園丁穿綠色，家庭教師穿藍色。

english: As these servants spread out to knock on doors and begin their work, the residents of the ward take their exits, parting fondly with spouses and children, their footsteps tramping along the sidewalks or taking them into rattling hire-coaches. In the span of just an hour, the North Ward comes to noisy life and then settles again into quiescence, until later in the day when the process reverses itself, as residents return from work and servants leave.
zh_tw: 當這些僕人分散開來敲門並開始他們的工作時，這個區域的居民也紛紛出門，親切地與配偶和孩子告別，他們的腳步沿著人行道踏行或帶他們進入嘎嘎作響的出租馬車。在短短的一個小時之內，北區變得喧鬧起來，然後又恢復了寧靜，直到一天晚些時候這一過程逆轉，居民們從工作地返回，僕人們離開。

english: The liveliest, and perhaps the loveliest, part of the ward is the Cliffwatch. Here, the plateau upon which Waterdeep sits features cliffs so steep and high that the city wall is interrupted to either side of them. Some of the most lavish residences and most luxurious taverns and inns of Waterdeep stand along this space, boasting terraces and balconies that allow one to take in the beautiful sight of the countryside to the east. Yet you need not pay their high prices, for a public walkway along the cliff's edge offers pedestrians ample opportunity to enjoy the view.
zh_tw: 這個區域最熱鬧，也許也是最可愛的地方是崖望。在這裡，深水城所坐落的高原有如此陡峭和高大的懸崖，以至於城牆在它們兩側都中斷了。深水城一些最豪華的住宅以及最奢侈的酒館和旅館就坐落在這個空間，擁有露臺和陽臺，讓人可以欣賞到東邊鄉村的美麗景色。然而，你無需支付他們高昂的價格，因為沿著懸崖邊的公共步行道為行人提供了充足的欣賞景色的機會。

english: The North Ward's colors are green and orange, and its mascot is the gentle white dove, depicted in flight. Many North Ward homes have dovecotes on their roofs, and the great flocks of the birds that circle over the city at dawn and dusk are a delight to behold.
zh_tw: 北區的顏色是綠色和橙色，它的吉祥物是展翅飛翔的溫柔白鴿。許多北區的房屋屋頂上都有鴿子窩，而在黎明和黃昏時分，成群的鴿子在城市上空盤旋，是一幅令人愉悅的景象。

english: The Castle Ward is the heart and mind of Waterdeep, if not its soul. It houses the city's military forces, courts, government, and the Market-the largest market square of any city in the North. It encompasses the City Navy's docks in the Great Harbor and all of Mount Waterdeep, and it is home to six walking statues, numerous temples, and many other landmarks.
zh_tw: 城堡區是深水城的心臟和思想中心，如果不是它的靈魂的話。它設有城市的軍事力量、法院、政府和市場——北方任何城市中最大的市場廣場。它包括城市海軍在大港口的碼頭和整個深水山，是六個行走雕像、眾多寺廟以及許多其他地標的所在地。

english: Castle Waterdeep stands above the city on a great bluff that extends out from the mountain, its towers soaring hundreds of feet into the sky. It surprises many to learn that this isn't where Waterdeep's rulers reside, nor from where the city is governed. The castle was and is a redoubt of last defense should the city be attacked, but for well over a century, the ruler of Waterdeep has occupied the Palace of Waterdeep-also known as Piergeiron's Palace, and still called that by elderly and long-lived citizens (including many elves).
zh_tw: 深水堡矗立於城市上方一處從山脈延伸出的巨大陡崖上，其塔樓高聳入雲達數百尺。許多人驚訝地發現這裡既非深水城統治者的居所，也非城市管理中樞。這座城堡過去與現在都是城市遇襲時的最後防線，而一個多世紀以來，深水城的統治者始終坐鎮於深水宮——也被稱為皮爾吉倫宮，長壽市民（包括許多精靈）至今仍沿用這個舊稱。

english: Though not quite as large as the castle, the palace is far more comfortable and lavishly decorated, with many halls used by government officials, guildmasters, and nobles for meetings and court proceedings. If you have reason to be invited (not compelled, I should hope!) to meet with the Masked Lords or the Open Lord of Waterdeep, it will likely take place in the audience chamber of the palace. There, you can witness the ancient and humble throne that Ahghairon first sat upon so long ago.
zh_tw: 儘管宮殿的規模不如城堡那麼大，但它要舒適得多，裝飾也更為奢華，許多大廳被政府官員、行會大師和貴族用於會議和法庭程式。如果你有理由被邀請（希望不是被迫！）與深水城的蒙面領主或公開領主會面，那麼很可能會在宮殿的接見廳進行。在那裡，你可以見證阿蓋爾倫很久以前首次坐下的古老而謙卑的寶座。

english: Many other buildings in the ward are given over to city business, including several courts for magisters and the barracks of the City Guard. So many of the ward's structures are offices and meeting halls for business owners, solicitors, publishers, and the like that the Castle Ward has the smallest resident population of all the wards.
zh_tw: 該區域內的許多其他建築都用於城市業務，包括幾個地方法官的法院和城防軍隊的兵營。該區的許多建築是企業主、律師、出版商等的辦公室和會議廳，以至於城堡區的居民人口是所有區中最少的。

english: Many landmarks of interest are found in this ward aside from the six walking statues (discussed later in this chapbook). You could hardly see them all in a day, but the following are highly recommended.
zh_tw: 除了這本小冊子後面會討論的六個行走雕像之外，這個區還有許多有趣的地標。你幾乎不可能在一天之內看完它們所有，但以下是強烈推薦的。

english: Blackstaff Tower is a squat black blot in the otherwise pretty ward. Humble though the edifice might be, looking at the place for too long can give you a queasy feeling and the sense that you are being watched-almost as if the tower itself has turned an unseen and wrathful eye upon you. Perhaps you think this fanciful. Well, go and try it yourself!
zh_tw: 黑杖塔是這個原本美麗的區域內一個矮胖的黑色汙點。儘管這座建築可能看起來不起眼，但注視它太久會讓你感到不適，並有一種被監視的感覺——就好像塔本身已經轉過一個看不見的、憤怒的目光注視著你。也許你認為這是異想天開。好吧，你自己去試試看！

english: On the opposite end of the mountain, close to the Naval Harbor, stands {@creature Mirt|WDH}'s Mansion. Once a fortress-like and glowering tower, it has been upgraded with more delicate fashions of architecture since the return of its long-absent owner.
zh_tw: 在山的另一端，靠近海軍港，矗立著{@creature Mirt|WDH|米爾特}的豪宅。它曾經是一座類似堡壘且陰沉的塔樓，自從它長期缺席的主人回來後，已經升級為更精緻的建築風格。

english: {@creature Mirt|WDH} has quite a history with {@creature Durnan|WDH}, the proprietor of the Yawning Portal. Together they descended into "the Well, "as the entrance to Undermountain was known in olden days. Waterdeep used to throw criminals in the Well, leaving them to die horribly in Undermountain's dungeons. {@creature Durnan|WDH} and {@creature Mirt|WDH} entered the dungeons of their own free will-and not only that, but returned laden with treasures. Both used magic to extend their lives, but they eventually parted ways. {@creature Mirt|WDH} kept on with a life of adventure, while {@creature Durnan|WDH} built the tavern called the Yawning Portal over the Well and now, almost two centuries later, charges coin to descend into it. Not a bad way to part fools from their money!
zh_tw: {@creature Mirt|WDH|米爾特} 與 {@creature Durnan|WDH|杜爾南}，即呵欠之門（呵欠之門）的老闆，有著相當悠久的歷史。他們一起下到了'井'中，'井'是古代對下山之路（地脈迷城）入口的稱呼。深水城（深水城）過去常常把罪犯扔進井裡，讓他們在下山之路的地牢中悲慘地死去。{@creature Durnan|WDH|杜爾南} 和 {@creature Mirt|WDH|米爾特} 自願進入了地牢——不僅如此，他們還帶著寶藏返回了。兩人都使用魔法延長了生命，但最終分道揚鑣。{@creature Mirt|WDH|米爾特} 繼續過著冒險的生活，而 {@creature Durnan|WDH|杜爾南} 在井上建造了名為呵欠之門的酒館，現在，幾乎兩個世紀後，他收取金幣讓人下到井裡。這不是一個從傻瓜那裡拿走錢財的好方法！

english: The glorious Spires of the Morning, dedicated to Lathander, is one of Waterdeep's most beautiful temples. But it is rivaled in this ward by the Temple of the Seldarine, dedicated to all the elf gods. The journey through Mount Melody Walk, a tunnel cut through Mount Waterdeep, to New Olamn's academy of music and other arts is a wondrous daytime excursion. The Market offers a wild array of sights, smells, and sounds in which folk might lose themselves for a tenday. The Font of Knowledge is a temple to Oghma, yes, but also the city's largest public library. Titles written throughout the ages can be viewed here-under the watchful eyes of the temple's priests. In short (if I can claim this section of the enchiridion to be such), the Castle Ward offers far too many splendors to list them all here.
zh_tw: 光輝的晨曦尖塔，獻給洛山達，是深水城最美麗的神殿之一。但它在這片區域中與席爾德琳神系神廟相媲美，席爾德琳神系神廟是獻給所有精靈神的。透過梅洛迪山路，這是一條穿過深水城山的隧道，前往新奧蘭的音樂和其他藝術學院，是一次奇妙的日間遠足。市場提供了一個狂野的景象、氣味和聲音的組合，人們可能會在這裡迷失十天。知識之泉是歐格瑪的神廟，是的，但也是這座城市最大的公共圖書館。這裡可以瀏覽到歷代的著作——在神廟祭司的警惕目光下。簡而言之（如果我可以聲稱這部分手冊是這樣的話），城堡區提供了太多輝煌，無法在這裡一一列舉。

english: The Castle Ward's colors are blue and purple, and its mascot is a griffon, typically depicted in gold. These borrow colors from the city's flag and reference the Griffon Cavalry, of course. Champions for the ward often come from among the ranks of the Guard, the Navy, or the Cavalry. Although such competitors have often had the advantage in races and competitions, their crowds of rabidly cheering fans are naturally much smaller than those of other wards.
zh_tw: 城堡區的顏色是藍色和紫色，其吉祥物是金色描繪的獅鷲。這些顏色借鑑了城市旗幟的顏色，並且當然指的是獅鷲騎兵。該區的冠軍通常來自警衛隊、海軍或騎兵的行列。儘管這樣的競爭者在比賽和競賽中經常擁有優勢，但他們狂熱歡呼的粉絲群體自然比其他區要小得多。

english: The stately, clean, and well-defended Castle Ward
zh_tw: 莊嚴、乾淨且防守堅固的城堡區

english: Trades Ward
zh_tw: 商業區

english: Shopping, shopping, shopping galore! Or eating, eating, eating! Or drinking, drinking, drinking! Or lavish accommodations, or fine art, or legendary parties! The Market in the Castle Ward is the largest market square in the city, but the Trades Ward is like a market town in itself-and is easily thrice the Market's size.
zh_tw: 購物，購物，購物多多！或者吃飯，吃飯，吃飯！或者喝酒，喝酒，喝酒！或者豪華住宿，或者精美藝術，或者傳奇派對！城堡區的市場是城市中最大的市場廣場，但商業區本身就像一個市場城鎮——而且面積至少是市場的三倍。

english: This ward bustles day and night with activity, both on the street and on balcony walkways that run the length of blocks and are sometimes layered five stories high. Shop signs appear to leap out from buildings, whose sides are plastered with advertisements all vying for the attention of the eye. Glove shops, shoe shops, jewelry stores, perfumeries, flower shops, cake shops, taverns, cafés, tea shops, inns, row houses, boarding schools, offices, dance academies, grocers, pottery stores, armor vendors-as long as it's not illegal, you can find it in the Trades Ward. But if you are looking for something illegal, the Trades Ward is likely the place to get that too. Do not do so too loudly, though. The City Watch has a heavy presence in this ward, in the form of both open patrols and officers working out of uniform.
zh_tw: 這個區域無論白天還是夜晚都熙熙攘攘，活動頻繁，不僅在街上，還在貫穿整個街區的陽臺步道上，這些步道有時高達五層。商店招牌似乎從建築物中跳出來，建築物的側面貼滿了爭奪眼球注意力的廣告。手套店、鞋店、珠寶店、香水店、花店、蛋糕店、酒館、咖啡館、茶館、旅館、聯排別墅、寄宿學校、辦公室、舞蹈學院、雜貨店、陶器店、盔甲商——只要不違法，你在商業區都能找到。但如果你在尋找違法的東西，商業區很可能也是得到那些的地方。不過，不要過於張揚。城市守衛在這個區域有強大的存在，包括公開巡邏和便衣工作的官員。

english: As befits a place of so much business, many guilds have their halls in this ward. Of particular note is the House of Light, the hall of the Guild of Chandlers and Lamplighters. Outside the building, a wagon-sized mound of wax with hundreds of wicks is kept lit day and night, while being continually built up with adhered candles. Inside, the best works of the guild are put on display and sold, including not just candles of various colors, {@item lamp|PHB|lamps}, and chandeliers, but elaborate waxwork constructions that depict all sorts of subjects from personages of note, to dragons, to complex and abstract lattices-all represented as fantastical candles.
zh_tw: 作為一個商業如此繁榮的地方，許多行會在這裡設有他們的大廳。特別值得一提的是光明之屋，即蠟燭商和路燈工人行會的大廳。在這座建築外面，有一個貨車大小的蠟堆，上面有數百個燈芯，日夜點燃，同時不斷增加粘附的蠟燭。裡面，行會的最佳作品展出並出售，包括不僅僅是各種顏色的蠟燭、{@item lamp|PHB|油燈}和吊燈，還有精緻的蠟制構造，它們描繪了各種主題，從著名人物到龍，再到複雜和抽象的格子圖案——全部以奇幻蠟燭的形式呈現。

english: Magic users should be wary in the Court of the White Bull. Long ago, this plaza was a grazing area for livestock, including an albino calf that was born here. The calf's owner built the White Bull Tavern, which thrived on the spot for years and gave the area its name. You'll not find the tavern now, though. It vanished, utterly destroyed during an infamous spell battle between the archmage Thongalar the Mighty and the evil mage Shile Rauretilar and his apprentices. In the storm of magic that touched down here, Shile and his apprentices all perished and the fabric of the Weave was rent, such that Azuth, god of wizards, was forced to appear and set things right. He is said to have stitched reality and the Weave back together, but a wrinkle in the fabric remains. To this day, magic brought to bear in the Court of the White Bull sometimes goes awry, and the use of magic items and spells is forbidden in the area.
zh_tw: 在白牛廣場，魔法使用者應該小心謹慎。很久以前，這個廣場是一個放牧區，包括一隻在這裡出生的白化小牛。小牛的主人建造了白牛旅館，旅館在這個地方繁榮了多年，並給了這個地區它的名字。不過，現在你找不到旅館了。它消失了，在強大的法師松加拉爾和邪惡法師希萊·勞雷提拉爾及其學徒之間的一場臭名昭著的法術戰鬥中被徹底摧毀。在這裡降臨的魔法風暴中，希萊和他的學徒都喪生了，魔網的結構被撕裂，以至於法師之神阿祖斯不得不出現並糾正事情。據說他將現實和魔網重新縫合，但布料上留下了一個褶皺。直到今天，在白牛廣場使用的魔法有時會出錯，該區域禁止使用魔法物品和咒語。

english: The Trades Ward uses green and purple as its colors, and its mascot is the mimic. This tradition supposedly arose because when mascots were first chosen, the Trades Ward took a chest of gold as its own-and was roundly mocked by citizens of other wards for not picking a creature. Now, every four years, the ward reveals a new object for its mascot, declaring it to be the mimic. The nature of the object is subject to much speculation and rumor until its unveiling. For months afterward, the object becomes the source of practical jokes in Waterdeep. Rock gnomes and wizards cause illusory mouths to lunge from real versions of the object, artisans craft beautiful fakes out of cake or paper that are easily crushed when assumed to be real, and so on. As of the writing of this enchiridion, the current mimic is a tankard.
zh_tw: 商業區使用綠色和紫色作為其顏色，其吉祥物是擬身怪。這個傳統據說起源於當吉祥物首次被選擇時，商業區選擇了一個裝滿金幣的箱子作為自己的代表——並因此被其他區的市民嘲笑，因為他們沒有選擇一個生物。現在，每四年，該區會揭示一個新的物品作為其吉祥物，宣稱它是擬身怪。這個物品的本質在揭曉之前會引發許多猜測和謠言。之後的幾個月裡，這個物品成為深水城惡作劇的來源。侏儒侏儒和法師會讓真實的物品版本上出現幻覺的嘴巴猛撲出來，工匠們會用蛋糕或紙張製作出美麗的贗品，這些贗品在被誤認為是真品時很容易被壓碎，等等。截至這本手冊編寫時，當前的擬身怪是一隻酒杯。

english: Southern Ward
zh_tw: 南區

english: It is called the Southern Ward, not the South Ward. Waterdavians are peculiar about this, and if you insist on referring to it as the South Ward, expect to be corrected or thought a fool. The name derives not merely from its southerly location in the city, but from the southerners who settled in this district as the city grew. Today, the ward still hosts most of the traveling merchants who visit the city, and is made up of many enclaves, blocks, and streets primarily occupied by citizens who trace their ancestry to other realms.
zh_tw: 它被稱為南區，而不是南區。沃特達維安人對此很特別，如果你堅持將其稱為南區，那麼期待被糾正或被認為是個傻瓜。這個名字不僅源於它在城市中的南部位置，還源於隨著城市發展而在此區域定居的南方人。今天，這個區仍然招待著大多數訪問城市的旅行商人，並且由許多飛地、街區和街道組成，這些地方主要由追溯其祖先來自其他領域的公民佔據。

english: One can indulge in the finest halfling food here, enjoy the best singers of Calishite music, and examine the most stunning works of dwarven crafting-but the first challenge is finding where these treats are housed. The Southern Ward has long been a district of laborers catering to travelers, so its folk have adopted the architectural custom of building homes and businesses above stables or around inn yards, near to where wagon trains are housed.
zh_tw: 在這裡，你可以盡情享受最美味的半身人食物，欣賞卡利希特音樂的最佳歌手，以及檢視最令人驚歎的矮人工藝作品——但第一個挑戰是找到這些美食和藝術作品的所在。南區長期以來一直是為旅行者服務的勞動者區域，因此，這裡的人們採用了在馬廄上方或圍繞客棧院落建造房屋和商業設施的建築習慣，靠近馬車隊的停放地點。

english: Residents of the Southern Ward take pride in their legacy as overland travelers and hardworking folk, so it should be no surprise that the ward's mascot is the mule. On their competition flags, a pugnacious mule in rampant pose stands on a field of red and white-colors said to represent the blood and tears the people of the Southern Ward have shed during their labors.
zh_tw: 南區的居民以他們作為陸路旅行者和勤勞人民的傳統為榮，因此，該區的吉祥物是騾子也就不足為奇了。在他們的比賽旗幟上，一隻好鬥的騾子以狂暴的姿態站在紅白相間的背景上——據說這些顏色代表了南區人民在勞動中流下的血和淚。

english: Not a landmark as such, but surely a sight that must be seen, is the Moon Sphere. This isn't a structure but an event that occurs during every full moon, when a glowing, spherical field of blue light appears in the square known as the Dancing Court. Any creatures that enter the sphere find that they can fly about inside it just by willing themselves to do so. For centuries, Waterdavians have used these supernatural events to develop a unique flying style of dance-but amateur enthusiasts aren't welcome, except on certain daylight appearances of the full moon.
zh_tw: 月亮球並不是一個地標，但它肯定是一個必看的景象。這不是一個建築物，而是一個發生在每個月圓之夜的事件，當一個發光的藍色光球出現在被稱為舞蹈廣場的廣場上時。任何進入球體的生物都會發現，他們只需有意願就能在其中飛翔。幾個世紀以來，深水城居民利用這些超自然事件發展出了一種獨特的飛行舞蹈風格——但業餘愛好者並不受歡迎，除非在滿月的某些白天出現。

english: Even when the full moon isn't out, the Dancing Court is worth visiting because of the adjacent festhall, the Jade Dancer. During appearances of the Moon Sphere, people sometimes daringly leap into the field of magic from the balconies of this three-story tavern, dance hall, and inn. But the festhall takes its name from a peculiar dancer within it rather than those in the court outside. The "Jade Dancer" is an eight-foot-tall jade statue of a woman that magically animates and dances for patrons-and on occasion serves as a bouncer. Elminster has informed me that despite its dexterity and seemingly fragile beauty, the Jade Dancer is as puissant as a stone golem. So enjoy the show, but don't get too rowdy.
zh_tw: 即使滿月沒有出現，跳舞廣場也值得一遊，因為旁邊有一家節日大廳——玉舞者。在月亮球體出現期間，人們有時會大膽地從這家三層的酒館、舞廳和旅館的陽臺跳入魔法領域跳舞。但節日大廳的名字來自於它內部的一個特殊舞者，而不是外面廣場上的舞者。'玉舞者'是一個八尺高的玉製女性雕像，它神奇地活化併為顧客跳舞——偶爾還充當保鏢。伊爾明斯特告訴我，儘管它動作靈活，看起來脆弱美麗，但玉舞者的力量就像石頭魔像一樣強大。所以享受表演，但不要太喧鬧。

english: Dock Ward
zh_tw: 碼頭區

english: The Dock Ward was long considered the most dangerous district in the city, but the Field Ward has since taken that title. I don't doubt the residents of the Dock Ward are glad of it, for in some respects this area has never truly deserved its bad reputation.
zh_tw: 碼頭區長期以來被認為是城市中最危險的區域，但原野區後來接過了這個頭銜。我毫不懷疑碼頭區的居民對此感到高興，因為在某些方面，這個區域從未真正配得上它的壞名聲。

english: Yes, aside from the Field Ward, this is the area where most of Waterdeep's poor reside. Yes, it is home to some of the least literate people in the city. Yes, most of its taverns are inhabited by habitual drinkers, and far too many inns charge by the hour. But all must concede this: the residents of the Dock Ward often work the hardest while living under the harshest conditions.
zh_tw: 是的，除了原野區之外，這裡是深水城大部分貧困人口居住的地區。是的，這裡是城市中最不識字的人的家園。是的，它的大多數酒館裡都有習慣性飲酒者，而且太多的旅館按小時收費。但所有人都必須承認這一點：碼頭區的居民通常在最艱苦的條件下工作最為努力。

english: Warehouses, poorhouses, and tenements dominate much of the area. Streets are steep throughout, and few have space alongside for pedestrians. Wandering through the ward can be a bewildering journey without a guide. Except in the immediate vicinity of the piers, shop signs and advertising of any kind are rare, and warehouses and other businesses often have no sign at all. You either know where you are going and have reason to be there-or you are lost, and a likely mark for pickpockets or worse.
zh_tw: 倉庫、貧民窟和出租公寓佔據了這個區域的大部分。街道到處都很陡峭，而且很少有空間供行人通行。沒有嚮導的話，在該區漫遊可能是一次令人困惑的旅程。除了碼頭附近的地區外，商店招牌和任何形式的廣告都很少見，倉庫和其他商業場所通常根本沒有標誌。你要麼知道自己要去哪裡並且有理由去那裡——要麼你就迷路了，很可能成為扒手或更糟的目標。

english: Streetlamps don't fare well in the Dock Ward. Their candles, oils, and glass are too regularly stolen or smashed. The Guild of Chandlers and Lamplighters makes a halfhearted attempt to repair the streetlamps at the start of each season, but for most of the year, locals are forced to carry their own light when traveling these streets at night.
zh_tw: 在碼頭區，路燈的狀況並不好。它們的蠟燭、油和玻璃太容易被偷或被砸碎。蠟燭商和路燈工人行會在每個季節開始時會半心半意地嘗試修復路燈，但在一年的大部分時間裡，當地人在夜間行走在這些街道時被迫攜帶自己的光源。

english: The colors of the Dock Ward are burgundy and orange, and its mascot is a swordfish that has always been depicted as green for reasons lost to time. The folk of the Dock Ward take competition seriously, and they frequently draft their champions from the rough-and-tumble sailors who come to the city. (Some say they draft pirates, but that is pure slander.) Frequent complaints arise that these women and men are more citizens of the sea than of the Dock Ward itself. But if they register with a magister and pay taxes, they are as welcome to compete as any long-term resident of Waterdeep.
zh_tw: 碼頭區的顏色是酒紅色和橙色，它的吉祥物是一種劍魚，出於某種已經遺失的原因，它總是被描繪成綠色。碼頭區的人們非常重視競爭，他們經常從來到城市的粗獷水手中選拔他們的冠軍。（有人說他們選拔的是海盜，但那完全是誹謗。）經常有人抱怨，這些男人和女人更像是海洋的公民，而不是碼頭區本身的居民。但如果他們向地方官註冊並納稅，他們就和深水城的任何長期居民一樣受歡迎參加比賽。

english: City of the Dead
zh_tw: 亡者之城

english: I could write a book about the City of the Dead. It is such a fascinating place, filled with so much history and so many stories. But alas, there would be few buyers for Volo's Guide to the City of the Dead, since it would be of interest mainly to Waterdavians-and the topic is one about which they are already intimately knowledgeable.
zh_tw: 我可以為亡者之城寫一本書。這是一個如此迷人的地方，充滿瞭如此多的歷史和故事。但可惜，對於《瓦羅的亡者之城指南》來說，買家會很少，因為它主要對沃特達維安人感興趣——而這個話題是他們已經非常熟悉的。

english: The City of the Dead is no drab cemetery. It is a great park of grassy hills, tended flower beds, artfully placed clusters of trees and bushes, beautiful sculptures, astounding architecture, and gravel paths that wend intriguingly through it all. Long ago, Waterdavians largely abandoned the practice of burying their dead, instead entombing them in mausoleums. For centuries, the major mausoleums here have each been connected to an extradimensional space where the dead are taken, mourned, and interred.
zh_tw: 亡者之城並非一個單調乏味的墓地。它是一個宏偉的公園，有著草地覆蓋的山丘、精心打理的花壇、巧妙佈置的樹木和灌木叢、美麗的雕塑、令人驚歎的建築以及蜿蜒曲折的礫石小徑。很久以前，沃特達維安人基本上放棄了埋葬死者的做法，而是將他們安葬在陵墓中。幾個世紀以來，這裡的主要陵墓都與一個額外維度的空間相連，死者被帶到那裡，接受哀悼和安葬。

english: Those who can afford it memorialize the departed with sculptures, making the City of the Dead an open-air museum that features some of the most stunning, haunting, mournful, and downright eerie statues ever crafted in marble or bronze. Nobles and wealthy merchants have competed to erect the grandest markers for their dead, leading to a wide variety of styles and concepts created by artists at the height of their skills.
zh_tw: 那些負擔得起的人會用雕塑來紀念逝者，使得亡者之城成為一個露天博物館，展出了一些最令人驚歎、令人難忘、悲傷以及徹頭徹尾詭異的大理石或青銅雕像。貴族和富有的商人競相為他們已故的親人樹立最宏偉的紀念物，導致由技藝高超的藝術家創造出了各種風格和概念。

english: One of the cemetery's most impressive attractions is the Warriors' Monument. This intricate, sixty-foot-high sculpture depicts a circle of women and men striking down trolls, orcs, hobgoblins, bugbears, and barbarians, all of which are falling backward and outward around the warriors. Above all of them, a flying griffon rider spears a skeletal knight whose breastplate bears the symbol of Myrkul, god of the dead. But this statue is also a fountain, and the wounds on these combatants gush water! Don't try to imagine it—just go see it. And see it as Waterdavians do: pack a midday feast, have a picnic, and then take a stroll through the beauty of the place.
zh_tw: 墓地最令人印象深刻的景點之一是戰士紀念碑。這座錯綜複雜、高達六十尺的雕塑描繪了一個由男女組成的圓圈，他們正在擊倒巨魔、獸人、大地精、熊地精和野蠻人，這些敵人都在戰士周圍向後向外倒下。在他們所有人之上，一位飛翔的獅鷲騎士用矛刺穿了一個骷髏騎士，其胸甲上刻有死者之神米爾庫爾的象徵。但這座雕像同時也是一個噴泉，這些戰鬥者身上的傷口噴湧著水！不要試圖想象它——親自去看看吧。像沃特達維安人那樣去觀賞：準備一箇中午的盛宴，舉行一次野餐，然後漫步於這個地方的美麗之中。

english: City of the Dead
zh_tw: 亡者之城

english: Outside the City Proper
zh_tw: 城外

english: There's more to the city of Waterdeep than just the wards within its walls. If you have need to visit the environs of the city, here's what you'll need to know.
zh_tw: 深水城這座城市不僅僅只有城牆內的各個區域。如果你需要訪問城市的周邊地區，以下是你需要了解的資訊。

english: Field Ward
zh_tw: 原野區

english: This district was once a caravan yard between Waterdeep's two northernmost walls, kept free of settlement to serve as a killing field in times of war. As refugees from various calamities settled there after not being allowed into the city's wealthy northern neighborhoods, the area has grown up into a lawless town of its own.
zh_tw: 這個區域曾經是深水城最北端兩堵牆之間的商隊庭院，在戰爭時期作為殺戮場地而未被開發。由於各種災難的難民在不被允許進入城市富裕的北部社群後定居在那裡，該地區已經發展成為自己的無法無天的城鎮。

english: Though not an official ward of the city, the Field Ward is commonly referred to as one. The Watch doesn't patrol this area, however, and many crimes go uninvestigated. The City Guard oversees the Field Ward from the walls around it, but its members get involved only when folk moving into or out of the city are threatened.
zh_tw: 儘管原野區並非城市的官方區域，但它通常被稱為一個區域。然而，守衛並不巡邏這個區域，許多犯罪行為未被調查。城衛隊從周圍的城牆上監督原野區，但其成員只有在進入或離開城市的人民受到威脅時才會介入。

english: The area is a muddy mess, populated by the poorest people and those who take advantage of those folks' desperation. It has no sewer system and isn't served by the Dungsweepers' Guild-a fact that will be quite evident to your nose if you venture here. I don't recommend that you spend any more time here than it takes to pass through from one gate to the next.
zh_tw: 這個區域是一個泥濘的混亂之地，居住著最貧窮的人和那些利用這些人絕望的人。這裡沒有下水道系統，也不由清潔工行會提供服務——如果你敢冒險來到這裡，你的鼻子會非常清楚地告訴你這一點。我建議你不要在這裡花費超過從一個城門到另一個城門所需的時間。

english: The Guild of Butchers operates several slaughterhouses, smokehouses, and leather-making facilities in the area-noisome operations that have been pushed out of the city proper. A word to the wise: being friendly with a burly fellow who is good with a knife is one of your best defenses in the Field Ward. The other place you might solicit aid is Endshift Tavern, a popular stop for off-duty members of the City Guard, situated on the corner of Endshift Street and the Breezeway. Though the guards might not be inclined to assist you, your status as a visitor to Waterdeep technically obliges them to help you reach the city proper in safety.
zh_tw: 屠夫行會在該區域經營著幾家屠宰場、燻肉房和皮革製造設施——這些令人不快的操作已經被趕出了城市中心。給聰明人的忠告：與一個擅長使用刀子的健壯傢伙友好相處，是您在原野區最好的防禦之一。另一個可能尋求幫助的地方是收工酒館，這是城防軍下班成員的熱門聚集地，位於收工街和微風路的拐角處。儘管守衛可能不太願意提供幫助，但作為訪問深水城的遊客，從技術上講，他們有義務幫助您安全到達城市中心。

english: The Wonders of the Waymoot
zh_tw: 路會廣場的奇蹟

english: The place where the High Road and the Way of the Dragon meet in the south of the city is called the Waymoot. At the center of the crossroads, a high signpost stands with hanging arrows pointing toward the harbor and each of the city gates. Created by the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors and funded by local merchants, the signpost magically directs travelers to well-known distant locations when the names of those locations are spoken into a crystal on the post. The magic of the Waymoot writes the destination onto the proper arrow of the signpost and indicates its distance from Waterdeep in miles. Folk are thereby sent out of the harbor or the appropriate gate leading north, east, or south, depending on their destination.
zh_tw: 城市南部，高路和龍道交匯的地方被稱為路會廣場。十字路口的中心，一個高高的路標上掛著箭頭，指向港口和每個城門。這個路標是由警戒法師與護衛教團建立，並由當地商人資助的，當人們在路標上的水晶中說出那些地點的名字時，它神奇地指引旅行者前往眾所周知的遙遠地點。路會廣場的魔法將目的地寫在路標的正確箭頭上，並標明它與深水城的距離（以英里計）。因此，人們會根據他們的目的地被送出港口或透過通往北、東或南的適當城門。

english: Unfortunately for newcomers, the Waymoot is of no use whatsoever in finding locations within Waterdeep. You will, however, find a number of enterprising individuals near the crossroads who take advantage of this fact to offer their services as city guides. Though some reputable members of this cadre will guide you true for a fair fee, plenty of citizens with nothing to lose or gain by doing so will also readily set you on the right course if you're simply polite.
zh_tw: 對於新來的人來說，不幸的是，路會廣場對於在深水城內尋找地點沒有任何幫助。然而，你會發現一些有進取心的個人在十字路口附近利用這一事實提供他們的城市導遊服務。儘管這個團隊中一些有聲譽的成員會以合理的費用真正引導你，但也有很多市民，他們沒有什麼可失去或獲得的，也會很樂意在你禮貌的情況下讓你走上正確的道路。

english: Undercliff
zh_tw: 崖下區

english: This area of rolling grassland and small wooded areas east of the city is a rural community focused on farming and animal husbandry, and which caters to travelers. It is also the site of a large and well-protected training camp for the City Guard, and a prison farm run by the City Watch (called Amendsfarm) where those convicted of minor offenses work off their debt to the city. Many gnomes and halflings live in this region, and most buildings are built to reflect their stature.
zh_tw: 這個城市東側的這片起伏的草原和小型林地是一個以農業和畜牧業為主的鄉村社群，併為旅行者提供服務。它還是城防軍的一個大型且保護良好的訓練營地，以及由城市守衛經營的監獄農場（稱為贖罪農場），那些犯有輕微罪行的人在這裡為城市工作以償還他們的債務。許多侏儒和半身人居住在這個地區，大多數建築物都是根據他們的體型建造的。

english: Two noble families have estates in Undercliff. The Amcathra estate is used for the housing and final training of horses bred in the town of Amphail, many of which are sold to the City Guard. The Hothemer noble house has an estate where its members conduct business in overland trade-beyond the reach of Waterdeep's auditors.
zh_tw: 兩個貴族家族在崖下區擁有莊園。安卡斯拉家族的莊園用於安置和最終訓練在安菲爾鎮飼養的馬匹，其中許多馬匹被出售給城防軍。霍瑟默貴族家族擁有一個莊園，其成員在那裡進行陸路貿易業務——遠離深水城審計員的觸及。

english: If you visit this area, I recommend the Snobeedle Orchard and Meadery, owned and run by the Snobeedle halflings. They have a delightful drinking hall and a shop sized for larger patrons, and you can pick your own fruit when it is in season.
zh_tw: 如果您訪問這個區域，我推薦斯諾比多果園和釀酒廠，由斯諾比多半身人擁有並經營。他們有一個令人愉快的飲酒大廳和一個為更大的顧客設計的商店，您可以在旺季時自己採摘水果。

english: Undermountain
zh_tw: 地脈迷城

english: Tales of this legendary dungeon below Waterdeep are told well by many in the city, but I'll provide you with the basic truths here.
zh_tw: 關於深水城下方這個傳奇地牢的故事，城裡許多人都講得很好，但我會在這裡為你提供一些基本的事實。

english: Beneath the plateau of Waterdeep lies the largest and deepest dungeon in the world. It sprawls out under the city, said to plunge as many as twenty levels deep. The Melairkyn dwarves first excavated the tunnels that would become Undermountain, and the drow are said to have dug their own tunnels up from below. All were claimed, altered, and expanded by the mad wizard Halaster and his apprentices-who are believed to dwell in the dungeons to this day. What drove them deep into the earth remains a mystery, but Undermountain's allure is a siren song that still draws many. If you want to see adventurers descend into the depths, or perhaps glimpse some returning with wondrous treasures, visit the Yawning Portal in the Castle Ward.
zh_tw: 在深水城高原之下，坐落著世界上最大的、最深的地牢。它在城市下方蔓延，據說深入地下多達二十層。梅拉金矮人最初挖掘了這些將成為地脈迷城的隧道，而卓爾據說從下方挖掘了自己的隧道。所有這些都被瘋狂的法師海拉斯特和他的學徒們聲稱、改變和擴建——他們被認為至今仍然居住在地牢中。是什麼驅使他們深入地下仍然是個謎，但地脈迷城的誘惑就像海妖的歌聲，仍然吸引著許多人。如果你想看到冒險家們深入地下，或者可能一睹一些帶著奇妙寶藏返回的人，可以訪問城堡區的呵欠之門。

english: The City's Splendors
zh_tw: 城市的輝煌

english: A description of each of the features that cause Waterdeep to be called the City of Splendors would require a library's worth of paper. This chapbook can't hope to encompass them all, no matter its author's expertise with a quill. However, I shall endeavor to enlighten you about several sights that have not been mentioned earlier, and to expand upon some previously covered.
zh_tw: 描述讓深水城被稱為壯麗之城的每一個特色，將需要圖書館那麼多的紙張。這本小冊子不可能包含它們全部，無論作者的羽毛筆技藝有多高超。然而，我將盡力向您介紹一些之前未提及的景點，並擴充套件一些之前已經覆蓋的內容。

english: Amenities
zh_tw: 便利設施

english: You'll find no city on the Sword Coast or in all the North half as civilized as Waterdeep. It's not just the law of the land that makes this so, but also the comforts that life here provides.
zh_tw: 你在劍海岸或整個北方找不到一個像深水城這樣文明的城市。這不僅僅是因為這片土地上的法律，還因為這裡的生活所提供的舒適。

english: In most other towns and cities, you'll start with an early-morning stumble on the stairs as you carry your night soil down to deposit it outside. But in Waterdeep, many buildings are connected directly to the sewers. Public facilities for those out and about can be found all around the Market and the Field of Triumph, and near the largest city squares. In places without ready access to sewers or public outhouses, members of the Dungsweepers' Guild make multiple rounds each day, collecting urine and excrement separately-for use in industry and agriculture, respectively. Take comfort that in Waterdeep, you'll always find a pot to piss in.
zh_tw: 在大多數其他城鎮，你會在清晨搖搖晃晃地走下樓梯，手裡提著夜間的糞便去外面倒掉。但在深水城，許多建築直接連線到下水道。在市場和凱旋廣場周圍以及最大的城市廣場附近，可以找到供外出人士使用的公共設施。在沒有現成下水道或公共廁所的地方，清潔工行會的成員每天會多次巡視，分別收集尿液和糞便——分別用於工業和農業。放心，在深水城，你總能找到地方解決個人問題。

english: Also notice how clean the streets are kept. This upkeep is due in large part to the hard work of the Dungsweepers' Guild. Dungsweepers can be seen working their brooms and carts at every hour of the day-and for a few hours after dark-all over the city, removing not just animal dung but other refuse. This service is free to all, paid for by taxes rendered to the city-although an egregious amount of trash left for pickup does result in a separate bill from the guild.
zh_tw: 還會注意到街道保持得多麼乾淨。這種維護在很大程度上歸功於清潔工行會的辛勤工作。在一天中的每個小時，甚至在天黑後的幾個小時裡，都能看到清潔工在全城各地揮舞著掃帚和推著手推車工作，清除的不僅僅是動物糞便，還有其他垃圾。這項服務對所有人免費，由城市徵收的稅款支付——儘管如果留下的垃圾量特別巨大，確實會導致行會另外開具賬單。

english: Another amenity soon appreciated by visitors is Waterdeep's water system. With public fountains and wells all about the city, clean water is plentiful. Many buildings have pumps of their own to draw water from the local supply, and some even possess taps that pour out water with the twist of a knob. This convenience is made possible by the inventiveness of the Gondar, the industry of the Cellarers' and Plumbers' Guild, and the magic that Waterdeep inherited from the Illefarni elves.
zh_tw: 訪客很快會欣賞到深水城的另一個便利設施是其水系統。城市中遍佈公共噴泉和水井，乾淨的水源非常充足。許多建築都有自己的水泵從當地供應中抽取水，有些甚至擁有隻需轉動旋鈕就能出水的水龍頭。這種便利性得益於貢達爾人的發明才能，地窖管理員和管道工行會的勤奮工作，以及深水城從伊勒法尼精靈那裡繼承的魔法。

english: Waterdeep is also a city of light. {@spell continual flame} spells illuminate many signs and streetlamps in the wealthier parts of the city. Elsewhere, the Guild of Chandlers and Lamplighters keeps the streets lit (excepting the Field Ward and the most dangerous areas of the Dock Ward). Not only that, but hundreds of {@item driftglobe||driftglobes} bob about the City of the Dead at night, departing to float over the rest of the city each morning. Such is not typical behavior for driftglobes, I assure you!
zh_tw: 深水城也是一個光明之城。在城市較富裕的地區，{@spell continual flame||不滅明焰}法術照亮了許多標誌和路燈。在其他地方，蠟燭和點燈工會保持街道的照明（不包括原野區和碼頭區最危險的區域）。不僅如此，每天晚上成百上千的{@item driftglobe||漂浮之球}在亡者之城上空飄動，每天早晨出發漂浮在城市的其他地方。我向你保證，這不是漂浮光球的典型行為！

english: Lastly, no city in the world is as literate as Waterdeep. Oghma's priests from the Font of Knowledge offer free instruction in reading to all who desire it, and the city has over thirty publishers of broadsheets in addition to chapbook printers and book publishers. Large paper advertisements are plastered onto alley walls, and smaller ones are passed out by those hired by businesses to trumpet their services. Printed menus can be found posted in the windows of most eateries and are handed out to those who dine within. Admittedly, you'll see less reading material in the Dock Ward and the Field Ward, but this fact is notable only because of its preponderance elsewhere.
zh_tw: 最後，世界上沒有哪個城市像深水城那樣文化普及。來自知識之泉的歐格瑪祭司提供免費的閱讀指導給所有有願望學習的人，城市中除了小冊子印刷商和書籍出版商之外，還有超過三十家印刷傳單的出版商。大型紙質廣告被貼在巷子的牆上，小型的則由商家僱傭的人分發，以宣傳他們的服務。大多數餐飲店的窗戶上都貼有印刷的選單，並且會提供給在店內用餐的人。誠然，在碼頭區和原野區你會看到較少的閱讀材料，但這一事實之所以值得注意，只是因為在其他地方閱讀材料的豐富。

english: The Griffon Cavalry
zh_tw: 獅鷲騎兵隊

english: Waterdeep doesn't have the fabled flying ships of Halruaa, but it does deploy an aerial defense force. Brave warriors of the City Guard light out from the Peaktop Aerie atop Mount Waterdeep, riding fearsome griffons that have been bred and trained for that purpose. Each of the riders is equipped with a ring of feather falling—not merely to prevent death from mishap, but to allow them to perform stunning feats of aerial acrobatics.
zh_tw: 深水城沒有傳說中的哈魯阿飛行船，但它確實部署了一支空中防禦力量。勇敢的城防軍戰士從深水城山頂的頂峰巢穴出發，騎著為這個目的而培育和訓練的可怕獅鷲。每位騎士都配備了一枚羽落戒指——不僅為了防止意外死亡，還允許他們表演令人驚歎的空中特技。

english: In both martial displays and in real battles against flying threats such as manticores, harpies, and outlaw wizards, the griffon riders actually leap off their mounts into the open air! For a breath-stealing moment, they fall like stones, closing in on their targets at incredible speed. Their opponents rarely see the death blow, distracted as they are by other mounted griffon riders. When they are past the danger, the free-falling riders then suddenly halt in the air, drifting like feathers until their griffon companions swoop in and they regain their saddles. Working in concert with one another in this fashion, members of the Griffon Cavalry can rapidly eliminate any threat to the city-and even catch the body of the offender before it hits the rooftops below.
zh_tw: 在武術表演以及對抗諸如蠍尾獅、鷹身女妖和非法法師等飛行威脅的真正戰鬥中，獅鷲騎士實際上會從他們的坐騎上跳入開闊的空中！在令人屏息的瞬間，他們像石頭一樣墜落，以驚人的速度接近目標。他們的對手很少看到致命一擊，因為他們被其他騎著獅鷲的騎士分散了注意力。當他們飛越危險時，自由落體的騎士們突然在空中停下，像羽毛一樣飄蕩，直到他們的獅鷲夥伴俯衝過來，他們重新坐上馬鞍。獅鷲騎兵的成員以這種方式協同工作，可以迅速消除對城市的任何威脅——甚至在罪犯的屍體擊中下面的屋頂之前抓住它。

english: Riders of the Griffon Cavalry are trained to stay above the rooftops, not because they fear crashing into towers and weather vanes, but because the smell of so much horseflesh in the streets below can sometimes drive their griffons into a frenzy.
zh_tw: 獅鷲騎兵隊的騎士們被訓練要待在屋頂上方飛行，並不是因為他們擔心撞上塔樓和風向標，而是因為下方街道上那麼多馬肉的氣味有時會使他們的獅鷲陷入狂暴狀態。

english: Griffon Cavalry Patrol
zh_tw: 獅鷲騎兵巡邏隊

english: The Walking Statues
zh_tw: 行走的雕像

english: Over a century ago, just one of these eight behemoth statues stood visible at the northern foot of Mount Waterdeep, on a bluff called Gull Leap. Ninety feet tall, it resembled a bald human staring out to sea. Later events (discussed below) caused it to be transformed into the statue known today as the Sahuagin Humbled.
zh_tw: 一個多世紀前，在深水城山北麓被稱為海鷗跳躍的峭壁上，只有這八個巨像中的一個明顯可見。它高90尺，看起來像一個禿頂的人凝視著大海。後來的事件（下面討論）導致它被改造成今天眾所周知的鯊華魚人謙卑雕像。

english: When the Spellplague gripped Waterdeep in 1385 DR, six more walking statues suddenly appeared in the city, wandering to wreak havoc even as the Sahuagin Humbled remained motionless. The authorities and citizens of Waterdeep succeeded in stopping three of these new statues, breaking the Swordmaiden and the Hawk Man, and sinking the God Catcher into the street up to its waist. Then all the statues mysteriously stopped their rampage just as quickly as they had begun it. Tsarra Chaadren, the Blackstaff at the time, couldn't command them to return to their former hiding places on the Ethereal Plane. Consequently, the city repaired itself and built up around them. Much later, in 1479 DR, the eighth statue-the Griffon-emerged from the Ethereal Plane to defend Ahghairon's Tower against intrusion. It roosted there for a time before flying to its current position near Peaktop Aerie on Mount Waterdeep. Once more, this activity seemed to be outside the Blackstaff's control. Thankfully, all the walking statues have been dormant for well over a decade now, serving only as beautiful, cyclopean reminders of Waterdeep's might.
zh_tw: 當法術疫病在1385 DR年侵襲深水城時，城市中突然出現了六個行走的雕像，它們四處遊蕩製造混亂，而鯊華魚人謙卑則保持靜止不動。深水城的當局和市民成功阻止了其中三個新雕像，打破了劍女和鷹人，並將捕神者沉入街道直到其腰部。然後，所有雕像神秘地停止了它們的暴行，就像它們開始時一樣迅速。當時的黑杖法師查拉·查德倫無法命令它們返回到以太界的原藏身之處。因此，城市自我修復並在它們周圍重建。更晚些，在1479 DR年，第八個雕像——獅鷲——從以太界出現，保衛阿蓋爾倫之塔免受侵入。它在那裡棲息了一段時間，然後飛到它目前在深水城山頂頂峰巢穴附近的當前位置。再一次，這一活動似乎超出了黑杖法師的控制。幸運的是，所有行走的雕像現在已經休眠了十多年，僅僅作為深水城力量的美麗、獨眼巨人般的提醒。

english: The God Catcher
zh_tw: 捕神者

english: This is perhaps the most famous walking statue in the city, thanks to its dramatic pose, its nearness to the Market, and the self-evident magic of its existence. The statue is of a well-muscled but impassive male human with its left leg sunk to the hip in the street, the result of a spell cast by the Blackstaff at the time of its rampage. Its left hand and right foot press against the ground as if it is trying to pull itself out. Its right arm is raised skyward, and above its open palm floats a sphere of stone. Its gaze looks up toward the sphere, and the pattern of bird droppings around its eyes gives it the appearance of weeping.
zh_tw: 這或許是城市中最有名的行走雕像，得益於它戲劇性的姿態、它靠近市場的位置，以及它存在本身的不言自明的魔法。這座雕像是一個肌肉發達但面無表情的男性人類，它的左腿陷在街道中直到臀部，這是在它暴走時由當時的黑杖法師施放的法術的結果。它的左手和右腳壓在地上，好像它正試圖將自己拉出來。它的右臂向天空舉起，在它張開的手掌上方浮動著一個石球。它的目光望向石球，眼睛周圍的鳥糞圖案讓它看起來像是在哭泣。

english: All about the statue, climbing up its chest and on its knee and shoulders, is a tenement that carries the name "the God Catcher." The tenement's landlord is Aundra Blackcloak, an unsociable sorcerer who is rarely seen in the city except when she alights from the door carved in the floating sphere, which serves as her home. On the rare occasions when she wants to meet with city folk (typically to purchase odd substances for magical purposes), she appears unannounced on balconies or rooftops after dark. Her dealings are polite, though, and she pays fair coin. She never confides in anyone or talks about her own doings-and if anyone but she has ever seen the inside of her spherical home, they've said nothing publicly about it.
zh_tw: 在雕像的四周，爬上它的胸部、膝蓋和肩膀，是一棟被命名為"捕神者"的公寓。公寓的房東是安德拉·布萊剋剋洛，一個很少在城市中露面的孤僻女巫，除非她從漂浮的球體中雕刻的門出來，這個球體是她的家。在她偶爾想要與城市居民見面時（通常是購買魔法用途的奇特物質），她會在天黑後不告而來出現在陽臺或屋頂上。她的行為很有禮貌，而且她支付公平的金幣。她從不向任何人吐露心聲或談論自己的行為——如果除了她之外還有人曾經見過她球形家的內部，他們也沒有公開談論過。

english: The God Catcher looming in the background
zh_tw: 背景中高聳的捕神者

english: The Griffon
zh_tw: 獅鷲

english: The walking statue called the Griffon is shaped like the beast for which it is named. Though it stands on all four legs, its back is fully twenty feet off the ground, making it a mount fit for a storm giant. Although it has shown itself to be capable of flight, with the granite feathers of its wings spreading like a bird's, the Griffon now merely stands in a regal pose near Peaktop Aerie atop Mount Waterdeep, looking to the southeast over the Dock Ward. Newcomers sometimes assume it to be a monument to Waterdeep's Griffon Cavalry, but Waterdavians know better.
zh_tw: 被稱為獅鷲的行走雕像形態與它被命名的生物相似。儘管它四肢站立，但它的背部離地面有整整二十尺，使它成為適合風暴巨人的坐騎。儘管它顯示出能夠飛行的能力，花崗巖製成的翅膀羽毛像鳥的翅膀一樣展開，但獅鷲現在只是站在深水城山頂頂峰巢穴附近的高貴姿態中，向東南方向俯瞰著碼頭區。新來者有時會認為它是深水城獅鷲騎兵隊的紀念碑，但深水城居民更瞭解真相。

english: The Sahuagin Humbled
zh_tw: 鯊華魚人謙卑

english: For years, the only visible walking statue of Waterdeep was known simply as "the walking statue." It stood at the foot of Mount Waterdeep near the head of Julthoon Street. Then, after its critical role in defending the city against an invasion of sahuagin in 1370 DR, Khelben Blackstaff reshaped the statue into a sahuagin. It now bows low toward the House of Heroes on bended knee-a gesture of obeisance to the city, and an acknowledgment of the sacrifice of all who fought for the city in that war.
zh_tw: 多年來，深水城唯一可見的行走雕像簡單地被稱為"行走雕像"。它位於深水城山腳下，靠近朱爾蘇恩街的起點。然後，在1370 DR年它在保衛城市免受鯊華魚人入侵中發揮了關鍵作用後，凱爾本·黑杖將雕像重塑成了一個鯊華魚人的形象。現在它向英雄之家低姿態鞠躬——這是對城市的一種敬意，也是對在那場戰爭中為城市而戰的所有人犧牲的認可。

english: The Great Drunkard
zh_tw: 醉漢

english: This walking statue stopped its rampage as it approached the Market, then fell backward and sat upon a building. When it settled, its arms fell limp at its sides and its head tilted forward onto its chest, giving the impression that it had fallen asleep. The statue's huge stone battleaxe still stands nearby, its haft angled upright and its blade half buried in the cobbles. The rubble of the crushed building was long ago rebuilt into a broad stone stair (with railings and a ramp that drunkards are often rolled down) that ascends from the cobbles to the statue's lap. That lap now holds a two-story tavern also built from the rubble, called Gralkyn's Tankard. The {@condition unconscious} pose of the statue and the tavern in its lap made the name of the Great Drunkard a natural fit.
zh_tw: 這座行走的雕像在接近市場時停止了它的暴走，然後向後倒下，坐在一棟建築物上。當它穩定下來時，它的手臂鬆散地垂在身體兩側，頭部向前傾斜到胸前，給人一種它已經睡著的印象。雕像的巨大的石制戰斧仍然立在附近，它的柄豎直向上，刀刃一半埋在鵝卵石中。被壓碎的建築物的瓦礫早已重建成了一段寬闊的石階（帶有欄杆和斜坡，常有人把醉漢從上面滾下來），從鵝卵石路面一直通向雕像的膝蓋。現在，雕像的膝蓋上建有一個兩層的酒館，也是用那些瓦礫建成的，叫做格拉爾金的酒杯。雕像的{@condition unconscious||昏迷}姿勢和它膝蓋上的酒館使得"醉漢"這個名字自然而然地貼切。

english: The Lady Dreaming
zh_tw: 夢想女神

english: This fair lady caused much chaos when she was active. The statue has the appearance of a female elf, whose hair and clothing appeared to flow naturally as it walked through the city during the Spellplague. When the walking statues stopped, this one toppled onto its side, taking on the appearance of a titanic sculpture of a noble lady asleep in her garden.
zh_tw: 這位美麗的女士在她活躍的時候引起了許多混亂。這座雕像看起來像是一位女性精靈，她的頭髮和衣服在魔法瘟疫期間穿城而過時似乎自然地流動。當行走的雕像停下來時，這一座傾斜倒下，呈現出一位高貴女士在她花園中沉睡的巨大雕塑的外觀。

english: The Honorable Knight
zh_tw: 榮譽騎士

english: The Honorable Knight is a statue of a male warrior in plate armor with a shield and {@item longsword|PHB}. When the walking statues stopped, it bowed to those opposing it, straightened, sheathed its sword, and doffed its shield, setting it point down on the ground and upright by its side. It then ceased motion in this position, facing southwest toward the harbor, and looking for all the world like a castle guard standing at ease. The pose it assumed led to its naming, and it is viewed with respect by the citizens of the southerly wards.
zh_tw: 光榮騎士是一座身穿板甲、手持盾牌和{@item longsword|PHB|長劍}的男性戰士雕像。當這些行走的雕像停下時，它會向對手鞠躬，然後挺直身軀，收起長劍並卸下盾牌，將其尖端朝下豎立在身旁。隨後它保持這個姿勢靜止不動，面朝西南方向的港口，彷彿一位城堡守衛在輕鬆站崗。它的這一姿態使它得名"光榮騎士"，並受到南部城區市民的尊敬。

english: The Hawk Man
zh_tw: 鷹人

english: This statue looks like a winged, hawk-headed being, and thus locals call it the Hawk Man. I can reveal that in fact it bears much resemblance to an aarakocra, one of the bird-people said to live in the Star Mounts in the High Forest. The statue's wings are folded tightly against its back and have never unfurled, leaving its flight capability uncertain. It was brought low during its rampage across the city, and now it tilts decidedly toward the northeast due to a missing right foot-long ago broken up for building rubble, along with its right arm. Its left arm is extended out toward the north, palm forward as if in a gesture to say, "Stop."
zh_tw: 這座雕像看起來像是一個有翅膀、鷹頭的生物，因此當地人稱其為鳥羽人。我可以透露，實際上它與鳥羽人非常相似，鳥羽人是據說居住在高森林星山脈中的鳥人之一。雕像的翅膀緊貼在它的背部，從未展開，留下了它的飛行能力不確定。在它穿越城市的暴走中被制服，現在由於失去了右腳——很久以前被砸碎用於建築材料，以及右臂，它明顯地向東北傾斜。它的左臂向北方伸出，掌心向前，好像在做一個手勢說：'停。'

english: The body has been hollowed out and turned into a tower shared by several wealthy tenants, which is officially known as Sparaunt Tower after its owner. The statue's left hand extends over a courtyard to the north, wherein lies the entrance of a tunnel carved through the arm. Visitors and residents can ring a bell in the courtyard, whereupon a door guard acknowledges the ringer and lowers a rope ladder for tenants and expected guests (or a rope chair that is drawn up for guests who are infirm or laden with heavy items).
zh_tw: 這座雕像的身體已經被挖空，變成了一個由幾位富有的租戶共享的塔樓，它的官方名稱是斯帕朗特塔，以它的所有者命名。雕像的左手伸向北方的一個庭院，庭院裡有一個透過手臂雕刻的隧道入口。訪客和居民可以在庭院裡按鈴，隨後門衛會確認按鈴者，併為租戶和預期的客人放下繩梯（或者為身體不便或攜帶重物的客人拉上繩椅）。

english: The Swordmaiden
zh_tw: 劍舞者

english: This statue appears virtually identical to the Honorable Knight, except for its female form and open-faced helm. It was felled during the Spellplague after causing much chaos and slaughter. The residents of Waterdeep's North Ward funneled much of their frustrated and dismayed reaction to its rampage into dismantling the statue, parts of which can now be found all over the North Ward, either incorporated into buildings or as bits of freestanding sculpture.
zh_tw: 這座雕像看起來幾乎與榮譽騎士完全相同，除了它是女性形象並且戴著一個開放式頭盔。它在法術疫病期間被擊倒，之前造成了巨大的混亂和屠殺。深水城北區的居民將他們對雕像暴走的沮喪和驚愕反應大部分轉化為拆除雕像，雕像的某些部分現在可以在北區各處找到，要麼被納入建築物中，要麼作為獨立的雕塑存在。

english: The head of the Swordmaiden sits in a stand of tall trees in the center of the block of the North Ward bounded by Hassantyr's Street, Tarsar's Street, Whaelgond Way, and Ussilbran Street. The center of its jaw and mouth have been replaced by a door, which leads into the shop known as Thort's Findings. Undevvur Thort is a wizened ex-adventurer who leans on a cane (which some locals insist is more than just a cane). He lives in the small shop, whose many levels, staircases, and landings fill the hollowed-out interior of the head, and which is crammed with oddments sold to Thort by adventurers and other travelers. These items bear little placards in Thort's beautiful, flowing handwriting that identify them (or at least provide speculation as to their origin and purpose). Nobles and wealthy merchants who desire props for themed revels often rent some of Thort's wares as decoration-and many sages, alchemists, and wizards visit him regularly in search of potentially useful items.
zh_tw: 劍女的頭部坐落在北區由哈桑提爾街、塔薩爾街、瓦爾貢德路和烏斯西布蘭街圍成的街區中心的一片高大樹木中。它的下巴和嘴巴的中心已經被一扇門所取代，這扇門通向一家名為索特的發現的商店。昂德維爾·索特是一位老練的前冒險家，他依靠一根手杖（一些當地人堅稱這不僅僅是一根手杖）。他住在這家小巧的商店裡，商店裡有許多層次、樓梯和平臺，填滿了頭部內部的空洞，裡面擺滿了由冒險家和其他旅行者出售給索特的各種小玩意兒。這些物品上掛著索特美麗流暢的手寫小牌子，上面標明瞭它們的身份（或者至少提供了關於它們的起源和用途的猜測）。貴族和富有的商人經常為了主題性聚會租借索特的一些商品作為裝飾——而且許多學者、鍊金術士和法師也會定期拜訪他，尋找可能有用的物品。

english: Infamous Alleys
zh_tw: 臭名昭著的小巷

english: Waterdeep has as many alleys as Baldur's Gate has cats, and each has a name and a story. Here are a few that you might wish to see—or should know to avoid.
zh_tw: 深水城的小巷和博德之門的貓一樣多，每個小巷都有自己的名字和故事。以下是你可能想要看看的——或者應該知道要避開的幾個。

english: Ruid's Stroll
zh_tw: 路德漫步道

english: This short avenue from Caravan Court to the Trollwall in the Southern Ward is haunted by the hooded ghost of the mage Ruid, whose touch causes deathly chills to those he meets on foggy nights. All attempts to banish or turn the spirit have failed. Those who brave its unearthly approach and allow Ruid to pass through them learn a secret truth about someone or something in their life—if they survive.
zh_tw: 這條從南區的商隊庭院到巨魔牆的短大街被巫師魯伊德的蒙面鬼魂所困擾，他在霧夜中觸控的人會感受到致命的寒意。所有試圖驅逐或驅轉這個靈魂的嘗試都失敗了。那些勇敢面對它超自然的存在並允許魯伊德穿過他們的人會瞭解到他們生活中某人或某事的秘密真相——如果他們能活下來的話。

english: Brindul Alley
zh_tw: 布林度巷

english: This is the lair of the Hand that Sings, a magical phantasm of a hand with a mouth in its palm. The hand is said to snatch valuables it fancies—especially magical ones—when it encounters them, and to occasionally attack folk in the darkness, strangling them or tripping them into fatal falls. Most often, though, it takes no notice of those who don't bother or follow it, eerily singing fragments of old Sword Coast ballads and love songs as it drifts through the night.
zh_tw: 這是"唱歌之手"的巢穴，一個手掌中有嘴巴的魔法幻象手。據說這隻手會搶奪它看中的貴重物品——尤其是魔法物品——當它遇到它們時，並且偶爾會在黑暗中攻擊人們，勒死他們或絆倒他們導致致命的墜落。然而，大多數情況下，它不會注意到那些不打擾或不跟隨它的人，當它在夜晚飄蕩時，它會詭異地唱著古老的劍海岸民歌和情歌的片段。

english: Manycats Alley
zh_tw: 群貓巷

english: This passage crosses two city blocks and winds through the interior of a third, running between and (for the most part) parallel to Julthoon Street and Traders' Way in the North Ward. It is, unsurprisingly, home to many cats that feed on scraps from the surrounding butchers' shops, but it is also known for the many carved stone heads of people and animals that adorn the alley's buildings. Individuals who have walked the alley alone report that some of the heads whispered cryptic messages to them.
zh_tw: 這段通道穿過兩個城市街區，並在第三個街區內部蜿蜒而行，主要在北區的朱爾蘇恩街和商人之路之間執行，並且大致與之平行。毫不奇怪，這裡有許多貓，它們以周圍肉店的殘羹剩飯為食，但這裡也因裝飾在小巷建築物上的許多雕刻的石頭人頭和動物頭而聞名。獨自走過這條小巷的人報告說，一些頭顱對他們耳語了神秘的訊息。

english: Gondwatch Lane
zh_tw: 貢德注視巷

english: Found at the southern entrance to the House of Inspired Hands in the Sea Ward, this alley serves as the testing ground for inventions considered too dangerous to operate inside the temple. The locals are generally unconcerned about the risks, though, and stand watching while food vendors circulate among them.
zh_tw: 位於海區受巧手之屋南入口的這條小巷，用作被認為在神廟內操作過於危險的發明的試驗場。然而，當地人通常對這些風險漠不關心，他們站在一邊觀看，而食品攤販在他們中間穿梭。

english: Pharra's Alley
zh_tw: 法拉巷

english: This alley in the Sea Ward is named after the first leader of the House of Wonder, but is more infamous for its Circle of Skulls. This infrequent and unpredictable haunting takes the form of seven floating skulls, which hover in a circle and argue with one another in whispered tones about events in the city. If they are interrupted, their reaction reportedly varies from being helpful to engaging in murderous spell-slinging.
zh_tw: 海區的這條小巷以奇蹟之家的首位領袖命名，但更因其頭骨圈而臭名昭著。這種罕見且不可預測的鬼魂現象呈現為七個漂浮的頭骨，它們在一個圈中盤旋，並以低語的語調相互爭論城市中的事件。如果它們被打斷，它們的反應據說從樂於助人到參與致命的法術投擲各不相同。

english: Three Daggers Alley
zh_tw: 三匕首巷

english: This alley in the Dock Ward suffers from a magical curse that causes three daggers to appear out of thin air and attack passersby. The daggers swoop and fly about, making multiple attempts at murder before vanishing again. This magical effect, the result of a spell cast by a long-dead wizard, has resisted all attempts to dispel it. Some locals boast of how many times they've crossed the alley and lived to tell of it, but the appearance of the daggers is entirely a matter of chance, and unpredictable. So take my advice and don't test Tymora's favor.
zh_tw: 碼頭區的這條小巷遭受了一個魔法詛咒的困擾，導致三把匕首會憑空出現並攻擊過路人。這些匕首會俯衝和四處飛行，在消失之前多次嘗試謀殺。這個魔法效果是由一位早已死去的法師施放的法術所致，至今所有試圖解除它的嘗試都失敗了。一些當地人誇耀他們多少次穿過這條小巷並活著講述這個故事，但匕首的出現完全是偶然的，不可預測。所以請聽從我的建議，不要考驗提莫拉的眷顧。

english: City Celebrations
zh_tw: 城市慶典

english: At many times of year, hardly a tenday can pass in Waterdeep without the staging of some rite, race, or rousing ceremony of civic pride. Here I briefly summarize the most widely celebrated events on the calendar, from the first of Hammer to the last of Nightal.
zh_tw: 在一年中的許多時候，在深水城幾乎每十天就會有一次儀式、比賽或激動人心的公民自豪感慶典。在這裡，我簡要概述了從哈默月的第一天到奈塔爾月的最後一天日曆上最廣泛慶祝的事件。

english: Hammer 1: Wintershield
zh_tw: 錘子節1: 冬盾節

english: Marking the start of the new year, this observance is a widely recognized day off work, when folk sip warmed ciders and broths (often laced with herbs for health and to bring on visions) and stay inside. They tell tales of what interested them or was important in the year just done, and discuss what they intend to do or should deal with-or things that everyone "should keep a hawk's clear eye on"-in the year ahead.
zh_tw: 作為新年開始的標誌，這個慶祝活動是一個廣泛認可的休息日，人們會品嚐溫熱的蘋果酒和肉湯（通常加入草藥以促進健康並帶來幻覺），並待在室內。他們會講述過去一年中引起他們興趣或重要的事情，並討論他們打算做或應該處理的事情——或者每個人"都應該保持鷹一樣銳利的警覺"——在來年的事情。

english: Such talk inevitably leads to discussions of politics, wars, and the intentions of rulers. Maps are usually consulted, and it's widely considered lucky to possess and examine a map on Wintershield. Map sales are brisk in the tenday preceding this holiday.
zh_tw: 這樣的談話很自然地會導致對政治、戰爭和統治者意圖的討論。通常會查閱地圖，人們普遍認為在冬盾節擁有和檢查地圖是幸運的。在這一節日前的十天裡，地圖銷量很好。

english: Alturiak 14: The Grand Revel
zh_tw: 阿爾圖里亞克14日：盛大狂歡節

english: Led by the clergy of Sune, Sharess, and Lliira, the Grand Revel is a day of dancing, music, and the consumption of sweet treats of all kinds, from chocolate to red firemint candies. Although some of the dancing is wanton and performed for show, large-scale ring dances in the street for all ages are also popular. All the dancing ends at dusk, after which bards and minstrels perform at "love feasts" for families. Couples-or those desiring to become couples-slip away together to kiss, exchange promises, and trade small tokens of affection (often rings blessed by clergy with prayers of faithfulness). Even if you have no paramour, indulge a little in the dance and food of this fine tradition. The night might be cold, but your heart will be warmed.
zh_tw: 盛大狂歡節是由太陽女神蘇妮、沙瑞絲和莉拉的神職人員引領的，這是一個跳舞、音樂和享用各種甜食的日子，從巧克力到紅色火焰薄荷糖。儘管有些舞蹈是為了表演而放蕩的，但所有年齡段都喜歡在街上進行的大型圓圈舞也非常受歡迎。所有的舞蹈在黃昏時結束，之後吟遊詩人和歌手為家庭舉辦"愛情盛宴"。情侶們——或者那些渴望成為情侶的人——會一起溜走，親吻、交換承諾，並交換小小的愛意象徵（通常是被神職人員用忠誠祈禱祝福過的戒指）。即使你沒有情人，也請在這個美好的傳統中稍微放縱一下舞蹈和美食。夜晚可能很冷，但你的心會被溫暖。

english: Ches 1: Rhyestertide
zh_tw: 切斯1日：瑞斯特潮節

english: This holiday is named in honor of Lathander's first prophet, Rhyester, a young blind boy who was cured of that blindness by the dawn's light on this day more than seven centuries ago. That holy event occurred in the vicinity of Silverymoon, but Lathander has long had a much larger temple in Waterdeep, and a following to match. Each of the faithful dons bright garb of sunrise hues and keeps one eye covered until the next dawn in honor of Rhyester. If you want to feel like a local, catch the eye of any celebrant you see and wink. Fine friendships have grown from far less.
zh_tw: 這個節日以洛山達的首位先知瑞斯特的名字命名，他是一個年輕的盲童，在七百多年前的今天，被黎明之光治癒了失明。那個神聖的事件發生在銀月城附近，但洛山達在深水城擁有一個更大的神廟，並且有著相匹配的追隨者。每一位信徒都會穿上日出色彩的鮮亮服裝，並且為了紀念瑞斯特，遮蓋一隻眼睛直到下一個黎明。如果你想感受當地的氛圍，就和你所看到的任何慶祝者對視並眨眼。許多美好的友誼都是從更小的事情開始的。

english: Ches 19: Fey Day
zh_tw: 切斯 19: 精類日

english: The veil between this world and the faerie realm of the Feywild is thought to be weak on this day. Though this phenomenon provokes caution in rural areas (with folk avoiding woodlands, putting offerings of food on doorsteps, and the like), it is an occasion of much drinking, singing, and dancing in Waterdeep. The wealthy host elaborate masked balls, while poorer folk don costumes of their own make and travel door to door, gaining brief entry into the celebrations in exchange for performing a song or a short play. All adopt the guises of fey beings and the supposed rulers of the Feywild, such as Queen Titania, Oberon, and Hyrsam, the Prince of Fools. Those inclined to remain sullen in the face of such frivolity had best stay home, for celebrants do their utmost to evoke a smile from those they meet.
zh_tw: 在這一天，人們認為這個世界與妖精荒野的精類王國之間的面紗被認為很薄弱。儘管這種現象在農村地區引起謹慎（人們避免進入林地，在門口放置食物作為供品等），但在深水城，這是一個大量飲酒、唱歌和跳舞的場合。富人舉辦精心製作的化妝舞會，而較貧窮的人則穿上自制的服裝，挨家挨戶地去，透過表演一首歌或短劇來獲得短暫的慶祝活動入場。所有人都裝扮成精類和精類王國所謂的統治者，如女王泰坦尼亞、奧伯倫和赫薩姆，愚人王子。那些傾向於在這種輕浮面前保持陰沉的人最好待在家裡，因為慶祝者會盡最大努力從他們遇到的人那裡引發微笑。

english: Ches 21–30: Fleetswake
zh_tw: 切斯月21–30日：艦隊覺醒節

english: This festival celebrates the sea, maritime trade, and the gods of the sea, navigation, and weather. It spans the last tenday of Ches, and includes a series of boat races, the Shipwrights' Ball at the Shipwrights' House, and guild-sponsored galas at the Copper Cup festhall. According to custom, the winners of the various competitions don't keep their trophies and earnings, but deliver them to the priests of Umberlee at the Queenspire, her temple on the beach by the east entrance to the Great Harbor, at the conclusion of the festival.
zh_tw: 這個節日慶祝海洋、海上貿易以及掌管海洋、導航和天氣的神祇。它貫穿了切斯的最後十天，並包括一系列划船比賽、造船師之屋舉行的造船師舞會，以及銅杯節日大廳舉行的行會贊助的晚會。根據習俗，各項比賽的獲勝者不會保留他們的獎盃和收入，而是在節日結束時將它們送到海灘上位於大港口東入口的女王塔，烏姆貝爾萊的神廟的祭司那裡。

english: The last two days of Fleetswake are the occasion of the Fair Seas Festival. During this time, there is much feasting on seafood, the harbor is strewn with flower petals, and City Guards go from tavern to tavern collecting offerings for Umberlee. Collection boxes also appear at large festival gatherings. Upon sunset of the final day, the collected coin is placed in chests and dumped into the deepest part of the harbor.
zh_tw: 艦隊覺醒節的最後兩天是公海節慶祝活動的時間。在這段時間裡，人們大量享用海鮮，海港裡撒滿了花瓣，城防軍會從一家酒館到另一家酒館為烏姆貝爾萊收集供品。在大型節日集會上也會出現收集箱。在節日最後一天的日落時分，收集到的錢幣被放入箱子中，然後傾倒在海港最深處。

english: This festival has existed in a number of forms since the first trade-meets occurred here more than two millennia ago, and an uncountable amount of wealth remains sunken in what has long been known as Umberlee's Cache. The area is closely watched by merfolk guardians, whose standing orders are to kill anyone attempting to disturb it. Rumors abound that the chests have magical protections; one story tells of thieves who stole some of the collection years ago and tried to leave the city under false pretenses, only to see a squall spring up as soon as their ship left the harbor. A huge wave shaped like a hand swept the thieves overboard, but spared the ship and its crew.
zh_tw: 這個節日自兩千多年前第一次貿易集會在此舉行以來，就以多種形式存在，無數的財富仍然沉沒在長久以來被稱為烏姆貝爾萊的藏寶處的水域。該區域由人魚守衛嚴密監視，他們的固定命令是殺死任何試圖擾亂它的人。有關寶箱擁有魔法保護的傳言滿天飛；有一個故事講述了一些盜賊在幾年前偷走了部分收藏，並試圖以虛假借口離開城市，但他們的船隻剛離開港口，就突然起了風暴。一個巨大的手形波浪將盜賊掃入海中，但放過了船隻和其船員。

english: Tarsahk 1–10: Waukeentide
zh_tw: 塔薩克月1-10日：沃金節

english: This festival has long gathered a number of older holidays under one name, stretching those celebrations into a holiday season that lasts a tenday. Among the rituals in homage to the goddess of wealth and trade are these: {@b Caravance (Tarsahk 1}). This gift-giving holiday commemorates the traditional arrival of the first caravans of the season into the city. Many parents hide gifts for their offspring in their homes, telling the children that they were left by Old Carvas—a mythical peddler who arrived with the first caravan to reach Waterdeep, his wagon loaded down with toys for children to enjoy. {@b Goldenight (Tarsahk 5}). This festival celebrates coin and {@item gold|PHB}, with many businesses staying open all night, offering midnight sales and other promotions. Some celebrants and customers decorate themselves with gold dust and wear coins as jewelry. {@b Guildsmeet (Tarsahk 7}). On this holiday, guild members gather in their halls for the announcement of new policies and a celebration of business concluded for the year. These gatherings culminate in a gala festival and dance sponsored by several guilds, which lasts from dusk till dawn and overruns the Market, the Cynosure, the Field of Triumph, and all areas in between. {@b Leiruin (Tarsahk 10}). In times long past, Waukeen caught Leira, the goddess of illusions and deception, attempting to cheat her in a deal, and buried her under a mountain of molten gold as punishment. A commemoration of that event, Leiruin is the day for guild members to pay their annual dues and for guildmasters to meet with the Lords of Waterdeep and renew their charters for another year.
zh_tw: 這個節慶早已把數個古老節日統合在同一名稱下，延伸為持續十天的節期。其中，向財富與貿易女神致敬的儀式包括：{@b 商隊節（塔薩克1日）}。這個互贈禮物的節日，紀念本季首批商隊抵達城中的傳統。許多父母把禮物藏在家裡，告訴孩子們，禮物是老卡瓦斯留下的。這位傳說中的小販隨第一支抵達深水城的商隊前來，馬車上滿載供孩子玩樂的玩具。{@b 金夜節（塔薩克5日）}。這個節日歌頌錢幣與{@item gold|PHB|金}。許多商家徹夜營業，提供午夜特賣與其他優惠；有些慶祝者和顧客以金粉裝飾自己，並把錢幣當成珠寶佩戴。{@b 行會聚會日（塔薩克7日）}。行會成員在各自的會館集合，宣告新政策，慶祝當年完成的生意。聚會最終迎來由數個行會贊助的盛大慶典與舞會，從黃昏持續到黎明，遍及市場、辛諾蘇爾、凱旋競技場，以及其間所有區域。{@b 雷烏林節（塔薩克10日）}。久遠以前，渥金撞見幻象與欺瞞女神蕾拉企圖在交易中欺騙她，便將蕾拉埋在熔金堆成的山下作為懲罰。雷烏林節紀念這件事；當天行會成員繳納年費，行會首領也與深水城領主會面，續訂下一年的特許狀。

english: Mirtul 6–9: The Plowing and Running
zh_tw: 米爾圖6–9日：耕耘與奔跑

english: Rural areas around the city observe this holiday in the traditional sense of shared activities of plowing fields and moving (or "running") livestock. But within the city, the holiday is celebrated with a series of races. Foot, horse, and chariot races are run through courses in each ward, and the winners from each ward compete at the Field of Triumph. If you really want to see the wards come to life, this is the time. Pick your favorite, wear its colors, and cheer alongside its residents. Better yet, if you're of an adventuresome bent, register in your favored ward and compete! Who knows? Your name or visage might soon have a place in the House of Heroes.
zh_tw: 城市周圍的農村地區以傳統的方式慶祝這個節日，共同進行耕田和移動（或"奔跑"）牲畜的活動。但在城市內，這個節日則是透過一系列比賽來慶祝的。每個區域都會舉行賽跑、賽馬和戰車比賽，每個區域的獲勝者在凱旋廣場進行比賽。如果你想看到各個區域活躍起來，這就是時候了。選擇你最喜歡的區域，穿上它的顏色，並與其居民一起歡呼。更好的是，如果你有冒險精神，就在你偏愛的區域報名參加比賽吧！誰知道呢？你的名字或形象可能很快就會在英雄之家裡佔有一席之地。

english: Kythorn 1: Trolltide
zh_tw: 凱索恩 1: 巨魔節

english: On this day commemorating Waterdeep's victory in the Second Trollwar, children run through the city acting like trolls, banging on doors and growling, from highsun till dusk. Home and shop owners are expected to give the children candy, fruits, or small items. Those who give no treat can expect to become the target of a trick at sundown. This mischief typically takes the form of "troll scratchings" at doors and windows.
