Those with more malicious intent sing screechingly in the wee hours, and hurl raw eggs at windows, signs, and the heads of those who try to stop them. Have some candy on hand or some sweet rolls, and all will be calm where you live.
zh_tw: 在這一天，紀念深水城在第二次巨魔戰爭中的勝利，孩子們在城市中奔跑，模仿巨魔，敲門和咆哮，從正午到黃昏。家庭和商店主人應該給孩子們糖果、水果或小物品。那些不給糖果的人可以期待在日落時分成為惡作劇的目標。這種惡作劇通常以'巨魔抓痕'的形式出現在門窗上。那些懷有更惡意的人在凌晨尖叫，並把生雞蛋扔向窗戶、招牌以及試圖阻止他們的人的頭上。手頭準備一些糖果或甜點，你住的地方一切都會平靜。

english: Kythorn 14: Guildhall Day
zh_tw: 凱索恩 14: 公會大廳日

english: This day is a time of trade fairs. Most shops are closed, and street sales are suspended for all but walking food peddlers. Guildhall Day celebrates the fruits of everyone's labor with revelations of new products, innovations, fashions, and signage extolling the extent and quality of guild members' services and wares. These offerings usually take the form of glittering displays, but guilds sometimes also sponsor brief plays or other hired entertainments (jugglers, singers, magic shows put on by hedge wizards and professional raconteurs) at which prizes or free samples are distributed. Many guilds try to recruit during this time. Guildhall Day is an excellent time to browse the city's merchandise-and it doesn't matter if you can't afford what you see, because you can't buy it that day anyway.
zh_tw: 這一天是貿易集市的時間。大多數商店都關閉了，除了步行食品小販外，街頭銷售都被暫停。公會大廳日慶祝每個人的勞動成果，透過展示新產品、創新、時尚和宣傳公會成員服務和商品的範圍與質量的標誌來揭示。這些展示通常以閃閃發光的形式出現，但公會有時也會贊助短暫的戲劇或其他僱傭的娛樂活動（雜技演員、歌手、由業餘法師和專業講故事者進行的魔術表演），在這些活動中分發獎品或免費樣品。許多公會在這段時間嘗試招募新成員。公會大廳日是瀏覽城市商品的絕佳時機——即使你買不起你看到的東西也沒關係，因為那天你反正也買不到。

english: Kythorn 20: Dragondown
zh_tw: 凱索恩 20: 龍降日

english: This day in Kythorn is celebrated with bonfires and rituals to "tame" or "drive down" dragons. In Waterdeep, the celebrations take the form of parades that center around effigies built of wood and cloth and filled with straw. Each effigy is named and has a traditional depiction, for it represents one of a handful of dragons the city has faced in its history. After being paraded to a square near where the dragon was defeated or driven off, the enormous effigy is burned.
zh_tw: 凱索恩的這一天，人們透過篝火和儀式來'馴服'或'驅趕'龍。在深水城，慶祝活動以圍繞用木頭和布製成的、裡面填充稻草的雕像的遊行形式進行。每個雕像都有名字並有傳統的描繪，因為它代表了這座城市在其歷史上面對過的少數幾條龍之一。在雕像被遊行到龍被擊敗或被趕走的廣場附近後，這個巨大的雕像被焚燒。

english: The height of the celebration comes when the effigy of Kistarianth the Red is burned on the slopes of Mount Waterdeep. A dracolich version of Kistarianth is then carried up the slopes and burned as well. These proceedings symbolize the defeat of Kistarianth first by the paladin Athar, and again decades later by his son, Piergeiron. Tradition dictates that the winners of the races run during the Plowing and Running take the role of the dragons' slayers, with the champion of the chariot race representing Athar and the champion of the horse race playing Piergeiron.
zh_tw: 慶祝活動的高潮是在深水山的斜坡上焚燒紅色基斯塔里安斯的肖像。然後，一個龍巫妖版本的基斯塔里安斯也被抬上斜坡並被焚燒。這些活動象徵著基斯塔里安斯首先被聖武士神明非神會擊敗，幾十年後又被他的兒子皮爾吉倫擊敗。傳統規定，在耕種和賽跑期間贏得比賽的人扮演屠龍者的角色，戰車賽的冠軍代表神明非神會，馬賽的冠軍扮演皮爾吉倫。

english: Flamerule 1: Founders' Day
zh_tw: 弗萊姆魯爾 1: 創始者日

english: This day commemorates the birth of the city. The Field of Triumph is the site of illusory displays that chronicle the history of Waterdeep, as well as martial exhibitions by the Guard and other worthies. Many festhalls sponsor Founders' Day costume contests, with prizes going to those who wear the best recreations of the garb of historical personages.
zh_tw: 這一天紀念城市的誕生。勝利之場是展示深水城歷史的幻影展示的地點，以及衛兵和其他傑出人物的武術表演。許多節日大廳贊助創始者日服裝比賽，獎品頒發給那些穿著最佳歷史人物服裝再現的人。

english: Once banned as frivolous and distracting, the practice of veiling Castle Waterdeep with an illusion has been reinstated. Several mages come together to produce the effect, which seemingly transforms the castle into the ancient log fortress of Nimoar. The illusion typically lasts from midday to sunset (unless someone has the audacity and magical might to dispel it) and is regarded as a stunning work of magical art.
zh_tw: 曾經因為被認為是輕佻和分散注意力而被禁止的將深水堡用幻象覆蓋的做法已經恢復。幾位法師聯手產生這種效果，這似乎將城堡變成了尼莫亞的古老木製堡壘。這種幻象通常從中午持續到日落（除非有人有膽量和魔法力量來驅散它），並且被視為令人驚歎的魔法藝術作品。

english: Flamerule 3–5: Sornyn
zh_tw: 弗萊姆魯爾3-5日：索爾寧

english: Sornyn is a festival of both Waukeen and Lathander, and is used for planning business, making treaties and agreements, and receiving envoys from unknown lands and traditional foes. Much wine is drunk over this three-day occasion when, as the saying goes, "My enemy is like family to me." If you are a newcomer to the city, this time is an excellent opportunity for you to engage with new partners in business or to gain financial support for some endeavor. My agreement to write Volo's Guide to Waterdeep was signed on a warm Sornyn evening many years ago, so who knows where your own initiative will take you?
zh_tw: 索恩恩節是渥金和洛山達的節日，用於規劃商業、簽訂條約和協議，以及接待來自未知土地和傳統敵人的使者。在這三天的場閤中，人們會喝很多酒，正如俗話說的，"我的敵人就像我的家人一樣。"如果您是這座城市的新來者，這是與新的商業夥伴接觸或為某些事業獲得財務支援的絕佳機會。多年前，在一個溫暖的索恩恩節晚上，我簽署了撰寫《瓦羅的深水城指南》的協議，所以誰知道你自己的主動性會帶你去哪裡呢？

english: Flamerule 7: Lliira's Night
zh_tw: 弗萊姆魯爾 7: 莉拉之夜

english: Originally a celebration held only in Waterdeep, this holiday has since spread up and down the Sword Coast. It has received a recent boost in popularity from the custom started in Baldur's Gate of lighting celebratory smokepowder fireworks-all purchased from Felogyr's Fireworks of that city, and utilized only by the City Guard, of course. This nightlong festival honors the Lady of Joy with dances and balls throughout the city. Pink beverages, ranging from healthy juices to deadly strong intoxicants, are imbibed. The boom and crackle of smokepowder explosions go off all night long, so you might as well stay up with the locals and enjoy the show.
zh_tw: 最初只在深水城舉行的慶祝活動，這個節日自那以後已經沿著劍海岸上下傳播。它最近因為博德之門開始的燃放慶祝煙火的習俗而人氣大增——所有煙火都購買自該城市的費洛吉爾煙火店，並且當然只有城防軍隊使用。這個通宵的節日以舞蹈和舞會的形式在整個城市慶祝歡樂女士。從健康的果汁到致命的烈性酒精飲料，粉色飲品被盡情享用。煙粉爆炸的轟鳴和噼啪聲整夜不斷，所以你不妨和當地人一起熬夜，享受這場表演。

english: Eleasis 1: Ahghairon's Day
zh_tw: 伊萊西斯 1: 阿蓋爾倫日

english: Many small rituals are held throughout this day, dedicated to honoring the first Open Lord. The Lords of Waterdeep toast Ahghairon and the Watchful Order, and guildmasters toast the Lords in Ahghairon's name. Commoners leave violets (Ahghairon's favorite flower) around Ahghairon's Tower, on his statue in the City of the Dead, and atop the altars of the House of Wonder. Bards perform songs in honor of the wizard all over the city. The Open Lord visits taverns and inns throughout Waterdeep to wish the people well-giving short speeches, offering toasts to Ahghairon's memory, buying rounds of drinks, or paying for meals or accommodation. Needless to say, establishments of those sorts are generally full throughout the day.
zh_tw: 在這一天，舉行許多小型儀式，以紀念第一位公開領主。深水城的領主們向阿蓋爾倫和守望秩序舉杯，公會大師以阿蓋爾倫的名義向領主們舉杯。平民在阿蓋爾倫塔周圍、亡者之城的他的雕像上，以及奇蹟之家的祭壇上留下紫羅蘭（阿蓋爾倫最喜歡的花）。吟遊詩人在全城演唱紀念這位法師的歌曲。公開領主訪問深水城的酒館和旅館，向人們致以良好的祝願——發表簡短的演講，向阿蓋爾倫的記憶舉杯，購買一輪飲料，或支付餐費或住宿費。不用說，這類場所在全天通常都是客滿的。

english: Eleint 21: Brightswords
zh_tw: 伊萊恩特 21: 明亮劍日

english: On this day, the City Guard, the City Navy, and the City Watch-all in glittering array-conduct parades, give demonstrations of martial skill, and stage mock battles. Those desiring to join their ranks are given a chance to demonstrate their prowess, usually with wooden practice weapons in contests against veteran soldiers. Makers and vendors of weapons sell their wares openly in the markets, experts who can hurl or juggle weapons show off their skills, and the wards compete in wrestling and boxing matches. The most anticipated part of the day is when horses are cleared from the Field of Triumph and the surrounding streets so that the Griffon Cavalry can perform aerial displays over the crowds in the stadium. Members of the Watchful Order present the cavalry with illusory foes to fight, allowing the griffon riders to engage in thrilling battles as the people watch.
zh_tw: 在這一天，城市守衛隊、城市海軍和城市守衛隊——全都穿著閃亮的制服——舉行遊行，展示武術技能，並舉行模擬戰鬥。那些希望加入他們行列的人有機會展示他們的能力，通常是用木製練習武器與經驗豐富的士兵進行比賽。製作和銷售武器的商人在市場公開銷售他們的商品，能夠投擲或耍弄武器的專家展示他們的技能，各個區域在摔跤和拳擊比賽中競爭。這一天最令人期待的部分是，當勝利之場和周圍街道上的馬被清空，以便獅鷲騎兵可以在體育場上空的人群進行空中表演。守望秩序的成員向騎兵展示了虛幻的敵人，讓獅鷲騎士在人們觀看時進行激動人心的戰鬥。

english: Marpenoth 3: Day of Wonders
zh_tw: 瑪佩諾斯 3: 奇蹟日

english: The imaginative inventions of the Gondar are revealed on this day and paraded through the city. These devices range from something as humble as new cabinet hinges to massive mechanical constructs that walk or roll about. Failure is the paramour of invention, though, meaning it is a rare year when there isn't some notable disruption of the celebration. The flying chair of Marchell was one such recent oddity-a device that worked marvelously on the way up but was incapable of descending. Marchell was rescued by the Griffon Cavalry, but his flying chair drifted away and was never seen again.
zh_tw: 貢達爾人的富有想象力的發明在這一天被展示出來，並在城市中游行。這些裝置從新的櫥櫃鉸鏈這樣簡單的東西到可以行走或滾動的巨大機械構造都有。然而，失敗是發明的情人，這意味著很少有一年慶祝活動沒有一些顯著的中斷。馬爾切爾的飛行椅就是這樣一個最近的奇特裝置——一個在上升過程中表現得非常出色的裝置，但卻無法下降。馬爾切爾被獅鷲騎兵救出，但他的飛行椅漂走了，從此再也沒有人見過。

english: Day of Wonders
zh_tw: 奇蹟日

english: Marpenoth 7: Stoneshar
zh_tw: 瑪佩諾斯 7: 石刃日

english: Stoneshar is an all-faiths day during which folk strive not to be idle. Even children at play are encouraged to dig holes, build sand castles, or construct crude models.
zh_tw: 石刃日是一個所有信仰的節日，在這一天人們努力不讓自己閒下來。即使是玩耍中的孩子們也被鼓勵去挖洞、建造沙堡或製作粗糙的模型。

english: Waterdavians consider Stoneshar the best day of the year to begin construction of a building, either by digging out a cellar or laying a foundation. The common wisdom is that folk who undertake new projects on Stoneshar can expect blessings upon their works in the coming year, whereas individuals who do nothing constructive on this day can expect all manner of misfortune to rain down on them in the year ahead.
zh_tw: 水深港居民認為石刃日是一年中開始建築建設的最佳日子，無論是挖掘地下室還是鋪設地基。普遍的感知是，在石刃日開始新專案的人們可以期待在來年的工程上得到祝福，而那些在這一天沒有做任何建設性事情的個人可以期待在來年遭遇各種不幸。

english: Marpenoth 10: Reign of Misrule
zh_tw: 瑪佩諾斯 10: 混亂統治日

english: Swift on the heels of Stoneshar comes the Reign of Misrule. This day honors Beshaba, goddess of misfortune. People of the city are expected to break trust, belie oaths, and disobey the normal order-as long as no laws are actually broken and no rift is made that can't be later bridged. During the Reign of Misrule, nobles serve meals to their servants, children take control of schools, priests give worship to their god's foes, and any who wish to may participate in a guild's trade. Pranks are played by and on many, from simple tricks to those requiring elaborate planning. Sundown brings an end to the festivities, and most folk spend much of the night cleaning and reordering things for the following day. Many visitors decline to participate, but doing so often inspires misfortune rather than avoiding it. For fear of catching the bad luck of cynics, citizens do their best to avoid talking to anyone known to not have played along, or dealing with them in any way until Gods' Day.
zh_tw: 緊隨石刃日之後的是混亂統治日。這一天向不幸女神貝沙巴致敬。城市居民被期望打破信任、違背誓言，並違背常規秩序——只要實際上沒有違反法律，也沒有造成後來無法彌補的裂痕。在混亂統治日期間，貴族為他們僕人服務餐食，孩子們接管學校，牧師向他們神的敵人獻祭，任何希望參加的人都可以參與公會的貿易。惡作劇由許多人上演，從簡單的把戲到需要精心策劃的。日落標誌著慶祝活動的結束，大多數人花費晚上的大部分時間清潔和重新整理第二天的事情。許多訪客拒絕參與，但這樣做往往會帶來不幸，而不是避免它。出於對懷疑論者帶來壞運氣的恐懼，市民盡力避免與任何已知沒有參與的人交談，或以任何方式與他們打交道，直到諸神之日。

english: Marpenoth 15: Gods' Day
zh_tw: 瑪佩諾斯 15: 諸神之日

english: This holiday observes the anniversary of the end of the Godswar in 1358 DR, when the gods of Faerûn returned to the heavens. Private shrines are brought out into the open, and many people wear holy symbols of their favored deities. A Gods' Day tradition in Waterdeep strictly limits the use of magic, in remembrance of the wild magic wrought during the Time of Troubles. Though not outlawed fully, spellcasting is allowable only in self-defense or in cases of extreme need.
zh_tw: 這個節日紀念1358 DR年神戰結束的週年，當時費倫的眾神回到了天堂。私人神龕被擺放到戶外，許多人佩戴他們所崇拜神祇的聖徽。在深水城，諸神之日的傳統嚴格限制了魔法的使用，以紀念動盪時期產生的野性魔法。雖然不是完全禁止，但施法只有在自衛或極端需要的情況下才被允許。

english: At night, this holiday becomes solemn and serious, as many Waterdavians offer prayers in thanks for the lives they have under their gods. The Griffon Cavalry sets up an immense bonfire at the peak of Mount Waterdeep, honoring the fallen and the risen gods Myrkul, Cyric, Kelemvor, Mystra, Helm, and Ao who appeared here. In thanks for their defense during Myrkul's invasion and the resulting fires that raged through the Southern, Dock, and Castle Wards, Gods' Day is also a semiofficial "Be Kind to the Guard and Watch Day" in Waterdeep. Feel free to participate by handing out small gifts and kind words, but be aware that any gift of greater value than a few nibs might be interpreted as a bribe.
zh_tw: 在夜晚，這個節日變得莊重而嚴肅，許多深水城居民為他們在神明庇護下的生活向神明祈禱表示感謝。獅鷲騎兵在深水城山頂上點燃了巨大的篝火，以紀念隕落和升起的神祇米爾庫爾、賽瑞克、克勒姆沃爾、密斯特拉、海爾姆和奧。為了感謝他們在米爾庫爾入侵期間以及隨後在南方、碼頭和城堡區域肆虐的火災中的保衛，諸神之日也是深水城半官方的"對警衛和守衛友好日"。你可以自由參與，透過分發小禮物和親切的話語，但請注意，任何價值超過幾個小硬幣的禮物都可能被解釋為賄賂。

english: Marpenoth 30: Liar's Night
zh_tw: 瑪佩諾斯 30: 說謊者之夜

english: This holy day pays tribute to Leira and Mask. To placate those deities and ward away their attention, folk of all walks of life don masks and costumes (magical or mundane) to disguise themselves and play at being other than what they are. Commonly seen mask styles include the black mask symbol of Mask and the mirror face of the priests of Leira. But there are no bounds on the disguise you don, and the more elaborate and outlandish it is, the more celebrated the wearer.
zh_tw: 這個神聖的日子向蕾拉和麵具致敬。為了安撫這些神祇並避免引起他們的注意，各行各業的人們戴上面具和服裝（無論是魔法的還是普通的），偽裝自己，扮演與自己不同的身份。常見的面具風格包括面具的黑色面具象徵和蕾拉神職人員的鏡面臉。但是你的偽裝沒有界限，越精緻和離奇，佩戴者就越受慶祝。

english: The festivities begin in the evening, when people place candles in hollowed-out gourds or pumpkins carved with faces. Each pumpkin represents a person donning a mask, while the light inside represents the truth of the soul. For as long as the candle remains lit, lies told and embarrassing things done don't sully a person's reputation, so celebrations often descend briefly into anarchic hedonism.
zh_tw: 慶祝活動從傍晚開始，人們將蠟燭放在挖空的葫蘆或雕刻有面孔的南瓜裡。每個南瓜代表一個戴面具的人，而裡面的光代表靈魂的真相。只要蠟燭保持點燃，說出的謊言和尷尬的事情不會玷汙一個人的聲譽，因此慶祝活動經常會短暫地陷入無政府主義的享樂主義。

english: Misfortune is said to come to anyone who returns to their pumpkin after celebrating to find it unlit, so buy a candle of good quality and put your gourd beyond reach of the wind. Intentionally blowing out someone else's candle or smashing someone else's pumpkin is taboo, and risks the wrath of both gods-yet it does occur.
zh_tw: 據說，任何在慶祝後返回發現自己的南瓜燈未點亮的人都會遭遇不幸，因此購買一支優質蠟燭，並確保你的葫蘆遠離風。故意吹滅別人的蠟燭或砸碎別人的南瓜是禁忌的，這可能會招致兩位神祇的憤怒——然而這樣的事確實會發生。

english: Tricks and pranks of all kinds are common on this night, and folk expect lies and foolishness. Pickpockets are rife on this day, so few carry much coin with them, having secreted it away somewhere the previous evening. Instead, people fill their pockets and belt pouches with candies. Traditionally, a pickpocket is meant to take the candy and leave a token in return (a tiny toy, a colorful paper folded into a shape, or the like), but this has changed over the years into adults exchanging candies among themselves and simply giving candy to children who ask for it.
zh_tw: 在這個夜晚，各種惡作劇和詭計都是常見的，人們預料到會有謊言和愚蠢行為。這一天小偷非常多，所以很少有人攜帶很多錢幣，而是在前一天晚上將其藏匿在某個地方。相反，人們會在他們的口袋和腰帶袋子裡裝滿糖果。傳統上，扒手應該拿走糖果並留下一個信物作為回報（一個小玩具，一張折成形狀的彩色紙，或類似的東西），但這些年來這已經演變成成年人之間互相交換糖果，並且只是簡單地給索要糖果的孩子們糖果。

english: By custom, no deals are made nor contracts signed on Liar's Night, because no one trusts that parties will abide by them. Illusionists and stage magicians (whether through magical or practical abilities) make the rounds to entertain private parties (having been paid in advance the previous day) or to perform in public spaces, in the hopes that a good show will earn them a meal, and perhaps a place at a private party in the future.
zh_tw: 按照習俗，說謊者之夜不進行交易也不簽訂合同，因為沒有人相信各方會遵守它們。幻術師和舞臺魔術師（無論是透過魔法還是實際能力）四處走動，為私人派對提供娛樂（已在前一天提前支付），或者在公共場合表演，希望一場精彩的表演能為他們贏得一餐，也許還能在未來獲得參加私人派對的機會。

english: Uktar: Selûne's Hallowing
zh_tw: 烏克塔爾: 賽爾菲之夜

english: On whatever night in Uktar the moon is fullest, Waterdavians celebrate Selûne's Hallowing. The goddess is the focus of worship throughout the full phase, of course, but the major ceremony on this night is a parade of worshipers leaving the House of the Moon at moonrise and moving down to the harbor, where the high priestess wields the Wand of the Four Moons in a ceremony blessing all navigators. This holy relic is said to be the mace wielded by Selûne in her first battle against Shar, and again in a fight with her sister during the Time of Troubles. It miraculously appeared in Waterdeep after the Godswar, and has since been the focus of many divine signs. You can view it in the House of the Moon at other times of the year, but only from a well-guarded distance.
zh_tw: 在烏克塔爾月最圓的任何夜晚，深水城居民慶祝賽爾菲之夜。這位女神當然是整個滿月階段的崇拜焦點，但在這個夜晚的主要儀式是遊行，崇拜者們在月亮升起時離開月之屋前往港口，在那裡大祭司揮舞著四月亮法杖為所有航海者祝福。這個神聖的遺物據說是賽爾菲在對抗沙爾的第一場戰鬥中使用的權杖，以及在動盪時期與她妹妹戰鬥時再次使用。它在神戰之後奇蹟般地出現在深水城，並自此成為許多神蹟的焦點。你可以在一年中其他時間在月之屋從嚴密守衛的距離觀看它，但只能在遠處。

english: If you're lucky, you might see the Wand of the Four Moons weep. Droplets said to be the tears of Selûne manifest on the mace from time to time, and are collected by the priestesses for use in potions that can heal, cure lycanthropy, and be used as holy water.
zh_tw: 如果你幸運的話，你可能會看到四月亮法杖流淚。據說賽爾菲的眼淚偶爾會在權杖上顯現成水滴，被神職人員收集用於製作藥劑，這些藥劑可以治療傷口、治癒狼人病，並作為聖水使用。

english: Uktar 20: Last Sheaf
zh_tw: 烏克塔爾 20: 最後一捆

english: Sometimes called "The Small Feast," this day of residential feasting is held in celebration of the year's bounty. Small gifts (traditionally hand kegs of ale, jars of preserves, or smoked fish and meats) are exchanged among neighbors, and "last letters" are gathered for carriage by ship captains and caravan merchants-so called because they are the last to leave the city before travel becomes difficult. Of Waterdeep's many celebrations, this one is perhaps the most relaxed and relaxing. Plan to spend a little extra on good food and enjoy a meal with those nearest you, be they dearest hearts or the folk across the hall in the inn.
zh_tw: 有時被稱為"小盛宴"，這一天的居民宴會是為了慶祝一年收成的豐富。鄰居們互贈小禮物（傳統上是手工桶裝的啤酒、果醬罐或煙燻魚和肉類），並且"最後一封信"被收集起來由船長和商隊商人透過船隻運送——之所以這樣稱呼是因為它們是在旅行變得困難之前最後一批離開城市的人。在深水城的眾多慶祝活動中，這個節日或許是最輕鬆和令人放鬆的。計劃多花一點錢購買美食，並與最親近的人一起享用一餐，無論是最親愛的人還是旅館走廊對面的人。

english: Nightal 11: Howldown
zh_tw: 奈塔爾 11: 嚎哭日

english: In honor of Malar, members of the City Guard leave the city in groups on this day to hunt down known threats to farmers and travelers, including brigands, {@creature wolf||wolves}, {@creature owlbear||owlbears}, {@creature ogre||ogres}, and trolls that haunt the roads and wilderness. These hunts typically last no longer than a tenday. During the same span of time, the City Watch engages in its own rigorous hunt for malefactors within the city walls. If you've any reason to doubt your standing in the eyes of the law, avoid Waterdeep for at least a tenday after Howldown.
zh_tw: 為了紀念馬拉，城市衛隊的成員們在這一天分組離開城市，追捕已知對農民和旅行者構成威脅的目標，包括強盜、{@creature wolf||狼}、{@creature owlbear||梟熊}、{@creature ogre||食人魔}和出沒在道路與荒野的巨魔。這些狩獵通常不會超過十天。在同一段時間內，城市守衛在城牆內展開對罪犯的嚴密追捕。如果你有任何理由懷疑自己在法律眼中的地位，在豪爾登之後的至少十天內，請避開深水城。

english: With no real hunting to do of their own, the children of Waterdeep spend Howldown engaging in mock hunts of adults dressed up as monsters, and play at the killing of these predators.
zh_tw: 深水城的孩子們沒有真正的狩獵活動，他們在嚎哭日這天參與模擬狩獵，成年人會裝扮成怪物，孩子們則模仿捕殺這些捕食者的遊戲。

english: Nightal 20: Simril
zh_tw: 奈塔爾 20: 辛裡爾

english: When dusk comes on this day, folk go outside to locate particular stars that were lucky for their ancestors, or that were associated with their own births. They then attempt to stay up through the night, celebrating outside with bonfires, song, and warmed drinks. Cloudy nights often draw larger crowds than clear ones, since glimpsing your star through the haze is thought to be a blessing from Tymora. Inside buildings, service folk keep roaring fires and engage in making food to keep celebrants fed throughout the long night and into morning of the next day. If you have no particular star of your own, you'll find many vendors of star maps willing to divine which is yours-based upon your place and date of birth-and to point you in the right direction for a shard or two.
zh_tw: 在這一天的黃昏時分，人們會外出尋找對他們祖先有利的特定星星，或者與他們自己出生相關的星星。然後他們嘗試整夜保持清醒，在外面用篝火、歌聲和熱飲慶祝。多雲的夜晚往往比晴朗的夜晚吸引更多的人群，因為透過薄霧瞥見你的星星被認為是泰摩拉的祝福。在建築物內，服務人員保持熊熊燃燒的火堆，並忙於製作食物，以確保慶祝者在整個漫長的夜晚以及第二天早晨都能得到食物。如果你沒有你自己特別的星星，你會發現許多願意出售星圖的商販，他們可以根據你的出生地和出生日期來占卜哪顆星星是你的——併為你指明正確的方向，換取一兩片碎片。

english: Parting Words
zh_tw: 結束語

english: Well, gentle readers, you've reached the end of my enchiridion. If you've yet to arrive in the city, its splendors await you. If you're reading this within its walls, please set aside this chapbook to experience the city. You might even see an extraordinarily handsome author hard at work reviewing one of Waterdeep's drinking establishments. If you do so, I greet you in advance: "Well met! Autographs cost seven nibs."
zh_tw: 好了，親愛的讀者們，你們已經讀到我手冊的結尾。如果你們還沒有到達這座城市，它的輝煌等著你們。如果你們正在城牆之內閱讀這段文字，請放下這本小冊子去體驗這座城市。你們甚至可能會看到一個非常英俊的作者在辛勤地評審深水城的一家飲酒場所。如果你們這樣做了，我提前向你們致意：'幸會！簽名要七枚小硬幣。'

english: Appendix A: Magic Items
zh_tw: 附錄A：魔法物品

english: This appendix describes new magic items that appear in the adventure, and which are presented here in alphabetical order.
zh_tw: 這個附錄描述了在冒險中出現的新魔法物品，並按字母順序在此列出。

english: Several of these items are found in the possession of specific NPCs:
zh_tw: 這些物品中的幾件出現在特定NPC的持有物品中：

zh_tw: {@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯} 擁有 {@item dragonstaff of Ahghairon|wdh|阿蓋爾倫的龍杖}。

english: {@creature Jalester Silvermane|WDH} has a {@item badge of the Watch|wdh}.
zh_tw: {@creature Jalester Silvermane|WDH|加萊斯特·銀鬃} 擁有一個 {@item badge of the Watch|wdh|警衛徽章}。

zh_tw: {@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH|賈拉索·班瑞} 擁有一個 {@item bracer of flying daggers|wdh|飛刀護腕}，一個 {@item feather of diatryma summoning|wdh|戴翠瑪召喚羽飾}，一個 {@item knave's eye patch|wdh|欺詐者眼罩}，以及一個 {@item ring of truth telling|wdh|真言戒指}。

zh_tw: {@creature Meloon Wardragon|WDH|麥倫·戰龍} 擁有 {@item Azuredge|wdh|蔚藍之鋒}。

english: {@creature Vajra Safahr|WDH} has the {@item Blackstaff|wdh}.
zh_tw: {@creature Vajra Safahr|WDH|瓦婕拉·莎法爾} 擁有 {@item Blackstaff|wdh|黑杖}。

english: The following items appear in various locations in the adventure:
