english: Appendix B: Monsters and NPCs
zh_tw: 附錄B：怪物與非玩家角色

english: This appendix describes various nonplayer characters  and monsters that have roles to play in the adventure.  These creatures are presented in alphabetical order.
zh_tw: 這個附錄描述了在冒險中有角色扮演的各種非玩家角色和怪物。這些生物按字母順序排列。

english: Ahmaergo
zh_tw: 阿莫戈

english: {@creature Ahmaergo|WDH}, {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s majordomo, has a fascination  with minotaurs. Although outwardly civil, the shield  dwarf is as devious and corrupt as the worst devil, yet  also unflinchingly loyal to his beholder master.
zh_tw: {@creature Ahmaergo|WDH|阿莫戈}，{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的管家，對牛頭人很感興趣。儘管表面上彬彬有禮，這位盾矮人和最壞的魔鬼一樣狡猾和腐敗，但同時也對他的眼魔主人忠心耿耿。

english: After the beholder, {@creature Ahmaergo|WDH} is the most influential  member of the Xanathar Guild.
zh_tw: 在姍娜薩公會中，{@creature Ahmaergo|WDH|阿莫戈}的影響力僅次於眼魔本人。

english: Ammalia Cassalanter
zh_tw: 阿瑪利亞·卡薩蘭特

english: The vainglorious {@creature Ammalia Cassalanter|wdh|lady of House Cassalanter} is schooled in the arcane arts. Like her husband Victoro, she worships Asmodeus. When they were young, Ammalia and Victoro signed a contract with the archdevil, trading the souls of their children for power, good health, and long life. The soul of Osvaldo, their eldest son, was taken immediately, and he was transformed into a chain devil. The souls of the younger twins, Terenzio and Elzerina, will be taken when they turn nine years old.
zh_tw: 虛榮的 {@creature Ammalia Cassalanter|wdh|卡薩蘭特家族的女士} 是卡薩蘭特家族的女主人，她精通奧術。和她丈夫維克托羅一樣，她崇拜阿斯蒙蒂斯。年輕時，阿瑪利亞和維克托羅與大魔鬼簽訂了一份契約，用他們孩子們的靈魂換取力量、健康和長壽。他們的長子奧斯瓦多的靈魂被立即取走，他被變成了一個鎖鏈魔鬼。而年幼的雙胞胎，特倫齊奧和艾爾澤琳娜的靈魂將在他們九歲時被取走。

english: A provision in the contract allows the Cassalanters to buy their way out of it, but doing so requires a tremendous amount of coin and a mass sacrifice of unfortunate people. While Victoro hunts for Dagult Neverember's lost cache of gold, Ammalia makes plans to host a {@condition poisoned} feast in celebration of Founders' Day.
zh_tw: 合同中的一項條款允許卡薩蘭特家族用金錢贖回自己，但這樣做需要鉅額的金錢和大量不幸之人的犧牲。維克托羅在尋找達格魯特·無燼遺失的黃金寶藏時，阿瑪利亞計劃在創始者日舉辦一場使參與者被 {@condition poisoned||中毒} 的盛宴慶祝。

english: Ammalia is well mannered, well read, well traveled, and exceptionally shrewd. She is known for driving a hard bargain. Her hobby is lepidopterology, and her estate has the most beautiful butterfly garden. She allows her youngest children to play in the garden under her supervision.
zh_tw: 阿瑪利亞舉止優雅，學識淵博，見多識廣，並且格外精明。她以談判時的強硬立場而聞名。她的愛好是蝴蝶學，她的莊園擁有最美麗的蝴蝶園。她允許她最年幼的孩子們在她的監督下在花園裡玩耍。

english: Apprentice Wizard
zh_tw: 學徒法師

english: {@creature apprentice wizard|vgm|Apprentice wizards} are novice arcane spellcasters who  serve more experienced wizards or attend school. They  perform menial work, such as cooking and cleaning, in  exchange for education in the ways of magic.
zh_tw: {@creature apprentice wizard|vgm|學徒法師}是新手奧術施法者，他們為更有經驗的法師服務或上學。他們做諸如烹飪和清潔等雜務，以換取學習魔法的方式。

english: Aurinax
zh_tw: 奧瑞納克斯

english: {@creature Aurinax|WDH} in Dwarf Form
zh_tw: {@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯} 矮人形態

english: {@creature Aurinax|WDH} is a male {@creature adult gold dragon} who can freely ignore {@i Ahghairon's dragonward} (see "Ahghairon's Dragonward,") and reside in the city. Maaril, the archmage who last wielded the {@item dragonstaff of Ahghairon|WDH}, was {@creature Aurinax|WDH}'s friend, and invited the dragon to stay with him in the city's Dragon Tower. Shortly before the Spellplague, Maaril went mad and left Waterdeep, entrusting the {@item dragonstaff of Ahghairon|WDH} to {@creature Aurinax|WDH}. (See {@adventure appendix A|WDH|11} for information on the dragonstaff.)
zh_tw: {@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯} 是一隻雄性的 {@creature adult gold dragon||成年金龍}，他可以自由地無視 {@i 阿蓋爾倫的龍之結界}（見"阿蓋爾倫的龍咒"），並居住在城市中。瑪里爾，最後一位揮舞著 {@item dragonstaff of Ahghairon|WDH|阿蓋爾倫的龍杖} 的大法師，是 {@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯} 的朋友，並邀請這條龍與他一起居住在城市中的龍之塔。在魔法瘟疫前不久，瑪里爾瘋狂地離開了深水城，並將 {@item dragonstaff of Ahghairon|WDH|阿蓋爾倫的龍杖} 交給了 {@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯}。（見 {@adventure 附錄A|WDH|11} 瞭解有關龍杖的資訊。）

english: When Dagult Neverember became the Open Lord of Waterdeep, he cut a deal with the dragon. Under its terms, {@creature Aurinax|WDH} could keep the {@item dragonstaff of Ahghairon|WDH} in exchange for guarding a vault beneath the city. When Neverember eventually removed the treasure from the vault, {@creature Aurinax|WDH} and the {@i dragonstaff} could return to the Dragon Tower.
zh_tw: 當達格魯特·無燼成為深水城的公開領主時，他與龍達成了一項協議。根據協議的條款，{@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯}可以保留{@item dragonstaff of Ahghairon|WDH|阿蓋爾倫的龍杖}，以換取守衛城市下方的一個金庫。當無燼最終將寶藏從金庫中移走時，{@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯}和{@i 龍杖}可以返回龍塔。

english: As it happens, no one has come to remove the treasure, and the faithful {@creature Aurinax|WDH} has remained in the vault. The vault is warded against scrying magic, and there's no one left in Waterdeep who knows about {@creature Aurinax|WDH} or the whereabouts of the dragonstaff.
zh_tw: 事實上，沒有人來移走寶藏，忠誠的 {@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯} 一直留在金庫中。金庫被防護魔法保護，防止被窺探，深水城中已經沒有人知道關於 {@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯} 或龍杖的下落。

english: Game Statistics
zh_tw: 遊戲資料

english: {@creature Aurinax|WDH} is an {@creature adult gold dragon}. He often assumes the form of an elderly gold dwarf named Barok Clanghammer, who uses the dragonstaff as a walking stick.
zh_tw: {@creature Aurinax|WDH|奧瑞納克斯} 是一隻 {@creature adult gold dragon||成年金龍}。他經常化身為一個名叫巴洛克·鏗鎚的年邁金矮人，他用龍杖作為手杖。

english: Bard
zh_tw: 吟遊詩人

english: {@creature bard|vgm|Bards} are gifted poets, storytellers, and entertainers  who travel far and wide, commonly found performing in  taverns or in the company of jolly bands of adventurers,  rough-and-tumble mercenaries, or wealthy patrons.
zh_tw: {@creature bard|vgm|吟遊詩人} 是有天賦的詩人、講故事者和表演者，他們四處旅行，通常可以在酒館中發現他們在表演，或者與歡樂的冒險者團體、粗獷的僱傭兵，或富有的贊助人相伴。

english: Barnibus Blastwind
zh_tw: 巴尼布斯·陣風

english: {@creature Barnibus Blastwind|wdh|Barnibus} works for the Watchful Order of Magists and  Protectors, investigating crimes that involve the use of  magic. He comes across as prickly and secretive, confiding only in {@creature Saeth Cromley|wdh}, a retired {@creature sergeant|WDH} of the City  Watch who assists in many of his investigations.
zh_tw: {@creature Barnibus Blastwind|wdh|巴尼布斯} 為警戒法師與護衛教團工作，調查涉及使用魔法的犯罪。他給人的印象是易怒和神秘，只向 {@creature Saeth Cromley|wdh|薩斯·克姆利} 吐露心聲，薩斯·克姆利是一位退休的 {@creature sergeant|WDH|軍士}，他是城市守衛的一員，協助他進行許多調查。

english: A lifelong bachelor, Barnibus has a small, tidy estate  in the Sea Ward that he inherited from his grandmother.  When not serving the Watchful Order, he spends his  days reading and writing books in his library.
zh_tw: 巴尼布斯是一個終身未婚者，在海區有一處從祖母那裡繼承來的小巧整潔的房產。當他不服務於警惕秩序時，他會在圖書館裡閱讀和寫作書籍。

english: Barnibus uses spells that help him investigate crimes,  pry secrets from the minds of suspects, and locate  missing persons. He finds violence appalling and would  never use his magic to inflict harm on others-even  those who harm him.
zh_tw: 巴尼布斯使用法術幫助他調查犯罪，從嫌疑人的腦海中探查秘密，並定位失蹤人員。他發現暴力令人震驚，絕不會使用他的魔法對他人造成傷害——即使是那些傷害他的人。

english: The Black Viper
zh_tw: 黑毒蛇

english: The {@creature Black Viper|wdh} was a notorious burglar, pickpocket, mugger, and assassin who died a century ago, after a long and nefarious career. Esvele Rosznar, a brash young noble, has recently adopted the {@creature Black Viper|WDH}'s persona to lead a secret life of crime. Like many other nobles, Esvele gossips about the {@creature Black Viper|WDH}'s exploits to lend credence to the villain's mystique.
zh_tw: {@creature Black Viper|wdh|黑毒蛇} 是一個聲名狼藉的竊賊、扒手、劫匪和刺客，一個世紀前結束了他漫長而邪惡的職業生涯。艾絲薇爾·羅茲納爾，一個魯莽的年輕貴族，最近採納了 {@creature Black Viper|WDH|黑毒蛇} 的身份來領導一個秘密的犯罪生活。像許多其他貴族一樣，艾絲薇爾八卦關於 {@creature Black Viper|WDH|黑毒蛇} 的冒險故事，以此來增加這個惡棍的神秘感。

english: The Rosznar family was convicted of slave trading-highly illegal in Waterdeep-and banished over a hundred years ago, but has since returned. The Rosznars' inability to regain the respect they feel they deserve rankles them. The slave trade has continued in Amn and elsewhere, and it's not like other noble houses don't have skeletons in their closets. But just because of a little family squabble that went public, the Rosznar name has been said with a sneer for a century. As part of the family's constant effort to prove this conception wrong and win others' respect, Esvele has been brought up to be the most proper noble possible, partaking in lessons of etiquette, dance, and poise as befits someone of her station.
zh_tw: 羅茲納爾家族因從事奴隸貿易——在深水城是高度非法的——而在一百多年前被定罪並放逐，但此後已經返回。羅茲納爾家族無法重新獲得他們認為應得的尊重，這讓他們感到痛苦。奴隸貿易在安姆和其他地方仍在繼續，而且並不是其他貴族家庭沒有自己的陰暗面。但僅僅因為一次小小的家族紛爭被公之於眾，羅茲納爾這個名字一個世紀以來一直被人帶著輕蔑提及。作為家族不斷努力證明這種看法錯誤並贏得他人尊重的一部分，艾絲薇爾被培養成了儘可能完美的貴族，參與禮儀、舞蹈和儀態課程，這些正符合她的身份。

english: In her younger days, Esvele openly rebelled, but that behavior led to locked doors at night and house guards watching her every move during the day.
zh_tw: 在年輕時，艾絲薇爾公然反叛，但這種行為導致她在夜間被鎖在房間裡，白天家丁們監視著她的一舉一動。

english: So she taught herself how to pick locks, pluck keys from belts and pouches, clamber up walls, and sneak past guards-playing the perfect daughter by day while cutting loose at night. To hide her identity from those she met, she wore a hood and mask, exchanging her fine clothes for the kind of practical clothing her parents would never let her wear.
zh_tw: 因此，她自學了如何撬鎖、從腰帶和袋子裡偷鑰匙、攀爬牆壁以及悄悄溜過守衛——白天扮演完美的女兒，而晚上則放縱自我。為了向她遇到的人隱藏自己的身份，她戴上了兜帽和麵具，將她的精美衣服換成了她父母永遠不會讓她穿的那種實用服裝。

english: One of the things Esvele has learned is to embrace the legend of the {@creature Black Viper|WDH}. When she throws back her cloak to reveal the costume she has put together, most folk toss their purses and flee. If that doesn't work, she usually needs only to draw her dagger. Of course, some of the nobles she targets are made of sterner stuff, so Esvele has learned how to fight as well. She knows she's playing a dangerous game, but is satisfied that at least one member of the Rosznar family is earning the respect of Waterdeep's nobility.
zh_tw: 艾絲薇爾學到的其中一件事是擁抱 {@creature Black Viper|WDH|黑毒蛇} 的傳說。當她掀開斗篷露出自己拼湊的服裝時，大多數人會扔下錢包逃跑。如果那樣不起作用，她通常只需要抽出她的匕首。當然，她針對的一些貴族是由更堅硬的材料製成的，所以艾絲薇爾也學會了如何戰鬥。她知道自己在玩一個危險的遊戲，但至少有一個羅茲納爾家族的成員正在贏得深水城貴族的尊重，這讓她感到滿意。

english: City Guard
zh_tw: 城防軍

english: City Guard Private, Captain, and Griffon Cavalry Rider
zh_tw: 城防軍列兵、上尉和獅鷲騎兵騎手

english: The City Guard is Waterdeep's army, charged with protecting the city's walls and {@spell gate||gates}, government buildings, harbor, and officials. The City Guard also patrols the roads to Amphail, Goldenfields, and Daggerford.
zh_tw: 城防軍是深水城的軍隊，負責保護城市的城牆和{@spell gate||異界之門}、政府建築、港口和官員。城防軍還巡邏通往安菲爾、金色原野和匕首灘的道路。

english: Ranks in the City Guard
zh_tw: 城防軍的等級

english: Members of the City Guard have ranks. From lowest to highest, they are:
zh_tw: 城防軍成員有等級之分。從低到高，它們是：

english: Private
zh_tw: 列兵

english: {@creature Sergeant|WDH} (armar)
zh_tw: {@creature Sergeant|WDH|軍士}（軍士）

english: Lieutenant (civilar)
zh_tw: 中尉（巡城官）

english: Captain (senior civilar)
zh_tw: 隊長（高階民政官）

english: Multiple command positions, some perennial (Seneschal of Castle Waterdeep, Defender of the Harbor, Master of the North Towers, Master of the South Towers, Master Armorer), others bestowed as needed in wartime (the Lords' Hand and the Lords' Champion)
zh_tw: 多個指揮職位，有些是長期性的（深水堡的管家、港口的保衛者、北塔大師、南塔大師、武器庫總管），其他的則根據戰時需要授予（領主之手和領主的冠軍）

english: Warden of Waterdeep
zh_tw: 深水城的守衛

english: The current Warden of Waterdeep is Elminster, who answers to the Open Lord, {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH}.
zh_tw: 當前深水城的守衛官是伊爾明斯特，他向公開領主，{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}彙報。

english: The {@creature Griffon Cavalry Rider|wdh|Griffon Cavalry} is a special branch of the City Guard whose members are veteran soldiers trained to fly {@creature griffon} mounts.
zh_tw: {@creature Griffon Cavalry Rider|wdh|獅鷲騎兵}是城防軍的一個特殊分支，其成員是訓練有素、能夠騎乘{@creature griffon||獅鷲}的老兵。

english: Game Statistics
zh_tw: 遊戲資料

english: City Guard privates and sergeants are {@creature guard||guards}. Members of lieutenant rank and higher are typically {@creature veteran||veterans}.
zh_tw: 城防軍的列兵和中士是{@creature guard||警衛}。少尉級別及以上的成員通常是{@creature veteran||老兵}。

english: City Watch
zh_tw: 城市守衛

english: Members of the City Watch
zh_tw: 城市守衛的成員

english: The City Watch is Waterdeep's police force, charged with keeping the peace and apprehending criminals. City Watch patrols are usually four to twelve persons strong. A patrol expecting trouble might also have reinforcement in the form of a priest (on loan from one of the local temples) or a mage (from the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors).
zh_tw: 城市守衛是深水城的警察力量，負責維護和平和逮捕罪犯。城市守衛的巡邏隊通常由四到十二人組成。預計會遇到麻煩的巡邏隊可能還會有來自當地某個寺廟的牧師（借用）或來自警戒法師與護衛教團的法師作為增援。

english: Ranks in the City Watch
zh_tw: 城市守衛的等級

english: Members of the City Watch are called officers. Their ranks are, from lowest to highest:
zh_tw: 城市守衛的成員被稱為官員。他們的等級從低到高是：

english: Constable
zh_tw: 警長

english: {@creature Sergeant|WDH} (armar)
zh_tw: {@creature Sergeant|WDH|軍士}（軍士）

english: Lieutenant (civilar)
zh_tw: 中尉（巡城官）

english: Captain (senior civilar; leader of a watch station)
zh_tw: 上尉（高階民政官；守衛站的領導者）

english: Major (ward civilar; one per city ward)
zh_tw: 少校（區民事警察；每個城市區一個）

english: Commander of the Watch
zh_tw: 守望指揮官

english: The Watch also includes a Senior Armsmaster, who reports to the Commander of the Watch and is in charge of supplies. The Commander of the Watch reports to the Open Lord, {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH}.
zh_tw: 警衛隊還包括一位高階武器大師，他向警衛隊指揮官彙報並負責供應物資。警衛隊指揮官向公開領主{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}彙報。

english: Game Statistics
zh_tw: 遊戲資料

english: Most City Watch members are {@creature veteran||veterans}. Some of the highest-ranked members are {@creature knight||knights}. All City Watch members wear helmets and carry {@item club|phb|clubs} while on duty.
zh_tw: 大多數城市守衛成員是{@creature veteran||老兵}。一些級別最高的成員是{@creature knight||騎士}。所有城市守衛成員在值班時都戴頭盔並攜帶{@item club|phb|短棒}。

english: The Doom Raiders
zh_tw: 末日劫掠者

english: The Doom Raiders (Left to Right): {@creature Davil Starsong|WDH}, {@creature Istrid Horn|WDH}, {@creature Tashlyn Yafeera|WDH}, {@creature Skeemo Weirdbottle|WDH} and {@creature Ziraj the Hunter|WDH}
zh_tw: 末日劫掠者（從左至右）：{@creature Davil Starsong|WDH|達維爾·星歌}, {@creature Istrid Horn|WDH|伊思崔德·霍恩}, {@creature Tashlyn Yafeera|WDH|塔什琳·雅菲拉}, {@creature Skeemo Weirdbottle|WDH|斯齊莫·奇瓶} 和 {@creature Ziraj the Hunter|WDH|獵人茲拉吉}

english: The Doom Raiders were five unscrupulous adventurers who liked to plunder lich lairs (called "dooms" by some). They gave up adventuring to join the Black Network and came to Waterdeep three years ago with plans to establish a Zhentarim foothold in the city. In that time, they have forged alliances with various nobles and guilds and run afoul of others, all the while fending off Harper spies.
zh_tw: 末日劫掠者是五個不擇手段的冒險者，他們喜歡掠奪巫妖的巢穴（有些人稱之為"末日"）。他們放棄了冒險，加入了黑網，並在三年前來到深水城，計劃在這座城市建立一個散塔林會的據點。在那段時間裡，他們與各種貴族和行會結成了聯盟，同時得罪了其他人，並且一直在抵禦豎琴手聯盟間諜。

english: Davil Starsong
zh_tw: 達維爾·星歌

english: Within the Waterdeep division of the Black Network, {@creature Davil Starsong|wdh|Davil} is accorded the title of Master of Opportunities and Negotiations because he's good at sniffing out lucrative business deals, and he makes friends easily.
zh_tw: 在深水城黑網分部中，{@creature Davil Starsong|wdh|達維爾}被授予機會與談判大師的頭銜，因為他擅長髮現有利可圖的商業交易，並且他很容易結交朋友。

english: Like many sun elves, Davil has an affinity for magic and is gifted with the kind of patience that comes with a long life span. Unlike most, he's not the least bit pretentious or aloof. He keeps a room at the Yawning Portal and does all his business in the establishment's taproom. He negotiates deals with grace and aplomb, even while drunk, and uses an elven lute as a spellcasting focus.
zh_tw: 像許多太陽精靈一樣，達維爾對魔法有著天然的親和力，並且他擁有與長壽相伴隨的耐心。與大多數精靈不同，他一點也不矯揉造作或高傲。他在呵欠之門（呵欠之門）保留了一個房間，並在該機構的酒吧裡處理所有的業務。即使在醉酒狀態下，他也能優雅而從容地進行交易談判，並使用精靈魯特琴作為施法焦點。

english: Davil can put the characters in contact with other leaders of the Black Network's Waterdeep division, namely {@creature Istrid Horn|WDH} (if they need a loan), {@creature Skeemo Weirdbottle|WDH} (if they need magic), {@creature Tashlyn Yafeera|WDH} (if they need weapons or mercenaries), and {@creature Ziraj the Hunter|WDH} (if they need a highly skilled assassin).
zh_tw: 達維爾能夠讓角色與黑網深水城分部的其他領導者聯絡，即{@creature Istrid Horn|WDH|伊思崔德·霍恩}（如果他們需要貸款），{@creature Skeemo Weirdbottle|WDH|斯齊莫·奇瓶}（如果他們需要魔法），{@creature Tashlyn Yafeera|WDH|塔什琳·雅菲拉}（如果他們需要武器或僱傭兵），以及{@creature Ziraj the Hunter|WDH|獵人茲拉吉}（如果他們需要一個高度技能的刺客）。

english: Istrid Horn
zh_tw: 伊思崔德·霍恩

english: {@creature Istrid Horn|wdh|Istrid} is regarded as the Black Network's Master of Trade and Coin in Waterdeep. The shield dwarf operates an illegal lending operation out of a heavily guarded warehouse in the Dock Ward, offering loans to those in need of coin. Her interest rates are comparable to those of her competitors (including noble families of bankers such as the Cassalanters and the Irlingstars), but the penalties for not paying back Istrid's loans are severe.
zh_tw: {@creature Istrid Horn|wdh|伊思崔德}被認為是深水城黑網的貿易與貨幣大師。這位盾矮人在一個位於碼頭區、重兵把守的倉庫中運營著一個非法放貸業務，向需要金錢的人提供貸款。她的利率與她的競爭對手相當（包括像卡薩蘭特家族和伊林斯塔家族這樣的貴族銀行家族），但不償還伊思崔德的貸款的懲罰是嚴厲的。

english: Istrid worships Vergadain, the dwarven god of wealth and luck. She likes having others indebted to her, and she employs thugs and enforcers to collect on her loans. If those resources prove inadequate, Istrid can call on her old adventuring companions for assistance.
zh_tw: 伊思崔德崇拜維加丹恩，矮人的財富與幸運之神。她喜歡讓別人欠她的債，並且僱傭惡棍和執行者來收取貸款。如果這些資源證明不夠，伊思崔德可以請求她以前的冒險夥伴幫忙。

english: Skeemo Weirdbottle
zh_tw: 斯齊莫·奇瓶

english: {@creature Skeemo Weirdbottle|wdh|Skeemo} became the Master of Magic for the Black Network in Waterdeep, setting up a cover in the Trades Ward in the form of a cramped little shop called Weirdbottle's Concoctions. Most of his potions and elixirs are nonmagical, but he crafts magical ones for his Zhent friends.
zh_tw: {@creature Skeemo Weirdbottle|wdh|斯齊莫}成為了深水城黑網的魔法大師，在商業區設立了一個掩護，形式是一家狹小的小店，名為奇瓶藥劑店。他的大部分藥水和藥劑都是非魔法的，但他為他在散塔林會成員的朋友製作魔法藥水。

english: Skeemo can add "sellout" to his credentials, his services having been bought by House Gralhund and the Black Network operatives loyal to {@creature Manshoon|WDH}. The rock gnome uses {@item paper bird|wdh|paper birds} (see {@adventure appendix A|WDH|11}) to send messages both to his new friends and his old ones.
zh_tw: 斯齊莫可以將"叛徒"加到他的資歷中，他的服務已經被格勞洪德家族和忠於{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的黑網特工買通。這位岩石侏儒使用{@item paper bird|wdh|紙鳶}（見{@adventure 附錄A|WDH|11}）向他的新舊朋友傳送訊息。

english: Tashlyn Yafeera
zh_tw: 塔什琳·雅菲拉

english: {@creature Tashlyn Yafeera|wdh|Tashlyn} is Master of Arms and Mercenaries for the Waterdeep Zhentarim. In this role, she provides armor, weapons, and training to sellswords on the Black Network's payroll.
zh_tw: {@creature Tashlyn Yafeera|wdh|塔什琳}是深水城散塔林會的武器與僱傭兵大師。在這個職位上，她為黑網工資單上的僱傭兵提供盔甲、武器和訓練。

english: Tashlyn has established a useful cover by serving as a bodyguard to Vorondar Levelstone, a dwarf magister stationed at the South Gate. She likes the dwarf and has earned his confidence, allowing her to reach the rank of captain in the City Guard. In that position, she watches over traffic that passes through the gate-and ensures that her associates in the Black Network can come and go freely.
zh_tw: 塔什琳透過擔任位於南門的矮人法師沃隆達爾·平石的保鏢，建立了一個有用的掩護。她喜歡這位矮人，並贏得了他的信任，使她得以在城防軍隊中晉升為隊長。在這個職位上，她監視著透過大門的交通——並確保她在黑網的同夥可以自由進出。

english: Born to a well-off family in Calimshan, Tashlyn has an unfettered sense of superiority. Quick to anger, she hates to back down from a fight. She respects anyone who can best her in melee combat.
zh_tw: 塔什琳出生在卡利姆杉的一個富裕家庭，她有一種不受限制的優越感。她容易發怒，不願意從戰鬥中退縮。她尊重任何能在近戰中勝過她的人。

english: Ziraj the Hunter
zh_tw: 獵人茲拉吉

english: {@creature Ziraj the Hunter|wdh|Ziraj} is a half-orc hunter who wields an oversized bow that shoots correspondingly large arrows. He is the Master of Assassination for the Black Network. If Ziraj sets out to kill someone, it's because one of his friends (Davil, Istrid, Skeemo, or Tashlyn) asked him to. The characters might become Ziraj's prey, or Ziraj might come to their aid to eliminate a common enemy. He's the strong, silent type.
zh_tw: {@creature Ziraj the Hunter|wdh|茲拉吉}是一位半獸人獵人，他使用的是一把超大號的弓，射出相應巨大的箭矢。他是黑網的暗殺大師。如果茲拉吉決定去殺某人，那是因為他的朋友（達維爾、伊思崔德、斯齊莫或塔什琳）要求他這麼做。角色們可能會成為茲拉吉的獵物，或者茲拉吉可能會來幫助他們，以消除共同的敵人。他是強壯且沉默寡言的型別。

english: The City Watch has received reports of a figure who haunts the rooftops of Waterdeep-a hulking shadow that glares from its perch, rains down death in the form of long black arrows, and slinks off without so much as a whisper. Where he comes from-if he even has a home-remains a mystery, as does the question of where he might show up next.
zh_tw: 城市守衛收到了關於一個在深水城屋頂上游蕩的身影的報告——一個巨大的陰影從其棲息地怒視，以長黑箭的形式降下死亡，並在連一絲耳語都沒有的情況下悄悄離開。他來自哪裡——如果他甚至有家——仍是一個謎，就像他下次可能出現的地方一樣。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Ziraj wears {@item +2 leather armor} and carries an {@item oversized longbow|wdh}. This unique weapon can be used only by a Medium or larger creature that has a Strength of 18 or higher. The bow shoots oversized arrows that deal piercing damage equal to {@dice 2d6} + the wielder's Strength modifier. Its range is the same as an ordinary {@item longbow|phb}.
zh_tw: 茲拉吉穿著 {@item +2 leather armor||+2 皮甲} 並攜帶一把 {@item oversized longbow|wdh|超大長弓}。這件獨特的武器只能由力量達到 18 或更高的中等體型或更大的生物使用。這張弓射出的是超大型箭矢，造成穿刺傷害，等於 {@dice 2d6} 加上使用者的力量調整值。它的射程與普通的 {@item longbow|phb|長弓} 相同。

english: Drow Gunslinger
zh_tw: 卓爾火槍手

english: Firearms aren't widely available in the North, but some members of Bregan D'aerthe are equipped with Lantanese pistols, bullets, and packets of smokepowder. These {@creature drow gunslinger|wdh|drow gunslingers} are expert pistoleers, as skilled with their guns as the best archers are with their bows.
zh_tw: 槍械在北方並不普遍，但布雷甘·達耶的一些成員配備了蘭檀語手槍、子彈和煙霧火藥包。這些{@creature drow gunslinger|wdh|卓爾火槍手}是手槍專家，他們使用槍械的技巧就像最好的弓箭手使用弓箭一樣熟練。

english: Fel'rekt Lafeen
zh_tw: 菲爾萊科特·拉菲恩

english: Fel'rekt is a male drow who was born female. Unhappy with the treatment of males in his society, he petitioned to join Bregan D'aerthe. Jarlaxle took a shine to Fel'rekt almost immediately, and the young drow has since become one of Jarlaxle's most loyal lieutenants. Eager to prove himself, Fel'rekt is quick to volunteer for tasks and hurls himself into combat with verve.
zh_tw: 菲爾萊科特是一位出生時為女性的男性黑暗精靈。由於不滿社會中對男性的待遇，他請求加入布雷甘·達耶。賈拉索幾乎立刻就對菲爾萊科特產生了好感，這位年輕的黑暗精靈從此成為了賈拉索最忠誠的副手之一。渴望證明自己的菲爾萊科特總是急於自願接受任務，並以極大的熱情投身於戰鬥之中。

english: Fel'rekt and {@creature Krebbyg Masq'il'yr|WDH} are close friends and work as a team, trading banter and jokes at their enemies' expense. Fel'rekt lacks the cruelty common to most drow, and he won't kill an adversary unless he is left with no other choice.
zh_tw: 菲爾萊科特和{@creature Krebbyg Masq'il'yr|WDH|克雷比格·馬斯奇爾}是親密的朋友，他們作為團隊一起工作，以敵人為樂互相開玩笑。菲爾萊科特沒有大多數黑暗精靈常見的殘忍，除非別無選擇，否則他不會殺死對手。

english: Game Statistics
zh_tw: 遊戲資料

english: {@creature Fel'rekt Lafeen|WDH} is a neutral good {@creature drow gunslinger|WDH}. In addition to his weapons, he carries four packets of {@item smokepowder|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix A|WDH|11}) and a pouch containing twenty pistol bullets.
zh_tw: {@creature Fel'rekt Lafeen|WDH|菲爾萊科特·拉菲恩}是一位中立善良的{@creature drow gunslinger|WDH|卓爾火槍手}。除了他的武器外，他還攜帶了四包{@item smokepowder|WDH|發煙粉}（見{@adventure 附錄A|WDH|11}）和一個裝有二十發手槍子彈的小袋。

english: Krebbyg Masq'il'yr
zh_tw: 克雷比格·馬斯奇爾

english: Krebbyg's house was destroyed long ago, leaving him with no connection to his old life in the Underdark. He is young and rash.
zh_tw: 克雷比格的房子很久以前就被摧毀了，使他與他在幽暗地域的舊生活失去了聯絡。他年輕而魯莽。

english: Krebbyg works closely with {@creature Fel'rekt Lafeen|WDH}, and the two collaborate well despite their disparate alignments. Krebbyg prefers to follow Fel'rekt's lead, letting him do most of the thinking and talking.
zh_tw: 克雷比格與{@creature Fel'rekt Lafeen|WDH|菲爾萊科特·拉菲恩}緊密合作，儘管他們的立場不同，但兩人合作得很好。克雷比格更願意跟隨菲爾萊科特的領導，讓他做大部分的思考和交談。

english: Game Statistics
zh_tw: 遊戲資料

english: {@creature Krebbyg Masq'il'yr|WDH} is a chaotic neutral {@creature drow gunslinger|WDH}. In addition to his weapons, he carries four packets of {@item smokepowder|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix A|WDH|11}) and a pouch containing twenty pistol bullets.
zh_tw: {@creature Krebbyg Masq'il'yr|WDH|克雷比格·馬斯奇爾}是一位混亂中立的{@creature drow gunslinger|WDH|卓爾火槍手}。除了他的武器外，他還攜帶了四包{@item smokepowder|WDH|發煙粉}（見{@adventure 附錄A|WDH|11}）和一個裝有二十發手槍子彈的小袋。

english: Soluun Xibrindas
zh_tw: 索倫·希布林達斯

english: Soluun is a sadistic, fanatical bully who is fiercely loyal to Bregan D'aerthe, and to Jarlaxle in particular. His younger brother, Nar'l, has infiltrated the Xanathar Guild. Soluun considers Nar'l a weakling who turned to arcane magic by way of compensation, and he has never had much faith in his brother or his abilities.
zh_tw: 索倫是一個殘忍、狂熱的惡霸，他對布雷甘·達耶特別忠誠，尤其是對賈拉索。他的弟弟納爾已經滲透進姍娜薩公會。索倫認為納爾是一個弱者，他透過學習奧術魔法來補償自己的不足，他對弟弟或他的能力從未有過太多信心。

english: Soluun has a burning hatred of surface elves and half-elves, having been taught from a young age to kill them as opportunity permits. When not engaged in a Bregan D'aerthe operation, Soluun spends his nights haunting the darkened streets and alleys of Waterdeep, looking for solitary elves or half-elves to pick off. He conceals his nighttime escapades as well as he can, but Jarlaxle, Fel'rekt, and Krebbyg know what he's up to.
zh_tw: 索倫對地表精靈和半精靈懷有強烈的仇恨，從小就被教導有機會就要殺掉他們。當不參與布雷甘·達耶行動時，索倫會在夜晚出沒於深水城陰暗的街道和小巷，尋找落單的精靈或半精靈下手。他儘量隱藏自己的夜間行動，但賈拉索、菲爾萊科特和克雷比格都知道他在做什麼。

english: Game Statistics
zh_tw: 遊戲資料

english: {@creature Soluun Xibrindas|wdh} is a neutral evil {@creature drow gunslinger|WDH}, with these changes:
zh_tw: {@creature Soluun Xibrindas|wdh|索倫·希布林達斯}是一位中立邪惡的{@creature drow gunslinger|WDH|卓爾火槍手}，有以下變化：

english: Soluun wields a scimitar instead of a shortsword (it deals slashing damage instead of piercing damage).
zh_tw: 索倫使用的是彎刀而不是短劍（它造成揮砍傷害而不是穿刺傷害）。

english: He wears a pair of drow-made {@item boots of elvenkind}. In addition to his weapons, he carries four packets of {@item smokepowder|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix A|WDH|11}) and a pouch containing twenty pistol bullets.
zh_tw: 他穿著一雙由黑暗精靈製造的{@item boots of elvenkind||精靈之靴}。除了他的武器外，他還攜帶了四包{@item smokepowder|WDH|發煙粉}（見{@adventure 附錄A|WDH|11}）和一個裝有二十發手槍子彈的小袋。

english: Durnan
zh_tw: 杜爾南

english: {@creature Durnan|wdh} is the owner and proprietor of the Yawning Portal. Although he looks like a middle-aged man whose best days are behind him, {@creature Durnan|WDH} has a sharp mind and can still swing a sword when he must. He doesn't like talking about his past, and he won't reveal anything about his time as an adventurer.
zh_tw: {@creature Durnan|wdh|杜爾南}是呵欠之門（呵欠之門）的老闆和所有者。儘管他看起來像是一個最好的日子已經過去的中年人，但{@creature Durnan|WDH|杜爾南}擁有敏銳的頭腦，並且在必要時仍然能夠揮舞劍。他不喜歡談論自己的過去，也不會透露任何關於他作為冒險家的時間。

english: If {@creature Durnan|WDH} has any living family members, he doesn't speak of them. He rarely says two words when one will do. He has a dark sense of humor and spares no pity on those who take the risk of entering Undermountain.
zh_tw: 如果{@creature Durnan|WDH|杜爾南}有任何在世的家庭成員，他從不提及他們。他很少說兩句話，當一句話就足夠時。他有一種黑暗的幽默感，對於那些冒險進入下層山脈（地脈迷城）的人，他毫不留情。

english: He keeps Grimvault, his magic greatsword, within reach under the bar, and can chop tables in half with it if he so desires. He also can pull out a double crossbow (a heavy crossbow with reduced range that fires two bolts at the same target). Still, if he gets involved in a brawl, he prefers fighting with fists or a well-flung tankard.
zh_tw: 他把格里姆瓦爾特（冷酷之竿），他的魔法巨劍，放在吧檯下方隨手可得的地方，如果他願意，可以用它將桌子一劈為二。他還可以隨時拿出一把雙管弩（一種射程較短但能同時向同一目標發射兩支弩箭的重型弩）。不過，如果他捲入一場打鬥，他更喜歡用拳頭或者扔出一個扔得很準的大酒杯來戰鬥。

english: {@creature Durnan|WDH} doesn't often venture far from the Yawning Portal, using his employees to run errands for him as needed. If he's feeling charitable, he might gently discourage likable "nobodies" from venturing into Undermountain, if he thinks they wouldn't survive. He can also direct adventurers toward tavern regulars who might be able to help them or offer useful information.
zh_tw: {@creature Durnan|WDH|杜爾南}很少冒險遠離呵欠之門（呵欠之門），他利用他的員工根據需要為他跑腿。如果他心情好，他可能會委婉地勸阻那些他認為無法在下層山脈（地脈迷城）中生存下來的可愛"無名之輩"。他還可以將冒險家引向酒館常客，這些人可能能夠幫助他們或提供有用的資訊。

english: Floon Blagmaar
zh_tw: 福盧恩·布拉格瑪

english: {@creature Floon Blagmaar|WDH|Floon}, a native Waterdavian in his early thirties, is a handsome fellow but not very bright. He used to work as an escort in festhalls but is currently unemployed. Several months ago, he came upon a married noble engaging in some indiscreet behavior, and now lives off the generous bribe he is being paid to keep silent.
zh_tw: {@creature Floon Blagmaar|WDH|福盧恩}，一位三十出頭的本地深水城居民，是個英俊的傢伙，但不太聰明。他過去在節慶大廳擔任伴遊，但目前失業。幾個月前，他撞見一位已婚貴族正在進行一些不檢點的行為，現在靠對方為讓他保持沉默而支付的豐厚賄賂生活。

english: With friends all over the city, Floon spends most of his time drinking and carousing. He gets by on his looks and doesn't know what to do with his life, and has shown little interest in working for a living.
zh_tw: 福盧恩在全城都有朋友，他大部分時間都在喝酒和狂歡中度過。他依靠自己的外表度日，對生活沒有明確的目標，並且對靠工作謀生表現出很少的興趣。

english: Game Statistics
zh_tw: 遊戲資料

english: Floon is a chaotic good Illuskan human {@creature commoner} with an Intelligence of 7 (-2) and a Charisma of 13 (+1). He speaks Common.
zh_tw: 福盧恩是一位混亂善良的伊路斯坎人人類{@creature commoner||平民}，智力為7（-2），魅力為13（+1）。他說通用語。

english: Gazer
zh_tw: 凝視者眼魔

english: A {@creature gazer|vgm} is a tiny manifestation of a beholder's dreams. It resembles the beholder who dreamed it into existence, but its body is only 8 inches wide, and it has only four eyestalks. The beholder can see through the gazer's eyes and uses it to spy on enemies as well as its other minions.
zh_tw: {@creature gazer|vgm|凝視者眼魔}是眼魔夢境的微小體現。它與創造它的眼魔相似，但其身體僅有8吋寬，並且只有四隻眼梗。眼魔可以透過凝視者眼魔的眼睛看到，並使用它來監視敵人以及它的其他手下。

english: A gazer can't speak any languages but can approximate mimicking words and sentences in a high-pitched, mocking manner. A lone gazer avoids picking fights with creatures that are Medium or larger, but a pack of them might take on larger prey.
zh_tw: A 凝視者眼魔不能說話，但可以以一種尖銳、諷刺的方式模仿單詞和句子。一隻孤獨的凝視者眼魔會避免與中型或更大的生物戰鬥，但一群凝視者眼魔可能會攻擊更大的獵物。

english: Gazer
zh_tw: 凝視者眼魔

english: A gazer might follow humanoids in its territory, noisily mimicking their speech and generally being a nuisance, until they leave the area, but it flees if confronted by something it can't kill.
zh_tw: 一隻凝視者眼魔可能會在其領地內跟隨類人生物，大聲模仿他們的語言，通常很煩人，直到他們離開該區域，但如果遇到它無法殺死的東西，它會逃跑。

english: Hlam
zh_tw: 胡拉姆

english: This venerable human monk lives in a cave halfway up the side of Mount Waterdeep. {@creature Hlam|wdh} is the grand master of the Order of the Even-Handed, a small monastic group devoted to Tyr. Would-be students periodically visit him to learn the Way of the Sacred Fists, which combines cleric magic and monk training. They usually return to the city confused, bruised, and not inclined to visit again.
zh_tw: 這位受人尊敬的人類武僧居住在深水城山半山腰的一個洞穴中。{@creature Hlam|wdh|胡拉姆}是公正之手秩序的宗師，這是一個致力於提爾的小僧侶團體。有志之士定期拜訪他，學習神聖之拳之道，它結合了牧師魔法和武僧訓練。他們通常帶著困惑、瘀傷返回城市，並且不再願意再次拜訪。

english: In times of great peril, {@creature Hlam|WDH} can be called on to help. Sometimes he offers pearls of wisdom, and sometimes he descends from his cave to set things right with fisticuffs. He can show up at any point in the story as a helpful figure, and the characters can visit him in his cave if they need guidance or training. The Order of the Gauntlet considers him a staunch ally.
zh_tw: 在巨大危險的時刻，可以召喚{@creature Hlam|WDH|胡拉姆}來幫助。有時他會提供感知的珍珠，有時他會從洞穴中下來，用拳頭解決問題。他可以在故事的任何時刻作為有益的人物出現，如果角色需要指導或訓練，他們可以在他的洞穴中拜訪他。鐵手套教團認為他是一個堅定的盟友。

english: {@creature Hlam|WDH} is immune to disease and doesn't require food or water. Although he ages, he suffers none of the frailty of old age.
zh_tw: {@creature Hlam|WDH|胡拉姆} 對疾病免疫，不需要食物或水。儘管他會老化，但他不會遭受老年的虛弱。

english: Hrabbaz
zh_tw: 哈巴茲

english: {@creature Hrabbaz|wdh} is a muscle-bound half-orc with a cleft palate who serves the lord and lady of House Gralhund as a bodyguard. He is well mannered and dresses impeccably-a disarming appearance that belies a murderous heart. Though he has great respect for Lady {@creature Yalah Gralhund|wdh}, he is less fond of her moody husband, and wouldn't be sad to see Orond knocked down a peg or two.
zh_tw: {@creature Hrabbaz|wdh|哈巴茲}是一位肌肉發達的半獸人，有顎裂，擔任格勞洪德家族領主和夫人的保鏢。他舉止優雅，衣著無可挑剔——這種迷人的外表掩蓋了他殘忍的內心。儘管他對{@creature Yalah Gralhund|wdh|雅拉·格勞洪德}夫人非常尊敬，但他對她情緒化的丈夫不太喜歡，如果看到奧隆德被打壓一兩次，他也不會感到難過。

english: {@creature Hrabbaz|WDH}
zh_tw: {@creature Hrabbaz|WDH|哈巴茲}

english: Jalester Silvermane
zh_tw: 加萊斯特·銀鬃

english: An earnest man in his mid-twenties, {@creature Jalester Silvermane|wdh|Jalester} hails from the distant land of Cormyr, where he earned his spurs working for a mercenary company called the Steel Shadows. A few years ago, Jalester left the Dales and traveled to Waterdeep with several other members of the company, one of whom-Faerrel Dunblade-would become his best friend and lover.
zh_tw: {@creature Jalester Silvermane|wdh|加萊斯特}是一位二十多歲中期的認真男子，他來自遙遠的科米爾（科米爾）土地，在那裡他為一家名為鋼鐵陰影（鋼影幫）的僱傭兵公司工作，贏得了他的馬刺。幾年前，加萊斯特離開了谷地（谷地），與公司的其他幾名成員一起前往深水城，其中之一——費瑞爾·鄧布萊德——將成為他最好的朋友和情人。

english: The wizard Elminster befriended the two young men and brought them to the attention of {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH}, who put them to work as deputies and spies. Jalester and Faerrel helped the Open Lord expose a plot to overthrow the government, but Faerrel was killed while helping bring the perpetrators to justice. Jalester remained in Waterdeep afterward, becoming one of Laeral's field operatives in the service of Waterdeep and the Lords' Alliance. He has been romantically unattached ever since Faerrel's death but longs again for love.
zh_tw: 法師伊爾明斯特與這兩位年輕人交了朋友，並將他們介紹給了{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}，後者讓他們擔任副手和間諜。加萊斯特和費瑞爾幫助公開領主揭露了一起推翻政府的陰謀，但在幫助將肇事者繩之以法時，費瑞爾被殺。此後，加萊斯特留在了深水城，成為了萊拉在深水城和領主聯盟服務中的一名外勤特工。自從費瑞爾去世以來，他一直沒有戀愛關係，但他渴望再次擁有愛情。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: Jalester carries a {@item badge of the Watch|WDH} (+2 bonus to AC if not using a shield). If the badge is lost or taken from him, it returns to {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH}.
zh_tw: 加萊斯特攜帶一枚{@item badge of the Watch|WDH|警衛徽章}（如果不使用盾牌，可獲得+2的護甲等級加成）。如果徽章丟失或被奪走，它將返回到{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}那裡。

english: Jarlaxle Baenre
zh_tw: 賈拉索·班瑞

english: {@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|wdh|Jarlaxle} is a flamboyant, swashbuckling drow iconoclast. He leads a renegade drow faction called Bregan D'aerthe, made up of disenfranchised male drow, most of them culled from destroyed or disgraced houses. Gifted with a sharp mind, a sense of humor, puissant skill with a blade, and a wealth of useful magic items, Jarlaxle infiltrated the city of Luskan, brought a kind of order to its lawlessness, and declared himself its secret lord.
zh_tw: {@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|wdh|賈拉索}是一個華麗、大膽的黑暗精靈異教徒。他領導著一個名為布雷甘·達耶的叛逆黑暗精靈派系，由被剝奪權利的男性黑暗精靈組成，他們大多數來自被摧毀或蒙羞的家族。賈拉索擁有敏銳的頭腦、幽默感、強大的劍術技能和大量有用的魔法物品，他潛入了路斯坎城，給這座無法無天的城市帶來了某種秩序，並自稱為它的秘密領主。

english: Jarlaxle likes to weave a tangled web of schemes that leave his enemies baffled-the latest of which is a plan to legitimize Luskan by making it a member of the Lords' Alliance. The city's unsavory reputation has thwarted all previous efforts, and the current leaders of the Lords' Alliance have voiced their opposition to Luskan's admittance. A few have flatly declared that the city will never be welcome in the alliance. Nonetheless, Jarlaxle aims to persuade {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH}, the Open Lord of Waterdeep, to champion Luskan's cause-even if that means losing other alliance members in the process. Tying Luskan's fortunes to those of Waterdeep would increase Jarlaxle's political and economic power on the Sword Coast.
zh_tw: 賈拉索喜歡編織一個錯綜複雜的陰謀網，讓他的敵人感到困惑——最新的計劃是讓路斯坎成為領主聯盟的成員，以此來合法化它。這座城市的不良聲譽阻礙了之前的所有努力，領主聯盟的現任領導人已經表達了他們對路斯坎加入的反對。一些人明確宣佈這座城市永遠不會在聯盟中受歡迎。儘管如此，賈拉索仍打算說服深水城的公開領主{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}，支援路斯坎的事業——即使這意味著在這個過程中失去其他聯盟成員。將路斯坎的命運與深水城聯絡起來將增加賈拉索在劍海岸的政治和經濟實力。

english: Jarlaxle has come to Waterdeep in the guise of an Illuskan human named Zardoz Zord. "Captain Zord" is the master of the Sea Maidens Faire, a carnival that travels up and down the Sword Coast in three ships: the {@i Eyecatcher}, the {@i Heartbreaker}, and the {@i Hellraiser} (all words that describe Jarlaxle). He spends most of his time aboard the {@i Eyecatcher}, his personal ship. The other two vessels carry members of the carnival and their parade wagons.
zh_tw: 賈拉索以一個名為扎多茲·佐德的伊路斯坎人人類的身份來到深水城。"佐德船長"是海上少女博覽會（海之少女嘉年華）的主人，這是一個沿著劍海岸上下旅行的嘉年華，共有三艘船：{@i 奪目號}、{@i 碎心號}和{@i 煽亂號}（所有這些詞都是描述賈拉索的）。他大部分時間都在他的私人船{@i 奪目號}上。另外兩艘船載著嘉年華的成員和他們的遊行馬車。

english: Jarlaxle has forged an alliance with Lantan (an island to the south), and has armed his Bregan D'aerthe lieutenants with Lantanese firearms that rely on magical {@item smokepowder|WDH} to function. He has also acquired a Lantanese submarine called the {@i Scarlet Marpenoth}. This underwater vessel is mounted below the {@i Eyecatcher} and kept out of sight. Jarlaxle plans on using the submarine to flee Waterdeep if his scheme unravels.
zh_tw: 賈拉索已經與蘭檀（南部的一座島嶼）結成了聯盟，並且已經用依靠魔法{@item smokepowder|WDH|發煙粉}運作的蘭檀語火器武裝了他的布雷甘·達耶副手們。他還獲得了一艘名為{@i 緋紅瑪佩諾斯}的蘭檀語潛水艇。這艘水下船隻被安裝在{@i 奪目號}下面，並且保持不顯眼。如果賈拉索的計劃失敗，他計劃使用潛水艇逃離深水城。

english: Jarlaxle's loyalties are to himself first and foremost, and to Bregan D'aerthe secondarily.
zh_tw: 賈拉索的忠誠首先是對他自己，其次是對布雷甘·達耶。

english: Laeral Silverhand
zh_tw: 萊拉·銀手

english: {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH}
zh_tw: {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}

english: Anamanué {@creature Laeral Silverhand|wdh} was born in the Year of the Cowl (765 DR), the fifth of seven daughters of the goddess Mystra. Each of the Seven Sisters is a powerful and ageless beauty with a penchant for arcane magic.
zh_tw: 阿納瑪努é {@creature Laeral Silverhand|wdh|萊拉·銀手}出生於斗篷年（765 DR），是女神密斯特拉的七個女兒中的第五個。七姐妹每個人都是擁有強大力量和不老容顏的美女，並且對奧術魔法有著特別的偏好。

english: Long ago, Laeral ruled a kingdom called Stornanter and held the title of Witch-Queen of the North. After that, she led a band of adventurers called the Nine. She met and married Khelben Arunsun, who would later become the Blackstaff, the Lord Mage of Waterdeep. After Khelben died, Laeral retired from public life. She resurfaced after the Spellplague and the Sundering, weakened by Mystra's death, rebirth, and withdrawal from the world.
zh_tw: 很久以前，萊拉統治著一個名為斯托南特的王國，並擁有北方女巫王的稱號。之後，她帶領了一支名為九人組的冒險家團隊。她遇到了凱爾本·奧羅桑，並與他結婚，後者後來成為了黑杖，深水城的主法師。凱爾本去世後，萊拉退出了公共生活。在咒語瘟疫和裂解之後，由於密斯特拉的死亡、重生和退出世界，萊拉重新出現並變得衰弱。

english: Laeral's magic isn't as great as it once was, though she does her utmost to hide this fact. Only Elminster, her trusted friend and advisor, knows the extent of her decline. Despite her diminished abilities, Laeral remains a formidable, clear-headed wizard with plenty of magic at her disposal.
zh_tw: 萊拉的魔法不如從前那般強大，儘管她盡最大努力隱藏這一事實。只有伊爾明斯特，她信任的朋友和顧問，知道她衰退的程度。儘管她的能力有所減弱，萊拉仍然是一個令人敬畏、頭腦清晰的法師，擁有大量魔法可供使用。

english: A few years ago, Dagult Neverember was ousted as Open Lord of Waterdeep. Laeral reluctantly stepped into the vacancy at the request of the Masked Lords, and has served as Waterdeep's Open Lord ever since. Initially overwhelmed by the demands of the nobles and guildmasters, she has settled nicely into her new role. She uses her magic sparingly and relies on trusted advisors and deputies. As time allows, she likes to venture outside the Palace of Waterdeep in disguise, just to clear her head or check up on old friends (and enemies).
zh_tw: 幾年前，達格魯特無燼被罷免了深水城公開領主的職位。萊拉在蒙面領主們的請求下，勉強填補了空缺，從那時起一直擔任深水城的公開領主。最初，她被貴族和行會大師們的要求所淹沒，但現在已經很好地適應了她的這一新角色。她很少使用魔法，而是依賴於信任的顧問和副手。隨著時間的允許，她喜歡偽裝成普通人，走出深水城的宮殿，只是為了清醒一下頭腦或檢視一下老朋友（和敵人）。

english: Laeral's relationship with {@creature Vajra Safahr|WDH}, the current Blackstaff, has its challenges. For one thing, Laeral is much older, much wiser, and much more powerful than Vajra, whom she views as an insecure child. In addition, Vajra wields the Blackstaff, which has Khelben Arunsun's soul and the souls of all the other Blackstaffs bound inside it. Laeral covets the staff, because it contains all that's left of her husband. Not surprisingly, the two mages avoid each other as much as possible.
zh_tw: 萊拉與當前黑杖持有者{@creature Vajra Safahr|WDH|瓦婕拉·莎法爾}的關係存在挑戰。首先，萊拉比瓦婕拉年長得多、聰明得多，也強大得多，她將瓦婕拉視為一個不安全的孩子。此外，瓦婕拉掌握著黑杖，它內部繫結了凱爾本·奧羅桑的靈魂以及其他所有黑杖持有者的靈魂。萊拉渴望得到這根法杖，因為它包含了她丈夫留下的一切。不出所料，這兩位法師儘可能避免彼此接觸。

english: In times of great need, Laeral can command Vajra to unleash Force Grey. Until that order is given, Force Grey isn't allowed to conduct operations in Waterdeep, though Laeral's spies tell her that Vajra has secretly activated members of the elite order and sent them on a number of unauthorized missions. Laeral is reluctant to confront Vajra on the matter, and rationalizes her inaction by framing it as a test of Vajra's competence.
zh_tw: 在極度需要的時刻，萊拉可以命令瓦婕拉釋放灰色力量（灰力）。在那個命令下達之前，灰色力量是不允許在深水城進行行動的，儘管萊拉的間諜告訴她瓦婕拉秘密啟用了精英秩序的成員，並將他們派往了多個未經授權的任務。萊拉不願意就此事與瓦婕拉對峙，並將自己的不作為合理化為對瓦婕拉能力的考驗。

english: Manshoon
zh_tw: 曼松

english: Referred to in this adventure simply as "{@creature Manshoon|wdh}," this clone of the ancient archwizard infiltrated Waterdeep years ago and has been hiding out in Kolat Towers ever since, in the city's Southern Ward.
zh_tw: 在這次冒險中簡稱為"{@creature Manshoon|wdh|曼松}"的這個古老大法師的克隆體多年前潛入了深水城，並從那時起一直隱藏在城市南部的克拉特雙塔中。

english: The original {@creature Manshoon|WDH} was one of the founders of the Zhentarim. Evil to the core, he made enemies all across Faerûn, including other powerful spellcasters such as Khelben Arunsun and Elminster. Fearing that he might be destroyed by his foes, {@creature Manshoon|WDH} magically crafted several clones-but a mishap caused all of them to be awakened at once, whereupon they tried to destroy one another in a series of conflicts that came to be known as the {@creature Manshoon|WDH} Wars.
zh_tw: 原始的{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}是散塔林會的創始人之一。他本質上邪惡，在費倫各地樹立了敵人，包括像凱爾本·奧羅桑和伊爾明斯特這樣的其他強大的施法者。擔心自己可能被敵人摧毀，{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}用魔法制造了幾個克隆體——但一次意外導致它們全部同時被喚醒，之後它們在一系列被稱為{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}戰爭的衝突中試圖互相摧毀。

english: Now the original {@creature Manshoon|WDH} is dead, and it's widely believed that all his clones were destroyed as well. In fact, at least three are still alive. The one presently in Waterdeep escaped death by hiding out in Undermountain, where he eventually ran afoul of Halaster Blackcloak. After a brief spell duel, Halaster captured {@creature Manshoon|WDH} and amputated his left arm at the elbow for reasons unknown. {@creature Manshoon|WDH} escaped imprisonment and fled Undermountain, taking refuge in the city above. Attempts to magically regenerate his severed limb failed, forcing him to craft an artificial arm and hand for himself.
zh_tw: 現在原始的{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}已經死了，人們普遍認為他所有的克隆體也被摧毀了。實際上，至少還有三個還活著。目前在深水城的那個透過隱藏在下層山脈（地脈迷城）中逃脫了死亡，他最終遭遇了海拉斯特·黑袍。在一場簡短的法術決鬥後，海拉斯特捕獲了{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}，並出於未知的原因截斷了他的左前臂。{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}從監禁中逃脫並逃離了下層山脈，最終在城市上方找到了避難所。他試圖用魔法再生他切斷的肢體失敗了，迫使他自己製造了一個人工的手臂和手。

english: {@creature Manshoon|WDH} took control of Kolat Towers, a crumbling residence in the Southern Ward that was abandoned years ago by the two wizards who built it. The edifice is surrounded by a magical barrier that has the properties of a wall of force. {@creature Manshoon|WDH} rarely leaves the towers and uses a teleportation circle when he must do so, and thus is never seen entering or leaving.
zh_tw: {@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}控制了克拉特雙塔，這是位於南區域的一座破敗的住宅，多年前由建造它的兩位法師廢棄。這座大廈被一個具有力牆屬性的魔法屏障所環繞。{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}很少離開塔樓，當他必須這麼做時會使用傳送法陣，因此從未有人見過他進出。

english: {@creature Manshoon|WDH} aims to rule Waterdeep and replace the City Watch with Black Network mercenaries that are loyal to him alone. By bribing and blackmailing the Masked Lords, he hopes to oust {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH} as Open Lord and take her place, kill the Blackstaff, reduce the Masked Lords to mere vassals, and declare himself the Wizard-King of Waterdeep. Once the city is firmly in his clutches, {@creature Manshoon|WDH} will then turn his attention toward Undermountain, destroy Halaster once and for all, and claim the dungeon's riches.
zh_tw: {@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松} 企圖統治深水城，用只忠於他自己的黑網僱傭兵取代城市守衛。透過賄賂和勒索蒙面領主，他希望驅逐 {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手} 作為公開領主並取代她的位置，殺死黑杖，將蒙面領主降為僅僅是封臣，並自封為深水城的法師王。一旦城市牢牢掌握在他手中，{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松} 將轉向地脈迷城，徹底摧毀海拉斯特，並宣稱地牢的財富。

english: Manshoon Simulacrum
zh_tw: 曼松的擬像

english: {@creature Manshoon|WDH} uses the {@spell simulacrum} spell to create a magical duplicate of himself as needed. He has customized the spell to increase {@creature Manshoon Simulacrum|wdh|his simulacrum}'s hit points at the expense of its spellcasting ability.
zh_tw: {@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}使用{@spell simulacrum||擬像術}法術根據需要創造自己的魔法複製體。他定製了這個法術，以犧牲其施法能力為代價增加{@creature Manshoon Simulacrum|wdh|他的幻象}的生命值。

english: {@creature Manshoon|WDH} can have only one simulacrum at any given time, and he uses it as a subordinate to command his Zhentarim minions in the field. If his simulacrum is destroyed, {@creature Manshoon|WDH} creates another. Each simulacrum has the statistics of {@creature Manshoon|WDH}, with these changes:
zh_tw: {@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}在任何給定時間只能擁有一個複製體，他將其用作下屬，指揮他在戰場上的散塔林會手下。如果他的複製體被摧毀，{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}會再創造另一個。每個複製體都具有{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的具體數值，但有以下變化：

english: The simulacrum has no special equipment. Consequently, it has AC 12 and lacks the Magic Resistance trait and the Staff of Power action option.
zh_tw: 複製體沒有特殊裝備。因此，它的AC（護甲等級）為12，並且缺乏魔法抗性特性和力量法杖行動選項。

english: It loses all spell slots of 6th level and higher.
zh_tw: 它失去了所有6級以及更高階別的法術位。

english: It has a challenge rating of 8 (3,900 XP).
zh_tw: 它的挑戰等級為8（3,900經驗值）。

english: Martial Arts Adept
zh_tw: 武術高手

english: {@creature Martial arts adept|VGM|Martial arts adepts} are disciplined monks who have extensive training in hand-to-hand combat. Some protect monasteries; others travel the world seeking enlightenment or new forms of combat to master. A few become bodyguards, trading their combat prowess and loyalty for food and lodging.
zh_tw: {@creature Martial arts adept|VGM|武術高手}是受過嚴格訓練的武僧，擅長近身肉搏戰。一些人保護寺廟；其他人周遊世界尋求啟迪或新的戰鬥形式來掌握。少數人成為保鏢，用他們的戰鬥技巧和忠誠換取食物和住宿。

english: Meloon Wardragon
zh_tw: 麥倫·戰龍

english: {@creature Meloon Wardragon|wdh|Meloon} is a handsome, formidable warrior in his prime, who serves the goddess Tymora and loves a good fight. His friends-among them {@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh} and {@creature Vajra Safahr|WDH}-describe him as honest, optimistic, and extraordinarily lucky. Until recently, he was a member of Force Grey and reported directly to the Blackstaff. In recent months, Meloon has spent much of his time at the Yawning Portal.
zh_tw: {@creature Meloon Wardragon|wdh|麥倫}是一位英俊、強大的戰士，正值壯年，他侍奉女神泰摩拉，喜歡一場好戰鬥。他的朋友們——其中包括{@creature Renaer Neverember|wdh|瑞納爾·無燼}和{@creature Vajra Safahr|WDH|瓦婕拉·莎法爾}——形容他為誠實、樂觀，並且非常幸運。直到最近，他還是灰色力量的成員，並且直接向黑杖報告。在過去的幾個月裡，麥倫大部分時間都在呵欠之門（呵欠之門）。

english: Three months ago, out of boredom, Meloon accompanied a fledgling band of adventurers on an expedition to Undermountain. There, his luck ran out. While resting in the dungeon, the adventuring party was attacked by monsters unleashed by {@creature Xanathar|WDH}-including a number of intellect devourers. One of the creatures succeeded in magically devouring and replacing Meloon's brain, turning the champion of Tymora into a puppet. After finishing off his unsuspecting companions, Meloon returned to Waterdeep as a Xanathar Guild spy.
zh_tw: 三個月前，出於無聊，麥倫陪同一支新成立的冒險家團隊前往下層山脈（地脈迷城）進行探險。在那裡，他的運氣用盡了。在地牢中休息時，冒險團隊被{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}釋放的怪物攻擊——包括一些噬腦怪。其中一個生物成功地透過魔法吞噬並替換了麥倫的大腦，將泰摩拉的冠軍變成了一個傀儡。在消滅了他毫無戒心的同伴之後，麥倫作為姍娜薩公會的間諜返回了深水城。

english: The intellect devourer that inhabits Meloon's skull was bred by {@creature Nihiloor|WDH}, a mind flayer in {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s employ. It knows everything Meloon knew, and Meloon behaves much as he did before his descent into Undermountain. He hangs out at the Yawning Portal, tries to bond with adventurers, and offers a helping hand whenever doing so feels appropriate. The intellect devourer's primary goals are to steer adventurers away from Undermountain and get them to undertake quests that further the aims of {@creature Xanathar|WDH}. Such quests usually involve the eradication of {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s enemies, and Meloon is all too eager to fight alongside those who fall for his ruse.
zh_tw: 佔據麥倫頭骨的噬腦怪是由{@creature Nihiloor|WDH|尼希盧爾}培育的，尼希盧爾是{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}僱傭的奪心魔。它知道麥倫所知道的一切，麥倫的行為和他進入地脈迷城之前的行為非常相似。他常去呵欠之門，試圖與冒險家建立聯絡，並在適當的時候提供幫助。噬腦怪的主要目標是引導冒險家遠離地脈迷城，並讓他們執行進一步實現{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}目的的任務。這樣的任務通常涉及根除{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的敵人，而麥倫非常渴望與那些落入他的圈套的人並肩戰鬥。

english: Adjusted Game Statistics
zh_tw: 調整後的遊戲具體數值

english: If Meloon is killed and raised from the dead, his true self is restored and his statistics change as follows:
zh_tw: 如果麥倫被殺並從死亡中復活，他的真實自我將得到恢復，他的具體數值將如下變化：

english: Meloon is neutral good.
zh_tw: 麥倫是中立善良。

english: He loses his telepathy, and his ability to speak and understand Deep Speech.
zh_tw: 他失去了心靈感應能力，以及說和理解深淵語的能力。

english: He can attune to {@item Azuredge|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix A|WDH|11}).
zh_tw: 他可以調諧到{@item Azuredge|wdh|蔚藍之鋒}（見{@adventure 附錄A|WDH|11}）。

english: Mirt
zh_tw: 米爾特

english: {@creature Mirt|WDH}
zh_tw: {@creature Mirt|WDH|米爾特}

english: Once known as {@creature Mirt|WDH} the Merciless and the Old Wolf, {@creature Mirt|wdh} made a fortune and carved out a reputation as an adventurer and philanderer. Today, an older and wiser {@creature Mirt|WDH} serves as one of the Masked Lords, a Harper, and a close advisor to {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH}. The years have not worn him down, and though he has grown soft in the flesh, he remains deceptively strong, vigorous, and clear of mind. {@creature Mirt|WDH} has survived the passing of centuries by means of magic, and of all the Masked Lords, he is the least concerned with concealing his identity.
zh_tw: 曾被稱為無情的{@creature Mirt|WDH|米爾特}和老狼，{@creature Mirt|wdh|米爾特}積累了財富，並作為一名冒險家和浪蕩子贏得了名聲。如今，更為年長和智慧的{@creature Mirt|WDH|米爾特}擔任著面具領主之一，一名豎琴手聯盟，以及{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}的親密顧問。歲月並未磨損他的精力，儘管他身體變得柔軟，但他依然保持著出人意料的強壯、精力充沛和思維清晰。{@creature Mirt|WDH|米爾特}透過魔法度過了數個世紀，在所有面具領主中，他是最不關心隱藏自己身份的人。

english: Despite his prodigious girth, {@creature Mirt|WDH} can move with good speed when he must, and he hasn't let his adventuring skills wither. His wife, Asper, passed away several years ago, and his rambling mansion has seen better days. {@creature Mirt|WDH} spends his days embroiled in politics and whiles away his nights in drink and debauchery.
zh_tw: 儘管體型龐大，{@creature Mirt|WDH|米爾特}在必要時仍能迅速移動，並且他沒有讓自己的冒險技能荒廢。他的妻子阿斯珀幾年前去世了，他那雜亂無章的豪宅也已風光不再。{@creature Mirt|WDH|米爾特}白天忙於政治，夜晚則沉迷於酒精和放蕩。

english: Treasure
zh_tw: 寶藏

english: {@creature Mirt|WDH} has access to magic items of all kinds, but keeps only a few on his person. He can equip himself with other magic items as the need arises.
zh_tw: {@creature Mirt|WDH|米爾特}可以接觸到各種魔法物品，但他身上只攜帶少數幾件。根據需要，他可以裝備其他魔法物品。

english: In addition to his other magical gear, {@creature Mirt|WDH} owns a {@item Lord's ensemble|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix A|WDH|11}). He dons the ensemble only when meeting with other Masked Lords in an official capacity.
zh_tw: 除了其他魔法裝備外，{@creature Mirt|WDH|米爾特}擁有一套{@item Lord's ensemble|wdh|領主套裝}（見{@adventure 附錄A|WDH|11}）。他僅在以官方身份與其他蒙面領主會面時才穿戴這套套裝。

english: Nar'l Xibrindas
zh_tw: 納爾·澤布林達斯

english: {@creature Nar'l Xibrindas|WDH} and Grell Bodyguard
zh_tw: {@creature Nar'l Xibrindas|WDH|納爾·澤布林達斯}和觸鬚怪保鏢

english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s advisor is a nervous and conniving male drow named {@creature Nar'l Xibrindas|wdh}. Nar'l's house was wiped out long ago, but he and his elder brother Soluun survived and joined Bregan D'aerthe. A year ago, Nar'l was given the difficult task of infiltrating the Xanathar Guild and getting as close to the beholder as possible. Not only did he succeed, but in the course of gaining {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s trust, he managed to convince the beholder to eliminate its other advisors. The beholder's paranoia will eventually cause {@creature Xanathar|WDH} to question the drow's loyalty, though, and Nar'l has become increasingly worried about his future. If forced to decide between himself and Bregan D'aerthe, he'll choose the former and betray his drow allies to save his own skin.
zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的顧問是一個緊張且狡猾的男性卓爾精靈，名叫{@creature Nar'l Xibrindas|wdh|納爾·澤布林達斯}。納爾的家族很久以前就被消滅了，但他和他的哥哥索倫倖存下來，並加入了布雷甘·達耶。一年前，納爾被賦予了一項艱鉅的任務：潛入姍娜薩公會並儘可能接近那隻眼魔。他不僅成功了，而且在贏得{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的信任的過程中，他設法說服眼魔消除了它的其他顧問。然而，眼魔的偏執最終會導致{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}質疑卓爾精靈的忠誠，納爾對自己的未來也越來越擔憂。如果被迫在他自己和布雷甘·達耶之間做出選擇，他會選擇前者，背叛他的卓爾精靈盟友以保全自己。

english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH} is aware that something is off with Nar'l, and recently assigned him a {@creature grell} bodyguard. The grell has instructions to dispose of Nar'l at the first sign of disloyalty.
zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}察覺到納爾有些不對勁，最近給他安排了一個{@creature grell||觸鬚怪}保鏢。鬼影得到的指令是，一旦發現納爾有不忠的跡象，就立刻處理掉他。

english: Game Statistics
zh_tw: 遊戲資料

english: {@creature Nar'l Xibrindas|wdh} is a {@creature drow mage}. He prepares and casts the {@spell sending} spell whenever he needs to communicate with his brother.
zh_tw: {@creature Nar'l Xibrindas|wdh|納爾·澤布林達斯}是一名{@creature drow mage||卓爾魔法師}。每當他需要與他的兄弟溝通時，他就會準備並施放{@spell sending||短訊術}。

english: In addition to his other gear, Nar'l carries a vial containing three doses of {@item eyescratch|WDH}, a contact poison. A creature that comes into contact with the poison must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for 1 hour and {@condition blinded} while {@condition poisoned} in this way. A lesser restoration spell or similar magic ends the effect.
zh_tw: 除了其他裝備外，納爾還攜帶了一個小瓶，內含三劑{@item eyescratch|WDH|眼撓}接觸毒藥。接觸此毒藥的生物必須成功透過一次{@dc 14}體質豁免檢定，否則將會陷入{@condition poisoned||中毒}狀態持續1小時，並在以這種方式{@condition poisoned||中毒}的同時陷入{@condition blinded||目盲}狀態。一次次級復原術或類似的魔法可以終止該效果。

english: Nihiloor
zh_tw: 尼希盧爾

english: {@creature Nihiloor|WDH}
zh_tw: {@creature Nihiloor|WDH|尼希盧爾}

english: The illithid {@creature Nihiloor|WDH} works for {@creature Xanathar|WDH}, spending its days creating intellect devourers and setting them loose in the sewers of Waterdeep. Each intellect devourer attacks the first humanoid it encounters, using its victim as a puppet to spy on the city and relay information back to {@creature Nihiloor|WDH}. Occasionally, an intellect devourer is instructed to seek out a particular kind of target, such as a member of the City Guard or the City Watch. Sometimes its instructions will include orders to capture specific Waterdavians and bring them to Skullport, where they can be enslaved or ransomed.
zh_tw: 奪心魔 {@creature Nihiloor|WDH|尼希盧爾} 為 {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩} 工作，整日製造噬腦怪並將其釋放到深水城的下水道中。每隻噬腦怪都會攻擊它遇到的第一個人形生物，並將其作為傀儡以監視城市並將資訊傳回 {@creature Nihiloor|WDH|尼希盧爾}。偶爾，噬腦怪會被指示去尋找特定型別的目標，例如城防軍或城市守衛的成員。有時，它的指示中還會包括抓捕特定的深水城居民並將他們帶到骷髏港的任務，在那裡他們可能會被奴役或勒索贖金。

english: {@creature Nihiloor|WDH} has an alien mind, and it considers itself {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s equal. It has no interest in supplanting the beholder, however, preferring to operate in the shadows and pursue its own fell schemes.
zh_tw: {@creature Nihiloor|WDH|尼希盧爾}擁有一個異域的心智，並且它認為自己是{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的平等。然而，它並沒有取代眼魔的興趣，更傾向於在幕後操作，追求自己的邪惡計劃。

english: Game Statistics
zh_tw: 遊戲資料

english: {@creature Nihiloor|WDH} is a {@creature mind flayer}.
zh_tw: {@creature Nihiloor|WDH|尼希盧爾}是一個{@creature mind flayer||奪心魔}。

english: Nimblewright
zh_tw: 秘偶

english: A {@creature nimblewright|wdh} is a magical construct created to serve as a guard or assassin. Composed predominantly of lightweight wood and powered by magic, it can pass for humanoid while wearing clothing. Some nimblewrights wear plain clothing, while others are clad in flashier attire. A nimblewright is emotionless, its face frozen in whatever expression was given to it by its creator.
zh_tw: 一個{@creature nimblewright|wdh|秘偶}是一個被創造出來作為守衛或刺客的魔法構裝生物。主要由輕質木材組成，由魔法驅動，它穿上衣服時可以冒充人類。一些秘偶穿著樸素的衣服，而另一些則穿著更華麗的服裝。秘偶沒有情感，它的面部表情被創造者賦予的任何表情所固定。

english: Duelist
zh_tw: 決鬥家

english: A nimblewright moves like a dancer and fights like a swashbuckler, using dodges and parries to avoid damage while deftly skewering its foes.
zh_tw: 一個秘偶移動起來像舞者，戰鬥起來像風流劍客，利用躲避和招架來避免傷害，同時巧妙地刺穿它的敵人。

english: Constructed Nature
zh_tw: 構裝本質

english: A nimblewright doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep. Damage it takes can be repaired with mending spells, but a nimblewright reduced to 0 hit points is permanently destroyed.
zh_tw: 一個秘偶不需要空氣、食物、飲水或睡眠。它受到的傷害可以透過修復法術來修復，但如果秘偶的生命值降至0點，則會被永久摧毀。

english: Noska Ur'gray
zh_tw: 諾思卡·厄格雷

english: Noska is a ruthless enforcer in the Xanathar Guild. A green slime in Undermountain dissolved his left hand and forearm, and the lost appendage has been replaced with a heavy crossbow that attaches to the stump.
zh_tw: 諾思卡是姍娜薩公會中的一個無情執法者。在地脈迷城的一團綠色粘液溶解了他的左手和前臂，失去的肢體被一把重型十字弓所替代，這把十字弓連線在殘肢上。

english: Game Statistics
zh_tw: 遊戲資料

english: {@creature Noska Ur'gray|wdh} is a shield dwarf {@creature thug}, with these changes:
zh_tw: {@creature Noska Ur'gray|wdh|諾思卡·厄格雷}是一個盾矮人{@creature thug||暴徒}，有以下變化：

english: Noska is neutral evil.
zh_tw: 諾思卡是中立邪惡。

english: He has these racial traits: His walking speed is 25 feet. He has advantage on saving throws against poison and resistance to poison damage. He has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. He speaks Common and Dwarvish.
zh_tw: 他有這些種族特徵：他的行走速度為25尺。他對毒素豁免檢定有優勢，並且對毒素傷害有抗性。他有60尺範圍內的黑暗視覺。他說通用語和矮人語。

english: He has disadvantage on Strength checks made to climb, due to his disability.
zh_tw: 由於他的殘疾，他在攀爬時進行的力量檢查上有劣勢。

english: Orond Gralhund
zh_tw: 奧隆德·格勞洪德

english: The Gralhunds are nobles who trade in arms and mercenaries, and whose family motto is "We see both sides." Orond is the patriarch, but he's not a quick-thinking or cultured sort-and deep down, he knows it. He leaves most of the plotting and socializing to his wife, {@creature Yalah Gralhund|wdh|Yalah}, to whom he is devoted.
zh_tw: 格勞洪德家族是貴族，從事武器和僱傭兵貿易，他們的家族座右銘是"我們看兩面"。奧隆德是家族的族長，但他不是一個思維敏捷或有教養的人——內心深處，他知道這一點。他把大部分策劃和社交活動留給了他的妻子，{@creature Yalah Gralhund|wdh|雅拉}，他對她非常忠誠。

english: When several of the Masked Lords were assassinated in quick succession some years ago, Lord Gralhund had expected his wife to fill one of the vacancies. That never happened, though, despite many promises and bribes. After she was passed over, Orond became insanely angry, and he has remained that way ever since.
zh_tw: 幾年前，當幾位蒙面領主在短時間內相繼被暗殺時，格勞洪德領主曾期望他的妻子填補其中一個空缺。然而，儘管有許多承諾和賄賂，這從未發生。在她被忽視之後，奧隆德變得異常憤怒，從那以後他就一直這樣。

english: Less than a year ago, the Gralhunds were approached by agents of the Zhentarim loyal to {@creature Manshoon|WDH}, and the nobles formed an alliance with them. House Gralhund gives the Zhents coin and allows them to use the family's noble villa as a refuge. In exchange, the house reaps all the benefits that the Black Network offers, including intelligence that its spies have gathered. So while the Zhents use House Gralhund as a shield, the Gralhunds are using the Zhents to ascertain the identities and weaknesses of the Masked Lords.
zh_tw: 不到一年前，格勞洪德家族被忠於{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的散塔林會代理人接觸，貴族們與他們結成了聯盟。格勞洪德家族給散塔林會人貨幣，並允許他們使用家族的貴族別墅作為避難所。作為交換，家族從黑網提供的所有好處中獲益，包括其間諜收集的情報。因此，雖然散塔林會人將格勞洪德家族作為盾牌，但格勞洪德家族則利用散塔林會人來確定蒙面領主的身份和弱點。

english: Orond doesn't fully grasp how entwined the Black Network and his family have become-it is now next to impossible to separate one from the other. It's no secret in Waterdeep that the Black Network has firmly rooted itself in House Gralhund. But what's not generally known is that the Zhents in House Gralhund are agents of {@creature Manshoon|WDH}. Neither Orond nor any other member of his family knows about the wizard's clone. As far as Orond and his wife are concerned, the local leaders of the Black Network (with {@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh} chief among them) reside with them in the family villa.
zh_tw: 奧隆德並沒有完全理解黑網和他的家族變得多麼緊密相連——現在要將兩者分開幾乎是不可能的。在深水城，黑網已在格勞洪德家族中牢固紮根，這已不是秘密。但普遍不為人知的是，格勞洪德家族中的贊塔瑞姆人是{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}的代理人。奧隆德和他的任何家族成員都不知道這位法師的克隆體。就奧隆德和他的妻子而言，黑網的地方領導人（以{@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh|厄斯圖爾·弗洛克辛}為首）與他們一起居住在家族別墅中。

english: Orond is a short, stocky man who dresses well and is easy on the eyes. When he opens his mouth, his boorish nature, inflated sense of self-importance, fragile ego, and despicable opinions about "the common rabble" come to the fore, and his charm quickly dissipates. When not in his wife's company, he is prone to excessive boasting and temper tantrums. When he must speak to strangers, he keeps his half-orc bodyguard {@creature Hrabbaz|WDH} close by, for fear that others might attack and rob him at any moment. While in Yalah's presence, Orond becomes an altogether different person: quiet, almost timid, and happy to let his wife have the spotlight.
zh_tw: 奧隆德是一個矮胖的男人，穿著得體，外表討人喜歡。當他開口說話時，他的粗俗本性、過分的自我重要感、脆弱的自尊心以及對"普通烏合之眾"的可鄙看法就會浮現出來，他的魅力很快就消失了。當他不在妻子的陪伴下時，他容易過度自誇和發脾氣。當他必須與陌生人交談時，他會讓他的半獸人保鏢{@creature Hrabbaz|WDH|哈巴茲}緊隨其後，因為他害怕別人隨時可能會攻擊並搶劫他。而在雅拉的面前，奧隆德變成了一個完全不同的人：安靜，幾乎是膽怯的，樂於讓他的妻子成為焦點。

english: Orond relies on Yalah to manage the Zhentarim. He spends his days watching mercenaries train, paying bills, and ranting about the cost of doing business in the city. Although he is human, Orond was born with a tiefling's tail. The tail was amputated when he was a young boy, but the scar on his backside remains.
zh_tw: 奧隆德依賴雅拉來管理散塔林會。他的日子花在觀看僱傭兵訓練、支付賬單以及抱怨在城市裡做生意的成本上。儘管他是人族，但奧隆德出生時帶有提夫林的尾巴。當他還是個小男孩時，尾巴就被切除了，但他的臀部仍然留有疤痕。

english: Osvaldo Cassalanter
zh_tw: 奧斯瓦多·卡薩蘭特

english: Ammalia and {@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH} traded the soul of their eldest child for power. Stripped of his humanity, Osvaldo was chained up in Cassalanter Villa and slowly transformed into a devil (and an insane one at that). Now a creature of pure evil and hate, he has no hope of regaining what was taken from him.
zh_tw: 阿瑪利亞和{@creature Victoro Cassalanter|WDH|維克托羅·卡薩蘭特}為了力量交換了他們長子的靈魂。奧斯瓦多被剝奪了人性，在卡薩蘭特別墅被鎖鏈束縛，並逐漸變成了一個魔鬼（而且是一個瘋狂的魔鬼）。現在，作為一個純粹的邪惡和仇恨的生物，他沒有希望恢復被奪走的東西。

english: Ott Steeltoes
zh_tw: 奧特·鋼趾

english: The dwarf {@creature Ott Steeltoes|wdh} has the nerve-wracking task of tending to {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s pet fish, {@creature Sylgar|wdh}. zh_tw: 矮人{@creature Ott Steeltoes|wdh|奧特·鋼趾}有一項令人神經緊張的任務，那就是照顧{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的寵物魚，{@creature Sylgar|wdh|斯爾嘉}。在他的業餘時間，他崇拜祖格託伊，真菌的惡魔女王，並培育蘑菇、孢子和黴菌。他戴著一頂縫有假眼魔眼柄的皮製頭巾。

english: Remallia Haventree
zh_tw: 蕾米莉亞·港樹

english: {@creature Remallia Haventree|wdh|Remallia} (Remi to her friends) is the lady of House Ulbrinter and a guiding light for the Harpers in Waterdeep. She became an active force for good in the city after assassins killed her husband, Arthagast Ulbrinter, and destroyed his remains. A sun elf, she has two adult children (a half-elf son named Arthius, who is studying music in Silverymoon, and a half-elf daughter named Serenore, who lives on the Moonshae island of Alaron with her husband and daughter). Lady Haventree retains a handful of loyal servants and spies.
zh_tw: {@creature Remallia Haventree|wdh|蕾米莉亞}（朋友們稱她為雷米）是烏爾布林特家族的女主人，也是深水城中豎琴手聯盟的指路明燈。在刺客殺害了她的丈夫，阿薩加斯特·烏爾布林特，並摧毀了他的遺體之後，她成為了這座城市中積極行善的力量。作為一名太陽精靈，她有兩個成年子女（一個名叫阿西烏斯的半精靈兒子，他正在銀月城學習音樂，以及一個名叫塞諾雷的半精靈女兒，她和她的丈夫以及女兒一起生活在莫恩沙島的阿拉隆）。海文特里女士保留了一小撮忠誠的僕人和間諜。

english: Remi holds secret Harper meetings in her villa, which is warded by all manner of spells. She uses a silver raven {@i figurine of wondrous power} to deliver messages to Harper spies scattered throughout the city.
zh_tw: 蕾米在她的別墅裡秘密舉行豎琴手聯盟議，別墅被各種法術保護著。她使用一隻銀色的烏鴉{@i 異能塑像}向遍佈全城的豎琴手聯盟間諜傳遞資訊。

english: Renaer Neverember
zh_tw: 瑞納爾·無燼

english: Renaer is the estranged son of Dagult Neverember, the former Open Lord of Waterdeep and the current Lord of Neverwinter. Father and son detest one another, and Renaer is least happy when he finds himself forced to deal with some mess his father left behind. Qualities that both share include striking good looks, a love of drink, and a flair for diplomacy. What Renaer lacks is his father's belligerence, ill temper, and bad judgment.
zh_tw: 瑞納爾是達格魯特無燼的疏遠兒子，達格魯特無燼是深水城的前公開領主，也是無冬城的現任領主。父子倆彼此憎恨，瑞納爾最不高興的時候就是他發現自己被迫處理父親留下的一些爛攤子。他們共有的品質包括引人注目的英俊外貌、對飲品的喜愛以及外交手腕。瑞納爾所缺乏的是他父親的好戰、壞脾氣和糟糕的判斷力。

english: Renaer lives off a sizable inheritance left to him by his mother. Approaching middle age, he has given up adventuring and settled down somewhat. As a Harper, he spends a lot of time defending Waterdavians against those who, like his father, would deprive them of their coin and rights. He owns Neverember House, a four-story residence in the Sea Ward. Renaer spends as little time there as possible, however, since it's constantly under surveillance by spies loyal to his father. His friends have an open invitation to use the house as they please, while Renaer spends most of his free time in taverns and festhalls.
zh_tw: 瑞納爾靠母親留給他的一筆可觀遺產過活。接近中年的他放棄了冒險，開始稍微安頓下來。作為一名豎琴手聯盟，他花費大量時間保護水城居民，對抗那些像他父親一樣想要剝奪他們金錢和權利的人。他擁有位於海區的四層住宅——無燼宅邸。然而，瑞納爾儘可能少地在那裡待著，因為那裡不斷受到忠於他父親的間諜監視。他的朋友們可以隨意使用這座房子，而瑞納爾大部分的空閒時間都在酒館和節日大廳裡度過。

english: Some believe that Renaer's estrangement from his father is nothing but an act, and that anyone who bears the Neverember name is an enemy of Waterdeep. Renaer just shakes his head at such accusations and gets on with his life. He has many powerful friends to watch his back.
zh_tw: 一些人認為瑞納爾與其父親的疏遠只是一種偽裝，並且認為任何姓無燼的人都是深水城的敵人。瑞納爾對這樣的指控只是搖頭，並繼續他的生活。他有許多有權勢的朋友在背後支援他。

english: Saeth Cromley
zh_tw: 薩斯·克姆利

english: {@creature Saeth Cromley|wdh} is a retired {@creature sergeant|WDH} of the City Watch, a likable fellow with a sharp, sarcastic wit. He occasionally comes out of retirement at the request of {@creature Barnibus Blastwind|WDH}, and he assists the mage in investigating unusual crimes in the city. Cromley helps Barnibus relate to the common folk, and he is good at coaxing information out of them. Though Cromley was once a strict proponent of Watch regulations and dress codes, he has grown a bit lax in both matters now that he's officially retired.
zh_tw: {@creature Saeth Cromley|wdh|薩斯·克姆利}是城市守衛一位已退役的{@creature sergeant|WDH|軍士}，一個討人喜歡的傢伙，有著尖銳且諷刺的機智。他偶爾會應{@creature Barnibus Blastwind|WDH|巴尼布斯·陣風}的請求重新出山，協助這位法師調查城市中不尋常的犯罪。克姆利幫助巴尼布斯與普通民眾打交道，並且他擅長從他們那裡引出資訊。儘管克姆利曾經是警衛隊規章制度和著裝規範的嚴格支持者，但自從他正式退休後，在這兩方面都變得有些鬆懈了。

zh_tw: {@creature Swashbuckler|VGM|風流劍客}是迷人的不法之徒，他們遵循自己的榮譽準則生活。他們渴望聲名狼藉，經常沉溺於浪漫情事，並以海盜和私掠者的身份勉強維持生計，很少在一個地方停留太久。

english: {@creature Thorvin Twinbeard|wdh|Thorvin} serves as {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s chief engineer and trapsmith. He also serves the Harpers as a paid informant, keeping that faction apprised of {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s plans as well as he can. Thorvin uses the ruse of maintenance inspections to cover up secret meetings he holds with Harper spies in Skullport and elsewhere.
zh_tw: {@creature Thorvin Twinbeard|wdh|索文}擔任{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的首席工程師和陷阱製造師。他還作為付費線人服務於豎琴手聯盟，儘可能讓他們瞭解{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的計劃。索文利用維護檢查的藉口來掩蓋他在骷髏港及其他地方與豎琴手聯盟間諜舉行的秘密會面。

english: Thorvin wears iron-rimmed spectacles and carries a large, heavy wrench that doubles as a club. He also carries mason's tools, {@item smith's tools|PHB}, and {@item thieves' tools|PHB}, and has proficiency with all three.

english: {@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh} works for {@creature Manshoon|WDH}, and he is the highest-ranking member of the Zhentarim squad stationed at House Gralhund. Urstul is a glorified thug with all the charm and breeding of a snake, but the Gralhunds tolerate him because he feeds them useful information culled from his spies throughout the city. Urstul takes his orders from {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s current simulacrum, which comes and goes from House Gralhund by way of a teleportation circle (connected to the circle in Kolat Towers).
zh_tw: {@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh|厄斯圖爾·弗洛克辛}為{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}工作，他是駐紮在格勞洪德家族的散塔林會小隊中的最高階別成員。厄斯圖爾是一個自大的暴徒，有著蛇一樣的魅力和教養，但格勞洪德家族容忍他，因為他從他在城市各處的間諜那裡收集到的有用資訊餵養他們。厄斯圖爾接受{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}當前的擬像的命令，該擬像透過傳送法陣（連線到克拉特雙塔中的圈子）進出格勞洪德家族。

english: Urstul is a large, heavyset man in his forties. He storms about House Gralhund like he owns the place. He has a collection of black {@creature flying snake||flying snakes} that he uses as couriers to deliver messages to underlings throughout the city.
zh_tw: 厄斯圖爾是一個四十多歲的高大、魁梧的男人。他在格勞洪德家族（格勞洪德家族）中橫衝直撞，就像他擁有那個地方一樣。他有一群黑色的{@creature flying snake||飛蛇}，他用它們作為信使，在全城向他的下屬傳遞資訊。
