english: Vajra Safahr
zh_tw: 瓦婕拉·莎法爾

english: {@creature Vajra Safahr|wdh|Vajra} is a capable wizard in her mid-thirties, the youngest person ever to hold the position of Blackstaff. As the High Wizard of Waterdeep, she is charged with using all the magic and resources at her disposal to defend the city against threats. She was handpicked for the job by Khelben Arunsun, and wields the Blackstaff from which Khelben derived his name and the title of the office. Vajra isn't the city's most powerful wizard, but she can hold her own. Despite her many gifts, she still questions her ability to meet the demands of her role, and she rarely makes a decision without first soliciting the advice of the Blackstaff, which contains Khelben Arunsun's spirit as well as the spirits of all the other Blackstaffs who preceded her. She also gets intelligence from many other sources, both through her own network of spies and from Harper agents.
zh_tw: {@creature Vajra Safahr|wdh|瓦婕拉}是一位三十多歲的能幹女巫，是有史以來最年輕擔任黑杖的人。作為深水城的高階法師，她負責利用所有可用的魔法和資源來保衛城市免受威脅。她是由凱爾本·奧羅桑親自挑選擔任這個職位的，並且持有凱爾本得名以及該職位頭銜的黑杖。瓦婕拉並非城市中最強大的法師，但她能夠自持。儘管她有許多天賦，她仍然質疑自己是否能夠滿足她角色的要求，她很少在沒有徵求黑杖的意見之前做出決定，黑杖中包含有凱爾本·奧羅桑的靈魂以及所有前任黑杖的靈魂。她還透過自己的間諜網路以及豎琴手聯盟特工從許多其他來源獲得情報。

english: Vajra runs Blackstaff Academy, a school for mages, out of Blackstaff Tower in the Castle Ward. She is also in charge of Force Grey, an order of highly skilled adventurers who are called upon to defend the city in times of need.
zh_tw: 瓦婕拉在城堡區的黑杖塔（黑杖塔）經營著黑杖學院（黑杖學院），這是一所為法師們開設的學校。她還負責領導灰力（灰色力量），這是一群技能高超的冒險家，他們被召喚在城市需要時保衛城市。

english: Vajra is always looking for new adventurers to fill the ranks of Force Grey, and she is particularly interested in those who can bring unique skills, abilities, or spells to the mix.
zh_tw: 瓦婕拉總是在尋找新的冒險家來填補灰力（灰色力量）的行列，她特別感興趣的是那些能夠帶來獨特技能、能力或法術的人。

english: Several of the older and more seasoned wizards in Waterdeep consider Vajra an upstart, but they are smart enough not to challenge her. Only the Open Lord, currently {@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH}, can strip Vajra of her title.
zh_tw: 深水城中的一些年長且更富有經驗的法師認為瓦婕拉是個新手，但他們很聰明，不會去挑戰她。只有公開領主，目前是{@creature Laeral Silverhand|WDH|萊拉·銀手}，才能剝奪瓦婕拉的頭銜。

english: Victoro Cassalanter
zh_tw: 維克托羅·卡薩蘭特

english: The {@creature Victoro Cassalanter|wdh|lord of House Cassalanter} is a devilishly handsome half-elf who likes coin and power. He and his wife gained both by cutting a deal with Asmodeus-which involved trading away the souls of their three children.
zh_tw: {@creature Victoro Cassalanter|wdh|卡薩蘭特家族的領主}是一個極其英俊的半精靈，他喜歡金錢和權力。他和他的妻子透過與阿斯蒙蒂斯達成交易獲得了這兩者——這涉及到交換他們三個孩子的靈魂。

english: Victoro is a priest of Asmodeus, though his devotion to the Lord of the Nine Hells is a secret known only to his wife and his closest friends. Most Waterdavians know him as a successful banker, philanthropist, and worshiper of Lathander. Some of his business profits go toward feeding and sheltering the poor. But behind this veneer of generosity, Victoro is a self-serving beast.
zh_tw: 維克托羅是阿斯蒙蒂斯的牧師，儘管他對九層地獄之主的奉獻是一個秘密，只有他的妻子和他最親密的朋友知道。大多數深水城居民知道他是一位成功的銀行家、慈善家，以及洛山達的崇拜者。他的一些商業利潤用於供養和庇護窮人。但在這種慷慨的外表下，維克托羅是一個自私的野獸。

english: The soul of Victoro's eldest son, Osvaldo, is forever lost and can't be saved. To allay his guilt, Victoro has forged a plan to win back the souls of his young twins, Terenzio and Elzerina. Under the terms of the contract, their souls will be forfeit on their ninth birthdays, and that day is fast approaching. But Victoro can buy his way out of the obligation by providing, as the contract states, "one shy of a million gold coins and the sacrifice of one shy of a hundred unfortunate souls."
zh_tw: 維克托羅的長子奧斯瓦多的靈魂永遠喪失，無法救贖。為了減輕他的內疚，維克托羅制定了一個計劃來贏回他的雙胞胎孩子，特倫齊奧和艾爾澤琳娜的靈魂。根據合同條款，他們的靈魂將在他們九歲生日時被沒收，而那一天即將到來。但是維克托羅可以透過提供合同中所說的"不足一百萬金幣和不足一百個不幸靈魂的犧牲"來贖回他的義務。

english: Victoro is well schooled, suave, slow to anger, and blessed with good health, long life, and immunity to disease. He dresses in the latest fashions and walks with a ruby-tipped cane, though not because he needs to. This cane has the magical properties of a {@item rod of rulership}.
zh_tw: 維克托羅受過良好的教育，舉止優雅，不易發怒，並且擁有良好的健康、長壽以及對疾病的免疫力。他穿著最時尚的服裝，手持一根鑲有紅寶石的手杖行走，儘管他並不真的需要它。這根手杖擁有{@item rod of rulership||統御權杖}的魔法屬性。

english: Volothamp Geddarm
zh_tw: 瓦羅贊普·格達姆

english: The bombastic world traveler {@creature Volothamp "Volo" Geddarm|ToA|Volothamp Geddarm} is enjoying some downtime in Waterdeep following a successful book tour promoting his latest work, {@book Volo's Guide to Monsters|vgm}. He spends most of his free time in the taproom of the Yawning Portal, reuniting with old friends and mulling over his next book project.
zh_tw: 誇誇其談的環球旅行家{@creature Volothamp "Volo" Geddarm|ToA|瓦羅贊普·格達姆}在成功地宣傳了他最新的作品{@book 瓦羅怪物指南|vgm}之後，正在深水城享受一些休息時間。他大部分的空閒時間都在呵欠之門的酒吧裡，與老朋友重聚，並思考他的下一個書籍專案。

english: Volo has an inflated opinion of himself and his importance in the world, but he's not without his charm. There is nothing he won't do to help a friend in need.
zh_tw: 瓦羅對自己的評價過高，認為自己在世界上很重要，但他並非沒有魅力。為了幫助需要幫助的朋友，他願意做任何事情。

english: Walking Statues of Waterdeep
zh_tw: 深水城自走雕像

english: Scattered throughout Waterdeep are eight enormous {@creature Walking Statue of Waterdeep|wdh|statues} that can defend the city in times of great peril. Because they are so destructive, the walking statues are used only to fend off armies and seemingly insurmountable foes.
zh_tw: 遍佈深水城的有八個巨大的{@creature Walking Statue of Waterdeep|wdh|雕像}，它們可以在極度危險的時刻保衛城市。由於它們的破壞性極大，行走雕像僅被用來抵禦軍隊和看似不可戰勝的敵人。

english: Each statue has a name and a unique appearance (see "The Walking Statues"), but in terms of statistics they are similar. The statue known as the Swordmaiden is too broken to be animated, and only the wielder of the {@item Blackstaff|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix A|WDH|11}) can animate the other seven.
zh_tw: 每個雕像都有一個名字和獨特的外觀（見"行走的雕像"），但在具體數值方面它們是相似的。被稱為劍女的雕像損壞得太嚴重，無法被活化，只有黑杖（{@item Blackstaff|wdh|黑杖}）的持有者（見{@adventure 附錄A|WDH|11}）才能活化其他七個。

english: Landmarks
zh_tw: 地標

english: Over the years, Waterdavians have built structures around and on top of several of the statues, believing them to be little more than landmarks at this point. In their inanimate state, the statues pose little danger-but any structures attached to a walking statue are destroyed the first time it animates.
zh_tw: 多年來，水城居民在幾座雕像的周圍和頂部建造了建築物，此時他們認為這些不過是地標而已。在它們的無生命狀態下，雕像幾乎沒有危險——但是任何附著在行走雕像上的建築物在它第一次活化時都會被摧毀。

english: Constructed Nature
zh_tw: 構裝本質

english: A walking statue doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.
zh_tw: 行走的雕像不需要空氣、食物、飲水或睡眠。

english: Xanathar
zh_tw: 姍娜薩

english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH} is the name given to the beholder crime lord that lives in the dungeons under Waterdeep. It isn't the first beholder to claim this mantle, nor will it be the last.
zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}是居住在深水城地牢中的眼魔犯罪領主的名字。它不是第一個聲稱這個頭銜的眼魔，也不會是最後一個。

english: Like all beholders, {@creature Xanathar|WDH} is a paranoid tyrant that charms and bullies its minions into servitude. The Xanathar Guild is made up of some of Waterdeep's most disreputable folk, as well as monsters forced into subservience or drawn to the beholder by the promise of treasure, food, or power. Treachery within the ranks of the guild is common as servants vie for the beholder's favor and affection. Such boons are fleeting, though, as the beholder is quick to distrust those who finagle their way into its good graces.
zh_tw: 像所有的眼魔一樣，{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}是一個偏執的暴君，它透過魅惑和恐嚇使其手下臣服。姍娜薩公會由深水城一些最不光彩的人物組成，還有被強迫臣服或被承諾的財寶、食物或權力吸引到眼魔身邊的怪物。在公會的行列中，背叛是常見的，因為僕人們爭奪眼魔的青睞和喜愛。然而，這些恩惠是短暫的，因為眼魔很快就會懷疑那些巧妙地贏得它好感的人。

english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH} lives in a dungeon under Skullport, a subterranean settlement connected to Undermountain's third level. The place resembles a ramshackle town, built inside a giant cavern connected to an underground river. Members of the Xanathar Guild haunt Skullport's dilapidated buildings, and flameskulls patrol its streets.
zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}居住在骷髏港下方的地牢中，骷髏港是一個與地脈迷城第三層相連的地下定居點。這個地方像是一個破敗的城鎮，建在一個連線著地下河的巨大洞穴內部。姍娜薩公會的成員出沒於骷髏港破舊的建築物中，而燃焰之顱在它的街道上巡邏。

english: The only creature {@creature Xanathar|WDH} truly cares about aside from itself is a fish, named {@creature Sylgar|wdh}, that it keeps in a large glass tank. {@creature Xanathar|WDH} has minions that look after the fish constantly, but even their ministrations can't keep such a creature alive forever. Whenever the fish dies, panic spreads through the occupants of the lair as minions try to replace the fish before {@creature Xanathar|WDH} realizes what has happened. Luckily for them, the beholder can't tell one fish from another.
zh_tw: 除了它自己之外，{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}真正關心的唯一生物是一條名為{@creature Sylgar|wdh|斯爾嘉}的魚，它被養在一個大型玻璃水箱中。{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}有手下不斷地照顧這條魚，但即使是他們的照料也不能讓這樣的生物永遠活著。每當這條魚死去，巢穴中的居民就會陷入恐慌，因為手下們試圖在{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}意識到發生了什麼之前替換這條魚。幸運的是，對於他們來說，眼魔無法分辨一條魚和另一條魚的區別。

english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH} is extremely fond of gold. A few years ago, its spies stole the Stone of Golorr, which contained information that led to the discovery of a dwarven vault under Waterdeep. {@creature Xanathar|WDH} was able to open the vault, but was forced out by the dragon inside the place. Recently, someone stole the Stone of Golorr from where it was hidden inside its lair, and the beholder is convinced that the Black Network is behind the theft.
zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}對黃金極為喜愛。幾年前，它的間諜偷走了含有通向深水城下矮人金庫資訊的格洛爾之石。{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}成功開啟了金庫，但被裡面的龍逼了出來。最近，有人從它的巢穴中偷走了格洛爾之石，而眼魔堅信黑網是這次盜竊的幕後黑手。

english: The beholder is caught up in the unbreakable grip of its own paranoia. It sees enemies everywhere, and lashes out at anyone it suspects of being a Zhentarim spy or assassin. Adventurers who attract its attention by dealing with known or suspected Black Network operatives are quickly branded as enemies that must be destroyed.
zh_tw: 這個眼魔被它自己的偏執症緊緊地控制著。它到處看到敵人，對任何它懷疑是散塔林會間諜或刺客的人都猛烈攻擊。那些透過與已知或疑似黑網（黑網）特工打交道而引起它注意的冒險家們很快就會被標記為必須被摧毀的敵人。

english: Game Statistics
zh_tw: 遊戲資料

english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH} is a {@creature beholder} that wears magic rings on three of its eyestalks. It is attuned to all three rings, which don't alter the beholder's challenge rating. It wears a {@item ring of invisibility} on its fear ray eyestalk, a {@item ring of mind shielding} on its sleep ray eyestalk, and a {@item ring of force resistance||ring of resistance (force)} on its slowing ray eyestalk.
zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}是一隻{@creature beholder||眼魔}，它在三隻眼梗上戴著魔法戒指。它與所有三個戒指都有共鳴，這些戒指不會改變眼魔的挑戰等級。它在恐懼射線的眼梗上戴著一個{@item ring of invisibility||隱身戒指}，在睡眠射線的眼梗上戴著一個{@item ring of mind shielding||心靈護盾戒指}，在減速射線的眼梗上戴著一個{@item ring of force resistance||抗性戒指（力場）}。

english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s beloved fish, {@creature Sylgar|wdh}, has the statistics of a {@creature quipper}, except that it lacks the Blood Frenzy trait.
zh_tw: {@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}鍾愛的魚，{@creature Sylgar|wdh|斯爾嘉}，擁有{@creature quipper||食人魚}的具體數值，除了它沒有血腥狂暴特性（血腥狂暴特性）。

english: Yalah Gralhund
zh_tw: 雅拉·格勞洪德

english: The lady of House Gralhund is no fool. She has a keen mind and the wisdom to discern friend from foe. She also has a husband who worships her (see "{@creature Orond Gralhund|wdh}"), and a house that has the resources of the Black Network at its disposal.
zh_tw: 格勞洪德家族的女主人不是傻瓜。她擁有敏銳的頭腦和辨別朋友與敵人的感知。她還有一個崇拜她的丈夫（見"{@creature Orond Gralhund|wdh|奧隆德·格勞洪德}"），以及一個擁有黑網資源的家族。

english: {@creature Yalah Gralhund|wdh|Yalah} stays abreast of events in the city, keeps a tight rein on her children, and uses her station and her family's wealth to pry secrets from the lips of nobles, guildmasters, and commoners alike. Though her previous attempts to become a Masked Lord have been thwarted, she believes it's only a matter of time until that honor is bestowed on her. Once she knows the identities and secrets of enough Masked Lords, Yalah is confident that she can bribe, blackmail, or extort her way into their ranks. From there, she plans to effect changes in the government that will ensure House Gralhund's prosperity for generations to come.
zh_tw: {@creature Yalah Gralhund|wdh|雅拉} 緊跟城市中的事件，嚴格管教她的孩子，並利用她的地位和家族的財富從貴族、行會首領和平民口中探聽秘密。儘管她之前成為蒙面領主的嘗試都失敗了，但她相信獲得這一榮譽只是時間問題。一旦她知道了足夠多蒙面領主的身份和秘密，雅拉有信心她可以透過賄賂、勒索或敲詐的方式進入他們的行列。從那裡開始，她計劃在政府中實施變革，確保格勞洪德家族的繁榮世代相傳。

english: Yalah shares the services of a half-orc bodyguard with her husband, although {@creature Hrabbaz|WDH} (see "{@creature Hrabbaz|WDH}") is more loyal to her than to him. She also uses the Zhentarim who are based in House Gralhund as her personal spy network, not realizing that the Zhents' true master is {@creature Manshoon|WDH}. Most of her dealings are with the Zhent master assassin {@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh} (see "{@creature Urstul Floxin|WDH}"), whom she treats as an underling.
zh_tw: 雅拉與她的丈夫共享一位半獸人保鏢的服務，儘管{@creature Hrabbaz|WDH|哈巴茲}（見"{@creature Hrabbaz|WDH|哈巴茲}"）對她比對她丈夫更忠誠。她還利用駐紮在格勞洪德家族的散塔林會作為自己的私人間諜網路，卻沒有意識到散塔林會真正的主人是{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}。她大部分的交易都是與散塔林會的首席刺客{@creature Urstul Floxin|wdh|厄斯圖爾·弗洛克辛}（見"{@creature Urstul Floxin|WDH|厄斯圖爾·弗洛克辛}"）進行的，她將他視為下屬對待。
